4.description: You fire your weapon as you jump, using the kickback to go farther.

4.name: Instant Backup
4.description: Even as your firearm misfires, you quickly draw a backup weapon.

4.name: Paired Shots
4.description: Your shots hit simultaneously.

4.name: Running Reload
4.description: You can reload your weapon on the move.

4.name: Greenwatch Initiate
4.description: You've received the basic training developed for all Greenwatch recruits.

4.name: Ostentatious Reload
4.description: Every good Firebrand knows that style can be as important as substance—so long as you don't screw up the delivery.

6.name: Advanced Shooter
6.description: You've dedicated your training to mastering even the most complex and weird firearms and crossbows from across the world.

6.name: Cauterize
6.description: You use the smoking barrel of your firearm to sear shut a bleeding wound.

6.name: Drifter's Juke
6.description: You move in and out of range to complement your attacks.

6.name: Munitions Machinist
6.description: You're particularly adept at crafting ammunition and bombs.

6.name: Phalanx Breaker
6.description: You know that to take out an enemy formation, you must punch a hole through its center.

6.name: Pistolero's Challenge
6.description: With a stern call, carefully chosen barb, or some other challenging declaration, you demand your foe's attention in a duel.

6.name: Scatter Blast
6.description: You pack your weapon with additional shot and powder, creating a risky but devastating wave of destruction.

6.name: Sniper's Aim
6.description: You take an extra moment to carefully sync your aim and breathing, then fire a shot with great accuracy.

6.name: Fight or Flight
6.description: You've learned to make use of the surge of adrenaline that comes with fear.

6.name: Seize an Advantage
6.description: You take any momentary advantage you can when fighting dirty.

6.name: Triggerbrand Salvo
6.description: You slice, stab, or batter your opponent with the melee portion of your combination weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range.

6.name: Defy Fey
6.description: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic.

6.name: Fey Tracker
6.description: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice.

6.name: Nightwave Springing Reload
6.description: Training with the crew of the Nightwave has taught you their technique for reloading while leaping to board another ship.

8.name: Bullet Split
8.description: You carefully align your weapon with the edge of your blade, splitting the projectile in two as you fire to attack two different targets.

8.name: Grit and Tenacity
8.description: You call upon deep reserves of toughness and mental fortitude to power through an otherwise debilitating effect.

8.name: Leap and Fire
8.description: You're quick enough to line up a shot even while diving to the ground.

8.name: Smoke Curtain
8.description: You load an extra dose of powder into your shot, causing it to belch a cloud of smoke.

8.name: Stab and Blast
8.description: You slice or smash your opponent with the melee portion of your weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range.

8.name: Cannonball Fall
8.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics
8.description: You've learned how to make a quick descent with a sudden stop—directly on an enemy.

8.name: Greenwatch Veteran
8.description: Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies.

8.name: Unseen Passage
8.description: You have mastered a magical technique for moving through dangerous woodlands unseen.

10.name: Called Shot
10.description: You target a specific area of your foe's anatomy to debilitating effect.

10.name: Deflecting Shot
10.description: You're always ready to take a quick shot to deflect a weapon or distract a foe enough to render them off target.

10.name: Penetrating Fire
10.description: You blast a bullet through one foe and into another.

10.name: Precious Munitions
10.description: You mix flecks of precious materials you've gathered on your journeys into your custom bullets to bring out those properties in your temporary ammunition.

10.name: Rebounding Assault
10.description: You hurl your melee weapon at an opponent, then fire a bullet into the weapon's hilt, making it deal additional damage and bounce back to your grasp.

10.name: Redirecting Shot
10.description: Seeing your ally's attack about to go astray, you fire your weapon to right its course.

10.name: Trick Shot
10.description: You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby.

10.name: Twin Shot Knockdown
10.description: You fire at an enemy while targeting a part of its anatomy that will disrupt its balance.

10.name: Halyard Strike
10.description: You've learned to fight confidently while swinging from a line.

10.name: Greenwatcher
10.description: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled.

12.name: Blood in the Air
12.description: Once you've locked on to a target, little can obscure your aim.

12.name: Deadeye
12.description: You relax your eyes, taking in the presence of hidden things, granting you the ability to locate invisible creatures.

12.name: Flesh Wound
12.description: You fire to ensure that even if your shot doesn't land cleanly, it still lands close enough to deal some damage.

12.name: Ricochet Shot
12.description: You bounce your shot off a nearby surface to strike your opponent from an unexpected angle.

12.name: Shattering Shot
12.description: You fling a bomb into the air and then shoot it with your gun before it falls, raining destruction down over a wide area.

12.name: Shooter's Camouflage
12.description: You specialize in blending into a particular type of environment, able to disappear after taking your shot.

12.name: Unshakable Grit
12.description: You've become hardened by conflict after everything you've faced, and you possess a certain intractable stubbornness.

12.name: Scattering Shot
12.description: You fling a bomb into the air and then shoot it with your gun before it falls, raining destruction down over a wide area.

14.name: Blast Tackle
14.description: You throw yourself at an enemy, bracing your weapon against it and pulling it close before releasing a destructive shot.

14.name: Come at Me!
14.description: You're a legendary duelist, welcoming all challengers, enabling you to challenge many foes even while other challenges are active.

14.name: Dance of Thunder
14.description: Your steps echo with the thunderous retort of exploding black powder as you dance a dance of death.

14.name: Disruptive Blur
14.description: You use cacophonous blasts from your gun or distracting shots from your crossbow to cause momentary diversions, letting you move about the battlefield with impunity.

14.name: Headshot
14.description: You attempt to finish your target with a final, well-placed shot.

14.name: Showstopper
14.description: Your twirling weapons create a grand distraction that's difficult to look away from.

14.name: Two-Weapon Fusillade
14.description: You attack with both your weapons in a furious barrage.

14.name: Think Twice
14.description: You make a sudden threat toward a creature about to attack you that makes them flinch, throwing off their aim.

14.name: Triggerbrand Blitz
14.description: You dance through your foes, stabbing and shooting.

16.name: Fatal Bullet
16.description: You're especially talented at striking your enemies in their most vulnerable areas.

16.name: Hair Trigger
16.prerequisite: initial deed that allows you to Interact to draw a weapon
16.description: No one can react faster than you can pull your trigger.

16.name: Instant Return
16.description: With a single fluid gesture, you catch a projectile out of the air, load it in your weapon, and shoot it back at the attacker.

16.name: Ricochet Master
16.description: You have an eye for angles and can find shots that others believe are impossible.

18.name: Final Shot
18.description: You jam a triple charge of black powder into your weapon to unleash a devastating but risky and inaccurate attack.

18.name: Piercing Critical
18.description: Your attacks with your preferred weapons deal especially devastating wounds.

18.name: Unerring Shot
18.description: Your senses are finely tuned to the slightest variations in the air, so much that you can place your shot exactly where you intend to aim it from any range possible with your weapon.

18.name: Reach for the Stars
18.description: The sky's the limit, as long as you've got enough black powder.

20.name: Perfect Readiness
20.description: You prepare to fire with an instinctive speed and muscle memory that go beyond your conscious thoughts.

20.name: Ricochet Legend
20.description: The more obstacles between you and your target, the deadlier your shots become, as you ricochet off multiple surfaces to hit them.

20.name: Slinger's Reflexes
20.description: Your ability to react to unexpected circumstances is preternaturally sharp.

1.name: Bardic Lore
1.description: Your studies make you informed on every subject.

1.name: Hymn of Healing
1.description: You learn the hymn of healing composition spell, which imbues your music with rich melodies that help your allies recover from harm.

1.name: Lingering Composition
1.description: By adding a flourish, you make your compositions last longer.

1.name: Martial Performance
1.description: Your muse has taught you how to handle a wider variety of weapons than most bards, empowering you to effortlessly blend your performance into combat tools.

1.name: Reach Spell
1.description: You can extend your spells' range.

1.name: Versatile Performance
1.description: You can rely on the grandeur of your performances rather than ordinary social skills.

1.name: Well-Versed
1.description: You're resilient to performative influences that aren't your own.

1.name: Zoophonic Communication
1.description: Your studies have expanded your ability to parley and negotiate into the animal realm.

2.name: Cantrip Expansion
2.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells.

2.name: Directed Audience
2.description: You can shape the area of your composition spells.

2.name: Emotional Push
2.description: You prepare to take advantage of your enemy's sudden change in emotions.

2.name: Esoteric Polymath
2.description: You keep a book of occult spells, similar to a wizard's spellbook, and can use its spells to supplement your spell repertoire.

2.name: Loremaster's Etude
2.description: You magically unlock memories, making them easier to recall.

2.name: Multifarious Muse
2.description: Your muse doesn't fall into a single label.

2.name: Song of Strength
2.description: Your performances inspire strength in your allies to aid them at physical tasks.

2.name: Uplifting Overture
2.description: You learn the uplifting overture composition cantrip, which aids your allies' skills with the inspiring nature of your performance.

2.name: Inspire Competence
2.description: You learn to aid your allies' skills with your performance.

2.name: Reliable Squire
2.description: You know the path to victory isn't traveled alone, and you lend aid to your companions whenever you can.

2.name: Bestial Snarling
2.description: You can convey the subtle menace of a low growl or predatory rumble.

4.name: Combat Reading
4.description: You use a performer's cold reading techniques, aura reading, and other tricks to discover your foe's strengths and weaknesses.

4.name: Courageous Advance
4.description: With a rousing call, you exhort an ally to advance.

4.name: In Tune
4.description: You attune your great skill in performing to another, granting them a small measure of your skill as though anyone could do it.

4.name: Melodious Spell
4.description: You subtly weave your spellcasting into a performance.

4.name: Rallying Anthem
4.description: You learn the rallying anthem composition cantrip, which protects you and allies.

4.name: Ritual Researcher
4.description: Careful research into the art of rituals has made you better at performing them.

4.name: Triple Time
4.description: You learn the triple time composition cantrip, which speeds up you and your allies for a round.

4.name: Versatile Signature
4.description: You're always tweaking your available repertoire.

4.name: Inspire Defense
4.description: You learn to protect yourself and your allies with your performance.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Inspiring Resilience
4.description: You show defiance in times of hardship and inspire your companions to persevere.

4.name: Masquerade of Seasons Stance
4.description: You have mastered the opening steps to the Masquerade of Seasons, a dance that channels the power of spring, summer, winter, and autumn.

4.name: Zoophonic Composition
4.description: When the inspiration strikes, you can weave messages for animals into your compositions.

6.name: Assured Knowledge
6.description: You can procure information with confidence.

6.name: Defensive Coordination
6.description: Like the storied heroes who persist in the face of overwhelming odds, you and your allies will hold the line.

6.name: Dirge of Doom
6.description: You learn the dirge of doom composition cantrip (page 370), which frightens your enemies and keeps them from fully recovering from their fear.

6.name: Educate Allies
6.description: You tweak the properties of your composition spell to convey a bit of your defensive knowledge.

6.name: Harmonize
6.description: You can perform multiple compositions simultaneously,

6.name: Song of Marching
6.description: You learn the song of marching composition cantrip, which enables you and your allies to cross vast distances without strain.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Pirouette
6.description: You twirl gracefully, spinning on one foot to evade your opponent's attack.

8.name: Accompany
8.description: You use your performance to supplement an ally's spellcasting, providing magical energy for their spell in their stead.

8.name: Call and Response
8.description: Your composition takes the form of a call-and-response chant that lets your allies continue the effect without you.

8.name: Eclectic Skill
8.description: Your broad experiences translate to a range of skills.

8.name: Fortissimo Composition
8.description: Your anthems grow louder and more potent, bolstered by your muse's power.

8.name: Know-It-All
8.description: When you Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context.

8.name: Reflexive Courage
8.description: You bellow a ferocious call to arms, inspiring yourself to lash out at a foe.

8.name: Soulsight
8.description: Your muse has opened your senses to the world beyond.

8.name: Inspire Heroics
8.description: Your performances inspire even greater deeds in your allies.

8.name: Courageous Opportunity
8.description: You bellow a ferocious call to arms, inspiring yourself to lash out at a foe.

8.name: Grand Dance
8.description: You can summon the full magic of Bhopan's grand dance.

8.name: Helt's Spelldance
8.description: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique.

8.name: Chaotic Spell
8.description: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

8.name: Ears of the Forest
8.description: Beyond relying on your own senses, you keep an ear open for nearby creatures for help in exploring your surroundings.

8.name: Songbird's Call
8.description: You call to the wilds with the voice of a songbird, thereby summoning a cloud of its kin.

10.name: Annotate Composition
10.description: By putting composition to paper, you can create a source of stirring words or song that others can read and understand.

10.name: Courageous Assault
10.description: With a mighty shout, you can stir an ally to attack.

10.name: House of Imaginary Walls
10.description: You erect an imaginary barrier others believe to be real.

10.name: Ode to Ouroboros
10.description: You learn the ode to ouroboros composition spell (page 371), which enables you to temporarily spare your allies from death.

10.name: Quickened Casting
10.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

10.name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart
10.description: You learn the symphony of the unfettered heart composition spell (page 371), which enables you to protect an ally against incapacitating conditions.

10.name: Unusual Composition
10.description: You can translate the emotion and power of a composition to other mediums.

12.name: Eclectic Polymath
12.description: Your flexible mind can quickly shift from one spell to another.

12.name: Enigma's Knowledge
12.description: Your muse whispers knowledge to you at all the right times.

12.name: Inspirational Focus
12.description: Your connection to your muse has granted you unusual focus.

12.name: Reverberate
12.description: You can manipulate the acoustics around you to deflect sonic damage back at its source.

12.name: Shared Assault
12.description: In the triumph of battle, you can share the glory with another ally.

12.name: Silver's Refrain
12.description: Learn the silver's refrain composition cantrip.

12.name: Shared Sight
12.description: You bestow the mystical vision granted to you by your muse upon your allies.

12.name: Chorus Companion
12.description: Animals can be musical partners as much as the subjects or audience.

14.name: Allegro
14.description: You can quicken your allies with a fast-paced performance.

14.name: Earworm
14.description: By endlessly repeating a motif, you implant a memorable song that repeats over and over again in your allies' heads, preparing them to respond to it later.

14.name: Soothing Ballad
14.description: You soothe your allies' wounds with the power of performance.

14.name: Triumphant Inspiration
14.description: With a triumphant shout, you inspire your allies.

14.name: True Hypercognition
14.description: Your mind works at an incredible pace.

14.name: Vigorous Anthem
14.description: You instill magical vigor in your allies when you inspire them to attack.

14.name: Vigorous Inspiration
14.description: You instill magical vigor in your allies when you inspire them to attack.

14.name: Musical Summons
14.description: Your studies have given you a deeper understanding of animals and beasts, allowing you to call them to your side as you cast your spell.

16.name: Courageous Onslaught
16.description: You use your performance to orchestrate an onslaught against your enemies.

16.name: Effortless Concentration
16.description: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

16.name: Resounding Finale
16.description: You bring your performance to a sudden, dramatic finish, drowning out other sounds.

16.name: Studious Capacity
16.description: Your continued study of occult magic has increased your magical capacity, allowing you to cast spells even when it seems impossible.

18.name: All in my Head
18.description: Using your occult connections and incredible powers of persuasion, you convince yourself that the triggering damage is a figment of your imagination.

18.name: Deep Lore
18.description: Your repertoire is vast, containing far more spells than usual.

18.name: Discordant Voice
18.description: Your courageous anthem lets loose a discordant shriek that imbues your allies' attacks with powerful sonic reverberations.

18.name: Eternal Composition
18.description: The world is a stage upon which you are always playing.

18.name: Impossible Polymath
18.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, or Trained in Religion; Esoteric Polymath
18.description: Your esoteric formulas are so unusual that they allow you to dabble in magic from diverse traditions that other bards don't understand.

18.name: Pack Performance
18.description: When you and animals sing together, your words ring even brighter and bolder, cutting through disruptions.

20.name: Fatal Aria
20.description: Your songs overwhelm the target with unbearable emotion, potentially striking them dead on the spot.

20.name: Perfect Encore
20.description: You develop another incredible creation.

20.name: Pied Piping
20.description: You learn the pied piping composition spell, which enables you to control the actions of weak-minded individuals.

20.name: Symphony of the Muse
20.description: You have learned how to weave countless performances together into a solo symphony with multitudinous effects.

20.name: Ultimate Polymath
20.description: You can flexibly cast all of your spells, granting a dizzying array of possible options.

20.name: Song of the Fallen
20.description: Gain the song of the fallen focus spell.

20.name: Ringmaster's Introduction
20.description: You announce the triggering ally with a litany of their legendary achievements, spurring them to action.

20.name: Head of the Night Parade
20.description: You remember the revelry of the Night Parade and call them to your aid in a riotous display.

1.name: Reach Spell
1.description: You can extend your spells' range.

1.name: Deadly Simplicity
1.prerequisite: deity with a simple or unarmed attack favored weapon, trained with your deity's favored weapon
1.description: When you are wielding your deity's favored weapon, increase the damage die size of that weapon by one step.

1.name: Divine Castigation
1.description: Your deity's grace doesn't extend to your sworn enemies.

1.name: Domain Initiate
1.description: Your deity bestows a special spell related to their powers.

1.name: Harming Hands
1.description: The mordant power of your void energy grows.

1.name: Healing Hands
1.description: Your vitality is even more vibrant and restorative.

1.name: Premonition of Avoidance
1.description: Your deity grants you a moment's foresight.

1.name: Holy Castigation
1.description: You combine holy energy with positive energy to damage demons, devils, and their evil ilk.

1.name: False Faith
1.description: Droskar knows you may need to disguise yourself in societies that oppose your faith.

1.name: Splinter Faith
1.description: Your faith in your deity is represented in an extremely unusual way that some might call heretical

1.name: Syncretism
1.description: You have come to see the overlap between two deities' teachings

1.name: Vile Desecration
1.description: You combine unholy might with negative energy to damage angels, archons, and other self-righteous denizens of the Outer Planes.

2.name: Cantrip Expansion
2.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells.

2.name: Communal Healing
2.description: You're an exceptional conduit for vitality and, as you channel it through you, you can divert some to heal yourself or another creature.

2.name: Emblazon Armament
2.description: Carefully etching a sacred image into a physical object, you steel yourself for battle.

2.name: Panic the Dead
2.description: Vitality strikes terror in the undead.

2.name: Rapid Response
2.description: You work quickly in emergencies.

2.name: Sap Life
2.description: You draw the life force out of your enemies.

2.name: Versatile Font
2.prerequisite: harmful font or healing font; deity that allows clerics to have both fonts
2.description: As you explore your deity's aspects, you move beyond restrictions on healing or harming.

2.name: Warpriest’s Armor
2.description: Your training has helped you adapt to ever-heavier armor.

2.name: Turn Undead
2.description: Undead harmed by your positive energy might flee, compelled by an innate aversion to the force opposite undeath.

2.name: Resilient Mind
2.description: You're firm in your convictions and have girded your mind against outside influence.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Cast Down
6.description: The sheer force of your faith can bring a foe crashing down.

6.name: Divine Rebuttal
6.description: You strive against magical threats physically and spiritually.

6.name: Divine Weapon
6.description: You siphon residual spell energy into a weapon you're wielding.

6.name: Magic Hands
6.description: The blessing of your deity heightens your healing ability, integrating magical healing with the mundane.

6.name: Selective Energy
6.description: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt.

6.name: Detonating Spell
6.description: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.

4.name: Channel Smite
4.description: You siphon the energies of life and death through a melee attack and into your foe.

4.name: Directed Channel
4.description: You can shape the energy you channel in a single direction.

4.name: Divine Infusion
4.description: You pour energy into the subject of your healing to empower its attacks.

4.name: Raise Symbol
4.description: You present your religious symbol emphatically.

4.name: Restorative Strike
4.description: You balance both sides of the scales, restoring yourself while striking a foe.

4.name: Sacred Ground
4.description: You pray continuously for 1 minute to call a subtle shadow of your deity's realm over a 30-foot burst centered on you.

4.name: Command Undead
4.description: You grasp the animating force within an undead creature and bend it to your will.

4.name: Improved Communal Healing
4.description: You can direct excess channeled energy outward to benefit an ally.

4.name: Necrotic Infusion
4.description: You pour negative energy into your undead subject to empower its attacks.

4.name: Expanded Domain Initiate
4.description: You have long venerated one of your deity's lesser-known aspects

4.name: Radiant Infusion
4.description: You pour invigorating positive energy into a living ally.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Undying Conviction
4.prerequisite: able to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
4.description: Your presence has a bolstering effect on your undead minions.

4.name: Prayer-Touched Weapon
4.prerequisite: divine spells, you follow a good-aligned deity
4.description: You coat a weapon you're wielding in prayers and the divine power given to you by your deity.

8.name: Advanced Domain
8.description: Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity's domain.

8.name: Cremate Undead
8.description: Your overwhelming vitality sets undead alight.

8.name: Emblazon Energy
8.description: With elemental forces, you make your emblazoned symbols more potent.

8.name: Martyr
8.description: You go to extreme lengths to support your allies, even when it means bringing harm to yourself.

8.name: Restorative Channel
8.description: You can remove conditions with divine grace.

8.name: Sanctify Armament
8.description: You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity.

8.name: Surging Focus
8.description: When an ally you can see falls in battle, your surge of righteous indignation allows you to draw upon untapped reserves of divine power.

8.name: Void Siphon (Cleric)
8.description: The raw energy of the Void saps the essence of the living.

8.name: Zealous Rush
8.description: You bless yourself on the move.

8.name: Align Armament
8.prerequisite: chaotic, evil, good, or lawful deity
8.description: You bring a weapon into metaphysical concordance with your deity's beliefs.

8.name: Channeled Succor
8.description: You can remove conditions with divine grace.

10.name: Castigating Weapon
10.description: The force of your deity's castigation strengthens your body so you can strike down the enemy and its allies.

10.name: Heroic Recovery
10.description: The restorative power of your healing invigorates the recipient.

10.name: Replenishment of War
10.prerequisite: expert in your deity's favored weapon
10.description: Striking out against your enemies draws praise and protection from your deity.

10.name: Shared Avoidance
10.description: You can project your premonitions of danger to your allies.

10.name: Shield of Faith
10.description: Residual energy from your domain spells bolsters your defenses.

10.name: Improved Command Undead
10.prerequisite: harmful font; Command Undead; evil alignment
10.description: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands.

10.name: Through Spell
10.description: Spells you cast can transform briefly into vital essence, traveling harmlessly through living and undead creatures between you and your target, blocked only by solid objects.

10.name: Consecrate Spell
10.prerequisite: ability to cast focus spells, divine spells
10.description: You infuse a spell with the power of your faith, consecrating it.

10.name: Holy Light
10.description: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light.

12.name: Defensive Recovery
12.description: Your faith provides temporary protection in addition to healing.

12.name: Domain Focus
12.description: Your devotion to your deity's domains grows greater, and so does the power granted to you.

12.name: Emblazon Antimagic
12.description: Your deity's symbol protects against offensive magic.

12.name: Fortunate Relief
12.description: Your god favors your attempts to remove afflictions and conditions.

12.name: Sapping Symbol
12.description: Your religious symbol glows with sacred energy, turning the attacker's strength to weakness.

12.name: Shared Replenishment
12.description: When your deity blesses your warlike acts, you can extend that favor to your allies.

12.name: Necromancer's Visage
12.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
12.description: Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect.

12.name: Miraculous Intervention
12.description: Through divine intervention or whispered prayers, you foil an enemy's response.

14.name: Channeling Block
14.description: You pour divine energy into a desperate block.

14.name: Deity's Protection
14.description: When you call upon your deity's power to fulfill the promise of their domain, you gain divine protection.

14.name: Ebb and Flow
14.description: You can pull forth both vitality and the void simultaneously to harm your enemies and heal your allies.

14.name: Fast Channel
14.description: Divine power is always at your fingertips, swiftly responding to your call.

14.name: Lasting Armament
14.description: When you sanctify a weapon, it remains sanctified for an extended period.

14.name: Premonition of Clarity
14.description: Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks.

14.name: Swift Banishment
14.description: The force of your blow sends your victim back to its home plane.

14.name: Extend Armament Alignment
14.description: The alignment you impose on a weapon lasts much longer.

14.name: Sepulchral Sublimation
14.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
14.description: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice.

14.name: Purifying Breeze
14.description: You transfer the divine essence of your magic to the air around you, cleansing it of toxins.

16.name: Eternal Bane
16.description: Your life has made you a nexus for your deity's vile power.

16.name: Eternal Blessing
16.description: Your deeds have brought your deity's grace to you for all of eternity.

16.name: Rebounding Smite
16.description: The energy from your smite persists for a moment, allowing you to pass it to a new target.

16.name: Remediate
16.description: If your next action is to use your divine font to cast a 3-action heal or harm spell, you can harness the residual energy to counterbalance opposing forces.

16.name: Resurrectionist
16.description: You can cause a creature you bring back from the brink of death to thrive and continue healing.

18.name: Divine Apex
18.description: You can pour divine power into an item, letting the wearer exceed their limits.

18.name: Echoing Channel
18.description: When you pull forth vitality or void energy, you also create a smaller pocket of that energy.

18.name: Improved Swift Banishment
18.description: You easily banish creatures with your weapon.

18.name: Inviolable
18.description: Your deity punishes creatures that harm you.

18.name: Miraculous Possibility
18.description: Your deity empowers you to perform minor miracles, allowing you to readily adapt to the fluctuating needs of your duties.

18.name: Shared Clarity
18.description: You can project your premonitions of clarity to your allies.

18.name: Domain Wellspring
18.description: The intensity of your focus grows from the investment you've placed in your domains.

20.name: Avatar's Audience
20.description: Your extensive service affords you certain divine privileges.

20.name: Avatar's Protection
20.description: In moments of danger, you can call upon your god's form in an instant.

20.name: Maker of Miracles
20.description: You are a conduit for truly deific power.

20.name: Spellshape Channel
20.description: Deep understanding of divine revelations into the nature of vital essence allows you to freely manipulate the energy of life and death.

20.name: Metamagic Channel
20.description: Deep understanding of divine revelations into the nature of vital essence allows you to freely manipulate the effects of your positive or negative energy.

20.name: Emblazon Divinity
20.description: Emblazon more equipment at the same time.

20.name: Denier of Destruction
20.description: You can manipulate the same energies that the aeon orbs use to sustain life.

20.name: Dance of Intercession
20.description: You either performed in or stood witness to the dance used to invoke the Celestial Dragon and can harness a sliver of their power.

1.name: Reach Spell
1.description: You can extend your spells' range.

1.name: Animal Companion
1.description: You gain the service of a young animal companion (page 206) that travels with you on your adventures and obeys any simple commands you give it to the best of its abilities.

1.name: Animal Empathy (Druid)
1.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

1.name: Leshy Familiar
1.description: You call a minor spirit of nature into a plant body, creating a leshy companion to aid you in your spellcasting.

1.name: Plant Empathy
1.description: You have a connection to flora that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

1.name: Storm Born
1.description: You are at home out in the elements, reveling in the power of nature unleashed.

1.name: Untamed Form
1.description: You are one with the wild, always changing and adapting to meet any challenge.

1.name: Verdant Weapon
1.description: You cultivate a seed that can sprout into a wooden staff, vine whip, or another weapon.

1.name: Widen Spell
1.description: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area.

1.name: Wild Shape
1.description: You are one with the wild, always changing and adapting to meet any challenge.

1.name: Fire Lung
1.description: A lifetime of proximity to flames has inured your lungs and eyes to smoke.

1.name: Shore Step
1.description: The shallows and tide pools have always called to you and let you pass unhindered.

1.name: Steadying Stone
1.description: The earth has taught you how to remain unyielding and firm.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Current Spell
6.description: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you.

6.name: Grown of Oak
6.description: You can make your skin take on the woody endurance of an ancient tree and have your familiar follow suit.

6.name: Insect Shape
6.description: Your understanding of life expands, allowing you to mimic a wider range of creatures.

6.name: Instinctive Support
6.description: When you support your animal companion, your companion supports you in turn.

6.name: Storm Retribution
6.description: You lash out, directing a burst of storming fury toward a creature that has harmed you.

6.name: Green Empathy
6.description: You can communicate with plants on a basic level and use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on them and to make very simple Requests of them.

6.name: Advanced Elemental Spell
6.prerequisite: flame order, stone order, storm order, or wave order
6.description: Your connection to one of the great elemental aspects of nature deepens, allowing you further control over its powers.

6.name: Misty Transformation
6.description: Wild mists cover your form.

6.name: Toppling Transformation
6.description: You use your body's expansion as leverage to displace a nearby creature.

6.name: Intensified Element Stance
6.description: You expend the elemental medicine in your body to empower your attacks, though you can't consume any more elemental medicine until the next day.

6.name: Fungal Exhalation
6.description: You can conjure toxic spores to infect enemies.

6.name: Hedge Prison
6.description: You cultivate plants to entrap your foes.

16.name: Effortless Concentration
16.description: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

16.name: Impaling Briars
16.description: You can fill an area with devastating briars.

16.name: Monstrosity Shape
16.description: You can transform into a powerful magical creature.

16.name: Uplifting Winds
16.description: The winds are eager to keep you aloft.

16.name: Too Much to Swallow
16.description: While you might be small enough to grab normally, you can change that at a moment's notice.

2.name: Call of the Wild
2.description: You call upon the creatures of nature to come to your aid.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Order Explorer
2.description: You have learned the secrets of another druidic order, passing whatever rites of initiation that order requires and gaining access to its secrets.

2.name: Poison Resistance
2.description: Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

4.name: Anthropomorphic Shape
4.description: Humanoids' supposed place apart from animals is folly—taking on their forms just requires some extra practice.

4.name: Elemental Summons
4.description: You can call the elements to you.

4.name: Forest Passage
4.description: You can always find a path, almost as if foliage parted before you.

4.name: Form Control
4.description: With additional care and effort, you can take on an alternate shape for a longer period of time.

4.name: Leshy Familiar Secrets
4.description: The leaf order's secrets allow your familiar to take advantage of its leshy form.

4.name: Mature Animal Companion (Druid)
4.description: Your animal companion has grown up over the course of your adventures, becoming a mature animal companion and gaining additional capabilities (page 211).

4.name: Order Magic
4.description: You have delved deeper into the teaching of a new order, gaining access to a coveted order spell.

4.name: Snowdrift Spell
4.description: The howling wind and precipitation of your magic turn to thick snow.

4.name: Cryptic Spell
4.description: You hide your magic in the croak of a frog, in the sway of the trees, in the howl of the wind, and the flicker of the will-o'- wisp.

4.name: Thousand Faces
4.description: Your form is as mutable as the weather, changing to meet your whim.

4.name: Woodland Stride
4.description: You can always find a path, almost as if foliage parted before you.

4.name: Fire Resistance
4.description: Your connection to heat and flame means that fire is reluctant to bring its full force to bear against you.

4.name: Natural Swimmer
4.description: Water flows around you, letting you cut through the waves as if born to it.

4.name: Sheltering Cave
4.description: You spend 10 minutes communing with spirits of earth and stone, requesting shelter.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Brutal Crush
4.description: You've learned how to cloud your foes' minds with the brutal impact of your repeated attacks.

4.name: Creature Comforts
4.description: You've found comfort in the forms of other creatures, insulating yourself from feelings of fear.

4.name: Rip and Tear
4.description: You've learned to debilitate your enemies in the same way a hunter tears at their prey.

8.name: Deimatic Display
8.description: Imitating animal threat displays, you make yourself appear larger and more imposing.

8.name: Ferocious Shape
8.description: You've mastered the shape of dinosaurs.

8.name: Fey Caller
8.description: You have learned some of the tricks the fey use to bend primal magic toward illusions and trickery.

8.name: Floral Restoration
8.description: You request that nearby plants share their vitality with you to replenish your body and magic.

8.name: Incredible Companion (Druid)
8.description: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

8.name: Raise Menhir
8.description: You raise a druidic monument, such as a standing stone or warding tree, from the ground, creating a powerful primal ward that blocks other types of magic.

8.name: Soaring Shape
8.description: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below.

8.name: Wind Caller
8.description: You bid the winds to aid you, carrying you through the air and allowing you passage through the strongest headwinds.

8.name: Can't You See?
8.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; Expert in Stealth
8.description: The eye rebels, the mind recoils—no matter how much those who can see you try to explain what's there, their friends' gazes just skitter over you, like a bird afraid to land.

8.name: Eerie Environs
8.prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Stealth
8.description: The natural world can be scary to those not used to it—and you make it scarier still.

8.name: Eerie Traces
8.prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Survival
8.description: The tracks you leave behind are strange, somehow disconcerting and unnerving—they might travel backward, or through places no one would think to pass through.

8.name: Forgotten Presence
8.description: The world conspires to keep you forgotten and unnoticed— memories cloud, ink stains out your name in ledgers, and portraits of you crack and warp over your face.

8.name: Fiery Retort
8.description: Ignoring your pain, you sear your attacker with a wave of flame.

10.name: Elemental Shape
10.description: You understand the fundamental elements of nature such that you can imbue them into your body and manifest as a living embodiment of those elements.

10.name: Healing Transformation
10.description: You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries.

10.name: Overwhelming Energy
10.description: With a complex gesture, you call upon the primal power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances.

10.name: Plant Shape
10.description: You can take the shape of a plant creature.

10.name: Primal Howl
10.description: Your companion can let out a howl laced with your primal magic.

10.name: Pristine Weapon
10.description: Your verdant weapon can cut through the resistances of magical creatures.

10.name: Side by Side (Druid)
10.description: You and your animal companion fight in tandem, distracting your foes and keeping them off balance.

10.name: Thunderclap Spell
10.description: Your lightning splits the air, generating a booming shock wave.

10.name: Eerie Proclamation
10.prerequisite: Expert in Occultism; Expert in Survival
10.description: You know there are places in the world that are just wrong— places where the birds don't sing and where you always feel like you're being watched.

10.name: Harden Flesh
10.description: You fortify your skin with minerals drawn from earth and stone.

12.name: Dragon Shape
12.description: You can take on the shape of some of the world's most fearsome creatures.

12.name: Garland Spell
12.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the fungus or plant trait, a garland of plants grows in a 10-foot burst in the spell's range.

12.name: Primal Focus
12.description: Your connection to nature is particularly strong, and the spirits of nature flock around you, helping you replenish your focus.

12.name: Primal Summons
12.description: Whenever you summon an ally, you can empower it with the elemental power of air, earth, fire, or water.

12.name: Wandering Oasis
12.description: You're surrounded by soothing energy.

12.name: Green Tongue
12.description: You share a special kinship with all things green and living.

12.name: Pesh Skin
12.description: Your plant form sprouts hundreds of spines, and your blood causes mild hallucinations in creatures exposed to it.

12.name: Purifying Spell
12.description: You purify the water within a creature's body to cleanse them of illness.

12.name: Necromantic Deflection
12.description: You imbue your shield with life-giving energy to deflect harmful necromantic magic.

12.name: Defensive Dismissal
12.description: You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow.

12.name: Explosive Metamorphosis
12.description: You use additional primal energy to transform, creating a burst of elemental energy to complement your transformation.

14.name: Reactive Transformation
14.prerequisite: Untamed Form; Dragon Shape, Elemental Shape, Plant Shape, or Soaring Shape
14.description: You transform reflexively when in danger.

14.name: Sow Spell
14.description: You fold your spell into a seed.

14.name: Specialized Companion (Druid)
14.description: Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability.

14.name: Timeless Nature
14.description: With primal magic sustaining you, you cease aging.

14.name: Verdant Metamorphosis
14.description: You have turned into a plant version of yourself, gaining the plant trait and losing traits inappropriate for your new form (typically humanoid).

14.name: Bizarre Transformation
14.description: The forms you take on defy belief—chimerical sights of twisted antlers or acidic drool.

14.name: Cleansing Transformation
14.description: You learn to cleanse bodily toxins alongside the transformations of your shape-changing magic.

14.name: Towering Transformation
14.description: The physical growth of your transformation is a spectacle that shakes foes to their core.

18.name: Invoke Disaster
18.description: You can invoke nature's fury upon your foes.

18.name: Perfect Form Control
18.description: Thanks to magic and muscle memory, you can stay in your alternate shapes indefinitely.

18.name: Primal Aegis
18.description: You surround yourself with a thick field of protective primal energy.

18.name: Primal Wellspring
18.description: Your reservoir of Focus Points is a deep wellspring.

20.name: Hierophant's Power
20.description: You have entwined yourself with the natural world, and its full power flows through you.

20.name: Ley Line Conduit
20.description: You can draw magic from the ley lines of the world.

20.name: True Shapeshifter
20.description: You transcend the limitations of form.

20.name: Leyline Conduit
20.description: You can cast your spells effortlessly by tapping into the leylines of the world.

20.name: Apex Companion
20.description: Gain the apex companion focus spell.

20.name: Verdant Presence
20.description: The life-giving properties of the aeon orbs flourish within you.

20.name: Heart of the Kaiju
20.description: Witnessing the might of a kaiju up close awoke a new ferocity within you.

1.name: Reach Spell
1.description: You can extend your spells' range.

1.name: Widen Spell
1.description: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area.

1.name: Cackle
1.description: Your patron's power fills you with confidence, letting you sustain a magical working even as a quick burst of laughter leaves your lips.

1.name: Cauldron
1.description: You can brew magic in your cauldron, creating useful magical concoctions.

1.name: Counterspell
1.description: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it.

1.name: Witch's Armaments
1.description: Your patron's power changes your body to ensure you are never defenseless.

1.name: Wortwitch
1.description: You have a particular affinity for leafy plants.

2.name: Cantrip Expansion
2.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Basic Lesson
2.description: Your patron grants you a special lesson, revealing a hidden facet of its nature.

2.name: Conceal Spell
2.description: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable.

2.name: Familiar's Language
2.description: You've learned to speak with your familiar and other creatures like it.

2.name: Living Hair
2.description: You can instantly grow or shrink your hair, eyebrows, beard, or mustache by up to several feet and manipulate your hair for use as a weapon, though your control isn't fine enough for more dexterous tasks.

2.name: Scatter Swarm
2.description: Your patron reaches through your familiar to magically disperse a group of smaller threats.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Ceremonial Knife
6.description: You have prepared a special knife to direct energies when spellcasting.

6.name: Greater Lesson
6.description: Your patron grants you greater knowledge.

6.name: Witch's Charge
6.description: You forge a magical link with another creature, granting you awareness of that creature's condition and creating a conduit for spellcasting.

6.name: Syu Tak-Nwa's Deadly Hair
6.description: Your hair deals increased damage and can grapple.

6.name: Detonating Spell
6.description: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.

6.name: Divine Emissary
6.prerequisite: a familiar, you follow a good-aligned deity or patron
6.description: Your familiar is a divine emissary, sent to you by your deity or patron and infused with celestial powers.

6.name: Wild Witch's Armaments
6.description: Your patron's power continues to enhance your natural offensive capabilities.

10.name: Quickened Casting
10.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

10.name: Double, Double
10.description: For each temporary oil or potion you brew during your daily preparations, you brew two copies of it.

10.name: Major Lesson
10.description: Your patron grants you even greater secrets.

10.name: Witch's Communion
10.description: You can keep watch over multiple charges.

10.name: Temporary Potions
10.description: During your daily preparations, you can create a batch of two temporary oils or potions using a formula you know.

16.name: Effortless Concentration
16.description: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

16.name: Siphon Power
16.description: You draw upon the reservoir of your patron's magic that resides within your familiar.

4.name: Rites of Convocation
4.description: Your patron grants you the power to summon other creatures to aid you.

4.name: Sympathetic Strike
4.description: You collect your patron's magic into one of your witch armaments, causing them to shine with runes, light, or another signifier of your patron.

4.name: Eldritch Nails
4.description: Your nails are supernaturally long and sharp.

4.name: Improved Familiar (Witch)
4.description: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

4.name: Syu Tak-Nwa's Skillful Tresses
4.description: You can expertly control your living hair and use it to perform various tasks.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Portents of the Haruspex
4.description: Although the divinations of a haruspex traditionally require organs and lengthy interpretation, you've learned how to glimpse the future in a more simple fashion by reading creatures' wounds.

8.name: Incredible Familiar
8.description: Your familiar is imbued with even more magic than other familiars.

8.name: Murksight
8.description: Your vision pierces through non-magical fog, mist, rain, and snow.

8.name: Spirit Familiar (Witch)
8.description: Your familiar can subsume its body to become pure spirit.

8.name: Stitched Familiar
8.description: Your familiar can shed its material form, becoming a mass of animated magic.

8.name: Witch’s Bottle
8.description: You spend 10 minutes and 1 Focus Point brewing a special potion containing the power of one of your hexes that targets a creature.

8.name: Witch's Bottle
8.description: You spend 10 minutes and 1 Focus Point brewing a special potion containing the power of one of your hexes that targets a creature.

8.name: Syu Tak-Nwa's Hexed Locks
8.description: Your hair attacks gain the reach trait and you can deliver hexes through it.

8.name: Helt's Spelldance
8.description: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique.

8.name: Chaotic Spell
8.description: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

12.name: Coven Spell
12.description: You rhyme with your ally's incantations or echo their movements, linking your magic to empower their spell in one of two ways.

12.name: Hex Focus
12.description: Your patron's teachings have allowed you to achieve a deeper focus.

12.name: Witch’s Broom
12.description: A broom is the only steed you need to fly through the night sky.

12.name: Familiar's Eyes
12.description: You use your familiar's senses as easily as your own.

14.name: Patron’s Presence
14.description: Your patron can direct its attention through your familiar, and its mere presence becomes an ominous weight on the minds of other beings to distract them and blot out their magic.

14.name: Reflect Spell
14.description: When you successfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can turn that spell's effect back on its caster.

14.name: Rites of Transfiguration
14.description: You can adapt your patron's power to transform other creatures into forms more befitting their behavior or your whims.

18.name: Patron’s Claim
18.description: Your patron partially manifests itself through your familiar to claim a foe's power for its own.

18.name: Split Hex
18.description: You siphon some of the power from an offensive hex you cast to direct it at a second target as well.

18.name: Hex Wellspring
18.description: Focus flows from your patron each time you commune with your familiar.

20.name: Hex Master
20.description: You embody the link to your patron so completely that you can cast your hexes in rapid succession.

20.name: Patron's Truth
20.description: You have mastered the greatest secrets of your patron's magic and learned a fundamental truth about your patron, even if their identity still remains a mystery.

20.name: Witch's Hut
20.description: Your home is an animated structure that obeys your commands.

20.name: Demon's Hair
20.description: Your hair constantly wriggles and writhes.

1.name: Reach Spell
1.description: You can extend your spells' range.

1.name: Widen Spell
1.description: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area.

1.name: Counterspell
1.description: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it.

1.name: Familiar
1.description: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.

1.name: Spellbook Prodigy
1.description: You are particularly adept at learning spells to add to your spellbook.

1.name: Eschew Materials
1.description: You can use clever workarounds to replicate the arcane essence of certain materials.

1.name: Hand of the Apprentice
1.description: You can magically hurl your weapon at your foe.

2.name: Cantrip Expansion
2.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Conceal Spell
2.description: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable.

2.name: Energy Ablation
2.description: As you direct destructive energy at a foe, you can divert some of its power into a protective barrier that shields you from harm.

2.name: Nonlethal Spell
2.description: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly.

2.name: Elemental Defense
2.description: You attune yourself to elemental power so that you gain a burst of protection when you call upon it.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Convincing Illusion
6.description: You use your deceptive skills to make your illusions seem even more real.

6.name: Explosive Arrival
6.description: Your summoned creature appears in a detonation of arcane runes.

6.name: Irresistible Magic
6.description: You've studied ways of overcoming the innate defenses against magic that dragons, otherworldly beings, and certain other powerful creatures have.

6.name: Split Slot
6.description: You can prepare two spells in one slot, giving you the freedom to choose the spell when you cast it.

6.name: Shrink Spell
6.description: You've learned to manipulate space to narrow the impact of other spells.

6.name: Spell Penetration
6.description: You've studied ways of overcoming the innate magical resistance that certain powerful creatures have.

6.name: Detonating Spell
6.description: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.

10.name: Quickened Casting
10.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

10.name: Overwhelming Energy
10.description: With a complex gesture, you call upon the primal power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances.

10.name: Scroll Adept
10.description: During your daily preparations, you can create two temporary scrolls containing arcane spells from your spellbook.

10.name: Shared Focus
10.description: Your magical expertise allows you to perform a metaphorical sleight of hand to manifest a Focus Point.

10.name: Spatial Awareness
10.description: Your study of different planes of existence makes you more attuned to teleportation effects.

10.name: Scroll Savant
10.description: During your daily preparations, you can create two temporary scrolls containing arcane spells from your spellbook.

16.name: Effortless Concentration
16.description: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

16.name: Scintillating Spell
16.description: Your spells become a radiant display of light and color.

16.name: Spell Tinker
16.description: You've learned to alter choices you make when casting spells on yourself.

14.name: Reflect Spell
14.description: When you successfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can turn that spell's effect back on its caster.

14.name: Bonded Focus
14.description: Your connection to your bonded item increases your focus pool.

14.name: Secondary Detonation Array
14.description: You divert some of your spell's energy into an unstable runic array.

14.name: Superior Bond
14.description: When you draw upon your bonded item, you can leave a bit of energy within it for later use.

14.name: Dizzying Spell
14.description: Your spell leaves a foe's head spinning and unable to concentrate.

14.name: Shift Spell
14.description: You move an active spell's area to a new location.

14.name: Sepulchral Sublimation
14.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
14.description: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice.

4.name: Bespell Strikes
4.description: You siphon spell energy into one weapon you're wielding, or into one of your unarmed attacks, such as a fist.

4.name: Call Wizardly Tools
4.description: You're mystically connected to your wizardly tools, ensuring you can always find them when you've misplaced them.

4.name: Linked Focus
4.description: You have linked your bonded item to the well of energy that powers your school spells.

4.name: Spell Protection Array
4.description: You inscribe a circle of arcane runes that dampen enemies' magic.

4.name: Incriminating Spell
4.description: You can attempt to blame someone else for your attempt to modify a target's mind.

4.name: Bespell Weapon
4.description: You siphon the residual energy from the last spell you cast into one weapon you're wielding.

4.name: Silent Spell
4.description: You've learned how to cast many of your spells without speaking the words of power you would normally need to provide.

4.name: Call Bonded Item
4.description: You're mystically connected to your bonded item and can call it to your hand.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Undying Conviction
4.prerequisite: able to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
4.description: Your presence has a bolstering effect on your undead minions.

8.name: Advanced School Spell
8.description: You gain access to the advanced teachings of your arcane institution, learning a powerful new school spell.

8.name: Bond Conservation
8.description: By efficiently and carefully manipulating the arcane energies unleashed by your bonded item, you can conserve just enough power to cast another spell, though this second spell is slightly weaker.

8.name: Form Retention
8.description: You have trained your mind and body to tolerate polymorph magic for longer periods of time, so long as you prepare for the change appropriately.

8.name: Knowledge is Power (Wizard)
8.description: Your academic knowledge about a creature allows you to subtly alter your magic to defeat them.

8.name: Knockback Spell
8.description: You imbue your spells with magical force to knock creatures back.

8.name: Spellbinding Speech
8.description: All the time you've spent discussing esoteric theses and performing spell incantations has made your words magical even when you aren't casting a full spell.

8.name: Universal Versatility
8.prerequisite: universalist wizard; Hand of the Apprentice
8.description: You can access the fundamental abilities of any school of magic.

8.name: Helt's Spelldance
8.description: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique.

8.name: Chaotic Spell
8.description: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

12.name: Clever Counterspell
12.description: You creatively apply your prepared spells to Counterspell a much wider variety of your opponents' magic.

12.name: Forcible Energy
12.description: You perform complex manipulations to make the energy from your spells so powerful that your enemies remain vulnerable to it afterward.

12.name: Keen Magical Detection
12.description: You sense magical dangers.

12.name: Magic Sense
12.description: You have a literal sixth sense for ambient magic in your vicinity.

12.name: Redirect Teleportation
12.description: You're able to intercept a teleportation effect and change where a creature appears.

12.name: Diviner Sense
12.description: You sense magical dangers.

12.name: Necromancer's Visage
12.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
12.description: Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect.

18.name: Infinite Possibilities
18.description: You can prepare a spell slot that exists in your mind as many different possibilities at once.

18.name: Reprepare Spell
18.description: You've discovered how to reuse some of your spell slots over and over.

18.name: Second Thoughts
18.description: When your target proves resilient to your magical deceptions, you can try them again on someone else.

18.name: Second Chance Spell
18.description: When your target proves resilient to your magical deceptions, you can try them again on someone else.

20.name: Archwizard's Might
20.description: You have mastered the greatest secrets of arcane magic.

20.name: Spell Combination
20.description: You can merge spells, producing multiple effects with a single casting.

20.name: Spell Mastery
20.description: You have mastered a handful of spells to such a degree that you can cast them even if you haven't prepared them in advance.

20.name: Spellshape Mastery
20.description: Your mastery of magic ensures that you can alter your spells just as easily as you can cast them normally.

20.name: Metamagic Mastery
20.description: Altering your spells doesn't take any longer than casting them normally.

20.name: Reclaim Spell
20.description: You have learned to manipulate reflections of magic, similar to the resonant reflections.

20.name: Worldsphere Gravity
20.description: Though creating demiplanes usually requires lengthy rituals, you know how to establish minor planar effects.

1.name: Reach Spell
1.description: You can extend your spells' range.

1.name: Widen Spell
1.description: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area.

1.name: Foretell Harm
1.description: Your magic echoes ominously as you glimpse injury in the target's future.

1.name: Glean Lore
1.description: You tap into the collected lore of the divine, accessing a variety of potentially useful information.

1.name: Nudge the Scales
1.description: You lay a finger on the scales of life and death to heal a creature, regardless of whether it's living or undead.

1.name: Oracular Warning
1.description: You have a premonition about impending danger that you use to warn your allies.

1.name: Whispers of Weakness
1.description: Voices whisper to you how to best lay a creature low.

1.name: Trance of Celerity
1.description: Your feet move faster, almost out of your conscious control.

2.name: Cantrip Expansion
2.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells.

2.name: Divine Aegis
2.description: A barrier offers protection against other magic but leaves you exposed to divine energy.

2.name: Domain Acumen
2.description: Every oracle's mystery touches on a divine domain of the deities that fuel it; you can access that power.

2.name: Meddling Futures
2.description: You open yourself to the guidance of whatever spirits or powers deign to help you.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Advanced Revelation
6.description: Divine power reveals greater mysteries to you.

6.name: Gifted Power
6.description: Your mystery grants you additional magic.

6.name: Spiritual Sense
6.description: You have a vague connection to the Ethereal Plane that enables you to notice spirits.

6.name: Detonating Spell
6.description: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.

10.name: Quickened Casting
10.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

10.name: Roll the Bones of Fate
10.description: You roll a handful of bones to learn (or perhaps influence) the future course of events.

10.name: The Dead Walk
10.description: You beseech warrior spirits to come forth and aid you.

10.name: Trial by Skyfire
10.description: Your lips murmur as you portend a great disaster, one you hope you survive.

10.name: Waters of Creation
10.description: Water is the source of life, and you draw upon this primordial force to heal your allies' wounds.

10.name: On Borrowed Time
10.description: You accelerate a foe's personal timestream, which causes them to experience time at a faster rate, putting a terrible strain on their mind and body.

10.name: Consecrate Spell
10.prerequisite: ability to cast focus spells, divine spells
10.description: You infuse a spell with the power of your faith, consecrating it.

4.name: Bespell Strikes
4.description: You siphon spell energy into one weapon you're wielding, or into one of your unarmed attacks, such as a fist.

4.name: Knowledge of Shapes
4.description: Inspiration lets you surpass your preconceptions of your spells' limits.

4.name: Thousand Visions
4.description: You open your senses to numerous visions of the immediate future.

4.name: Sacral Lord
4.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
4.description: By right of ritual or sheer stubbornness, you have claimed rulership of the land.

4.name: Bespell Weapon
4.description: You siphon the residual energy from the last spell you cast into one weapon you're wielding.

4.name: Divine Access
4.description: Your ability to tap into divine magic surpasses the spells traditionally available to you (the divine spell list).

4.name: Vision of Weakness
4.description: You can call upon divine insights to single out your foes' weak points.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Undying Conviction
4.prerequisite: able to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
4.description: Your presence has a bolstering effect on your undead minions.

4.name: Prayer-Touched Weapon
4.prerequisite: divine spells, you follow a good-aligned deity
4.description: You coat a weapon you're wielding in prayers and the divine power given to you by your deity.

12.name: Magic Sense
12.description: You have a literal sixth sense for ambient magic in your vicinity.

12.name: Domain Fluency
12.description: You command a deep understanding of the domains related to your mystery.

12.name: Epiphany at the Crossroads
12.description: The crossroads between life and death is a place that can reveal many secrets.

12.name: Greater Revelation
12.description: You unlock deeper revelations hidden within your mystery.

12.name: Necromancer's Visage
12.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
12.description: Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect.

8.name: Debilitating Dichotomy
8.description: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well.

8.name: Read Disaster
8.description: You spend 10 minutes and open yourself to the divine mysteries of the world, peering into the most sinister portents of the future.

8.name: Surging Might
8.description: You focus the power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances.

8.name: Water Walker
8.description: When in the throes of your curse, your steps take on a supernatural buoyancy.

8.name: Chaotic Spell
8.description: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

14.name: Forestall Curse
14.description: You've learned to hold back your curse.

14.name: Lighter than Air
14.description: Your mysterious steps become even lighter, transcending the mortal world altogether.

14.name: Mysterious Repertoire
14.description: Your mystery holds unknowable depths of magic not always associated with the divine.

14.name: Revelation's Focus
14.description: The further extents of your mystery provide an endless wellspring of magic.

14.name: Sacral Monarch
14.prerequisite: Sacral Lord; Master in Occultism or Master in Religion
14.description: You have come into your full powers and are truly a monarch of your realm, by your own definition at least.

14.name: Sepulchral Sublimation
14.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
14.description: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice.

14.name: Purifying Breeze
14.description: You transfer the divine essence of your magic to the air around you, cleansing it of toxins.

16.name: Conduit of Void and Vitality
16.description: You use the unstable energy of your curse to manipulate the most basic of divine magic.

16.name: Diverse Mystery
16.description: You have broadened your understanding of the divine and can tap into the wonders of a different mystery.

16.name: Portentous Spell
16.description: Your spellcasting is rife with strange lights, mild fumes, and other captivating effects that befuddle your foes.

18.name: Blaze of Revelation
18.description: Your mind and body can, for a short time and with great peril, surpass the final limits of your curse.

18.name: Divine Effusion
18.description: The power of your mystery surges through you like a font of divine energy, even when your own magic dwindles.

20.name: Mystery Conduit
20.description: The power of your mystery enables you access to myriad magic.

20.name: Oracular Providence
20.description: Your mystery grants you access to deep reserves of truly miraculous divine power.

20.name: Paradoxical Mystery
20.description: The truest depths of your divine mystery are fathomless and contradictory, granting you changing powers that even you can barely begin to fathom.

20.name: Scapegoat Parallel Self
20.description: You've realized a way to manipulate the effects of your oracular curse.

1.description: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area.

1.name: Familiar
1.description: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.

1.name: Blood Rising
1.description: The magic in your blood surges in response to your foe's spell.

1.name: Tap Into Blood
1.description: The power in your blood allows you to perform minor feats of magic.

1.name: Dangerous Sorcery
1.description: Your legacy grants you great destructive power.

1.name: Blessed Blood (Sorcerer)

1.description: Your deity's blessings manifest in your blood-borne power

1.name: Ancestral Blood Magic

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Anoint Ally
2.description: You forge a mystical connection with an ally using a drop of your blood, allowing them to benefit from your magic.

2.name: Bleed Out
2.description: You channel the residual energy from the last spell you cast into a ranged bloodletting.

2.name: Propelling Sorcery
2.description: The force of your magic can be used to propel yourself or another.

2.name: Entreat with Forebears
2.prerequisite: a bloodline that corresponds with a creature trait
2.description: Something about your presence causes creatures of your bloodline to, consciously or not, recognize you as one of their own, and you become inured to their tricks.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting

6.name: Advanced Bloodline
6.description: You draw more power from your bloodline.

6.name: Diverting Vortex
6.description: You use vestiges of magic to create a protective vortex.

6.name: Energy Ward
6.description: You convert energy from the last spell you cast into a protective ward.

6.name: Safeguard Spell
6.description: You are inured to the effects of your own spells.

6.name: Spell Relay
6.description: You open the power in your blood to your ally's spellcasting, using your magic to boost their range.

6.name: Energetic Resonance
6.description: Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells.

6.name: Detonating Spell
6.description: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.

6.name: Divine Emissary
6.prerequisite: a familiar, you follow a good-aligned deity or patron
6.description: Your familiar is a divine emissary, sent to you by your deity or patron and infused with celestial powers.

8.name: Soulsight
8.description: Your muse has opened your senses to the world beyond.

8.name: Bloodline Resistance
8.description: Your magical blood makes you more resistant to magic.

8.name: Crossblooded Evolution
8.description: Odd interactions in your bloodline provide you with unexpected effects.

8.name: Explosion of Power
8.description: Your magic explodes.

8.name: Safeguarded Spell
8.description: You bring the magical wavelengths of your spell into sync with the ones produced by your own body.

8.name: Helt's Spelldance
8.description: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique.

8.description: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

10.name: Quickened Casting
