10.name: Overwhelming Energy
10.description: With a complex gesture, you call upon the primal power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances.

10.name: Energy Fusion
10.description: You fuse two spells together, combining their energy types.

10.name: Greater Bloodline
10.description: You uncover the greater secrets of your bloodline.

10.name: Signature Spell Expansion
10.description: Your innate connection to magic lets you cast more spells with greater freedom.

10.name: Ancestral Mage
10.description: The magic of your ancestry and bloodline are one and the same.

10.name: Consecrate Spell
10.prerequisite: ability to cast focus spells, divine spells
10.description: You infuse a spell with the power of your faith, consecrating it.

16.name: Effortless Concentration
16.description: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

16.name: Scintillating Spell
16.description: Your spells become a radiant display of light and color.

16.name: Greater Mental Evolution
16.description: Your bloodline's deep connection to mental essence greatly enhances your spell repertoire.

16.name: Greater Vital Evolution
16.description: Vital power surges through you like a font of energy.

16.name: Terraforming Spell
16.description: You capture transformative fragments of magic and slam them into the ground, creating a shock wave that alters your surroundings.

4.name: Bespell Strikes

4.name: Arcane Evolution
4.description: Your arcane legacy allows you to perceive how magic affects everything.

4.name: Divine Evolution
4.description: The divine might provided by your bloodline flows through you.

4.name: Occult Evolution
4.description: You draw power from the obscure secrets of the universe.

4.name: Primal Evolution
4.description: You can call upon the creatures of the wild for aid.

4.name: Split Shot
4.description: You fragment a ranged spell.

4.name: Bespell Weapon
4.description: You siphon the residual energy from the last spell you cast into one weapon you're wielding.

4.name: Elaborate Flourish
4.description: You embellish your spellcasting with entrancing flourishes and grand pronouncements, making it harder to identify or counter.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo

4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

12.name: Magic Sense
12.description: You have a literal sixth sense for ambient magic in your vicinity.

12.name: Blood Sovereignty
12.description: You wield blood magic masterfully.

12.name: Bloodline Focus
12.description: By listening to the beating of your heart, your focus recovers faster.

12.name: Greater Physical Evolution
12.description: You change form readily.

12.name: Greater Spiritual Evolution
12.description: Your magical blood allows your spells to be fully effective against incorporeal creatures.

12.name: Terraforming Trickery
12.description: You know how to channel the transformative aspects of your blood magic to alter your surroundings.

12.name: Blood Component Substitution
12.description: You can bypass the need for incantations and gestures by drawing energy directly from your blood, causing you to visibly glow the color of your blood and crackle with magical energy.

12.name: Shared Sight
12.description: You bestow the mystical vision granted to you by your muse upon your allies.

20.name: Spellshape Mastery
20.description: Your mastery of magic ensures that you can alter your spells just as easily as you can cast them normally.

20.name: Bloodline Conduit
20.description: Your inborn magical nature lets you redirect ambient energies to fuel your spells.

20.name: Bloodline Mutation
20.prerequisite: a bloodline based on a specific type of creature
20.description: You permanently mutate to become more like the creatures of your bloodline.

20.name: Bloodline Perfection
20.description: You command the ultimate powers of your bloodline and tradition.

20.name: Metamagic Mastery
20.description: Altering your spells doesn't take any longer than casting them normally.

20.name: Bloodline Metamorphosis
20.description: Swap out spells from your repertoire more easily.

20.name: Tenacious Blood Magic
20.description: You have learned how to invest magic more deeply by witnessing Aroden's works.

20.name: Ruby Resurrection
20.description: In a burst of flame, you return to health like a phoenix rising from the ashes.

14.name: Blood Ascendancy
14.description: When you would benefit from a blood magic effect through Blood Rising, you can choose to benefit from two different blood magic effects you know.

14.name: Interweave Dispel
14.description: You weave dispelling energy into a spell.

14.name: Reflect Harm
14.description: You can wrap your magic around you like a cloak that causes those who dare to target you with spells to suffer a similar fate.

14.name: Spell Shroud
14.description: Your spell shrouds you in a billowing cloud.

14.name: Consume Spell
14.description: When you successfully Counterspell a spell of the tradition that matches your bloodline, you consume it, replenishing yourself with its energy.

14.name: Purifying Breeze
14.description: You transfer the divine essence of your magic to the air around you, cleansing it of toxins.

18.name: Echoing Spell
18.description: You time the components of your spell with exacting precision, setting up a resonance that duplicates the spell's effects.

18.name: Greater Crossblooded Evolution
18.description: Your bloodline is extraordinarily complex.

18.name: Bloodline Wellspring
18.description: Your blood's power replenishes your focus.

2.name: Cantrip Expansion
2.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells.

2.name: Mental Balm
2.description: Your spells release soothing mental waves.

2.name: Psi Burst
2.description: With a passing thought, you direct violent psychic energies at a nearby creature.

2.name: Warp Space
2.description: You use your magic to bend space, causing your spell to strike from a strange vector.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Inertial Barrier
6.description: Your spell leaves behind barriers that reduce shock and motion.

6.name: Parallel Breakthrough
6.description: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty.

6.name: Sixth Sense
6.description: Your psychic abilities also allow you to detect the lingering thoughts of spirits and similar entities.

6.name: Strain Mind
6.description: You strain your body beyond its limits to use an amp even when your mental power is depleted.

10.name: Signature Spell Expansion
10.description: Your innate connection to magic lets you cast more spells with greater freedom.

10.name: Dream Guise
10.description: You Stride into a willing ally's space, at which point both of your appearances shift into a shared third appearance, usually one that looks like a mix of the two of you.

10.name: Emotional Surge
10.description: Your heart soars, increasing your power for a moment.

10.name: Impose Order (Psychic)
10.description: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform.

10.name: Scour the Library
10.description: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan.

1.name: Ancestral Mind
1.description: By unraveling memories and connections passed down from your progenitors and buried within your unconscious mind, you learn to convert your inherent magic into psychic power.

1.name: Counter Thought
1.description: When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it.

1.name: Mental Buffer
1.description: Your mind deflects some amount of harm from attacks that induce pain or manipulate your mind directly.

1.name: Psychic Rapport
1.description: Your telepathic sensitivity intensifies when you're affected by mental magic, making it easier for you to link to other creatures.

4.name: Astral Tether
4.description: You spin out a thread of psychic energy that connects you to an ally, using it as a conduit for your abilities.

4.name: Homing Beacon
4.description: As your spell strikes a target, you plant a beacon in the target's mind that announces its presence to those nearby.

4.name: Psi Strikes
4.description: You siphon residual psychic energies from your spell into one weapon you're wielding or one of your unarmed attacks.

4.name: Thoughtform Summoning
4.description: You can create a prototypical creature from the depths of your imagination instead of calling one from elsewhere.

4.name: Violent Unleash
4.description: The force of your mind unleashing itself releases a violent shock wave that batters your enemies.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

8.name: Brain Drain
8.description: With a wresting of will, you siphon off a creature's mental energy to replenish your own.

8.name: Dark Persona's Presence
8.description: When you Unleash your Psyche, all your rage and pain—the portion of your psyche dedicated to cruel retribution—come along with it.

8.name: Mental Static
8.description: Your thoughts sting back when a lesser mind tries to invade your own.

8.name: Remove Presence
8.description: Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it.

8.name: Thoughtsense
8.description: You can detect the flickers of mental activity let off by all thinking creatures.

8.name: Whispering Steps
8.description: Your spell leaves a lingering connection between you and a creature—one through which you can nudge the creature's mind this way or that.

12.name: Amp Focus
12.description: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind.

12.name: Foreseen Failure
12.description: You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell.

12.name: No!!!
12.description: The shock of seeing your ally near death breaks whatever limits exist in your mind, sending your power spilling forth.

12.name: Psi Catastrophe
12.description: You stop holding your power back, unleashing it all in a catastrophic blast.

14.name: Conscious Spell Specialization
14.description: You become more adept with the spells that are always in your mind.

14.name: Deep Roots
14.description: Your mind-control spells send burrowing mental roots that tear at your target's mind when they're removed or run their course.

14.name: Shatter Space
14.description: The sheer power of your magic fractures reality.

16.name: Constant Levitation
16.description: Your power has unbound you from the earth below.

16.name: Target of Psychic Ire
16.description: Your magic saturates your surroundings with hateful psychic energy.

16.name: Wandering Thoughts
16.description: When your Psyche is Unleashed, each burst of magic you cast also folds space around you, and you travel through one of those folds.

18.name: All in your Head
18.description: Flames scouring at your body, venom coursing through your veins—you refuse to believe they exist, and nothing can affect you if you don't believe in it.

18.name: Cranial Detonation
18.description: As your overwhelming psyche fells a creature, you use its flickering consciousness to detonate psychic energy from the creature's head.

18.name: Twin Psyche
18.description: You've segmented your psyche so it can operate in tandem.

18.name: Deepest Wellspring
18.description: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind.

20.name: Become Thought
20.description: You shed some of your material form, becoming a being of pure thought.

20.name: Mind over Matter
20.description: Your mind's limits are only what you imagine them to be.

20.name: Unlimited Potential
20.description: The laws of magic can limit your mind only if you think you need them, and you've grown past the need for such limits.

20.name: Automatic Psychic Action
20.description: Your power wants to be free.

2.name: Cantrip Expansion
2.description: Study broadens your range of simple spells.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Expansive Spellstrike
2.description: You can blast the energy of a spell out around the target of your attack.

2.name: Force Fang
2.description: You can turn your attack into an unerring blur of force.

2.name: Spell Parry
2.description: You infuse magical power into your body or armaments to parry both physical and magical assaults.

2.name: Spirit Sheath
2.description: You've magically constructed an extradimensional sheath for your weapon that you access through your clothing, typically through a pocket, sleeve, or seam.

2.name: Convergent Tides
2.description: Your footwork is like the convergence of tides, granting your body supernatural power and fluidity.

1.name: Familiar
1.description: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.

1.name: Arcane Fists
1.description: Your physical training encompasses unarmed combat forms.

1.name: Magus's Analysis
1.description: You make an assessment informed by your knowledge of how a creature fights.

1.name: Raise a Tome
1.description: You can flip open a book to simultaneously study and deflect attacks.

12.name: Magic Sense
12.description: You have a literal sixth sense for ambient magic in your vicinity.

12.name: Conflux Focus
12.description: You imagine how you'll weave magic and combat into future battles, improving your focus.

12.name: Overwhelming Spellstrike
12.description: You pierce through your foe's resistance. Make a Spellstrike.

12.name: Sprinting Spellstrike
12.description: Magic propels you across the battlefield as you speed toward your target.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Conjurer's Countermeasure
6.description: You can make yourself resistant to damaging spells.

6.name: Knowledge is Power (Magus)
6.description: Your academic knowledge about a creature allows you to subtly alter your magic to defeat them.

6.name: Shielded Tome
6.description: You can magically fuse a shield into your favorite book during your daily preparations or as a 10-minute activity with the manipulate trait.

6.name: Spell Crash
6.prerequisite: Your Spellstrike is charged, and you have at least one spell prepared in a spell slot.
6.description: Instead of blending a spell into an attack, you can funnel the spell's magic into a pure blast that expands out from you.

6.name: Spell Retaliation
6.description: Battling other spellcasters is one of your major focuses, and harnessing magic from spells you defend against gives you everything you need to fight back.

6.name: Attack of Opportunity
6.description: You swat a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Cascade Countermeasure
6.description: When in Arcane Cascade, you can make yourself resistant to magic.

6.name: Knowledge is Power
6.description: When you critically succeed at a Recall Knowledge check about a creature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against the creature, to your AC against its next attack roll, and to your save against its next effect requiring a save.

6.name: Surface Tension
6.description: You encase the pieces of your broken weapon together with water you pull from the surrounding environment.

4.name: Burning Cascade
4.description: Energy flares out around you when you drop into your signature stance.

4.name: Devastating Spellstrike
4.description: Your Spellstrike sweeps are so wide and devastating, they smash into nearby foes.

4.name: Distracting Spellstrike
4.description: You weave distracting magic with one hand to enhance the efficacy of your Spellstrike.

4.name: Emergency Targe
4.description: You immediately Raise a Shield or cast shield .

4.name: Exploding Bullet
4.description: You load your gun with a bullet forged of magic instead of matter, barely contained in an arcane shell.

4.name: Recharging Flurry
4.description: The clash of steel fuels your magic, preparing you to unleash another magic-infused assault.

4.name: Running Recharge
4.description: Preparing in every way for your next assault, you both relocate yourself and ready your Spellstrike.

4.name: Starlit Eyes
4.description: Starlight shines in your sight, enhancing your perception and range.

4.name: Striker's Scroll
4.description: You can attach a scroll to your weapon or handwraps of mighty blows to blend its spell into an attack, carefully folding it around a part of the weapon or sealing it to the weapon's surface.

4.name: Student of the Staff
4.description: You've studied the staff extensively to learn the hidden capabilities of your chosen weapon.

4.name: Steady Spellcasting (Magus)
4.description: Confident in your technique, you don't easily lose your concentration when you Cast a Spell.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Distant Waterbird's Poise
4.description: You flow around your foe, using the magic of your attack to carry you away.

4.name: Heaven-Earth Encompassing Sleeves
4.description: Your magic extends to your garments.

4.name: Shattering Spellstrike
4.description: You intentionally channel a rampaging cascade of magic through your weapon, breaking it to deal more damage.

8.name: Capture Magic
8.description: When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use.

8.name: Fused Staff
8.description: You can use your arcane prowess to fuse a magical staff into a weapon during your daily preparations or as a 10-minute activity with the manipulate trait.

8.name: Runic Impression
8.description: You can temporarily replicate the effects of a property rune for your weapon or unarmed attacks.

8.name: Spell Swipe
8.description: You attack in an arc and enact your spell against everyone you hit.

8.name: Standby Spell
8.description: You've honed one spell as your favored combat technique, and you've practiced it enough that you no longer need to prepare it to cast it.

8.name: Crosscurrent Counter
8.description: You counter the creature with the power of elemental water, a tendril of it encasing your limb or weapon.

8.name: Whirlpool's Pull
8.description: You briefly conjure a tendril of water that allows you to grab an improvised weapon and then subsume that water to power your magic.

10.name: Cascading Ray
10.description: Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck.

10.name: Dazzling Block
10.description: As your shield blocks an assault, you create a flash of brilliant, multicolored light in a 15-foot cone.

10.name: Dimensional Disappearance
10.prerequisite: _dimensional assault_ focus spell,; laughing shadow hybrid study
10.description: You take advantage of certain idiosyncrasies of teleportation magic to better hide your position.

10.name: Killshot's Report
10.description: As you drop an enemy, a loud echo issues out as you chain the spell's energy to a nearby creature.

10.name: Lunging Spellstrike
10.description: Your spell unwinds the structure of your staff to make it exceptionally long, or even separate it into shards held together by magical power.

10.name: Meteoric Spellstrike
10.description: A trail of energy flows from your target back to you.

10.name: Rapid Recharge
10.description: You tap into an arcane trick to recover your ability to meld spells and attacks.

10.name: Split Spellstrike
10.description: Like knives slicing through magic itself, both your weapons carry your spell, delivering it to separate foes.

10.name: Sustaining Steel
10.description: You pull magic from the surrounding area into your weapon, using its substance to transform the magic into restorative energy.

10.name: Vermilion Threads
10.prerequisite: Arcane Cascade; unfurling brocade hybrid study
10.description: Your Arcane Cascade sends threads to the four directions, creating a web of strings dyed by your skill and your enemies' blood.

10.name: Unsheathing the Sword-Light
10.description: Honed through 10,000 battles, your sword's mere light can shatter ambitions and break armies.

10.name: Maelstrom Flow
10.description: You pour energy into an improvised weapon, speeding its destruction to grant it power.

14.name: Arcane Shroud
14.description: Your magic has a powerful aftereffect, briefly granting you a certain spell.

14.name: Hasted Assault
14.description: You can speed yourself up to move and attack more swiftly.

14.name: Preternatural Parry
14.description: You snap your weapon or limb into place to ward off harm.

16.name: Dispelling Spellstrike
16.description: The spell you deliver tries to force out magic affecting your enemy.

16.name: Resounding Cascade
16.description: The magical reinforcement from your Arcane Cascade extends to nearby allies.

18.name: Stolen Spell
18.description: As you perfectly counter a spell, you re-aim its magic to use it yourself.

18.name: Versatile Spellstrike
18.description: You can channel the entire realm of possibilities of your spellbook into an attack.

18.name: Conflux Wellspring
18.description: You've achieved perfect magical and physical balance, allowing magic to flow into and through you more easily.

20.name: Supreme Spellstrike
20.description: For you, it is almost effortless to combine spells and attacks into devastating combinations.

20.name: Whirlwind Spell
20.description: You combine the might of a multitarget spell with a whirling flurry of attacks.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Bind Heroic Spirit
6.description: You bind the spirit of a dead hero into you, gaining some of their talent.

6.name: Bloody Tendrils
6.description: You create three immobile tendrils made of blood that lash out at your enemies.

6.name: Bone Burst
6.description: You destroy the thrall in an explosion of bone shards that fly toward the triggering creature, dealing 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.

6.name: Collateral Reinforcement
6.description: With a combination of bony armor, extra flesh layers, and tactical incorporeal phasing, you protect your thralls from collateral damage.

6.name: Conjurer of Corpses
6.description: You can call forth many kinds of undead to do your bidding.

6.name: Corrupted Ground
6.description: The ground on which you stride is mere fuel that you burn with unholy void energies, scarring the earth in your wake.

6.name: Hallowed Earth
6.description: The earth is both where the dead rise from and where they are put to rest.

6.name: Reclaim Power
6.description: You use your thralls to restore yourself.

6.name: Zombie Horde
6.description: You raise what seems like an endless torrent of walking corpses.

10.name: Quickened Casting
10.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

10.name: Blossoming Gore
10.description: You create a field of bloody roses.

10.name: Desperate Surge
10.description: You can conjure up at will the kind of strength that most beings only attain in life-or-death situations.

10.name: Expanded Necromancy
10.description: You delve into other magical traditions.

10.name: Necromantic Lifesense
10.description: Your connection to life and death allows you to sense the life force of a creature with a glance.

10.name: Overburdening Spell
10.description: You have learned how to weigh down your enemies' life essence.

10.name: Skeletal Extension
10.description: You make use of what remains of a thrall to extend your limbs to unnatural lengths.

10.name: Speak with Days Long Dead
10.description: You channel the essences and echoes of spirits long dead that reside within a location, an object, or a bloodline.

16.name: Effortless Concentration
16.description: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

16.name: Anatomical Quartering
16.description: You briefly separate into four forms that share your space.

16.name: Beckoning Dirge
16.description: Your dirge beckons, overflowing into a thrall within 60 feet.

16.name: Desperate Revival
16.description: On the verge of death, you drain the life of all around you in a desperate attempt to remain alive.

16.name: Flesh Tsunami
16.description: You unleash a wave of melted flesh.

16.name: Temporary Possession
16.description: You temporarily possess of a creature's body.

2.name: Conceal Spell
2.description: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable.

2.name: Bone Speaker
2.description: To truly understand the mechanical advantages of an undead skeleton, you must understand how it functioned in life.

2.name: Deathly Scream
2.description: A thrall's scream mentally harms and frightens your foes.

2.name: Draining Strike
2.description: You draw the life out of your target using both your weapon and your thralls as a conduit.

2.name: Enhanced Undead Familiar
2.description: You infuse your undead familiar with void energy.

2.name: Invert Harm
2.description: Your mastery of life and death grows.

2.name: Muscle Barrier
2.description: You create an extra thick layer of muscle to protect your target.

2.name: Song of the Soul
2.description: You transform a thrall into a special instrument that plays a silent, soothing song heard only by a creature's soul.

2.name: Undead Creator
2.description: You've learned the unholy art of creating permanent undead creatures.

1.name: Death Speaker
1.description: Your voice and magic speak to the core existence within undead creatures, circumventing the need for the creature to comprehend.

1.name: The Hallowed Dead
1.description: While many necromancers seek unholy and perverse power, you have dedicated yourself to the practice of necromancy to stop the creation of permanent undead and the corruption of souls.

1.name: Reach of the Dead
1.description: You channel your necrotic magic through a thrall, expending it in the process.

1.name: Undead Familiar
1.description: You gain the ability to raise an undead familiar who will serve you as your loyal and sometimes expendable partner as you explore your necromantic magic.

1.name: The Unholy Dead
1.description: You have turned your necromancy against the divine powers that seek to stop you from achieving your unholy goals.

1.name: Widespread Fascination
1.description: You are not content to restrict yourself to one field. Instead, you've studied a wider range of necromantic magic to better expand your horizons and explore your unscrupulous fascinations.

4.name: Body Shield
4.description: You throw an adjacent thrall in between you and the attacker.

4.name: Bony Barrage
4.description: You launch a massive barrage of tiny bones.

4.name: Ghostly Stride
4.description: You fade into a slightly incorporeal form as you move.

4.name: Mobile Thralls
4.description: Your thralls can now follow you wherever you go.

4.name: Osteo Armaments
4.description: If you have bones, you have a weapon.

4.name: Overwhelming Harm
4.description: Your ability to manipulate void energy has led you to the conclusion that more is always better.

4.name: Vampiric Spell
4.description: Your magic drains the life from your enemy.

4.name: Void Siphon (Necromancer)
4.description: You open your body to absorb void energy.

8.name: Conglomerate of Limbs
8.description: You call forth a lumbering mass of fleshy limbs.

8.name: Final Spite
8.description: You can channel the power of death into a poisonous spite.

8.name: Infused Void
8.description: If the next action you use is to cast a grave spell that deals damage, creatures damaged by the spell take additional void damage equal to the rank of the spell.

8.name: March of the Dead
8.description: You compel your horde of thralls, overwhelming your enemies.

8.name: Poison Drinker
8.description: You temporarily transform your digestive system to instead gain a burst of sustenance from the poison you ingest.

8.name: Sanguine Transference
8.description: You transfer your blood and soul into a thrall.

8.name: Wings of Bone and Sinew
8.description: You can harness the power of death to craft wings from bones and a thin membrane of flesh.

12.name: Become as Spirit
12.description: You can move through an unwilling creature's spaces as if they were difficult terrain.

12.name: Bridge of Graves
12.description: You create a massive line of grave dirt that thralls can easily traverse.

12.name: Endless Return
12.description: You can return your enemies as thralls without a second thought.

12.name: Grave Focus
12.description: Studying necromancy in great depth has perfected your ability to find the links between life and death where you least expected.

12.name: Reinforced Skeleton
12.description: You take on the toughness and lightness of bone. You gain resistance equal to half your level to two damage types; one is your choice of cold, electricity, or fire, and the other is your choice of slashing or piercing. You also gain a +5- foot status bonus to your Speeds. Wheneve

12.name: Sanguine Mastery
12.description: Your mastery over the intricacies of your fascination has allowed you to infuse your own blood with additional healing properties while increasing your ability to bleed out any foes that stand against you.

12.name: Thick Skin
12.description: You thicken your skin by adding an impossibly thin layer of dense muscle directly under the surface. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level.

14.name: Amalgamate
14.description: You create a single mighty abomination using the pieces of two expendable thralls.

14.name: Blood Pool
14.description: You use the lifeblood of your enemies to heal your allies.

14.name: Instinctual Creation
14.description: You have trained to never be caught without some semblance of necromantic defense.

14.name: Ocular Flesh
14.description: You create a fleshy eyeball that is the size of a marble.

14.name: Recurring Nightmare
14.description: You summon a lingering spirit that just won't stay dead.

14.name: Skeletal Lancers
14.description: You create a myriad of swift skeletal warriors.

14.name: Unholy Resurrection
14.description: You can bring back the recently deceased, but at what cost?

18.name: Calcification
18.description: You attempt to turn a creature into pure bone.

18.name: Dread Mosquito Storm
18.description: You release a massive swarm of deadly bloodsuckers.

18.name: Ectoplasmic Aura
18.description: For the next 10 minutes, you and all allies in a 30-foot emanation from you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between you and your enemies thickens with ectoplasm.

18.name: Power Hungry
18.description: You focus your hunger, allowing you to consume even more power from your thralls.

18.name: Reanimate Foe
18.description: You attempt to bring a creature back to life to fight by your side.

20.name: Final Union
20.description: You and the heroic spirit have formed an eternal pact and now share your body.

20.name: Instant Army
20.description: You keep a reserve cache of thralls ready in case of an emergency.

20.name: Living Graveyard
20.description: You conjure forth a massive, animated graveyard.

20.name: Mortem Ultimatum
20.description: You have discovered the greatest secrets of life and death.

20.name: Perfected Thrall
20.description: Using your accumulated knowledge of all forms of necromancy, you create the perfect thrall.

20.name: Soul Thief
20.description: You attempt to steal the soul of a creature that was at least 18th level that died within the last minute.

8.name: Know-It-All
8.description: When you Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context.

8.name: Incredible Familiar
8.description: Your familiar is imbued with even more magic than other familiars.

8.name: Cursed Effigy
8.description: After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body.

8.name: Elaborate Talisman Esoterica
8.description: As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Call Implement
2.description: You can tug on the bonds of ownership between yourself and your implement, causing it to find its way back to you.

2.name: Esoteric Warden
2.description: When you apply antithetical material against a creature successfully, you also ward yourself against its next attacks.

2.name: Talisman Esoterica
2.description: You know how to assemble the supernatural objects in your esoterica into a number of temporary talismans.

2.name: Turn Away Misfortune
2.description: You perform a superstition, such as casting salt over your shoulder to ward off bad luck.

1.name: Familiar
1.description: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.

1.name: Ammunition Thaumaturgy
1.description: You're so used to handling your implement, weapon, and esoterica in the heat of combat that adding a few bullets or arrows to the mix is no extra burden.

1.name: Diverse Lore
1.description: Your wandering studies mean you've heard rumors or theories about almost every topic.

1.name: Divine Disharmony
1.description: From your collection of religious trinkets, you pull out opposing divine objects.

1.name: Haunt Ingenuity
1.description: Your cunning knowledge grants you the ability to notice the emotional echo of a soul that passed on, leaving a haunt in its wake.

1.name: Root to Life
1.description: Marigold, spider lily, pennyroyal—many primal traditions connect flowers and plants with the boundary between life and death, and you can leverage this association to keep an ally on this side of the line.

1.name: Scroll Thaumaturgy
1.description: Your multidisciplinary study of magic means you know how to activate the magic in scrolls with ease.

4.name: Breached Defenses
4.description: You can find the one weak point in a creature's scales, wards, or armor to get past its resistances.

4.name: Instructive Strike
4.description: You attack your foe and analyze how it reacts.

4.name: Paired Link
4.description: You break a trinket, such as a lodestone or jade pendant, in two, creating a sympathetic link between the halves that bridges distance.

4.name: Thaumaturgic Ritualist
4.description: Your studies into the supernatural have resulted in an especially strong knowledge of rituals

6.name: One More Activation
6.description: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual.

6.name: Scroll Esoterica
6.description: Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls.

6.name: Sympathetic Vulnerabilities
6.prerequisite: Exploit Vulnerability mortal weakness or personal antithesis
6.description: When you apply your will to invoke a vulnerability, the result is more powerful, and the vulnerability ripples out in a web from your main target to affect a broader range of creatures.

10.name: Share Weakness
10.description: You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you.

10.name: Thaumaturge's Investiture
10.description: Magical equipment and gear are the tools of your trade, and you know you need as many as possible to help you against the supernatural.

10.name: Twin Weakness
10.description: As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh.

12.name: Elaborate Scroll Esoterica
12.description: You've picked up more scraps of magic texts, improving your makeshift scrolls.

12.name: Intensify Investiture
12.description: Your bond to your invested items enables you to put more of yourself into them.

12.name: Shared Warding
12.description: You ward your allies from the attacks of your foes whenever you apply those protections to yourself.

12.name: Thaumaturge's Demesne
12.description: You have claimed an area or location as your demesne, granting you the ability to ward and protect it.

14.name: Esoteric Reflexes
14.prerequisite: an implement that grants a reaction
14.description: Reacting with an implement becomes instinct.

14.name: Grand Talisman Esoterica
14.description: You've gained the ability to place multiple talismans on an item.

14.name: Trespass Teleportation
14.description: You can hunt your foe to the ends of creation.

16.name: Implement's Flight
16.description: By weakening your relation to the ground and strengthening your relation to the sky, you've learned to soar through the air, your implement carrying you as surely as any broomstick or pestle.

16.name: Seven-Part Link
16.description: By exchanging pieces of a seven-part set of esoterica, you create a magical web by which your allies can affect each other at a distance.

16.name: Sever Magic
16.description: You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell.

18.name: Grand Scroll Esoterica
18.description: You've completed the third and final step in your assimilation of scroll esoterica, granting you daily scrolls of incredible power.

18.name: Implement's Assault
18.description: Your implement supercharges your weapon to shoot an impossible volley or carve through your foes.

18.name: Intense Implement
18.description: You have an exceptional link to your third implement.

20.name: Ubiquitous Weakness
20.description: You've nurtured your bonds with your comrades, allowing you to share the benefits of your esoterica.

20.name: Unlimited Demesne
20.description: You can move your demesne here and there, bringing it wherever your journey takes you.

20.name: Wonder Worker
20.prerequisite: Legendary in Arcana, Legendary in Nature, Legendary in Occultism, or Legendary in Religion
20.description: The thaumaturge's path culminates with the working of wonders.

16.name: Effortless Concentration
16.description: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

16.name: Eidolon's Trample
16.description: Your eidolon Strides up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space they enter.

16.name: Ever-Vigilant Senses
16.description: Your eidolon has enhanced senses.

16.name: Trample (Summoner)
16.description: Your eidolon Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space it enters.

1.name: Advanced Weaponry
1.description: Your eidolon's attack evolves.

1.name: Dual Studies
1.description: You and your eidolon learn different skills.

1.name: Energy Heart
1.description: Your eidolon's heart beats with energy.

1.name: Expanded Senses
1.description: Your eidolon evolves more acute senses.

1.name: Extend Boost
1.description: You can increase the duration of your eidolon's boosts.

1.name: Glider Form
1.description: Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent.

1.name: Meld Into Eidolon
1.description: Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon.

1.name: Unfetter Eidolon
1.description: You can allow your eidolon to travel far from your side.

2.name: Alacritous Action
2.description: Your eidolon moves more quickly.

2.name: Amphibious Form
2.description: Your eidolon adapts to life on land and underwater.

2.name: Magical Understudy
2.description: Your eidolon evolves to cast spells.

2.name: Ranged Combatant
2.description: Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance.

2.name: Reinforce Eidolon
2.description: You buffer your eidolon.

2.name: Steed Form
2.description: Your eidolon changes to make them particularly effective as your mount.

4.name: Bloodletting Claws
4.description: Your eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow.

4.name: Defend Summoner
4.description: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you.

4.name: Dual Energy Heart
4.description: A second energy dwells in your eidolon.

4.name: Lifelink Surge
4.description: You can tap into your shared connection to heal your eidolon.

4.name: Reactive Dismissal
4.description: You abruptly dismiss your eidolon to reduce the damage they take, though this makes summoning them again more difficult.

4.name: Shrink Down
4.description: Your eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces.

4.name: Skilled Partner
4.description: Your eidolon gains a 1st-level skill feat and a 2nd-level or lower skill feat.

4.name: Tandem Movement
4.description: You and your eidolon move together.

4.name: Vibration Sense
4.description: Your eidolon gains tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

6.name: Blood Frenzy
6.description: Your eidolon flies into a frenzy.

6.name: Eidolon's Retort
6.description: Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature.

6.name: Eidolon's Wrath
6.description: Your eidolon gains the eidolon's wrath link spell, which they cast, instead of you.

6.name: Master Summoner
6.description: During daily preparations, you can designate one of your spell slots to become two summoning slots of the same spell rank, from which you can cast only spells with the summon or incarnate trait.

6.name: Ostentatious Arrival
6.description: If the next action you take is to Manifest your Eidolon as a three-action activity, or to Cast a 3-action summon or incarnate Spell, the creature appears in an explosion.

6.name: Phase Out
6.description: Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force, spirit, and vitality) equal to half your level.

6.name: Tandem Strike
6.description: You and your eidolon each attack, seamlessly targeting the same foe without interfering with each other's movements.

6.name: Eidolon's Opportunity
6.description: Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature.

8.name: Boost Summons
8.description: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon.

8.name: Constricting Hold
8.description: Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your eidolon's level plus their Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.

8.name: Energy Resistance
8.description: Your eidolon has stronger resistance.

8.name: Hulking Size
8.description: Your eidolon grows substantially.

8.name: Magical Adept
8.description: Your eidolon gains more magic.

8.name: Miniaturize
8.description: Your eidolon can shrink even further.

8.name: Surprising Leap
8.description: Your eidolon jumps into the air to attack a foe.

8.name: Protective Pose
8.description: Many physical poses can fortify one's health, but some poses need more than one body to accomplish.

10.name: Burrowing Form
10.description: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt.

10.name: Magical Onslaught
10.description: Your eidolon's attack provides you an opening for one of your spells.

10.name: Merciless Rend
10.description: Your eidolon rends their foes.

10.name: Nimble Form
10.description: Your eidolon evolves into a figure of pure grace.

10.name: Protective Bond
10.description: The power of your bond can protect you and your eidolon from harm.

10.name: Transpose
10.description: You switch places with your eidolon.

10.name: Weighty Impact
10.prerequisite: Your eidolon has an unarmed attack with the shove or trip trait.
10.description: Your eidolon hurls enemies to the ground or across the battlefield.

10.name: Pushing Attack
10.description: Your eidolon has an attack that pushes away enemies.

12.name: Airborne Form
12.description: Your eidolon can fly.

12.name: Flexible Transmogrification
12.description: You've learned how to transmogrify your eidolon to suit the circumstances of the day.

12.name: Grasping Limbs
12.description: Your eidolon grabs enemies.

12.name: Link Focus
12.description: Communing with your eidolon helps you achieve a deeper focus.

12.name: Summoner's Call
12.description: In a moment of danger, you call your eidolon to your side.

12.name: Towering Size
12.description: Your eidolon becomes even bigger.

14.name: Guiding Retort
14.description: With a cunning twist of their unarmed attack, your eidolon shifts the position of a foe.

14.name: Piercing Jab
14.description: Your eidolon runs an enemy through with a horn or similar attack.

14.name: Resilient Shell
14.description: Your eidolon is resilient against attacks.

14.name: Share Eidolon Magic
14.description: Your eidolon shares innate spells with you.

14.name: Spell-Repelling Form
14.description: Your eidolon evolves to protect itself from the danger of spells.

18.name: Hobbling Criticals
18.description: Your eidolon's unarmed attacks batter your foes into submission, hampering their movement.

18.name: Magical Master
18.description: Your eidolon gains a bevy of lower-rank spells.

18.name: True Transmogrification
18.description: You transmogrify your eidolon each day.

18.name: Link Wellspring
18.description: Your bond replenishes your focus.

20.name: Eternal Boost
20.description: Your link with your eidolon is so intense that you continuously reinforce their abilities.

20.name: Legendary Summoner
20.description: Your ability to summon extends past your other spellcasting.

20.name: Twin Eidolon
20.description: You can transform to match your eidolon

18.name: Echoing Channel
18.description: When you pull forth vitality or void energy, you also create a smaller pocket of that energy.

18.name: Cycle of Souls
18.prerequisite: liturgist practice; at least one animist stance
18.description: Your spiritual allies guide your movements, allowing you to prepare for the trials before you at a speed faster than thought.

18.name: Spirit's Sacrifice
18.description: Your attuned apparition gathers all of the energy it can through your shared bond and uses that power to disperse itself while channeling the energy back into you, saving your life.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Conceal Spell
2.description: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable.

2.name: Embodiment Of The Balance
2.description: Your place in the balance between the forces of life and entropy expands the spells you can pull from the spirit realms.

2.name: Grasping Spirits Spell
2.description: Gaining substance from your magic, your apparitions increase the range of your spells, which then pull your enemy closer.

2.name: Spiritual Expansion Spell
2.description: Your apparitions manifest to scatter the energy of your spell.

10.name: Incredible Familiar (Animist)
10.description: Your connection to your apparition and your mastery of spiritual magic reach a new threshold that allows you to channel even more power into the physical form you allow it to take on as your familiar.

10.name: Apparition's Quickening
10.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, you can draw power from one of your attuned apparitions to reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

10.name: Fly on Shadowed Wings
10.description: Your apparition embraces you, feeding on your magic to become a pair of protective wings.

1.name: Apparition Sense
1.description: You can see and interact with things others can't.

1.name: Circle of Spirits
1.description: With a thought, word, or gesture, you reach your mind out to another spirit.

1.name: Relinquish Control
1.description: Your apparition takes over and shields you from outside influence.

1.name: Spirit Familiar (Animist)
1.description: When you attune to your apparitions during your daily preparations, you can choose to dedicate a small amount of your life force to allow one of them to physically manifest as a familiar, which gains the spirit trait.

1.name: Channeler's Stance
1.description: You enter a stance that allows power to flow through you.

4.name: Apparition's Enhancement
4.description: Spiritual power encases your weapon or unarmed attack.

4.name: Channeled Protection
4.description: Your apparition uses excess energy to protect you.

4.name: Walk the Wilds
4.description: You know the ways of birds and beasts and have gained the right to wear their forms.

6.name: Apparition Stabilization
6.description: Your attuned apparition ensures that even if you would be distracted or disrupted, your magic does not go to waste.

6.name: Blazing Spirit
6.description: Your apparition grants fiery defenses.

6.name: Grudge Strike
6.description: You channel the spiritual power of spiteful grudges.

6.name: Medium's Awareness
6.description: Your apparitions watch over you.

6.name: Roaring Heart
6.description: You surge forward inexorably.

8.name: Apparition's Reflection
8.description: Your apparition infuses your body with additional power.

8.name: Instinctive Maneuvers
8.description: When you allow an apparition control over your body, it might vent its fury against your foes.

8.name: Spirit Walk
8.description: Your allied apparitions ward you against the predations of their restless peers.

8.name: Wind Seeker
8.description: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below.

12.name: Apparition Cloud
12.description: With a mere thought, you discorporate your familiar into a thousand shards of spiritual magic, protecting both it and yourself from physical harm while making it difficult for enemies to move near you.

12.name: Shadows Within Shadows
12.description: Your apparition possesses a furtive and elusive nature that can influence and blend with your spiritual energy to form a protective and nearly impenetrable shroud of nondetection around you.

12.name: Whisper of Warning
12.description: Your protective apparitions alert you to an incoming attack.

14.name: Banish Falsehoods of Flesh
14.description: Your ability to manipulate supernatural energy allows you to deploy divine magic directly against a disguised enemy to reveal them as they truly are, or to cleanse an ally from an unwilling transformation.

14.name: Cardinal Guardians
14.description: You focus your divine magic to allow your apparitions to work in concert using the magic from one to weaken an enemy against the power of the next.

16.name: Forest's Heart
16.description: You adopt a stance that allows your apparitions to channel spiritual energy down through you to inhabit roots, control vines, and command plant-life from the ground you stand on to fight on your behalf.

16.name: Jester's Gambol
16.description: You adopt a stance that makes your movements carefree and sublimely unpredictable, allowing you to move past impediments with ease and resist the attacks and importunateness of natural threats.

16.name: Monstrous Inclinations
16.description: Your apparitions share with you the monstrous nature of those creatures who dwell in deep seas or ancient woods.

16.name: Spiritual Spellshape Stance
16.description: You feed excess magical power into your apparition, allowing it to grow ethereal limbs it can use to help shape and focus your spells.

20.name: Eternal Guide
20.description: Your attuned apparitions recognize that you still have essential work to do and refuse to allow you to pass on, gathering up your essence to carry your soul back to the community you call home.

20.name: True Channel Spell
20.description: You are a true conduit for spiritual power, able to unleash the greatest spells.

1.name: Animal Companion
1.description: You gain the service of a young animal companion (page 206) that travels with you on your adventures and obeys any simple commands you give it to the best of its abilities.

1.name: Crossbow Ace
1.description: Your deep understanding of the crossbow allows you to reload efficiently while moving yourself out of the line of return fire.

1.name: Hunted Shot
1.description: You take two quick shots against the one you hunt.

1.name: Initiate Warden
1.description: You've trained with one of the ranger sects known as wardens, who practice a specialized type of primal magic.

1.name: Monster Hunter
1.description: You quickly assess your prey and apply what you know.

1.name: Twin Takedown
1.description: You swiftly attack your hunted prey with each of your weapons, potentially combining their damage into a single devastating attack.

1.name: Gravity Weapon
1.description: Your expertise with your weapons and commitment to taking out your targets lends you magical power.

1.name: Heal Companion
1.description: You have a deep devotion to your animal companion that enables you to magically heal their wounds.

4.name: Twin Parry
4.description: You use your two weapons to parry attacks.

4.name: Advanced Warden
4.description: You unlock more powerful primal spells.

4.name: Companion's Cry
4.description: You can urge your companion to do its utmost.

4.name: Disrupt Prey
4.description: Make a melee Strike against your prey.

4.name: Far Shot
4.description: Your experience in the field has taught you how to focus your aim at a distance, increasing your accuracy.

4.name: Favored Prey
4.description: You have studied a specific type of wild creature and can hunt it more easily.

4.name: Running Reload
4.description: You can reload your weapon on the move.

4.name: Scout's Warning
4.description: You visually or audibly warn your allies of danger, granting them each a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

4.name: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
4.description: With a bit of hide, some antlers, and some cast-off fur, you can create a disguise that will fool even an experienced hunter.

4.name: Favored Enemy
4.description: You have studied a specific type of wild creature and can hunt it more easily.

4.name: Snare Specialist
4.description: You specialize in creating quick traps to obstruct your enemies on the battlefield.

4.name: Animal Feature
4.description: You are so connected with the animal world that you can grant yourself an animal's features and abilities.

4.name: Hunter's Luck
4.description: Your recollection of monsters is magically enhanced by luck.

4.name: Soothing Mist
4.description: You have a connection to the healing properties of nature and can produce a magical mist to heal damage and stop burning or bleeding.

4.name: Farabellus Flip
4.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics; trained in medium armor
4.description: Surprisingly agile even in a breastplate and carrying a full rucksack, Marcos Farabellus developed this evasive maneuver during one of his many adventures.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Giant Hunter
4.description: You have studied giants and hunt them with efficiency.

4.name: Greenwatch Initiate
4.description: You've received the basic training developed for all Greenwatch recruits.

4.name: Natural Conduit
4.description: You can use an animal as a conduit for your magic.

4.name: Haft Striker Stance
4.description: You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Deadly Aim
8.description: You aim for your prey's weak spots, making your shot more challenging but dealing more damage if you hit.

8.name: Hazard Finder
8.description: You have an intuitive ability to sense hazards.

8.name: Terrain Master
8.description: You are able to adapt to your surroundings in any natural terrain.

8.name: Warden's Boon
8.description: You point out vulnerabilities present in your hunted prey, granting the benefits listed in Hunt Prey and your hunter's edge to an ally until the end of their next turn.

8.name: Can't You See?
8.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; Expert in Stealth
8.description: The eye rebels, the mind recoils—no matter how much those who can see you try to explain what's there, their friends' gazes just skitter over you, like a bird afraid to land.

8.name: Eerie Environs
8.prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Stealth
8.description: The natural world can be scary to those not used to it—and you make it scarier still.

8.name: Eerie Traces
8.prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Survival
8.description: The tracks you leave behind are strange, somehow disconcerting and unnerving—they might travel backward, or through places no one would think to pass through.

8.name: Powerful Snares
8.description: Your snares are particularly dif cult for enemies to avoid.

8.name: Enlarge Companion
8.description: You make your companion enormous.

8.name: The Harder They Fall (Ranger)
8.description: You know how to make a larger creature hurt when it falls to the ground.

8.name: Hamstringing Strike
8.description: You slow your foes with a well-aimed attack.

8.name: Greenwatch Veteran
8.description: Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies.

8.name: Unseen Passage
8.description: You have mastered a magical technique for moving through dangerous woodlands unseen.

10.name: Twin Riposte
10.description: A clever parry with one weapon leaves your opponent open to an attack with the other weapon.

10.name: Camouflage
10.description: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness.

10.name: Incredible Companion (Ranger)
10.description: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

10.name: Master Monster Hunter
10.description: You have a nearly encyclopedic knowledge of all creatures of the world.

10.name: Peerless Warden
10.description: Your mastery of primal magic has given you access to the greatest secrets of warden magic.

10.name: Penetrating Shot
10.description: You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey.

10.name: Warden's Step
10.description: You can guide your allies to move quietly through the wilderness.

10.name: Eerie Proclamation
10.prerequisite: Expert in Occultism; Expert in Survival
10.description: You know there are places in the world that are just wrong— places where the birds don't sing and where you always feel like you're being watched.

10.name: Hunter's Vision
10.description: You are so focused on your hunted prey that you can see it clearly even beyond the limits of your senses.

10.name: Terrain Transposition
10.description: You are so connected to the wilderness that you can magically jump from place to place within it.

10.name: Greenwatcher
10.description: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled.

10.name: Dazzling Display
10.description: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes.

10.name: Haft Beatdown
10.description: The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown.

18.name: Impossible Volley
18.description: You fire a volley at all foes in an area.

18.name: Impossible Flurry
18.description: You forgo precision to attack at an impossible speed.

18.name: Manifold Edge
18.description: You've learned to leverage every possible edge.

18.name: Masterful Companion
18.description: Your animal companion shares your incredible hunting skills, allowing it to take down your shared prey with ease.

18.name: Perfect Shot
18.description: After watching the motions of combat with incredible intensity and precision, you fire at your prey at the perfect moment to deliver maximum pain.

18.name: Shadow Hunter
18.description: You blend in to your surroundings so well that others have trouble telling you apart from the terrain.

18.name: Warden's Wellspring
18.description: You command unparalleled focus when you commune with the world around you.

2.name: Animal Empathy (Ranger)
2.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

2.name: Favored Terrain
2.description: You have studied a specific terrain to overcome its challenges.

2.name: Hunter's Aim
2.description: When you focus on aiming, your attack becomes particularly accurate.

2.name: Monster Warden
2.description: You understand how to defend yourself and others against your prey.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Wild Empathy
2.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world.

2.name: Relentless Stalker
2.description: Stay adjacent to your prey when they attempt to move away.

2.name: Magic Hide
2.description: You can defend your companion in battle.

2.name: Snare Hopping
2.description: You can magically move your snares around.

2.name: United Assault
2.description: Through countless battles, you've learned you're stronger when working alongside your allies.

6.name: Additional Recollection
6.description: You scan the battlefield quickly, remembering critical details about multiple opponents you face.

6.name: Masterful Warden
6.description: Your mastery of warden magic increases.

6.name: Mature Animal Companion (Ranger)
6.description: Your animal companion becomes a mature animal companion and gains additional capabilities (page 211).

6.name: Skirmish Strike
6.description: Your feet and weapon move in tandem.

6.name: Snap Shot
6.description: You can react with ranged weapons when a creature is in close quarters.

6.name: Swift Tracker
6.description: Your keen eyes catch signs of passage even when you're moving.

6.name: Quick Snares
6.description: You can rig a snare in only moments.

6.name: Ephemeral Tracking
6.description: You are able to track your quarry through impossible places.

6.name: Ranger's Bramble
6.description: You can cause plants to grow and trap your foes with thorns.

6.name: Defy Fey
6.description: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic.

6.name: Fey Tracker
6.description: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice.

6.name: Animal Strength
6.description: You tap into the primal strength of your animal feature .

6.name: Nature Prowler
6.description: When you begin your turn hidden or unnoticed by your hunted prey, that creature is off-guard to you until the end of your turn.

6.name: Intensified Element Stance
6.description: You expend the elemental medicine in your body to empower your attacks, though you can't consume any more elemental medicine until the next day.

12.name: Distracting Shot
12.description: The sheer power of your attacks, or the overwhelming number of them, leaves an enemy flustered.

12.name: Double Prey
12.description: You can focus on two foes at once, hunting both of them down.

12.name: Second Sting
12.description: You read your prey's movements and transform them into openings, so failures with one weapon set up glancing blows with the other.

12.name: Side by Side (Ranger)
12.description: You and your animal companion fight in tandem.

12.name: Warden's Focus
12.description: Your connection with your surroundings deepens and expands, allowing you to draw in more of nature's primal power as you focus.

12.name: Obscured Emergence
12.description: You are, by nature, a thing of gloomy woods and barren wilds, and when you choose show yourself, a bit of this gloom clings to you, obscuring your form with strange distortions or mist.

12.name: Roll with It (Ranger)
12.description: You can dodge attacks from giants.

14.name: Sense the Unseen
14.description: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.

14.name: Shared Prey
14.description: Hunting as a duo, you and your ally both single out your prey.

14.name: Stealthy Companion
14.description: You've trained your animal companion to blend in to its surroundings.

14.name: Warden's Guidance
14.description: You convey your prey's location to your allies with a series of careful words or gestures.

14.name: Targeting Shot
14.description: You carefully track your prey's position and defenses.

16.name: Greater Distracting Shot
16.description: Even a single missile can throw off your enemy's balance, and more powerful attacks leave it flustered for longer.

16.name: Improved Twin Riposte (Ranger)
16.description: At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to perform a Twin Riposte.

16.name: Legendary Monster Hunter
16.prerequisite: Legendary in Nature; Master Monster Hunter
16.description: Your knowledge of monsters is so incredible that it reveals glaring flaws in your prey.

16.name: Specialized Companion (Ranger)
16.description: Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability, and it is now cunning enough to become specialized.

16.name: Warden’s Reload
16.description: Your mastery of magic and weapons like the crossbow allow you to wield both with equal ease.

16.name: Ubiquitous Snares
16.description: You can prepare a seemingly impossible number of snares in advance, and you're ready to spring them on unsuspecting foes.

16.name: Giant Slayer
16.description: Your well-placed blows can fell mighty giants.

20.name: Legendary Shot
20.description: You focus on your hunted prey, perceiving angles, air resistance, and every variable that would affect your ranged attack.

20.name: To the Ends of the Earth
20.description: Your ability to track your prey has surpassed explanation, allowing you to trace your prey's movements and predict its location with ease.

20.name: Triple Threat
20.description: You can divide your attention three ways when hunting.

20.name: Ultimate Skirmisher
20.description: You are so skilled at navigating the wild, your movement is completely unaffected by terrain.

20.name: Superior Sight
20.description: Increase your visual acuity.

20.name: Mimic Protections
20.description: By adopting resonant reflections, you have learned to copy the abilities of other creatures as well.

20.name: Accurate Flurry
20.description: You refine the precision of your unbelievable storm of blows.

20.name: Impossible Snares
20.description: You can create endless shorter-lived snares, protecting your lair or using them against foes.

20.name: Time Dilation Cascade
20.description: You borrow a bit of time from the future to act now.

2.name: Poison Resistance
2.description: Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

2.name: Clotting Elixirs
2.description: Your restorative concoctions have a clotting effect on the drinker's blood.

2.name: Improvise Admixture
2.description: You scrounge together enough ingredients from what's left in your alchemist's toolkit to produce a few more versatile vials on the fly.

2.name: Pernicious Poison
2.description: You can add a toxic additive to an alchemical poison to make it splash poison on its target.

2.name: Revivifying Mutagen
2.description: You metabolize a mutagen to heal yourself.

2.name: Smoke Bomb
2.description: You can add a tarry additive to an alchemical bomb to make it emit smoke.

2.name: Demolition Charge
2.description: You can rig your bombs to inanimate objects in order to cause destruction to the surrounding area.

1.name: Alchemical Familiar
1.description: You have used alchemy to create life, a simple creature formed from alchemical materials, reagents, and a bit of your own blood.

1.name: Alchemical Assessment
1.description: You can identify alchemical items quickly.

1.name: Blowgun Poisoner
1.description: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun.

1.name: Far Lobber
1.description: You've learned how to throw a longer distance.

1.name: Quick Bomber
1.description: You keep your bombs and bomb-related reagents in easy-to-reach pouches from which you draw without thinking.

1.name: Soothing Vials
1.description: The healing chemicals in your versatile vials also help calm a patient's mind.

1.name: Alchemical Savant
1.description: You can identify alchemical items quickly.

1.name: Subtle Delivery
1.description: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun.

4.name: Efficient Alchemy
4.description: Thanks to the time you've spent studying and experimenting, you know how to scale your formulas into larger batches that don't require any additional attention.

4.name: Enduring Alchemy
4.description: You've learned how to make your personal energy last just a little bit longer when quickly brewing ad hoc concoctions.

4.name: Healing Bomb
4.description: You can add a foamy catalyst to an elixir of life to turn it into a topical projectile.

4.name: Invigorating Elixir
4.description: You can mix an aromatic salve into an elixir with the healing trait to soothe physical maladies.

4.name: Regurgitate Mutagen
4.description: You redirect a mutagen within your body to spit a stream of stomach acid at a foe.

4.name: Tenacious Toxins
4.description: Your victims tend to expire long before your poisons, since the latter have been specifically formulated to last longer.

4.name: Calculated Splash
4.description: You have calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb's splash.

4.name: Efficient Alchemy (Alchemist)
4.description: Thanks to the time you've spent studying and experimenting, you know how to scale your formulas into larger batches that don't require any additional attention.

4.name: Inured to Alchemy
4.description: You've developed control over how your body processes alchemical poisons and drugs.

4.name: Chemical Purification
4.description: You developed a method to chemically purify and consecrate your bombs on the fly.

4.name: Numbing Spice Exhalation
4.description: You can mix alchemically preserved peppers into an alchemical food consumable to spice it up with alchemical fire.

4.name: Fermenting Liquors
4.description: You always have a special batch of preserved liquor ready for each day.

6.name: Combine Elixirs
6.description: You can add the full ingredients of a second elixir to an elixir you make to create a hybrid concoction.

6.name: Debilitating Bomb
6.description: You can add a crystalline additive to an alchemical bomb to have it undermine your enemy.

6.name: Directional Bombs
6.description: You can lob bombs with great force and a precise trajectory to angle the splash in a cone that sprays in a single direction, potentially allowing you to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines.

6.name: Fortified Elixirs
6.description: Your treatments for diseases and poisons can be very efficacious, though they tend not to last as long.

6.name: Sticky Poison
6.description: A combination of additional viscosity and careful application keeps your weapons poisoned even when suffering significant wear and tear.

6.name: Artokus's Fire
6.description: Artokus developed a mixture of volatile materials that burns hotter and longer than typical alchemist's fire.

8.name: Alter Admixture
8.description: Sometimes, you need to adapt your alchemical mixtures to new situations.

8.name: Improved Invigorating Elixir
8.description: Choose physical invigoration or mental invigoration, and add the listed conditions to those you can choose for an invigorating elixir.

8.name: Mutant Physique
8.description: Basic mutagens that affect your physical form can bring out the beast within you, turn you nigh invincible, or make your body more elastic.

8.name: Pinpoint Poisoner
8.description: Unsuspecting targets are especially vulnerable to your poisons.

8.name: Sticky Bomb
8.description: You can mix in a sticky additive to an alchemical bomb to make its contents adhere and continue to deal damage.

8.name: Feral Mutagen
8.description: Your bestial mutagen brings out the beast lurking within you.

8.name: Perpetual Breadth
8.description: You have expanded your supply of near-infinite items.

8.name: Retaliatory Cleansing
8.description: You twist your hand in front of the blow, ensuring the enemy's attack shatters the required holy water or bomb.

8.name: Glitter Crystals
8.description: You can mix a blend of crushed flowers and alchemical salt into an alchemical elixir with the healing trait or alchemical food.

10.name: Advanced Efficient Alchemy
10.description: You make an even-larger batch of alchemical items each morning.

10.name: Expanded Splash
10.description: You can throw bombs at just the right trajectory to create especially large and powerful explosions.

10.name: Greater Debilitating Bomb
10.description: You have learned enhanced techniques and alchemical secrets that allow you to expand the range of effects you can impose with your bombs.

10.name: Unstable Concoction
10.description: You can mix a wondrous yet volatile liquid into an alchemical consumable if it has an initial effect that uses dice.

10.name: Elastic Mutagen
10.description: You can cause your body to twist and flow like the quicksilver within your mutagens.

10.name: Merciful Elixir
10.description: You mix a special additive into your elixir that calms the drinker's body and mind.

10.name: Potent Poisoner
10.description: By concentrating your poisons' toxic components, you make them harder for victims to resist.

10.name: Sour Bomb
10.description: You can mix ingredients with a powerful sour smell into an alchemical bomb to make its explosion an overpowering stench.

12.name: Extend Elixir
12.description: Integrating your own personal energy into the elixirs you create causes them to affect you for longer.

12.name: Supreme Invigorating Elixir
12.description: For the purposes of counteracting effects with invigorating elixirs, treat your level as though it were 2 higher.

12.name: Uncanny Bombs
12.description: You lob bombs unerringly, despite obstructions or distance.

12.name: Invincible Mutagen
12.description: The fortifying additives you brew into your mutagens make your juggernaut form impervious.

12.name: Shaped Contaminant
12.description: Through a combination of careful manipulation and precise breath control, you can deploy inhaled toxins precisely.

14.name: Double Poison
14.description: You can apply two different infused injury poisons to the same weapon, though not to a piece of ammunition.

14.name: Mutant Innervation
14.description: Basic mutagens that affect your mind and thoughts can make you communicate telepathically, protect you from being detected, or let you communicate with anyone.

14.name: True Debilitating Bomb
14.description: You have discovered increasingly devastating ways for your bombs to impede your foes.

14.name: Glib Mutagen
14.description: Your silvertongue mutagen transcends languages and plausibility.

14.name: Greater Merciful Elixir
14.description: Your additives contain panaceas that can remedy a plethora of maladies.

16.name: Eternal Elixir
16.description: Your body readily accepts and retains minor changes.

16.name: Exploitive Bomb
16.description: You can mix a refractile substance into an alchemical bomb to foil resistances.

16.name: Persistent Mutagen
16.description: You've trained your physical form to remain stable.

16.name: Genius Mutagen
16.description: Specialized tweaks to your formula that supplements your genius considerably broaden the benefits you gain from cognitive mutagens.

18.name: Improbable Elixirs
18.description: Your mastery of alchemical secrets enables you to replicate effects most believe can be achieved only via magic.

18.name: Miracle Worker
18.description: Your alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain.

18.name: Perfect Debilitation
18.description: You have perfected the formulas for bombs that impede your enemies.

18.name: Mindblank Mutagen
18.description: With a minor adjustment of ratios in the formula for your serene mutagen, you gain mental protections.

20.name: Alchemical Revivification
20.description: If you die while under the effect of at least one elixir, the alchemical compounds in your bloodstream bring you back to life at the start of your next turn.

20.name: Craft Philosopher's Stone
20.description: Your research has paid off, culminating in the legendary philosopher's stone.

20.name: Mega Bomb
20.description: You can add a highly explosive additive to an alchemical bomb to turn it into a mega bomb.

20.name: Perfect Mutagen
20.description: You have enhanced the formulas for your mutagens, aligning them perfectly to your physiology.

20.name: Efficient Alchemy (Paragon)
20.description: Prepare more alchemical items from your infused reagents.

20.name: Astonishing Explosion
20.description: Your bomb incorporates an explosive spark of wonder that leaves witnesses dumbfounded.

20.name: Wish Alchemy
20.description: You have learned Artokus Kirran's most hidden secrets, granting you the ability to create alchemy infused with the power of wishes.

20.name: Plum Deluge
20.description: You have learned to saturate an area with poison.

1.name: Combat Assessment
1.description: You make a telegraphed attack to learn about your foe.

1.name: Double Slice
1.description: You lash out at your foe with both weapons.

1.name: Exacting Strike
1.description: You make a controlled follow-up attack, fully accounting for your momentum.

1.name: Point Blank Stance
1.description: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly.

1.name: Reactive Shield
1.description: You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second.

1.name: Snagging Strike
1.description: You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach.

1.name: Sudden Charge
1.description: With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing.

1.name: Vicious Swing
1.description: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady.

1.name: Point-Blank Shot
1.description: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly.

1.name: Power Attack
1.description: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady.

1.name: Everstand Stance
1.description: You brace your shield with both hands, enhancing its potential for both offense and defense.

1.name: Agile Shield Grip
