1.description: You change your grip on the shield, allowing you to combine rapid attacks with your shield boss or shield spikes and your main weapon's Strikes in a series of swift motions.

2.name: Aggressive Block
2.description: You push back as you block, knocking your foe away or off balance.

2.name: Assisting Shot
2.description: Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat.

2.name: Blade Brake
2.description: You plow your weapon into a floor, wall, or another sturdy surface, anchoring yourself in place.

2.name: Brutish Shove
2.description: Using the momentum of your last attack to throw your weight into another, you make your opponent stumble back.

2.name: Combat Grab
2.description: Using your prior attack to shift your opponent's guard, you take another swing and grab them.

2.name: Dueling Parry (Fighter)
2.description: You can parry attacks against you with your one-handed weapon.

2.name: Intimidating Strike
2.description: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence.

2.name: Lightning Swap
2.description: You have practiced quickly switching between combat styles and the equipment needed for them.

2.name: Lunge
2.description: You attack an enemy at the edge of your reach.

2.name: Rebounding Toss
2.description: You bounce your weapon off one foe to strike another.

2.name: Sleek Reposition
2.description: While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please.

2.name: Dragging Strike
2.description: You aim your weapon to snag a foe's armor, clothing, or flesh to pull them closer.

2.name: Devoted Guardian
2.description: You adopt a wide stance, ready to defend both yourself and your chosen ward.

2.name: United Assault
2.description: Through countless battles, you've learned you're stronger when working alongside your allies.

4.name: Barreling Charge
4.description: You rush forward, moving enemies aside to reach your foe.

4.name: Double Shot
4.description: You shoot twice in blindingly fast succession.

4.name: Dual-Handed Assault
4.description: You snap your free hand over to grip your weapon just long enough to add momentum and deliver a more powerful blow to your opponent.

4.name: Parting Shot
4.description: You jump back and make a quick shot that catches your opponent by surprise.

4.name: Powerful Shove
4.description: You can push larger foes around with your attack.

4.name: Quick Reversal
4.description: You turn your foes' flanking against them with a quick reverse.

4.name: Shielded Stride
4.description: When your shield is up, your enemies' blows can't touch you.

4.name: Slam Down
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

4.name: Swipe
4.description: You make a wide, arcing swing.

4.name: Twin Parry
4.description: You use your two weapons to parry attacks.

4.name: Cheaters Always Prosper
4.description: You're no champion of justice and are perfectly willing to fight dirty if it helps you survive.

4.name: Knockdown
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

4.name: Everstand Strike
4.description: Your follow-up blow leaves you an opening to set your shield.

4.name: Farabellus Flip
4.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics; trained in medium armor
4.description: Surprisingly agile even in a breastplate and carrying a full rucksack, Marcos Farabellus developed this evasive maneuver during one of his many adventures.

4.name: Inured to Alchemy
4.description: You've developed control over how your body processes alchemical poisons and drugs.

4.name: Knock Sense
4.description: You attack carefully to knock some sense into a creature whose actions aren't their own.

4.name: Haft Striker Stance
4.description: You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right.

6.name: Advanced Weapon Training
6.description: You've studied the art of wielding an advanced weapon.

6.name: Advantageous Assault
6.description: After compromising your enemy's movement, you deliver a more deadly blow.

6.name: Dazing Blow
6.description: You pummel a held foe, hoping to stagger them.

6.name: Disarming Stance
6.description: You adopt a fencing stance that improves your control over your weapon.

6.name: Furious Focus
6.description: You've learned to maintain your balance even when swinging furiously.

6.name: Guardian's Deflection (Fighter)
6.description: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack.

6.name: Reflexive Shield
6.description: You can use your shield to fend off explosions and the like.

6.name: Revealing Stab
6.description: You drive your piercing weapon into an imperceptible foe, revealing its location to your allies.

6.name: Ricochet Stance (Fighter)
6.description: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

6.name: Shatter Defenses
6.description: Your offense exploits your enemy's fear.

6.name: Shield Warden
6.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

6.name: Triple Shot
6.description: You can quickly fire multiple shots with greater control.

6.name: Pain Tolerance
6.description: You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you clumsy, drained, or enfeebled.

6.name: Shield Wall
6.description: You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade.

6.name: Spear Dancer
6.description: You favor weapons that allow you to lash out viciously while keeping enemies at bay, giving you an opportunity to strike without fear of reprisal.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Disorienting Opening
8.description: You use your foes' openings to expose even greater weaknesses.

8.name: Dueling Riposte
8.description: You elegantly counterattack against your flailing enemy.

8.name: Felling Strike
8.description: Your attack can ground an airborne foe.

8.name: Incredible Aim
8.description: By spending a moment to focus, you can ensure your attack strikes true.

8.name: Mobile Shot Stance
8.description: Your shots become nimble and deadly.

8.name: Positioning Assault
8.description: With punishing blows, you force your opponent into position.

8.name: Quick Shield Block
8.description: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought.

8.name: Resounding Bravery
8.description: Even your fears serve as fuel for your fighting spirit.

8.name: Sudden Leap
8.description: You make an impressive leap and swing while you soar.

8.name: Cannonball Fall
8.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics
8.description: You've learned how to make a quick descent with a sudden stop—directly on an enemy.

8.name: Rock the Boat
8.description: You know how easy it is for a falling person to cause another to lose their footing at the same time, and how to use that to your advantage.

8.name: Impassable Wall Stance
8.description: You refuse to let foes past your guard.

8.name: Knight's Retaliation
8.description: You knock the enemy's blow aside and twist, unbalancing your foe.

10.name: Agile Grace
10.description: Your graceful moves with agile weapons are beyond compare.

10.name: Certain Strike
10.description: Even when you don't hit squarely, you can still score a glancing blow.

10.name: Crashing Slam
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

10.name: Cut from the Air
10.description: You can knock aside ranged attacks.

10.name: Debilitating Shot
10.description: Aiming for a weak point, you impede your foe with a precise shot.

10.name: Disarming Twist
10.description: After your initial attack redirects your foe's defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp.

10.name: Disruptive Stance
10.description: The slightest distraction can provoke your wrath, and you're prepared to foil enemies' actions.

10.name: Fearsome Brute
10.description: Fear makes your foes weak and more vulnerable to your attacks.

10.name: Flinging Charge
10.description: You throw a weapon to distract your opponent as you close the gap to begin your assault.

10.name: Mirror Shield
10.description: You reflect the spell back against its caster.

10.name: Overpowering Charge
10.description: You trample foes as you charge past.

10.name: Tactical Reflexes
10.description: You are particularly swift at punishing foes who leave you openings.

10.name: Twin Riposte
10.description: A clever parry with one weapon leaves your opponent open to an attack with the other weapon.

10.name: Halyard Strike
10.description: You've learned to fight confidently while swinging from a line.

10.name: Combat Reflexes
10.description: You are particularly swift at punishing foes who leave you openings.

10.name: Improved Knockdown
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

10.name: Dazzling Display
10.description: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes.

10.name: Haft Beatdown
10.description: The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown.

12.name: Brutal Finish
12.description: Your final blow can make an impact even if it rebounds off a foe's defenses.

12.name: Dashing Strike
12.description: Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another.

12.name: Dueling Dance (Fighter)
12.description: Using a free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon.

12.name: Flinging Shove
12.description: Whether you're shoving opponents with a shield or a large weapon, you've learned to push them even further.

12.name: Improved Dueling Riposte
12.description: Your weapon whirls and darts, striking foes whenever the slightest opening or moment of weakness presents itself.

12.name: Incredible Ricochet
12.description: After your first shot singles out your opponent's position, you direct another that ricochets around obstacles and strikes unerringly.

12.name: Lunging Stance
12.description: Your body coiled to strike, you can lash out at distant enemies.

12.name: Paragon's Guard
12.description: Once you've had a moment to set your stance, you always have your shield ready without a thought.

12.name: Spring Attack
12.description: Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another.

14.name: Desperate Finisher
14.description: You throw everything you have into one last, reckless press.

14.name: Determination
14.description: Your training allows you to shrug off your foes' spells and conditions when the need is dire.

14.name: Guiding Finish
14.description: Using your weapon as a lever, you force your opponent to end up right where you want them.

14.name: Guiding Riposte
14.description: By shifting your weight and angling your weapon, you guide your opponent to a more favorable position.

14.name: Improved Twin Riposte (Fighter)
14.description: Your weapons are a blur, blocking and biting at your foes.

14.name: Opening Stance (Fighter)
14.description: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.

14.name: Two-Weapon Flurry
14.description: Using the momentum of your prior attack, you lash out with both your weapons in a sudden frenzy.

14.name: Whirlwind Strike
14.description: You lash out in a blur of motion, attacking all nearby adversaries.

14.name: Think Twice
14.description: You make a sudden threat toward a creature about to attack you that makes them flinch, throwing off their aim.

14.name: Stance Savant (Fighter)
14.description: When there's imminent danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.

16.name: Graceful Poise
16.description: With the right positioning, your off-hand weapon can strike like a scorpion's stinger.

16.name: Improved Reflexive Shield
16.description: Your shield can help save nearby allies.

16.name: Master of Many Styles
16.description: You move fluidly between stances, using your mastery of combat to always adopt the best tactics.

16.name: Multishot Stance
16.description: You lock yourself in a stable position so you can fire swiftly and accurately.

16.name: Overwhelming Blow
16.description: You throw your weight into a powerful attack that leaves you vulnerable.

16.name: Twinned Defense (Fighter)
16.description: You're always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you.

16.name: Needle In The God's Eyes
16.description: With sinews of bronze and thews of iron, you leap to the heavens, piercing the arrogant eyes of the gods.

18.name: Impossible Volley
18.description: You fire a volley at all foes in an area.

18.name: Savage Critical
18.description: The wounds you inflict are grievous.

18.name: Smash from the Air
18.description: Your expertise enables you to knock away spells.

20.name: Boundless Reprisals
20.description: With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required.

20.name: Ultimate Flexibility
20.description: Your experience keeps you on your toes, helping you adopt complex strategies on the fly and face the most dangerous challenges.

20.name: Weapon Supremacy
20.description: Your skill with weapons bends the laws of reality, allowing you to continuously attack with speed that would normally require magical assistance.

20.name: Reflecting Riposte
20.prerequisite: Dueling Riposte, Mirror Shield, or Twin Riposte
20.description: You attempt to counteract the triggering spell using powerful magical techniques observed in the Kortos Mounts.

20.name: Sever Space
20.description: You destroy the space between you and your targets, allowing you to strike with your melee weapons at great range.

1.name: Combat Assessment
1.description: You make a telegraphed attack to learn about your foe.

1.name: Armor Regiment Training
1.description: You've trained for grueling marches in full battle kit.

1.name: Commander's Companion
1.description: You gain the service of a young animal companion. You can affix your banner to your companion.

1.name: Deceptive Tactics
1.description: Your training has taught you that the art of war is the art of deception.

1.name: Officer's Medical Training
1.description: You received formal training in battlefield triage and wound treatment.

1.name: Plant Banner
1.description: You plant your banner to inspire your allies to hold the line.

6.name: Shield Warden
6.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Battle-Tested Companion
6.description: Your companion is a tried and tested ally of unshakable reliability.

6.name: Claim the Field
6.description: You hurl your banner forward with precision, claiming the battlefield for yourself and your allies.

6.name: Efficient Preparation
6.description: You've developed techniques for drilling your allies on multiple tactics in a succinct and efficient manner.

12.name: Reactive Interference
12.description: Grabbing a sleeve, swiping with your weapon, or creating another obstruction, you reflexively foil an enemy's response.

12.name: Fortunate Blow
12.description: You set an enemy up for a devastating follow-through from your allies.

12.name: Perfected Evaluations
12.description: You instantly assess the strengths and weaknesses of the enemy forces.

2.name: Adaptive Stratagem
2.description: Your constant training and strong bond with your allies allow you to change tactics on the fly.

2.name: Defensive Swap
2.description: You and your allies work together selflessly to protect each other from harm.

2.name: Guiding Shot
2.description: Your ranged attack helps guide your allies into striking your enemy's weak point.

2.name: Rapid Assessment
2.description: You quickly evaluate your enemies.

2.name: Set-up Strike
2.description: Your attack makes it difficult for your enemy to defend themselves against your allies' attacks.

2.name: Tactical Expansion
2.description: Your folio is filled with tactics and techniques you've devised based on study and experience.

4.name: Banner Twirl
4.description: You spin your banner in an elaborate pattern that your enemies find inscrutable.

4.name: Banner's Inspiration
4.description: You wave your banner, inspiring allies to throw off the shackles of fear.

4.name: Observational Analysis
4.description: You are able to rapidly discern relevant details about your opponents in the heat of combat.

4.name: Shielded Recovery
4.description: You can bandage wounds with the same hand you use to hold your shield.

4.name: Unsteadying Strike
4.description: Your attack makes your opponent more susceptible to follow-up maneuvers from your allies.

8.name: Defiant Banner
8.description: You vigorously wave your banner to remind yourself and your allies that you can and must endure.

8.name: Officer's Education
8.description: You know that a broad knowledge base is critical for a competent commander.

8.name: Rallying Banner
8.description: Your banner waves high, reminding your allies that the fight can still be won.

8.name: Unrivaled Analysis
8.description: Your experience allows you to derive even more information about your opponents from a mere glance.

10.name: Battle-Hardened Companion
10.description: Accompanying you across countless battlefields has allowed your companion to unleash its full potential.

10.name: Drilled Reflexes
10.description: You leave a lasting impression on your squadmates that makes them particularly adept at following your commands.

10.name: Standard-Bearer's Sacrifice
10.description: Seeing an enemy take aim at your ally, you bravely flourish your banner to redirect their attention to you.

10.name: Targeting Strike
10.description: Your attack creates an opening in your target's defenses for your allies to capitalize on.

14.name: Contact with the Enemy
14.description: You know that even the best-laid plans rarely survive contact with the enemy, and you have prepared your allies to adapt with a wide array of contingencies.

14.name: Desperate Resuscitation
14.prerequisite: Officer's Medical Training; Master in Medicine
14.description: You can use your training in combat medicine to revive the recently deceased.

14.name: Quickening Banner
14.description: The sight of your banner urges your allies to strike now.

16.name: Confusing Commands
16.description: You shout out bewildering but authoritative commands while imitating the voices, linguistic quirks, and speech patterns of your opponents.

16.name: Peerless Mascot Companion
16.description: As veterans of countless battles, you and your companion share an indomitable strength.

18.name: Demand Surrender
18.description: Confident in your victory, you command your opponent's surrender.

18.name: Mercenary Reversal
18.description: Even though the fight seems to be surging against you and your compatriots, you know that a key ally can always turn the tide.

18.name: Practiced Reflexes
18.description: You snap out a quick series of signals or commands that urge your allies to act with alacrity.

20.name: Glorious Banner
20.description: Your banner is an awesome sight to behold.

20.name: Pennant of Victory
20.description: You wave your banner in victory, signaling to your allies that the fight is won.

1.name: Reactive Shield
1.description: You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second.

1.name: Defensive Advance
1.description: With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride.

1.name: Bodyguard
1.description: You swear a vow to protect one of your allies at all costs, regardless of the risk this might pose to you.

1.name: Larger than Life (Guardian)
1.description: When you're clad in the heaviest of armors, you have an outsized presence.

1.name: Long-distance Taunt
1.description: You can draw the wrath of your foes even at a great distance.

1.name: Punishing Shove
1.description: When you push a foe away, you put the entire force of your armored form into it.

1.name: Shield Warfare
1.description: You know how to use shields offensively far better than most.

1.name: Shoulder Check
1.description: You hit a foe with your armor to throw them off balance.

2.name: Aggressive Block
2.description: You push back as you block, knocking your foe away or off balance.

2.name: Covering Stance
2.description: Your very presence on the field of battle protects nearby allies from harm.

2.name: Hampering Stance
2.description: You make it difficult for enemies to move past you.

2.name: Phalanx Formation (Guardian)
2.description: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies.

2.name: Raise Haft
2.description: You know how to use the haft of larger weapons to block your enemies' attacks.

2.name: Shield your Eyes
2.description: You reflexively place your shield between your eyes and visual dangers.

2.name: Shielding Taunt
2.description: By banging loudly on your shield, you get the attention of even the most stubborn of foes.

2.name: Taunting Strike
2.description: The force of your blow causes your enemy to focus their attention on you.

6.name: Reflexive Shield
6.description: You can use your shield to fend off explosions and the like.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Disarming Intercept
6.description: When you catch a weapon in your armor, you can move your body to wrench it from your foe's grasp.

6.name: Guarded Advance (Guardian)
6.description: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution.

6.name: Lock Down
6.description: You attack an enemy to ensure they can't move beyond your reach.

6.name: Retaliating Rescue
6.description: When an ally is in danger, you can hustle to reach them and punish the foe threatening them.

6.name: Ring their Bell
6.description: Using your armor, you pummel a foe that isn't focused on you in the head or face to stagger them.

6.name: Stomp Ground
6.description: You bring your booted foot down on the ground with enough force to rattle your foes.

12.name: Paragon's Guard
12.description: Once you've had a moment to set your stance, you always have your shield ready without a thought.

12.name: Armor Break
12.description: You flex your muscles to crack your damaged armor, blasting jagged shards into nearby enemies.

12.name: Armored Counterattack
12.description: With the might of your armor behind you, you hit back at a foe who would dare try to hurt your allies.

12.name: Devastating Shield Wallop
12.description: The impact of your shield sends foes tumbling to the ground.

12.name: Right Where you Want Them
12.description: Whether with a weapon or your bare hands, you keep your opponents in their place.

12.name: Scattering Charge
12.description: You charge into a group of enemies to send them flying.

12.name: Weakening Assault
12.description: With a barrage of blows, you diminish an enemy's strength.

16.name: Improved Reflexive Shield
16.description: Your shield can help save nearby allies.

16.name: Clang!
16.description: You make a foe pay for attacking you as its blow or spell glances off your armor.

16.name: Clobber
16.description: With a mighty blow, you send an enemy flying backward and onto the ground.

16.name: Never!
16.description: The idea that you would hurt your companions, even when you've lost your reason, is unthinkable.

20.name: Boundless Reprisals
20.description: With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required.

20.name: Great Shield Mastery
20.description: You've learned how to maximize the defensive abilities of the largest shields.

20.name: Unyielding Force
20.description: Thanks to your armor, almost nothing can stop you.

10.name: Shield Salvation
10.description: You can save your shield from total destruction, even after a devastating attack.

10.name: Belly Flop
10.description: You crush an enemy under the enormous weight of your armor.

10.name: Get Behind Me!
10.description: When saving your allies from harm, you push them behind you to better protect them.

10.name: Momentum Strike
10.description: Putting your weight behind your weapon's swing, you can push one enemy into another.

10.name: Sure-Footed
10.description: Even if you're knocked off balance, your armor continues to protect you.

10.name: Tough Cookie
10.description: Though you've taken a lot of punishment, you aren't easily brought down.

4.name: Area Armor
4.description: The armor you wear protects you and shelters your allies against explosions and other large-scale assaults.

4.name: Armored Courage
4.description: You take comfort in the safety of your armor.

4.name: Energy Interceptor
4.description: Though other guardians understand how to anticipate the flow of martial combat, you predict blasts of magical lightning, blazing trap runes, and more.

4.name: Flying Tackle
4.description: You barrel forward, gathering enough momentum to take down a threatening foe.

4.name: Not so Fast!
4.description: You lash out when foes try to get past you, possibly stopping them in their tracks.

4.name: Proud Nail
4.description: When a foe ignores your taunts, you make them pay.

4.name: Shielded Attrition
4.description: You provoke attacks from foes that might otherwise stop your allies from moving.

8.name: Group Taunt
8.description: Your taunts draw the attention of multiple enemies at once.

8.name: Juggernaut Charge
8.description: As you move forward in a rush, you put the weight of your armor behind an attack that can drag a foe with you.

8.name: Repositioning Block
8.description: As you absorb a blow from an enemy, you can use their attack's momentum against them.

8.name: Shield from Arrows
8.description: You place your shield in the path of an oncoming projectile.

8.name: Shield Wallop
8.description: Attacks with your shield knock the sense out of your foes.

14.name: Blanket Defense
14.description: You become a bulwark against foes' attacks that target you and your allies.

14.name: Bloody Denial
14.description: You strike a foe with force to prevent them from reacting.

14.name: Opening Stance
14.description: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.

18.name: Demolish Defenses
18.description: With a powerful blow, you crack a foe's armor or tough hide, opening it up for further attacks.

18.name: Perfect Protection
18.description: Your armor protects you from the deadliest hits.

18.name: Quick Vengeance
18.description: Indignant at any who would strike you or your allies, you get your revenge.

18.name: Shield from Spells
18.description: Your prowess with a shield allows you to block magic and more.

1.name: Sudden Charge
1.description: With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing.

1.name: Acute Vision
1.description: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.

1.name: Adrenaline Rush
1.description: In the heat of battle, you are capable of amazing feats of strength.

1.name: Draconic Arrogance
1.description: Few can sway you from your goals while the fury of combat fills you.

1.name: Moment of Clarity
1.description: You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly.

1.name: Raging Intimidation
1.description: Your fury fills your foes with fear.

1.name: Raging Thrower
1.description: Thrown weapons become especially deadly in your fury.

2.name: Intimidating Strike
2.description: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence.

2.name: Acute Scent
2.description: When your anger is heightened, your sense of smell improves.

2.name: Bashing Charge
2.description: You smash, bust, and charge through solid obstacles without hesitation.

2.name: Furious Finish
2.description: Desperate to finish the fight, you pour all your rage into one final blow.

2.name: No Escape
2.description: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

2.name: Second Wind
2.description: You can enter a second rage, but afterward you need to catch your breath.

2.name: Shake It Off
2.description: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness.

2.name: Elemental Evolution
2.description: The elemental power within you is more mutable and versatile than most.

4.name: Barreling Charge
4.description: You rush forward, moving enemies aside to reach your foe.

4.name: Swipe
4.description: You make a wide, arcing swing.

4.name: Oversized Throw
4.description: With a great heave, you seize a piece of your surroundings, such as a boulder, log, table, wagon, or chunk of earth, and hurl it at your foes.

4.name: Raging Athlete
4.description: Physical obstacles can't hold back your fury.

4.name: Scars of Steel
4.description: When you are struck with the mightiest of blows, you can flex your muscles to turn aside some of the damage.

4.name: Spiritual Guides
4.description: Though no one sees them and only you can hear them, the spirits around you constantly chatter, save when you are raging.

4.name: Supernatural Senses
4.description: Your scent is preternaturally sharp, and you can always rely on your sense of smell to help guide you when your vision is compromised.

4.name: Wounded Rage
4.description: You roar in pain, awakening the rage within you.

4.name: Fast Movement
4.description: Your rage is a frenzy of rapid movements.

4.name: Farabellus Flip
4.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics; trained in medium armor
4.description: Surprisingly agile even in a breastplate and carrying a full rucksack, Marcos Farabellus developed this evasive maneuver during one of his many adventures.

4.name: Inured to Alchemy
4.description: You've developed control over how your body processes alchemical poisons and drugs.

4.name: Ghost Wrangler
4.description: Spirits around you coalesce upon your fists, enabling you to seize and harm other ghosts and spirits.

4.name: Brutal Crush
4.description: You've learned how to cloud your foes' minds with the brutal impact of your repeated attacks.

4.name: Creature Comforts
4.description: You've found comfort in the forms of other creatures, insulating yourself from feelings of fear.

4.name: Rip and Tear
4.description: You've learned to debilitate your enemies in the same way a hunter tears at their prey.

8.name: Sudden Leap
8.description: You make an impressive leap and swing while you soar.

8.name: Animalistic Brutality
8.description: You deepen the connection into your animal instincts.

8.name: Disarming Assault
8.description: You attack with enough force to knock the weapon out of your foe's hands.

8.name: Follow-up Assault
8.description: Even in the face of failure you press the attack, determined to succeed.

8.name: Friendly Toss
8.description: You toss your friends around the battlefield.

8.name: Furious Bully
8.description: You bully foes across the battlefield.

8.name: Instinctive Strike
8.description: You trust your instincts and your sense of smell, using all your senses to pinpoint your opponent's location.

8.name: Invulnerable Rager
8.description: Even the heaviest armors serve only to enhance your unbridled fury.

8.name: Renewed Vigor
8.description: Through the haze of battle, you quickly recover your raging vigor.

8.name: Share Rage
8.description: You stoke an ally's fury.

8.name: Thrash
8.description: You thrash your foe around.

8.name: Animal Rage
8.description: You transform into your animal.

10.name: Overpowering Charge
10.description: You trample foes as you charge past.

10.name: Come and Get Me
10.description: You open yourself to attacks so you can respond in turn.

10.name: Furious Sprint
10.description: You rush forward.

10.name: Great Cleave
10.description: Your fury carries your weapon through multiple foes.

10.name: Impressive Landing
10.description: You slam into the ground, shattering it around you.

10.name: Knockback
10.description: The weight of your swing drives your enemy back.

10.name: Resounding Blow
10.description: You strike your enemy in the head with such force that its ears ring.

10.name: Silencing Strike
10.description: A quick strike to the face or mouth silences your opponent.

10.name: Tangle of Battle
10.description: Your vicious strike pulls your foe closer, giving you the opportunity to grab them.

10.name: Terrifying Howl
10.description: You unleash a terrifying howl.

10.name: Determined Dash
10.description: Nothing can keep you from your enemy.

10.name: Corpse-Killer's Defiance
10.description: You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies.

14.name: Whirlwind Strike
14.description: You lash out in a blur of motion, attacking all nearby adversaries.

14.name: Awesome Blow
14.description: Your attacks are so powerful, they can flatten your opponents.

14.name: Giant's Lunge
14.description: You extend your body and prepare to attack foes outside your normal reach.

14.name: Impaling Thrust
14.description: You impale your enemy and hold it in place with your weapon, and leave it bleeding when it gets free.

14.name: Sunder Enchantment
14.description: You can focus your superstition to break the magic of an item, in addition to destroying freestanding spells and those active on creatures.

14.name: Vengeful Strike
14.description: When struck by an enemy, you respond in turn.

14.name: Towering Transformation
14.description: The physical growth of your transformation is a spectacle that shakes foes to their core.

14.name: Meditate on This!
14.prerequisite: Trained in Medicine or Tian Xia Lore
14.description: You meditate to alter your qi, coloring it with your resentment and anger.

6.name: Animal Skin
6.description: Your proficiency in unarmored defense increases to expert.

6.name: Brutal Bully
6.description: You push your foes around and leave bruises.

6.name: Cleave
6.description: You swing clear through one foe and into another.

6.name: Dragon's Rage Breath
6.description: You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a 30-foot cone, dealing 1d6 damage per level to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

6.name: Giant's Stature
6.description: You grow to incredible size.

6.name: Inner Strength
6.description: Your strength is part of your rage.

6.name: Mage Hunter
6.description: You use your hatred of magic to lash out at a known spellcaster.

6.name: Nocturnal Senses
6.description: Your senses gain even greater clarity.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Scouring Rage
6.prerequisite: an instinct that allows you to change your additional damage from Rage to a different damage type
6.description: You emit a powerful surge of instinctual energy when you unleash your anger.

6.name: Spirits' Interference
6.description: You call forth protective spirits to ward off ranged attacks.

6.name: Attack of Opportunity
6.description: You swat a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Nocturnal Sense
6.prerequisite: Acute Scent or precise or imprecise scent and low-light vision
6.description: Your senses gain even greater clarity.

6.name: Pain Tolerance
6.description: You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you clumsy, drained, or enfeebled.

6.name: Elemental Explosion
6.description: You unleash the energy roiling within you.

12.name: Dragon's Rage Wings
12.description: You sprout dragon wings from your back of the same color as your chosen dragon.

12.name: Embrace the Pain
12.description: Ignoring your pain, you reach out and grab the creature or weapon that caused you harm.

12.name: Furious Grab
12.description: You grab your foe while it's distracted by your attack.

12.name: Predator's Pounce
12.description: You close the distance to your prey in a blur, pouncing on the creature before it can react.

12.name: Spirit's Wrath
12.description: You call forth an ephemeral spirit, typically the apparition of an ancestor or a nature spirit, which takes the form of a wisp.

12.name: Sunder Spell
12.description: You draw upon your superstitious fury to destroy a spell.

12.name: Titan's Stature
12.description: You grow to even greater size.

12.name: Unbalancing Sweep
12.description: You make a great sweep with your weapon or fists about yourself, knocking creatures off their feet and away from you.

16.name: Collateral Thrash
16.description: You smack the foe you're thrashing into someone else.

16.name: Desperate Wrath
16.description: Your blood boils when you take a beating, and you throw caution to the wind to finish the fight.

16.name: Dragon Transformation
16.description: You transform into a ferocious Large dragon, gaining the effects of 6th-rank dragon form except that you use your own AC and attack modifier, you apply your extra damage from Rage, and the Dragon Breath action uses your class DC.

16.name: Furious Vengeance
16.description: Your enemy's blow fuels your rage and provokes your immediate retaliation.

16.name: Penetrating Projectile
16.description: Your projectiles are unhindered by flesh and bone.

16.name: Shattering Blows
16.description: Your forceful blows shatter objects with ease.

16.name: Reckless Abandon
16.description: Your blood boils when you take a beating, and you throw caution to the wind to finish the fight.

18.name: Brutal Critical
18.description: Your critical hits are particularly devastating.

18.name: Perfect Clarity
18.description: You burn out all your rage to ensure that your attack lands and your mind remains free.

18.name: Vicious Evisceration
18.description: You make a vicious attack that maims your enemy.

18.name: Whirlwind Toss
18.description: You whirl a foe to smash into all nearby creatures before throwing them far away.

20.name: Annihilating Swing
20.description: You have embraced brute destructive power.

20.name: Contagious Rage
20.description: You can drive your allies into a frenzy, granting them incredible benefits.

20.name: Quaking Stomp
20.description: You stomp the ground with such force that it creates a minor earthquake, with the effects of the earthquake spell.

20.name: Unstoppable Juggernaut
20.description: You have become a brutal, unstoppable force of nature, able to shrug off mortal wounds with ease.

2.name: Lightning Swap
2.description: You have practiced quickly switching between combat styles and the equipment needed for them.

2.name: Hurl at the Horizon
2.description: Your weapon flies from your hand as if propelled under its own power.

2.name: Leap the Falls
2.description: Reinforcing your legs with divine energy, you can leap the battlefield as powerfully as a salmon clearing a waterfall.

2.name: Red-Gold Mortality
2.description: By channeling your divinity into a creature along with a strike, you can disrupt their ability to recover.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Binding Serpents Celestial Arrow
6.description: As you prepare to shoot your weapon, you invoke divine serpents that bind your enemies.

6.name: Flow of War
6.description: Divine battle instincts take over your body, letting you move and lash out with instinctive speed.

6.name: Motionless Cutter
6.description: Your weapon is so sharp even an insect alighting upon its still blade would be severed.

6.name: Riddle the Sphinx
6.description: You've learned the secrets of the sphinx's riddles and empowered your ikon with them.

6.name: Shield of Stone
6.description: You stole a gorgon's gaze and trapped it in your ikon.

1.name: Energized Spark
1.description: The energy of your spirit manifests as crackling lightning, the chill of winter, or the power of an element.

1.name: Sanctified Soul
1.description: You've drawn a line in the sand in the cosmic struggle between good and evil and chosen a side.

1.name: Twin Stars
1.description: Your divine spark embodies a primordial duality, and your ikon splits itself accordingly into two corresponding halves.

1.name: Vow of Mortal Defiance
1.prerequisite: You are not sanctified with the holy or unholy trait.
1.description: Having seen the wreckage left by the gods and their servitors as they play in their great war of good and evil, you've come to the only reasonable conclusion: they all must be cut from their silken thrones.

4.name: Only the Worthy
4.description: You can designate your ikons as movable by only your own hand, leaving them fixed in place as surely as if they were lodged in stone.

4.name: Steel on Steel
4.description: The ring of divinely empowered steel assails your enemies.

4.name: Through the Needle's Eye
4.description: Your weapon strikes with the perfection your will demands.

4.name: Follow the Threads of Fate
4.description: A norn's thread—spun from fate itself—runs through or wraps around your ikon.

4.name: Topple the Titans
4.description: Even the greatest titans of the world are easier to kill when they're lying on the ground.

8.name: Additional Ikon
8.description: Your story has grown rich enough that three ikons can't contain its full complexity.

8.name: Battle Hymn to the Lost
8.prerequisite: of verse unbroken or peerless under heaven
8.description: Your movements in combat are an artistic dirge to those spirits who could not fight to see another day.

8.name: Raise Island
8.prerequisite: born of the bones of the earth or restless as the tides
8.description: You churn the sea and fish up stone so your enemies together can receive their punishment.

8.name: Rejoice in Solstice Storm
8.prerequisite: whose cry is thunder or dancer in the seasons
8.description: You hold your arms out, and the fury of the seasons comes to your jubilant embrace.

8.name: As a Thousand Soldiers
8.description: Though you may have stolen from the hive, you've nothing but respect for the armies guarding it, and you borrow their strength to overwhelm your foes.

8.name: Forward Gaze into Life
8.description: Despite the constant cold of death at your back, you keep your gaze forward into the realm of life.

10.name: Breath of Vital Ash
10.description: Reddish ash stains your ikon, impossible to clean off.

10.name: Exult in Violence
10.description: You let out a war cry as your blow lands true, and judgment descends on an enemy.

10.name: Fish from the Falls' Edge
10.description: Seeing your ally fall, you let out a cry, sending your divine spark to them temporarily to keep them from tumbling down the River of Souls.

10.name: Journey Of the Sky Chariot
10.description: Small wings, flaming wheels, or another signifier of flight sprout from your ikon as it gains the power to lift you from the ground.

10.name: Mated Birds in Paired Flight
10.description: Your ikons bond like a pair of one-winged birds.

12.name: Compliant Gold
12.description: You can command your weapon to shrink or grow, for convenience or power.

12.name: Extract Vow of Nonviolence
12.description: You entice or threaten a weapon, making it swear not to harm you.

12.name: Rapid Spark
12.description: Your spark shifts to where it needs to be.

12.name: Warped by Rage
12.description: Rage courses through your body, transforming you into a beast of battle.

14.name: Complete the Hero's Journey
14.description: As your divine spark travels through each of your ikons in turn, it gains power, culminating its journey when it enters your third ikon.

14.name: Destined Victory
14.description: You demand a battle against your chosen enemy.

14.name: Infinite Blades Celestial Arrow
14.description: Each shot you launch multiplies itself with spiritual blades, rings, and other missiles that shower upon your foes.

16.name: Crown of Rule
16.description: This badge of office proclaims your sovereignty.

16.name: Gift of the Immortal Herb
16.description: Your blood turns a divine gold, shining in moments its spilled and begetting new life.

16.name: Mark of The Sage
16.description: Your ikon gains a pin, stripe, or similar marking showing you as a master of your craft.

16.name: Shroud of Ghosts
16.description: Your ikon is connected to the world of the spirits, allowing you to partially fade into their realm.

16.name: Strike Rivers, Seize Winds
16.description: Through sheer physical force, you can wrestle a river, lasso the winds, punch a hole to the molten center of the planet, or create other environmental disturbances via nothing but your own strength.

18.name: Branched Tree Of Pain
18.description: The blade of your ikon takes one or more notches, capable of dealing mortal pain to your foes. Immanence When you Strike with the ikon, you critically succeed if you roll a 19 on the die as long as that result would be a success.

18.name: Eternity-Incinerating Blaze
18.description: The blaze of your divine spark is hot enough that it burns in not just the present, but the past and future as well.

18.name: Seven-Colored Cosmic Bridge
18.description: Your divine spark shines in a riot of shimmering colors, capable of carrying you through the world as fast as light itself.

18.name: Sunwrecker
18.description: Your weapon has the might of legends, capable of shooting or striking any light out of the sky.

20.name: Cutting Without Blade
20.description: While tales of your divine ikons have spread far and wide, you've realized that, as they are all manifestations of your soul, the object itself is unnecessary.

20.name: Reach for Immortality
20.description: Your divine spark is now a bonfire in your soul, bringing you to the very cusp of undying immortality.

20.name: Remake the World
20.description: For the briefest of moments, you can reach into the realm of true gods, gaining the power to shape reality to your will.

6.name: Shield Warden
6.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Expand Aura
6.description: You focus your divine power to extend your influence and protection.

6.name: Loyal Warhorse
6.description: The loyalty you and your mount share is unbreakable.

6.name: Smite
6.description: You single out one enemy to destroy in your deity's name.

6.name: Attack of Opportunity
6.description: You swat a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Litany Against Wrath
6.description: You excoriate a foe for its wrath against goodly creatures.

6.name: Smite Evil
6.description: Your blade ally becomes an even more powerful tool against evildoers.

6.name: Corrupted Shield
6.description: Your shield ally is more than just a spirit of protection— it's a conduit for deadly divine magic.

6.name: Invigorating Mercy
6.description: Your divine touch rejuvenates the weak and tired.

6.name: Smite Good
6.description: Your blade ally shares your lust for the blood of good creatures.

6.name: Shield Wall
6.description: You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade.

8.name: Quick Shield Block
8.description: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought.

8.name: Advanced Deity's Domain
8.description: Through your conviction, you have glimpsed the deeper secrets of your deity's domain.

8.name: Greater Cruelty
8.description: The extent of your corruption devastates your foes' minds and reflexes.

8.name: Greater Mercy
8.description: Your faith enhances your ability to remove conditions.

8.name: Greater Security
8.description: Shield in hand, you offer your ally its full protection you do yourself.

8.name: Heal Mount
8.description: Your devotion to your mount manifests as a surge of vital energy.

8.name: Second Blessing
8.description: Your continued service grants you another boon.

8.name: Second Ally
8.description: Your inner grace attracts the attention of a second protective spirit.

8.name: Sense Evil
8.description: You sense evil as a queasy or foreboding feeling.

8.name: Impassable Wall Stance
8.description: You refuse to let foes past your guard.

8.name: Sacrifice Armor
8.description: With divine awareness, you twist your body to lessen the impact of an attack.

8.name: Sense Good
8.description: The presence of goodness sickens you with its saccharine self-righteousness.

8.name: Sense Holiness
8.description: The presence of goodness sickens you with its saccharine self-righteousness.

8.name: Sense Unholiness
8.description: You sense the truly wicked as a queasy or foreboding feeling.

8.name: Faithful Stride
8.description: Confident in your faith, you Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or up to three times its Speed if you used 3 actions for Faithful Stride).

1.name: Brilliant Flash
1.description: Your light cleanses souls of fear.

1.name: Defensive Advance
1.description: With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride.

1.name: Deity's Domain
1.description: You embody an aspect of your deity.

1.name: Desperate Prayer
1.description: You call out to your deity in a plea for their aid.

1.name: Faithful Steed
1.description: You gain the service of a young animal companion as a mount.

1.name: Iron Repercussions
1.description: Disobeying your Iron Command has lasting consequences.

1.name: Nimble Reprisal
1.description: You can use Retributive Strike at greater distance.

1.name: Ongoing Selfishness
1.description: Your powerful personality and incredible ego demand that you protect yourself above all else.

1.name: Unimpeded Step
1.description: With a burst of divine liberation, your ally's movement from your Liberating Step is unaffected by difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, narrow surfaces, and uneven ground.

1.name: Vicious Vengeance
1.description: While your vengeance is painful for both you and your foe, none can doubt that your enemies suffer more.

1.name: Weight of Guilt
1.description: Guilt clouds the minds of those who ignore your Glimpse of Redemption.

1.name: Ranged Reprisal
1.description: You can use Retributive Strike with a ranged weapon.

1.name: Everstand Stance
1.description: You brace your shield with both hands, enhancing its potential for both offense and defense.

1.name: Splinter Faith
1.description: Your faith in your deity is represented in an extremely unusual way that some might call heretical

1.name: Agile Shield Grip
1.description: You change your grip on the shield, allowing you to combine rapid attacks with your shield boss or shield spikes and your main weapon's Strikes in a series of swift motions.

2.name: Divine Grace
2.description: You call upon your deity's grace

2.name: Divine Health
2.description: Your faith makes you resistant to disease, protecting you as you offer succor to the ill.

2.name: Dragonslayer Oath
2.description: You've sworn to slay evil dragons.

2.name: Fiendsbane Oath
2.description: You've sworn an oath to banish the corruption of fiends to the dark planes they call home.

2.name: Shining Oath
2.description: You've sworn an oath to put the undead to rest.

2.name: Vengeful Oath
2.description: You've sworn an oath to hunt down wicked evildoers and bring them to judgment.

2.name: Conceited Mindset
2.description: Because you know your mind is superior, you scoff at anyone who would alter your mental state—but this hubris gets the better of you when you're wrong.

2.name: Esoteric Oath
2.description: You've sworn an oath to slay the alien abominations that lurk in the remote corners of Golarion.

2.name: Lightslayer Oath
2.description: You've sworn to rid the world of the self-righteousness of celestial beings.

2.name: Devoted Guardian
2.description: You adopt a wide stance, ready to defend both yourself and your chosen ward.

2.name: Reliable Squire
2.description: You know the path to victory isn't traveled alone, and you lend aid to your companions whenever you can.

2.name: Resilient Mind
2.description: You're firm in your convictions and have girded your mind against outside influence.

2.name: Oath of The Avenger
2.description: You've sworn an oath to punish wicked acts you witness.

2.name: Oath of The Defender
2.description: During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defend against a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day.

2.name: Oath of The Slayer
2.description: During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defeat, topple, or destroy a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day.

4.name: Aura of Courage
4.description: You stand strong in the face of danger and inspire your allies to do the same.

4.name: Aura of Despair
4.description: Your presence as an avatar of evil makes your foes more susceptible to terror and makes it almost impossible for them to shake off fear when you are near.

4.name: Cruelty
4.description: The harm you deal with your corrupting touch saps the strength from your enemy's body.

4.name: Mercy
4.description: Your touch soothes the body or mind.

4.name: Security
4.description: Those you shield can benefit from your lasting protection.

4.name: Sacral Lord
4.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
4.description: By right of ritual or sheer stubbornness, you have claimed rulership of the land.

4.name: Everstand Strike
4.description: Your follow-up blow leaves you an opening to set your shield.

4.name: Light of Revelation
4.description: You've learned to call upon light to reveal what is hidden.

4.name: Sun Blade
4.description: You can unleash burning sunlight from your sword or spear.

4.name: Accelerating Touch
4.description: Your healing energies are infused with bounding energy.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Inspiring Resilience
4.description: You show defiance in times of hardship and inspire your companions to persevere.

4.name: Knock Sense
4.description: You attack carefully to knock some sense into a creature whose actions aren't their own.

4.name: Acclimated Mount
4.description: By the grace of your god, your mount can overcome the natural challenges and hazards present in a specific terrain.

10.name: Imposing Destrier
10.description: Under your care, your mount has realized its innate potential.

10.name: Radiant Armament
10.description: Your blessed armament radiates power, further enhancing your chosen weapon.

10.name: Shield of Reckoning
10.prerequisite: Shield Warden; blessed shield, champion's reaction
10.description: When you shield your ally against an attack, you call upon your power to protect your ally further.

10.name: Spectral Advance
10.description: You gain the spectral advance devotion spell

10.name: Litany Against Sloth
10.description: You rail against the sin of sloth, turning a foe's laziness against it.

10.name: Radiant Blade Spirit
10.description: Your divine ally radiates power, enhancing your chosen weapon.

10.name: Elucidating Mercy
10.description: Your mercy grants clarity to those around you just when they need it most.

10.name: Litany of Self-Interest
10.description: You compel a creature to act toward its own ends rather than consider others.

10.name: Resilient Touch
10.description: Your healing energies create an aura of protection that defends your allies against more than just blades and arrows.

10.name: Holy Light
10.description: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light.

12.name: Affliction Mercy
12.description: The divine grace that flows through you grants reprieve from an affliction.

12.name: Aura of Faith
12.description: You radiate an aura of belief that imbues your attacks and those of nearby allies with divine power.

12.name: Blessed Counterstrike
12.prerequisite: champion's reaction that grants an ally resistance to an enemy's damage (including the grandeur, justice, liberation, and redemption causes)
12.description: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction.

12.name: Champion's Sacrifice
12.description: You can suffer so that others might live.

12.name: Devoted Focus
12.description: Your devotion is strong enough to increase your focus to incredible heights.

12.name: Divine Wall
12.description: You use your shield to harry your enemies, preventing them from stepping away from or around you.

12.name: Gruesome Strike
12.prerequisite: champion's reaction that grants extra damage with your Strikes (including the desecration, iniquity, and obedience causes)
12.description: Make a Strike against the creature that triggered your champion's reaction.

12.name: Blade of Justice
12.description: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against a foe you have witnessed harming an ally or innocent.

12.name: Lasting Doubt
12.description: When you cast doubt upon your foes, the effect lasts longer than usual.

12.name: Liberating Stride
12.description: Your allies can move farther when you release them from harm.

12.name: Amplifying Touch
12.description: Your healing energies empower attacks.

12.name: Enforce Oath
12.prerequisite: You've sworn to an oath against a specific type of creature.
12.description: You call on your oath to embolden you in combat.

12.name: Pale Horse
12.description: Your mount becomes a grotesque creature of foreboding when you ride it.

12.name: Miraculous Intervention
12.description: Through divine intervention or whispered prayers, you foil an enemy's response.

12.name: Necromantic Deflection
12.description: You imbue your shield with life-giving energy to deflect harmful necromantic magic.

12.name: Steed's Toppling Strike
12.description: Those who defy your cause feel the powerful attacks of your mount.

14.name: Aura of Determination
14.description: Your aura protects against powers that would twist the mind and body.

14.name: Aura of Life
14.description: Your aura protects against the power of the Void.

14.name: Aura of Righteousness
14.description: Your righteous aura dampens evil's might and prevents the unholy from escaping you.

14.name: Divine Reflexes
14.description: You gain an additional reaction that you can use only for your champion's reaction.

14.name: Sacral Monarch
14.prerequisite: Sacral Lord; Master in Occultism or Master in Religion
14.description: You have come into your full powers and are truly a monarch of your realm, by your own definition at least.

14.name: Anchoring Aura
14.description: Your aura hampers fiends' teleportation.

14.name: Aura of Vengeance
14.description: When you call upon others to take retribution, you also guide their aim.

14.name: Litany of Righteousness
14.description: You call upon righteousness to expose an evil foe's weakness.

14.name: Wyrmbane Aura
14.description: Your aura protects against destructive energies and dragons' breath.

14.name: Aura of Preservation
14.description: Your aura protects against the twisting powers of aberrations.

14.name: Greater Interpose
14.description: Your divine grace empowers you to avoid hits when you otherwise could not.

14.name: Litany of Depravity
14.description: You undercut your enemy's vain moralism, opening their heart to evil.

14.name: Exalted Greatness
14.description: You improve your exalted reaction with the benefit listed for your cause.

16.name: Auspicious Mount
16.description: Guided by your ongoing care, your steed has developed incredible intelligence and skill.

16.name: Instrument of Slaughter
16.prerequisite: champion's reaction that grants extra damage with your Strikes (including the desecration, iniquity, and obedience causes)
16.description: Your blessed armament thirsts for the blood of your foes.

16.name: Instrument of Zeal
16.prerequisite: Blessed Counterstrike or Retributive Strike; champion's reaction that grants an ally resistance to an enemy's damage (including the grandeur, justice, liberation, and redemption causes)
16.description: Divine energy fills your weapon.

16.name: Shield of Grace
16.description: You protect an ally with both your shield and your body.

18.name: Rejuvenating Touch
18.description: Your healing energies linger after you cast, providing continual benefits.

18.name: Swift Retribution
18.description: The transgressions of your enemies fuel you to retaliate with divine speed.

18.name: Ultimate Mercy
18.description: Your mercy transcends the bounds of life and death.

18.name: Celestial Form
18.description: You take on a celestial countenance, appearing like a type of celestial who serves your deity.

18.name: Fiendish Form
18.description: Your features reshape into those of a type of fiend who serves your deity; for example, as a demon you might have putrid scales, twisted horns, and red eyes.

18.name: Retributive Focus
18.description: Your enemy's offenses fuel your righteous power.

20.name: Armament Paragon
20.description: Add the following property runes to the list you can choose for your blessed armament: animated, greater fearsome , grievous , keen , and greater vitalizing .

20.name: Sacred Defender
20.description: You are a great warrior that can stand strong against the fiercest opponents to your cause.

20.name: Shield Paragon
20.description: Your shield is a vessel of divine protection.

20.name: Swift Paragon
20.description: The movement of you and your allies is swift and decisive as the judgment of your deity.

20.name: Celestial Mount
20.description: Your steed gains incredible celestial powers granted by your deity.

20.name: Radiant Blade Master
20.description: Your divine ally turns your chosen weapon into a paragon of its type.

20.name: Aura of Unbreakable Virtue
20.description: Overwhelm evil creatures with your aura.

20.name: Banishing Blow
20.description: The erratic teleportation magic you experienced in the Kortos Mounts has taught you a few tricks.

20.name: Fiendish Mount
20.description: Your steed ally manifests a suite of powerful and sinister gifts granted to it by your deity.

20.name: Everdistant Defense
20.description: You have learned that distance can foil enemies better than any armor.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Bullseye
8.description: You carefully take aim to avoid your foe's concealment and cover.

8.name: Delay Trap
8.description: You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects.

8.name: Improved Poison Weapon
8.description: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects.

8.name: Inspired Stratagem
8.description: During your daily preparations, you can review stratagems for the day's adventures with up to five allies.

8.name: Nimble Roll
8.description: You throw yourself into a roll to escape imminent danger.

8.name: Opportune Backstab
8.description: When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction.

8.name: Predictive Purchase (Rogue)
8.description: You somehow manage to have just the thing for the situation.

8.name: Ricochet Stance (Rogue)
8.description: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

8.name: Sidestep
8.description: You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue.

8.name: Sly Striker
8.description: Your attacks deal more damage, even against creatures that aren't off-guard.

8.name: Swipe Souvenir
8.description: When you wriggle free from an enemy's grasp, you take something of theirs with you.

8.name: Tactical Entry
8.description: You Stride.

8.name: Sawtooth Grapple
8.description: Your sawtooth saber training enables you to pin down an enemy using your twin blades.

8.name: Loaner Spell
8.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
8.description: During your daily preparations, you can gain the assistance of an allied prepared spellcaster to prepare one spell for the day.

8.name: Ambushing Knockdown
8.description: You emerge from hiding and deliver a blow that can knock an enemy sprawling to the ground.

8.name: Subtle Shank
8.description: You draw a concealed weapon, attack with it, and then hide it away again in one smooth motion.

8.name: Grand Dance
8.description: You can summon the full magic of Bhopan's grand dance.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Brutal Beating
2.description: Your critical hits shakes your foes' confidence.

2.name: Clever Gambit
2.description: Your battle tactics are aided by assessing your foe's capabilities and range.

2.name: Distracting Feint
2.description: Your Feints are far more distracting than normal.

2.name: Mobility
2.description: You move without leaving an opening.

2.name: Strong Arm
2.description: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, the weapon's range increment increases by 10 feet.

2.name: Unbalancing Blow
2.description: Interweaving attacks, you unbalance your foes.

2.name: Underhanded Assault
2.description: You capitalize on the distraction provided by an ally.

2.name: Minor Magic
2.description: You've dabbled in a variety of tricks, gaining minor magical abilities from a particular tradition.

2.name: Fane's Fourberie
2.description: Stella Fane has perfected a technique for using playing cards as weapons that's one part sleight of hand and one part magic.

4.name: Scout's Warning
4.description: You visually or audibly warn your allies of danger, granting them each a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

4.name: Dread Striker
4.description: You capitalize on your enemies' fear to slip past their defenses.

4.name: Head Stomp
4.description: Make an unarmed melee Strike against a prone target.

4.name: Mug
4.description: You make a quick attack and rob your foe in the process.

4.name: Poison Weapon
4.description: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action.

4.name: Predictable!
4.description: By observing an opponent, you can get a sense of their next move and prepare to counter or resist it.

4.name: Reactive Pursuit
4.description: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

4.name: Sabotage
4.description: You subtly damage others' equipment.

4.name: Scoundrel's Surprise
4.description: You drop your disguise at the right moment and surprise your target.

4.name: The Harder They Fall (Rogue)
4.description: You make your foes fall painfully when you trip them.

4.name: Twin Distraction
4.description: Your movements with two weapons are so swift and disorienting that they befuddle your opponent.

4.name: Battle Assessment
4.description: With careful observation during battle, you identify an enemy's strengths and weaknesses.

4.name: Magical Trickster
4.description: You can sneak spells past your foes' defenses as easily as any blade.

4.name: Masquerade of Seasons Stance
4.description: You have mastered the opening steps to the Masquerade of Seasons, a dance that channels the power of spring, summer, winter, and autumn.

4.name: Devrin's Dazzling Diversion
4.description: Devrin Arlos has a habit of using whatever is at hand to temporarily blind others in combat.

4.name: Haft Striker Stance
4.description: You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right.

6.name: Skirmish Strike
6.description: Your feet and weapon move in tandem.

6.name: Analyze Weakness
6.description: Your knowledge of a creature's physiology helps you attack with pinpoint accuracy.

6.name: Anticipate Ambush
6.description: You keep watch for any hidden creatures or dangerous sites, moving at half your travel Speed.

6.name: Far Throw
6.description: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, you take only a –1 penalty for each additional range increment between you and the target, rather than a –2 penalty.

6.name: Gang Up
6.description: You and your allies harry an opponent in concert.

6.name: Light Step
6.description: You aren't bothered by tricky footing.

6.name: Shove Down
6.description: You leverage your weight to topple foes that you move.

6.name: Sly Disarm
6.description: You can Disarm a creature through sleight of hand rather than brute force.

6.name: Twist The Knife
6.description: After stabbing your opponent in a weak spot, you tear the wound open.

6.name: Watch Your Back
6.description: You menace the target, stoking their fears and drawing their attention.

6.name: Fog Cloak
6.description: When you are concealed by mist or fog, you're hidden until a creature successfully Seeks to find you.

6.name: Slice and Swipe
6.description: Steal from your target when you successfully strike them.

6.name: Stella's Stab and Snag
6.description: You dart towards your opponent, seeking to stab them and slice their purse-strings with a single movement.

6.name: Pirouette
6.description: You twirl gracefully, spinning on one foot to evade your opponent's attack.

14.name: Sense the Unseen
14.description: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.

14.name: Defensive Roll
14.description: Dropping into a roll to disperse the force of the blow, you can partially evade a lethal attack and stay conscious.

14.name: Instant Opening
14.description: You distract your opponent with a few choice words or a rude gesture.

14.name: Leave An Opening
14.description: When you hit hard enough, you leave an opening so your ally can jump in on the action.

14.name: Stay Down!
14.description: You have ways of keeping your foes down.

1.name: Nimble Dodge
1.description: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

1.name: Overextending Feint
1.description: You goad a foe into overextending.

1.name: Plant Evidence
1.description: You can put a single item you're holding of light or negligible Bulk onto a person without them noticing by succeeding at a Thievery check against their Perception DC.

1.name: Trap Finder
1.description: You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the presence of traps.

1.name: Tumble Behind (Rogue)
1.description: You tumble under and behind your foe, your rapid movement letting you catch them off guard.

1.name: Twin Feint
1.description: You use an attack with one weapon to distract your foe from a second attack coming at a different angle.

1.name: You're Next
1.description: After downing a foe, you menace another.

10.name: Methodical Debilitations
10.description: You strategically craft your debilitations to lessen or negate an enemy's tactical advantages.

10.name: Nimble Strike
10.description: You're cunning enough to find an opening in an opponent's attack.

10.name: Precise Debilitations
10.description: You attack with great precision.

10.name: Sneak Adept
10.description: It's almost impossible to spot you.

10.name: Tactical Debilitations
10.description: You learn new debilitations that grant you tactical advantages against your foes.

10.name: Vicious Debilitations
10.description: The debilitations you dish out seriously impair your foes.

10.name: Heartless Debilitations
10.description: You debilitate your enemies with ruthless and terrifying efficiency.

10.name: Sneak Savant
10.description: It is almost impossible to spot you without taking effort to look.

10.name: Eldritch Debilitations
10.description: You know how to apply debilitations that are particularly troublesome for spellcasters.

10.name: Deny Support
10.description: Keep opponents from flanking when you Feint them.

10.name: Dazzling Display
10.description: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes.

10.name: Haft Beatdown
10.description: The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown.

12.name: Bloody Debilitation
12.description: Your attacks slice arteries and veins.

12.name: Critical Debilitation
12.description: Your debilitations are especially effective on your most powerful attacks.

12.name: Fantastic Leap
12.description: You launch yourself through the air at a foe.

12.name: Felling Shot
12.description: Your ranged attacks can shoot an unprepared foe right out of the air.

12.name: Preparation
12.description: You survey the battlefield, calculating the possibilities.

12.name: Reactive Interference
12.description: Grabbing a sleeve, swiping with your weapon, or creating another obstruction, you reflexively foil an enemy's response.

12.name: Ricochet Feint
12.description: While in Ricochet Stance, you can bounce a thrown weapon off a foe to distract them.

12.name: Spring from the Shadows
12.description: You leap from hiding and assail your target.

12.name: Critical Debilitations
12.description: Your debilitations are especially effective on your most powerful attacks.

12.name: Deadly Poison Weapon
12.description: Your poisons are devastatingly potent.

12.name: Coordinated Distraction
12.description: You distract an opponent from the fact that one of your allies is about to attack them.

16.name: Blank Slate
16.description: Your deceptions confound even the most powerful magic that could spy on you.

16.name: Cloud Step
16.description: Using fantastic acrobatic skill, you can walk for brief stretches across insubstantial surfaces.

16.name: Cognitive Loophole
16.description: You can find a loophole in a mental effect to temporarily overcome it.

16.name: Dispelling Slice
16.description: Your sneak attack slices through the threads binding magic to a target.

16.name: Perfect Distraction
16.description: You use clever tactics to mislead your foes as you sneak away.

16.name: Reconstruct The Scene
16.description: You spend 1 minute surveying a small location (such as a single room) to get an impression of events that occurred there in the last day.

16.name: Swift Elusion
16.description: Attempt an Acrobatics check against the foe's Reflex DC.

16.name: Cutthroat Grapple
16.description: You can punish a creature that tries to escape your blades.

16.name: Steal Spell
16.description: When you use Legendary Thief to steal the impossible, you can steal a prepared spell or spontaneous spell from a foe.

18.name: Implausible Infiltration
18.description: You find tiny imperfections and somehow fit yourself through them, possibly moving directly through the wall or floor.

18.name: Implausible Purchase (Rogue)
18.description: You can use Prescient Planner even if you have already used it after purchasing goods, and you can Interact to draw the item as a single action instead of a 2-action activity.

18.name: Powerful Sneak
18.description: You've learned to exploit your enemies' openings.

18.name: Sanguine Evasion
18.description: You avoid death by turning into a spray of red mist.

20.name: Hidden Paragon
20.description: When you slip out of sight, you disappear.

20.name: Impossible Striker
20.description: Nothing can prevent you from making a sneak attack, even if your opponent can see every blow coming.

20.name: Reactive Distraction
20.description: You reactively switch with your decoy to foil your foe.

20.name: Enduring Debilitation
20.description: Your debilitations last for 1 minute.

20.name: Steal Essence
20.prerequisite: legendary in Thievery or master in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
20.description: Being in the presence of the aeon orbs as they deteriorated has taught you how to siphon energy, and you do so with the required magic item.

20.name: Extradimensional Stash
20.description: When you perform sleight of hand, you fold space so that objects really do disappear.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Clue Them All In
8.description: You can clue in all your allies at once.

8.name: Defensive Stratagem
8.description: By scrutinizing a foe, you learn how to better avoid its attacks.

8.name: Whodunnit?
8.description: You carefully consider your case and narrow down some of the details.

8.name: Greenwatch Veteran
8.description: Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies.

8.name: Unseen Passage
8.description: You have mastered a magical technique for moving through dangerous woodlands unseen.

14.name: Sense the Unseen
14.description: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.

14.name: Plot the Future
14.description: You spend 10 minutes in contemplation to uncannily predict how events will play out.

14.name: Strategic Bypass
14.description: Your plans account for your foes' resistances, enabling you to strike a telling blow.

14.name: Forensic Countermeasures
14.description: Your knowledge of deductive reasoning allows you to derail fellow investigators.

1.name: Trap Finder
1.description: You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the presence of traps.

1.name: Eliminate Red Herrings
1.description: You have a keen sense for avoiding spurious lines of inquiry.

1.name: Flexible Studies
1.description: You've collected a cross-section of information on various disciplines you can refer to when preparing for various tasks.

1.name: Known Weaknesses
1.description: Whenever you Devise a Stratagem, you can also attempt a check to Recall Knowledge as part of that action before rolling the d20.

1.name: Takedown Expert
1.description: You've mastered combat practices that let you get up close and bring down perpetrators alive.

1.name: That's Odd
1.description: When you enter a new location, such as a room or corridor, you immediately notice one thing out of the ordinary.

1.name: Underworld Investigator
1.description: Your work as an investigator makes you familiar with the criminal element.

1.name: Undead Spotter
1.description: Your studies of the undead have taught you tellale signs of a disguised undead creature.

16.name: Reconstruct The Scene
16.description: You spend 1 minute surveying a small location (such as a single room) to get an impression of events that occurred there in the last day.

16.name: Didactic Strike
16.description: When you find a glaring weakness, you can set your allies up to annihilate your foe.

16.name: Implausible Purchase
16.description: It seems impossible, but you've analyzed every angle and are able to just keep pulling out exactly the item you need, even in far-flung locations.

16.name: Implausible Purchase (Investigator)
16.description: It seems impossible, but you've analyzed every angle and are able to just keep pulling out exactly the item you need, even in far-flung locations.

2.name: Athletic Strategist
2.description: You know how to calculatedly manipulate joints and body weight.

2.name: Certain Strategem
2.description: You know exactly where to strike a foe to target their weak spots.

2.name: Exploit Blunder
2.description: By watching your foes closely, you can make the most out of their mistakes.

2.name: Person of Interest
