2.description: Sometimes, you need to follow the leads as they come in the middle of an investigation.

2.name: Shared Stratagem
2.description: The plans you make include your allies as well as yourself.

2.name: Solid Lead
2.description: Sometimes your case splinters into smaller mysteries, but you never lose sight of the big picture.

2.name: Personalized Poisoning
2.description: You developed techniques for discovering a target's weaknesses to poisons using your forensic knowledge.

2.name: Red Herring
2.description: You have a keen sense for avoiding spurious lines of inquiry.

4.name: Alchemical Discoveries
4.description: You've devoted extra time in the lab to improve your knowledge of alchemy.

4.name: Detective's Readiness
4.description: When you're on a case, you stay watchful and resolute to avoid tricks your suspect might pull.

4.name: Lie Detector
4.description: You're adept at noticing the tells of a liar—sweat, flushing, a quavering voice, a quickening pulse.

4.name: Ongoing Investigation
4.description: You're always investigating what's around you, even as you perform other activities.

4.name: Scalpel's Point
4.description: Your stratagems benefit from your precise knowledge of anatomy.

4.name: Strategic Assessment
4.description: You learn your foes' strengths and weaknesses by watching them move.

4.name: Greenwatch Initiate
4.description: You've received the basic training developed for all Greenwatch recruits.

4.name: Strategic Repose
4.description: You've trained extensively in fighting the undead.

6.name: Connect the Dots
6.description: Ephemeral connections between people, places, and concepts are invisible to most, but seeing them is your stock and trade.

6.name: Predictive Purchase
6.description: You have just the thing for the situation.

6.name: Thorough Research
6.description: You have comprehensive knowledge in your fields of interest.

6.name: Deadly Casework
6.prerequisite: member of the Red Mantis assassins
6.description: You treat a well-planned assassination with the diligence that you would bring to any investigation.

6.name: Predictive Purchase (Investigator)
6.description: You have just the thing for the situation.

6.name: Defy Fey
6.description: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic.

6.name: Fey Tracker
6.description: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice.

6.name: Read the Dust
6.description: You watch the creature or hazard as it collapses, careful for any sign it may return.

10.name: Just One More Thing
10.description: After your attempt to influence someone goes poorly, you add another bit of information or ask a pointed question, possibly salvaging your previous attempt.

10.name: Ongoing Strategy
10.description: You're constantly studying small aspects of everyone's movements, even if you don't have a stratagem in place ahead of time.

10.name: Suspect of Opportunity
10.description: Sometimes something intrudes upon your case unexpectedly, such as an ambush sent to bring your investigation to a close.

10.name: Greenwatcher
10.description: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled.

12.name: Empiricist's Eye
12.description: Sharp and piercing, your eyes see all and convey more.

12.name: Foresee Danger
12.description: You perceive every possible way your foe's attack could land and attempt to avoid them all.

12.name: Just As Planned
12.description: In the blink of an eye, you calculate your enemy's movements and know exactly where to aim your next blow.

12.name: Make 'em Sweat
12.description: Your line of questioning lets a suspect know you can see right through them, shaking them to the core.

12.name: Reason Rapidly
12.description: Your mind works through clues at an unbelievable speed.

12.name: Share Tincture
12.description: You use Quick Tincture, and the item you create remains potent until the start of your next turn.

12.name: Surgical Shock
12.description: With a few well-placed jabs with your fist or weapon, you render your opponent disoriented or ungainly.

18.name: Lead Investigator
18.description: You spend 1 minute briefing up to four allies about one of your open investigations.

18.name: Trickster's Ace
18.description: Whether from jury-rigged magic items, deduction from the study of magical interactions, or other means, you have a contingency in your back pocket for desperate situations.

18.name: Deduce Habits
18.description: When you use Plot the Future, you can instead contemplate a person that you've gotten to observe within 30 feet for at least 1 minute.

20.name: Everyone's a Suspect
20.description: You are so suspicious of everyone you meet that you keep mental notes on how to defeat them all—even your own allies.

20.name: Just the Facts
20.description: You fundamentally understand everything to the point where your research can't possibly be wrong.

20.name: All the Time in the World
20.description: Your firsthand experience of the subjective nature of time and space has given you new observational insights.

16.name: Master of Many Styles
16.description: You move fluidly between stances, using your mastery of combat to always adopt the best tactics.

16.name: Fuse Stance
16.description: You have combined two stances into a single stance all your own.

16.name: Master Qi Spells
16.description: You have achieved near-total mastery of your qi.

16.name: One-millimeter Punch
16.description: Your punches have incredible force and control.

16.name: Shattering Strike (Monk)
16.description: The force of your considered blow shatters objects and defenses alike.

16.name: Enlightened Presence
16.description: You exude an aura of resolve.

16.name: Quivering Palm
16.description: Your strikes can kill foes.

16.name: Flinging Blow
16.description: You take a moment to center yourself, then unleash a powerful blow that sends your target tumbling away.

16.name: Medusa's Wrath
16.description: You learn a monstrous ki technique that infuses your blows with the petrifying power of a medusa's gaze.

16.name: Electric Counter
16.description: You can charge yourself with lighting, gain resistance to electricity or shocking an attacker.

1.name: Crane Stance
1.description: Your arms flutter like a crane's wings.

1.name: Dragon Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a dragon and make powerful leg strikes like a lashing dragon's tail.

1.name: Monastic Archer Stance
1.description: You enter a specialized stance for a unique martial art centered around the use of a bow.

1.name: Monastic Weaponry
1.description: You have trained with the weaponry of your monastery or school.

1.name: Mountain Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of an implacable mountain—a technique created by dwarven monks—allowing you to strike with the weight of an avalanche and block blows with your garments.

1.name: Qi Spells
1.description: You have cultivated your qi to produce magical effects.

1.name: Stumbling Stance
1.description: You enter a seemingly unfocused stance that mimics the movements of the inebriated—bobbing, weaving, leaving false openings, and distracting your enemies from your true movements.

1.name: Tiger Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a tiger and can make tiger claw attacks.

1.name: Wolf Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a wolf, low to the ground with your hands held like fangs.

1.name: Ki Rush
1.description: You can use ki to move with extraordinary speed and make yourself harder to hit.

1.name: Ki Strike
1.description: Your study of the flow of mystical energy allows you to harness it into your physical strikes.

1.name: Rain of Embers Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of an enraged phoenix.

1.name: Gorilla Stance
1.description: You lower yourself to the ground and take an imposing, knuckle-walking stance.

1.name: Reflective Ripple Stance
1.description: You enter a stance of fluid grace as small amounts of water flow with your movements and attacks.

1.name: Stoked Flame Stance
1.description: You enter a stance of fast, fiery movements.

1.name: Rushing Goat Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of an unruly goat, lowering your body and preparing to butt heads with your foes.

1.name: Twisting Petal Stance
1.description: Your body moves like a petal twisting on the wind, confounding your opponents while using their energy against them.

1.name: Flood Stance
1.description: The lessons of the flood teach a stance that distributes and circulates a single breath through the body and allows your punches to contain the focused power of a torrent of water.

1.name: Wombat Style
1.description: You enter the stance of the implacable wombat, your reinforced backside ready to jostle and batter those who offend you.

2.name: Crushing Grab
2.description: Like a powerful constrictor, you crush targets in your unyielding grasp.

2.name: Dancing Leaf
2.description: You are as light as a leaf on the breeze.

2.name: Elemental Fist
2.description: You can color your qi in bright elemental energy.

2.name: Shooting Stars Stance
2.description: You enter a stance that lets you throw shuriken with lightning speed.

2.name: Stunning Blows
2.description: The focused power of your flurry threatens to overwhelm your opponent.

2.name: Brawling Focus
2.description: You know how to make the most of your attacks when fighting hand-to-hand.

2.name: Stunning Fist
2.description: The focused power of your flurry threatens to overwhelm your opponent.

2.name: Ancestral Weaponry
2.prerequisite: Monastic Weaponry; a feat granting access to all weapons with an ancestry trait (such as elf or orc)
2.description: You blend monastic techniques with the ancestral fighting styles of your people.

2.name: Student of Water
2.description: Following your studies of water, your qi stirs the water of the natural world.

2.name: Waterfowl Stance
2.description: In your hands, swords dance like rainfall over the waves; who can tell where the storm ends and the sea begins?

4.name: Cobra Stance
4.description: You enter a tightly coiled stance, with your hands poised as venomous fangs.

4.name: Deflect Projectile
4.description: You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

4.name: Flurry of Maneuvers
4.description: Your flurry is a combination of maneuvers.

4.name: Flying Kick
4.description: You launch yourself at a foe.

4.name: Guarded Movement
4.description: Your guard is up, even while moving.

4.name: Harmonize Self
4.description: You can restore your health by tapping into your qi.

4.name: Stand Still
4.description: You strike out when your foe tries to flee.

4.name: Deflect Arrow
4.description: Your reflexes allow you to deflect ranged attacks.

4.name: Wholeness of Body
4.description: You can restore your health by tapping into your ki.

4.name: Sacred Ki
4.prerequisite: Ki Strike; you follow a deity
4.description: The power of your faith suffuses your ki

4.name: Peafowl Stance
4.description: You enter a tall and proud stance while remaining mobile, with all the grace and composure of a peafowl.

4.name: Irezoko Tattoo
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
4.description: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the irezoko , a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.

4.name: Divert Streamflow
4.description: With a brief gesture, you adapt swiftly to an attack like a flowing stream.

4.name: Tributary Circulation
4.description: Never distant from water's succoring presence, your refined breathing techniques focus your awareness and control of water inward.

6.name: Advanced Monastic Weaponry
6.description: Your rigorous training regimen allows you to wield complex weaponry with ease.

6.name: Advanced Qi Spells
6.description: Your talent at controlling your qi has reached new heights.

6.name: Align Qi
6.description: The power of your qi soothes your wounds and energizes you for battle.

6.name: Crane Flutter
6.description: You interpose your arm between yourself and your opponent.

6.name: Dragon Roar
6.description: You bellow, instilling fear in your enemies.

6.name: Mountain Stronghold
6.description: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you.

6.name: One-inch Punch
6.description: You put all your force into a single mighty, carefully controlled blow.

6.name: Return Fire
6.description: Snatching an arrow out of the air, you instantly put it to your bow and return fire.

6.name: Stumbling Feint
6.description: You lash out confusingly, with what seems to be a weak move, but instead allows you to unleash a dangerous flurry of blows upon your unsuspecting foe.

6.name: Tiger Slash
6.description: You make a fierce swipe with both hands.

6.name: Water Step
6.description: You can Stride across liquid and surfaces that don't support your weight.

6.name: Whirling Throw
6.description: You propel your enemy away.

6.name: Wolf Drag
6.description: You rip your enemy off their feet.

6.name: Asp Stance
6.description: You adopt a fluid, sinuous stance, swaying your body, twisting your arms, and shimmying your legs in a way that you seem almost to glide over the ground.

6.name: Abundant Step
6.description: You can teleport yourself a short distance.

6.name: Ki Blast
6.description: You can unleash an impactful cone of force by channeling your ki.

6.name: Align Ki
6.description: The power of your ki soothes your wounds and energizes you for battle.

6.name: Gorilla Pound
6.description: You pound your chest before slamming into your foes.

6.name: Blazing Talon Surge
6.description: You rush forward and latch onto your enemy with talons of hungering fire.

6.name: Jellyfish Stance
6.description: You relax your posture and loosen your joints, allowing yourself to move with incredible fluidity.

6.name: Inner Fire (SoM)
6.description: While you're in Stoked Flame Stance, you have cold and fire resistance, and any creature touches you takes fire damage.

6.name: Ki Cutting Sight
6.description: Everything is connnected—all is part of the whole. Find where to add your ki and you can break the whole.

6.name: Momentous Charge
6.description: You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force.

6.name: Culvert's Collapse
6.description: Under your foes' onslaught, the water within your violent blood stirs.

6.name: Wombat Bastion
6.description: You make a quick attack before retreating to safety.

8.name: Clinging Shadows Initiate
8.description: You learn a mystical stance that transforms your qi into sticky smoke that shrouds your limbs.

8.name: Ironblood Stance
8.description: You enter the stance of impenetrable iron, refusing to yield to any blow.

8.name: Mixed Maneuver
8.description: You leverage your knowledge of martial arts to mix different maneuvers together into a single flowing combination.

8.name: Pinning Fire
8.description: You target your opponent's clothing, equipment, or loose flesh with a series of piercing projectiles to pin them to the ground or a nearby surface.

8.name: Projectile Snatching
8.description: You pluck missiles from the air and hurl them back at their source.

8.name: Tangled Forest Stance
8.description: You extend your arms like gnarled branches to interfere with your foes' movements.

8.name: Wall Run
8.description: You defy gravity, traversing vertical planes as easily as the ground.

8.name: Wild Winds Initiate
8.description: You learn a stance that lets you attack from a distance.

8.name: Arrow Snatching
8.description: You pluck missiles from the air and hurl them back at their source.

8.name: Rippling Spin
8.description: After the triggering attack is done, Step.

8.name: Kaiju Stance
8.description: Your encounter with one of the rare forces of nature known as kaiju has imbued you with knowledge of a martial art that allows you to emulate a fraction of their power.

8.name: Scattering in Spring
8.description: You evade an incoming attack by twisting your enemy's tactics in your favor.

8.name: Snakebird's Shadow
8.description: Ganhil developed this technique through observing the sharp-beaked darters fishing Prada Hanam's waters, seeking to match their speed and suppleness with the elemental flash of his blade.

8.name: Wake to Strife
8.description: You summon the explosive power of a geyser beneath a foe.

10.name: Cobra Envenom
10.prerequisite: Cobra Stance; expert in unarmed strikes
10.description: You slightly dislocate your joints to lash out with devious intent and the power to envenom your foe.

10.name: Knockback Strike
10.description: You focus your strength into a blow powerful enough to push an enemy away from you.

10.name: Prevailing Position
10.description: Your flexibility with stances lets you sacrifice their benefits to better protect yourself.

10.name: Sleeper Hold
10.description: You pinch crucial points of your target's nervous system, impeding its ability to function.

10.name: Wind Jump
10.description: You gather the wind beneath you, allowing you to soar as you jump.

10.name: Winding Flow
10.description: Any journey consists of more than simply reaching your destination.

10.name: Peafowl Strut
10.description: You slowly move across the battlefield with dangerous grace.

10.name: Entwined Energy Ki
10.description: You can transform your inner power into a type of energy to empower your ki abilities.

10.name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
10.description: You gain the wronged monk's wrath ki spell.

10.name: Blazing Streak
10.description: Stride twice, making Strikes against up to four different creatures within reach at any point during your movement.

10.name: Lessons of Flux
10.description: You apply the persistence and permutation taught by faydhaans to your failures.

10.name: Wave Dashes Rocks
10.description: You slam an unlucky foe with the tremendous power of a plunging wave.

10.name: Wombat Burrow
10.description: While in Wombat Stance, you gain a Burrow speed equal to the Speed bonus granted by your Incredible Movement ability.

12.name: Disrupt Qi
12.description: You carefully target a creature's pressure points to block its inner life force.

12.name: Dodging Roll
12.description: You dodge a blow at the last possible moment.

12.name: Focused Shot
12.description: You achieve a state of perfect calm before unleashing your attack, opening your mind to the minute movements of the world around you to increase your accuracy.

12.name: Improved Knockback
12.description: When you successfully Shove a creature, increase both the distance you can push the creature and the distance you can move to follow along with the target by 5 feet on a success or 10 feet on a critical success.

12.name: Meditative Focus
12.description: Your meditation is so effective that you can achieve a deep focus with the world around you.

12.name: Overwhelming Breath
12.description: You control your breathing and align it with your qi, exhaling with controlled force in order to overcome your opponent's resistance.

12.name: Reflexive Stance
12.description: You enter a stance without a thought.

12.name: Diamond Soul
12.description: You have fortified your body and mind against eldritch effects.

12.name: Disrupt Ki
12.description: Your strike can block a creature's inner life force.

12.name: Stance Savant (Monk)
12.description: You enter a stance without a thought.

12.name: Sense Ki
12.description: You can read the presence of ki in your area.

12.name: Wave Spiral
12.description: You dip and spin, unleashing a wide whirlpool of water.

12.name: Five-gods Ram
12.description: You attack in an unceasing flurry of charging headbutts.

12.name: Whirling in the Summer Storm
12.description: Your hands move in a hypnotic and distracting flurry that throws your foes off-balance before you cast them away with a violent pirouette.

14.name: Form Lock
14.description: Your ability to control your own qi empowers you to pressure other creatures into resuming their true forms.

14.name: Ironblood Surge
14.description: You steel yourself, preparing to resist oncoming attacks and using your muscles to absorb the impact.

14.name: Mountain Quake
14.description: You stomp, shaking the earth beneath you.

14.name: Peerless Form
14.description: Your mastery over your body is perfect enough to hold back the ravages of time.

14.name: Shadow's Web
14.description: You can launch a wave of shadowy qi outward from your body, damaging your opponents and potentially binding them in place.

14.name: Tangled Forest Rake
14.description: You reposition foes with raking attacks.

14.name: Whirling Blade Stance
14.description: You enter a mindful stance that creates a deep connection between you and your monk weapons, allowing you to manipulate them with your qi, even at a distance.

14.name: Wild Winds Gust
14.description: You build air pressure with repeated motions, before releasing an enormous crescent of rushing wind strikes.

14.name: Timeless Body
14.description: You cease aging.

14.name: Tongue of Sun and Moon
14.description: You have transcended the barriers between words and meaning.

14.name: Explosive Death Drop
14.description: You lift your enemy into the air before bringing them crashing down with a fiery detonation.

14.name: World-breaking Footfall
14.description: You slam the ground and unleash a fearsome roar, sending broken shards of earth flying in all directions.

18.name: Diamond Fists
18.description: Your body hardens as you combine your attacks, making your finishing blows more damaging.

18.name: Grandmaster Qi Spells
18.description: You have unlocked a qi technique achievable only by those who attain complete mastery of both their body and their spirit.

18.name: Qi Center
18.prerequisite: Master of Many Styles; Qi Spells
18.description: You center yourself with the universe and draw upon its vast power.

18.name: Swift River
18.description: You flow like water, avoiding all restraints.

18.name: Triangle Shot
18.description: You string three arrows to your bow and fire them all at once.

18.name: Empty Body
18.description: You transmute your body into an ethereal form.

18.name: Meditative Wellspring
18.description: When you clear your mind, your focus comes flowing back in a powerful rush.

18.name: Ki Center
18.prerequisite: ki spells; Master of Many Styles
18.description: You center yourself with the universe and draw upon its vast power.

18.name: Ki Form
18.description: You have mastered a potent technique for using your ki to reinforce your physical form and propel yourself through the air.

18.name: Effortless Reach
18.description: Focusing the powers of your ki to augment your blows, you stretch and lengthen your body in ways that defy logic.

20.name: Enduring Quickness
20.description: You move as fast and freely as the wind.

20.name: Godbreaker
20.description: You have mastered an ultimate grappling technique capable of breaking even the mightiest of foes.

20.name: Immortal Techniques
20.description: You flow from technique to technique, renewing yourself as you embrace each style you have mastered.

20.name: Impossible Technique
20.description: You execute a maneuver that defies possibility.

20.name: Lightning Qi
20.description: Qi flows freely from within you.

20.name: Golden Body
20.description: Strike harder and heal more rapidly.

20.name: Endurance of the Rooted Tree
20.description: Just as the Vale of Aroden retains light and life despite inhospitable surroundings, you can sustain yourself regardless of your environment.

20.name: Deadly Strikes
20.description: You have honed your body to attack with lethal focus.

20.name: Vitality-Manipulating Stance
20.description: You have learned to attack meridians and pressure points.

20.name: Wake of Devastation
20.description: Like a kaiju, you leave a trail of destruction in your wake.

1.name: You're Next
1.description: After downing a foe, you menace another.

1.name: Disarming Flair
1.description: You knock weapons from the hands of your foes with style.

1.name: Elegant Buckler
1.description: You've learned a flexible way to position your buckler to provide more protection.

1.name: Extravagant Parry
1.description: You use one-handed weapons to parry with style.

1.name: Flashy Dodge
1.description: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

1.name: Flying Blade
1.description: You apply your flashy techniques to thrown weapons as easily as melee attacks.

1.name: Focused Fascination
1.description: When you use Fascinating Performance in a combat encounter, you need only a success, rather than a critical success, to fascinate your target.

1.name: Goading Feint
1.description: Your tricks make foes overextend their attacks.

1.name: One For All
1.description: With precisely the right words of encouragement, you bolster an ally's efforts.

1.name: Plummeting Roll
1.description: Through nimble movements, a graceful landing, and a bit of luck, you can manage to fall from spectacular heights without a scratch.

1.name: Buckler Expertise
1.description: You've learned a flexible way to position your buckler to provide more protection.

1.name: Dueling Parry (Swashbuckler)
1.description: You can parry attacks against you with your weapon.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Agile Maneuvers
6.description: Your easily maneuver against your foes.

6.name: Combination Finisher
6.description: You combine a series of attacks with a powerful finishing blow.

6.name: Precise Finisher
6.description: Even when your foe avoids your Confident Finisher, you can still hit a vital spot.

6.name: Vexing Tumble
6.description: You tumble around your foes, expertly avoiding their reactions.

6.name: Fight or Flight
6.description: You've learned to make use of the surge of adrenaline that comes with fear.

6.name: Attack of Opportunity
6.description: You swat a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Stella's Stab and Snag
6.description: You dart towards your opponent, seeking to stab them and slice their purse-strings with a single movement.

6.name: Pirouette
6.description: You twirl gracefully, spinning on one foot to evade your opponent's attack.

2.name: After You
2.description: You allow your foes to make the first move in a show of incredible confidence.

2.name: Antagonize
2.description: Your taunts and threats earn your foes' ire.

2.name: Brandishing Draw
2.description: You draw and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Charmed Life
2.description: When danger calls, you have a strange knack for coming out on top.

2.name: Enjoy the Show
2.description: You address an ally or any onlookers to your combat, flaunting to your foes how little attention they require.

2.name: Finishing Follow-through
2.description: Finishing a foe maintains your swagger.

2.name: Retreating Finisher
2.description: You make a calculated attack without letting down your guard.

2.name: Tumble Behind (Swashbuckler)
2.description: Your tumbling puts your foes on the back foot.

2.name: Unbalancing Finisher
2.description: You attack with a flashy assault that leaves your target off balance.

2.name: Swan Dive
2.description: You soar through the air and into the water, using your momentum to propel yourself forward.

2.name: Fane's Fourberie
2.description: Stella Fane has perfected a technique for using playing cards as weapons that's one part sleight of hand and one part magic.

4.name: Dastardly Dash
4.description: You dash past an opponent, confounding them with underhanded tactics.

4.name: Even the Odds
4.description: You shine brightest in desperate moments.

4.name: Flamboyant Athlete
4.description: Your panache allows you to perform incredible feats: climbing, swimming, and leaping far beyond your normal capacity.

4.name: Guardian's Deflection
4.description: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering attack.

4.name: Impaling Finisher
4.description: You stab two foes with a single thrust or bash them together with one punch.

4.name: Leading Dance
4.description: You sweep your foe into your dance.

4.name: Swaggering Initiative
4.description: You swagger readily into any fight.

4.name: Twirling Throw
4.description: Your thrown weapons seem to defy physics as they soar through the air and spin back to you after a strike.

4.name: Guardian's Deflection (Swashbuckler)
4.description: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering attack.

4.name: Masquerade of Seasons Stance
4.description: You have mastered the opening steps to the Masquerade of Seasons, a dance that channels the power of spring, summer, winter, and autumn.

4.name: Devrin's Dazzling Diversion
4.description: Devrin Arlos has a habit of using whatever is at hand to temporarily blind others in combat.

8.name: Bleeding Finisher
8.description: Your blow inflicts profuse bleeding.

8.name: Distracting Toss
8.description: You toss one weapon into the air as a distraction as you throw another.

8.name: Dual Finisher
8.description: You split your attacks.

8.name: Flashy Roll
8.description: You can use Flashy Dodge before attempting a Reflex save, in addition to its original trigger.

8.name: Stunning Finisher
8.description: You attempt a dizzying blow.

8.name: Vivacious Bravado
8.description: Your ego swells, granting you a temporary reprieve from your pain.

8.name: Cannonball Fall
8.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics
8.description: You've learned how to make a quick descent with a sudden stop—directly on an enemy.

8.name: Flamboyant Cruelty
8.description: You love to kick your enemies when they're down, and you look fabulous when you do.

8.name: Knight's Retaliation
8.description: You knock the enemy's blow aside and twist, unbalancing your foe.

8.name: Grand Dance
8.description: You can summon the full magic of Bhopan's grand dance.

10.name: Buckler Dance
10.description: You spin your buckler defensively toward every attack.

10.name: Derring-do
10.description: When you compound panache with even more derring-do, it somehow tends to work out.

10.name: Reflexive Riposte
10.description: You can riposte almost without a thought.

10.name: Stumbling Finisher
10.description: Your excellent display of fighting prowess leaves your opponent stumbling back.

10.name: Switcheroo
10.description: You attempt to deftly swap places with an adjacent enemy to avoid the attack.

10.name: Targeting Finisher
10.description: Your attack harms and hinders your foe.

10.name: Halyard Strike
10.description: You've learned to fight confidently while swinging from a line.

10.name: Dueling Dance (Swashbuckler)
10.description: Using your free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon.

10.name: Corpse-Killer's Defiance
10.description: You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies.

10.name: Dazzling Display
10.description: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes.

12.name: Cheat Death
12.description: Somehow you always escape the reaper by a hair's breadth.

12.name: Get Used to Disappointment
12.description: You capitalize on an opponent's failure with smug attitude and swagger, reminding them of the gap in skill between you and your opponent.

12.name: Mobile Finisher
12.description: You attack in motion.

12.name: The Bigger They Are
12.description: With reckless speed, you dash, jump and swing around a creature to find a more vulnerable spot.

14.name: Flamboyant Leap
14.description: You stylishly leap and deliver a powerful finisher.

14.name: Impossible Riposte
14.description: Your ripostes can deflect attacks back at their source.

14.name: Perfect Finisher
14.description: You focus your panache into an impeccable assault.

14.name: Twinned Defense (Swashbuckler)
14.description: You're always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you.

16.name: Deadly Grace
16.description: Your graceful attacks are especially powerful.

16.name: Felicitous Riposte
16.description: You take advantage of your foe's openings with uncanny odds.

16.name: Revitalizing Finisher
16.description: Your swagger instills confidence in you and your allies.

18.name: Incredible Luck
18.description: You always seem to bounce back from the worst.

18.name: Lethal Finisher
18.description: You stab your foe in a vital organ, possibly killing them outright.

18.name: Parry and Riposte
18.description: Your parries and finishers allow you to riposte with the slightest provocation.

20.name: Illimitable Finisher
20.description: Your strikes flow endlessly.

20.name: Inexhaustible Countermoves
20.description: At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an extra reaction

20.name: Panache Paragon
20.description: You find opportunities to perform stylish feats in the moments between others' heartbeats and eye blinks.

20.name: Vivacious Afterimage
20.description: You move so quickly that you create a short-lived afterimage, looks exactly like you, in front of you or behind you.

12.name: Burning Demand
12.description: You create a faintly glowing sigil (shedding normal light in a 5-foot radius) on the target's body, after which you command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the fleeing condition), release what it's holding, drop prone, or stand in place.

12.name: Drowning Mist
12.description: Though not unique to Chelaxian kineticists, this sarglagon-inspired technique floods enemies' lungs.

12.name: Effortless Impulse
12.description: A steady ripple from your kinetic gate maintains one of your impulses.

12.name: Ghosts in the Storm
12.description: Clouds, like eager pets, are drawn to you and to those in your good graces.

12.name: Wiles on the Wind
12.description: Speaking lies, you set them loose upon a drifting wind.

12.name: Rattle The Earth
12.description: Striking the ground with the gravity of the deepest rocks, you cause an earthquake.

12.name: Rock Rampart
12.description: Drawing on your connection to the Plane of Earth, you form a wall of rock and earth.

12.name: Architect of Flame
12.description: Flames rise and shape to your will, forming a wall or dome of your design.

12.name: Furnace Form
12.description: Opening your kinetic gate, you allow flames to consume your form and leave you a living flame.

12.name: Rain of Razors
12.description: Razor-sharp slivers of metal fall from the sky.

12.name: Shattershields
12.description: Four plates of pitted metal float around you to intercept attacks.

12.name: Glacial Prison
12.description: Intense cold swirls around your foe, covering it in frost that slows it down and turns its body to ice.

12.name: Sea Glass Guardians
12.description: Eerily beautiful elemental water beings race around you, eager to protect and heal you and your allies.

12.name: Hedge Maze
12.description: You sculpt a manicured maze of hedges.

12.name: Witchwood Seed
12.description: You touch a creature to implant a malignant seed in its body.

14.name: Liberating Dive
14.description: You sprout wings with steel feathers, resembling those of the celestial Talmandor.

14.name: Nourishing Gate
14.description: You can sustain yourself on a single drop of elemental dew or the slightest spark from the Plane of Fire.

14.name: Rapid Reattunement
14.description: You spend 10 minutes realigning your elemental connections in an elemental trance.

14.name: Body of Air
14.description: Your gathered air consumes your body, leaving only a cloud of living vapor.

14.name: Assume Earth's Mantle
14.description: Enormous pieces of rock cluster around your body.

14.name: Walk Through the Conflagration
14.description: You fall through your own kinetic gate, leaving behind an effigy of flame and reappearing majestically near another fire.

14.name: Alloy Flesh and Steel
14.description: Elemental energy replaces every cell of your body with raw metal.

14.name: Barrier of Boreal Frost
14.description: You form an intricate structure of ice, such as a wall of bricks made of packed snow or a screen of enormous icicles.

14.name: Orchard's Endurance
14.description: Patches of bark appear on the skin of you and your nearby allies.

1.name: Elemental Familiar (Kineticist)
1.description: A small creature made of elemental matter springs forth from your kinetic gate.

1.name: Extended Kinesis
1.description: You've refined the control you can exert over your elements.

1.name: Versatile Blasts
1.description: Accessing a wider realm of elemental manifestations, you can make blasts with rare forms of your elements.

1.name: Weapon Infusion
1.description: With a signature flair, you shape blasts of elemental power into the form of a weapon, such as a sword made of whirling wind or a bow that shoots flames.

1.name: Aerial Boomerang
1.description: A blade of shearing wind races away from you in a 60-foot line.

1.name: Air Cushion
1.description: Air currents flow upward to slow the target's fall to 60 feet per round.

1.name: Four Winds
1.description: Mimicking the anemoi—monarchs of the four winds—you propel four creatures.

1.name: Whisper on the Wind
1.description: You speak in a whisper, a soft wind carrying your words far away.

1.name: Armor in Earth
1.description: Stone encases you like armor.

1.name: Geologic Attunement
1.description: You tune to the earth and stone around you, extending your senses through it in rippling waves.

1.name: Stepping Stones
1.description: Disks of rock fly to points that you designate to make a new path.

1.name: Tremor
1.description: You unleash a small, localized tremor in a 10-foot burst within 30 feet.

1.name: Burning Jet
1.description: A condensed burst of flame shoots behind you, propelling you forward with its sheer force.

1.name: Eternal Torch
1.description: You open a connection to your kinetic gate, large enough for a torch flame to flow.

1.name: Flying Flame
1.description: A Tiny shape of flame appears, taking a form of your choice— such as a bird, an arrow, or a simple sphere.

1.name: Scorching Column
1.description: With an upward gesture, you shape a vertical column of extreme heat.

1.name: Flash Forge
1.description: An artificial metal object forms in the hands of you or a willing ally within 30 feet.

1.name: Magnetic Pinions
1.description: Small pieces of metal fly from you, propelled with magnetism at great velocity.

1.name: Metal Carapace
1.description: Sheets of bent and rusted metal cover you in an armored shell.

1.name: Shard Strike
1.description: Jagged metal shards form in the air and lash out from you.

1.name: Deflecting Wave
1.description: A cascade of water blunts or disperses the incoming attack.

1.name: Ocean's Balm
1.description: A blessing of the living sea salves wounds and douses flames.

1.name: Tidal Hands
1.description: With an emphatic gesture, you create waves that rush out from you in the shape of your hands.

1.name: Winter's Clutch
1.description: Gleaming flakes of chilling snow fall in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet.

1.name: Fresh Produce
1.description: You grow a nourishing nut, vegetable, seed, or fruit.

1.name: Hail of Splinters
1.description: A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you.

1.name: Hardwood Armor
1.description: Wood and bark grow over your body like armor.

1.name: Timber Sentinel
1.description: A slim, symmetrical tree travels from the Plane of Wood.

2.name: Kinetic Activation
2.description: Rather than incantations and gestures, you can use your kinetic gate to directly unlock the potential of elementally empowered magic items.

2.name: Voice of the Elements
2.description: You can speak with the secret tones of elements you channel, finding words in the crackle of flame, the grinding of stone.

4.name: Command Elemental
4.description: You grasp the animating force within an elemental creature and bend it to your will.

4.name: Safe Elements
4.description: Elements are wild and dangerous, but you've found ways to reduce their risk.

4.name: Air Shroud
4.description: Turbulent air suffuses your kinetic aura.

4.name: Lightning Dash
4.description: For an instant, you transform yourself into a being of pure lightning and fly forward, shocking anyone in your way.

4.name: Calcifying Sand
4.description: Your flesh gives way as you're struck, becoming coarse sand that can magically turn your enemy to stone.

4.name: Igneogenesis
4.description: You can create a permanent stone object, either sculpting stone pulled directly from your kinetic gate or manipulating earth and stone around you.

4.name: Blazing Wave
4.description: Flames flow out of you in a cascade, engulfing everyone in a 30-foot cone.

4.name: Thermal Nimbus
4.description: You direct waves of warmth into or out of your kinetic gate to drastically shift the temperature around you.

4.name: Magnetic Field
4.description: A magnetic field surrounds you.

4.name: Plate in Treasure
4.description: Precious metal flows from your fingers to plate an object.

4.name: Return to the Sea
4.description: You adapt a creature to living and moving in water.

4.name: Winter Sleet
4.description: Bone-chilling, swirling sleet surrounds you, cruel as deepest winter.

4.name: Ravel of Thorns
4.description: Thorny vines grow in geometric patterns on surfaces in your kinetic aura.

4.name: Tumbling Lumber
4.description: A slew of logs eject from the Plane of Wood and slam into your enemies.

4.name: Ambush Bladderwort
4.description: You plant the seed of a giant bladderwort in an unoccupied square of ground or water within 30 feet.

4.name: Lava Leap
4.description: You wreath yourself in molten stone and hurtle toward your enemy.

4.name: Living Bonfire
4.description: Roots and branches of living wood writhe in elemental fire at your command, forming a bonfire fearsome enough to scare off predators in the night.

4.name: Rain of Rust
4.description: You conjure a red raincloud in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet, which pours rust-colored rain directly below it.

4.name: Whirling Grindstone
4.description: A whirling grindstone made of flint appears in an unoccupied square within 30 feet.

4.name: Born to the Trees
4.description: You adapt a creature to live among the trees, improving its ability to climb, balance, and leap.

6.name: Counter Element
6.description: Your absolute dedication to a single element lets you attempt to gain control over it, even when the element is in service to another entity.

6.name: Fearsome Familiar
6.description: Your elemental familiar trades places with an elemental from its elemental plane.

6.name: Two-Element Infusion
6.description: Slamming one element into another, you combine their strengths.

6.name: Clear as Air
6.description: Compact layers of air diffract and bend light around your body, making you appear as clear as the sky on a perfect day.

6.name: Flinging Updraft
6.description: A speeding wind heeds your call, picking someone up and depositing them nearby.

6.name: Sand Snatcher
6.description: A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet.

6.name: Weight of Stone
6.description: A packed cloud of thundering boulders descends from the sky, beating down everyone in its path.

6.name: Crawling Fire
6.description: You mimic the motions of a beast of your devising, and it becomes real, with a flaming pelt and searing claws.

6.name: Volcanic Escape
6.description: Lava reflexively explodes underneath you and the creature that hurt you.

6.name: Consume Power
6.description: You absorb energy and hold it in your kinetic gate.

6.name: Scrap Barricade
6.description: Ragged pieces of metal weld together into a ramshackle structure.

6.name: Driving Rain
6.description: Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision.

6.name: Torrent in the Blood
6.description: A healing wave splashes across creatures in a 30-foot cone, its cleansing water driving afflictions from the body.

6.name: Dash of Herbs
6.description: A small cloud of medicinal herbs heal a creature.

6.name: Wooden Palisade
6.description: Planks of wood, embellished with carvings, spring forth to form a wall.

6.name: Ash Strider
6.description: You discorporate into a cloud of whirling ash and Stride.

6.name: Desert Wind
6.description: A vortex of sand and dust surrounds you.

6.name: Elemental Artillery
6.description: Spinning wood and metal together, you create a rugged wooden ballista.

6.name: Jagged Berms
6.description: You conjure up to six cube-shaped mounds of packed earth.

6.name: Lightning Rod
6.description: You smash a metal rod into your foe and call lightning to it.

6.name: Molten Wire
6.description: Spinning molten iron through a vortex of fire, you trap your foe in searing wires.

6.name: Rising Hurricane
6.description: A hurricane lifts your enemies into the air before bringing them crashing down in a bloody rain.

6.name: Roiling Mudslide
6.description: You form water and earth into a mudslide that smashes your opponents and coats them in mud.

6.name: Steam Knight
6.description: You shape your kinetic aura into swirling armor of steam that scalds your enemies and propels you on super-heated jet streams.

6.name: Tree of Duality
6.description: An ephemeral tree bursts forth, floating on air in an unoccupied square of your choice within 60 feet.

8.name: Elemental Overlap
8.description: Though you've dedicated yourself to one element, you learn to mix that element with another.

8.name: Purify Element
8.description: You turn an element into its purest form.

8.name: Cyclonic Ascent
8.description: Whorls of wind surround your lower body, forming a cyclone that lifts you into the air.

8.name: Storm Spiral
8.description: Dark thunderclouds swirl in a miniature storm, crisscrossed with lightning bolts; a tremendous thunderclap fills the air.

8.name: Spike Skin
8.description: You touch a willing creature, causing its skin to harden and form spiky protrusions.

8.name: Swim Through Earth
8.description: The earth parts before you, letting you swim through it.

8.name: Kindle Inner Flames
8.description: As a candle can light another, you awaken the latent potential to channel fire in other creatures.

8.name: Solar Detonation
8.description: Blinding flames explode in a swirling sphere! The detonation fills a 20-foot burst within 60 feet of you.

8.name: Conductive Sphere
8.description: A floating metal ball forms in a space within 30 feet, flashing with electricity.

8.name: Retch Rust
8.description: You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal.

8.name: Call the Hurricane
8.description: Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane.

8.name: Impenetrable Fog
8.description: Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you.

8.name: Drifting Pollen
8.description: A haze of pollen floats around you.

8.name: Sanguivolent Roots
8.description: Blood-drinking vines grow from the ground in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet.

10.name: Aura Shaping
10.description: You control the size of your kinetic aura.

10.name: Chain Infusion
10.description: The elemental matter in your blast keeps reconstituting itself to travel onward, no matter how many bodies it collides with.

10.name: Elemental Transformation
10.description: You open your kinetic gate, but rather than activating your kinetic aura, you instead become overwhelmed with transformative elemental energy.

16.name: Imperious Aura
16.prerequisite: one or more stance impulses that affect your kinetic aura
16.description: Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements.

18.name: Elemental Apotheosis
18.prerequisite: Nourishing Gate; exactly one kinetic element
18.description: You take on an elemental countenance, appearing like a type of elemental of your element.

18.name: Crowned in Tempest's Fury
18.description: You become one with a devastating thunderstorm from the Plane of Air, placing a crown of lightning upon your brow.

18.name: Infinite Expanse of Bluest Heaven
18.description: An illusion of a limitless expanse with an impossibly blue sky makes all within feel the sensation of falling...

18.name: Rebirth in Living Stone
18.description: Rock overflows from within you to consume your form before cracking open to reveal your body transformed into living stone.

18.name: The Shattered Mountain Weeps
18.description: A massive sphere of rock explodes, unleashing a cataclysm of falling debris and deadly shrapnel.

18.name: All Shall End in Flames
18.description: White-hot fire consumes everything in a cataclysmic sphere of death.

18.name: Ignite the Sun
18.description: The fires of creation become yours to control.

18.name: Beasts of Slumbering Steel
18.description: You conjure metal elemental mounts made of interlocking metal pieces.

18.name: Hell of 1,000,000 Needles
18.description: The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal.

18.name: Ride the Tsunami
18.description: Booming, crashing walls of water, enough to fill a harbor, smash out ahead of you, overwhelming all in their path.

18.name: Usurp the Lunar Reins
18.description: The moon has always been connected to the tides, and now you can grasp that connection.

18.name: Rouse the Forest's Fury
18.description: Terrifying trees attack your enemies.

18.name: Turn the Wheel of Seasons
18.description: The seasons shift rapidly.

18.name: The Thousand Lashes of the Weeping Willow
18.description: You conjure a massive willow tree, which lashes your foes with a thousand branches.

20.name: Kinetic Pinnacle
20.description: No one can match the pace at which elements flow from you.

20.name: Omnikinesis
20.description: You can realign your kinetic gate with a thought.

1.name: Backup Runic Enhancement
1.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
1.description: While you are not a spellcaster, you have a working knowledge of the most fundamental runic magic.

1.name: Engraving Strike
1.description: You draw a rune onto the surface of your weapon in reverse, the mark branding or bruising itself into your target at the moment of impact.

1.name: Glyph Familiar
1.description: You have taken a living rune as a familiar to aid you in your adventures.

1.name: Rune Ward
1.description: You quickly sketch a rune in the air to gain a modicum of protection against the triggering magic.

1.name: Rune-Singer
1.description: You practice the lost art of using music to guide your runecarving, singing the runes into existence as much as crafting them.

1.name: Seek the Hidden Glyphs
1.description: You are well-versed in the use of magical runes in traps and hazards.

1.name: Smithing Weapons
1.description: Though you are an artisan, you are well versed in using the tools of your trade to fend off enemies.

2.name: Enhanced Glyph Familiar
2.description: Your living rune is imbued with more magical power.

2.name: Fortifying Knock
2.description: Your shield is a natural canvas for your art.

2.name: Invisible Ink
2.description: After your rune is drawn, it flares once and then fades, leaving only the barest mark.

2.name: Pattern Flight
2.description: You place a bit of magic in a physical projectile, causing it to fly in a runic pattern through the air once you loose it.

2.name: Runic Tattoo
2.description: By drawing your favorite rune in your flesh, you know you'll never be without it.

4.name: Artist's Attendance
4.description: Your runes call you to better attend to your art.

4.name: Ghostly Resonance
4.description: Your runes don't just draw power from the world of the spirits— they can let even the most mundane objects harm spirits as well.

4.name: Song of Glorious Invocation
4.description: You weave the true names of several runes you've drawn into a beautiful song, invoking them all simultaneously. Choose up to three rune-bearers within 30 feet and Invoke one Rune on each of them. The song also inspires the rune-bearers, granting them a +1 status bonus to skill ch

4.name: Terrifying Invocation
4.description: You spit and roar as you pronounce your rune's terrible name.

4.name: Transpose Etching
4.description: With a pinching gesture, you pick up a word and move it elsewhere.

4.name: Writing on the Wall
4.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
4.description: You place hidden messages written in a runic cipher of your devising.

6.name: Diacritic Fluency
6.description: When you intensify your attention, you can modify a rune with great speed.

6.name: Engraving Maneuver
6.description: After quickly drawing a rune on your weapon, you can transfer the rune to a foe as you knock them down, push them away, or disarm their weapon.

6.name: Runic Reprisal
6.description: When you Raise your Shield, you can bury a runic trap into it, which is set off by the clash of an enemy weapon.

6.name: Tracing Trance
6.description: Your hands flow unbidden, tracing runes as if by purest instinct.

6.name: Vital Compound Invocation
6.description: You can invoke runes from traditions that manipulate vital energy to restore flesh.

6.name: Words, Fly Free
6.description: Just because your runes are tattooed on your very body doesn't mean they need to remain there.

8.name: Drawn in Vital Ink
8.description: After striking the target, you run a brush or finger along your weapon to collect a bit of its blood.

8.name: Edifying Trace
8.description: When you apply a rune to a foe, it reveals something about them to you.

8.name: Elemental Revision
8.description: You can scratch out and rewrite part of an elemental rune to temporarily change the type of power it channels.

8.name: Swiping Trace
8.description: You prepare a rune on the end of your weapon so that it transfers to your enemies.

10.name: Chain of Words
10.description: You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another.

10.name: Clashing Compound Invocation
10.description: As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash.

10.name: Overloaded Ammunition
10.description: You can tenuously bind power into arrows or sling stones to transform them into explosive missiles.

10.name: Prodigal Rune-Singer
10.description: You have mastered the art of singing your runes.

10.name: Runic Correspondence
10.prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion
10.description: You can write a message that travels long distances at the speed of thought.

12.name: Astral Compound Invocation
12.description: Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes.

12.name: Distant Invocation
12.description: Your connection to your runes stretches over even greater distances.

12.name: Expanded Glossary
12.description: You have memorized more runes than many in your craft.

12.name: Orbiting Runestone
12.description: You create a runestone that floats around you, and you Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on it even if the rune could not normally be applied to an object.

14.name: Dance of Bloody Ink
14.description: As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target's flesh.

14.name: Define the Canvas
14.description: You produce rune-inscribed stones, which whirl in the air before darting away to form a perimeter for a runic canvas.

14.name: Henge Gate
14.description: You hold a rune in your heart and strike the earth, causing two standing stones to rise nearby, your chosen rune carved upon their surfaces and blazing in the air above them.

14.name: Unerring Runic Attraction
14.description: Your runes act as beacons for your arrows and bolts. Make a ranged Strike against a foe you're aware of that's currently bearing a rune and within your first range increment. The ammunition homes in on your target, even going around corners. Your Strike doesn't require line of si

16.name: By Your Name
16.description: In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name.

16.name: Maze of Runes
16.prerequisite: Legendary in Arcana, Legendary in Nature, Legendary in Occultism, or Legendary in Religion
16.description: You can trap a foe in a twisting, extradimensional labyrinth of ever-shifting runes.

16.name: Return Unto Runes
16.description: You attempt to deconstruct an incoming spell into its individual magical components, storing them temporarily as a rune.

16.name: Runesight
16.description: It is impossible for those bearing runes to hide from you.

18.name: Annihilating Compound Invocation
18.description: Each tradition of magic holds sway over two of the four essences that make up all of creation, and so by invoking runes from each tradition at once, you can pull from the four corners of magic to unravel anything.

18.name: Living Lexicon
18.description: Your knowledge of runes knows no bounds.

18.name: Unbounded Invocations
18.description: Your words can shake the very foundations of the world.

20.name: Forge New Word
20.description: At the pinnacle of your art, you have forged a new great rune of power, a new ideal expression or utterance to be added to the craft.

20.name: Generational Rune-Singer
20.description: You are a once-in-a-generation genius.

20.name: Shades of Meaning
20.description: As the gap between your intention and your words becomes almost nothing, you find that you don't need to consciously draw the diacritic marks that would embellish or modify your runes.

20.name: Stone Forge of the First
20.description: You conjure forth a massive stone forge within 30 feet that occupies a 15-foot cube in empty spaces on the ground.

2.name: Tattoo Artist
2.description: You can craft tattoos, including magical tattoos.

2.name: Express Driver
2.description: You can optimize your vehicle's performance, coaxing extra speed and choosing paths to avoid slowdowns.

2.name: Automatic Knowledge
2.prerequisite: expert in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action; Assurance in that skill
2.description: Recall Knowledge as a free action once per round

2.name: Bonded Animal
2.description: An animal becomes permanently easier to command

2.name: Communal Crafting
2.description: Other PCs can help you Craft

2.name: Confabulator
2.description: Reduce the bonuses against your repeated lies

2.name: Continual Recovery
2.description: Treat Wounds on a patient more often

2.name: Glad-Hand
2.description: Make an Impression on a target you've just met

2.name: Intimidating Prowess
2.description: Gain a bonus to physically Demoralize a target

2.name: Inventor
2.description: Use Crafting to create item formulas

2.name: Lasting Coercion
2.description: Coerce a target into helping you longer

2.name: Magical Crafting
2.description: Craft magic items

2.name: Magical Shorthand
2.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
2.description: Learn spells quickly and at a reduced cost

2.name: Nimble Crawl
2.description: Crawl at a faster rate

2.name: Powerful Leap
2.description: Jump farther and higher

2.name: Quick Disguise
2.description: Set up a disguise in less time

2.name: Quiet Allies
2.description: Roll a single Stealth check when sneaking with allies

2.name: Rapid Mantel
2.description: Pull yourself onto ledges quickly

2.name: Robust Recovery
2.description: Greater benefits from Treat Disease and Treat Poison

2.name: Unmistakable Lore
2.description: Recall Knowledge about your Lore more effectively

2.name: Unusual Treatment
2.description: Treat Wounds tends to additional conditions

2.name: Ward Medic
2.description: Treat several patients at once

2.name: Wary Disarmament
2.description: +2 to AC or saves against devices or traps while disarming

2.name: Fresh Ingredients
2.description: It is amazing the difference fresh herbs can make.

2.name: Armored Stealth
2.description: You have learned techniques to adjust and modify your armor and movements to reduce the noise you make.

2.name: Assured Identification
2.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
2.description: You rarely misidentify an item.

2.name: Backup Disguise
2.description: You have a specific disguise that you keep at the ready, worn underneath your outer garment.

2.name: Battle Planner
2.description: You are constantly drawing up plans and battle scenarios, assembling strategies and gathered intelligence for later use.

2.name: Discreet Inquiry
2.prerequisite: Expert in Deception or Expert in Diplomacy
2.description: You are subtle in your efforts to learn the things you need to know.

2.name: Distracting Performance
2.description: Your performances are especially distracting, allowing your allies to Sneak away with ease.

2.name: Exhort the Faithful
2.prerequisite: Expert in Religion; follower of a specific religion
2.description: Your knowledge of the tenets of your faith gives you insight into the best ways to get others of your faith to help you or to follow your directions.

2.name: Eyes of the City
2.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Society
2.description: You can track down targets with the help of locals.

2.name: Lead Climber
2.description: When climbing, you can prepare routes for others to follow, and you can pull your allies up to avoid disaster.

2.name: Leverage Connections
2.prerequisite: Courtly Graces or Streetwise; Expert in Society
2.description: You know the right people who can get things done for you in certain circles.

2.name: Rolling Landing
2.description: You land with quick rolls that help you keep your momentum.

2.name: Sanctify Water
2.prerequisite: Expert in Religion; you follow a deity with "holy" or "unholy" sanctification
2.description: You imbue water with your deity's blessing.

2.name: Shadow Mark
2.description: You have learned special tricks that help you follow individuals without them noticing you.

2.name: Slippery Prey
2.prerequisite: Trained in Athletics or Trained in Acrobatics
2.description: You're able to escape bonds more easily than others.

2.name: Sow Rumor
2.description: You spread rumors, which may or may not be true, about a specific subject.

2.name: Terrifying Resistance
2.description: The spells of those you have Demoralized are less effective on you.

2.name: Tumbling Teamwork
2.description: Your tumbling distracts a foe enough to create an advantage for one of your allies.

2.name: Underground Network
2.description: You're connected to groups that know what's going on in the streets, and you can get information out of them quickly.

2.name: Aura Sight
2.description: You've learned how to read the natural auras of other living creatures.

2.name: Automatic Writing
2.description: When confronted with the unknown, you can receive knowledge beyond your own experience via written messages delivered by your hand.

2.name: Chromotherapy
2.description: You firmly believe in the technique of strengthening one's life force, spiritual energies, and bodily fluids through the application of colored light.

2.name: Familiar Oddities
2.prerequisite: Curse Maelstrom Dedication; Trained in Occultism or Trained in Curse Lore
2.description: Perhaps due to the curse within you, curses occasionally perceive you as an extension of themselves and readily reveal themselves to you

2.name: Malleable Movement
2.prerequisite: Mind Smith Dedication; Expert in Athletics
2.description: You shift the shape of your weapon to help you Leap farther and faster.

2.name: Godless Healing
2.prerequisite: Battle Medicine; can't have a patron deity
2.description: You recover an additional 5 Hit Points from a successful attempt to Treat your Wounds or use Battle Medicine on you.

2.name: Mortal Healing
2.prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; you follow the Laws of Mortality
2.description: You grant greater healing when the gods don't interfere.

2.name: Tactical Acumen
2.description: Even if you don't know much about its constituent creatures, you can always recognize a troop's capabilities through features like the formation they move in or even more subtle hints others might miss.

2.name: Connections
2.description: Leverage your connections for favors and meetings.

2.name: Wilderness Spotter
2.description: Use Survival for your Initiative when in a specific terrain.

2.name: Eye of the Arclords
2.description: The Arclords of Nex have achieved a unique mastery of magic.

2.name: Tweak Appearances
2.description: You can alter a creature's clothing to improve their social impact.

2.name: Juggle
2.description: You can Juggle items and still use your hands between tosses.

2.name: Encouraging Words
2.description: You give an ally a quick pep talk, helping them recover.

2.name: Criminal Connections
2.description: Leverage your underworld connections for favors from criminals.

2.name: Quick Contacts
2.prerequisite: Expert in Society; Connections or Criminal Connections
2.description: Spend only 1 day to use Connections or Criminal Connections.

2.name: Embed Aeon Stone
2.description: You discover the secrets to embedding aeon stones into your flesh.

2.name: Spirit Speaker
2.description: You know that when an animal dies, its spirit lingers briefly before moving on.

2.name: Triumphant Boast
2.description: You relate a loud and impressive tale of your triumph over a formidable foe.

2.name: Predict Weather
2.description: By observing often subtle indicators in the environment, you may try to predict the day's weather.

2.name: Fleeing Diversion
2.description: You are quick to capitalize on your distractions.

2.name: Half-Truths
2.prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Expert in Diplomacy
2.description: You are able to weave your words in such a way that you never use actual lies, but still mislead people to certain conclusions.

2.name: Cooperative Crafting
2.description: You've learned to make the most of working with others on your crafting projects, a must when working with the various guilds of Highhelm.

2.name: What's That up Your Sleeve?
2.description: Whether as a dealer or player, you've learned to spot cheaters.

2.name: Energy Fortification
2.prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Occultism
2.description: You learn Minkaian traditions about the void and know how to manipulate the five elements to fortify vitality and void energies in the body.

2.name: Pei Zing Adept
2.prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Expert in Medicine
2.description: You're practiced at timing preparations to the point where you can treat multiple patients at once.

2.name: Performer's Treatment
2.prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; Expert in Performance
2.description: With your experience as a performer, you can keep a set of medical tools handy at all times.

2.name: Vasodilation
2.description: Using the power of your own blood, you encourage increased blood flow to nourish damaged tissue.

2.name: Dueling Acumen
2.description: You're always ready for a new duel, and you've been trained to start and end fights quickly.

4.name: Gear Gnash
4.description: Snares you create have complicated inner workings that are quite difficult to disable.

4.name: Power Slide
4.description: You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit or bring your weapons to bear.

4.name: Engine Bay
4.prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Expert in Crafting
4.description: You are practiced at working in vast garages of vehicles and can work on many machines at a time.

4.name: Named Artillery
4.description: It is a tradition among artillerists to name the siege weapon most important to them and closest to their heart—much as a sailor on a ship, the weapon is their livelihood.

4.name: Settlement Scholastics
4.description: Your studies open up new horizons.

4.name: Quick Mount
4.description: You and your mount can spring into action at a moment's notice.

4.name: Distracting Flattery
4.description: You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company.

4.name: Fancy Moves
4.description: You show off your fighting style to discourage your foes.

4.name: Multilingual Cipher
4.description: You use multiple languages to create and break codes.

4.name: Phonetic Training
4.description: You can pronounce and repeat words with near-perfect accuracy even if you don't understand their meaning, and you can write them down in a phonetic script that allows you or another creature with Phonetic Training to read it later.

4.name: Treat Condition
4.description: You treat an adjacent creature in an attempt to reduce the clumsy, enfeebled, or sickened condition.

4.name: Rope Runner
4.prerequisite: Pirate Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics; Trained in Athletics
4.description: You run and climb across ropes and rigging almost as easily as on the ground.

4.name: Reverse Engineering
4.description: Your nigh-constant tinkering and fiddling with objects means you are able to reverse engineer items into formulas more effectively than most.

4.name: Steel Skin
4.description: You wear your armor like a second skin, taking comfort in the protection it offers.

4.name: Hidden Magic
4.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
4.description: You've learned to hide the magical auras of your gear.

4.name: Minion Guise
4.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Deception; animal companion or familiar
4.description: When you are in your social identity, you can also grant a social identity to an animal companion, familiar, pet, or other minion you gained from a class feature or feat.

4.name: Social Purview
4.description: You have built a reputation for yourself in your social identity.

4.name: Change of Face
4.description: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look—luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques.

4.name: In Plain Sight
4.description: People often only see what they want to see, a weakness you know how to take full advantage of.

4.name: Sociable Vow
4.description: You can leverage your vow in more social interactions.

4.name: Inner Sea Privateer
4.prerequisite: Pirate Dedication; Expert in Sailing Lore
4.description: You make your living as a pirate, as well as a little extra by hiring out your services to Andoran, Cheliax, or Mbe'ke.

4.name: Peer Past the Hedge
4.description: You can pick up on subtle magic with ease.

4.name: Thorough Reports
4.description: Recalling Knowledge adds creatures to your list, granting you bonuses to Recall in future encounters.

4.name: Diabolic Certitude
4.description: Your Hellknight training drilled details of Hell's denizens deep into your mind.

4.name: Sure Foot
4.prerequisite: Horizon Walker Dedication; Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Athletics
4.description: You know the secrets of moving in your favored terrain.

4.name: Orthographic Mastery
4.description: You understand the principles that underlie all written words, allowing you to read nearly any text.

4.name: Hideous Ululation
4.description: Your throat has multiple separate chambers that can give your voice an eerie echo.

4.name: Dead Reckoning
4.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Trained in Survival
4.description: You've trained yourself to maintain a strong sense of direction at all times, even when you can't use a compass or see the sky above.

4.name: Fane's Escape
4.description: A good getaway requires a good distraction.

4.name: Kreighton's Cognitive Crossover
4.description: Kreighton teaches his students that an agile mind can glean clues leading to the truth, even from the most unlikely of sources.

4.name: Blessed Medicine
4.description: Your experience battling undead has uniquely prepared you to fight the diseases they inflict on the survivors, and you know that leaving these maladies untreated for long will eventually lead to more undead.

4.name: Familiar Foe
4.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; Expert in Religion or Expert in Undead Lore
4.description: You regularly face off against undead and can identify many with a glance.

4.name: Final Rest
4.description: As stubborn in death as you are in life, you vow you'll never aid your hated enemies.

4.name: Eclipsed Vitality
4.prerequisite: Assassin Dedication or Scout Dedication; Master in Stealth
4.description: You shroud yourself in ashes that hide the vital essence sought by life-sensing undead.

4.name: That's Not Natural!
4.description: Your mastery at surviving in the wild has given you a sort of sixth-sense when it comes to noticing creatures that aren't part of the natural order.

4.name: Ambush Tactics
4.prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain
4.description: You've made a study of the best practices for laying ambushes in terrains you've spent time learning about, be it the best way to ambush foes or the best methods of reacting to surprise attacks in those terrains.

4.name: Efficient Explorer
4.prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain
4.description: You are more efficient at exploring uncharted territories.

4.name: Solo Dancer
4.prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Expert in Performance
4.description: You often dance alone with a grace exceeding that of most other performers, carrying yourself with a poise and confidence that draws the attention of those around you.

4.name: Twirl Through
4.description: You sweep across the battlefield in a fluttering of movement honed from years of coordinating perfectly spaced movements alongside fellow dancers.

4.name: Text Decoder
4.description: Thanks to your constant involvement with cryptic texts, you have attained an almost-supernatural ability to decipher complex codes and understand ancient writings.

4.name: Canopy Predator
4.prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Trained in Athletics
4.description: You are as at home in the treetops as you are beneath their branches.

4.name: Commitment to Equality
4.prerequisite: Eagle Knight Dedication; Expert in Diplomacy
4.description: You help an ally shake off any impediment that would give an enemy an unfair advantage.

4.name: Predispose Settlement
4.prerequisite: Field Propagandist Dedication; Expert in Deception
4.description: You spend 7 days of downtime seeding propaganda through a settlement with a population of 2,500 or fewer.

4.name: Cushion Landing
4.description: As you fall, your mount dashes to your rescue.

4.name: Mounting Leap
4.description: You jump atop your mount from afar, landing comfortably astride it.

4.name: Devil you Know
4.prerequisite: Hellbreaker Dedication; Expert in Devil Lore or Expert in Hellknight Lore
4.description: Your knowledge of your enemies gives you an advantage against them, granting you a swift reaction to their devilry.

7.name: Propeller Attachment
7.description: You've mastered attaching clockwork propellers to your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

7.name: Push it
7.prerequisite: Trick Driver Dedication; Master in Driving Lore
7.description: You can push your vehicle's performance beyond the limits envisioned by its makers.

7.name: Efficient Controls
7.prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Master in Crafting
7.description: By reducing redundant systems and streamlining essential functions, you have made it easier for the vehicle to operate with fewer crew.

7.name: That was a Close One, Huh?
7.prerequisite: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication; Master in Deception
7.description: You laugh innocently about the inexplicable luck of your last shot hitting its mark or how close the attack that just missed you came to taking your head off, causing your foes to second guess whether it's a good idea to oppose you in battle.

7.name: Quick Setup
7.description: You have learned to setup simple crafting jobs with ease.

7.name: Advanced First Aid
7.description: Use First Aid to reduce frightened and sickened condition values

7.name: Battle Cry
7.description: Demoralizes foes when you roll for initiative

7.name: Bizarre Magic
7.description: Your magic becomes more difficult to identify

7.name: Break Curse
7.prerequisite: Master in Occultism or Master in Religion
7.description: Use your knowledge to break curses

7.name: Foil Senses
7.description: Take precautions against special senses

7.name: Impeccable Crafting
7.description: Craft items more efficiently

7.name: Kip Up
7.description: Stand up for free without triggering reactions

7.name: Monster Crafting
7.description: Craft items using monster parts

7.name: Planar Survival
7.description: Use Survival to Subsist on different planes

7.name: Quick Climb
7.description: Climb swiftly

7.name: Quick Recognition
7.prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion; Recognize Spell
7.description: Identify spells as a free action

7.name: Quick Swim
7.description: Swim quickly

7.name: Quick Unlock
7.description: Pick a Lock with 1 action

7.name: Shameless Request
7.description: Make Requests of others with lesser consequences

7.name: Slippery Secrets
7.description: Evade attempts to uncover your true nature

7.name: Swift Sneak
7.description: Move your full Speed while you Sneak

7.name: Terrified Retreat
7.description: Cause foes you Demoralize to flee

7.name: Wall Jump
7.description: Jump off walls

7.name: Graceful Leaper
7.description: Mass and muscle are meaningless when you propel yourself through the air; only grace and balance matter.

7.name: Scholastic Identification
7.description: You have the knowledge needed to understand ancient texts and cultural artifacts.

7.name: Fabricated Connections
7.description: You can lie about having taken an action so convincingly that you acquire all the tangible benefits of having successfully completed it.

7.name: Party Crasher
7.description: You attend all the fashionable society parties, no matter how exclusive they might be.

7.name: Read Shibboleths
7.description: All communication is filled with slight tells and signals.

7.name: Expert Disassembly
7.description: You can apply the same techniques you use to reverse engineer objects to disable dangerous traps and break apart locks.

7.name: Subjective Truth
7.description: Your disparate identities allow you to defeat magic that detects lies.

7.name: Aerobatics Mastery
7.description: You move with grace in flight and can perform amazing aerial stunts.

7.name: Biographical Eye
7.description: In even a brief conversation or social interaction, you pick up on subtle social and visual cues to learn a great deal about a person's origin and history.

7.name: Consult the Spirits
7.prerequisite: Master in Occultism, Master in Nature, or Master in Religion
7.description: You have learned rites or meditations that enable you to perceive minor, invisible spirits within a place.

7.name: Disturbing Knowledge
7.description: You utter a litany of dreadful names, prophecies, and descriptions of realms beyond mortal comprehension, drawn from your study of forbidden tomes and scrolls.

7.name: Doublespeak
7.description: You're skilled at saying one thing and meaning something different.

7.name: Environmental Guide
7.description: You can rapidly adapt to climates and help others do the same.

7.name: Evangelize
7.prerequisite: Master in Diplomacy; follower of a specific religion or philosophy
