7.description: You point out a detail that incontrovertibly supports your faith, causing a listener's mind to whirl.

7.name: Influence Nature
7.description: With patience and time, you can make bird calls, leave game trails, and ultimately influence the behavior of a certain type of animals in the region to favor and even aid you in the days to come.

7.name: Rapid Affixture
7.description: You take only 1 minute to Affix a Talisman.

7.name: Signature Crafting
7.description: Magic items you create bear a stamp specific to your handiwork.

7.name: Tumbling Theft
7.prerequisite: Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Thievery
7.description: You reach for an opponent's item as you move past a foe.

7.name: Water Sprint
7.description: Experience and training have taught you that water has just enough surface tension for a master sprinter to traverse the surface.

7.name: Morphic Manipulation
7.description: You've attuned your natural aura to that of plant life, coaxing it to grow faster than normal.

7.name: Skeptic's Defense
7.description: You don't believe in any mental twaddle, and you're certainly not afraid of it.

7.name: Muscle Mimicry
7.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication; Trained in Athletics; Master in Deception
7.description: Your study of another allows you to mirror their movements subtly, even in the heat of combat.

7.name: Chronocognizance
7.prerequisite: Time Mage Dedication; master in Perception
7.description: The flows and ebbs of time are obvious to you, as are the tangles that form when it's distorted.

7.name: Fabricated Credentials
7.prerequisite: Twilight Talon Dedication; Master in Deception
7.description: You're so familiar with the paperwork necessary to maintain your cover that you can easily whip up documents that support your fabrications.

7.name: Petal District Socialite
7.description: Through your experience with the many parties held nightly in clubs and estates within the Petal District, you understand the way rumors and gossip circulate during social events.

7.name: Paragon Battle Medicine
7.description: You've learned the modern uses of Battle Medicine originated by Kassi Aziril.

7.name: Adventurous Outfitter
7.description: You tinker, create, and repair gear as you adventure. You can spend part of your daily preparations adjusting your group's equipment.

7.name: As on the Board, so on the Battlefield
7.description: You're a master of strategy games, able to translate strategies and mechanics from these games to the actual battles they were created to simulate.

7.name: Improvise Strategy
7.description: You're a wild card on the battlefield, inventing unpredictable tactics and surprising foes.

7.name: Seasoned Command
7.prerequisite: Master in Diplomacy or Master in Intimidation
7.description: Allies intuitively follow your orders.

7.name: Entourage
7.description: You have a small group of admirers who tend to follow you around while you're in civilized settlements.

7.name: Battle Prayer
7.prerequisite: Master in Religion; you follow a deity
7.description: Calling out to your deity, you recite scripture to harm a foe

7.name: Bless Tonic
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _heal_ divine font
7.description: You channel positive energy into restoratives that ward against harm

7.name: Bless Toxin
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _harm_ divine font
7.description: You pour negative energy into toxins you create to further debilitate your targets

7.name: Environmental Grace
7.prerequisite: Master in Survival; deity who grants the cold, fire, nature, or travel domain
7.description: You rapidly adapt to environments through a combination of skill, meditation, and divine grace

7.name: Sacred Defense
7.prerequisite: Master in Religion; you follow a deity
7.description: You call upon your deity to grant you their protective blessing

7.name: Expert Disassembler
7.description: You can apply the same techniques you use to reverse engineer objects to disable them.

7.name: Speech of the Mammoth Lords
7.prerequisite: Mammoth Lord Dedication; Master in Diplomacy or Master in Intimidation
7.description: You've learned the ancient tongue spoken by the creatures of the far north.

7.name: Prepare Papers
7.prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Society
7.description: You're practiced at creating forgeries that establish your outlaw credentials or augment your legal authority.

7.name: Ashen Veil
7.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Expert in Religion; Master in Stealth
7.description: By smearing ash or tainted earth over your skin and armor, you shroud yourself from the dead.

7.name: Voice Cold as Death
7.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Master in Intimidation
7.description: Channeling the energy of the Crimson Oath into your voice, you pronounce a threat in a tone so icy it freezes the blood.

7.name: Grudging Compliment
7.description: Every Firebrand can recognize the skill of others, but you've turned it into an art you can wield in combat.

7.name: Master of Apprentice
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting, Master in Performance, or Master in a Lore skill
7.description: Teaching is a difficult art form, but you've gotten a pretty good handle on it.

7.name: Go With the Flow
7.description: You have an occult connection to the world that helps you blend in with the cacophony of life around you.

7.name: Temperature Adjustment
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting, Master in Medicine, or Herbalism Lore
7.description: You learn Hwan temperature classifications for the elements—wood and water are cold elements, while fire, earth, and metal are hot elements.

7.name: Talent Envy
7.description: You give off a bedazzling glow with every performance, sparking feelings of severe envy and inadequacy in those who compare their talent to yours.

7.name: Beautiful Knifework
7.prerequisite: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication; Master in Medicine
7.description: You perform surgical adjustments to disguise a willing ally or your construct companion.

7.name: Inflame Crowd
7.description: Your performances are a call to action for the crowds who listen to you.

7.name: Vanish into The Land
7.prerequisite: Master in Stealth; Trained in Survival; Terrain Stalker
7.description: You're adept at using the land's natural features to find places to hide.

15.name: Legendary Tattoo Artist
15.description: Your craftsmanship at decorating flesh is unparalleled.

15.name: Cloud Jump
15.description: Jump impossible distances

15.name: Craft Anything
15.description: Ignore most requirements for crafting items

15.name: Divine Guidance
15.description: Find guidance in the writings of your faith

15.name: Legendary Codebreaker
15.description: Quickly Decipher Writing using Society

15.name: Legendary Linguist
15.description: Create pidgin languages to communicate with anyone

15.name: Legendary Medic
15.description: Remove disease, blinded, deafened, doomed, or drained

15.name: Legendary Negotiation
15.description: Quickly parley with foes

15.name: Legendary Performer
15.description: Gain renown for your Performance

15.name: Legendary Professional
15.description: Gain renown for your Lore

15.name: Legendary Sneak
15.description: Hide and Sneak without cover or being concealed

15.name: Legendary Survivalist
15.description: Survive extreme conditions

15.name: Legendary Thief
15.description: Steal what would normally be impossible to steal

15.name: Scare to Death
15.description: Scare a target so much, they might die

15.name: Unified Theory
15.description: Use Arcana for checks for all magical traditions

15.name: Legendary Guide
15.description: You know the wilderness so well that you can help your party travel through it with ease.

15.name: Reveal Machinations
15.description: You convince a creature that you played a minor but recurring role in its life.

15.name: Legendary Leader
15.prerequisite: Captain Dedication; legendary in Diplomacy or Intimidation
15.description: Your fame has spread throughout the lands.

1.description: Fight more effectively as you Climb

1.description: Get along in noble society

1.name: Group Impression
1.description: Make an Impression on multiple targets more easily

1.description: Increase your Bulk limits by 2

1.description: Gather Information rapidly

1.name: Intimidating Glare
1.description: Demoralize a creature without speaking

1.name: Lengthy Diversion
1.description: Remain hidden after you Create a Diversion

1.name: Lie to Me

1.name: Survey Wildlife

1.description: +1 to Survival checks in certain terrain

1.description: Fight more effectively underwater

1.name: Virtuosic Performer
1.description: +1 with a certain type of performance

1.description: You're an incredible acrobat, evoking wonder and enrapturing audiences with your prowess.

1.name: Armor Assist

1.description: You are practiced in helping yourself and others don heavy gear.

1.name: Bon Mot
1.description: You launch an insightful quip at a foe, distracting them.

1.name: Concealing Legerdemain
1.description: Rather than hide an object somewhere the inspectors won't search, you're skilled at keeping the object on the move so it's never where they look.

1.name: Crafter's Appraisal
1.description: Your knowledge of items' construction allows you to discern their magical effects as well.

1.name: Deceptive Worship
1.description: Members of your cult frequently pass themselves off as worshippers of other religions.

1.name: Dirty Trick
1.description: You hook a foe's bootlaces together, pull their hat over their eyes, loosen their belt, or otherwise confound their mobility through an underhanded tactic.

1.name: Express Rider
1.description: You can encourage your mount to cover ground quickly.

1.name: Eye for Numbers
1.description: You've learned to quickly estimate the number of items in a group with relative accuracy at only a glance.

1.name: Forensic Acumen
1.description: You understand principles of forensic medicine, making you better at examining a body to determine the cause of death or injury.

1.name: Glean Contents
1.description: You are adept at quickly scanning loose papers and carefully discerning the contents of sealed letters without damaging the seal.

1.name: Improvise Tool
1.description: You can jury-rig solutions when you don't have the proper tools on hand.

1.name: Inoculation
1.description: You have practice combating plague, and your patients are less likely to succumb to the same disease again for a time.

1.name: Pilgrim's Token
1.prerequisite: Trained in Religion; follower of a specific religion
1.description: You carry a small token of protection from a site holy to your faith.

1.name: Risky Surgery
1.description: Your surgery can bring a patient back from the brink of death, but might push them over the edge.

1.name: Root Magic
1.description: Your talismans ward against foul magic.

1.name: Snare Crafting
1.description: You can use the Craft activity to create snares.

1.name: Crystal Healing
1.description: You know how to stimulate a body's natural healing abilities through the application of resonant crystals.

1.name: Read Psychometric Resonance
1.description: With a touch, you can read the psychic impressions left on objects by their previous owners.

1.name: Secret Speech
1.description: Learn the secret language of a society.

1.name: Charlatan
1.description: You've learned to mimic the abilities of spellcasters by studying their flourishes and words

1.name: Ravening's Desperation
1.description: Your study of the Beast of Gluttondark has taught you how to make do in the most trying of circumstances rather than succumb to weakness.

1.name: Medical Researcher
1.description: Kassi has taught you not only how to apply medicines with your medical skills but how to craft them as well.

1.name: Reveal True Name
1.prerequisite: trained in Intimidation and at least one of Arcana, Nature, Occult, and Religion
1.description: You attempt to get a creature to do as you wish by threatening them with your knowledge of their true name.

1.name: All of the Animal
1.description: You know how to make the best and most efficient use of a hunted animal's carcass.

1.name: Tame Animal
1.description: Animals born and raised far from humanoid settlements rarely get along with two-legged beings, whom they assume to be dangerous predators.

1.name: Stitch Flesh
1.description: You can use Treat Wounds to restore Hit Points to undead creatures, not just living ones.

1.name: Contract Negotiator
1.description: Your experience with bargaining and deciding terms as part of Highhelm's guilds helps you make deals in other situations.

1.name: Vicious Critique
1.prerequisite: Trained in Crafting; Trained in Intimidation
1.description: You have an eye for detail and a mouth for pointing out flaws, which makes it all the easier to convince the merchants and crafters of King's Heart to help you.

1.name: Prepare Elemental Medicine
1.prerequisite: Trained in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Trained in Medicine
1.description: You diagnose your patient, then prepare and administer a dose of elemental medicine to a creature.

1.name: Acupuncturist
1.description: You've studied the routes by which qi flows through the body.

1.name: Stifle Flames
1.prerequisite: Trained in Nature or Trained in Survival
1.description: Your forestry experience helped you develop techniques for fighting wildfires.

1.name: Myth Hunter
1.prerequisite: Trained in Hero-God Lore or Trained in Legendary Beast Lore
1.description: Your ancestors confronted and bested mythic beasts of Iblydan antiquity.

1.name: Dad Joke
1.description: Using the power of punnery, you deliver a lovingly tailored joke at a creature within 60 feet.

6.name: Analyze Idiolect
6.prerequisite: Linguist Dedication; Expert in Deception; Expert in Society
6.description: You break down a specific individual's idiolect, memorizing their speech mannerisms and habits.

6.name: Holistic Care
6.description: You provide emotional and spiritual care.

6.name: Resourceful Ritualist
6.description: You can cast difficult rituals that might otherwise be just beyond your skill.

6.name: Slippery as an Eel
6.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics
6.description: You mimic the serpentine movements of an eel.

6.name: Stealthy as an Octopus
6.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; Expert in Stealth
6.description: You're an expert at using the dark of the ocean to conceal yourself.

6.name: Emerald Boughs Accustomation
6.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Expert in Society; Emerald Boughs affiliation
6.description: You are comfortable and socially capable in almost any cultural context.

6.name: Uzunjati Storytelling
6.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Uzunjati affiliation; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
6.description: You tell a quick story or begin telling a longer tale.

6.name: Forced Entry
6.prerequisite: Expert in Athletics; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
6.description: You are trained to preserve the archaeological value of your location when entering.

6.name: Craft Facsimile
6.prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
6.description: You're renowned for your ability to recover important items and sometimes that requires creating a stand-in.

6.name: Megafauna Veterinarian
6.prerequisite: Mammoth Lord Dedication; Expert in Nature
6.description: By heeding the wise advice of elders in your following— and aided by your own experience—you've learned how to provide medical care to the megafauna of the Mammoth Lord followings.

6.name: Say that Again!
6.description: The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you—put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a Shove attempt against that op

6.name: Fluttering Misdirection
6.description: You've trained in drawing the eyes of your audience to specific aspects of your performance through the careful manipulation of your fans and body.

6.name: Dashing Pickup
6.prerequisite: Cavalier Dedication; expert in Acrobatics or Athletics
6.description: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has the corresponding movement type).

6.name: Cadre
6.prerequisite: Captain Dedication; expert in Diplomacy or Intimidation
6.description: Between your daring adventures, people seek you out.

6.name: Commitment to Protection
6.prerequisite: Golden Legionnaire Dedication; Expert in Warfare Lore
6.description: You attempt to guide an ally into a more defensive pose against a particular danger.

3.name: Folk Dowsing
3.description: You can find what you're looking for using a dowsing rod or pendulum.

3.name: Ivy District Influencer
3.description: After mingling alongside the tastemakers of the Ivy District, you understand how rumors spread through larger settlements.

3.name: Inspired Memory
3.description: A memory of each spell you have absorbed remains within your soul.

3.name: Know the Beat
3.description: You have been trained to investigate crimes.

3.name: We're on the List
3.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication or Archaeologist Dedication; Trained in Society
3.description: Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same.

3.name: Graft Technician
3.description: You can create and implant grafts.

3.name: Aurochs-Headed
3.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Intimidation
3.description: Your words and body language can subconsciously unsettle orcs, giving you an advantage when convincing them to see things your way.

11.name: Flower Street Infamy
11.description: Your history of coquetries, flirtations, dalliances, and liaisons is so lengthy that, even in a city as large as Absalom, you're bound to run into your past at inopportune moments.

8.name: Boarding Party
8.description: You're practiced at scaling ships, and even a wet and slippery exterior won't stand in your way.

8.name: Recognize Threat
8.prerequisite: master in a Recall Knowledge skill; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
8.description: You quickly assess the threat so you can relay the information to your team.

8.name: Unravel Mysteries
8.prerequisite: master in a Decipher Writing skill; Scrollmaster Dedication
8.description: You can understand the true meaning of texts quickly, and even when you get lost or hit a dead end, you aren't discouraged from making further attempts to get to the bottom of things.

8.name: Insistent Command
8.prerequisite: Master in Nature; Animal Trainer Dedication
8.description: When you roll a success to Command an Animal, you get a critical success.

8.name: Diverse Recognition
8.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; master in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
8.description: Your Pathfinder training allows you to quickly size up numerous threats.

8.name: Snap Out of It! (Pathfinder Agent)
8.prerequisite: Master in Medicine; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
8.description: Pathfinders are trained to help each other be safe and successful, and you know how to jolt your allies back to their senses.

8.name: Improvised Crafting
8.description: You've learned to repair your equipment even in challenging circumstances, making use of what you have available.

8.name: Ilverani Purist
8.description: All twilight speakers are trained to resist the alluring customs of younger peoples, but you have made it your mandate to keep the Ilverani way unchanged.

8.name: Calm and Centered
8.description: Your occult connection to the world helps you deal with being frightened or stupefied.

8.name: Rally Support
8.prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; trained in either Diplomacy or Intimidation
8.description: You often rely on the local populace for supplies and shelter.

10.name: Uzunjati Recollection
10.prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
10.description: You tell a story spontaneously from nearly forgotten facts, delving into your memory and entertaining your audience in the process.

10.name: Masterful Obfuscation
10.prerequisite: master in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action; Scrollmaster Dedication
10.description: You've mastered the art of deceiving others about your area of study.

10.name: Emissary of Peace
10.description: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender.

10.name: Comforting Presence
10.description: You use your occult connection to your allies to take on the fear and confusion they feel.

12.name: Emergency Medical Assistance
12.description: You've learned a variety of methods for helping allies who are bleeding, burning, or otherwise suffering persistent damage, from brushing off acid to patting down fires.

12.name: Recollect Studies
12.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; expert in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
12.description: You paid attention during your studies and remember the right way to attack various creatures.

12.name: Rugged Survivalist
12.description: You've studied survival skills with the School of Swords experts and are comfortable spending long periods of time in the wilderness.

12.name: Too Angry to Die
12.description: You refuse to yield the battle, even after you've been knocked off your feet and nearly killed.

12.name: Operatic Adventurer
12.description: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows.

5.name: Cutting Flattery
5.prerequisite: Dandy Dedication or Pirate Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
5.description: Repeated entries in Firebrand bragging and flyting contests have taught you how to twist pretty words into concealed insults.

13.name: Quick Spring
13.description: Ishii Bunji is a skilled tumbler, and learning his technique allows you to propel yourself across the battlefield faster than your enemies can react.

14.name: Fear of God
14.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Expert in Intimidation
14.description: You embed a divine fear into the triggering foe that lasts for 10 minutes.

14.name: Master Merchant
14.description: Kalistrade teaches that setbacks are only temporary and that perseverance is a treasured virtue.

14.name: Crusader's Masquerade
14.description: Your mask can hide you from the undead.

16.name: Preternatural Polish
16.description: Armor you polish shines with righteous grace.

18.name: I Knew the Heroes
18.prerequisite: Uzunjati Recollection; legendary in a Recall Knowledge Skill
18.description: Your stories aren't mere tales passed down from elder to youth or teacher to student.

18.name: Terrain Ghost
18.prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; Master in Stealth; Master in Survival
18.description: You move through your territory like a living shadow.

2.name: Tattoo Artist
2.description: You can craft tattoos, including magical tattoos.

2.name: Automatic Knowledge
2.prerequisite: expert in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action; Assurance in that skill
2.description: Recall Knowledge as a free action once per round

2.name: Bonded Animal
2.description: An animal becomes permanently easier to command

2.name: Communal Crafting
2.description: Other PCs can help you Craft

2.name: Confabulator
2.description: Reduce the bonuses against your repeated lies

2.name: Continual Recovery
2.description: Treat Wounds on a patient more often

2.name: Glad-Hand
2.description: Make an Impression on a target you've just met

2.name: Intimidating Prowess
2.description: Gain a bonus to physically Demoralize a target

2.name: Inventor
2.description: Use Crafting to create item formulas

2.name: Lasting Coercion
2.description: Coerce a target into helping you longer

2.name: Magical Crafting
2.description: Craft magic items

2.name: Magical Shorthand
2.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
2.description: Learn spells quickly and at a reduced cost

2.name: Nimble Crawl
2.description: Crawl at a faster rate

2.name: Powerful Leap
2.description: Jump farther and higher

2.name: Quick Disguise
2.description: Set up a disguise in less time

2.name: Quiet Allies
2.description: Roll a single Stealth check when sneaking with allies

2.name: Rapid Mantel
2.description: Pull yourself onto ledges quickly

2.name: Robust Recovery
2.description: Greater benefits from Treat Disease and Treat Poison

2.name: Unmistakable Lore
2.description: Recall Knowledge about your Lore more effectively

2.name: Unusual Treatment
2.description: Treat Wounds tends to additional conditions

2.name: Ward Medic
2.description: Treat several patients at once

2.name: Wary Disarmament
2.description: +2 to AC or saves against devices or traps while disarming

2.name: Armored Stealth
2.description: You have learned techniques to adjust and modify your armor and movements to reduce the noise you make.

2.name: Assured Identification
2.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
2.description: You rarely misidentify an item.

2.name: Backup Disguise
2.description: You have a specific disguise that you keep at the ready, worn underneath your outer garment.

2.name: Battle Planner
2.description: You are constantly drawing up plans and battle scenarios, assembling strategies and gathered intelligence for later use.

2.name: Discreet Inquiry
2.prerequisite: Expert in Deception or Expert in Diplomacy
2.description: You are subtle in your efforts to learn the things you need to know.

2.name: Distracting Performance
2.description: Your performances are especially distracting, allowing your allies to Sneak away with ease.

2.name: Exhort the Faithful
2.prerequisite: Expert in Religion; follower of a specific religion
2.description: Your knowledge of the tenets of your faith gives you insight into the best ways to get others of your faith to help you or to follow your directions.

2.name: Eyes of the City
2.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Society
2.description: You can track down targets with the help of locals.

2.name: Lead Climber
2.description: When climbing, you can prepare routes for others to follow, and you can pull your allies up to avoid disaster.

2.name: Leverage Connections
2.prerequisite: Courtly Graces or Streetwise; Expert in Society
2.description: You know the right people who can get things done for you in certain circles.

2.name: Rolling Landing
2.description: You land with quick rolls that help you keep your momentum.

2.name: Sanctify Water
2.prerequisite: Expert in Religion; you follow a deity with "holy" or "unholy" sanctification
2.description: You imbue water with your deity's blessing.

2.name: Shadow Mark
2.description: You have learned special tricks that help you follow individuals without them noticing you.

2.name: Slippery Prey
2.prerequisite: Trained in Athletics or Trained in Acrobatics
2.description: You're able to escape bonds more easily than others.

2.name: Sow Rumor
2.description: You spread rumors, which may or may not be true, about a specific subject.

2.name: Terrifying Resistance
2.description: The spells of those you have Demoralized are less effective on you.

2.name: Tumbling Teamwork
2.description: Your tumbling distracts a foe enough to create an advantage for one of your allies.

2.name: Underground Network
2.description: You're connected to groups that know what's going on in the streets, and you can get information out of them quickly.

2.name: Aura Sight
2.description: You've learned how to read the natural auras of other living creatures.

2.name: Automatic Writing
2.description: When confronted with the unknown, you can receive knowledge beyond your own experience via written messages delivered by your hand.

2.name: Chromotherapy
2.description: You firmly believe in the technique of strengthening one's life force, spiritual energies, and bodily fluids through the application of colored light.

2.name: Godless Healing
2.prerequisite: Battle Medicine; can't have a patron deity
2.description: You recover an additional 5 Hit Points from a successful attempt to Treat your Wounds or use Battle Medicine on you.

2.name: Mortal Healing
2.prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; you follow the Laws of Mortality
2.description: You grant greater healing when the gods don't interfere.

2.name: Tactical Acumen
2.description: Even if you don't know much about its constituent creatures, you can always recognize a troop's capabilities through features like the formation they move in or even more subtle hints others might miss.

2.name: Connections
2.description: Leverage your connections for favors and meetings.

2.name: Wilderness Spotter
2.description: Use Survival for your Initiative when in a specific terrain.

2.name: Eye of the Arclords
2.description: The Arclords of Nex have achieved a unique mastery of magic.

2.name: Tweak Appearances
2.description: You can alter a creature's clothing to improve their social impact.

2.name: Juggle
2.description: You can Juggle items and still use your hands between tosses.

2.name: Encouraging Words
2.description: You give an ally a quick pep talk, helping them recover.

2.name: Criminal Connections
2.description: Leverage your underworld connections for favors from criminals.

2.name: Quick Contacts
2.prerequisite: Expert in Society; Connections or Criminal Connections
2.description: Spend only 1 day to use Connections or Criminal Connections.

2.name: Spirit Speaker
2.description: You know that when an animal dies, its spirit lingers briefly before moving on.

2.name: Triumphant Boast
2.description: You relate a loud and impressive tale of your triumph over a formidable foe.

2.name: Predict Weather
2.description: By observing often subtle indicators in the environment, you may try to predict the day's weather.

2.name: Fleeing Diversion
2.description: You are quick to capitalize on your distractions.

2.name: Half-Truths
2.prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Expert in Diplomacy
2.description: You are able to weave your words in such a way that you never use actual lies, but still mislead people to certain conclusions.

2.name: Cooperative Crafting
2.description: You've learned to make the most of working with others on your crafting projects, a must when working with the various guilds of Highhelm.

2.name: What's That up Your Sleeve?
2.description: Whether as a dealer or player, you've learned to spot cheaters.

2.name: Energy Fortification
2.prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Occultism
2.description: You learn Minkaian traditions about the void and know how to manipulate the five elements to fortify vitality and void energies in the body.

2.name: Pei Zing Adept
2.prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Expert in Medicine
2.description: You're practiced at timing preparations to the point where you can treat multiple patients at once.

2.name: Performer's Treatment
2.prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; Expert in Performance
2.description: With your experience as a performer, you can keep a set of medical tools handy at all times.

2.name: Vasodilation
2.description: Using the power of your own blood, you encourage increased blood flow to nourish damaged tissue.

15.name: Legendary Tattoo Artist
15.description: Your craftsmanship at decorating flesh is unparalleled.

15.name: Cloud Jump
15.description: Jump impossible distances

15.name: Craft Anything
15.description: Ignore most requirements for crafting items

15.name: Divine Guidance
15.description: Find guidance in the writings of your faith

15.name: Legendary Codebreaker
15.description: Quickly Decipher Writing using Society

15.name: Legendary Linguist
15.description: Create pidgin languages to communicate with anyone

15.name: Legendary Medic
15.description: Remove disease, blinded, deafened, doomed, or drained

15.name: Legendary Negotiation
15.description: Quickly parley with foes

15.name: Legendary Performer
15.description: Gain renown for your Performance

15.name: Legendary Professional
15.description: Gain renown for your Lore

15.name: Legendary Sneak
15.description: Hide and Sneak without cover or being concealed

15.name: Legendary Survivalist
15.description: Survive extreme conditions

15.name: Legendary Thief
15.description: Steal what would normally be impossible to steal

15.name: Scare to Death
15.description: Scare a target so much, they might die

15.name: Unified Theory
15.description: Use Arcana for checks for all magical traditions

15.name: Legendary Guide
15.description: You know the wilderness so well that you can help your party travel through it with ease.

15.name: Reveal Machinations
15.description: You convince a creature that you played a minor but recurring role in its life.

7.name: Quick Setup
7.description: You have learned to setup simple crafting jobs with ease.

7.name: Advanced First Aid
7.description: Use First Aid to reduce frightened and sickened condition values

7.name: Battle Cry
7.description: Demoralizes foes when you roll for initiative

7.name: Bizarre Magic
7.description: Your magic becomes more difficult to identify

7.name: Break Curse
7.prerequisite: Master in Occultism or Master in Religion
7.description: Use your knowledge to break curses

7.name: Expeditious Search
7.description: Search areas in half the time

7.name: Foil Senses
7.description: Take precautions against special senses

7.name: Impeccable Crafting
7.description: Craft items more efficiently

7.name: Kip Up
7.description: Stand up for free without triggering reactions

7.name: Monster Crafting
7.description: Craft items using monster parts

7.name: Planar Survival
7.description: Use Survival to Subsist on different planes

7.name: Prescient Consumable
7.description: Procure consumable items with Prescient Planner

7.name: Quick Climb
7.description: Climb swiftly

7.name: Quick Recognition
7.prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion; Recognize Spell
7.description: Identify spells as a free action

7.name: Quick Swim
7.description: Swim quickly

7.name: Quick Unlock
7.description: Pick a Lock with 1 action

7.name: Shameless Request
7.description: Make Requests of others with lesser consequences

7.name: Slippery Secrets
7.description: Evade attempts to uncover your true nature

7.name: Swift Sneak
7.description: Move your full Speed while you Sneak

7.name: Terrified Retreat
7.description: Cause foes you Demoralize to flee

7.name: Wall Jump
7.description: Jump off walls

7.name: Aerobatics Mastery
7.description: You move with grace in flight and can perform amazing aerial stunts.

7.name: Biographical Eye
7.description: In even a brief conversation or social interaction, you pick up on subtle social and visual cues to learn a great deal about a person's origin and history.

7.name: Consult the Spirits
7.prerequisite: Master in Occultism, Master in Nature, or Master in Religion
7.description: You have learned rites or meditations that enable you to perceive minor, invisible spirits within a place.

7.name: Disturbing Knowledge
7.description: You utter a litany of dreadful names, prophecies, and descriptions of realms beyond mortal comprehension, drawn from your study of forbidden tomes and scrolls.

7.name: Doublespeak
7.description: You're skilled at saying one thing and meaning something different.

7.name: Environmental Guide
7.description: You can rapidly adapt to climates and help others do the same.

7.name: Evangelize
7.prerequisite: Master in Diplomacy; follower of a specific religion or philosophy
7.description: You point out a detail that incontrovertibly supports your faith, causing a listener's mind to whirl.

7.name: Influence Nature
7.description: With patience and time, you can make bird calls, leave game trails, and ultimately influence the behavior of a certain type of animals in the region to favor and even aid you in the days to come.

7.name: Numb to Death
7.prerequisite: Diehard; you have died at least once
7.description: Your past has left you numb to death's call.

7.name: Rapid Affixture
7.description: You take only 1 minute to Affix a Talisman.

7.name: Signature Crafting
7.description: Magic items you create bear a stamp specific to your handiwork.

7.name: Supertaster
7.description: You have refined your palate and have a discerning sense of taste that can detect abnormalities in the flavor and texture of food and beverages.

7.name: Tumbling Theft
7.prerequisite: Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Thievery
7.description: You reach for an opponent's item as you move past a foe.

7.name: Water Sprint
7.description: Experience and training have taught you that water has just enough surface tension for a master sprinter to traverse the surface.

7.name: Morphic Manipulation
7.description: You've attuned your natural aura to that of plant life, coaxing it to grow faster than normal.

7.name: Skeptic's Defense
7.description: You don't believe in any mental twaddle, and you're certainly not afraid of it.

7.name: Paragon Battle Medicine
7.description: You've learned the modern uses of Battle Medicine originated by Kassi Aziril.

7.name: Adventurous Outfitter
7.description: You tinker, create, and repair gear as you adventure. You can spend part of your daily preparations adjusting your group's equipment.

7.name: As on the Board, so on the Battlefield
7.description: You're a master of strategy games, able to translate strategies and mechanics from these games to the actual battles they were created to simulate.

7.name: Improvise Strategy
7.description: You're a wild card on the battlefield, inventing unpredictable tactics and surprising foes.

7.name: Seasoned Command
7.prerequisite: Master in Diplomacy or Master in Intimidation
7.description: Allies intuitively follow your orders.

7.name: Entourage
7.description: You have a small group of admirers who tend to follow you around while you're in civilized settlements.

7.name: Battle Prayer
7.prerequisite: Master in Religion; you follow a deity
7.description: Calling out to your deity, you recite scripture to harm a foe

7.name: Bless Tonic
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _heal_ divine font
7.description: You channel positive energy into restoratives that ward against harm

7.name: Bless Toxin
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _harm_ divine font
7.description: You pour negative energy into toxins you create to further debilitate your targets

7.name: Environmental Grace
7.prerequisite: Master in Survival; deity who grants the cold, fire, nature, or travel domain
7.description: You rapidly adapt to environments through a combination of skill, meditation, and divine grace

7.name: Sacred Defense
7.prerequisite: Master in Religion; you follow a deity
7.description: You call upon your deity to grant you their protective blessing

7.name: Free and Fair
7.description: Use New Leadership and other activities more efficiently

7.name: Quality of Life
7.description: Cost of living expenses are reduced

7.name: Master of Apprentice
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting, Master in Performance, or Master in a Lore skill
7.description: Teaching is a difficult art form, but you've gotten a pretty good handle on it.

7.name: Go With the Flow
7.description: You have an occult connection to the world that helps you blend in with the cacophony of life around you.

7.name: Temperature Adjustment
7.prerequisite: Master in Crafting, Master in Medicine, or Herbalism Lore
7.description: You learn Hwan temperature classifications for the elements—wood and water are cold elements, while fire, earth, and metal are hot elements.

1.description: You are practiced in helping yourself and others don heavy gear.

1.name: Bon Mot

1.description: Rather than hide an object somewhere the inspectors won't search, you're skilled at keeping the object on the move so it's never where they look.

1.name: Crafter's Appraisal
1.description: Your knowledge of items' construction allows you to discern their magical effects as well.

1.name: Deceptive Worship
1.description: Members of your cult frequently pass themselves off as worshippers of other religions.

1.name: Dirty Trick

1.name: Eye for Numbers
1.description: You've learned to quickly estimate the number of items in a group with relative accuracy at only a glance.

1.name: Forensic Acumen

1.name: Glean Contents
1.description: You are adept at quickly scanning loose papers and carefully discerning the contents of sealed letters without damaging the seal.

1.name: Improvise Tool
1.description: You can jury-rig solutions when you don't have the proper tools on hand.

1.name: Inoculation
1.description: You have practice combating plague, and your patients are less likely to succumb to the same disease again for a time.

1.name: Pilgrim's Token

1.description: You carry a small token of protection from a site holy to your faith.

1.name: Risky Surgery
1.description: Your surgery can bring a patient back from the brink of death, but might push them over the edge.

1.name: Root Magic
1.description: Your talismans ward against foul magic.

1.name: Snare Crafting

1.name: Crystal Healing

1.name: Read Psychometric Resonance

1.name: Secret Speech
1.description: Learn the secret language of a society.

1.description: You've learned to mimic the abilities of spellcasters by studying their flourishes and words

1.name: Ravening's Desperation
1.description: Your study of the Beast of Gluttondark has taught you how to make do in the most trying of circumstances rather than succumb to weakness.

1.name: Medical Researcher

1.name: Reveal True Name

1.description: You attempt to get a creature to do as you wish by threatening them with your knowledge of their true name.

1.name: All of the Animal

1.name: Tame Animal
1.description: Animals born and raised far from humanoid settlements rarely get along with two-legged beings, whom they assume to be dangerous predators.

1.name: Stitch Flesh

1.name: Civil Service

1.name: Acupuncturist

1.name: Stifle Flames

1.name: Myth Hunter

1.description: Your ancestors confronted and bested mythic beasts of Iblydan antiquity.

3.name: Improvised Repair
3.description: You can hastily patch damaged equipment together, but the temporary fix lacks the full care required for lasting repairs.

3.name: Keen Follower

3.name: Pick Up the Pace

3.name: Robust Health
3.description: Your physiology responds well to first aid.

3.name: Thorough Search
