11.name: A Home in Every Port
11.description: You have a reputation in towns and villages you've visited, and residents are always willing to open their doors to you.

11.name: Caravan Leader
11.description: You know how to get the most effort out of your allies on the road.

11.name: Incredible Scout
11.description: When you scout, you are particularly alert for danger, granting your allies precious moments to prepare to fight.

11.name: Fame and Fortune
11.description: Gain RP when you critically succeed at Kingdom skills

11.name: Axuma's Awakening
11.prerequisite: Exposure to the Well of Axuma
11.description: Exposure of the well of Axuma has given you some arcane magic.

11.name: Axuma's Vigor
11.prerequisite: Exposure to the Well of Axuma
11.description: Your vigor makes it easier for others to heal you.

11.name: Sanguine Tenacity
11.description: Your blood carries permanent regenerative properties.

19.name: True Perception
19.description: Your perceptive abilities and ability to process sensory information are so far beyond the pale that you notice minute discrepancies in all sorts of illusions and physical transformations.

4.name: Fane's Escape
4.description: A good getaway requires a good distraction.

4.name: Kreighton's Cognitive Crossover
4.description: Kreighton teaches his students that an agile mind can glean clues leading to the truth, even from the most unlikely of sources.

4.name: That's Not Natural!
4.description: Your mastery at surviving in the wild has given you a sort of sixth-sense when it comes to noticing creatures that aren't part of the natural order.

4.name: Ambush Tactics
4.prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain
4.description: You've made a study of the best practices for laying ambushes in terrains you've spent time learning about, be it the best way to ambush foes or the best methods of reacting to surprise attacks in those terrains.

4.name: Efficient Explorer
4.prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain
4.description: You are more efficient at exploring uncharted territories.

6.name: Say that Again!
6.description: The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you—put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a Shove attempt against that op

12.name: Too Angry to Die
12.description: You refuse to yield the battle, even after you've been knocked off your feet and nearly killed.

8.name: Calm and Centered
8.description: Your occult connection to the world helps you deal with being frightened or stupefied.

10.name: Comforting Presence
10.description: You use your occult connection to your allies to take on the fear and confusion they feel.

1.name: Automaton Armament
1.description: You've been provided a body part designed for combat.

1.name: Arcane Communication
1.description: You can deliver silent messages.

1.name: Arcane Eye
1.description: Your eye has been magically enhanced to pierce darkness.

1.name: Automaton Lore
1.description: You have come to better understand the process that made your body and the magic that powers it.

1.name: Energy Beam
1.description: You can channel your core's power through the magical gem that serves as your eye.

1.name: Reinforced Chassis
1.description: Your body is designed to be particularly resilient.

1.name: Expressive Face
1.description: Your face is constructed to move organically and show your emotions, making you more relatable to organic creatures.

1.name: Messenger
1.description: You were built with a special ability to relay private messages to your fellow automatons, but you can luckily use it with anyone you would like.

1.name: Powerful Tail
1.description: You resemble an animal or a type of humanoid who has a tail.

1.name: Undead Hunter
1.description: You were created by a Nexian mage specifically for the purpose of fighting undead,

5.name: Arcane Safeguards
5.description: The magic powering you makes it difficult for outside magic to affect you.

5.name: Integrated Armament
5.description: Your mechanical body houses a weapon or shield that you can quickly draw and stow, leaving you prepared for combat at all times.

5.name: Magical Resistance
5.description: Your animating magic provides some defense.

5.name: Hardened Chassis
5.description: Your exterior is so tough that only the strongest of weapons can fully damage it.

5.name: Infiltration Automation
5.description: You have quiet, well-oiled joints, and you move around as silently as a shadow, though you sometimes use a magical boost.

5.name: Inscribed Blast
5.description: Some of the patterning on your exterior covering is not just decorative but is instead a set of runes.

5.name: Resilient Chassis
5.description: You are tough enough to draw on your own internal stores of energy when you get injured.

9.name: Arcane Camouflage
9.description: You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey.

9.name: Arcane Propulsion
9.description: You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time.

9.name: Arcane Slam
9.description: You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground.

9.name: Core Attunement
9.description: Your core allows you to draw more power from it.

9.name: Lesser Augmentation
9.description: You've focused on enhancing yourself and have received an improvement to one of your existing abilities.

9.name: Rain of Bolts
9.description: Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis.

9.name: Bodily Disintegration
9.description: You have such complete control of your component atoms that you can momentarily separate them far enough apart for you to pass through solid material.

9.name: Overburn
9.description: You engage your core, giving yourself more energy and speed for a fight.

13.name: Arcane Locomotion
13.description: You've modified your body to allow you to augment your movement.

13.name: Astral Blink
13.description: You've attuned your core to allow you to phase in and out of the Astral Plane, allowing you to teleport periodically.

13.name: Core Rejuvenation
13.description: Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness.

13.name: Enlarged Chassis
13.description: You've empowered your core to support a larger body, granting you size and additional reach.

13.name: Purge System
13.description: You can sense the influence of harmful toxins in your body, and you heat and cool various parts of your body to expel them.

17.name: Axial Recall
17.description: You have reconfigured the magical resonance of your core to attune to the planar energies of Axis.

17.name: Core Cannon
17.description: Your body transforms into a powerful magical cannon.

17.name: Greater Augmentation
17.description: You've greatly improved your abilities and your core can support further augmentations.

17.name: System Override
17.description: When someone takes control of your consciousness or your body, you innately resist their domination with everything you have.

1.name: Adaptive Vision
1.description: After years of using black powder weaponry in dimly lit spaces, you've become accustomed to dazzling flashes of light and sudden shifts in illumination.

1.name: Clan Pistol
1.description: Raised in the ancient halls of Dongun Hold or the surrounding region, you display your lineage with a clan pistol, rather than a clan dagger.

1.name: Dongun Education
1.description: You're knowledgeable in trades that are important to your people's survival and commercial interests.

1.name: Explosive Savant
1.description: A lifetime wielding firearms and explosive ordinance amid the chaos of battle has granted you great skill with volatile weapons.

1.name: Fire Savvy
1.description: You've grown up around a forge and are well-suited to dealing with smoke and flame.

1.name: Dwarven Doughtiness
1.description: You are naturally calm and collected in the face of imminent danger.

1.name: Dwarven Lore
1.description: You eagerly absorbed the old stories and traditions of your ancestors, your gods, and your people.

1.name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity
1.description: Your kin have instilled in you an affinity for hard-hitting weapons, and you prefer these to more elegant arms.

1.name: Mountain Strategy
1.description: Dwarves have a long history fighting common foes, and you've mastered the ancient tactics to better face these enemies.

1.name: Rock Runner
1.description: Your innate connection to stone makes you adept at moving across uneven surfaces.

1.name: Stonemason's Eye
1.description: You understand the intricacies of stonework.

1.name: Unburdened Iron
1.description: You've learned techniques first devised by your ancestors during their ancient wars, allowing you to comfortably wear massive suits of armor.

1.name: Stonecunning
1.description: You have a knack for noticing even small inconsistencies and craftsmanship techniques in the stonework around you.

1.name: Vengeful Hatred
1.description: You heart aches for vengeance against those who have wronged your people.

1.name: Avenge in Glory
1.description: You honor your ally's life, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute.

1.name: Clan's Edge
1.description: By moving your clan dagger with rapid precision, you can protect yourself more effectively.

1.name: Forge-Day's Rest
1.description: Your unusual rest cycle allows you to recover faster.

1.name: Surface Culture
1.description: Your interactions with other cultures on the surface have not only taught you about many other ancestries, but have also helped you realize the value of your own.

1.name: Eye for Treasure
1.description: You know good artisanship when you see it and can wax poetic about crafting techniques and forms.

1.name: Clan Lore
1.description: Your identity as a member of your clan is as central to your sense of self as your dwarven ancestry.

1.name: Rivethun Disciple
1.description: By studying with the dwarven shamans of Highhelm, you have become aware of the friction between your body and spirit.

5.name: Blast Resistance
5.description: You're used to the clamor of steel, the crack of a firearm, and the thunderous blast of explosions.

5.name: Spark Fist
5.description: You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent.

5.name: Boulder Roll
5.description: Your dwarven build allows you to push foes around, just like a mighty boulder tumbles through a subterranean cavern.

5.name: Defy the Darkness
5.description: Using ancient dwarven methods developed to fight enemies wielding magical darkness, you've honed your darkvision and sworn not to use such magic yourself.

5.name: Dwarven Reinforcement
5.description: You can use your knowledge of engineering and metalwork to temporarily strengthen thick objects and structures.

5.name: Dwarven Weapon Cunning
5.description: You've learned cunning techniques to get the best effects out of your dwarven weapons.

5.name: Clan Protector
5.description: Your clan dagger can protect your allies as easily as yourself.

5.name: Protective Sheath
5.description: When you lash out with your clan dagger, you keep its sheath close at hand.

5.name: Tomb-Watcher's Glare
5.description: When you critically hit an undead creature, or an undead creature critically fails a saving throw against one of your abilities, you drive your divine wrath home in your enemy's heart.

5.name: Sheltering Slab
5.description: The stone around you is your ally, and you have learned to use it to shore up your weaknesses.

9.name: Demolitionist
9.description: You know how to destroy objects with a well-placed explosion.

9.name: Smoke Sight
9.description: You're used to fighting and hiding in a haze of smoke and flame.

9.name: Echoes in Stone
9.description: You pause a moment to attune your senses to the stone around you.

9.name: Mountain's Stoutness
9.description: Your hardiness lets you withstand more punishment than most.

9.name: Stone Bones
9.description: Your intractable nature can help you shrug off even the most grievous injuries.

9.name: Stonewalker
9.description: You have a deep reverence for and connection to stone.

9.name: Battleforger
9.description: You can sharpen weapons, polish armor, and apply special techniques to temporarily gain better effects from your armaments.

9.name: Energy Blessed
9.description: Energy runs through your blood more powerfully.

9.name: Heroes' Call
9.description: The songs of ancient heroes echo through your mind and quicken your pulse, especially in dire straits.

9.name: Kneel for No God
9.description: Your ancestors' defiance of magic and your people's strictly egalitarian mindset mean that certain forms of magic have little effect on you.

9.name: Returning Throw
9.description: You have mastered the technique of arcing a projectile so that it returns to your hand after being thrown, though this requires a moment to precisely calculate the trajectory and possible ricochets.

9.name: Rivethun Spiritual Attunement
9.description: Your time spent among the Rivethun has heightened your awareness of animate spirits around you, giving you the ability to sense them briefly.

13.name: Crafter's Instinct
13.description: You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw.

13.name: Explosive Expert
13.description: You have continued training in volatile weapons and gained a deeper understanding.

13.name: Scrutinizing Gaze
13.description: Your family's traditions of defending against Geb's undead have granted you a sixth sense for detecting spirits, haunts, and other restless dead, no matter their form or the strength of their presence.

13.name: March the Mines
13.description: You march through the earth and lead an ally along.

13.name: Telluric Power
13.description: You channel strength from the earth beneath your feet to pummel your enemies.

13.name: Dwarven Weapon Expertise
13.description: Your dwarven affinity blends with your training, granting you great skill with dwarven weapons.

17.name: Forge-Blessed Shot
17.description: You intone a prayer to the dwarven deities Torag or Angradd, willing a higher power to guide your aim in the heat of battle.

17.name: Stonegate
17.description: Earthen barriers no longer impede your progress.

17.name: Stonewall
17.description: The strength of stone overcomes you so strongly that it replaces your stout body.

17.name: Forge-Blessd Shot
17.description: You intone a prayer to the dwarven deities Torag or Angradd, willing a higher power to guide your aim in the heat of battle.

1.name: Ancestral Longevity
1.description: You have accumulated a vast array of lived knowledge over the years.

1.name: Elven Lore
1.description: You've studied traditional elven arts, learning about arcane magic and the world around you.

1.name: Elven Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You favor bows and other elegant weapons.

1.name: Forlorn
1.description: Watching your friends age and die fills you with moroseness that protects you against harmful emotions.

1.name: Nimble Elf
1.description: Your muscles are tightly honed.

1.name: Otherworldly Magic
1.description: Your elven magic manifests as a simple arcane spell, even if you aren't formally trained in magic.

1.name: Unwavering Mien
1.description: Your mystic control and meditations allow you to resist external influences upon your consciousness.

1.name: Aquatic Elf Warrior
1.description: You have trained in the use of weapons both above and below water.

1.name: Friend of the Sea
1.description: You have established a companionship with a sea creature, often carrying them in a small, waterfilled globe when you are on land.

1.name: Touch of the Sea
1.description: The power of the sea flows through you, allowing you to manifest a portion of its strength.

1.name: Elemental Wrath
1.description: You are so attuned to the land that you can call forth a bolt of energy from your surroundings.

1.name: Elven Verve
1.description: While all elves are immune to the paralyzing touch of ghouls, you can shake off flesh-numbing magic of all kinds.

1.name: Share Thoughts
1.prerequisite: Mualijae ethnicity, Ilverani ethnicity, or Vourinoi ethnicity
1.description: You have an uncanny knack of communicating with other elves without speaking, though this habit that is often uncomfortable to observers.

1.name: Wildborn Magic
1.description: You have learned to access the old magic of wild places.

1.name: Woodcraft
1.description: You have a innate familiarity with forested areas.

1.name: Ancestral Linguistics
1.description: Over your extensive lifespan, you've studied many languages.

1.name: Elven Aloofness
1.description: As much as you might care for them, you've come to terms with the ephemeral nature of non-elves, and it makes their threats feel less troublesome.

1.name: Know Your Own
1.description: You've spent countless hours studying the history of elves on your world and beyond and are a studied expert in your people's ways.

1.name: Demonbane Warrior
1.description: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage with weapons and unarmed attacks against demons.

1.name: Political Acumen
1.description: You have spent years following the political maneuvering and secret alliances of elves in Iadara.

1.name: Traditional Ways
1.description: You are a fervent follower of the long-standing elven traditions established when your people returned to Kyonin.

1.name: Free Heart
1.description: You follow all your passions, unlimited in creativity and zeal.

5.name: Ageless Patience
5.description: You work at a pace born from longevity that enhances your thoroughness.

5.name: Ancestral Suspicion
5.description: Long-lived elves have seen civilizations rise and fall, often at the hands of outside forces. As a result, they have developed a wariness of others who might seek to influence or control them.

5.name: Martial Experience
5.description: You've crossed blades with a wide variety of foes wielding a wide variety of weapons, and you've learned the basics of fighting with nearly any of them.

5.name: Elven Weapon Elegance
5.description: You are attuned to the weapons of your elven ancestors and are particularly deadly when using them.

5.name: Defiance Unto Death
5.description: You loathe the alghollthus and their mind magic, and you've been trained to be willing to die rather than give into mental manipulation.

5.name: Elven Instincts
5.description: Your senses let you react rapidly.

5.name: Forest Stealth
5.description: You are skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage.

5.name: Wildborn Adept
5.description: The whispers of the jungle grant you more diverse access to simple primal magic.

5.name: Shame the Sin
5.description: Your conviction against the sins that all demons grow from is so strong that you can force a demon to suffer from its sins when you strike a sound blow against them.

5.name: Swamp Stealth
5.description: In swamplands, you are particularly skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage, or moving quietly through murky water.

5.name: Elven Persistence
5.description: Elves don't give up easily on their pursuits.

9.name: Elf Step
9.description: You move in a graceful dance, and even your steps are broad.

9.name: Expert Longevity
9.description: You've continued to refine the knowledge and skills you've gained through your life.

9.name: Otherworldly Acumen
9.prerequisite: at least one innate spell gained from an elf ancestry feat
9.description: The arcane magic you possess grows in power and complexity.

9.name: Tree Climber
9.description: You've spent much of your life among the treetops and have become an expert at quickly and safely climbing them.

9.name: Submerged Stillness
9.description: With a mix of magic and physical training, you have learned to render yourself invisible while hiding underwater.

9.name: Brightness Seeker
9.description: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes studying your surroundings in search of omens related to a particular course of action to cast augury as an innate divine spell.

9.name: Sense Thoughts
9.description: You have an even stranger knack for knowing what other people are thinking.

9.name: Tree Climber (Elf)
9.description: You've spent much of your life among the treetops and have become an expert at quickly and safely climbing them.

9.name: Political Virtuoso
9.description: Your mastery of the politics of your home nation is profound.

9.name: Demon Hunter
9.prerequisite: Expert in Religion or Expert in Demon Lore
9.description: The demons of Tanglebriar have long haunted your dreams, just as they have long threatened Kyonin.

13.name: Avenge Ally
13.description: Though you know that you will eventually outlive your companions, seeing them at death's door brings clarity to your attacks.

13.name: Universal Longevity
13.description: You've perfected your ability to keep up with all the skills you've learned over your long life, so you're almost never truly untrained at a skill.

13.name: Elven Weapon Expertise
13.description: Your elven affinity blends with your class training, granting you great skill with elven weapons.

13.name: Wandering Heart
13.prerequisite: Arctic Elf, Cavern Elf, Desert Elf, Woodland Elf, or any other elf heritage based on adapting to an environment
13.description: While all elves adapt to their environments over time, you have traveled so widely and become attuned to so many environs that your body now changes more rapidly than other elves.

13.name: Anchoring Arrow
13.description: You can prevent demonic foes from fleeing your wrath via teleportation.

13.name: Cold Iron Stomach
13.description: You have steeled yourself against potent odors.

13.name: Treehealer
13.description: You can undo the effect of demonic corruption in plants.

17.name: Magic Rider
17.description: Your people used powerful magic to travel between distant worlds in the distant past, and the remnants of that magic make such transportation easier for you.

17.name: Eyes of the Sea
17.description: Your eyes have adapted to the rigors of the sea.

17.name: Demon Slayer
17.description: You can deliver a melee blow to a demon that creates an explosion of holy light to try to finish the demon off.

1.name: Animal Accomplice
1.description: You build a rapport with an animal, which becomes magically bonded to you.

1.name: Animal Elocutionist
1.description: You hear animal sounds as conversations instead of unintelligent noise, and you can respond in turn.

1.name: Fey Fellowship
1.description: Your enhanced fey connection (either through your blood or via prolonged contact with their kind) affords you a warmer reception from creatures of the First World as well as tools to foil their tricks or withstand their magic.

1.name: First World Magic
1.description: Your connection to the First World grants you a primal innate spell, much like those of the fey.

1.name: Gnome Obsession
1.description: You might have a flighty nature, but when a topic captures your attention, you dive into it headfirst.

1.name: Gnome Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You favor unusual weapons tied to your people, such as blades with curved and peculiar shapes.

1.name: Illusion Sense
1.description: Your ancestors spent their days cloaked and cradled in illusions, and as a result, sensing illusion magic is second nature to you.

1.name: Razzle-Dazzle
1.description: You've spent considerable time practicing the manipulation of light, weaponizing your blade's reflection or bolstering the luminosity of magical displays to unconventional heights.

1.name: Burrow Elocutionist
1.description: You recognize the chittering of ground creatures as its own peculiar language.

1.name: Gnome Polyglot
1.description: Your extensive travels, curiosity, and love of learning help you to learn languages quickly.

1.name: Grim Insight
1.description: Others' attempts to scare you often grant you insights about your would-be bullies that you can then exploit.

1.name: Inventive Offensive
1.description: You can jury-rig your weapons to perform in unexpected ways.

1.name: Life-Giving Magic
1.description: The upwelling of innate magic refreshes your body.

1.name: Natural Performer
1.description: Entertainment comes naturally to you.

1.name: Theoretical Acumen
1.description: You study a creature's form and behavior to hypothesize likely means of overcoming its strengths.

1.name: Unexpected Shift
1.description: Your supernatural connection sometimes causes you to phase from reality when under threat, disappearing for split seconds before reappearing—often surprising you as much as your enemies.

1.name: Vibrant Display
1.description: Whereas most gnomes' coloration is static or changes slowly, you can cause your hair, eye, and skin color to scintillate in brief and disorienting bursts.

1.name: Empathetic Plea
1.description: The way you cringe or use those puppydog eyes you've been practicing elicits an empathetic response in the attacker.

1.name: Fisheye
1.description: You can gain the magic of the seas by eating your favorite seafood.

5.name: Energized Font
5.prerequisite: focus pool, at least one innate spell from a gnome heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at least one of your focus spells
5.description: You can focus your mind more quickly thanks to the magic that flows within you.

5.name: Project Persona
5.description: Where others etch their armor to serve as a conduit for their imaginations, your vivid mind and bold personality allow you to project a more fitting persona over your lackluster armor.

5.name: Gnome Weapon Innovator
5.description: You produce outstanding results when wielding unusual weapons.

5.name: Eclectic Obsession
5.description: Your desire for stimulation has led you from one pursuit to another and granted you a smattering of expertise with myriad crafts and professions.

5.name: Intuitive Illusions
5.description: Illusion magic comes to you so naturally that you can effortlessly sustain your magical ruses.

5.name: Natural Illusionist
5.description: By drawing upon the First World's magic, you can siphon a portion of that malleable world to create a convincing illusion.

5.name: Briny Beverage
5.description: You can survive off the sea as well as gain insight from its waters.

9.name: Cautious Curiosity
9.prerequisite: at least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat
9.description: You've learned a few magical techniques for getting yourself both into and out of trouble unnoticed.

9.name: First World Adept
9.prerequisite: at least one primal innate spell
9.description: Over time your fey magic has grown stronger.

9.name: Life Leap
9.description: You phase through a space that a living creature occupies in a flash, spontaneously appearing on the opposite side of it in a vibrant display of colorful light.

9.name: Vivacious Conduit
9.description: Your connection to the First World has grown, and its vital energy flows into you rapidly.

9.name: Fortuitous Shift
9.description: You have grown more comfortable with your penchant for supernatural disappearance.

9.name: Scarlet Strands
9.description: The innate magic in your blood turns your signature crimson tresses into more than just a stylish coiffure.

13.name: Instinctive Obfuscation
13.prerequisite: at least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat
13.description: The magic within you manifests as a natural reaction to threats.

13.name: Gnome Weapon Expertise
13.description: Your gnome affinity blends with your class training, granting you great skill with gnome weapons.

13.name: Arboreal Conversationalist
13.prerequisite: Kijimuna Gnome heritage or at least one primal innate spell from a gnome heritage or feat
13.description: With your close connection to primal energies and the First World, you can communicate with trees.

13.name: Kijimuna Whistle
13.prerequisite: Kijimuna Gnome heritage or at least one primal innate spell from a gnome heritage or feat
13.description: Your connection to nature—and trees, in particular—has become so strong that you can summon the plants you befriended in the forests of your youth.

17.name: Homeward Bound
17.description: The connection between you and the First World resonates within your body stronger than it does for most gnomes, allowing you to cross the threshold between the Universe and the First World.

1.name: Burn It!
1.description: Fire fascinates you.

1.name: City Scavenger
1.description: You know that the greatest treasures often look like refuse.

1.name: Goblin Lore
1.description: You've picked up skills and tales from your goblin community.

1.name: Goblin Scuttle
1.description: You take advantage of your ally's movement to adjust your position.

1.name: Goblin Song
1.description: You sing annoying goblin songs, distracting your foes with silly and repetitive lyrics.

1.name: Goblin Weapon Familiarity
1.description: Others might look upon them with disdain, but you know that the weapons of your people are as effective as they are sharp.

1.name: Junk Tinker
1.description: You can make useful tools out of even twisted or rusted scraps.

1.name: Rough Rider
1.description: You are especially good at riding traditional goblin mounts.

1.name: Very Sneaky
1.description: Taller folk rarely pay attention to the shadows at their feet, and you take full advantage of this.

1.name: Bouncy Goblin
1.description: You have a particular elasticity that makes it easy for you to bounce and squish.

1.name: Fang Sharpener
1.prerequisite: Irongut Goblin heritage or Razortooth Goblin heritage
1.description: You have filed your teeth into jagged points and have an unusually powerful jaw, making your mouth a dangerous weapon.

1.name: Hard Tail
1.description: Your tail is much stronger than most, and you can lash out with it with the strength of a whip.

1.name: Extra Squishy
1.description: Your rubbery physique makes it easier for you to wedge yourself into tight spaces and more difficult for your enemies to dislodge you.

1.name: Twitchy
1.description: You are naturally suspicious and wary of danger, especially when you suspect someone might be leading you into an ambush.

1.name: Dokkaebi Fire
1.description: You can create illusory wisps of ghostly blue flame.

1.name: Phantom Visage
1.description: You cloak yourself in illusions to mask your nature.

1.name: Tangle of Limbs
1.description: Dokkaebi have a strong tradition of wrestling.

5.name: Kneecap
5.description: You deliver a punishing blow to an enemy's knee, shin, or other vulnerable anatomy within your reach.

5.name: Loud Singer
5.description: Staying on pitch, proper breath control, and remembering the words are all less important than the real measure of a good singer: volume!

5.name: Vandal
5.description: You have a knack for breaking and dismantling things.

5.name: Goblin Weapon Frenzy
5.description: You know how to wield your people's vicious weapons.

5.name: Ankle Bite
5.prerequisite: Fang Sharpener or Razortooth Goblin heritage
5.description: Whenever someone grabs onto you, you instinctively bite down hard.

5.name: Chosen of Lamashtu
5.description: You bear the favor and blessings of Lamashtu, the Mother of Monsters.

5.name: Tail Spin
5.description: You excel at using your tail as a weapon to upend your foes.

5.name: Torch Goblin
5.description: You've spent enough time on fire that you know how to use it to your advantage.

5.name: Tree Climber (Goblin)
5.prerequisite: Tailed Goblin heritage or Treedweller Goblin heritage
5.description: Your time in forest or jungle canopies has taught you how to scramble across branches with sure feet.

5.name: Phantom Resemblance
5.description: Your can now draw from experience to wear any face you remember.

5.name: Glorious Gamtu
5.description: You can access the mystical power that dokkaebi refer to as a hat.

9.name: Cave Climber
9.description: After years of clambering through caverns, you can climb easily anywhere you go.

9.name: Cling
9.description: You hang onto a foe to harry them into submission.

9.name: Skittering Scuttle
9.description: You can scuttle farther and faster when maneuvering alongside allies.

9.name: Freeze It!
9.description: You are no rime hag or Jadwiga, but the magic of the north has still left a mark on you.

9.name: Hungry Goblin
9.description: You'll eat anything and anyone.

9.name: Roll with It (Goblin)
9.description: When you take a big hit, your foe bounces you around like a rubber ball, but you escape the worst of the blow.

9.name: Scalding Spit
9.description: Your bodily fluids burn with surprising volatility, as if you ran on oil instead of blood.

9.name: Goblin Club
9.description: You can summon a mass of magic energy in your hand that, naturally, you use to smack those who offend you.

9.name: Whispers in the Night
9.description: You weave your illusions with greater ability, allowing you to play tricks and slip through the night.

13.name: Very, Very Sneaky
13.description: You can move up to your Speed when you use the Sneak action, and you no longer need to have cover or greater cover or be concealed to Hide or Sneak.

13.name: Goblin Weapon Expertise
13.description: Your goblin affinity blends with your class training, granting you great skill with goblin weapons.

13.name: Unbreakable-er Goblin
13.description: As hard as most unbreakable goblins are to break, you are that much harder to break.

13.name: Flames of Vision
13.description: Dokkaebi were among the first goblins to pioneer gazing through flames, spectral or physical, to cast their senses far and wide.

17.name: Reckless Abandon (Goblin)
17.description: Despite a lifetime filled with questionable decisions, you've managed to survive, as though you have uncanny luck that lets you avoid the consequences of your own actions.

17.name: Perfected Gamtu
17.description: Your hat embodies the illusory grandeur of a master dokkaebi.

1.name: Distracting Shadows
1.description: You have learned to remain hidden by using larger folk as a distraction to avoid drawing attention to yourself.

1.name: Folksy Patter
1.description: You are adept at disguising coded messages as folksy idioms.

1.name: Halfling Lore
1.description: You've dutifully learned how to keep your balance and how to stick to the shadows where it's safe, important skills passed down through generations of halfling tradition.

1.name: Halfling Luck
1.description: Your happy-go-lucky nature makes it seem like misfortune avoids you, and to an extent, that might even be true.

1.name: Halfling Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You favor traditional halfling weapons, so you've learned how to use them more effectively.

1.name: Prairie Rider
1.description: You grew up riding your clan's shaggy ponies and riding dogs.

1.name: Sure Feet
1.description: Whether keeping your balance or climbing, your feet easily find purchase.

1.name: Titan Slinger
1.description: You have learned how to use your sling to fell enormous creatures.

1.name: Unfettered Halfling
1.description: You were either pressed into indentured servitude or shackled in a prison, but you've since escaped and have trained to ensure you'll never be caught again.

1.name: Watchful Halfling
1.description: You pay close attention to the people around you, allowing you to more easily notice when they act out of character.

1.name: Adroit Manipulation
1.description: You've fiddled with knots, locks, and blacksmith's puzzles since you were a child to give your hands something to do.

1.name: Innocuous
1.description: Halflings have been unobtrusive assistants of larger folk for untold ages, and your people count on this assumption of innocence.

1.name: Intuitive Cooperation
1.description: You are accustomed to working alongside others, relying on each other to get by.

1.name: Unassuming Dedication
1.description: Your family instilled the values of care and patience into you from a young age.

5.name: Cultural Adaptability
5.description: During your adventures, you've honed your ability to adapt to the culture of the predominant ancestry around you.

5.name: Step Lively
5.description: You are an expert at avoiding the lumbering footsteps of larger creatures.

5.name: Halfling Weapon Trickster
5.description: You are particularly adept at fighting with your people's favored weapons.

5.name: Easily Dismissed
5.description: You are practiced at blending into the background of the streets and halls of larger folk to ensure that you are overlooked.

5.name: Halfling Ingenuity
5.description: While your willingness to dig into a task you know little about might get you into trouble, your incredible luck often saves you from danger.

5.name: Shared Luck (Halfling)
5.description: You are evidence that it's lucky to travel with a halfling.

9.name: Dance Underfoot
9.description: You dart under the legs of your enemies in combat.

9.name: Guiding Luck
9.description: Your luck guides you to look the right way and aim your blows unerringly.

9.name: Irrepressible
9.description: You are easily able to ward off attempts to play on your fears and emotions.

9.name: Unhampered Passage
9.description: You won't allow others to restrain you.

9.name: Cunning Climber
9.description: Whether you are climbing a ship's rigging, a jungle tree, or a clock tower, you have an uncanny knack for finding footholds and handholds where larger creatures can't.

9.name: Fade Away
9.description: Your ability to blend into the background allows you to fade away entirely or appear innocuous even to magical effects.

9.name: Helpful Halfling
9.description: When you aid a friend with a task, you find many ways to help and avoid interfering.

13.name: Ceaseless Shadows
13.description: You excel at going unnoticed, especially among a crowd.

13.name: Toppling Dance
13.description: While sharing a creature's space using Dance Underfoot, your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain the trip trait, but only against the creature whose space you share.

13.name: Halfling Weapon Expertise
13.description: Your halfling affinity blends with your class training, granting you great skill with halfling weapons.

13.name: Cobble Dancer
13.description: You know how to take advantage of foes thrown off-balance by unstable flooring, loose cobblestones, or similar impediments.

13.name: Incredible Luck (Halfling)
13.description: Even other halflings consider you to be particularly lucky.

17.name: Shadow Self
17.description: You slip from your adversaries' notice and appear to be somewhere else.

1.name: Adapted Cantrip
1.description: Through study of multiple magical traditions, you've altered a spell to suit your spellcasting style.

1.name: Cooperative Nature
1.description: The short human life span lends perspective and has taught you from a young age to set aside differences and work with others to achieve greatness.

1.name: General Training
1.description: Your adaptability manifests in your mastery of a range of useful abilities.

1.name: Haughty Obstinacy
1.description: Your powerful ego makes it harder for others to order you around.

1.name: Natural Ambition
1.description: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field.

1.name: Natural Skill
1.description: Your ingenuity allows you to learn a wide variety of skills.

1.name: Unconventional Weaponry
1.description: You've familiarized yourself with a particular weapon, potentially from another ancestry or culture.

1.name: Arcane Tattoos
1.description: You have tattoos on your body corresponding to one of the ancient Thassilonian schools of magic.

1.name: Courteous Comeback
1.description: You grew up in the proud Padishah Empire, where even insults have a certain poetic wit.

1.name: Devil's Advocate
1.description: You know more about the habits of devils than is entirely safe.

1.name: Dragon Spit
1.description: Many Tian-Dan claim to have dragon blood in their veins, and in your case, this is true—you can spit energy, and you might have an especially visible sign of your draconic heritage.

1.name: Gloomseer
1.description: Gloom holds few terrors for you, and the pall of darkness over Nidal has made you comfortable in dim light.

1.name: Keep Up Appearances
1.description: Taldan pride means you never show weakness.

1.name: Know Oneself
1.description: You center yourself and call to mind the Vudrani monastic ideals of mindfulness and self-knowledge.

1.name: Quah Bond
1.description: You grew up among the Shoanti tribes, with the spirits watching over you, and they offer you guidance.

1.name: Saoc Astrology
1.description: The ancient Saoc Brethren were the masters of astrology, and while your knowledge may be but a pale shadow of their wisdom, it still comes in handy.

1.name: Tupilaq Carver
1.prerequisite: You have a spellcasting class feature with the divine or primal tradition
1.description: You know the truth behind old stories that tell of sending a fetish of bone and sinew to seek vengeance.

1.name: Viking Shieldbearer
1.description: You trained with shields and weapons as soon as you were old enough to hold them, eager to win honor and glory for yourself.

1.name: Witch Warden
1.description: You and your family have fought long and hard against witches, particularly the winter witches of Irrisen, and you've learned to be wary of their curses and the otherworldly powers their patrons grant.

5.name: Adaptive Adept
5.description: You've continued adapting your magic to blend your class's tradition with your adapted tradition.

5.name: Clever Improviser
5.description: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth.

5.name: Sense Allies
5.description: Like many humans raised in a close-knit community, you have always been strongly attuned to the presence of others.

5.name: Darkseer
5.description: Zon-Kuthon smiles upon you—even if you curse his name—granting you pitch-black eyes that allow you to see in shadows and darkness.

5.name: Ornate Tattoo
5.description: You expand your tattoos to encompass greater magic.

5.name: Wavetouched Paragon
5.description: You have been blessed by the sea, granting you the ability to swim like a fish.

9.name: Cooperative Soul
9.description: You have developed a soul-deep bond with your comrades and maintain an even greater degree of cooperation with them.

9.name: Group Aid
9.description: Your upbringing emphasized teamwork, and helping your allies comes naturally to you.

9.name: Hardy Traveler
9.description: There's no journey too far or burden too heavy when you have friends at your side or hope within your heart.

9.name: Incredible Improvisation
9.description: A stroke of brilliance gives you a major advantage with a skill despite your inexperience.

9.name: Multitalented
9.description: You've learned to split your focus between multiple classes with ease.

9.name: Dragon Prince
9.description: The blood of the Dragon Kings runs strong in your veins.

9.name: Heir of the Saoc
9.description: In the past, you would have been a proud initiate of the Saoc Brethren.

9.name: Shory Aeromancer
9.prerequisite: Garundi ethnicity, Mauxi ethnicity, or Tian-Yae ethnicity
9.description: Your ancestors hailed from the flying cities of the Shory, and a few simple tricks have come down through the ages to you.

9.name: Virtue-Forged Tattoos
9.description: Your tattoos are a work of eldritch genius, a masterpiece of art, magic, and skin.

13.name: Advanced General Training
13.description: Over the long course of your adventuring life, your adaptability has let you pick up numerous useful abilities.

13.name: Bounce Back
13.description: You recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience.

13.name: Stubborn Persistence
13.description: Humans are renowned for their ability to persist through the most grueling of trials that would leave others ready to drop.

13.name: Unconventional Expertise
13.prerequisite: Unconventional Weaponry; trained in the weapon you chose for Unconventional Weaponry
13.description: You've continued to advance your powers using your unconventional weapon.

13.name: Irriseni Ice-Witch
13.description: You can trace your direct descent from one of the Queens of Irrisen and thus from Baba Yaga herself.

13.name: Shadow Pact
13.description: Thousands of years ago, your ancestors made a pact with Zon-Kuthon.

13.name: Shory Aerialist
13.prerequisite: Garundi ethnicity, Mauxi ethnicity, or Tian-Yae ethnicity; Shory Aeromancer or ability to cast _fly_
13.description: Unique in Golarion's history, the Shory people developed fighting styles dedicated to combat in the air.

17.name: Heroic Presence
17.description: The blood of heroes courses through your veins, and you inspire your allies to dig deep and find a new level of resolve.

1.name: Grasping Reach
1.description: You can extend a tangle of vines or tendrils to support your arms and extend your reach.

1.name: Harmlessly Cute
1.description: Your size and demeanor make it easy for you to convince others that you mean no harm.

1.name: Leshy Lore
1.description: You deeply understand your people's cultural traditions and innate strengths.

1.name: Leshy Superstition
1.description: You notice spirits that inhabit objects, learning which bring good fortune and which are unlucky.

1.name: Seedpod
1.description: Your body produces a nearly endless supply of hard seedpods.

1.name: Shadow of the Wilds
1.description: It's difficult to notice your passage through wild areas.

1.name: Undaunted
1.description: Your spirit has endured many challenges over its long existence.

1.name: Ageless Spirit
1.description: You remember more about your previous incarnations than most leshys.

1.name: Pyrophilic Recovery
1.description: You rely on fire and extreme heat to sprout and regrow.

1.name: Childlike Plant
1.prerequisite: Chrysanthemum Leshy heritage or Peachchild Leshy heritage
1.description: You're adept at hiding your plantlike features to pass as a human.

1.name: Caustic Nectar
1.description: You have specialized glands inside your throat, which produce acidic nectar that you can spit long distances.

1.name: Wilderness Born
1.description: You're at home in the wilderness and easily disappear into it.

5.name: Anchoring Roots
5.description: Small roots sprout from your feet, steadying you as you move.

5.name: Leshy Glide
5.prerequisite: Leaf Leshy heritage or Cat Fall
5.description: Using your own leaves, you can control your descent.

5.name: Ritual Reversion
5.description: You can temporarily revert to a less conspicuous form without diminishing your senses.

5.name: Speak with Kindred
5.description: You have a connection with creatures that share your physiology.

5.name: Climate Adaptation
5.description: Like evergreen trees, which stay healthy and vibrant from winter through summer, you too can adapt to a variety of extreme climates.

5.name: Defensive Needles
5.prerequisite: Cactus Leshy heritage or Pine Leshy heritage
5.description: Your body is covered in sharp needles or spines which you can use to defend yourself.

5.name: Unassuming Heroes
5.description: You have a talent for making friends through simple kindness, often among stray animals or other creatures that people tend to overlook, and your inherent magic can make these acts take on additional power.

5.name: Noble Bloom
5.description: Certain plants and flowers hold a reputation throughout Tian Xia for being strong and upstanding, able to weather adversity.

5.name: Quick Root
5.description: You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing.

9.name: Bark and Tendril
9.description: You wield primal magic.

9.name: Lucky Keepsake
9.description: You have a keepsake that grants you luck.

9.name: Solar Rejuvenation
9.description: If you rest outdoors for 10 minutes during the day, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × half your level.

9.name: Thorned Seedpod
9.description: When your seedpods strike a felling blow, they burst into viciously thorny vines.

9.name: Solar Rejuvenation (Leshy)
9.description: If you rest outdoors for 10 minutes during the day, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × half your level.

9.name: Spore Cloud
9.description: You unleash a cloud of pollen or similar spores.

9.name: Towering Growth
9.description: You're capable of growing as tall as a pine tree for a short time.

9.name: Kodama Call
9.description: The small spirits known as kodama pride themselves in taking care of trees and other vegetation, and they'll happily come to your aid as well.

9.name: Green Dash
9.description: The spirits of vegetation send you on your way, letting you move in a burst of speed.

9.name: Sash of the Wind
9.description: At your request, the nature spirits of the air and wind spin themselves into an iridescent sash loosely draped around your shoulders that buoys you through the sky.

9.name: Grow Tool
9.description: You grow a simple tool from your own body, coaxing flowers, vines, roots, and wood to grow and sprout from your flesh into the desired shape.

9.name: Pollinate
9.description: As you're hit, you emit a dense cloud of pollen, obscuring you from sight.

13.name: Call of the Green Man
13.description: You can call forth nearby nature spirits to augment your body.

13.name: Cloak of Poison
13.description: You secrete a cloak of concentrated poison that harms any who dare attack you.

13.name: Flower Chimera
13.description: You call on a guardian of the wild to burst forth from the land to aid you.

13.name: Unfettered Growth
13.description: By tapping into the limitless power of the Plane of Wood, you can experience sudden, dramatic growth for a short time.

17.name: Flourish and Ruin
17.description: You can call upon the vital essence of your spirit to restore life to your allies and call forth vines to ensnare and bludgeon your foes.

17.name: Regrowth
17.description: Your command over your vital essence allows you or an ally to recover from grievous wounds.

17.name: Return to the Seed
17.description: Once per month, when you die, you can instead choose to fade away.

17.name: Irresistible Bloom
17.description: You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible.

1.name: Beast Trainer
1.description: You have an impressive innate ability to tame and command ferocious beasts.

1.name: Iron Fists
1.description: Your fists have been forged by battle, your naturally tough skin and dense bone further hardened by conflict.

1.name: Orc Ferocity
1.description: Fierceness in battle runs through your blood, and you refuse to fall from your injuries no matter how terrible they may be.

1.name: Orc Lore
1.description: The hold elders taught you your people's histories, told tales of great athletic feats, and shared with you the hardships your ancestors endured so that you can pass this wisdom down to future generations.

1.name: Orc Superstition
1.description: You defend yourself against magic by relying on techniques derived from orc cultural superstitions.

1.name: Hold Mark
1.description: You bear scars or tattoos enhanced by the mark of your community's prowess.

1.name: Orc Weapon Familiarity
1.description: In combat, you favor the brutal weapons that are traditional for your orc ancestors.

1.name: Tusks
1.description: You have particularly long, jagged tusks perfect for tearing meat from bone.

1.name: Orc Warmask
1.description: You paint your face to create a warmask .

5.name: Athletic Might
5.description: Surviving in hostile terrain has given you a great talent for mobility.

5.name: Bloody Blows
5.description: Your lethal unarmed attacks leave bloody gouges or cause severe internal bleeding.

5.name: Defy Death
5.description: You're exceptionally difficult to kill.

5.name: Scar-Thick Skin
5.description: Glorious, storied scars cover and protect much of your body, girding you in fleshly armor that resists any wound weaker than those you have already survived.

5.name: Orc Weapon Carnage
5.description: You are brutally efficient with the weapons of your orc ancestors.

5.name: Victorious Vigor
5.description: Your victories in battle fill you with pride and imbue you with the energy to fight a bit longer despite your wounds.

5.name: Mask of Power
5.description: Your warmask sharpens your connection to the source of your mask's power.

5.name: Mask of Rejection
5.description: Your warmask projects a white-hot fury that attempts to vaporize the offending magic.

5.name: Demonblood Frenzy
5.description: Just the taste of fiendish blood is enough to send blood rushing through your veins in a supernatural fury.

5.name: Spell Survivor
5.description: Once you've resisted an opponent's magic, anything else they throw your way becomes less effective.

9.name: Pervasive Superstition
9.description: You steep yourself in superstition and practice ancient orc mental exercises for shrugging off the effects of magic.

9.name: Undying Ferocity
9.description: You resist death's clutches with supernatural vigor, daring death to claim you while promising that any such attempt will surely fail.

9.name: Death's Drums
9.description: Your life has been spent challenging death itself, and proximity to that implacable foe only makes your heart beat harder.

9.name: Dragon Grip
9.description: Your hold has a unique draconic connection.

9.name: Mask of Pain
9.description: Your mask has grown into a manifestation of your pain, which you can release.

13.name: Incredible Ferocity
13.description: Given time to collect yourself after a near-death scrape, you can rebuild your ferocity and withstand additional finishing blows.

13.name: Ferocious Beasts
13.prerequisite: Bonded Animal, animal companion, or Pet; Orc Ferocity
13.description: Since ancient times, the mightiest orc beast tamers would draw out the true fighting spirit of their companion beasts by feeding the creatures a draft incorporating the orc's own blood.

13.name: Spell Devourer
13.description: You don't just resist magic; you devour it.

13.name: Orc Weapon Expertise
13.description: Your orc affinity blends with your class training, granting you great skill with orc weapons.

13.name: Lifeblood's Call
13.description: The impulse to survive and continue fighting resonates deep within you.

13.name: Mask of Fear
13.description: Your warmask burns off of your face, releasing your apprehension.

17.name: Rampaging Ferocity
17.description: You lash out viciously even as you fend off death.

1.name: Cat Nap
1.description: You can regain your energy quickly with a brief nap.

1.name: Cat's Luck
1.description: You instinctively twist away from danger.

1.name: Catfolk Dance
1.description: You have a habit of always being in the way when other creatures attempt to move.

1.name: Catfolk Lore
1.description: Growing up among catfolk has taught you the traditional values of freedom, stewardship, and quick reactions to trouble.

1.name: Catfolk Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the catfolk trait.

1.name: Saber Teeth
1.description: You have long fangs, natural or augmented.

1.name: Well-Met Traveler
1.description: You naturally adopt a pleasant and affable demeanor when meeting others.

1.name: Saberteeth
1.description: You have long fangs, natural or augmented.

1.name: Winter Cat Senses
1.description: Your eyes are keen and accustomed to winter conditions.

5.name: Climbing Claws
5.description: You can extend your claws to aid you in climbing.

5.name: Graceful Guidance
5.description: You can demonstrate how to quickly twist out of the way of dangerous effects.

5.name: Light Paws
5.description: You can balance on your toes to step carefully over obstructions.

5.name: Lucky Break
5.description: You are luckier even than most catfolk.

5.name: Pride Hunter
5.description: You avoid the attention of creatures focused on your allies.

5.name: Springing Leaper
5.description: Your powerful legs allow you to make sudden and dramatic leaps.

5.name: Well-Groomed
5.description: You are fastidious about keeping clean.

5.name: Catfolk Weapon Rake
5.description: You know how to efficiently use weapons that rake across your enemies.

5.name: Expanded Luck
5.description: You are luckier even than most catfolk.

5.name: Focused Cat Nap
5.description: When you Cat Nap, you can also Refocus as you dream of a relevant activity.

9.name: Aggravating Scratch
9.description: Your claws carry an irritant that is harmless to you but can be damaging to others.

9.name: Evade Doom
9.description: You can elude supernatural disaster.

9.name: Luck of the Clowder
9.description: When you use Cat's Luck to reroll, any creatures you choose within 10 feet who also just failed against the same effect (such as a single spell) can also reroll their saving throws and use the better result.

9.name: Predator's Growl
9.description: You give a throaty growl to attempt to Demoralize a creature you just found.

9.name: Silent Step
9.description: You Step, then Hide or Sneak.

9.name: Wary Skulker
9.description: You can perform the Scout exploration activity at the same time as the Avoid Notice exploration activity.

9.name: Shared Luck (Catfolk)
9.description: Other creatures can benefit from your luck

9.name: No Evidence
9.description: You leave little sign when attempting to remain unseen.

9.name: Sense for Trouble
9.description: You can tell when something's off.

13.name: Black Cat Curse
13.description: You hiss a spiteful curse.

13.name: Caterwaul
13.description: You give a daring yowl, calling your companion back from the brink of unconsciousness.

13.name: Catfolk Weapon Expertise
13.description: You are well-trained in traditional catfolk weapons

13.name: Inspirit Hazard
13.description: You awaken a spirit of creation within the hazard.

17.name: Elude Trouble
17.description: Stride up to your Speed.

17.name: Reliable Luck
17.description: You survive danger with surprising regularity.

17.name: Ten Lives
17.description: When your character would die, you can attempt a DC 17 flat check.

1.name: Alchemical Scholar
1.description: You gain the Alchemical Crafting feat.

1.name: Cantorian Reinforcement
1.description: The life energy that helped create the first hobgoblins is particularly potent in you, protecting you from ongoing maladies.

1.name: Hobgoblin Lore
1.description: You've studied traditional hobgoblin exercises and fieldcraft, all of which have a militaristic bent.

1.name: Hobgoblin Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the hobgoblin trait.

1.name: Leech-Clip
1.description: You are trained to capture deserters, or "leeches." Make a melee Strike with weapon from the flail group.

1.name: Remorseless Lash
1.description: You're skilled at beating an enemy when their morale is already breaking.

1.name: Sneaky
1.description: Stealth is an important tool in your arsenal.

1.name: Stone Face
1.description: You've mastered the art of composure, even in the face of fear.

1.name: Vigorous Health
1.description: You can withstand blood loss startlingly well.

1.name: Leech-Clipper
1.description: You are trained to capture deserters, or "leeches".

5.name: Agonizing Rebuke
5.description: When you terrorize your enemies, you also cause them painful mental distress.

5.name: Expert Drill Sergeant
5.description: While exploring, when you are leading and allies are Following the Expert, instead of granting a +2 circumstance bonus in the applicable skill, you grant a +3 circumstance bonus if you're an expert and a +4 circumstance bonus if you're a master.

5.name: Recognize Ambush
5.description: Your combat training has honed you to be ready for an attack at all times.

5.name: Runtsage
5.description: Unlike most of your kind, who dismiss goblins as embarrassments or expendable annoyances, you have studied the methodology behind their irresponsible and incomprehensible actions.

5.name: Formation Training
5.description: You know how to fight in formation with your brethren.

5.name: Hobgoblin Weapon Discipline
5.description: You know how to efficiently utilize the weapons soldiers use in close quarters.

9.name: Cantorian Rejuvenation
9.description: The life-giving energy that flows in your blood revitalizes you.

9.name: Fell Rider
9.description: You have trained with your animal companion to become a terrifying juggernaut on the battlefield.

9.name: Pride in Arms
9.description: With a shout of triumph, you grant inspiration to an ally fight on.

9.name: Squad Tactics
9.description: You are adept at working with your allies to surround an enemy.

13.name: Can't Fall Here
13.description: You physically help an ally remain standing and encourage them to push through their pain against dire odds.

13.name: War Conditioning
13.description: You have extensive training in remote environments, allowing you to move through these areas easily.

13.name: Formation Master
13.description: You can assemble a formation even with members of ancestries that lack the hobgoblins' military discipline, and you can extend these benefits to your hobgoblin allies.

13.name: Hobgoblin Weapon Expertise
13.description: You increase your training in battlefield weapons.

13.name: We March On
13.description: You make sure that your allies push themselves while traveling.

17.name: Cantorian Restoration
17.description: The energy that flows in your blood can save a life in the direst of times.

17.name: Rallying Cry
17.description: You call out to your allies and push them to give their all in combat.

17.name: Azaersi's Roads
17.description: Azaersi has granted you limited access to the Stone Roads, attuning you to the tiniest sliver of the Onyx Key .

1.name: Ask the Bones
1.description: You keep the bone of an ancestor or a friend to call upon for advice.

1.name: Crunch
1.description: Your jaws can crush bone and bite through armor.

1.name: Hyena Familiar
1.description: Hyenas serve kholo as pets and trackers.

1.name: Kholo Lore
1.description: You paid close attention to the senior hunters in your clan to learn their tricks.

1.name: Kholo Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the kholo trait.

1.name: Pack Hunter
1.description: You were taught how to hunt as part of a pack.

1.name: Sensitive Nose
1.description: Your large black nose isn't just for show.

1.name: Gnoll Lore
1.description: You paid attention to your senior hunters to learn their tricks.

1.name: Gnoll Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You were taught to be a hunter and a raider.

5.name: Absorb Strength
5.description: You consume a piece of your enemy, absorbing their strength.

5.name: Distant Cackle
5.description: It takes a very brave person to enter the laughter-haunted forest where you dwell.

5.name: Pack Stalker
5.description: Ambushes are an honored kholo tradition.

5.name: Rabid Sprint
5.description: You run on all fours as fast as you can.

5.name: Affliction Resistance
5.description: Your diet has strengthened you against diseases and poisons.

5.name: Left-hand Blood
5.description: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous.

5.name: Right-hand Blood
5.description: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous.

5.name: Gnoll Weapon Practicality
5.description: You have come to know gnoll weapons as you know yourself.

9.name: Ambush Hunter
9.description: You are always searching for the perfect opportunity to ambush your enemies.

9.name: Breath Like Honey
9.description: You smell of honey and savory things.

9.name: Grandmother's Wisdom
9.description: You carry the bones of your ancestors with you, and you can ask them for counsel.

9.name: Laughing Kholo
9.description: Your sinister giggle is a sound of warning and threat.

9.name: Laughing Gnoll
9.description: A gnoll's sinister giggle is a sound of warning and threat.

13.name: Ancestor's Rage
13.description: You transform into an enormous, otherworldly hyena.

13.name: Bonekeeper's Bane
13.description: Whenever an enemy starts its turn adjacent to you, it must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is highest.

13.name: Gnoll Weapon Expertise
13.description: You fight with effortless expertise with gnoll weapons.

17.name: First to Strike, First to Fall
17.description: Whenever you successfully Strike a creature that has not acted in the first round of combat, that creature is off-guard until the end of your next turn.

17.name: Impaling Bone
17.description: Once per day, you can cast impaling spike as a 7th-rank innate occult spell, except the spike is made of bone instead of cold iron.

17.name: Legendary Laugh
17.description: Your laugher echoes in the minds of your enemies.

1.name: Cringe
1.description: With pitiful posturing, you cause your foe to pull back a deadly attack.

1.name: Dragon's Presence
1.description: As kin to dragonkind, you project unflappable confidence (that collapses catastrophically against the deadliest foes).

1.name: Kobold Lore
1.description: You attentively learned key kobold survival strategies from your elders.

1.name: Kobold Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the kobold trait.

1.name: Scamper
1.description: You Stride up to your Speed, with a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

1.name: Snare Setter
1.description: You are adept at the time-honored kobold art of making traps.

1.name: Kobold Breath
1.description: You channel your draconic exemplar's power into a gout of energy.

1.name: Draconic Sycophant
1.description: You have an affect that dragonkind find unusually pleasing—and when that fails, you know when to duck.

1.name: Slither
1.description: You are an expert at moving through extremely tight spaces.

1.name: Koi Secrets
1.description: Due to their beautiful colors, ornamental koi are often found in parks and gardens where townsfolk roam.

1.name: Benefactor's Resistance
1.description: Your scales have taken on the characteristics of your draconic benefactor and insulate you from certain damage types.

1.name: Dragonscaled Lore
1.description: The study of dragons is not merely academic to you but part of your family tree.

1.name: Hoarder's Craw
1.description: Your draconic features include a pouch inside your body that you use to store food prior to digestion.

5.name: Ally's Shelter
5.description: You follow your allies' example.

5.name: Grovel
5.description: You convince your foe you're less of a threat.

5.name: Snare Genius
5.description: If the snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead.

5.name: Winglets
5.description: Through the lingering influence of your warren's patron, you've sprouted a small set of wings.

5.name: Kobold Weapon Innovator
5.description: You've learned devious tactics with your kobold weapons.

5.name: Duck!
5.description: Your long experience with your erratic patrons and their peers has given you a lot of practice in hitting the deck when you hear the rumbling of a powerful entity.

5.name: Friend of the Family
5.description: You come from a long line of imperial kobolds—if you meet a stranger who has some political standing in Tian Xia, they might know someone from your family line.

5.name: Benefactor's Strike
5.description: Your benefactor's blood flows through your veins, and you channel their power into your body.

5.name: Kobold Momentum
5.description: You possess the confidence of a dragon, and your success emboldens you to draw on power reserves you didn't know you had.

5.name: Tip the Scales
5.description: You're a cunning adversary in close quarters and are well-versed in hit-and-run tactics that exploit the advantages of your small stature.

9.name: Between the Scales
9.description: You've learned to take advantage of slips in your foes' defenses.

9.name: Briar Battler
9.description: When you're in difficult terrain from an environmental feature, you can Take Cover, even if the feature wouldn't ordinarily be large enough for you to Take Cover.

9.name: Close Quarters
9.description: If you're Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small or smaller ally.

9.name: Evolved Spellhorn
9.description: Your inborn arcane power grows.

9.name: Fleeing Shriek
9.description: You let out an ear-piercing screech.

9.name: Winglet Flight
9.description: Intense use and exercise have made your winglets more powerful.

9.name: Dracomancer
9.description: Your inborn arcane power manifests as your exemplar's most time-honored spells.

9.name: Dragon's Breath
9.description: You can put more effort into your Kobold Breath to channel greater draconic power, though it takes more out of you.

9.name: Dragonblood Paragon
9.prerequisite: Strongjaw Kobold heritage, Venomtail Kobold heritage, Dracomancer, or Kobold Breath
9.description: Your draconic anatomy becomes especially pronounced.

9.name: Snare Commando
9.prerequisite: Snare Crafting; Expert in Deception or Expert in Intimidation
9.description: Your snares are so befuddling that your victims rarely notice you slipping out of sight.

9.name: Breath Unleashed
9.description: You're able to channel more of your draconic benefactor's power and focus it into your Kobold Breath, increasing its effectiveness but requiring more time to recover.

9.name: Draconic Paragon
9.description: Your connection to your draconic benefactor becomes especially pronounced.

13.name: Resplendent Spellhorn
13.description: Your magic continues to flourish.

13.name: Tumbling Diversion
13.prerequisite: Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Deception
13.description: Attempt to Tumble Through an opponent's space.

13.name: Vicious Snares
13.description: You deal an additional 1d6 precision damage with damage snares you craft.

13.name: Elite Dracomancer
13.description: Your magic rivals that of lesser dragons.

13.name: Hatchling Flight
13.description: You can fly a little!

13.name: Kobold Weapon Expertise
13.description: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the crossbow, greatpick, light pick, pick, and spear, as well as any kobold weapons in which you are trained.

13.name: Imperial Dragon Potion
13.prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Heavenscribe Kobold heritage
13.description: During your daily preparations, you can spend 10 minutes to create a variant energy breath potion, which has the kobold trait in addition to its normal traits.

13.name: Kaiju's Footfalls
13.description: You channel the might and mass of a kaiju.

17.name: Benefactor's Majesty
17.description: You tap into the grandeur of your warren's benefactor.

17.name: Wyrmling Flight
17.description: Your draconic wings have grown large and strong enough for flight.

1.name: Bone Magic
1.description: Your connection to your iruxi ancestors manifests as a simple primal spell that you cast using a fragment of an ancestor's bones.

1.name: Iruxi Armaments
1.description: Your weapons are those you were born with.

1.name: Lizardfolk Lore
1.description: You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community.

1.name: Marsh Runner
1.description: When you use the Step action, you can ignore difficult terrain caused by flooding, swamps, or quicksand.

1.name: Parthenogenic Hatchling
1.description: You were hatched from an unfertilized egg during hard times for your people, and are a biological copy of your mother.

1.name: Reptile Speaker
1.description: You hear the sounds of reptiles as language.

1.name: Razor Claws
1.description: Your have honed your claws to be deadly.

1.name: Sharp Fangs
1.description: Your teeth are formidable weapons.

1.name: Tail Whip
1.description: By birth or through training, your tail is strong enough to make for a powerful melee weapon.

1.name: Consult the Stars
1.description: You find wisdom in the movements of the heavens.

1.name: Lightning Tongue
1.description: Your tongue darts out faster than the eye can see to retrieve loose objects.

1.name: Reptile Rider
1.description: To you, crocodilians, giant lizards, and dinosaurs are loyal steeds, not monsters.

1.name: Crocodile's Twin
1.prerequisite: Bakuwa Lizardfolk heritage or Makari Lizardfolk heritage
1.description: Your egg contained your twin, a crocodile.

1.name: Spirit Coffin
1.description: A hump forms on your back that allows you to attack and trap spirits.

5.name: Envenom Fangs
5.description: You envenom your fangs.

5.name: Flexible Tail
5.description: You can perform simple Interact actions with your tail, such as opening an unlocked door.

5.name: Gecko's Grip
5.description: You cling to walls with a preternatural grip.

5.name: Shed Tail
5.description: You can shed a portion of your tail to escape.

5.name: Swift Swimmer
5.description: You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

5.name: Iruxi Unarmed Cunning
5.description: You make the most of your iruxi unarmed attacks.

5.name: Guided by the Stars
5.description: The stars grant you insights that guide your actions.

5.name: Iruxi Glide
5.description: You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air.

5.name: Tongue Disarm
5.description: You lash out with your tongue to disarm your foe.

9.name: Dangle
9.description: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

9.name: Hone Claws
9.description: You grind or gnaw a particularly wicked edge onto your claws.

9.name: Terrain Advantage
9.description: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain are off-guard to you.

9.name: Bone Caller
9.description: Using a mixture of dinosaur bones and the bones of your ancestors to focus your magic, you animate lizards and dinosaurs to carry messages or serve as mounts.

9.name: Read the Stars
9.prerequisite: Trained in Astrology Lore or Trained in Occultism
9.description: You're incredibly skilled in iruxi astrology, and you can gain useful (if cryptic) hints from the stars' alignment.

9.name: Ancestral Form
9.prerequisite: Bakuwa Lizardfolk heritage or Makari Lizardfolk heritage
9.description: Casting your memory back deep into the past, you take the form of an ancestral guardian.

9.name: River Adaptation
9.description: Webbing sprouts on your legs and tail as you shift to a more aquatic form.

13.name: Bone Investiture
13.description: You encase yourself in spiritual dinosaur bones to become a Huge dinosaur.

13.name: Iruxi Spirit Strike
13.description: Your iruxi unarmed attacks channel the spiritual energy of your ancestors.

13.name: Primal Rampage
13.description: You gain unfettered movement and mountain resilience as 4th-rank primal innate spells that you can cast once per day.

13.name: Spiritual Headhunter
13.description: Your spirit coffin can temporarily detain the spirits of those you kill, allowing you to ask them one last question before they pass on.

13.name: Ferry Through Waves
13.description: The waters around you permit you passage, a privilege you can share with a willing ally.

17.name: Fossil Rider
17.description: Using your ancestors' bones, you manifest their spirits around you in a fossilized form.

17.name: Scion Transformation
17.description: You go into hibernation for twenty-four hours and perform a ritual dedicated to your ancestors, undergoing a one-time metamorphosis.

17.name: Bone Rider
17.description: Using your ancestors' bones, you manifest their spirits around you in a fossilized form, terrifying your foes.

17.name: Mooneater
17.description: You call on the spirit of the dragon that devoured the moon to temporarily swallow a celestial body and blind onlookers with its visage.

1.name: Cheek Pouches
1.description: Your cheeks are stretchy, and you can store up to four items of light Bulk or less in these cheek pouches.

1.name: Pack Rat
1.description: You've learned how to cram vast quantities into small spaces.

1.name: Rat Familiar
1.description: You have a pet rat that has become magically bonded to you.

1.name: Ratfolk Lore
1.description: Years of experience among ratfolk communities have made you nimble, and you've learned to run and hide when enemies threaten.

1.name: Ratspeak
1.description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with rodents, including beavers, mice, porcupines, rats, and squirrels, but not with other mammals, such as dogs or bats.

1.name: Tinkering Fingers
1.description: You're trained in Crafting.

1.name: Vicious Incisors
1.description: Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage instead of 1d4, and gains the backstabber trait.

1.name: Warren Navigator
1.description: You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival.

1.name: Skull Creeper
1.description: You wear skulls to demoralize foes.

1.name: Warren Friend
1.description: You're adept at making contact with other ysoki.

5.name: Cornered Fury
5.description: If a foe of a larger size than you critically hits and damages you, that foe is off-guard to you for 1 round.

5.name: Lab Rat
5.description: You've spent more than your share of time in an alchemy lab.

5.name: Quick Stow
5.description: You Interact to store one item you're holding in your cheek pouches (provided it fits).

5.name: Rat Magic
5.description: There always seems to be a little rat around to carry messages for you.

5.name: Ratfolk Roll
5.description: You roll up into a ball and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline.

5.name: Quick Stow (Ratfolk)
5.description: You are adept at quickly moving items into your cheek pouches.

5.name: Gnaw
5.description: With enough time and determination, you can chew through nearly anything.

5.name: Plague Sniffer
5.description: You can sniff out the pungent tang of disease.

9.name: Big Mouth
9.description: Instead of storing up to four items of Light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items.

9.name: Overcrowd
9.description: As long as you are Small, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small ally.

9.name: Rat Form
9.description: You can transform into an innocuous-looking rat.

9.name: Uncanny Cheeks
9.description: You gain the Prescient Consumable and Prescient Planner feats, except that you always withdraw the objects from your cheek pouches.

13.name: Shinstabber
13.description: As long as you're Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as an ally of any size.

13.name: Skittering Sneak
13.description: You squish, slink, and skitter from cover to cover with great speed and stealth.

13.name: Warren Digger
13.description: You've learned to put your sturdy claws to work digging through the earth.

17.name: Call the Swarm
17.description: You give a shrill whistle and point, and a massive swarm of rats pours forth from the surrounding terrain to fill a 30-foot burst within 120 feet.

17.name: Greater than the Sum
17.description: You call upon the familial bonds you share with your allies and other ratfolk to become an overwhelming force in battle.

17.name: Ratfolk Growth
17.description: You call upon the familial bonds you share with other ysoki to defend them in battle.

1.name: Mariner's Fire
