1.description: You conjure uncanny orbs of spiritual flame that float above or below the water's surface.

1.name: One-Toed Hop
1.description: Assuming a peculiar stance, you make a short hop on each toe.

1.name: Scavenger's Search
1.description: You're always on the lookout for supplies and valuables.

1.name: Squawk!
1.description: You let out an awkward squawk, ruffle your feathers, or fake some other birdlike tic to cover up a social misstep or faux pas.

1.name: Storm's Lash
1.description: Wind and lightning have always been friends to you.

1.name: Tengu Lore
1.description: You learned skills for surviving in the place where your people were dispersed.

1.name: Tengu Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tengu trait plus the katana, khakkara, temple sword, and wakizashi.

1.name: Uncanny Agility
1.description: You have near-supernatural poise that lets you move swiftly across the most unsteady surfaces.

1.name: Waxed Feathers
1.description: Your feathers are coated in a waxy substance that repels water.

5.name: Eat Fortune
5.description: As someone tries to twist fate, you consume the interference.

5.name: Long-Nosed Form
5.description: You transform into a specific, curious-looking human form.

5.name: Magpie Snatch
5.description: You move quickly, snatching a shiny item that catches your eye.

5.name: Soaring Flight
5.description: You Fly.

5.name: Tengu Feather Fan
5.description: You've learned to bind some of your feathers together into a fan to focus your ancestral magic.

5.name: Tengu Weapon Study
5.description: You've learned techniques for using blades and other tengu weapons.

5.name: Dogfang Bite
5.description: You can swing your beak to slash your foes when piercing attacks won't do.

9.name: Soaring Form
9.description: You have a fly Speed of 20 feet at all times.

9.name: Wind God's Fan
9.description: Your fan can stir up even more powerful winds.

9.name: Eclectic Sword Training
9.description: You were always taught that you needed to be able to use whatever weapon came your way.

13.name: Harbinger's Claw
13.description: You caw ominously, cursing the creature with misfortune.

13.name: Jinx Glutton
13.description: You can Eat Fortune once per hour, rather than once per day.

13.name: Thunder God's Fan
13.description: Your fan unleashes the fury of the storm.

13.name: Tengu Weapon Expertise
13.description: Study has made you an expert with tengu weapons.

13.name: Eclectic Sword Mastery
13.description: You instinctively learn how to use a sword with just a few practice swings.

13.name: Harbinger's Caw
13.description: You caw ominously, cursing the creature with misfortune.

17.name: Great Tengu Form
17.description: You take on the imposing form of a large, winged spirit.

17.name: Trickster Tengu
17.description: You can transform yourself or the bodies of others to express your displeasure.

17.name: Favor of Heaven
17.description: You're one of Hei Feng's chosen people and have the authority of the Celestial Court on your side.

17.name: Hurricane Swing
17.description: Choose either lightning bolt or gust of wind .

1.name: Croak Talker
1.description: You can communicate with the simplest of frogs and other similar creatures using longwinded croaks.

1.name: Hunter's Defense
1.description: Your canny understanding of natural and primal creatures helps you predict and dodge their attacks.

1.name: Jungle Strider
1.description: You are adept at dodging roots, foliage, and other jungle obstacles.

1.name: Nocturnal Tripkee
1.description: You tend to do most of your hunting and work at night and have adapted to the requirements of nocturnal life.

1.name: Terrifying Croak
1.description: You release a haunting croak that reminds those around you of their fears.

1.name: Tripkee Lore
1.description: You are well versed in tripkee culture and tactics.

1.name: Tripkee Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tripkee trait.

1.name: Bounce Boost
1.description: You've learned to use your own athletic abilities and springy legs to help others who need a boost with their leaps.

1.name: Waterweave Tripkee
1.description: Your body has adapted to remain underwater indefinitely.

5.name: Fantastic Leaps
5.description: Your leaps seem to defy gravity as you soar through the air in a single bound.

5.name: Long Tongue
5.description: You've learned to stretch your exceptionally long tongue beyond its original limits.

5.name: Prodigious Climber
5.description: Your natural climbing ability and technique has made you a potent climber.

5.name: Tenacious Net
5.description: Escaping your nets is no simple task.

5.name: Tripkee Glide
5.description: You can use your webbed feet to guide your fall.

5.name: Vomit Stomach
5.description: In dire circumstances you can vomit out your stomach to expel toxins.

5.name: Frog Geyser
5.description: You can spray a powerful steam of water from your mouth to push your foes around.

9.name: Absorb Toxin
9.prerequisite: You are not immune to diseases or poisons
9.description: Your skin readily absorbs poison and can consciously draw toxins into your body to spare others.

9.name: Moisture Bath
9.description: Your moist skin is especially resistant to damage from temperature-altering effects.

9.name: Ricocheting Leap
9.description: You quickly use your momentum to topple and spring off of foes.

9.name: Tongue Tether
9.description: Your tongue can momentarily latch on as readily as your hands.

13.name: Envenomed Edge
13.description: With a combination of your poison glands and herbal concoctions, you can consistently deliver venomous attacks when you hit an enemy's weak points.

13.name: Hop Up
13.description: Your frog-like agility awakens as soon as you do.

13.name: Burrowing Tripkee
13.description: You've gotten the knack of using your oversized, webbed hands to rapidly shovel earth.

17.name: Unbound Leaper
17.description: Your jumping prowess is unmatched.

17.name: Frog Tide
17.description: You have a connection to water and are able to call upon it to batter your foes and carry them away.

1.name: Decisive Swimmer
1.description: You are a talented athlete trained to compete in swimming competitions, and would sometimes be asked to help your community settle disputes with others by participating in swimming races.

1.name: Razorsharp Bite
1.description: You have long, sharp teeth designed to shred flesh.

1.name: Athamaru Lore
1.description: You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals.

1.name: Athamaru Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease.

1.name: Community-Minded
1.description: You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles.

1.name: Coral Symbiotes
1.description: You've tended to your coral jewelry so well that you have formed a symbiotic relationship with it.

1.name: Elver Pet
1.description: Athamarus have bonded with eels more closely than any other fish.

1.name: Emit Defensive Odor
1.description: While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes.

1.name: Ocean Wariness
1.description: Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about alghollthu mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community.

1.name: Pheromonal Message
1.description: Your communicative pheromones are particularly well developed from years of living with other athamarus.

5.name: Swimming Charge
5.description: You swim directly into a foe, attempting to push them out of the way.

5.name: Coral Growth
5.description: The difference between yourself and your coral symbiotes is nearly impossible to tell apart as your bodies are so intertwined.

5.name: Growing Eel Friend
5.description: Your eel pet grows larger and stronger.

5.name: Noxious Odor
5.description: You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form.

5.name: Riptide Mount
5.description: After working with aquatic beasts of burden for years, you have learned how to easily mount and dismount them.

5.name: Skilled Swimmer
5.description: You move through the water with ease, mastering your movements with years of practice.

9.name: Coerce the Current
9.description: With a flick of your tail, you direct the water around you to move creatures.

9.name: Sea Swarmer
9.description: You've learned how to hunt with others, whether above or below the surface.

9.name: Coral Detoxification
9.description: The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration.

9.name: Emissary Assistance
9.description: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements.

9.name: Moray Eel Mount
9.description: You have either trained a giant moray eel since its hatching or have tamed one in the wild.

9.name: Persistent Odor
9.description: Your pheromones now linger on creatures.

17.name: Form of the Sea
17.description: You can call upon sea waters to empower you.

17.name: Coral Lifeline
17.description: Your coral symbiotes have grown into your bloodstream and are now curled around your heart.

17.name: Moray Ambush
17.description: Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding.

17.name: Offensive Odor
17.description: You've mastered your defensive pheromones and have nearly complete control over them.

13.name: Attuned Electroreceptors
13.description: You grow specialized organs that allow you to detect even the faintest of heartbeats.

13.name: Coral Reserve
13.description: Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed.

13.name: Rapid Pheromone Recovery
13.description: Your supply of pheromones replenish very quickly.

13.name: Swift Eel Mount
13.description: Your rapport with your eel lets you guide it to avoid dangers as it swims.

1.name: Appraiser's Eye
1.description: You have experience handling and evaluating magical items, which are common in merfolk society.

1.name: Spray Ink
1.description: Your body provides you with natural defenses common to other creatures of the sea.

1.name: Merfolk Lore
1.description: You paid close attention to your lessons in school.

1.name: Merfolk Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea.

1.name: Ocean's Bite
1.prerequisite: Abyssal Merfolk heritage or Carcharodon Merfolk heritage
1.description: Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles.

1.name: Seasong
1.description: Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices.

1.name: Swimmer's Guidance
1.description: You're always ready to help those floundering in the water.

1.name: Wave Speaker
1.description: Being part fish yourself, you can speak the language of the sea.

5.name: Steal for the Depths
5.description: You reach out and grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface.

5.name: Apprentice Sea Witch
5.description: You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know.

5.name: Fishblooded
5.description: There's nothing beneath the waves that can slow you down.

5.name: Healing Flesh
5.description: Some legends claim that the flesh of a merfolk, if consumed, can grant health, longevity, and even immortality.

5.name: Strong Tail
5.description: From sheer necessity, you've gotten surprisingly good at moving around on land.

9.name: Hallucinogenic Ink
9.description: Your defensive ink spray has developed the capacity to cause haunting hallucinations.

9.name: Ill Tide
9.description: Some land dwellers say that merfolk are bad luck.

9.name: Shore Gift
9.description: Using old magic, you slip off your tail like an item of clothing and walk on two feet, resembling a humanoid ancestry, usually human but possibly elf, half-elf, or something stranger.

9.name: Siren Song
9.description: You can beguile and bewitch with your song.

9.name: Tears of Pearl
9.description: You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them.

17.name: Songs of the Sea's Wrath
17.description: You have learned songs that overwhelm and curse your foes.

17.name: Doom of Sailors
17.description: Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again.

17.name: Kraken's Call
17.description: You call forth the sleeping krakens of the deep to crush your enemies.

13.name: Pummeling Whirlpool
13.description: You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes.

13.name: Sea Witch
13.description: You've studied the waves, and they obey your will as extensions of your own fin.

1.name: Dig Quickly
1.description: Your hands work as effectively as shovels when you need to dig a quick hole.

1.name: Esteemed Visitor
1.description: Your polite manners and natural ability to comfort others make it easy for you to break down cultural barriers and earn strangers' trust.

1.name: Handy with Your Paws
1.description: You can easily craft objects.

1.name: Improvisational Defender
1.description: You are always prepared for fights that frequently disrupt seemingly peaceful times.

1.name: Scamper Underfoot
1.description: You are used to ducking under foes and can scurry around the battlefield with ease.

1.name: Shoony Lore
1.description: Growing up in shoony society, you learned the value of honesty, friendship, and hard work, even during trying times.

5.name: Loyal Empath
5.description: You have incredible empathy for your friends and family, and you have an innate timing for helping others in distress.

5.name: Practiced Paddler
5.description: You're skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony.

5.name: Tough Tumbler
5.description: You've taken your share of licks while scurrying around the battlefield and know how to defend yourself against opportunistic attackers.

9.name: Improvisational Warrior
9.description: You have increased skill with improvised weapons.

9.name: Sodbuster
9.description: Years toiling in soil have made you an expert digger.

13.name: Steadfast Ally
13.description: Your presence alone is enough to provide your allies with emotional support.

13.name: Unrivaled Builder
13.description: Building things is like solving a puzzle, and you know how to use anything at your disposal to get the job done.

1.name: Ancestral Insight
1.description: You have extensive knowledge of your ancestors' ancient origins.

1.name: Hydraulic Deflection
1.description: Drawing moisture from the atmosphere, you create a disc of hovering water that deflects attacks.

1.name: Pelagic Aptitude
1.description: You've learned special tricks to survive underwater.

1.name: Striking Retribution
1.description: You have an appropriately intense hatred for alghollthus.

1.name: Alghollthu Bound
1.description: Although you may not even be aware, the alghollthus your ancestors once served maintain a stranglehold on the deepest, tethered parts of your mind.

1.name: Azarketi Lore
1.description: You have learned the history and origins of your people and how to connect to both your land and sea heritage.

1.name: Azarketi Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You are familiar with weapons that excel underwater.

1.name: Cynical
1.description: You've been approached with suspicion and distrust throughout your life and return these sentiments back to the strangers you encounter.

1.name: Perfect Dive
1.description: You dive into the water with exceptional skill and connection to the waves, urging the water itself to cushion your fall.

1.name: Surface Skimmer
1.description: By sinking gently beneath the waves, you obscure your presence and utilize the water as a barrier between you and land combatants.

5.name: Aquatic Conversationalist
5.description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals with the amphibious or aquatic traits.

5.name: Marine Ally
5.description: You've befriended a sea creature, which becomes magically bonded to you.

5.name: Water Conjuration
5.description: You carry the ocean with you wherever you go.

5.name: Azarketi Weapon Aptitude
5.description: You become familiar with using your weapons both in and out of water.

5.name: Drag Down
5.description: While swimming in water at least 10 feet deep, you grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface.

9.name: Azarketi Purification
9.description: You can cast purify food and drink as a primal innate spell, but only on liquids.

9.name: Water Dancer
9.description: You glide through the water with graceful ease.

9.name: Water Strider
9.description: Water cradles your every step, allowing you to walk on its surface.

9.name: Aboleth Transmutation
9.description: You have tapped into the ancient magic used by alghollthu masters to mold the flesh of your ancestors.

9.name: Replenishing Hydration
9.description: You draw life from the water around you.

13.name: Aquatic Adaptation
13.description: If you and up to four other creatures are in contact with a body of water deep enough for you to fully submerge, you can spend 10 minutes adapting the creatures to that specific body of water.

13.name: Aquatic Camouflage
13.description: You blend into the waves.

13.name: Hydraulic Maneuvers
13.description: You batter your foes with a torrent of water siphoned from your surroundings.

13.name: Mist Strider
13.description: You condense the moisture in the air, solidifying it so it can hold your weight.

13.name: Rehydration
13.description: You surround your body with a thin layer of water drawn from the moisture in the air.

13.name: Azarketi Weapon Expertise
13.description: Your mastery with weapons both above and below water is unmatched.

17.name: Underwater Volcano
17.description: You can cast volcanic eruption as a 7th-level primal innate spell once per day.

1.name: Android Lore
1.description: You have a keen interest in the origins of your people.

1.name: Cleansing Subroutine
1.description: Your nanites help purge your body of harmful chemicals and toxins.

1.name: Emotionless
1.description: Your malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions.

1.name: Internal Compartment
1.description: You can hide a small object of up to light Bulk inside a hollow cavity on one of your forearms.

1.name: Nanite Surge
1.description: You stimulate your nanites, forcing your body to temporarily increase its efficiency.

1.name: Nightvision Adaptation
1.description: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark.

1.name: Proximity Alert
1.description: You're unnaturally in tune with your surroundings and react instinctively to danger.

1.name: Radiant Circuitry
1.description: Your biological circuitry emits light like a torch, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

5.name: Advanced Targeting System
5.description: Your ocular processors are augmented with advanced targeting systems, which allow you to more easily pinpoint your enemy and read their movements.

5.name: Inoculation Subroutine
5.description: Your nanites reject diseases with ease.

5.name: Nanite Shroud
5.description: Your nanites fly out of your body, swarming around you in a cloud.

5.name: Protective Subroutine
5.description: Your nanites can augment your defenses.

9.name: Internal Respirator
9.description: Your body can internally synthesize oxygen for limited periods of time.

9.name: Offensive Subroutine
9.description: Nanites augment your attacks.

9.name: Repair Module
9.description: You trigger your body's repair programming, causing your body's nanites to heal your wounds.

13.name: Consistent Surge
13.description: Your nanites are incredibly effective, capable of improving your body's efficiency regularly.

13.name: Revivification Protocol
13.description: Your nanites are programmed to automatically revive you.

1.name: Fetchling Lore
1.description: You've learned obscure lessons about your fellow fetchlings.

1.name: Hard to Fool
1.description: You're accustomed to seeing through shifting darkness and bewildering magic.

1.name: Shadow Blending
1.description: You draw shadows close to create a shroud.

1.name: Shrouded Magic
1.description: Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list.

1.name: Shrouded Mien
1.description: You're used to dealing with dangerous situations and sinister creatures.

1.name: Slink
1.description: You can move through gloom with the speed of darkness.

5.name: Clever Shadow
5.description: You can perform simple Interact actions with your shadow, such as opening an unlocked door.

5.name: Extinguish Light
5.description: You wrap shadow around a single unattended light source within 120 feet that's no larger than a torch.

5.name: Lightless Litheness
5.description: Your body is almost as flexible as your shadow.

5.name: Shadowy Disguise
5.description: You wrap yourself in shadow to change your appearance.

9.name: Hefting Shadow
9.description: Your shadow can contain objects.

9.name: Sculpt Shadows
9.description: You coax nearby shadows into the shape of a simple weapon or a simple tool or item, using a tiny piece of your shadow to make it solid; in doing so, you lose 1 Hit Point.

9.name: Shadow Sight
9.description: You draw on your connection with the Shadow Plane to see through all but the deepest darkness.

13.name: Shadow's Assault
13.description: Your shadow assaults your foes.

13.name: Skirt the Light
13.description: You can travel the border between the Material and Shadow Planes and even bring others along.

17.name: Pierce the Light
17.description: You tear the veil between the Material Plane and its shadow.

1.name: Aberration Kinship
1.description: Your mind resonates with the inscrutable thought processes that inhuman aberrations use to communicate.

1.name: Deepvision
1.description: Your vision is suited for night or the underground.

1.name: Living Weapon
1.description: You've learned to use part of your form as a weapon.

1.name: Startling Appearance (Fleshwarp)
1.description: Your appearance is enough to frighten without words.

1.name: Embodied Legionary Subjectivity
1.description: Nex's Fleshforges shaped you not to achieve individual greatness at arms, but rather to become a part of a legion, a modular piece integral to the combined arms stratagems of Nexian battlemages.

5.name: Finned Ridges
5.description: The ridges and flaps of your skin steer you through the water.

5.name: Gaping Flesh
5.description: Your wound yawns open, appalling your attacker.

5.name: Mutate Weapon
5.description: deal more damage with your Living Weapon.

5.name: Powerful Guts
5.description: Your stomach is particularly durable.

5.name: Uncanny Awareness
5.description: You have a keen sense of movement around you.

5.name: Embodied Dreadnought Subjectivity
5.description: Your colossal might marks you as a behemoth, the pride of Nex's Fleshforges, and the heaviest ordnance is a child's toy in your monumental grasp.

5.name: Transposable Compliance
5.description: Your protean vitality is fecund and many-succoring: your veins run with life-giving ichor that adapts to the blood and physiology of any body, and your skin molts on command, creating wound-stanching sheaths of tissue for yourself and others.

9.name: Captivating Curiosity
9.description: You can snare the attentions of onlookers with your unique appearance.

9.name: Coating of Slime
9.description: An acidic ooze coats your limbs.

9.name: Eerie Compression
9.description: Your limbs and even your torso can collapse in on themselves, allowing you to fit through tight spaces as though you were a Small creature.

9.name: Gripping Limbs
9.description: Nodules, hooks, or claws on your limbs allow you to cling to surfaces with ease.

9.name: Slip the Grasp
9.description: You have some feature that allows you to quickly evade effects that restrain you.

9.name: Embodied Dragoon Subjectivity
9.description: When your allies call for swift reinforcements or lightning raids, you're ready to answer.

13.name: Augment Senses
13.description: You open vestigial eyes, unfurl tympanic flaps of skin, or otherwise enhance your senses.

13.name: Spew Tentacles
13.description: You can open your mouth to an immense size and spew forth an impossibly large field of tentacles.

1.name: Foxfire
1.description: A crack of your tail sparks wisps of blue energy.

1.name: Kitsune Lore
1.description: You excel at navigating social situations and keeping secrets.

1.name: Kitsune Spell Familiarity
1.description: You've picked up a few magical tricks.

1.name: Retractable Claws
1.description: You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage.

1.name: Shapechanger's Intuition
1.description: A lifetime of experience helps you see through disguises.

1.name: Star Orb
1.description: Your magic has crystallized into a spherical stone.

1.name: Seven Changes Performance
1.description: While kitsune are known for their magical illusion powers, you're skilled at stage magic, especially costuming and quick changes.

5.name: Hybrid Form
5.description: When you Change Shape, you retain elements of your kitsune form, allowing you to speak in a fox form, use kitsune unarmed attacks in a tailless form, or gain a tail in your tailless form to use abilities that require one.

5.name: Kitsune Spell Mysteries
5.prerequisite: at least one innate spell from a kitsune heritage or ancestry feat
5.description: You know more kitsune magic.

5.name: Myriad Forms
5.description: With a bit of self-discovery, you find a new form.

5.name: Shifting Faces
5.description: You wear many faces, even those that don't belong to you.

5.name: Rekindled Light
5.description: You temporarily drain your star orb familiar's energy to save an ally.

5.name: Vulpine Scamper
5.description: You're especially nimble while in your full fox shape.

9.name: Fox Trick
9.description: You always have time for a joke or prank.

9.name: Fox Arson
9.description: When you critically hit with a foxfire Strike, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent damage of the same type as the foxfire.

13.name: Killing Stone
13.description: Your star orb hides a deadly miasma.

13.name: Kitsune Spell Expertise
13.description: Your tails show your magical mastery.

13.name: Larger than Life (Kitsune)
13.description: When you Change Shape, you can assume the form of a creature that's Large or Huge in size.

17.name: Rampaging Form
17.prerequisite: Change Shape with a fox alternate form
17.description: Once per day, when you Change Shape into a fox, you can instead gain the effects of both the canine form of 5th-level animal form and 7th-level fiery body for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first.

17.name: Fox Possession
17.description: You can project a spiritual form to possess another.

1.name: Corgi Mount
1.description: The smallest of fey have ridden corgis as mounts since time immemorial, leading to a pattern on corgis' backs called a "faerie saddle.

1.name: Evanescent Wings
1.description: You've manifested wings that can flutter for brief spurts.

1.name: Fey Cantrips
1.description: You've learned the cantrips sprites have used since time immemorial.

1.name: Speak with Bats
1.description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with bats.

1.name: Sprite's Spark
1.description: You can fling a portion of your magic at foes.

1.name: Charmed Sleep
1.description: When you sleep, you turn into an inanimate object a little smaller than a human's thumb—easily overlooked and carried.

5.name: Animal Speaker
5.prerequisite: ability to communicate with some type of animals (such as bats or arthropods)
5.description: You can speak to all animals, not just a particular subset.

5.name: Catchy Tune
5.description: You create a tune so catchy, your foes can't help but dance along.

5.name: Fey Disguise
5.description: You can disguise yourself with magical illusions.

5.name: Energize Wings
5.description: You stoke your magic to energize your wings, temporarily transforming them into glowing, majestic forms.

5.name: Speak with the Sleeping
5.description: You can speak to all inanimate objects and the slumbering spirits within them.

5.name: Elemental Spark
5.description: You've learned to alter the magic of your sprite's spark, imparting them with elemental energies.

9.name: Fey Magic
9.description: You can use faerie magic to hide yourself and expose hidden foes.

9.name: Hero's Wings
9.description: You have begun the final steps to reaching your full potential.

13.name: Fey Skin
13.description: While you are more susceptible to cold iron than most of the Wingless, you also have an incredible resilience and a deeper connection to the healing energies of the First World.

13.name: Invisible Trickster
13.description: You have learned how to become invisible and remain so.

17.name: Along the Deep River
17.description: Once per year, when you die, you turn into an immaterial ball of light.

1.name: Story Crooner
1.description: You're a talented story weaver and use your voice effectively.

1.name: Strix Defender
1.description: Your ancestral feud with humans gives you experience dealing with vicious foes, and your vengeance knows no bounds.

1.name: Strix Lore
1.description: You're well connected to your tribe and perhaps even strix communities beyond your own, where you've learned about the land and techniques of graceful movement.

1.name: Fledgling Flight
1.description: You can fly through the air in short bursts at half your land Speed.

5.name: Feathered Cloak
5.description: To blend in with the grounded and wingless, you fold your wings just so on your back, creating the illusion of a feathered cloak.

5.name: Strix Vengeance
5.description: You dedicate yourself to destroying those who harm your kin.

5.name: Thrown Voice
5.description: You've learned how to throw your voice through the winds, tricking others as to your location.

5.name: Juvenile Flight
5.description: You unfold your wings for travel and can keep them unfolded for 10 minutes.

9.name: Ferocious Gust
9.description: With heavy wing beats, you whip up a furious gust and direct it at your opponents.

9.name: Rokoan Arts
9.description: Ancestral spirits have begun to bond themselves to you, granting you powers characteristic of a rokoa.

9.name: Wing Step
9.description: With a sharp flap of your wings, you stay light on your feet as you move.

9.name: Fully Flighted
9.description: You gain the effects of Juvenile Flight at all times, rather than just once per day for 10 minutes.

13.name: Ancestor's Transformation
13.description: You can commune with ancestor spirits to assume the form of an enormous primeval strix.

1.name: Anadi Lore
1.description: You've learned how to provide for your community, be it through hard-earned sustenance or useful crafts.

1.name: Reassuring Presence
1.description: You serve as an anchor to your close companions, calming them in times of stress.

1.name: Skittertalk
1.description: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with spiders and other arachnids.

1.name: Studious Magic
1.description: You've taken an interest in anadi arcane traditions.

1.name: Web Walker
1.description: You have plenty of practice navigating webs.

1.name: Web Weaver
1.description: You can produce a soft silk to weave into useful items.

5.name: Friendform
5.description: The shared bond between you and your allies allows you to act on their behalf.

5.name: Hunter's Fangs
5.description: Your fangs are exceptionally painful.

5.name: Hybrid Shape
5.description: Mastery of your shapeshifting lets you combine the best features of your humanoid and spider forms.

9.name: Disorienting Venom
9.description: The venom injected by your fangs disorients your foes.

9.name: Strand Strider
9.description: Your eight legs serve you well when climbing walls and webs alike.

9.name: Studious Adept
9.description: You achieve a breakthrough in your exploration of magic.

9.name: Web Hunter
9.description: Through the careful cultivation of highly sensitive hairs, you've developed the ability to sense creatures without seeing them.

13.name: Webslinger
13.description: Your natural ability to create silken webs blends with your magical powers, allowing you to create impossibly large webs with great frequency.

1.name: Ceremony of Protection
1.description: You manipulate your exoskeleton to overlap itself.

1.name: Ceremony of the Evened Hand
1.description: You have cultivated your exoskeleton's form for close combat, using knots, whorls, and reinforced branches.

1.name: Conrasu Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You have taken it upon yourself to learn the ways of combat to aid with your tasks, perhaps in a role as a corrector.

1.name: Conrasu Lore
1.description: You have learned about your history and your people from shapers.

1.name: Caustic Nectar
1.description: You have specialized glands inside your throat, which produce acidic nectar that you can spit long distances.

1.name: Wilderness Born
1.description: You're at home in the wilderness and easily disappear into it.

5.name: Ceremony of Knowledge
5.description: You tap into aeon knowledge.

5.name: Ceremony of Sunlight
5.description: You have learned how to master the power contained within sunlight, just like the trees that form your body.

5.name: Conrasu Weapon Understanding
5.description: You have come to know conrasu weapons as you know yourself.

5.name: Quick Root
5.description: You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing.

9.name: Ceremony of Aeon's Guidance
9.description: Your patron aeon has allowed you to call upon their gifts to serve their ends.

9.name: Ceremony of Aeon's Shield
9.description: Your patron aeon graced you with powers of protection.

9.name: Ceremony of Fortification
9.description: Your exoskeleton arranges itself into an optimal defensive shape.

9.name: Ceremony of the Strengthened Hand
9.description: Your exoskeleton's weapons are even more potent.

9.name: Grow Tool
9.description: You grow a simple tool from your own body, coaxing flowers, vines, roots, and wood to grow and sprout from your flesh into the desired shape.

9.name: Pollinate
9.description: As you're hit, you emit a dense cloud of pollen, obscuring you from sight.

13.name: Conrasu Weapon Expertise
13.description: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency for conrasu weapons.

13.name: Ceremony of Growth
13.description: You can alter your exoskeleton's size.

13.name: Unfettered Growth
13.description: By tapping into the limitless power of the Plane of Wood, you can experience sudden, dramatic growth for a short time.

17.name: Ceremony of Sun's Gift
17.description: Your connection to the sun has become an unbreakable bond.

17.name: Irresistible Bloom
17.description: You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible.

1.name: Catch the Details
1.description: You are quick at recognizing broad details about people and things around you.

1.name: Goloma Courage
1.description: The most important thing you've learned living with fear is how to overcome it.

1.name: Goloma Lore
1.description: You lived an insulated life focused on avoiding danger.

1.name: Pierce the Darkness
1.description: Your eyes have adapted to see in all circumstances, even without the assistance of light.

1.name: Watchful Gaze
1.description: You use your many eyes to look in all directions at once, making you extremely observant for a short period of time.

5.name: Ambush Awareness
5.description: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks attempted as initiative rolls.

5.name: Protective Claws
5.description: The chitin on your claws is so hard you can defend against attacks with them.

9.name: Constant Gaze
9.description: Your eyes keep a continual watch for dangers from all sides.

9.name: Defensive Instincts
9.description: Your body tenses up when surrounded, putting you on edge just enough to anticipate an attack.

13.name: Arcane Sight
13.prerequisite: ability to cast the _detect magic_ cantrip
13.description: You've trained yourself to constantly be on the lookout for magical effects, even when focusing on looking out for other things.

13.name: See the Unseen
13.description: You notice things that others can't see at all.

17.name: True Gaze
17.description: When you focus your eyes carefully, your gaze can pierce through all obfuscations, even magical ones.

1.name: Grippli Lore
1.description: You are well versed in grippli culture and tactics.

1.name: Grippli Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You've trained with weapons ideally suited to marshes and dense forests.

1.name: Nocturnal Grippli
1.description: You tend to do most of your hunting and work at night and have adapted to the requirements of nocturnal life.

5.name: Grippli Glide
5.description: You can use your webbed feet to guide your fall.

5.name: Grippli Weapon Innovator
5.description: You've learned devious ways to make the most of your grippli weapons.

13.name: Grippli Weapon Expertise
13.description: You fight with effortless expertise with grippli weapons.

1.name: Eidetic Ear
1.description: You have an amazing memory for sound.

1.name: Shisk Lore
1.description: You hoard knowledge like a dragon hoards gold.

1.name: Spelunker
1.description: Living underground, you have learned to find your way without landmarks or even solid ground.

1.name: Spine Stabber
1.description: The quills on your arms are particularly sharp and sturdy.

5.name: Bristle
5.description: You curl into a posture that splays out your bone spines.

5.name: Inured to the Heat
5.description: You have a love for extreme heat.

5.name: Renewing Quills
5.description: Your spines grow back much faster than other shisks.

9.name: Dig Up Secrets
9.description: You are an endless well of knowledge and can remember several vital pieces of information at once.

9.name: Piercing Quills
9.description: Your quills can dig particularly deep into the flesh of your opponents.

9.name: Quill Spray
9.prerequisite: Quillcoat Shisk heritage or quill unarmed attack
9.description: You can launch a mass of quills at opponents.

13.name: Delver
13.description: Subterranean life taught you to swim through the ground like water.

13.name: None Shall Know
13.description: Even magical means have a hard time prying information from you.

13.name: Secret Eyes
13.description: You can call forth an invisible eye to let you peek on secrets.

17.name: Fountain of Secrets
17.description: You constantly remember details about the world.

1.name: Harmless Doll
1.description: You look like nothing more than an ordinary toy, doll, or statuette, and you can fool others with your innocuous appearance.

1.name: Helpful Poppet
1.description: You're particularly skilled at helping others with a task.

1.name: Quadruped
1.description: You were crafted in a form with four legs rather than two.

1.name: Shiny Button Eyes
1.description: You've polished your eyes to reflect the smallest details in dimmest light.

1.name: Wash Out
1.description: Toxins seep out of your artificial body quickly.

1.name: Made for Combat
1.description: You can use your body as a deadly weapon.

1.name: Sudden Terror
1.description: You leverage your body's amorphous nature to spook others.

1.name: Minuscule Mentee
1.description: You've found a fellow poppet on the cusp of awakening and decided to help.

5.name: Cunning Tinker
5.description: Time spent tending to your own form has unlocked your ability to fix other things.

5.name: Histrionic Injury
5.description: You respond with a startled look, dramatic pratfall, or theatrical arm-flailing that stymies your attacker.

5.name: Nothing but Fluff
5.description: Your fluffy interior lacks specific organs and struts, with few weak spots to injure.

5.name: Sealed Poppet
5.description: You've reinforced your interior parts with sealant or other flame-retardant materials, protecting you from fire.

5.name: Spark of Independence
5.description: You touch a creature with the minion trait and share the heightened sense of autonomy you've discovered.

5.name: Swimming Poppet
5.description: Your fins, flippers, or other accessories assist with steering you through water.

5.name: Insulated Poppet
5.prerequisite: Tsukumogami Poppet heritage; you have a metal or ceramic body
5.description: You've used insulating wraps or special glazes to reduce your weakness to current and temperature.

5.name: No Hands, No Problems
5.description: After a lifetime of using temporary, ghostly limbs to manipulate objects, you hardly need real hands.

9.name: Scaling Poppet
9.description: Your construction integrates ropes, hooks, or other tools to help you move across steep surfaces.

9.name: Wheedle and Jig
9.description: You make capering motions and silly sounds to captivate onlookers.

9.name: Solidarity
9.description: You bestow some of your own life energies to mend damage.

13.name: Impossible Gossip
13.description: You can speak to inanimate objects, finding a magical spark within them similar to the one that animated you.

13.name: Reanimating Spark
13.description: The magic that animates you strains to keep you alive.

13.name: Squirm Free
13.description: You're used to slipping out of a bigger creature's grasp or escaping a child's overly enthusiastic hug.

13.name: Awaken the Obake
13.description: Not every tool is well cared for, and those that are treated badly might awaken as malevolent spirits.

17.name: Restitch
17.description: You've learned how to sew even the most terrible tears and wounds together.

17.name: Soaring Poppet
17.description: Your construction has flaps of cloth or wicker that can keep you aloft.

1.name: As in Life, So in Death
1.description: Specific memories of your old life are hard to hold onto, but you know things without remembering why.

1.name: Collapse
1.description: You collapse into a pile of bones, mitigating the worst of the damage you would have taken, and the triggering attack deals only the amount it would deal on a hit (typically full damage instead of double damage).

1.name: Play Dead
1.description: You lie prone and pretend to be an ordinary skeleton.

1.name: Undead Empathy
1.description: Your relationship with undeath gives you a stronger bond with other undead.

5.name: Past Life
5.description: Flashes of your life become clearer and more frequent, allowing you to apply skills you developed while alive.

5.name: Well-armed
5.description: Your detachable limbs offer flexibility.

9.name: Bone Missile
9.description: You can remove your ribs to use them as arrows or bolts.

9.name: Rejuvenation Token
9.description: You tie yourself to the Material Plane by implanting a piece of your consciousness into a weapon, piece of armor, or other item that's precious to you.

9.name: Skeletal Resistance
9.description: Your body becomes resistant, your hardened bones deflecting weapons and other forms of damage.

13.name: Skeletal Transformation
13.description: You rearrange your bones into a bestial shape.

13.name: Skeleton Commander
13.description: You gain the ability to summon your own skeletal minions.

17.name: Bone Swarm
17.description: You scatter your body and transform into a whirling storm of bones for up to 1 minute or until you spend a single action to return to your normal shape.

17.name: Necromantic Heir
17.description: Your affinity for negative energy spills outward and grants you a refilling well of necromantic essence.

1.name: Ancient Memories
1.description: In the long years since Ghorus's day, you've done pretty much everything at one time or another.

1.name: Flexible Form
1.description: Your body is as supple as a sapling, capable of bending without breaking.

1.name: Ghoran Lore
1.description: The very first memories ghorans have are those of their creation, and even after thousands of years, those memories have never faded for you.

1.name: Ghoran Weapon Familiarity
1.description: Over the course of your long, long existence, you've had a chance to practice with traditional ghoran weapons.

1.name: Hidden Thorn
1.description: Some flowers can hide their thorns, and yours happen to be hidden along your arms.

1.name: Caustic Nectar
1.description: You have specialized glands inside your throat, which produce acidic nectar that you can spit long distances.

1.name: Wilderness Born
1.description: You're at home in the wilderness and easily disappear into it.

5.name: Ghoran Weapon Practice
5.description: With plenty of practice, the memories of previous fights from previous lives come flooding back.

5.name: Murderous Thorns
5.prerequisite: Hidden Thorn or Thorned Rose heritage
5.description: Your thorns are many, vicious, and sharp.

5.name: Speak with Flowers
5.description: At your very heartwood, you're a flower animated by elder magic, and with a little effort, you can speak to your kindred.

5.name: Tree's Ward
5.description: You've lived among trees for so long they recognize your presence and seek to protect you from harm.

5.name: Quick Root
5.description: You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing.

9.name: Endless Memories
9.description: You've lived a thousand lives and done a hundred-thousand things.

9.name: Flower Magic
9.description: Certain magics in the world flow easily through your sap.

9.name: Perfume Cloud
9.description: You issue a cloud of your fragrance like a full-body sneeze—but one that might save your life as the powerful perfume makes your attackers' eyes sting and water.

9.name: Solar Rejuvenation (Ghoran)
9.description: The warmth and light of the sun gives you life.

9.name: Grow Tool
9.description: You grow a simple tool from your own body, coaxing flowers, vines, roots, and wood to grow and sprout from your flesh into the desired shape.

9.name: Pollinate
9.description: As you're hit, you emit a dense cloud of pollen, obscuring you from sight.

13.name: Eternal Memories
13.description: You have lived longer than most realize, and due to your many lifetimes of practice you remember almost everything from your previous incarnations now.

13.name: Ghoran Weapon Expertise
13.description: It's as if you've been training for a thousand years.

13.name: Look but Don't Touch
13.description: Many flowers are beautiful to look upon but deadly to touch—and you're one of them.

13.name: Violent Vines
13.description: When angered, you can imbue nearby vines with your wrath, provoking them into a murderous rampage.

13.name: Unfettered Growth
13.description: By tapping into the limitless power of the Plane of Wood, you can experience sudden, dramatic growth for a short time.

17.name: Ghoran's Wrath
17.description: You have such a strong connection to the natural world that you can inspire it to attack at those who threaten you.

17.name: Irresistible Bloom
17.description: You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible.

1.name: Community Knowledge
1.description: You commune with the psychic echoes of your ancestors and community, channeling their experiences into yourself.

1.name: Crystal Luminescence
1.description: Your horn glows with bioluminescent color, casting bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

1.name: Emotional Partitions
1.description: You have created strong mental partitions in your mind to filter out negative emotional influences.

1.name: Mental Sustenance
1.description: You can sustain yourself with the power of your mind.

1.name: Open Mind
1.description: You have inherent psychic abilities that allow you to tap into the power of your mind.

1.name: Puncturing Horn
1.description: While many kashrishi never use their horns for more than cracking open hard-shelled fruits or amplifying their psychic powers, you've practiced using yours offensively.

1.name: Scuttle Up
1.description: Your environment requires you to climb cave walls or tree trunks with great regularity.

1.name: Tough Skin
1.description: Your skin is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, and has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of 16, and the comfort trait.

5.name: Empathic Calm
5.description: Once per day, you can cast either calm emotions or sanctuary as an innate occult spell, heightened to half your level rounded up.

5.name: Fighting Horn
5.description: You can modify the size and shape of your horn over time using your mental powers.

5.name: Skilled Climber
5.description: You can navigate vertical surfaces with ease.

5.name: Unlock Secret
5.description: You delve deeper into your psychic potential.

5.name: Well of Potential
5.prerequisite: focus pool, at least one innate spell from a kashrishi heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at least one of your focus spells
5.description: Your mind is a deep well of psychic potential.

9.name: Fortified Mind
9.description: Your mind is unusually resilient and resistant to influence.

9.name: Telekinetic Slip
9.description: A thin shell of telekinetic energy pushes from your skin, widening your enemy's grasp enough for you to slip free.

9.name: Transcendent Realization
9.description: You've unleashed even more of your mind's limitless potential.

13.name: Kashrishi Revivification
13.description: The well of psychic energy held within your mind can exceed the limitations of your physical body.

13.name: Reimagine
13.description: You can cast dreaming potential as an innate occult spell.

17.name: Bend Space
17.description: Not even space itself is a match for the unleashed power of your mind.

17.name: Cleansing Light
17.description: A burst of light from your horn cleanses your allies of ailments and sends your foes reeling.

1.name: Cold Minded
1.description: The subtle strands of beguiling magic leave little impression on your mind.

1.name: Nagaji Lore
1.description: You're the vassal or apprentice of a learned naga, and you've studied the secrets of naga magic and concocting intricate poisons.

1.name: Nagaji Spell Familiarity
1.description: Either through study, exposure, or familial devotion, you have the magic of nagas bubbling in your blood.

1.name: Serpent's Tongue
1.description: You subconsciously flick your tongue through the air to taste the world around you.

1.name: Water Nagaji
1.description: Much like a water naga, you've formed a connection to a sacred or pristine body of water, either as a home or a place to protect.

1.name: It Takes a Village
1.description: Your community bond creates better dynamics when working together.

1.name: Nalinivati's Light
1.description: Your slit eyes expand to absorb light and can see in the darkest of places.

1.name: Throat Pocket
1.description: You've trained to use unique nagaji eating habits to your advantage.

5.name: Hypnotic Lure
5.description: Your unblinking gaze is so intense it can befuddle the mind of others, drawing your victims toward you even against their better judgment.

5.name: Nagaji Spell Mysteries
5.prerequisite: at least one innate spell from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat
5.description: You've learned more naga magic.

5.name: Skin Split
5.description: You claw open the top layer of your scales and peel off the premature shed in order to remove harmful substances from your skin.

5.name: Venom Spit
5.description: You've learned the art of lobbing toxic spittle at vulnerable spots on your foes, especially the eyes.

5.name: Metabolic Control
5.description: You're able to better control your body's metabolism to preserve energy.

5.name: Venom Gulp
5.description: You can store prepared venom in your throat and spit it at your foes in addition to your own toxic spray.

9.name: Envenom Strike
9.prerequisite: you possess a Strike from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat that deals poison damage
9.description: You spit venom onto a weapon you're holding or a weapon held by a willing creature within 30 feet; you can also use this ability to envenom your nagaji fangs unarmed attack.

9.name: Guarded Thoughts
9.description: Your mind, like a dark naga's, foils attempts to read your thoughts.

9.name: Serpentcoil Slam
9.description: Your people's ancient and storied rivalry with garudas led you to develop special techniques against flying foes.

9.name: Serpentine Swimmer
9.description: You undulate your body in a series of sinuous serpentine motions as you swim, drastically improving the speed at which you move through the water.

9.name: Hypnotic Gaze
9.description: You can widen your field of vision, allowing you to affect more creatures with your Hypnotic Lure.

13.name: Disruptive Stare
13.description: Your frigid gaze can turn a foe's blood to ice.

13.name: Nagaji Spell Expertise
13.description: Your magical skill rivals that of accomplished naga spellcasters.

13.name: Pit of Snakes
13.description: Mundane serpents obey your summons.

13.name: Synchronous Slither
13.description: You've learned to travel at your ally's rhythm and use their movement to adjust your own position.

17.name: Breath of Calamity
17.description: Your roar shakes the earth and splits the heavens.

17.name: Prismatic Scales
17.description: You can cause your scales to glow with scintillating, many-hued colors, protecting you from energy while dazzling foes.

17.name: Form of the Beloved Mother
17.description: You channel the blessings of Nalinivati to transform into a manifestation of her will.

1.name: Canopy Sight
1.description: You can see equally well even in dense jungles where only a small amount of light shines through.

1.name: Climbing Tail
1.description: Your tail makes it much easier for you to climb.

1.name: Sudden Mindfulness
1.description: Your mind retains full awareness despite the best attempts of others, and your focus throws others off-balance.

1.name: Vanara Lore
1.description: You attained the cultural training of a ba-sadhak, a seeker of treasures and rare delights.

1.name: Vanara Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You favor weapons steeped in vanaran tradition.

1.name: Whitecape
1.description: You're shorter and wider than many vanaras of your heritage, and the hair on your shoulders and your head is particularly thick and luxurious, like a majestic cape.

5.name: Darting Monkey
5.description: You have a heightened awareness in combat, and your darting strikes prevent your foes from distracting you or breaking your focus.

5.name: Jungle Runner
5.description: You run through the jungle as easily as you would through an open field.

5.name: Ragdya's Revelry
5.description: You dart away from your foe's attack with a casual laugh, using the opening to cause mischief.

5.name: Skillful Climber
5.description: You can scamper up or down surfaces as nimbly as a monkey.

5.name: Tail Snatch
5.description: You can whip your tail around to lash items from the unwary's grip.

5.name: Vanara Weapon Trickery
5.description: You've learned how to trick your foes using vanara weapons.

9.name: Dangle (Vanara)
9.description: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

9.name: Legendary Size
9.description: The vanaras of old were tricksters able to step across wide rivers or slip into impossibly small spaces.

9.name: Ragdya's Dance
9.description: Even when faced with deadly danger, you fight with the rapturous laughter of Ragdya in your heart and can play impossible tricks.

9.name: Rakshasa Ravaged
9.description: You and your family know well the ravages of rakshasa predations, and you know how to best defend yourself against their growing corruption in the world.

13.name: Monkey Spirits
13.description: Vanaras generally consider the spirits of departed monkeys to be less informative or interesting than their own ancestors traveling the cycles of existence, yet these monkey spirits can prove useful when the situation is dire.

13.name: Unbound Freedom
13.description: Your future is no other person's to control, and the cycles of your fate sometimes step in to protect you when that control would be taken from you.

13.name: Vanara Battle Clarity
13.description: Your focus in combat is practically unshakable.

13.name: Vanara Weapon Expertise
13.description: Thanks to numerous joyous practice exercises, you've become an expert in vanara weapons.

17.name: Unfettering Prankster
17.description: You can uplift all around you with your pranks, causing you and your allies to receive divine guidance in all your movements to effortlessly avoid environmental hindrances.

1.name: Alabaster Eyes
1.description: In place of the normal vishkanyan golden eyes, you were born with especially perceptive snow-white eyes.

1.name: Lesser Enhance Venom
1.description: Your venom grows deadlier and more plentiful.

1.name: Social Camouflage
1.description: You have the uncanny ability to quickly blend into the lifestyle of whatever settlement in which you find yourself.

1.name: Vishkanya Lore
1.description: You deeply understand vishkanyan strengths and cultural traditions.

1.name: Vishkanya Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You favor weapons historically used in subtle work and in ceremony.

5.name: Debilitating Venom
5.description: Your venom is particularly potent, affecting targets in different ways.

5.name: Restoring Blood
5.description: Your body can process an alternative to your venom that heals wounds.

5.name: Vishkanya Weapon Arts
5.description: You are graceful and efficient in the use of vishkanyan weapons.

9.name: Alluring Performance
9.description: You command the attention of those around you with an elegant display.

9.name: Moderate Enhance Venom
9.description: You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with Envenom to moderate vishkanyan venom.

9.name: Swift Application
9.description: You expertly combine the motions of attacking and coating your weapon with venom.

9.name: Viper Strike
9.description: You move and attack with a swiftness that most can't follow.

13.name: Stronger Debilitating Venom
13.description: Add one of the following to the debilitations from which you can choose when you Envenom.

13.name: Venom Purge
13.description: You produce a specialized venom that burns out other toxins and impurities in your body.

13.name: Vishkanya Weapon Expertise
13.description: Extensive training has granted you an elegant control in the use of vishkanyan weapons.

17.name: Greater Enhance Venom
17.description: You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with Envenom to greater vishkanyan venom.

17.name: Vicious Venom
17.description: The venom you produce is exceptionally potent and difficult to overcome.

1.name: Awakened Animal Lore
1.description: You have taken the time to learn about the process of awakening and the experiences of your fellow awakened animals.

1.name: Awakened Magic
1.description: When you awakened, primal magic was released within you.

1.name: Fascinated by Society
1.description: Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough.

1.name: Land Legs
1.description: You are comfortable on land for a short time.

1.name: Learn by Watching
1.description: Before your awakening, you watched humanoids performing some skill near you frequently.

1.name: Natural Senses
1.description: You have retained your sharp animal senses even after awakening.

1.name: Sea Legs
1.prerequisite: You don't have a swim Speed.
1.description: You are comfortable on the water for short bursts.

1.name: Take Flight
1.description: Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you.

1.name: Tooth and Claw
1.description: You've become adept with your born weapons.

1.name: You're So Cute!
1.description: You know how to put on the charm, doing playful tricks to win favor.

5.name: Fierce Grasp
5.description: Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away.

5.name: Late Awakener
5.description: Whether due to a more gradual process or your animal and sapient sides being especially in conflict, your awakening was a little slower than most, but your eyes are now fully open and your abilities have returned.

5.name: Natural Ambassador
5.description: You remember what it was like to speak easily with other animals, using old, familiar ways of communication to learn what they want and ask for favors in return.

5.name: Scurry!
5.description: Your instincts to move to safety are strong.

5.name: Strong of Wing
5.description: You can fly with a greater distance.

5.name: Urban Jungle
5.prerequisite: Fascinated by Society; Expert in Society or Expert in Survival
5.description: Cities are just a new form of wilderness.

5.name: Wild Stride
5.description: You can move quickly when using your preferred modes of travel.

9.name: Animal Summoner
9.description: The connection between you and primal magic deepens.

9.name: Full Flight
9.description: Your flight is unbound, as natural as it was before you were awakened.

13.name: Awaken Others
13.description: You can awaken others just through contact and communication.

13.name: Digger
13.prerequisite: Climbing Animal heritage or Running Animal heritage
13.description: You are used to building homes and defenses underground.

13.name: Sharpened Senses
13.description: Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously.

17.name: Awakened Stride
17.description: You blend your instinct and intellect to move so fast you seem to be a blur.

17.name: Fearsome Form
17.description: A fearsome illusion covers you, evoking the terror of the most dangerous animals.

17.name: True Senses
17.description: Your senses are so sharp they pierce through all illusions.

1.name: Centaur Lore
1.description: You've learned how to nurture your environment and to care for your people.

1.name: Centaur Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster.

1.name: Practiced Brawn
1.description: You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor.

1.name: Skilled Herbalist
1.description: You've been taught how to craft healing remedies with a variety of herbs and plants.

1.name: Steelhoof
1.description: You've girded your hooves in steel or other reinforcements aimed to inflict maximum damage.

5.name: Accommodating Mount
5.description: You've trained to serve as a mount, if only for your most trusted allies.

5.name: Distant Archer
5.description: You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target.

5.name: Proud Mentor
5.description: You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments.

5.name: Speaker in Training
5.prerequisite: Budding Speaker Centaur heritage or the ability to cast a divine or primal spell
5.description: You've begun your training as a Speaker.

9.name: Herbal Forager
9.description: Your skill with herbs has improved.

9.name: Fierce Competitor
9.description: You challenge a single ally to a physical competition.

9.name: Mentor of Legends
9.description: You're an extraordinary teacher, capable of inspiring your students to amazing feats of athletics and ingenuity.

9.name: Ride On
9.description: Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance.

9.name: Speaker's Defense
9.prerequisite: Budding Speaker Centaur heritage or Speaker in Training
9.description: As a Speaker, you've forged a deep bond with powerful spirits who you can urge to rise up to defend you and your people.

9.name: Stubborn Defiance
9.description: You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another.

13.name: Camoflage Coat
13.description: You've learned to use your natural camouflage to your advantage, enhancing your ability to blend with your surroundings through careful movements and additional markings or attire.

13.name: Incredible Sprint
13.description: You push yourself, unleashing a burst of sudden speed.

13.name: Miraculous Medic
13.description: Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death.

13.name: Trample (Centaur)
13.description: You've trained to stampede right over smaller foes without causing yourself any harm.

17.name: Merge with the Source
17.prerequisite: Speaker in Training or Budding Speaker Centaur heritage
17.description: You're among the most powerful of Speakers and can adopt the form of the spirits you entreat with.

17.name: Starshot Arrow
17.description: The greatest centaurs need not wait until their stories are over to touch the stars in the sky.

1.name: Artisanal Crafter
1.description: Like many minotaurs, you take pride in creating items made from stone or metal.

1.name: Cattle Speech
1.description: You can understand the lowing of cattle and similar animals as its own language.

1.name: Eye for Masonry
1.description: Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework.

1.name: Friendly Nudge
1.description: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself.

1.name: Keen Nose
1.description: Accustomed to the foul air of underground tunnels, your sense of smell is sharpened, and noxious scents are less offensive.

1.name: Minotaur Lore
1.description: You were raised in a minotaur enclave or have spent a great deal of time studying your culture and ancestry.

1.name: Minotaur Weapon Familiarity
1.description: Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields.

1.name: Pantheon Magic
1.description: The touch of divine meddling still runs through you, whether you want it or not.

5.name: Alarming Disappearance
5.description: Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies.

5.name: Beast of Burden
5.description: Your broad frame can allow you to carry weights that immobilize smaller creatures.

5.name: Labyrinthine Echoes
5.description: You can make your voice reverberate off any surface.

5.name: Natural Orienteering
5.description: There are few twisting paths that can disorient you.

5.name: Puzzle Solver
5.description: You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown.

5.name: Stretching Reach
5.description: You can leverage your size and muscle to extend your reach and attack more distant foes.

9.name: Friendly Fling
9.description: You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield.

9.name: Goring Charge
9.description: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes.

9.name: Siphon Torment
9.description: Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others.

9.name: Stone Passage
9.description: Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through.

13.name: Phantom Charm
13.description: You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate.

13.name: Shift the Little Ones
13.description: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends.

13.name: Threatening Pursuit
13.prerequisite: Expert in Intimidation; Expert in Stealth
13.description: You emit a terrifying growl and snort, stamping your hooves for all to hear so that they know that you hunt them.

17.name: Begin Stampede
17.description: The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow.

17.name: Into the Labyrinth
17.description: Calling on your connection to minotaurs of myth, you shunt an enemy into a complex maze full of puzzles of your own devising.

1.name: Sequestered Spell
1.description: You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct.

1.name: Small Speak
1.description: You understand the languages of most small insects and can speak to them.

1.name: Surki Lore
1.description: Either through the tales of elders in your settlement or through the messages thumped by those who oversaw your generation dig, you hold the knowledge of many surkis before you.

1.name: Surki Weapon Familiarity
1.description: Surki weapons favor utility and practicality over grace and brutality.

1.name: Vestigial Magicsense
1.description: While most surkis' ability to taste magic fades once they metamorphose into their adult form—replaced by keener darkvision—you've retained some of this sense.

5.name: Chemical Trail
5.description: You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate.

5.name: Secondary Adaptation
5.description: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult.

5.name: Tunnel Roll
5.description: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball.

9.name: Consume Magic
9.description: You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion.

9.name: Grand Metamorphosis
9.description: One of your nodes has adapted into a new magic-emitting organ.

9.name: Nodal Healing
9.description: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body.

13.name: Generation Digger
13.description: You're so adept at burrowing through the earth that you don't even need tools; in fact, you just might be trusted to lead the latest generation dig.

13.name: Magitaxis
13.description: You move reflexively toward the source of magic you most consumed as a larva.

17.name: Unlimited Pluripotency
17.description: Within all surkis is the capacity to be whatever they need to be, and you can tap into that capacity even now.

17.name: Nodal Regeneration
17.description: Your body processes magic so effectively that you can induce true regeneration, replacing limbs and restoring organs.

5.name: Nourishing Symbiosis
5.description: As you recuperate from your wounds, life energy flows from you to the land and back to you again.

5.name: Colugo's Traversal
5.description: Forbidding valleys and sheer cliffs can't curb your vows to reunite the lost.

5.name: Stem the Tide
5.description: You can cast protector tree as a 1st-rank primal innate spell once per day.

5.name: Withstand the Storm
5.description: Your skin hardens like bark and gains the sheen of glazed clay, lessening the wild's ruinous sting against your body.

9.name: Witness of Earth
9.description: The primal magic in your soul offers the patient earth's timeless counsel.

9.name: Abjure the False Kin
9.description: Your vow reminds you that there can be brackish vinegar hiding within honeyed words, helping you detect attempts to influence your mind.

9.name: Fiend-trampling Stature
9.description: Fiends unfortunate enough to be trampled beneath your feet or rent within your grasp are swiftly granulated into bone kindling and blood powder, and the pain of your strikes prevents them from action.

9.name: Four-armed Aspect
9.description: You intone vows to shoulder others' pains; in response, your torso sprouts an additional pair of arms to help you bear those burdens.

9.name: Horn and Bone Incantation
9.description: You invoke mantras of tellurian rebirth.

9.name: World-protector's Hospitality
9.description: Through your spiritual power, you impede starvation and restore pantries.

1.name: Ash-piercing Gaze
1.description: Neither cinders nor winds shall prevent you from seeing those who need help.

1.name: Avowed Insight
1.prerequisite: Yaksha heritage with an edict that requires you to confront a certain type of creature.
1.description: You become trained in the Lore skill corresponding to one creature type mentioned by your vow (for example, Fey Lore if your heritage is deny the firstborn pursuit).

1.name: Bamboo and Silt Repose
1.description: At home among mire and copse, you flit from river to tree with a dragonfly's shimmering grace.

1.name: Howling Aspect
1.description: Pulling your hair loose into flames and gnashing your teeth into ragged fangs, you howl a vow of ire, and your form surges to meet the demands of your deadly promise.

1.name: Meticulous Restorer
1.description: Waste not, want not; your steady eye allows you to restore craftwork quickly while conserving valuable material.

1.name: Sage of Scattered Leaves
1.description: The epics of your people's tragic yet proud history blaze like burning leaves in the forests of ancestral memory.

1.name: Tangle-tongue's Wit
1.description: Your talent for language is a blessing from the yaksha makers of old.

1.name: Unwavering Guide
1.description: Sharp-eyed and sure-footed, your presence is a boon to those you guide.

13.name: Adamantine Mantra
13.description: You attain your true potential as a tutelary spirit.

13.name: Germination of Resolve
13.description: Vitality floods your trammeled soul, offering you rejuvenation, if not quite rest.

13.name: Wild-haired Fury
13.description: Your broken bones jut at odd angles, yet this pain only adds to your anger and prowess.

17.name: Strength of Eight Legions
17.description: You meditate for 24 hours in a one-time ceremony within a forest or cave; after your seclusion, your frame and limbs swell with warlike might to enact your vows.

17.name: Transcend the Azimuth
17.description: As the earth drinks the light of sun and moon, so does your steady vow imbibe superlunary forces, ready to be unleashed with a moment's mantra.

1.name: All This Will Happen Again
1.description: Even in the face of overwhelming tribulation, you find solace in the notion that this feeling is fleeting; all things are merely part of a never-ending cycle.

1.name: Elucidating Vision
1.description: Your eyes have seen many things in your past lives, and your sight seems to have grown more powerful over your lifetimes.

1.name: Innate Understanding
1.description: Vague connections to the knowledge and prowess of your past help guide you in tasks that this life might not understand.

1.name: Remnants of the Past
1.description: Memories of your first life are strong and continually return to you, even after several incarnations.

1.name: Samsaran Lore
1.description: You have untold ages of knowledge beneath your belt, focused on the pursuit of enlightenment.

1.name: Samsaran Weapon Memory
1.description: The training of your past lives and even of those of samsarans who came before is deep-seated and guides your movements in combat.

5.name: All This Has Happened Before
5.description: You instantly recall a memory from one of your countless past lives that heightens your awareness of your surroundings and quickens your response.

5.name: And Will Do So Once More
5.description: You've learned how to let go of most worries and move past them.

5.name: Blood Like Water
5.description: The watery fluid in your veins doesn't flow in the same way as traditional blood.

5.name: Thousand-Year Grudge
5.description: You can call upon your former lives and project all of your accumulated frustration, failure, and despair through your eyes at a target, overwhelming their senses.

9.name: I Will Return
9.description: Your special connection to death and rebirth allows you to sense when it's your time to enter the Great Beyond, and now isn't the time.

9.name: Life's Blood
9.description: Your journey to enlightenment has made your blood possess nigh-immortal properties, allowing you to heal others.

9.name: Memory of Skill
9.description: Your years of training in a previous life didn't go to waste with your death, and you can call upon this training when you most need it.

9.name: Secrets of the Past
9.description: You've established a stronger connection with your past selves and can play out the memories of your lifetimes in an instant, helping you draw on knowledge that lives deep within your mind.

13.name: Memory of Mastery
13.description: Flashes of past selves surface in an instant, especially when you're under duress.

13.name: Water to Water
13.description: You allow your body to collapse into water, then reconstitute your corporeal form elsewhere.

17.name: The Cycle Continues
17.description: Death is as natural as breathing to you, and you can move past it as easily as the other troubles in your life.

17.name: This Too Shall Pass
17.prerequisite: And Will Do So Once More
17.description: Mortal worries are such simple matters to you that you leave them behind almost as quickly as you experience them.

1.name: Awakened Jewel
1.description: You once held the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, and it awakened a mysterious power in your own.

1.name: Crown of Bone
1.description: When you came of age, you were blessed by the Mother Earth with a thickened skull, which was celebrated as an auspicious sign among your community.

1.name: Folk Healer
1.description: Your community recognizes you as a shaman or other animist, a status you obtained through lineage, apprenticeship, or a supernatural event.

1.name: Sarangay Lore
1.description: You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community.

1.name: Traveler's Counsel
1.description: On your travels, you've resolved countless disputes and counseled those in need.

5.name: Deflecting Jewel
5.description: You walk the line between two sides of something, such as belonging to two clans, having a mixed allegiance or faith, or being caught between two possible fates.

5.name: The Moon Weaver's Art
5.description: You've learned to create minor illusions by collecting strands of moonlight and weaving them together to create small images or cloaking veils.

5.name: Smoke Through Bamboo
5.description: You've spent significant time slipping silently between bamboo thickets, and your light-footedness allows you to navigate even the thickest forests and brush with ease.

5.name: Tikling Bird Twirl
5.description: You trained your footwork by dancing to music between snapping bamboo poles, and your increased mobility helps you succeed when hunting dangerous beasts or fighting multiple opponents.

5.name: Warding Jewel
5.description: A life of hunting and battle has caused your head gem to attune to the waxing moon, which has manifested in the power to protect you from harm.

9.name: Ancestral Healer
9.description: Following the traditions of those who came before you, you've learned how to banish effects that cloud the mind, body, and spirit.

9.name: Paralyzing Jewel
9.description: Your dedication to the ideals of art and beauty allows your head gem to access the power of the waning moon.

9.name: Spiritual Echo
9.description: You possess the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, which has begun to resonate with your own.

13.name: Light-bending Jewel
13.description: Your ability to walk unseen through the world has given you the new moon's blessing.

13.name: Rejuvenating Embrace
