13.description: You rejuvenate your spirit by taking your rest where Mother Earth embraces Father Moon.

13.name: Sheltering Jewel
13.description: Your head gem has accessed the power of the full moon through your determination to heal and protect your loved ones.

17.name: Convocation of Earth and Moon
17.description: You call upon Mother Earth and Father Moon to fill you with light.

17.name: Trample
17.description: You know how to leverage your size and momentum when using your horns attack, and can use your movement speed to overrun your foes.

1.name: Everyday Form
1.description: There's nothing better than being a tanuki, but sometimes you need a less conspicuous form when going into the big city or other crowded places.

1.name: Iron Belly
1.description: A good laugh comes from the belly, and by laughing every day, yours has grown quite strong.

1.name: Scorched on the Crackling Mountain
1.description: By ritualistically marking your fur with fire, like an infamous tanuki of legend, you protect yourself against future flames.

1.name: Tanuki Lore
1.description: Tanuki love to play two things: tricks and music.

1.name: Teakettle Form
1.description: Your shapeshifting is advanced enough to take the form of not just creatures, but objects as well.

5.name: False Priest Form
5.description: Nobody respects tanuki, but most everyone respects an esteemed priest, so what better form to take if you want to get by a little easier? When you Change Shape, you can assume the shape of a priest or other religious official from a religion of your choosing.

5.name: Hasty Celebration
5.description: After even the briefest success, you get caught up in the moment and begin to party, cheering your allies on.

5.name: Leaf Transformation
5.description: You know how to run an enterprise that others would never be able to get off the ground—some say it's your savvy acumen or jovial manner, but you know it's because you can cut costs by transforming leaves into money.

5.name: Ponpoko
5.description: No true tanuki would ever be caught without a musical instrument to play under the full moon.

5.name: Statue Form
5.description: An inconspicuous statue in front of a shop is the perfect form to wait for things to blow over.

9.name: Many Faces
9.description: Putting on a new face offers a great way to get a fresh perspective on life.

9.name: Mud Boat's Passage
9.description: You instinctively create magical boats that keep your feet dry (mostly).

9.name: Phantom Orchestra
9.description: An easy way to trick others is to throw your voice into a nearby forest or thicket to make strange noises.

9.name: Rolling White Bottle Form
9.description: As you fall to the ground, you transform into a white bottle, gourd, or sake jar, then roll away before anyone can pick you up.

13.name: Combined Form
13.description: Cooperation and coordination are the secrets to getting by in tanuki society.

13.name: Ponpoko-pon!
13.description: Whether it's because you play especially vigorously or are simply off-key, the music of your belly drum can physically wound your foes.

13.name: Splendid Illusion
13.description: You cover your surroundings in outlandish fantasy.

17.name: Landscape Form
17.description: While walking down the road on a moonlit night, one might be puzzled to find a shop or hill that wasn't there before.

17.name: Start the Festival!
17.description: No distance can stop tanuki from making their way to a good party.

1.name: Aegis of the Dissolution
1.description: You are a friend of shadows and know how to avoid the troubles they bring.

1.name: Dance of the Mousedeer
1.description: You move your body in a pattern that evokes the small and clever Sister Mousedeer, misdirecting enemies and filling their vision with shadows to hide behind.

1.name: Inherit the Dreaming Heirloom
1.description: Whether you always carried it or perhaps only recently inherited, you have a pusaka— an heirloom containing a spirit who you communicate with in your dreams.

1.name: Refined Motion in Darkness
1.description: The ability to move elegantly and undetected through darkness aided your people as they fled the Netherworld.

1.name: Wayang Lore
1.description: You can use your knowledge to enhance your performances or aid you in hiding.

1.name: Wayang Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You learned to fight with weapons that help you keep your distance or make the most of striking from shadows.

5.name: Dissolution's Clarity
5.description: The Dissolution teaches that darkness can bring clarity and focus, serenity and strength—and so you draw on nearby shadows to replenish your magic.

5.name: Shadowplay
5.description: As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy.

9.name: Dance of the Tiger
9.description: Tales tell of the Tiger stalking the Mousedeer for days, hidden and instilling dread upon its prey.

9.name: Dissolution's Sight
9.description: Accepting your inner darkness means that no outer darkness can obscure your sight.

9.name: Rouse the Dreaming Relic
9.description: The spirit within your pusaka resonates with other magical items in your possession.

9.name: Shadow Tempo
9.description: As your ally moves past you, you match your movements to their rhythm, following them across the battlefield.

13.name: Dalang's Ally
13.description: You move your shadow as a master puppeteer, allowing it to dance around your enemies and serve you in combat.

13.name: Dance of the Jester
13.description: Through your incredible dance skill, you can embody the character of the Jester, able to take control of the shadows of other players on stage (much to your amusement).

13.name: Palm-leaf Silhouette
13.description: You can make yourself as flat as a paper doll or shadow.

13.name: Slay Giants Unseen
13.description: In the darkness, your attacks can bring any red-faced giant to their knees.

17.name: Dissolution's Sovereignty
17.description: With discipline born from a lifetime in darkness, you convince the shadow of an enemy to fight by your side.

17.name: Sever the Dreaming Shadow
17.description: As you whisper to your pusaka, it attempts to cut away an enemy's shadow, leaving them in an eternal sleep.

1.name: Crawling Form
1.prerequisite: Born of Animal heritage or Born of Celestial heritage
1.description: You can transform into a small animal or celestial creature to scurry and spy.

1.name: Morphic Strike
1.description: You can lash out with a portion of your previous self.

1.name: Natural Mutagen
1.description: You can distill your natural shapeshifting ability into an elixir that grants a lesser ability to morph.

1.name: Polymorphic Escape
1.description: You polymorph into a tiny vermin, a cloud of leaves, or another shape that allows you to escape.

1.name: Twilight Dweller
1.description: You're accustomed to shaded forests and caves.

1.name: Yaoguai Historian
1.description: You know extensively about your own kind.

5.name: Among Humanity
5.description: Your talents in shapechanging allow you to pass unseen.

5.name: Awakened Yaoguai Heritage
5.description: You've delved into the power of your legacy.

5.name: Bold Defiance
5.description: You harden your form as you dance between shapes.

5.name: Immobile Form
5.prerequisite: Born of Item heritage, Born of Elements heritage, or Born of Vegetation heritage
5.description: You take on the shape you had before you awoke to hide in plain sight.

5.name: Kin Hunter
5.description: You're adept at combating other supernatural creatures.

5.name: Signature Weapon
5.description: Your energy saturates one of your weapons; it might be one inherited or one tied to your history.

9.name: Brilliant Vision
9.description: You ignore concealment from clouds, dust, fog, mist, smoke, and similarly loose matter.

9.name: Forever Among Humanity
9.description: Passing unseen within society is second nature to you now.

9.name: Quick Recovery (Yaoguai)
9.description: You use your command over your form to repair lifethreatening wounds.

9.name: Unleash Yaoguai Might
9.description: As you enter your yaoguai form, you draw upon your internal magic to assume an even greater form.

13.name: Elucidation
13.description: You can cut through illusions with such precision that all those around you find their senses sharpened as well.

13.name: Improved Signature Weapon
13.description: Your signature weapon takes on the properties of mystical materials renowned for defeating undead, spirits, and other such creatures.

13.name: Unnerving Terror
13.description: You let out a mighty howl, chant of death, or speak with eerie repetition that plants fear in others.

17.name: Gentle Death and Rebirth
17.description: You were once born from the energies of the land and nature, and by their power, you can return to life again.

17.name: Legendary Monster
17.description: Your yaoguai form has reached its pinnacle, allowing you to assume (or perhaps, return to) the form of a monster of legend.

1.name: Caretaker's Intuition
1.description: Your forebears had a deep understanding of the natural world around them, and you've learned some of their knowledge and techniques.

1.name: Caretaker's Restoration
1.description: The stewarding abilities of your forebears allows you to repair objects important to you.

1.name: Jotun's Eyes
1.description: Your vision has adapted to the darkness between planes.

1.name: Jotunborn Grappler
1.description: Wrestling is a common pastime for jotunborn, and you've done your fair share.

1.name: Jotunborn Lore
1.description: You were taught the history of your people's planar travels as well as the skills necessary to thrive in sub-planar environments.

1.name: Jotunborn Weapon Familiarity
1.description: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the jotunborn trait.

1.name: Plane-Stepping Dash
1.description: You move with magical swiftness, treading between planar boundaries to shorten your journey.

5.name: Call the First Tools
5.description: You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment's notice.

5.name: Jotun's Battle Stance
5.description: You emulate the battle stance of your forebears, allowing you to use mighty weapons to attack distant foes.

5.name: Jotun's Grasp
5.description: You've mastered a technique that allows you to close the gap on foes and wrestle them into submission.

5.name: Planar Resilience
5.description: Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels.

5.name: Pounding Leap
5.description: You use the momentum of your massive fists to launch yourself through the air.

9.name: Build the First Walls
9.description: The powers of creation that run through you allow you to conjure a temporary wall.

9.name: Iivlar's Deflection
9.description: You're able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows.

9.name: Jotun's Boost
9.description: Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield.

9.name: Plane Step
9.description: You temporarily move just beyond the threshold of the current plane, granting you concealment until the end of your next turn.

13.name: Iivlar's Boundary Break
13.description: You can bend the boundary between planes with the natural skill of an iivlar.

13.name: Jotun's Restoration
13.description: You've mastered how to tap into your restorative powers at a higher frequency.

13.name: Plane Hop
13.description: The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways.

13.name: Smoothing Stomp
13.description: You stomp and unleash a wave of the magic of creation in a 30-foot emanation that transforms non-magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain into normal terrain.

17.name: Jotun's Heart
17.description: You have unlocked the power of a true giant within you.

17.name: Jotun's Transposition
17.description: You've learned to fully move across planes, beginning with the Ethereal Plane.

17.name: Planar Traveler
17.description: You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period.

1.name: Covet Hoard
1.description: You have a dragon's desire for treasure.

1.name: Dragonet Breath
1.description: You have developed your magical breath.

1.name: Dragonet Resistances
1.description: You might be a little dragon, but you are still a dragon, which means it's difficult to constrain you.

1.name: Mighty Dragonet
1.description: You've grown especially large and now tower over your fellow dragonets.

1.name: My Claws are Daggers
1.description: Your claws are as sharp as your teeth.

1.name: Scales of Steel
1.description: Your scales are hard as armor, ensuring you always have some protection in the dangerous world.

1.name: Take Wing
1.description: You have strengthened your wings and can now fly for short distances.

5.name: Ascended Dragonet Heritage
5.description: You've awoken the power of your draconic heritage.

5.name: Inhale, Exhale!
5.description: You take an especially deep breath as a prelude to unleashing your dragonet breath on your foes.

5.name: Jealous Grip
5.description: You are protective of your hoard, and woe betide anyone who tries to take what's yours.

5.name: Zip! Zoom!
5.description: You can fly longer distances before you need to land.

9.name: Bond Companion
9.description: You form a close bond with a companion, similar to that of a master and familiar, that lets you gift them with a touch of your inherent magic.

9.name: Ferocious Will
9.description: You send a blast of magical feedback at the effect's source, dealing 5d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

9.name: Into the Sky
9.description: You fly as naturally as any dragonet.

13.name: Form a Flock
13.description: You call nearby wild dragonets to swarm to your side.

13.name: Lurching Chomp
13.description: Through your wiles, charm, or a little bit of magic, you lure in a foe for a closer look—and a quick bite!

17.name: Dazzling Dragonet Disappearance
17.description: A brilliant sheen on your scales flashes when you're hit, then you're nowhere to be found.

17.name: Dragonet Immunities
17.description: You will not fall asleep unless you choose to allow it, nor will you sit still.

2.name: Tattoo Artist
2.description: You can craft tattoos, including magical tattoos.

2.name: Runelord Dedication
2.description: Your rune magic increases, and you practice with your school's associated weapon.

2.name: Embed Aeon Stone
2.description: You discover the secrets to embedding aeon stones into your flesh.

4.name: Aeon Resonance
4.description: You gain the resonant power of one embedded aeon stone as if it were placed in a wayfinder .

6.name: Polearm Tricks
6.description: Your connection to rune magic has revealed tricks to make polearms deadlier in your hands.

6.name: Rod of Rule
6.description: Your personal rune is connected more closely to your arcane bond.

6.name: Sinbladed Spell
6.description: You punctuate your spellcasting with a flourish of your weapon, imparting physical force to your magic.

8.name: Sin Reservoir
8.description: During daily preparations, you can indulge in your associated sin.

10.name: Fused Polearm
10.description: During your daily preparations, you can magically fuse your arcane bonded weapon and a magical staff together into one item, with the staff making up the haft of the weapon.

10.name: Sin Counterspell
10.description: Your deep connection to a specific sin allows you to easily negate spells that sin opposes.

12.name: School Counterspell
12.description: Your intricate knowledge of your school lets you easily negate spells from that school.

18.name: School Spell Redirection
18.description: When you Counterspell a spell with a school matching your specialization, if you critically succeed at your counteract check, or if you succeed while using a spell of a higher level than the spell you countered, you can redirect the spell you countered.

18.name: Orichalcum Bond
18.description: The ancient Thassilonians associated sins with different skymetals, and you've adapted that theory to empower your bonded weapon beyond its normal limits.

1.name: No! No! I Created You!
1.description: You appeal to your construct companion's bond with its creator to have it break free of a controlling effect.

2.name: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Medicine; attended the University of Lepidstadt
2.description: Before everything else, before the blood and the monsters and the Stasian technology and the horror, you are a doctor.

4.name: In Lightning, Life
4.description: "In lightning, there is life." This lesson is whispered throughout Lepidstadt, and you can put it to practical use.

4.name: Rise, My Creature!
4.description: You have created life! You have usurped the power of the gods themselves!

6.name: Artery Map
6.description: While you've learned all the places a scalpel can cause extensive bleeding to avoid disasters in surgery, such knowledge can serve other purposes.

6.name: Let my Creature Live!
6.description: You continue to tinker with your creation's muscles and rudimentary mind, granting it a limited form of autonomy.

7.name: Beautiful Knifework
7.prerequisite: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication; Master in Medicine
7.description: You perform surgical adjustments to disguise a willing ally or your construct companion.

8.name: Behold My Creation!
8.description: You have rebuilt your creation once more.

8.name: Stasian Charge
8.description: Charging a living body with electricity may seem like a bad idea, but you know better.

12.name: Stand Back, I'm a Doctor!
12.prerequisite: Master in Medicine; Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication
12.description: You have mastered techniques to aid those at the brink of death, even if they use dangerous Stasian technology.

14.name: A Miracle of Science!
14.description: Once, you dreamed of creating life. Now you know that merely creating life lacks ambition.

2.name: Inventor Dedication
2.description: You become trained in Crafting and inventor class DC.

4.name: Basic Breakthrough
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level inventor feat of your choice.

4.name: Brilliant Crafter
4.description: Your skill at crafting is unparalleled.

6.name: Advanced Breakthrough
6.description: You gain one inventor feat.

6.name: Explosion
6.description: Your innovation can explode on command.

8.name: Basic Modification
8.description: You've learned to modify your innovation in order to enhance its capabilities beyond what an ordinary piece of equipment can accomplish.

2.name: Overwatch Dedication
2.description: You have an innate knack for tactical observation, and you've innovated to apply that knack in a variety of ways that allow you to assist your allies.

4.name: Spyglass Modification
4.description: Your enhanced visual gear includes a regulating scope and reflectors, combined in an ingenuous setup that allows you to see around corners within the area of your overwatch field.

6.name: Swift Intervention
6.description: You're burdened with noticing potential threats at all times.

8.name: Topple Giants
8.description: When you observe an ally try and fail to execute a strategic maneuver against your enemies, you coordinate with your other allies to finish the job.

10.name: Wide Overwatch
10.description: Through a variety of perceptive techniques, careful routines, and upgrades to your enhanced visual gear, you have become able to observe and maintain your overwatch at a much greater distance.

12.name: Forewarn
12.description: Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults.

12.name: Master Spotter
12.description: Your incredible perception and trusty enhanced visual gear allow you to see things others miss.

14.name: Control Tower
14.description: Your keen senses and ability to process battlefield information have dramatically improved, allowing you to drastically reduce the advantage of unseen foes.

16.name: Converge
16.description: Informing your ally of an opening created by your shot, you coordinate to set them up to hit the target at the same time.

2.name: Sterling Dynamo Dedication
2.description: You obtain a sterling dynamo prosthetic, which allows you to replace or augment a limb, or even add a simple new non-prehensile limb, such as a tail.

4.name: Modular Dynamo
4.description: Your dynamo has modular configurations, allowing you to swap between various different possibilities with ease in order to adapt to various situations in combat.

6.name: Piston Punch
6.description: You lash out with a powerful punch, extending your dynamo to a greater length in order to attack two creatures in a row.

8.name: Stasian Smash
8.description: You've modified your dynamo with Stasian coils, allowing you to make a powerful attack that crackles with electricity.

10.name: Beast Dynamo Howl
10.description: You've incorporated beast tech from Arcadia into your dynamo, adding in components from various terrifying creatures to enhance your prosthesis's capabilities.

12.name: Golem Dynamo
12.description: You've learned the secrets of Jistkan golem prostheses, allowing you to incorporate golem components into your dynamo and gain a portion of their magic.

18.name: Soaring Dynamo
18.description: You've built clockwork wings or jets into your dynamo, allowing you to use your prosthesis to fly.

4.name: Trapsmith Dedication
4.description: You use glimmering gears and gnashing mechanisms to manufacture snares using specialized parts.

4.name: Gear Gnash
4.description: Snares you create have complicated inner workings that are quite difficult to disable.

7.name: Propeller Attachment
7.description: You've mastered attaching clockwork propellers to your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

8.name: Recycled Cogwheel
8.description: You're able to scavenge the cogwheels from your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

10.name: Repurposed Parts
10.description: You are familiar with the fittings and cogwheels of your snares and can repurpose parts from prepared quick-deploy snares to assemble a new creation on the fly.

12.name: Finessed Features
12.description: You've learned how to build snares that trigger based on visual stimuli.

2.name: Trick Driver Dedication
2.description: You are equally at home piloting any vehicle, adapting yourself instantly to varied controls, movements, and handling.

2.name: Express Driver
2.description: You can optimize your vehicle's performance, coaxing extra speed and choosing paths to avoid slowdowns.

4.name: Take the Wheel
4.prerequisite: Trick Driver Dedication; Expert in Driving Lore; Trained in Driving Lore
4.description: Diving into a moving vehicle and seizing the controls is nothing new for you.

4.name: Power Slide
4.description: You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit or bring your weapons to bear.

7.name: Push it
7.prerequisite: Trick Driver Dedication; Master in Driving Lore
7.description: You can push your vehicle's performance beyond the limits envisioned by its makers.

10.name: Roadkill
10.description: In your hands, any vehicle is a weapon.

12.name: Drive-By Attack
12.description: You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control.

2.name: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication
2.description: You are adept at designing and maintaining mechanical vehicles, and you lavish your attention and ingenuity on one vehicle in particular.

4.name: Engine Bay
4.prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Expert in Crafting
4.description: You are practiced at working in vast garages of vehicles and can work on many machines at a time.

4.name: Patch Job
4.description: You can patch up damage to an object with a quick fix.

6.name: Superior Propulsion
6.description: By experimenting with the effects of momentum gained from your signature vehicle's movement, you have learned to get more from propulsion than just speed when the pilot pushes the vehicle to its limit.

7.name: Efficient Controls
7.prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Master in Crafting
7.description: By reducing redundant systems and streamlining essential functions, you have made it easier for the vehicle to operate with fewer crew.

8.name: Impervious Vehicle
8.description: From armor plating and flexible components, to reinforced materials and backup redundant functionality, you have built safeguards to protect your vehicle from the rigors of combat.

18.name: Miraculous Flight
18.description: With superior engineering and magical application, you have freed your signature vehicle from the bonds of gravity, allowing it to soar through the sky like a dragon.

1.name: Cover Fire
1.description: You lay down suppressive fire to protect allies by forcing foes to take cover from your wild attacks.

10.name: Deflecting Shot
10.description: You're always ready to take a quick shot to deflect a weapon or distract a foe enough to render them off target.

10.name: Redirecting Shot
10.description: Seeing your ally's attack about to go astray, you fire your weapon to right its course.

10.name: Tag Team
10.description: Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike.

2.name: Sniping Duo Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in at least one type of weapon in the crossbow or firearm groups; Trained in Stealth
2.description: You can choose one willing, non-minion ally to act as your spotter.

2.name: Assisting Shot
2.description: Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat.

4.name: Triangulate
4.description: Your spotter's quick signals help you make even difficult shots seem simple.

6.name: Exploit Opening
6.description: You take advantage of your spotter's devastating attack to unleash your own follow-up attack.

6.name: Targeted Redirection
6.description: You aim a shot at your spotter, intending for your spotter to redirect that shot off their own weapon or shield to hit your foe from a better angle, and avoid your foe's cover.

8.name: Duo's Aim
8.description: With assistance from your spotter, you aim for an especially accurate attack.

8.name: Vantage Shot
8.description: You and your spotter take advantage of each other's attacks to momentarily hide and throw your foes off-balance against your follow-up attack.

12.name: Eagle Eyes
12.description: You and your spotter are adept at watching out for one another.

14.name: Concentrated Assault
14.description: You and your spotter combine your efforts to bring down your target.

1.name: Hit the Dirt!
1.description: You fling yourself out of harm's way.

2.name: Risky Reload
2.description: You've practiced a technique for rapidly reloading your firearm, but attempting to use this technique is a dangerous gamble with your firearm's functionality.

2.name: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication
2.description: Who needs skill when you've got dumb luck?

10.name: Trick Shot
10.description: You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby.

10.name: Unbelievable Escape
10.description: Your ability to narrowly evade danger defies all logic.

10.name: I Meant to Do That
10.prerequisite: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication; Trained in Deception
10.description: Somehow your stray bullet causes an unintended reaction that creates a problem for your enemy: perhaps a ricochet knocks your foe's weapon away or they stumble over stray debris in an attempt to dodge your bullets.

4.name: Lucky Escape
4.description: Force your foe to reroll the triggering attack

6.name: No Hard Feelings
6.description: Despite the devastation your weapons tend to inflict upon their targets or the destruction you might unleash upon an area, your foes still manage to walk away at the end of a fight—at least sometimes.

7.name: That was a Close One, Huh?
7.prerequisite: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication; Master in Deception
7.description: You laugh innocently about the inexplicable luck of your last shot hitting its mark or how close the attack that just missed you came to taking your head off, causing your foes to second guess whether it's a good idea to oppose you in battle.

8.name: Unbelievable Luck
8.description: While no one, not even you, might appear to understand why, you demonstrate a greater ability to hit your targets regardless of the obstacles in your way.

12.name: Chain Reaction
12.description: You fire your gun once, creating a devastating and unpredictable chain of events; perhaps your bullet strikes exactly the right spot on a water tower, causing it to flood and incite a stampede of horses which knock over a lantern that sets a city on fire.

1.name: Sword and Pistol
1.description: You're comfortable wielding a firearm or crossbow in one hand and a melee weapon in the other, combining melee attacks with shots from the firearm.

10.name: Trick Shot
10.description: You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby.

10.name: Phenom's Verve
10.description: You're possessed with an incredibly vivacious spark that separates you not only from ordinary gun users and gunslingers, but even from other phenoms.

14.name: Showstopper
14.description: Your twirling weapons create a grand distraction that's difficult to look away from.

14.name: Whirling Knockdown
14.description: You fire your gun while throwing off a target's balance with your melee weapon.

2.name: Pistol Phenom Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in at least one type of one-handed firearm; Trained in Deception; Trained in Performance
2.description: You catch an opponent off-guard by spinning your weapon.

4.name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
4.description: Your flair keeps foes' attention, as your motions with your gun draw your foes into a deadly game.

6.name: Dazzling Bullet
6.description: Your tricks discombobulate your opponent, leaving spots in their vision from the bright flash of your gunshot reflected straight into their eyes.

8.name: Hot Foot
8.description: Using a carefully aimed shot, you make a creature "dance."

12.name: Reach for the Sky
12.description: You command the room, firing a gun into the air and ordering everyone to surrender and put their hands in the air.

2.name: Pistol Twirl
2.description: Your quick gestures and flair for performance distract your opponent, leaving it vulnerable to your follow-up attacks.

2.name: Bullet Dancer Dedication
2.prerequisite: expert in unarmored defense and trained in unarmed attack
2.description: You've learned how to synchronize traditional martial arts and guns.

4.name: Black Powder Boost
4.description: You fire your weapon as you jump, using the kickback to go farther.

4.name: Bullet Dancer Burn
4.description: The fiery blaze of your weapons combined with your unorthodox technique leaves your opponents with little opportunity to capitalize on any gaps in your defenses, or properly defend themselves against your onslaught.

10.name: Trick Shot
10.description: You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby.

10.name: Bullet Dancer Reload
10.description: You've learned to reload your simple firearms with uncanny grace, the ammunition simply falling into place as though part of a well-practiced kata.

12.name: Ricochet Shot
12.description: You bounce your shot off a nearby surface to strike your opponent from an unexpected angle.

14.name: Showstopper
14.description: Your twirling weapons create a grand distraction that's difficult to look away from.

14.name: Two-Weapon Fusillade
14.description: You attack with both your weapons in a furious barrage.

14.name: Ranged Disarm
14.description: When using a simple firearm, you can shoot objects right out of your enemy's hands.

8.name: Black Powder Blaze
8.description: You learn to take advantage of every shot, flying across the battlefield with the help of your weapon's recoil.

6.name: Snap Shot
6.description: You can react with ranged weapons when a creature is in close quarters.

1.name: Qi Spells
1.description: You have cultivated your qi to produce magical effects.

1.name: Ki Rush
1.description: You can use ki to move with extraordinary speed and make yourself harder to hit.

2.name: Gunslinger Dedication
2.description: You become trained in simple and martial crossbows and simple and martial firearms.

4.name: Basic Shooting
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level gunslinger feat of your choice.

6.name: Advanced Shooting
6.description: You gain one gunslinger feat.

6.name: Slinger's Readiness
6.description: You've learned a gunslinger's tricks for staking out your territory in a fight.

10.name: Practiced Reloads
10.description: You've mastered the reloading techniques and methods usually practiced by only the most dedicated firearm professionals.

12.name: Eagle Eye
12.description: Your practice with crossbows and firearms has sharpened your attention to detail.

12.name: Advanced Firearm Familiarity
12.prerequisite: Gunslinger Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
12.description: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency.

12.name: Firearm Expert
12.prerequisite: Gunslinger Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
12.description: You've become an expert with your chosen weapons.

2.name: Artillerist Dedication
2.description: Artillery is a team sport, where every member of the crew has to rely on the other members.

4.name: Named Artillery
4.description: It is a tradition among artillerists to name the siege weapon most important to them and closest to their heart—much as a sailor on a ship, the weapon is their livelihood.

4.name: Shorthanded
4.description: You can operate a siege weapon with fewer than the minimum number of crew, at an increasing penalty.

6.name: Cannon Corner Shot
6.description: By loading special ammunition in a particular way, you can make your siege weapons do all manner of tricks that other siege engineers can barely even imagine.

6.name: Field Artillery
6.description: While castles are generally obliging enough to stay in one place, out in the field positioning is of paramount importance—a gun in the wrong place is worse than useless.

8.name: Live Ammunition
8.description: There are generally few things as ill-advised as being shot out of a cannon or launched by a trebuchet, but people use the tactic every so often in a desperate situation.

16.name: Master Siege Engineer
16.description: What you don't know about artillery isn't worth knowing and your mastery allows you to perform an impossible number of actions as part of a siege weapon's crew.

6.name: Field Artillery
6.description: While castles are generally obliging enough to stay in one place, out in the field positioning is of paramount importance—a gun in the wrong place is worse than useless.

6.name: Siege Celerity
6.description: You push yourself and your light mortar beyond your limits.

16.name: Master Siege Engineer
16.description: What you don't know about artillery isn't worth knowing and your mastery allows you to perform an impossible number of actions as part of a siege weapon's crew.

2.name: Munitions Master Dedication
2.description: You have drilled enough with your light mortar to operate it with unrivaled efficiency.

4.name: Focused Fire
4.description: You limit the blast of your shot for accuracy.

4.name: Wrapped in Smoke
4.description: You ignite a small portion of powder in a rapid, inefficient burn, creating a hazy cloud.

8.name: Recoiling Relocation
8.description: Your innovation contains a chamber to store a small amount of compressed exhaust gas from your Launches.

10.name: Burrowing Shot
10.description: You tune light mortar to maximize penetration into hard surfaces.

6.name: Beast Gunner Dedication
6.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana; Trained in Crafting; expert with at least one type of firearm, you own a beast gun and have slain the type of creature associated with your beast gun in a fair hunt (see above)
6.description: You've bonded to your beast gun and unlocked the first hints of its hidden potential.

8.name: Basic Beast Gunner Spellcasting
8.description: You've unlocked the first secrets of beast guns, granting you the power of their synergistic magic.

8.name: Call Gun
8.description: You build a powerful magical connection with a chosen gun or crossbow, gaining the ability to conjure it directly to your hand from any distant location.

10.name: Drain Vitality
10.description: You draw out the bestial magic energy within your bonded beast gun to fortify yourself, purge ongoing harm, and bolster your life force with a sheath of swirling life essence.

12.name: Expert Beast Gunner Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Beast Gunner Spellcasting or Basic Wizard Spellcasting
12.description: You've learned the deeper secrets of beast guns, making you an expert in the magic they grant you.

16.name: Controlled Bullet
16.description: You create a direct magical connection with your beast gun, allowing you to guide the beast gun's next shot by taking control of the projectile directly.

18.name: Master Beast Gunner Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Beast Gunner Spellcasting or Expert Wizard Spellcasting
18.description: You've learned the final truth of beast guns, making you a master in the magic they grant you.

2.name: Demolitionist Dedication
2.description: You know how to set explosives to cause the maximum possible damage to buildings and other structures.

2.name: Demolition Charge
2.description: You can rig your bombs to inanimate objects in order to cause destruction to the surrounding area.

4.name: Safety Measures
4.description: You're often careful to be sure you're not hoisted on your own petard, or anyone else's, for that matter.

4.name: Calculated Splash
4.description: You have calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb's splash.

7.name: Explosive Entry
7.prerequisite: Demolitionist Dedication; Master in Engineering Lore
7.description: You know exactly how to make a memorable entrance.

8.name: Controlled Blast
8.description: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously.

12.name: Collapse Wall
12.description: You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature.

6.name: Directional Bombs
6.description: You can lob bombs with great force and a precise trajectory to angle the splash in a cone that sprays in a single direction, potentially allowing you to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines.

10.name: Expanded Splash
10.description: You can throw bombs at just the right trajectory to create especially large and powerful explosions.

2.name: Firework Technician Dedication
2.description: You've learned the secrets of making fire and sound bloom using black powder, metals, and paper.

4.name: Coughing Dragon Display
4.description: This display emits a cascade of loud bangs or glittering trails.

6.name: Expert Fireworks Crafter
6.prerequisite: Firework Technician Dedication; Expert in Crafting
6.description: You're particularly adept at crafting fireworks, allowing you to create much more powerful fireworks than you otherwise could.

8.name: Jumping Jenny Display
8.description: This multi-sequence rocket blasts confetti at a series of altitudes.

10.name: Goblin Jubilee Display
10.description: Flames and explosions sear the air in a riot of color and devastation that rivals that wrought by even the wildest goblin party.

12.name: Banshee Cry Display
12.description: You've learned how to pull off a sudden noisemaker at just the right moment in your display, a technique that can disrupt precise wording.

2.name: Spellshot Dedication
2.description: You've steeped yourself in magic and gunplay to the extent that you can conjure bullets from thin air.

6.name: Fulminating Shot
6.description: You channel potent magic into your next shot, empowering it with a blast of crackling energy.

6.name: Advanced Arcana
6.description: You gain one wizard feat.

8.name: Call Gun
8.description: You build a powerful magical connection with a chosen gun or crossbow, gaining the ability to conjure it directly to your hand from any distant location.

8.name: Arcane Breadth
8.description: Your thorough studies allow you to cast more arcane spells each day.

14.name: Phase Bullet
14.description: You can aim your bullets not just in three normal dimensions, but in additional dimensions as well, removing all obstacles between you and your target.

18.name: Black Powder Embodiment
18.description: You merge your body with your ammunition, enabling you to travel the same path as your bolt or bullet.

4.name: Basic Arcana
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level wizard feat of your choice.

4.name: Basic Wizard Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Spell-Woven Shot
4.description: You combine your own magic with that of your magical crossbow or firearm.

12.name: Expert Wizard Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Wizard Spellcasting; Master in Arcana
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Ursine Avenger Form
2.description: You draw the Ursine Avenger Hood over your head and its fur over your arms, assuming an ursine form that has traits of your original form as well as that of a bear.

4.name: Senses of the Bear
4.description: While in ursine form, you gain low-light vision and scent (imprecise) 30 feet.

6.name: Bear Hug (Ursine Avenger)
6.description: You snatch at your opponent with your claws, pulling them close in a ferocious bear hug.

8.name: Call Ursine Ally
8.description: You can cast a 3rd-rank summon animal as an innate spell, but only to summon a black bear.

10.name: Bear Empathy
10.description: You have a magical affinity for bears and can speak to them through sounds and body language.

12.name: Great Bear
12.description: When you transform, you can take on a bear's bulk and size.

14.name: Terrible Transformation
14.description: You let out a mighty roar as part of your transformation.

16.name: Fearsome Fangs
16.description: Your claws and jaws are brutally powerful and efficient, even by ursine standards.

18.name: Mighty Bear
18.description: The power of the bear within you can expand your physical presence even further.

20.name: Immortal Bear
20.description: Your body thrums with the primal vitality of the greatest of the ursine beasts.

2.name: First Frost
2.description: The gelid shard within your heart may sap your ability to feel and experience emotion, but it also lets you create and manipulate cold.

4.name: Snowcaster
4.description: Your magical power grows as the shard's icy influence spreads ever deeper into your being.

6.name: Snow Step
6.description: Snow and ice are no hindrance to you.

8.name: Frozen Breadth
8.description: Your attunement to arcane cold enhances the depths of your growing power.

10.name: Winter's Embrace
10.description: Your eyes are accustomed to the harsh glare of the sun on snow and ice.

12.name: Expert Snowcasting
12.description: You draw ever more magical cold into your being, learning how to manipulate it to your whims.

14.name: Winter's Kiss
14.description: Whether in the heart of a volcanic passageway or the glacial tundras of the Crown of the World, the only temperature you ever personally experience is an oddly comfortable chill.

16.name: Greater Snow Step
16.description: You can't be impeded by environmental effects that rely on cold or its byproducts.

18.name: Master Snowcasting
18.description: You have unlocked the deeper magic of your gelid shard , gaining access to new levels of spells.

20.name: Icy Apotheosis
20.description: You are as much a creature of cold as whatever ancestry you were born to.

2.name: Loremaster's Etude
2.description: You magically unlock memories, making them easier to recall.

2.name: Loremaster Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in at least one skill to Decipher Writing
2.description: You've compiled a vast repository of information that touches on nearly every subject.

6.name: Assured Knowledge
6.description: You can procure information with confidence.

12.name: Enigma's Knowledge
12.description: Your muse whispers knowledge to you at all the right times.

14.name: True Hypercognition
14.description: Your mind works at an incredible pace.

4.name: Magical Edification
4.description: You've learned those tidbits of magic that are most conducive to furthering your acquisition and transmission of knowledge.

4.name: Orthographic Mastery
4.description: You understand the principles that underlie all written words, allowing you to read nearly any text.

4.name: Quick Study
4.description: During your daily preparations, you can study a particular subject to gain the trained proficiency rank in one Lore skill of your choice.

10.name: Greater Magical Edification
10.description: You've continued to expand your compendium of tools to compile knowledge.

6.name: Steady Spellcasting
6.description: You don't lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn't disrupted.

6.name: Shatter Defenses
6.description: Your offense exploits your enemy's fear.

6.name: Hellknight Dedication
6.prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; lawful alignment; member of a Hellknight Order; passed the Hellknight Test
6.description: You have forged your body to comply with the commands of your mind—orders steeped in the Measure and the Chain.

6.name: Hellknight-Errant
6.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; you've refused to take or have failed the Hellknight Test.
6.description: Either through unfortunate circumstances or your own choice, you remain a Hellknight armiger instead of entering the true ranks of your order, though you still believe in the tenets of law and order.

6.name: Hellknight Preferment
6.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; passed the Hellknight Test; trained in Hellknight plate
6.description: You've forged your body to be able to stand toe-to-toe with a devil, and your mind has been shaped by the strictures of the Measure and the Chain.

6.name: Hellknight Signifer Preferment
6.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; passed the Hellknight Test; trained in Hellknight breastplate; you have a spellcasting class feature.
6.description: You've bolstered your force of will with the power of the Measure and the Chain.

10.name: Fearsome Brute
10.description: Fear makes your foes weak and more vulnerable to your attacks.

8.name: Sense Chaos
8.description: You sense chaos as an unsettling feeling of nervous energy.

8.name: Hellknight Mobility
8.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; expert in Hellknight half plate or Hellknight plate
8.description: You've learned how best to move in your heavy armor.

8.name: Sense Iniquity
8.description: Your Hellknight training gives you the ability to focus your senses and root out those who would attempt to deceive or hide from you.

12.name: Blade of Law
12.description: You call upon the power of law and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against a foe you have witnessed breaking or disrespecting the law or otherwise acting disorderly.

12.name: Hell's Armaments
12.description: You've trained with your order's weapon and your Hellknight plate long enough to apply your expertise from other weapons and armor.

12.name: Conjure Hell
12.description: Though you might not worship Asmodeus or other devils, you've studied enough of Hell to call forth a brief burst of its fire.

12.name: Order Cross-Training
12.description: You gain the lesser order benefit of a Hellknight order other than the one to which you belong.

4.name: Armiger's Protection
4.description: You've learned to wear the iconic Hellknight armor.

14.name: March of Law
14.description: When faced with lawbreakers, you become almost unstoppable, and your purposeful steps instill terror.

14.name: Unfetter Sight
14.description: You release the magic within your mask in an invisible burst, allowing it to temporarily flow into your allies' minds.

16.name: Infernal Interference
16.description: Your attacks force a foe to glimpse the iron, soul-wrenching landscapes of Hell.

16.name: Branding Spell
16.description: The flames of your magic mark a target as an enemy of order.

8.name: Know-It-All
8.description: When you Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context.

8.name: Minor Omen
8.description: The stars warn you of danger in the nick of time.

8.name: Scholar's Hunch
8.description: Scholarly debates have taught you to think on your feet.

2.name: Oatia Skysage Dedication
2.description: Your study of the stars unlocks supernatural insights and magic.

4.name: Basic Skysage Divination
4.description: The stars move, granting you a sliver of their magic.

4.name: Stargazer's Eyes
4.description: Long hours in darkened observatories have sharpened your senses.

6.name: Night's Glow
6.description: The stars and moon lend you their light.

10.name: Starlit Spells
10.description: The stars reveal and punish your enemies.

10.name: Expert Skysage Divination
10.description: Your studies of the stars have taught you about the mysteries of the cosmos.

12.name: Night's Shine
12.description: Your power from the moon and stars becomes strong enough to illuminate the night sky.

14.name: Night's Warning
14.description: Portents written in the night sky show you how to avoid an attack.

14.name: Starlight Armor
14.description: You armor yourself in the light of distant suns, shielding yourself from harm.

16.name: Master Skysage Divination
16.description: You unlock the most powerful secrets hidden in the stars above.

10.name: Quickened Casting
10.description: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

10.name: Into the Future
10.description: You know your spell will be needed not now but in a few moments, so you cast your magic into the future.

14.name: Plot the Future
14.description: You spend 10 minutes in contemplation to uncannily predict how events will play out.

8.name: Read Disaster
8.description: You spend 10 minutes and open yourself to the divine mysteries of the world, peering into the most sinister portents of the future.

8.name: Chronomancer's Secrets
8.description: The secrets of time peel back, revealing deeper truths.

8.name: Future Spell Learning
8.description: More future memories of time magic percolate back to the present, teaching you spells you've yet to learn.

8.name: What Could Have Been
8.description: Rather than conjuring creatures from elsewhere in the world or the planes, you can temporarily pull a much different version of yourself from an alternate timeline.

18.name: Echoing Spell
18.description: You time the components of your spell with exacting precision, setting up a resonance that duplicates the spell's effects.

18.name: Timeline-Splitting Spell
18.description: You invest in two futures, then choose the one to make a reality.

6.name: Time Mage Dedication
6.prerequisite: You have a spellcasting class feature.
6.description: You might be a novice in the temporal arts now, but in the future, you'll hold time in the palm of your hand.

7.name: Chronocognizance
7.prerequisite: Time Mage Dedication; master in Perception
7.description: The flows and ebbs of time are obvious to you, as are the tangles that form when it's distorted.

12.name: Spell Acceleration
12.description: Special time-weaving techniques let you compress your spellcasting gestures and incantations into a short burst so you can cast with incredible speed—though it causes temporal strain.

16.name: Purge of Moments
16.description: All things eventually end, a truth that you can put into practice by accelerating your passage through time to shake off harmful effects.

1.name: Domain Initiate
1.description: Your deity bestows a special spell related to their powers.

1.name: Familiar
1.description: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.

8.name: Advanced Domain
8.description: Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity's domain.

8.name: Enhanced Psychopomp Familiar
8.description: Your psychopomp's continued service in Pharasma's name brings it favor from the goddess.

8.name: Safeguard Soul
8.description: You've girded your soul against outside interference.

4.name: Expanded Domain Initiate
4.description: You have long venerated one of your deity's lesser-known aspects

4.name: Cycle Spell
4.description: Your devotion to the cycle of souls grants you an additional divine spell.

4.name: Psychopomp Familiar
4.description: Your familiar becomes a masked psychopomp—an extraplanar guardian of the cycle of souls.

2.name: Soul Warden Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion; worships Pharasma or a psychopomp usher
2.description: You can take 10 minutes to emblazon Pharasma's holy sigil—a spiraling comet that represents the winding path a soul takes through its existence—upon a shield, tabard, banner, or other prominent object that your wear or wield.

6.name: Liberate Soul
6.description: The light flows from your sigil of Pharasma to shatter the bonds imprisoning a soul.

6.name: Spiral Sworn
6.description: You trace a spiral in the air while intoning prayers to Pharasma, gaining her blessing for a time.

10.name: Expand Spiral
10.description: Your prayers encompass your companions, granting you the ability to share Pharasma's blessings.

1.name: Domain Initiate
1.description: Your deity bestows a special spell related to their powers.

8.name: Advanced Domain
8.description: Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity's domain.

8.name: Silence the Profane (Vindicator)
8.description: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy spellcasters from using their prayers against you.

4.name: Ongoing Investigation
4.description: You're always investigating what's around you, even as you perform other activities.

4.name: Instructive Strike
4.description: You attack your foe and analyze how it reacts.

6.name: Thorough Research
6.description: You have comprehensive knowledge in your fields of interest.

6.name: Interrogate
6.description: You ask questions you know will be answered.

2.name: Vindicator Dedication
2.description: Your church ensures that you are cared for.

10.name: Vindicator's Judgement
10.description: You can pronounce judgment on your foes, making them magically susceptible to your attacks.

12.name: Call The Hunt
12.description: You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey.

8.name: Advanced Domain
8.description: Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity's domain.

8.name: Flickering Stories
8.description: Stories, like fires, can create shadows as much as they illuminate.

2.name: Campfire Chronicler Dedication
2.description: You've gained Isthralei's attention and can now offer stories up to him

4.name: The Dead Tell Tales
4.description: New campfire chroniclers are inundated with the stories of the ghosts below Pulura's Fall and the lessons learned there.

4.name: Listener's Boon
4.description: Isthralei has given you a gift to assist you on your journey.

4.name: Raging Stories
4.description: When you Offer a Story about wild chances and fighting against all odds, you can wrap yourself in spectral flame in place of the normal benefits.

6.name: Cozy Campfire
6.description: You spend 1 hour building a campfire in a single unoccupied square and whispering the stories of those you've met on your journeys.

6.name: Illuminating Stories
6.description: Stories serve as beacons in the night, illuminating valuable knowledge even if the tale itself misses the mark.

10.name: Tales of the Road
10.description: The blessings of Isthralei connect you to the thrum of the stories that underlie all settlements.

14.name: Stories of Home
14.description: You share the joy of every story of long-awaited homecoming you've offered to Isthralei.

8.name: Martyr
8.description: You go to extreme lengths to support your allies, even when it means bringing harm to yourself.

8.name: Watcher on the Wall
8.description: You claim a patron's symbol that you can etch onto any surface.

14.name: Premonition of Clarity
14.description: Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks.

14.name: Unstable Patronage
14.description: You can act as a magical patron for your charges.

18.name: Inviolable
18.description: Your deity punishes creatures that harm you.

2.name: Seneschal Witch Dedication
2.description: As you work to understand the connection with your missing patron, it's increasingly easy to form bonds with those around you.

4.name: Patron's Glamour
4.description: Gathering up threads of your old connection, you can temporarily disguise yourself as your missing patron.

4.name: Seneschal Spell
4.description: You can channel even complex spells through your connection to your charge.

6.name: Multifaceted Will
6.description: Without the firm hand of a patron, your power begins to reflect deeper complexities, sometimes latching onto entirely unexpected sources of magical potency.

6.name: Spiritual Secret
6.description: You gain deeper insights into your patron's abandoned power, allowing you to draw on that power more directly.

10.name: Patron's Whisper
10.description: You gain the ability to speak to your charge over great distances.

20.name: Patron Reborn
20.description: You have fully realized the ability to serve as a patron.

14.name: Premonition of Clarity
14.description: Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks.

14.name: Domain Embodiment
14.description: Your deity contains multitudes, and you can express any aspect of them you desire.

14.name: Fear of God
14.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Expert in Intimidation
14.description: You embed a divine fear into the triggering foe that lasts for 10 minutes.

14.name: Flash of Omnipresence
14.description: Empowered with divine energy, you can be at an ally's side in the blink of an eye.

14.name: Herald's Weapon
14.description: Your weapon becomes a wrathful instrument of your deity's power.

14.name: Mortal Ascension
14.description: Your power uplifts you, breaking the bonds between you and the ground.

14.name: Shield the Faithful
14.description: You and those closest to you are protected by your deity's power.

16.name: Eternal Bane
16.description: Your life has made you a nexus for your deity's vile power.

16.name: Eternal Blessing
16.description: Your deeds have brought your deity's grace to you for all of eternity.

16.name: Resurrectionist
16.description: You can cause a creature you bring back from the brink of death to thrive and continue healing.

16.name: Chastise
16.description: With but a mere word from your deity, you exploit a foe's fear to see their inner being brought low.

16.name: Declare Anathema
16.description: You declare a creature you are aware of within 30 feet anathema, causing their friends and strangers to shy away from them.

16.name: Dive of the Divine
16.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; fly Speed of at least 20 feet
16.description: You dive from the sky, bringing down the might of the divine with you.

16.name: Following Smite
16.description: You call upon your deity's power and channel it through your weapon.

16.name: Free from Bonds
16.description: As a mortal herald, you cannot easily be captured, nor can your allies.

16.name: Healing Sanctuary
16.description: When you call upon your deity's power, you also radiate a sense of safety that fortifies your allies.

16.name: Heraldic Proclamation
16.description: You proclaim your spell with the might of your god behind you.

16.name: Invisible Hand
16.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Master in Stealth
16.description: Sometimes your deity requires you to act in the shadows, accomplishing things without drawing attention to yourself— or them.

18.name: Divine Apex
18.description: You can pour divine power into an item, letting the wearer exceed their limits.

18.name: Shared Clarity
18.description: You can project your premonitions of clarity to your allies.

18.name: Deific Font
18.description: Your life force can fuel the stuff of miracles.

18.name: Divine Presence
18.description: Your spirit becomes one with your deity, granting you the bearing of a god.

18.name: Eyes of God
18.description: You can see things as they truly are.

18.name: Flash of Omniscience
18.description: You briefly see the world as your deity does, recognizing the truth of those around you for a moment.

18.name: Glory on High
18.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; fly Speed of at least 20 feet
18.description: You take to the skies to unveil the full magnificence of your deity's power.

18.name: Guiding Words
18.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Master in Diplomacy
18.description: Your words speak divine truth, guiding blades and arrows to their mark.

18.name: Marked For Rebuke
18.description: You declare that an enemy is fit for further punishment in the sight of your deity.

18.name: Stand for the Fallen
18.description: You protect your allies at the cost of your own blood, but your deity shields you from the worst of the harm.

12.name: Mortal Herald Dedication
12.prerequisite: Worshiper of a specific deity; Master in Religion or your deity's divine skill
12.description: You become a mortal herald of your deity, gaining power in return for your service.

20.name: Ease the Burden
20.description: You wash away a creature's pain with a touch.

20.name: Enter Divine Realm
20.description: You are granted access to your deity's realm and can travel there quickly.

20.name: Flash of Omipotence
20.description: For but a moment you hold the power of a god.

20.name: Herald's Strike
20.description: The power of your blows can send your victim hurling through your deity's realm for a fragment of a second.

20.name: Moment of Apotheosis
20.description: For a small moment, you can assume the form of your god.

20.name: Spark of Immortality
20.description: You have become a divine entity, no longer entirely mortal.

1.name: Animal Empathy (Druid)
1.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

1.name: Initiate Warden
1.description: You've trained with one of the ranger sects known as wardens, who practice a specialized type of primal magic.

10.name: Side by Side (Druid)
10.description: You and your animal companion fight in tandem, distracting your foes and keeping them off balance.

10.name: Beastmaster Bond
10.description: You can communicate telepathically with your animal companions within 100 feet.

10.name: Ferocious Charge
10.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an antlers, head, or horn unarmed attack
10.description: You've taught your companions to charge directly at an enemy.

10.name: Running Kick
10.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a foot, hoof, or talon unarmed attack
10.description: Your companion weaves in and out of combat, swiftly attacking before getting to a better position.

10.name: Sinking Jaws
10.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack
10.description: Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it.

10.name: Sweeping Tail
10.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a tail unarmed attack
10.description: Your companion swings its tail powerfully.

10.name: Vicious Rend
10.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a claw, fist, pincer, or talon unarmed attack
10.description: Your companion sinks its claws and rips.

2.name: Animal Empathy (Ranger)
2.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

2.name: Beastmaster Dedication
2.description: You gain the service of a young animal companion that travels with you and obeys your commands.

2.name: Wild Empathy
2.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world.

2.name: Magic Hide
2.description: You can defend your companion in battle.

4.name: Advanced Warden
4.description: You unlock more powerful primal spells.

4.name: Companion's Cry
4.description: You can urge your companion to do its utmost.

4.name: Additional Companion
4.description: Another animal joins you in your travels.

4.name: Mature Beastmaster Companion
4.description: All of your animal companions grow up, becoming mature animal companions and gaining additional capabilities. Your animal companion has greater independence.

4.name: Heal Animal
4.description: You can heal your animal companion's wounds.

4.name: Spirit of the Beast
4.description: You imbue your companion with the aspect of another animal.

6.name: Beastmaster's Trance
6.description: You can enter a trance that allows you to briefly inhabit the body of one of your animal companions and share its senses.

6.name: Swift Guardian
6.description: When danger appears, you quickly send away your active companion and call in a different animal ally.

6.name: Bestial Protection
6.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion that's Large or larger
6.description: Your companion's mere presence is enough to rattle creatures that fall under its shadow.

6.name: Nature's Precision
6.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an agile or finesse unarmed attack
6.description: Your companions pick at an enemy's weak points.

6.name: Tenacious Endurance
6.description: You encourage your companion to refuse to yield, against even the mightiest of foes.

8.name: Incredible Beastmaster Companion
8.description: Your mature animal companions continue to grow and develop.

8.name: Enlarge Companion
8.description: You make your companion enormous.

8.name: Pack Movement
8.description: You and your companion move to take down a common enemy.

12.name: Beastmaster's Call
12.description: You quickly call in a primal projection of a non-active companion to provide the companion's support benefit.

12.name: Billowing Wings
12.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with wings
12.description: You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them.

14.name: Specialized Beastmaster Companion
14.description: Your nimble and savage animal companions become cunning enough to become specialized.

16.name: Lead the Pack
16.prerequisite: Mature Beastmaster Companion; you have multiple animal companions
16.description: You can have up to two animal companions active at once.

18.name: Heightened Instincts
18.description: You've worked to sharpen your companions' instincts to supernatural levels.

20.name: Pack Takedown
20.description: The pack is strongest when it acts as one, and like a group of hungry wolves, you work together to bring down a single target.

1.name: Animal Empathy (Druid)
1.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

4.name: Companion's Cry
4.description: You can urge your companion to do its utmost.

4.name: Quick Mount
4.description: You and your mount can spring into action at a moment's notice.

4.name: Mammoth Lord Dedication
4.description: You've undertaken the ultimate challenge of the Mammoth Lords and tamed a megafauna.

10.name: Trampling Charge
10.description: You urge your mount to charge into the fray, trampling all enemies who stand in your path.

10.name: Staggering Blow
10.description: You've trained your megafauna companion to stagger its enemies, impeding their ability to fight back.

10.name: Unbreakable Bond
10.description: You and your megafauna companion are bound together; as long as you live, it's much harder for your companion to die.

20.name: Legendary Rider
20.description: You and your mount move like one being, effortlessly reading each other's signals and synchronizing even in the thick of battle.

2.name: Wild Empathy
2.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world.

6.name: Mammoth Charge
6.description: You Command an Animal to order your megafauna companion to Stride twice.

6.name: Mature Megafauna Companion
6.description: You've raised your megafauna companion to be a more powerful force on the battlefield than most of its kind.

6.name: Megafauna Veterinarian
6.prerequisite: Mammoth Lord Dedication; Expert in Nature
6.description: By heeding the wise advice of elders in your following— and aided by your own experience—you've learned how to provide medical care to the megafauna of the Mammoth Lord followings.

7.name: Speech of the Mammoth Lords
7.prerequisite: Mammoth Lord Dedication; Master in Diplomacy or Master in Intimidation
7.description: You've learned the ancient tongue spoken by the creatures of the far north.

8.name: Incredible Megafauna Companion
8.description: Under your care and training, your megafauna companion has realized its innate potential.

8.name: Stalwart Mind
8.description: When necessary to avoid a magical compulsion or curse, you can be as stubborn as your megafauna companion.

12.name: Gigantic Megafauna Companion
12.description: The mammoths and other megafauna ridden by your people are larger than any ordinary beast.

14.name: Specialized Megafauna Companion
14.description: You've trained your mammoth or other megafauna companion to perform in unusual or extreme situations, granting it abilities far beyond others of its kind.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Familiar Master Dedication
2.description: You have forged a mystical bond with a creature.

4.name: Familiar Mascot
4.description: When selecting master abilities, you can choose an ally to benefit from any specific master ability.

4.name: Familiar Conduit
4.prerequisite: Familiar Master Dedication; able to cast spells
4.description: Under your tutelage, your familiar has grown attuned to the hidden currents of the world and can serve as a conduit for your magic.

6.name: Improved Familiar
6.description: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

6.name: Improved Familiar (Familiar Master)
6.description: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

8.name: Mutable Familiar
8.description: Your familiar's supernatural spirit has outgrown its corporeal body.

10.name: Incredible Familiar (Familiar Master)
10.description: Your familiar is infused with even more magic than other familiars.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Elementalist Dedication
2.description: Each day when you make your daily preparations, you can attune yourself to one element of your choice: air, earth, fire, or water.

6.name: Current Spell
6.description: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you.

6.name: Burning Spell
6.description: You enhance your spell with elemental fire, causing it to set the target on fire.

6.name: Expanded Elemental Magic
6.description: You reach new understandings of the elements, taking an expansive view.

1.name: Familiar
1.description: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.

4.name: Dousing Spell
4.description: You enhance your spell with elemental water, soaking the target.

4.name: Elemental Familiar
4.description: Your familiar becomes an elemental spirit capable of taking on aspects of the four elements: air, earth, fire, or water.

8.name: Metabolize Element
8.description: Your rapidly metabolize the elemental particles in your opponent's spell to gain a boost of energy.

10.name: Rockslide Spell
10.description: You enhance your spell with elemental earth, causing chunks of stone to litter the ground.

10.name: Reverberating Spell
10.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; metal is in your elemental philosophy
10.description: Your spell disorients your targets with a metallic clangor.

10.name: Growth Spell
10.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; wood is in your elemental philosophy
10.description: You enhance your spell with elemental wood, causing your magic to expand and grow beyond its original limitations.

12.name: Redirect Elements
12.description: You seize the elemental essence of an incoming spell and redirect the spell to a creature of your choice within the spell's area.

14.name: Wind-Tossed Spell
14.description: You enhance your spell with elemental air, using the wind to find your target and carry your magic around cover.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Shadowcaster Dedication
2.description: You've sacrificed a piece of your spirit, allowing the powers of shadow into your being and changing the nature of your magic.

1.name: Familiar
1.description: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.

10.name: Shadow Magic
10.description: You gain the ability to fuse and play with shadows by using focus spells specific to shadowdancers.

10.name: Shadow Reservoir
10.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots; Shadowcaster Dedication
10.description: Your own shadow speaks to you, providing knowledge of spells and a reservoir of magical power.

12.name: Additional Shadow Magic
12.description: Choose an additional shadowdancer focus spell you haven't already selected from Shadow Magic.

12.name: Shadow Illusion
12.description: With an artful eye, you shape shadows into illusory forms.

12.name: Secrets of Shadow
12.description: Your shadow's voice grows ever clearer; it whispers secrets of true power to you and shields your flesh from harm.

14.name: Shadow Power
14.description: You can focus the shadows into a powerful blast.

14.name: Unending Emptiness
14.description: You pool the power of shadow within your eyes, gaining the ability to gather darkness into a turbulent orb of crushing emptiness within your line of sight.

4.name: Shadow Spells
4.description: Hidden darkness whispers to you, teaching you secrets of shadow beyond other spellcasters of your tradition.

6.name: Disciple of Shade
6.description: You've delved deeper into the mysteries of shadow and become blessed with magical power that increases your skills in the arts of deception and persuasion.

8.name: Shadow Spell
8.description: You attach a piece of your shadow to a spell to cloud the senses and cause mischief.

2.name: Enhanced Familiar
2.description: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

2.name: Rivethun Emissary Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Religion
2.description: You're a practicing Rivethun emissary, skilled at interacting and bonding with the spirits of living creatures.

8.name: Incredible Familiar
8.description: Your familiar is imbued with even more magic than other familiars.

8.name: Kaleidoscopic Entreaty
8.description: If your next action is to cast entreat spirit, you can cause that spirit to unleash a brilliant display of color, light, and sound in a 10-foot emanation centered on you.

8.name: Rivethun Devotion
8.description: Through study, dedication, and introspection, you've learned to wield magic that affects the spirit.

4.name: Emissary Familiar
4.description: You forge a mystical bond with a spirit or create a spirit from a fragment of your own soul.

6.name: Domain Spirit
6.description: You forge an intense spiritual bond of mutual trust and appreciation with a single spirit that you have already bonded with using Bond with Spirit.

10.name: Advanced Domain Spirit
10.description: Your connection with your domain spirit has deepened.

12.name: Consult the Spirits (Rivethun Emissary)
12.description: You spend 1 hour communing with powerful spirits of the world to gain insight, information, or advice.

12.name: Manifold Conduit
12.description: You can manifest multiple spirits at once in a cyclone around you.

16.name: Rivethun Adept
16.description: Your ability to wield spirit magic has increased.

18.name: Embolded With Glorious Purpose
18.description: Communing with powerful spirits of the world and other powers far greater than yourself fills your heart with purpose and inspires you to strive for greater accomplishments.

2.name: Poison Resistance
2.description: Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

2.name: Assassin Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Deception; Trained in Stealth
2.description: You've trained to assassinate your foes, and you do so with tenacity and precision.

4.name: Poison Weapon
4.description: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action.

4.name: Sneak Attacker
4.description: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except it deals 1d4 damage, increasing to 1d6 at 6th level.

4.name: Expert Backstabber
4.description: You excel at quickly dispatching your foes.

4.name: Surprise Attack
4.description: You act before foes can react.

4.name: Angel of Vindication
4.description: To aid with your mission of destroying undead, you've specialized in techniques to destroy them, much as other assassins learn to kill the living.

4.name: Eclipsed Vitality
4.prerequisite: Assassin Dedication or Scout Dedication; Master in Stealth
4.description: You shroud yourself in ashes that hide the vital essence sought by life-sensing undead.

8.name: Improved Poison Weapon
8.description: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects.

8.name: Public Execution
8.description: Some rebel Firebrand cells make a practice of publicly declaring the main target of a given operation.

10.name: Angel of Death
10.description: All your Strikes against a creature you have Marked for Death have the death trait, causing the mark to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

12.name: Assassinate
12.description: You strike with one swift movement, trying to instantly slay your mark.

2.name: Poison Resistance
2.description: Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

2.name: Poisoner Dedication
2.description: You make a point of always having a few toxins near at hand—you never know when some arsenic or the like might prove useful.

4.name: Poison Weapon
4.description: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action.

4.name: Tenacious Toxins
4.description: Your victims tend to expire long before your poisons, since the latter have been specifically formulated to last longer.

4.name: Poisoner's Twist
4.description: Poisons attack specific parts of the body—one venom might target the lungs, another the circulatory system, while another deteriorates the nerves.

8.name: Improved Poison Weapon
8.description: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects.

8.name: Pinpoint Poisoner
8.description: Unsuspecting targets are especially vulnerable to your poisons.

8.name: Acquired Tolerance
