8.description: A small amount of poison taken at nonlethal doses, can help the body build up resistance against a more deadly dosage.

1.name: Blowgun Poisoner
1.description: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun.

1.name: Subtle Delivery
1.description: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun.

6.name: Sticky Poison
6.description: A combination of additional viscosity and careful application keeps your weapons poisoned even when suffering significant wear and tear.

6.name: Advanced Poisoncraft
6.description: You can create up to 6 poisons per day with advanced alchemy.

6.name: Poison Coat
6.description: In nature, certain animals are covered in venomous spines, and just brushing against them can prove deadly.

6.name: Expert Poisoner
6.description: Your advanced alchemy level for poison increases to your level – 3.

18.name: Chemical Contagion
18.description: Your injury poisons can spray onto creatures.

4.name: Mature Animal Companion (Druid)
4.description: Your animal companion has grown up over the course of your adventures, becoming a mature animal companion and gaining additional capabilities (page 211).

4.name: Basic Rivethun Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Spirit Companion
4.description: You gain the service of a young animal companion, which has been blessed by the spirits of this world.

8.name: Incredible Companion (Druid)
8.description: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

2.name: Rivethun Involutionist Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; Trained in Religion
2.description: You're a practicing Rivethun involutionist, with a deep well of inner power.

12.name: Expert Rivethun Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Rivethun Spellcasting; Master in Religion
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

14.name: Specialized Spirit Companion
14.description: Your animal companion gains a unique specialization, spirit-blessed.

18.name: Master Rivethun Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Rivethun Spellcasting; Legendary in Religion
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Mature Animal Companion (Druid)
4.description: Your animal companion has grown up over the course of your adventures, becoming a mature animal companion and gaining additional capabilities (page 211).

4.name: Face Your Fears
4.description: A lifetime of facing Nidal's terrors has taught you to fight through fear.

4.name: Repel Darkness
4.description: Your stoicism and courage seem to drive off darkness and shadow.

8.name: Incredible Companion (Druid)
8.description: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

8.name: Dismounting Strike
8.description: You leap from your horse, using the momentum of its movement to deal a devastating blow with your melee weapon.

8.name: Swallow Pain
8.description: You're capable of absorbing pain with less difficulty than others, and your bond with your horse helps it similarly ignore such suffering.

14.name: Specialized Companion (Druid)
14.description: Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability.

14.name: Sense the Unseen
14.description: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.

14.name: Defy Chains
14.description: You turn to face a fiend that attacked you, looking them squarely in the eyes (if it has them) and showing no fear.

2.name: Favored Terrain
2.description: You have studied a specific terrain to overcome its challenges.

2.name: Nidalese Horselord Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; horse animal companion
2.description: Thanks to the deep bond you share with your Nidalese horse, the two of you gain remarkable abilities.

10.name: Penetrating Shot
10.description: You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey.

10.name: Horselord's Bond
10.description: Your bond with your horse becomes supernaturally strong as the two of you continue your crusade against Zon-Kuthon's dominion.

6.name: Fear No Pain!
6.description: You have learned to endure pain without complaint and are capable of steeling your allies with similar resolve.

6.name: Swift Support
6.description: Nidalese horses are known as some of the fastest across all Golarion, and your mount has trained to ride quickly into battle.

12.name: Shadowpiercing Charge
12.description: You charge into the fray on horseback, and those that lurk in the shadows will feel your wrath.

16.name: Gallop Across Shadow
16.description: Though your enemy wields shadow and darkness as weapons, they are no impediment to you when you ride your trusted horse.

1.name: Combat Assessment
1.description: You make a telegraphed attack to learn about your foe.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Clever Gambit
2.description: Your battle tactics are aided by assessing your foe's capabilities and range.

4.name: Dread Striker
4.description: You capitalize on your enemies' fear to slip past their defenses.

4.name: Butterfly Blade Dedication
4.description: You've trained in one of Goka's oldest traditions of espionage, intimidation, and combat mastery.

6.name: Butterfly's Kiss
6.description: You can make nonlethal Strikes with a butterfly sword without taking a penalty.

6.name: Butterfly's Sting
6.description: You gain the sneak attack class feature.

6.name: Mastermind's Eye
6.description: When you identify a creature with Recall Knowledge, that creature is flat-footed to you.

8.name: Deadly Butterfly
8.description: You gain access to the butterfly sword's critical specialization effect.

14.name: Innocent Butterfly
14.description: You know how to alter the perceptions of others.

1.name: Combat Assessment
1.description: You make a telegraphed attack to learn about your foe.

2.name: Lightning Swap
2.description: You have practiced quickly switching between combat styles and the equipment needed for them.

2.name: Hellbreaker Dedication
2.description: By joining the League, you've taken on the responsibilities of a Hellbreaker.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Felling Strike
8.description: Your attack can ground an airborne foe.

8.name: Hell's Bane
8.description: Your in-depth knowledge of your foes grants you insight into their weaknesses, granting you an advantage when fighting against them.

8.name: Rend Armor
8.description: Your enemies' defenses are no match for you as you wrench your weapon to compromise their armor.

4.name: Devil you Know
4.prerequisite: Hellbreaker Dedication; Expert in Devil Lore or Expert in Hellknight Lore
4.description: Your knowledge of your enemies gives you an advantage against them, granting you a swift reaction to their devilry.

4.name: Hellbreaker's Resolve
4.description: You gird yourself in both mind and body for danger, steeling your resolve.

6.name: High Alert
6.description: You're constantly on guard, keeping watch over your allies against fiendish forces—no one can get the jump on your group while you're around.

6.name: Oppurtune Trickster
6.description: You aren't above using underhanded tactics to gain an advantage, easily routing your opponents when they attack.

10.name: Battle Scars
10.description: You've faced enough opponents that your experience is written across your skin, toughening you against your fiendish foes.

10.name: Defy Hell
10.description: Your devotion to your cause gives you endless strength and courage to withstand the enemy's attacks.

12.name: Return to the Pit!
12.description: You can send the fiends who have vexed you back to their home plane where they belong.

12.name: Thorn in Hell's Side
12.description: Your devotion to the ideals of justice, freedom, and revolution allow you to truly punish those who stand in your way.

1.name: Point Blank Stance
1.description: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly.

1.name: Crossbow Ace
1.description: Your deep understanding of the crossbow allows you to reload efficiently while moving yourself out of the line of return fire.

1.name: Point-Blank Shot
1.description: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly.

2.name: Assisting Shot
2.description: Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat.

2.name: Archer Dedication
2.description: You have familiarity with all weapons in the bow and crossbow weapon groups.

4.name: Double Shot
4.description: You shoot twice in blindingly fast succession.

4.name: Parting Shot
4.description: You jump back and make a quick shot that catches your opponent by surprise.

4.name: Running Reload
4.description: You can reload your weapon on the move.

4.name: Quick Shot
4.description: You draw your bow and attack with the same action.

6.name: Triple Shot
6.description: You can quickly fire multiple shots with greater control.

6.name: Crossbow Terror
6.description: Your skill with a crossbow strikes terror into your opponents when you threaten them with the next bolt.

6.name: Advanced Bow Training
6.description: Through constant practice and the crucible of experience, you increase your skill with advanced bows.

6.name: Staggering Fire
6.description: You've learned how to fire at enemies to slow them down, allowing innocents and fellow knights alike time to escape.

8.name: Mobile Shot Stance
8.description: Your shots become nimble and deadly.

8.name: Archer's Aim
8.description: You slow down, focus, and take a careful shot.

16.name: Multishot Stance
16.description: You lock yourself in a stable position so you can fire swiftly and accurately.

18.name: Impossible Volley
18.description: You fire a volley at all foes in an area.

10.name: Unobstructed Shot
10.description: With a quick use of brute force, you remove an obstacle and take a calculated shot as part of the same motion.

1.name: Reactive Shield
1.description: You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second.

4.name: Shielded Stride
4.description: When your shield is up, your enemies' blows can't touch you.

4.name: Hurling Charge
4.description: You make a ranged Strike with your thrown weapon, Stride, and then Interact to draw another weapon.

4.name: Viking Weapon Familiarity
4.description: From childhood, you have been exposed to traditional viking combat techniques, and you soon learned to handle axe, sword, and shield in battle.

8.name: Quick Shield Block
8.description: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought.

8.name: Into the Fray
8.description: You charge into battle with shield-splintering fury.

8.name: Viking Vindicator
8.description: You are one of the raiders eagerly planning to launch an assault by sea on the Whispering Tyrant's Isle of Terror.

2.name: Viking Dedication
2.description: Vikings spend long periods of time at sea, only to leap from their boats at a moment's notice, charge through the surf, and take their enemies by storm.

6.name: Second Shield
6.description: You're used to your shield breaking in the middle of battle, and you're prepared to use a backup or any convenient nearby object to defend yourself.

6.name: Viking Weapon Specialist
6.description: You are even more skilled in the weapons of your people.

1.name: Snagging Strike
1.description: You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach.

2.name: Combat Grab
2.description: Using your prior attack to shift your opponent's guard, you take another swing and grab them.

2.name: Crushing Grab
2.description: Like a powerful constrictor, you crush targets in your unyielding grasp.

2.name: Wrestler Dedication
2.description: Your training in the wrestling arts has made you particularly adept at moving, striking, and grappling while unencumbered.

6.name: Whirling Throw
6.description: You propel your enemy away.

6.name: Clinch Strike
6.description: Your opponents can't slip your grasp without punishment.

14.name: Form Lock
14.description: Your ability to control your own qi empowers you to pressure other creatures into resuming their true forms.

14.name: Form Lock (Wrestler)
14.description: Your ability to manipulate your enemy's body is potent enough that you can tear and break apart alternate forms.

20.name: Godbreaker
20.description: You have mastered an ultimate grappling technique capable of breaking even the mightiest of foes.

4.name: Disengaging Twist
4.description: Your ability to twist your opponents' bodies into painful locks and holds makes you particularly adept at escaping such predicaments.

4.name: Elbow Breaker
4.description: You bend your opponent's body or limbs into agonizing positions that make it difficult for them to maintain their grip.

4.name: Suplex
4.description: Flexing your entire body, you heave your opponent over your head and slam them into the ground.

8.name: Running Tackle
8.description: You charge, throwing your body at your foe in a vicious tackle.

8.name: Strangle
8.description: You squeeze the breath out of your foe.

8.name: Submission Hold
8.description: Your iron grip saps your opponent's strength.

10.name: Aerial Piledriver
10.description: Heaving both yourself and your opponent into the air, you bring them crashing to the ground.

10.name: Spinebreaker
10.description: You squeeze your opponent in a vicious bear hug, putting intense pressure on their nerves, joints, or other pain points.

12.name: Inescapable Grasp
12.description: Your grasp has a supernatural quality to it, preventing your foes from easily escaping—with or without magical assistance.

1.name: Vicious Swing
1.description: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady.

1.name: Power Attack
1.description: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady.

4.name: Slam Down
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

4.name: Knockdown
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

10.name: Crashing Slam
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

10.name: Improved Knockdown
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

12.name: Brutal Finish
12.description: Your final blow can make an impact even if it rebounds off a foe's defenses.

12.name: Unbalancing Sweep
12.description: You make a great sweep with your weapon or fists about yourself, knocking creatures off their feet and away from you.

2.name: Mauler Dedication
2.description: You specialize in melee weapons that require two hands.

6.name: Clear the Way
6.description: You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path.

8.name: Shoving Sweep
8.description: You swing your weapon at your foe, rebuffing them back.

14.name: Hammer Quake
14.description: You smash the ground with your weapon, knocking nearby creatures to the ground.

16.name: Avalanche Strike
16.description: You attack all nearby adversaries.

1.name: Vicious Swing
1.description: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady.

1.name: Power Attack
1.description: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady.

2.name: Intimidating Strike
2.description: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence.

2.name: Battle Harbinger Dedication
2.description: You have trained extensively in combat, battlefield tactics, and stamina, focusing on being an exceptional warrior for your faith in exchange for less time studying the traditional spells and scriptures.

4.name: Bespell Strikes
4.description: You siphon spell energy into one weapon you're wielding, or into one of your unarmed attacks, such as a fist.

4.name: Bespell Weapon
4.description: You siphon the residual energy from the last spell you cast into one weapon you're wielding.

4.name: Aura Enhancement
4.description: You've enhanced your training with your battle magic, allowing you access to a more potent divine font.

4.name: Tandem Onslaught
4.description: You have trained your body and mind to work in tandem, and you can combine your combat and spellcasting prowess to better support yourself in battle.

6.name: Exigent Aura
6.description: The power of your deity and your own convictions leave an impression on creatures even when they normally would be unable to comprehend your words or the feelings spurred on by your god.

6.name: Harbinger's Protection
6.description: You often work on missions alone, making sure to cover up your weaknesses more effectively than other members of your faith.

8.name: Creed Magic
8.description: You've expanded your divine capabilities, granting you magic that better supports your combat focus.

8.name: Harbinger's Armament
8.description: Your deity grants you extra power that you have learned to channel into your weapons.

12.name: Empowered Onslaught
12.description: When your body and mind are perfectly in sync and pushed to the limit, it can produce even greater results.

12.name: Tandem Auras
12.description: You've learned how to maintain multiple auras at once, reinforcing them simultaneously.

16.name: Aura Expertise
16.description: You've become so accustomed to maintaining your battle auras that it's become second nature to you.

16.name: Greater Armament
16.description: Your weapons have greater power available to them.

20.name: Live the Creed
20.description: You've become an unparalleled figure among your faith, able to align your divine abilities with unparalleled swiftness.

2.name: Combat Grab
2.description: Using your prior attack to shift your opponent's guard, you take another swing and grab them.

2.name: Bashing Charge
2.description: You smash, bust, and charge through solid obstacles without hesitation.

2.name: Crushing Grab
2.description: Like a powerful constrictor, you crush targets in your unyielding grasp.

2.name: Zombie Dedication
2.prerequisite: You died and were animated as a husk zombie.
2.description: Despite your death and subsequent reanimation as a rotting corpse, you retain most of your mind and identity.

12.name: Corpse Stench
12.description: Your body exudes an overwhelming scent of decay in a 10-foot emanation, so putrid that it nauseates creates within that range.

12.name: Festering Wound
12.description: Wounds you inflict with your unarmed attacks fester and rot, becoming infected and difficult to heal.

4.name: Ankle Biter
4.description: You fight just as well on the ground as you do standing up.

4.name: Feast
4.description: You feast upon an adjacent restrained or unconscious creature, or a deceased creature that died in the past hour.

4.name: Ravenous Charge
4.description: Hungry for the flesh of the living, you hurl yourself into the fray, teeth gnashing.

6.name: Brains!
6.description: You consume the brains of your foe, causing synapses long rotten to fire and enabling you to shake off your mental torpor.

6.name: Numb
6.description: As your body continues to rot and putrefy, your senses deaden and your undead powers grow.

8.name: Out of Hand
8.description: Even when your limbs are severed, they remain a part of you.

8.name: Shamble
8.description: You may be slower than you were in life, but your pace is unfaltering.

8.name: Unkillable
8.description: You're relentless and nigh unkillable, shrugging off blows that should destroy you, though they might make your body start to fall apart.

14.name: Seize
14.description: You seize your foe and pull it close.

2.name: Dueling Parry (Fighter)
2.description: You can parry attacks against you with your one-handed weapon.

2.name: Duelist Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in light armor and simple weapons
2.description: You are always ready to draw your weapon and begin a duel, no matter the circumstances.

6.name: Disarming Stance
6.description: You adopt a fencing stance that improves your control over your weapon.

6.name: Watch This!
6.description: A common saying among Firebrands is, "There's always a fool who thinks they can do it better—and they're often right." You verbally commit to using an action on your next turn to make a melee Strike against the same enemy your ally has missed.

8.name: Dueling Riposte
8.description: You elegantly counterattack against your flailing enemy.

8.name: Selfless Parry
8.description: You protect those near to you with a flash of steel and a stroke of good luck.

10.name: Disarming Twist
10.description: After your initial attack redirects your foe's defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp.

12.name: Dueling Dance (Fighter)
12.description: Using a free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon.

12.name: Improved Dueling Riposte
12.description: Your weapon whirls and darts, striking foes whenever the slightest opening or moment of weakness presents itself.

12.name: Student of the Dueling Arts
12.description: Dueling is your art, and your weapon is your instrument.

14.name: Guiding Riposte
14.description: By shifting your weight and angling your weapon, you guide your opponent to a more favorable position.

4.name: Duelist's Challenge
4.description: Select one enemy you can see and proclaim a challenge against it.

4.name: Tut-Tut
4.description: The Sapphire Butterfly is not one for violence when simply intimidating a foe will do.

2.name: Intimidating Strike
2.description: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence.

2.name: Blackjacket Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in medium armor and martial weapons
2.description: You have entered the ranks of the Mercenary League and now wear the black uniform that's the source of the organization's popular epithet.

6.name: Shatter Defenses
6.description: Your offense exploits your enemy's fear.

6.name: Battlefield Agility
6.description: Your enemies might think they have you surrounded, but you know just how to extricate yourself.

4.name: Reactive Striker
4.description: You gain the Reactive Strike reaction.

4.name: Opportunist
4.description: You gain the Attack of Opportunity reaction.

4.name: Belay That!
4.description: You can recognize when a strategy isn't working and advise your ally to change course.

4.name: Mercenary Motivation
4.description: A large part of being in the Mercenary League entails doing mercenary work.

8.name: Lead by Example
8.description: You telegraph your next attack to let your allies in on your strategy.

8.name: Nothing Personal
8.description: When you're on a job, you can't allow anyone to stop you.

10.name: Close Contract
10.description: You're bolstered when a plan comes together.

10.name: Opportune Opening
10.description: Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe.

2.name: Lunge
2.description: You attack an enemy at the edge of your reach.

2.name: Thlipit Contestant Dedication
2.prerequisite: You have a long prehensile tongue or a tail. At the GM's discretion, similar flexible appendages, such as tentacles, can be used to qualify instead.
2.description: Grueling practice has strengthened your tongue or tail to the point where it's become a formidable weapon.

4.name: Slam Down
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

4.name: Knockdown
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

4.name: Fly Swat
4.description: You've learned the secret of swatting away annoying pests and occasionally getting an easy meal out of it.

4.name: Lassoing Lash
4.prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; Trained in Athletics
4.description: You quickly wrap your lash around an opponent and pull them toward you.

10.name: Crashing Slam
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

10.name: Improved Knockdown
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

10.name: Slingshot Maneuver
10.description: You spin your lash out for your ally to grab on to, giving them a boost to their movement.

6.name: Powerful Lash
6.description: You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs.

6.name: Snap Falling Fruit
6.description: Your lash whips around to intercept projectiles.

8.name: Levered Swing
8.prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; Master in Athletics
8.description: You can wrap your lash around a tree branch or railing, then pull yourself where you need to go.

8.name: Slurp Up
8.prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; unarmed attack with your tongue
8.description: Your tongue darts out in search of refreshment.

8.name: Tail Guard
8.prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; unarmed attack with your tail
8.description: Enemies who attempt to stab you in the back will be unhappy to find your lashing tail on guard.

12.name: Reflexive Grapple
12.description: You've honed your reflexes so well that your lash can begin closing around a target as soon as it makes contact.

14.name: Spinning Release
14.description: You wind your lash around your opponent, then spin them rapidly to discombobulate them.

16.name: Whirling Clobber
16.description: After you've grasped a creature with your lash, you swing them around like a whirling hammer, smashing them into all nearby enemies.

4.name: Barreling Charge
4.description: You rush forward, moving enemies aside to reach your foe.

4.name: Slam Down
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

4.name: Knockdown
4.description: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

4.name: Invoke Offense
4.description: You manifest a physical attack of the spirits all around you, such as the claw of an animal spirit or the whipping vine of a nature spirit.

10.name: Crashing Slam
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

10.name: Overpowering Charge
10.description: You trample foes as you charge past.

10.name: Improved Knockdown
10.description: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

10.name: Defy Sorrow
10.description: You draw on this spiritual pain to push your body to greater heights.

2.name: Rivethun Invoker Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Athletics; Trained in Religion
2.description: You're a practicing Rivethun invoker, able to enter a trance that connects you physically and mentally to surrounding spirits.

6.name: Leverage Anguish
6.description: You leverage your emotional turmoil to mend your physical form.

8.name: Invoke Defense
8.description: You manifest a defensive quality of spirits all around, such as the thick hide of an animal spirit or the sturdy bark of a nature spirit.

12.name: Invoke Movement
12.description: You manifest a form of locomotion of the spirits all around, such as the wings of an animal spirit or the watery flow of a nature spirit.

16.name: One with the Spirits
16.description: The spirits you've invoked throughout your life have left behind echoes and spiritual fragments, which you can manifest across your own flesh, temporarily transforming you into something more akin to spirit than mortal.

4.name: Barreling Charge
4.description: You rush forward, moving enemies aside to reach your foe.

4.name: Demon-Hunting Companion
4.description: You gain a young animal companion that has been specially trained to help you fight demons.

4.name: Wyldsinger
4.description: Passion and song are your weapons of choice.

14.name: Whirlwind Strike
14.description: You lash out in a blur of motion, attacking all nearby adversaries.

6.name: Mature Animal Companion (Ranger)
6.description: Your animal companion becomes a mature animal companion and gains additional capabilities (page 211).

6.name: Blessed Sentinel
6.description: You infuse a weapon with the blessing of Ketephys and attack.

10.name: Incredible Companion (Ranger)
10.description: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

16.name: Specialized Companion (Ranger)
16.description: Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability, and it is now cunning enough to become specialized.

16.name: Fiend Slayer
16.description: Your attack tears through a fiend, possibly sending it back to where it came from.

2.name: Wylderheart Dedication
2.description: You're primed to face off against threats from the Outer Rifts.

8.name: Primal Guardian
8.description: You grow in power as a guardian of nature.

12.name: Wild Dance
12.description: The combination of your passion for both life and the battle against evil makes you graceful and unpredictable.

18.name: Sacred Weapon
18.description: You're a living weapon honed to destroy fiends.

4.name: Shielded Stride
4.description: When your shield is up, your enemies' blows can't touch you.

4.name: Disarming Block
4.description: With deft and practiced movement, you block at an angle to potentially dislodge the weapon.

4.name: Everstand Strike
4.description: Your follow-up blow leaves you an opening to set your shield.

6.name: Reflexive Shield
6.description: You can use your shield to fend off explosions and the like.

6.name: Shield Warden
6.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

6.name: Nimble Shield Hand
6.description: You are so used to wielding a shield that you can do so even while using the hand that's holding it for other tasks that require the dexterity of a hand.

8.name: Quick Shield Block
8.description: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought.

8.name: Drive Back
8.description: You push the enemy back and attempt to intercede between the foe and your ally.

10.name: Mirror Shield
10.description: You reflect the spell back against its caster.

10.name: Destructive Block
10.description: You can protect yourself more effectively, at the expense of your shield.

10.name: Shield Salvation
10.description: You can save your shield from total destruction, even after a devastating attack.

16.name: Improved Reflexive Shield
16.description: Your shield can help save nearby allies.

2.name: Bastion Dedication
2.description: You are particularly skilled at using a shield to protect yourself in combat.

1.name: Everstand Stance
1.description: You brace your shield with both hands, enhancing its potential for both offense and defense.

1.name: Agile Shield Grip
1.description: You change your grip on the shield, allowing you to combine rapid attacks with your shield boss or shield spikes and your main weapon's Strikes in a series of swift motions.

4.name: Twin Parry
4.description: You use your two weapons to parry attacks.

4.name: Dual Thrower
4.description: You know how to throw two weapons as easily as strike with them.

4.name: Dual-Weapon Reload
4.description: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons.

10.name: Twin Riposte
10.description: A clever parry with one weapon leaves your opponent open to an attack with the other weapon.

10.name: Dual-Weapon Blitz
10.description: You attack as you weave your way around the battlefield.

14.name: Improved Twin Riposte (Fighter)
14.description: Your weapons are a blur, blocking and biting at your foes.

14.name: Two-Weapon Flurry
14.description: Using the momentum of your prior attack, you lash out with both your weapons in a sudden frenzy.

14.name: Dual Onslaught
14.description: When you lash out with both weapons, you leave no room for the target to escape your attack.

16.name: Twinned Defense (Fighter)
16.description: You're always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Dual-Weapon Warrior Dedication
2.description: You're exceptional in your use of two weapons.

8.name: Flensing Slice
8.description: When you hit with both attacks with Double Slice, you flense the target, making it bleed and creating a weak spot.

4.name: Twin Parry
4.description: You use your two weapons to parry attacks.

10.name: Twin Riposte
10.description: A clever parry with one weapon leaves your opponent open to an attack with the other weapon.

10.name: Shadow of Death
10.description: Strikes you make with your deity's favored weapon against a creature with the doomed condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

14.name: Improved Twin Riposte (Fighter)
14.description: Your weapons are a blur, blocking and biting at your foes.

1.name: Twin Takedown
1.description: You swiftly attack your hunted prey with each of your weapons, potentially combining their damage into a single devastating attack.

12.name: Second Sting
12.description: You read your prey's movements and transform them into openings, so failures with one weapon set up glancing blows with the other.

12.name: Slay
12.description: You finish your target with a vicious attack.

2.name: Avenger Dedication
2.description: Your training regimen has given you particular advantages when it comes to enforcing the interests of your faith.

6.name: Zealous Inevitability
6.description: You channel your zeal through a sacred weapon, bringing a foe closer to their demise.

8.name: Silence the Profane (Avenger)
8.description: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have now mastered and adapted.

6.name: Guardian's Deflection (Fighter)
6.description: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack.

6.name: Shield Warden
6.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

6.name: Guarded Mind
6.description: When your enemies try to turn your mind against you, thoughts of your anathema bolster you.

6.name: Wounded Party
6.description: Harm to either you or your allies awakens your fury.

4.name: Reactive Striker
4.description: You gain the Reactive Strike reaction.

4.name: Opportunist
4.description: You gain the Attack of Opportunity reaction.

4.name: Defender's Grit
4.description: You can't protect anyone if you're dead.

4.name: Guard's Fury
4.prerequisite: Ulfen Guard Dedication; you can't already use the Rage action
4.description: Some Ulfen Guards tap into a well of fury to protect their charges.

2.name: Ulfen Guard Dedication
2.prerequisite: member of the Ulfen Guard; Trained in Athletics; Trained in Intimidation
2.description: Central to your Ulfen Guard training is the ability to protect an ally.

8.name: Tight Follower
8.description: You keep up as a protector.

10.name: Protective Strike
10.description: You keep harm at bay.

6.name: Reflexive Shield
6.description: You can use your shield to fend off explosions and the like.

6.name: Shield Warden
6.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Armor Specialist
6.description: You have trained hard to optimize your armor's unique protective qualities to maximize the materials used in its creation.

6.name: Attack of Opportunity
6.description: You swat a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Commitment to Protection
6.prerequisite: Golden Legionnaire Dedication; Expert in Warfare Lore
6.description: You attempt to guide an ally into a more defensive pose against a particular danger.

6.name: Legion's Aim
6.description: Long hours of experimentation with the Platinum Wing have familiarized you with experimental weaponry.

6.name: Polished Distraction
6.description: You take pride in the sheen of your armor, and how useful it is at distracting your enemies when you reflect light from it.

16.name: Improved Reflexive Shield
16.description: Your shield can help save nearby allies.

16.name: Shield of Grace
16.description: You protect an ally with both your shield and your body.

16.name: Officer's Protection
16.description: When you use Commitment to Protection, you can target all allies within 30 feet.

4.name: Golden Legionnaire Dedication
4.description: You're a wall of metal standing against the tide of Andoran's enemies.

8.name: Armed and Armored
8.prerequisite: Golden Legionnaire Dedication; trained in martial firearms
8.description: You're used to juggling defensive equipment and your firearms.

8.name: Commitment to Valor
8.description: While fear might distract you from your duty, it'll never cause you to abandon it.

10.name: Crack Retort
10.prerequisite: Reactive Strike; trained in martial firearms
10.description: You can use Reactive Strike with a loaded firearm you're wielding.

10.name: Hell-Lancer Shot
10.prerequisite: Golden Legionnaire Dedication; trained in martial firearms
10.description: Make a ranged Strike with a firearm against a fiend, ignoring the fiend's concealed condition and any lesser cover.

10.name: Lasting Protection
10.description: When you use Commitment to Protection, the effects on your ally apply to all attacks the creature or hazard makes.

14.name: Commitment to Vigilance
14.description: Your foes find it difficult to maneuver around you without attracting your attention.

18.name: No Need to Fear
18.description: With a simple reminder of perseverance, you bolster the bravery of yourself and your allies.

6.name: Shield Warden
6.description: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

6.name: Knight Vigilant
6.prerequisite: Trained in Religion; any good alignment; member of the Knights of Lastwall of knight rank
6.description: You are dedicated to the cause of the Shining Sentinels.

10.name: Mirror Shield
10.description: You reflect the spell back against its caster.

10.name: Endure Death's Touch
10.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in medium or heavy armor
10.description: Your conviction redirects the undead's attack through your armor and then harmlessly away.

10.name: Vigil's Walls Rise Anew!
10.description: You can train your allies to Raise a Shield on your order

10.name: Emissary of Peace
10.description: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender.

10.name: Instant Armor
10.description: A knight is nothing without their armor, and you know how to keep yours ready.

10.name: Lead the Way
10.description: You move forward, creating an opening for others to follow.

10.name: Stalwart Standard
10.description: Your banner makes it harder for your foes to push your allies around and encourages your allies to protect the innocent.

8.name: Unshakable Idealism
8.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in Will saves
8.description: Your faith and hope can't be shaken, and you won't flee when lives are at stake.

8.name: Divine Healing
8.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Expert in Religion; worship a deity with a divine font that grants _heal_
8.description: Although you aren't a proper champion of your faith, your deity still recognizes your efforts and provides you with a small divine ability to help others.

8.name: Interrupt Charge
8.description: You attempt to snag the foe before they run away.

8.name: Phalanx Formation (Knight Vigilant)
8.description: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies.

12.name: Aegis of Arnisant
12.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Shield Block; Master in Religion
12.description: Inspired by the tale of Arnisant, you transform your shield into a magic ward.

12.name: Knight in Shining Armor
12.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in light armor, medium armor, or unarmored defense; trained in heavy armor
12.description: As a knight in shining armor, you train daily in the heaviest armor, expanding your expertise to heavy armor.

12.name: Guarded Advance (Knight Vigilant)
12.description: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution.

12.name: Vigilant Benediction
12.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; alignment permitted by the chosen deity
12.description: Unwilling to be outdone by the Crimson Reclaimers and their oath, you've petitioned the gods of good for a sliver of divine magic.

14.name: Instinctual Interception
14.description: You react to movement with hardly a thought, seeming constantly poised to spring.

14.name: Keep up the Good Fight
14.description: Your devotion to helping others and doing good keeps you going, even against insurmountable odds.

20.name: Empyreal Aura
20.description: As an ultimate foe of evil and protector of the innocent, your very presence is a ward against evil.

20.name: Tower Shield Mastery
20.description: You've learned how to maximize the defensive abilities of your tower shield.

16.name: Preternatural Polish
16.description: Armor you polish shines with righteous grace.

18.name: Body Barrier
18.description: When your allies are in danger, you don't hesitate to take the brunt of the blow for them.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Terrain Master
8.description: You are able to adapt to your surroundings in any natural terrain.

10.name: Warden's Step
10.description: You can guide your allies to move quietly through the wilderness.

10.name: Magical Adaptation
10.description: When an obstacle bars your path, you pull a trick from your sleeve to overcome it.

2.name: Horizon Walker Dedication
2.description: You've mastered travel within a specific type of terrain.

4.name: Acclimatization
4.description: Your time spent in the hostile parts of the world has inured you to extreme climates.

4.name: Sure Foot
4.prerequisite: Horizon Walker Dedication; Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Athletics
4.description: You know the secrets of moving in your favored terrain.

4.name: Rebel's Map
4.prerequisite: Horizon Walker Dedication or Scout Dedication
4.description: Rebellions require an intricate knowledge of one's surroundings—because you might need to escape at any moment.

6.name: Perpetual Scout
6.description: You spot anything out of place in the areas you know best.

12.name: Wild Strider
12.description: Natural obstacles pose no obstacle to you.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Sense Evil
8.description: You sense evil as a queasy or foreboding feeling.

8.name: Spirit's Anguish
8.description: You purify a spirit by coaxing it to release its anguish in a final cathartic howl.

8.name: Sense Unholiness
8.description: You sense the truly wicked as a queasy or foreboding feeling.

14.name: Sense the Unseen
14.description: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.

6.name: Spiritual Sense
6.description: You have a vague connection to the Ethereal Plane that enables you to notice spirits.

6.name: Cast Out
6.description: You attempt to cast a malevolent entity out of the creature or object it's possessing.

6.name: Spirit's Absolution
6.description: You purify a spirit by absolving it of its sins and regrets.

4.name: Exorcist Dedication
4.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
4.description: You've learned to attract, quell, and purify spirits, housing them in a special receptacle called a spirit dwelling until they're ready to move on.

12.name: Enticing Dwelling
12.description: Your spirit dwelling is particularly inviting to spirit wisps.

8.name: Blind-Fight
8.description: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

8.name: Hazard Finder
8.description: You have an intuitive ability to sense hazards.

8.name: Bolster Ally
8.description: You shout encouragement to your embattled ally.

10.name: Tactical Reflexes
10.description: You are particularly swift at punishing foes who leave you openings.

10.name: Combat Reflexes
10.description: You are particularly swift at punishing foes who leave you openings.

10.name: Stir Allies
10.description: You shout a command for your allies to scramble.

14.name: Determination
14.description: Your training allows you to shrug off your foes' spells and conditions when the need is dire.

14.name: Immediate Rebuke
14.description: You can use Reactive Strike when a creature within your reach Strikes one of your allies.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Eagle Knight Dedication

2.description: Eagle Knights are the marshals and envoys of Andoran and are committed to keeping the peace.

4.name: Reactive Striker
4.description: You gain the Reactive Strike reaction.

4.name: Opportunist
4.description: You gain the Attack of Opportunity reaction.

4.name: Commitment to Equality
4.prerequisite: Eagle Knight Dedication; Expert in Diplomacy
4.description: You help an ally shake off any impediment that would give an enemy an unfair advantage.

4.name: Interpose
4.description: You put yourself between an ally and danger.

6.name: Commitment to Justice
6.description: When your allies are harmed, you deliver retribution.

6.name: Commitment to Liberty
6.description: You can't abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip.

12.name: Aura of Confidence
12.description: Your will and your faith in your nation is unassailable, and the feeling is contagious.

12.name: Talmandor's Shout
12.prerequisite: Eagle Knight Dedication; Master in Intimidation
12.description: After seeing an enemy harm one of your allies, you deliver a righteous shout in the name of the celestial Talmandor.

18.name: Impossible Volley
18.description: You fire a volley at all foes in an area.

18.name: Fatal Shot
18.description: You modify an arrow or bolt to bring death to your target in a single potent hit.

18.name: Master Eldritch Archer Spellcasting
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Arrow of Death
18.description: You modify an arrow or bolt to bring death to your target in a single potent hit.

4.name: Running Reload
4.description: You can reload your weapon on the move.

6.name: Eldritch Archer Dedication
6.prerequisite: expert in at least one weapon from the or bow or crossbow weapon group
6.description: You channel powerful magic with your archery, allowing you to deliver potent spells through the tip of an arrow rather than the more mundane flick of the wrist or whatever other gestures are usually used.

8.name: Basic Eldritch Archer Spellcasting
8.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

8.name: Enchanting Shot
8.description: With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks.

8.name: Magic Ammunition
8.description: You imbue your ammunition with raw and potent magic, transforming it to suit your needs in any situation.

8.name: Precious Ammunition
8.description: You have learned to mimic the power that lies between magic and material.

8.name: Enchanting Arrow
8.description: With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks.

8.name: Magic Arrow
8.description: You imbue your ammunition with eldritch power.

8.name: Precious Arrow
8.description: You enchant a piece of ammunition with the magical essence of a precious material, allowing you to leverage certain creatures' weaknesses.

10.name: Eldritch Reload
10.description: You integrate your talent for magic into your use of reloading weapons.

12.name: Expert Eldritch Archer Spellcasting
12.description: You learn additional eldritch archer magic.

14.name: Homing Shot
14.description: Your shots zip around corners and fly at impossible angles to reach your target.

14.name: Seeker Arrow
14.description: Your shots zip around corners and fly at impossible angles to reach your target.

16.name: Incorporeal Shot
16.description: You can concentrate an immense amount of magic to create a piece of ammunition that phases through everything but your target.

16.name: Phase Arrow
16.description: You can concentrate an immense amount of magic to create a piece of ammunition that phases through everything but your target.

1.name: Monster Hunter
1.description: You quickly assess your prey and apply what you know.

12.name: Double Prey
12.description: You can focus on two foes at once, hunting both of them down.

2.name: Bounty Hunter Dedication
2.description: When focused on finding your quarry, you're relentless.

4.name: Posse
4.description: By spending 1 minute giving guidance to help hunt down your prey, you instruct up to five willing creatures to assist you.

4.name: Tools of the Trade
4.description: You're well-versed in weapons that allow you to bring bounties back in one piece, or at least alive.

6.name: Keep Pace
6.description: Once you are upon your prey, they can't escape.

8.name: Opportunistic Grapple
8.description: You use an opening to capture your prey.

2.name: Animal Empathy (Ranger)
2.description: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

2.name: Wild Mimic Dedication
2.description: Fighting in the wilds has honed your understanding of the unique abilities many creatures have.

1.name: Crane Stance
1.description: Your arms flutter like a crane's wings.

1.name: Tiger Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a tiger and can make tiger claw attacks.

1.name: Wolf Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a wolf, low to the ground with your hands held like fangs.

1.name: Gorilla Stance
1.description: You lower yourself to the ground and take an imposing, knuckle-walking stance.

6.name: Crane Flutter
6.description: You interpose your arm between yourself and your opponent.

6.name: Tiger Slash
6.description: You make a fierce swipe with both hands.

6.name: Wolf Drag
6.description: You rip your enemy off their feet.

6.name: Gorilla Pound
6.description: You pound your chest before slamming into your foes.

6.name: Electrogenesis
6.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature deal electricity damage with an unarmed Strike or have identified a creature capable of dealing electricity damage with an unarmed Strike in combat
6.description: Some animals and beasts have electric organs in their body that they can use to jolt their prey.

6.name: Primal Proportions
6.description: You can mimic the sheer mass of the largest beasts.

6.name: Wild Speech
6.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; Animal Empathy (Ranger) or the ability to speak with a type of animal
6.description: Your connection to the denizens of the wilds grows ever stronger, and you find yourself able to speak with animals like you would in your native tongue.

4.name: Ferocity Mimicry
4.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have encountered a creature who has kept fighting or dealt damage after being reduced to 0 Hit Points (such as via death throes or Ferocity) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
4.description: You have trained yourself to continue fighting even when your body is screaming for you to stop.

4.name: Rend Mimicry
4.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use Rend or have identified a creature that has Rend in combat
4.description: Taking advantage of the brutal efficiency of hacking away at a target with two slashing attacks, you've mastered the art of punishing a foe caught between your slices.

8.name: Environmental Adaptability
8.description: Having experienced the harshest environs that nature has to offer, your body is able to adapt to intense heat and cold.

10.name: Petrifying Gaze Mimicry
10.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have attempted a saving throw against a creature's petrifying gaze or a similar ability or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
10.description: Either by witnessing or surviving the petrifying stare of a medusa or similar creature, you have learned to petrify those you lock eyes with.

10.name: Trample Mimicry
10.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use Trample or have identified a creature with Trample in combat
10.description: You Stride up to double your speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, trampling each creature whose space you enter.

12.name: Roar Mimicry
12.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have been targeted by a creature's auditory ability that effects an area or have identified a creature with an auditory ability that effects an area
12.description: You unleash a roar so loud that it's felt as deeply as it's heard.

14.name: Pounce Mimicry
14.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use an ability that lets them Stride and Strike as a single action (such as Pounce) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
14.description: You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable.

16.name: Emergency Regeneration
16.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have deactivated a creature's regeneration for at least 1 round or have identified a creature with regeneration in combat
16.description: You have battled against foes whose bodies naturally regenerate, and while yours doesn't do so all the time, it can happen in a pinch.

2.name: Favored Terrain
2.description: You have studied a specific terrain to overcome its challenges.

8.name: Terrain Master
8.description: You are able to adapt to your surroundings in any natural terrain.

8.name: Salt Kissed
8.description: You have a supernatural ability to survive at sea and keep your companions from drowning.

8.name: Uncanny Prediction
8.description: You have an eerie ability to guess the next move of creatures you've Sized Up.

14.name: Sense the Unseen
14.description: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.

14.name: Perplex
14.description: You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly.

7.name: Evangelize
7.prerequisite: Master in Diplomacy; follower of a specific religion or philosophy
7.description: You point out a detail that incontrovertibly supports your faith, causing a listener's mind to whirl.

4.name: Steel Falcon Dedication
4.description: You serve as an envoy of the ideals of Andoran, whether it's in a foreign court or on the field of battle.

6.name: Denounce Tyranny
6.description: You call out a creature's despicable or cowardly actions, disrupting its alliances or even making its allies ashamed to be seen with it.

6.name: Gray Corsair Training
6.prerequisite: Steel Falcon Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
6.description: You strike for Andoran on the waters of the Inner Sea and beyond.

6.name: Liberty's Promise
6.prerequisite: Steel Falcon Dedication; Trained in Religion
6.description: Your devotion to Andoran's ideals is as much spiritual as philosophical.

10.name: Eye for Smugglers
10.description: Your time checking seemingly innocent cargo ships for illicit goods has made you as canny as you are suspicious.

12.name: Liberty's Devotion
12.description: You've deepened your connection with the ideals of Andoran.

16.name: Frightening Indignation
16.description: Your anger at the world's many injustices boil out from you in a wave of palpable energy.

2.name: Hunter's Aim
2.description: When you focus on aiming, your attack becomes particularly accurate.

2.name: Game Hunter Dedication
2.description: You are skilled at tracking big game animals and similar creatures.

4.name: Running Reload
4.description: You can reload your weapon on the move.

4.name: Big Game Trapper
4.description: You can set snares specifically for big prey, leaving smaller creatures unscathed.

12.name: Double Prey
12.description: You can focus on two foes at once, hunting both of them down.

8.name: Quick Positioning
8.description: You're always ready to get the jump on your target.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Vigilante Dedication
2.description: You have two identities, each with its own name and abilities.

4.name: Hidden Magic
4.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
4.description: You've learned to hide the magical auras of your gear.

4.name: Minion Guise
4.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Deception; animal companion or familiar
4.description: When you are in your social identity, you can also grant a social identity to an animal companion, familiar, pet, or other minion you gained from a class feature or feat.

4.name: Safe House
4.description: You establish a safe house—a secure space in which to hide your secrets from the outside world.

4.name: Social Purview
4.description: You have built a reputation for yourself in your social identity.

6.name: Startling Appearance
6.description: You can startle foes who are unaware of your presence.

6.name: Startling Appearance (Vigilante)
6.description: You can startle foes who are unaware of your presence.

7.name: Quick Change
7.description: You can shift between your identities with ease.

7.name: Subjective Truth
7.description: Your disparate identities allow you to defeat magic that detects lies.

8.name: Many Guises
8.description: You can take on any number of mundane guises.

8.name: Reminder of the Greater Fear
8.description: You give a target a stern glower to remind them that it is you, and no one else, they should truly fear.

12.name: Frightening Appearance
12.description: Your dramatic appearances can frighten bystanders.

16.name: Stunning Appearance
16.description: Your sudden appearance leaves your foe unable to respond.

14.name: It Was Me All Along!
14.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication or Vigilante Dedication
14.description: You discard a disguise and dramatically reveal your true identity, catching your foes off guard.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Alkenstar Agent Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Deception; trained at least one firearm
2.description: You put on the persona of a rough and tumble outlaw, but your real goals are to report threats to Alkenstar back to the grand duchess.

4.name: Running Reload
4.description: You can reload your weapon on the move.

4.name: Reactive Pursuit
4.description: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

4.name: Loose Cannon
4.description: Your unpredictable gunfire often catches enemies off guard or hits unprotected areas.

6.name: Snap Shot
6.description: You can react with ranged weapons when a creature is in close quarters.

1.name: Plant Evidence
1.description: You can put a single item you're holding of light or negligible Bulk onto a person without them noticing by succeeding at a Thievery check against their Perception DC.

14.name: Instant Opening
14.description: You distract your opponent with a few choice words or a rude gesture.

7.name: Prepare Papers
7.prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Society
7.description: You're practiced at creating forgeries that establish your outlaw credentials or augment your legal authority.

10.name: Flash your Badge
10.prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Intimidation
10.description: You make a fearsome show of your authority.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Underhanded Assault
2.description: You capitalize on the distraction provided by an ally.

2.name: Red Mantis Assassin Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in sawtooth sabers; worshipper of Achaekek; lawful evil alignment; member of the Red Mantis assassins
2.description: Dedicate yourself to the assassins of Achaekek.

1.name: Twin Feint
1.description: You use an attack with one weapon to distract your foe from a second attack coming at a different angle.

4.name: Poison Weapon
4.description: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action.

4.name: Twin Distraction
4.description: Your movements with two weapons are so swift and disorienting that they befuddle your opponent.

4.name: Basic Red Mantis Magic
4.prerequisite: Trained in Religion; Red Mantis Assassin Dedication
4.description: You have learned limited divine magic from your Red Mantis training.

6.name: Gang Up
6.description: You and your allies harry an opponent in concert.

6.name: Advanced Red Mantis Magic
6.description: Your Red Mantis magical training has improved.

6.name: Crimson Shroud
6.description: You can surround yourself with bloody mist.

6.name: Red Mantis School Spell
6.description: You gain the Red Mantis magic school's initial school spell.

8.name: Opportune Backstab
8.description: When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction.

8.name: Advanced School Spell
8.description: You gain access to the advanced teachings of your arcane institution, learning a powerful new school spell.

8.name: Mantis Form
8.description: You can transform yourself into a mantis battle form.

8.name: Achaekek's Grip
8.description: You sense if a creature you have slain in the last year has been restored to life, as long as you and that creature are on the same plane.

10.name: Fading
10.description: You fade partially from reality.

14.name: Prayer Attack
14.description: You've mastered the signature assassination style of the Red Mantis.

12.name: Vernai Training
12.prerequisite: Achaekek's Grip; Advanced Red Mantis Magic
12.description: To resurrect a creature you've slain, a spellcaster must counteract your influence on its death.

12.name: Expert Red Mantis Magic
12.prerequisite: Master in Religion; Basic Red Mantis Magic
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits

18.name: Master Red Mantis Magic
18.prerequisite: Legendary in Religion; Basic Red Mantis Magic
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Quick Draw
2.description: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

2.name: Rose Warden Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; you worship Milani
2.description: As a follower of the Everbloom, you stand up against tyranny and oppression, understanding that revolution against an unjust ruler must sometimes be enacted in secret.

4.name: Reactive Pursuit
4.description: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

4.name: Blessed Thorn Strike
4.description: When you see a foe hurt one of your allies, your righteous retribution causes your weapon to sprout holy thorns.

4.name: Holy Bloom
4.description: Though you might not be a priest of Milani, her divine spirit flows through you.

6.name: Light Step
6.description: You aren't bothered by tricky footing.

6.name: Unbalancing Appearance
6.description: When you attack from the shadows, your foes are thrown off balance.

6.name: Unfettering Strike
6.description: With a damaging blow, you cause a foe to loosen their grip on an ally they're holding down.

12.name: Spring from the Shadows
12.description: You leap from hiding and assail your target.

12.name: Rise Up!
12.description: Sometimes, you must even slip the chains of gravity to rebel.

8.name: Liberated Mind
8.description: Your mind won't be held hostage by those who would seek to control you.

8.name: Wall of Roses
8.description: Roses are the symbol of Milani, and you can call forth a wall of them to stymie those who don't follow her teachings.

10.name: Holy Flower
10.description: Milani's grace empowers you further.

4.name: Companion's Cry
4.description: You can urge your companion to do its utmost.

4.name: Additional Companion
4.description: Another animal joins you in your travels.

4.name: Mature Beastmaster Companion
4.description: All of your animal companions grow up, becoming mature animal companions and gaining additional capabilities. Your animal companion has greater independence.

8.name: Incredible Beastmaster Companion
8.description: Your mature animal companions continue to grow and develop.

8.name: Guardian Ghosts
8.description: You magically divert some of the harm from an incoming attack away from yourself, forcing your undead companion to take it in your stead.

14.name: Specialized Beastmaster Companion
14.description: Your nimble and savage animal companions become cunning enough to become specialized.

16.name: Lead the Pack
16.prerequisite: Mature Beastmaster Companion; you have multiple animal companions
16.description: You can have up to two animal companions active at once.

2.name: Undead Master Dedication
2.description: You gain the services of an undead companion that travels with you and obeys your commands.

12.name: Their Master's Call
12.prerequisite: Undead Master Dedication; Call Companion, at least one inactive undead companion whose remains or anchor are currently in your possession.
12.description: In a pinch, you pull one of your inactive companions from their rest to provide a companion's support benefit.

4.name: Running Reload
4.description: You can reload your weapon on the move.

4.name: Poison Weapon
4.description: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action.

4.name: Repeating Hand Crossbow Training
4.description: You become trained in the repeating hand crossbow and gain access to repeating hand crossbows and shootist bandoliers.

6.name: Skirmish Strike
6.description: Your feet and weapon move in tandem.

6.name: Reloading Trick
6.description: You can fire off a single shot even when unprepared. You Interact to reload your hand crossbow and Strike with it.

2.name: Drow Shootist Dedication
2.description: Every chance you get, you practice with the hand crossbow to increase your draw speed and accuracy.

8.name: Lethargy Poisoner
8.prerequisite: Drow Shootist Dedication; Trained in Crafting
8.description: You've learned more than the use of hand crossbows from drow lore.

4.name: Scout's Warning
4.description: You visually or audibly warn your allies of danger, granting them each a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

4.name: Reactive Pursuit
4.description: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

10.name: Camouflage
10.description: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness.

10.name: Sneak Adept
10.description: It's almost impossible to spot you.

10.name: Sneak Savant
10.description: It is almost impossible to spot you without taking effort to look.

10.name: Shall Not Falter, Shall Not Rout
10.description: You gain the shall not falter, shall not rout focus spell.

10.name: Hilt Hammer
10.description: You know how to turn any weapon into a bone-crushing implement of skeletal destruction.

6.name: Knight Reclaimant Dedication
6.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival; any non-evil alignment; member of the Knights of Lastwall of knight rank
6.description: You have sworn the Crimson Oath and become a full member of the Crimson Reclaimers.

8.name: Invoke the Crimson Oath
8.description: You can invoke the Crimson Oath to unleash blasts of ruby energy from your weapon.

8.name: Survivor of Desolation
8.description: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against unnatural weather events or environmental hazards occurring in blighted or otherwise unnaturally marred regions.

12.name: Reaper of Repose
12.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; master proficiency in a weapon
12.description: Your skill and fervor allow you to pierce undead defenses and exploit their weaknesses.

12.name: Blade of the Crimson Oath
12.description: You call upon the Crimson Oath to smite undead and then make a weapon or unarmed Strike against an undead foe.

12.name: For Love, For Lightning
12.description: Rumors suggest this technique was pioneered by knights who undertook missions for Clarethe Iomedar at the half-moon, but many Crimson Reclaimers have since mastered it.

12.name: Reclaimant Plea
12.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; ability to cast divine spells
12.description: You call on the power of the Crimson Oath to gain magical aid.

12.name: Shepherd of Desolation
12.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Survivor of Desolation
12.description: You know how to keep others alive in the Gravelands' murkiest shadows.

7.name: Ashen Veil
7.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Expert in Religion; Master in Stealth
7.description: By smearing ash or tainted earth over your skin and armor, you shroud yourself from the dead.

7.name: Voice Cold as Death
7.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Master in Intimidation
7.description: Channeling the energy of the Crimson Oath into your voice, you pronounce a threat in a tone so icy it freezes the blood.

14.name: Crimson Oath Devotion
14.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; ability to cast focus spells
14.description: You've made the Crimson Oath a part of yourself; you mumble it in your sleep and recite it under your breath as you march.

20.name: The Tyrant Falls!
20.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Invoke the Crimson Oath
20.description: You've reached the apex of the Crimson Oath's power.

20.name: May Death Itself Reconsider
20.description: Your will is so steadfast that even death can't stop you.

16.name: Grave Threat
16.description: You use your imposing demeanor to set up the undead for defeat.

18.name: Cut them Down, Burn them Out
18.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; master proficiency in a weapon
18.description: Inspired by the sixth line of the Crimson Oath, when you oppose the enemies of Lastwall, you aim to excise the rot from the land itself.

6.name: Skirmish Strike
6.description: Your feet and weapon move in tandem.

6.name: Infiltrator's Reload
6.prerequisite: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication; Expert in Stealth
6.description: You specialize in reloading while preparing for the next step in your infiltration.

4.name: Dual-Weapon Reload
4.description: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons.

4.name: Crescent Cross Training
4.description: You have familiarity with the crescent cross, an ingenious weapon that combines an arm-mounted, multi-chamber crossbow with a crescent-shaped blade.

2.name: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication
2.description: You have mastered stealthy weapons that allow you to strike carefully from a distance far enough to avoid reprisal, yet close enough to confirm your kills.

10.name: Infiltration Assassination
10.description: With a high-priority target in reach, you quickly move to eliminate them.

14.name: Unseen Shot
14.description: Your attacks are deadly, silent, and nearly untraceable.

16.name: Infiltrator's Blitz
16.description: Though your training is meant to ensure you don't get caught by your enemies, your missions are often high risk, and sometimes the only option you have left when things go wrong is to unleash a blistering torrent of violence while running away as fast as possible.

10.name: Camouflage
10.description: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness.

10.name: Scout's Pounce
10.description: You leap from the shadows to strike at your foes.

2.name: Scout Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival
2.description: You are a highly skilled scout, capable of guiding your allies, detecting imminent threats, and avoiding the attention of dangerous enemies.

4.name: Scout's Charge
4.description: You meander around unpredictably, and then ambush your opponents without warning.

4.name: Terrain Scout
4.description: You have mastered movement in many different environments.

4.name: Eclipsed Vitality
4.prerequisite: Assassin Dedication or Scout Dedication; Master in Stealth
4.description: You shroud yourself in ashes that hide the vital essence sought by life-sensing undead.

4.name: Rebel's Map
4.prerequisite: Horizon Walker Dedication or Scout Dedication
4.description: Rebellions require an intricate knowledge of one's surroundings—because you might need to escape at any moment.

6.name: Fleeting Shadow
6.description: You're able to quickly disappear and then move about without drawing the attention of your enemies.

6.name: Scout's Speed
6.description: You move faster, especially when traveling, allowing you to scout out ahead and report back without slowing your allies.

10.name: Camouflage
10.description: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness.

10.name: Sneak Adept
10.description: It's almost impossible to spot you.

10.name: Scout's Pounce
10.description: You leap from the shadows to strike at your foes.

10.name: Sneak Savant
10.description: It is almost impossible to spot you without taking effort to look.

10.name: Sense the Strike
10.prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Master in Survival
10.description: You sense how an incoming attack moves through ambient primal energy, predicting how best to dodge.

4.name: Sneak Attacker
4.description: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except it deals 1d4 damage, increasing to 1d6 at 6th level.

4.name: Canopy Predator
4.prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Trained in Athletics
4.description: You are as at home in the treetops as you are beneath their branches.

4.name: Underbrush Trailblazer
4.description: You gain the Terrain Stalker feat, selecting the underbrush terrain; if you already have Terrain Stalker for underbrush, you can select a different type of difficult terrain.

6.name: Fleeting Shadow
6.description: You're able to quickly disappear and then move about without drawing the attention of your enemies.

6.name: Verduran Ambush
6.prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Expert in Stealth
6.description: You prepare to ambush a foe.

2.name: Verduran Shadow Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival
2.description: Your awareness of primal energies allows you to explore forests with preternatural ease.

14.name: Sense the Unseen
14.description: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.

14.name: Shadow Power
14.description: You can focus the shadows into a powerful blast.

12.name: Spring from the Shadows
12.description: You leap from hiding and assail your target.

12.name: Additional Shadow Magic
12.description: Choose an additional shadowdancer focus spell you haven't already selected from Shadow Magic.

12.name: Shadow Illusion
12.description: With an artful eye, you shape shadows into illusory forms.

16.name: Cognitive Loophole
16.description: You can find a loophole in a mental effect to temporarily overcome it.

10.name: Uncanny Dodge
10.description: You gain the deny advantage class feature.

10.name: Shadow Sneak Attack
10.description: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except you deal 1d6 precision damage regardless of your level.

10.name: Shadow Magic
10.description: You gain the ability to fuse and play with shadows by using focus spells specific to shadowdancers.

8.name: Shadowdancer Dedication
8.prerequisite: Master in Stealth; Expert in Performance
8.description: You dedicate yourself to the shadows.

18.name: Shadow Master
18.description: The shadows protect you better than any armor can, and they give you power to plunge others into darkness.

1.name: Plant Evidence
1.description: You can put a single item you're holding of light or negligible Bulk onto a person without them noticing by succeeding at a Thievery check against their Perception DC.

4.name: Sabotage
4.description: You subtly damage others' equipment.

4.name: Twilight Talon Dedication
4.description: Few would even suspect that you're a member of the Eagle Knights, and you use the tricks of the spymaster's trade to keep it that way.

16.name: Blank Slate
16.description: Your deceptions confound even the most powerful magic that could spy on you.

16.name: Implausible Purchase
16.description: It seems impossible, but you've analyzed every angle and are able to just keep pulling out exactly the item you need, even in far-flung locations.

16.name: Implausible Purchase (Investigator)
16.description: It seems impossible, but you've analyzed every angle and are able to just keep pulling out exactly the item you need, even in far-flung locations.

6.name: Predictive Purchase
6.description: You have just the thing for the situation.

6.name: Make Do
6.description: You sometimes need to act in a pinch, even if you haven't had the time to repair your gear.

6.name: Predictive Purchase (Investigator)
6.description: You have just the thing for the situation.

6.name: Talon's Mark
6.description: On the rare occasions that Twilight Talons need to identify themselves as members of the organization, many rely on an easily concealed tattoo to reveal their allegiance.

7.name: Fabricated Credentials
7.prerequisite: Twilight Talon Dedication; Master in Deception
7.description: You're so familiar with the paperwork necessary to maintain your cover that you can easily whip up documents that support your fabrications.

8.name: Deceptive Deduction
8.description: You've had to take on many roles while working undercover, so you're practiced at following the example of those around you to pretend expertise in a variety of fields.

10.name: Hidden Intentions
10.prerequisite: Twilight Talon Dedication; Master in Deception
10.description: You layer meanings in your words, and only those you've taken into your confidence can divine your true plans.

10.name: Inked Cache
10.description: You've learned to use your Twilight Talon's mark to secret away contraband.

12.name: Feign Innocence
12.description: You convince a creature that, despite appearances, you're on its side.

14.name: Instant Credentials
14.description: In a pinch, ink from your tattoo arranges itself into a temporary pass, writ of authority, or similar document.

18.name: Burn Identity
18.description: You transport yourself up to 1 mile, as a 5th-rank translocate spell.

1.name: Trap Finder
1.description: You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the presence of traps.

8.name: Delay Trap
8.description: You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects.

8.name: Archaeologist's Luck
8.description: You are more than just skillful; your drive to find the secrets of the past manifests as a strange kind of luck.

2.name: Archaeologist Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Society; Trained in Thievery
2.description: You are a student of peoples and their histories, and are in constant pursuit of knowledge and artifacts from the past.

4.name: Magical Scholastics
4.description: While study is key to your success, a bit of magic can be a helpful aid in discovering the secrets of the past.

4.name: Settlement Scholastics
4.description: Your studies open up new horizons.

7.name: Scholastic Identification
7.description: You have the knowledge needed to understand ancient texts and cultural artifacts.

10.name: Greater Magical Scholastics
10.description: You broaden the scope of your magical understanding, allowing you to find the right path, detect hidden objects, and conceal those objects from unscrupulous rivals.

3.name: We're on the List
