3.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication or Archaeologist Dedication; Trained in Society
3.description: Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same.

1.name: You're Next
1.description: After downing a foe, you menace another.

2.name: Antagonize
2.description: Your taunts and threats earn your foes' ire.

2.name: Pirate Dedication
2.description: As a pirate, you sail the seas in search of enemy ships to plunder and great adventures to embark on.

4.name: Pirate Combat Training
4.description: You're particularly skilled at wielding the weapons used traditionally by pirates.

4.name: Rope Runner
4.prerequisite: Pirate Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics; Trained in Athletics
4.description: You run and climb across ropes and rigging almost as easily as on the ground.

4.name: Bitter Taste of Betrayal
4.description: Spend enough time in Hell Harbor, and you pick up the paranoia encouraged by Arronax Endymion.

4.name: Inner Sea Privateer
4.prerequisite: Pirate Dedication; Expert in Sailing Lore
4.description: You make your living as a pirate, as well as a little extra by hiring out your services to Andoran, Cheliax, or Mbe'ke.

4.name: Into the Storm
4.description: Many Shackles pirates use the Eye of Abendego to great effect, but none have more familiarity with the storm than the Master of the Gales, ruler of Drenchport and five-time winner of the Free Captains' Regatta.

4.name: Pirate's Pet
4.description: An animal has become your loyal ally, perhaps after you liberated it from another ship or found it on a remote island.

4.name: Sharkskin Grip
4.description: You served on nephilim pirate Ila "Sharkskin" Clare's ship, the Scorched Shark , and have adopted xir practice of embellishing clothing and armor with sharkskin.

4.name: Pirate Weapon Training
4.description: You're particularly skilled at wielding traditional pirate weapons.

4.name: Broadside Buckos
4.description: Shimali Manux trains every Salt Breaker to fight in the cramped quarters below deck, and you've learned how to use these techniques with your crew.

8.name: Walk the Plank
8.description: You frighten a foe into moving where you want them, traditionally demanding they walk the plank.

5.name: Cutting Flattery
5.prerequisite: Dandy Dedication or Pirate Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
5.description: Repeated entries in Firebrand bragging and flyting contests have taught you how to twist pretty words into concealed insults.

6.name: Watch This!
6.description: A common saying among Firebrands is, "There's always a fool who thinks they can do it better—and they're often right." You verbally commit to using an action on your next turn to make a melee Strike against the same enemy your ally has missed.

10.name: Hook 'Em
10.description: The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat.

4.name: Reactive Pursuit
4.description: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

4.name: Guarded Movement
4.description: Your guard is up, even while moving.

4.name: Replenishing Consumption
4.description: When you devour corpses and satiate your hunger, you also recover from some of your wounds, your necrotized blue flesh knitting back together almost immediately as soon as you begin shoveling the chunks of dead flesh down your throat.

4.name: Swift Leap
4.description: Your undead physiology allows you to leap quickly toward or away from your opponent.

8.name: Wall Run
8.description: You defy gravity, traversing vertical planes as easily as the ground.

8.name: Paralyzing Slash
8.description: Your enzymes can paralyze your foes rather than merely making it harder for them to heal their wounds.

8.name: Sickening Bite
8.description: Your saliva causes severe nausea and mild fever in the living, weakening them so that you can more easily finish them off.

2.name: Ghoul Dedication
2.prerequisite: You were killed by ghoul fever.
2.description: You have succumbed to ghoul fever, dying and returning as a ghoul, an undead cursed with a never-ending hunger for dead flesh that slowly overrides your reason and willpower until you would do anything for the meal you crave.

6.name: Feverish Enzymes
6.description: Your claws and fangs exude an infectious enzyme, related to the necrotic effects of ghoul fever, that causes a creature's wounds to heal slowly.

6.name: Grave Strength
6.description: The flesh you've consumed over the course of your existence as a ghoul has made you stronger, gifting you with strange insights from the minds of the sapient creatures you've devoured and bringing you closer to a state of undead perfection.

10.name: Glutton for Flesh
10.description: You have developed a capacity to store more flesh within your gaunt body to leave yourself satiated longer.

10.name: Flailtongue
10.description: Your tongue has mutated into a lashing weapon reminiscent of Kabriri's bone-laden flail.

12.name: Corpse Stench
12.description: Your body exudes an overwhelming scent of decay in a 10-foot emanation, so putrid that it nauseates creates within that range.

12.name: Competitive Eater
12.description: Gorging on flesh after your stomach is full fortifies you, making you hardy enough to withstand more punishment.

12.name: Secret Eater
12.description: You have discovered and found favor with the cult within the church of Kabriri known as the Secret Eaters.

12.name: Tunneling Claws
12.description: You have elongated claws and enhanced senses, making you uncanny at digging the underground passageways needed to construct ghoul warrens and rob graves without arousing suspicion.

14.name: Bodysnatcher
14.description: Your secret-stealing maggots reveal how to devour more than just the flesh and secrets of a victim; you can ingest and assume their whole physical appearance.

14.name: Graveshift
14.description: The maggots inhabiting your body impart you with the knowledge to travel from grave to grave, drawing upon the mystical power of the labyrinthine network of magical warrens and tunnels that connect Everglut to the Material Plane.

16.name: Breath of Hungry Death
16.description: You have uncovered occult mysteries that allow you to unleash the devastating hunger of Kabriri upon your foes with a single exhalation, releasing a massive cloud of flesh-eating gas that glows with a sickly green light.

20.name: Wrath of the First Ghoul
20.description: The ravenous maggots inside you become capable of exploding forth from your attacks into the wounds of an opponent, whispering telepathic words of destruction that invoke horrific flashbacks of Kabriri's transformation from elf to ghoul or psychic images of hundreds of maggots bu

12.name: Spring from the Shadows
12.description: You leap from hiding and assail your target.

12.name: Aerial Flash
12.description: Even creatures who take to the air can't escape you.

12.name: Afterimage
12.description: You leave behind an afterimage of yourself in your previous square.

2.name: Veil Dancer Dedication
2.description: You're able to shift yourself into the spaces between to avoid notice.

4.name: Contingency Leap
4.description: When imperiled by a fall, you swiftly transport yourself out of danger.

4.name: Dimensional Pilfer
4.prerequisite: Veil Dancer Dedication; Expert in Stealth
4.description: You have a preternatural ability to whisk items out from under their owners' noses.

4.name: Gossamer Blade
4.description: Drawing upon your command of intangible spaces, you create an echo of your weapon to resonate through its victim.

6.name: Fade Presence
6.description: You weave magic around you to mask your presence from observers.

6.name: Warp Path
6.description: You fold space around you, transporting yourself to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet.

8.name: Dart Between
8.description: In the blink of an eye, you transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within 60 feet that you can see.

8.name: Veil of Eternity
8.description: You can remain within the interstices of reality longer.

10.name: Translocational Adept
10.description: Your command over teleportation grows.

10.name: Interstitial Escape
10.description: To evade your foe, you shift yourself to another location, teleporting from your current square to another unoccupied square within 30 feet.

14.name: Hush
14.description: You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help.

4.name: Bespell Strikes
4.description: You siphon spell energy into one weapon you're wielding, or into one of your unarmed attacks, such as a fist.

4.name: Split Shot
4.description: You fragment a ranged spell.

4.name: Bespell Weapon
4.description: You siphon the residual energy from the last spell you cast into one weapon you're wielding.

4.name: Blood Calls Blood
4.description: The magical potency of your blood will not be denied.

4.name: Rising Blood Magic
4.description: The power within your blood grows.

6.name: Energy Ward
6.description: You convert energy from the last spell you cast into a protective ward.

6.name: Siphon Magic
6.description: You gorge upon the magical energies of your foe's blood.

2.name: Bloodrager Dedication
2.description: Drinking powerful blood has awakened magical potential within you.

8.name: Spelldrinker
8.description: You temporarily add a 3rd-rank spell to your spell repertoire, as determined by the type of creature whose blood you just drank.

10.name: Hematocritical
10.description: You bathe in the arterial fluids of your enemy, drinking deep of their freed essence to empower your magic and increase your spellcasting efficacy.

12.name: Surging Blood Magic
12.prerequisite: Rising Blood Magic; master in Arcana or Religion, depending on your chosen tradition
12.description: Your blood courses with magic.

18.name: Exultant Blood Magic
18.prerequisite: Surging Blood Magic; legendary in Arcana or Religion, depending on your chosen tradition
18.description: The magic in your blood sings an exultant song of battle.

12.name: Magic Sense
12.description: You have a literal sixth sense for ambient magic in your vicinity.

12.name: Lich Dedication
12.prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; living creature, ability to cast 6th-level or higher spells from spell slots, completed ritual to become a lich and crafted a _soul cage_
12.description: After years of study and careful planning, you finally completed a soul cage to house your soul and successfully performed a ritual to transform yourself into a lich.

14.name: Drain Soul Cage
14.prerequisite: Lich Dedication; Drain Bonded Item, spellbook
14.description: You make your soul cage into your bonded item, allowing you to harness its abundant magical energy.

14.name: Enshroud Soul Cage
14.description: You wreathe your soul cage in an ever-growing collection of obfuscating illusions and protective abjurations to hide it from your enemies.

14.name: Hand of the Lich
14.description: Negative energy intensifies your undead form and makes your very touch the antithesis of life.

16.name: Bolster Soul Cage
16.description: Your constant efforts to augment and perfect your soul cage have bolstered its efficiency.

16.name: Spell Gem
16.description: Inspired by the degenerate demiliches your kind sometimes devolves into, you've embedded a gem into your brow, fusing it to your necrotic flesh.

18.name: Frightful Aura
18.description: You're surrounded by a palpable sense of menace and power that's terrifying to behold.

16.name: Scintillating Spell
16.description: Your spells become a radiant display of light and color.

8.name: Surging Might
8.description: You focus the power of your spell to overcome enemies' resistances.

6.name: Spell Relay
6.description: You open the power in your blood to your ally's spellcasting, using your magic to boost their range.

6.name: Energetic Resonance
6.description: Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells.

6.name: Urgent Upwelling
6.description: Defeat lets you to tap into your wellspring.

18.name: Echoing Spell
18.description: You time the components of your spell with exacting precision, setting up a resonance that duplicates the spell's effects.

2.name: Wellspring Mage Dedication
2.description: There's no longer a limit on how many temporary spell slots you can gain per day from wellspring magic.

4.name: Wellspring Control
4.description: When you generate a wellspring surge, roll twice on the Wellspring Surges Table and take the result of your choice.

12.name: Interfering Surge
12.description: You overcharge the triggering spell with magic.

2.name: Bard Dedication
2.description: You cast spells like a bard and gain the Cast a Spell activity.

4.name: Basic Bard Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Basic Muse's Whispers
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level bard feat.

6.name: Advanced Muse's Whispers
6.description: You gain one bard feat.

6.name: Counter Perform
6.description: You gain the counter performance composition spell.

8.name: Anthemic Performance
8.description: Your music, speech, or other performance inspires your allies to dive into battle.

8.name: Occult Breadth
8.description: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more occult spells each day.

8.name: Inspirational Performance
8.description: You gain the inspire courage composition cantrip.

12.name: Expert Bard Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Bard Spellcasting; Master in Occultism
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Bard Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Bard Spellcasting; Legendary in Occultism
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Cleric Dedication
2.description: You cast spells like a cleric.

4.name: Basic Cleric Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Basic Dogma
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level cleric feat.

6.name: Advanced Dogma
6.description: You gain one cleric feat.

8.name: Divine Breadth
8.description: As your understanding increases, your god grants you more divine spells each day.

12.name: Expert Cleric Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Cleric Spellcasting; Master in Religion
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Cleric Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Cleric Spellcasting; Legendary in Religion
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Druid Dedication
2.description: You cast spells like a druid.

4.name: Basic Druid Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Basic Wilding
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level druid feat.

4.name: Order Spell
4.description: You gain the initial order spell from your order.

6.name: Advanced Wilding
6.description: You gain one druid feat.

8.name: Primal Breadth
8.description: Increase the spell slots you gain from druid archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest druid spell slots.

12.name: Expert Druid Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Druid Spellcasting; Master in Nature
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Druid Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Druid Spellcasting; Legendary in Nature
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

20.name: Cunning Trickster Mask
20.description: Your mask carries the legacy of Verdant Spider, the Speaker of Needs, allowing you to deceive and outwit your foes.

20.name: Emancipator's Mask
20.description: Your mask grants you the abilities of Whistling Kite, the Vigilant Seer, who emancipated thousands.

20.name: Grand Medic's Mask
20.description: Your mask is infused with restorative magic associated with Ibex, the Flourishing Field, so it constantly repairs itself.

20.name: Protective Spirit Mask
20.description: Your mask carries the protective instincts of White Bull, the Horn Forger, and no one will hurt your allies while you have anything to say about it.

20.name: Sky Master Mask
20.description: Your mask holds the legacy of Black Heron, the Wings of Knowledge, who united the aeromancers of the Shory Empire.

20.name: Stalking Feline Mask
20.description: Like Azure Leopard, the Patient Warden, your mask makes you most at home in the night and teaches you how to use the darkness to hunt.

20.name: Storyteller's Mask
20.description: Your mask remembers the stories of Shifting Frog, Storyteller of the Past and Future.

20.name: Thick Hide Mask
20.description: Your mask grants you the toughness of Elephant, the Conjured Chronicle.

20.name: Tireless Guide's Mask
20.description: Your mask hosts the legacy of Golden Snake, the Tireless Guide, allowing you to guide others with ease.

20.name: Vigilant Mask
20.description: Your mask grants the extraordinary magical senses of Carmine Jaws, the Hyena who Looks Between.

2.name: Fighter Dedication
2.description: You become trained in martial weapons.

4.name: Basic Maneuver
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level fighter feat.

4.name: Fighter Resiliency
4.prerequisite: Fighter Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier
4.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each fighter archetype class feat you have.

4.name: Reactive Striker
4.description: You gain the Reactive Strike reaction.

4.name: Opportunist
4.description: You gain the Attack of Opportunity reaction.

6.name: Advanced Maneuver
6.description: You gain a fighter feat.

12.name: Diverse Weapon Expert
12.prerequisite: Fighter Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
12.description: Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons and martial weapons increase to expert, and your proficiency rank for advanced weapons increases to trained.

2.name: Ranger Dedication
2.description: You become trained in Survival; if you were already trained in Survival, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

4.name: Basic Hunter's Trick
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level ranger feat.

4.name: Ranger Resiliency
4.prerequisite: Ranger Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier
4.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each ranger archetype class feat you have.

6.name: Advanced Hunter's Trick
6.description: You gain one ranger feat.

12.name: Master Spotter (Ranger)
12.description: Your proficiency rank in Perception increases to master.

2.name: Rogue Dedication
2.description: You gain a skill feat and the rogue's surprise attack class feature.

4.name: Basic Trickery
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level rogue feat.

4.name: Sneak Attacker
4.description: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except it deals 1d4 damage, increasing to 1d6 at 6th level.

6.name: Advanced Trickery
6.description: You gain one rogue feat.

8.name: Skill Mastery (Rogue)
8.prerequisite: Rogue Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill
8.description: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert.

10.name: Uncanny Dodge
10.description: You gain the deny advantage class feature.

12.name: Evasiveness (Rogue)
12.prerequisite: Rogue Dedication; expert in Reflex saves
12.description: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.

4.name: Sneak Attacker
4.description: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except it deals 1d4 damage, increasing to 1d6 at 6th level.

4.name: Ongoing Investigation
4.description: You're always investigating what's around you, even as you perform other activities.

4.name: Lost in the Crowd
4.description: You've learned how to move as one with crowds and hide among them.

4.name: Inspiring Recitation
4.description: You quietly speak or recall coded phrases and metaphors whose meanings inspire you to complete your mission.

1.name: Focused Fascination
1.description: When you use Fascinating Performance in a combat encounter, you need only a success, rather than a critical success, to fascinate your target.

2.name: Lion Blade Dedication
2.prerequisite: member of the Lion Blades; Trained in Performance
2.description: You are a Lion Blade, an elite spy in the service of Taldor.

6.name: Crowd Mastery
6.description: You use the crowd to your advantage, diverting your foes' attention to potential hidden dangers in the crowd.

6.name: Expeditious Advance
6.description: You advance and retreat quickly.

10.name: Spy's Countermeasures
10.description: You've learned how to analyze and fake your responses to the most common magic used against spies.

12.name: Flicker
12.description: You use your movements and disguises to make yourself a flickering blur.

12.name: Flickering Twirl
12.description: You use your movements and disguises to make yourself a flickering blur.

12.name: Slowing Strike
12.description: You wound your enemy so they can't move nimbly.

8.name: Interposing Crowd
8.description: Your enemies can't stop you when there's a host of people between you.

8.name: Lion's Magic
8.description: Many Lion Blades enhance their words with a bit of magic.

14.name: Stunning Surprise
14.description: You quickly move in to bring your foe down with a single blow.

2.name: Witch Dedication
2.description: You cast spells like a witch.

4.name: Basic Witch Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Basic Witchcraft
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level witch feat of your choice.

6.name: Advanced Witchcraft
6.description: You gain one witch feat.

8.name: Patron's Breadth
8.description: You can cast more spells each day.

12.name: Expert Witch Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Witch Spellcasting; master in the skill associated with your patron's tradition
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Witch Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Witch Spellcasting; legendary in the skill associated with your patron's tradition
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Wizard Dedication
2.description: You cast spells like a wizard, gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice.

4.name: Arcane School Spell
4.description: You gain your school's initial school spell.

4.name: Basic Arcana
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level wizard feat of your choice.

4.name: Basic Wizard Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

6.name: Advanced Arcana
6.description: You gain one wizard feat.

8.name: Arcane Breadth
8.description: Your thorough studies allow you to cast more arcane spells each day.

12.name: Expert Wizard Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Wizard Spellcasting; Master in Arcana
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Wizard Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Wizard Spellcasting; Legendary in Arcana
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

20.name: Cunning Trickster Mask
20.description: Your mask carries the legacy of Verdant Spider, the Speaker of Needs, allowing you to deceive and outwit your foes.

20.name: Emancipator's Mask
20.description: Your mask grants you the abilities of Whistling Kite, the Vigilant Seer, who emancipated thousands.

20.name: Grand Medic's Mask
20.description: Your mask is infused with restorative magic associated with Ibex, the Flourishing Field, so it constantly repairs itself.

20.name: Protective Spirit Mask
20.description: Your mask carries the protective instincts of White Bull, the Horn Forger, and no one will hurt your allies while you have anything to say about it.

20.name: Sky Master Mask
20.description: Your mask holds the legacy of Black Heron, the Wings of Knowledge, who united the aeromancers of the Shory Empire.

20.name: Stalking Feline Mask
20.description: Like Azure Leopard, the Patient Warden, your mask makes you most at home in the night and teaches you how to use the darkness to hunt.

20.name: Storyteller's Mask
20.description: Your mask remembers the stories of Shifting Frog, Storyteller of the Past and Future.

20.name: Thick Hide Mask
20.description: Your mask grants you the toughness of Elephant, the Conjured Chronicle.

20.name: Tireless Guide's Mask
20.description: Your mask hosts the legacy of Golden Snake, the Tireless Guide, allowing you to guide others with ease.

20.name: Vigilant Mask
20.description: Your mask grants the extraordinary magical senses of Carmine Jaws, the Hyena who Looks Between.

1.name: Blowgun Poisoner
1.description: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun.

1.name: Subtle Delivery
1.description: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun.

2.name: Guerrilla Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival
2.description: You're skilled in subtle tactics and using the environment against your enemies.

4.name: Guerrilla Weaponry
4.description: You are especially skilled in transforming simple weapons that can be easily assembled from readily available materials into deadly weapons.

4.name: Snare Expert
4.description: Your knowledge of traps aids you in defending your hideout.

6.name: Hit and Run
6.description: Leaping from a hiding place, you quickly attack your foe before retreating.

6.name: Poisoned Sticks and Stones
6.description: You prepare your sling stones with small, edged grooves to enable them to deliver poison, and you have learned other techniques for poisoning your weapons.

8.name: Rally Support
8.prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; trained in either Diplomacy or Intimidation
8.description: You often rely on the local populace for supplies and shelter.

8.name: Venomous Weapons
8.description: Your skill with poisons is such that your preferred weapons also contain trace amounts of it, even when you don't actively apply a dose.

10.name: Battlefront Sabotage
10.description: You know methods of sabotaging your enemy's war machines and weaponry.

12.name: Frightful Attrition
12.description: Your diminishment of your foes' ranks damages their morale.

14.name: Lonely Army
14.description: You move and attack with deadly silence, unbelievable speed, and unlimited ferocity.

16.name: Deathblow
16.prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; Poisoned Sticks and Stones
16.description: Your carefully prepared and placed shot brings instant death to your target.

18.name: Terrain Ghost
18.prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; Master in Stealth; Master in Survival
18.description: You move through your territory like a living shadow.

6.name: Reactive Strike
6.description: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

6.name: Cadence Call
6.description: You call out a quick cadence, guiding your allies into a more efficient rhythm.

6.name: Rallying Charge
6.description: Your fearless charge into battle reinvigorates your allies to carry on the fight.

6.name: Attack of Opportunity
6.description: You swat a foe that leaves an opening.

2.name: Marshal Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Intimidation; trained in martial weapons
2.description: You've combined your social skills and combat training to become a talented combat leader.

4.name: Dread Marshal Stance
4.description: Putting on a grim face for the battle ahead, you encourage your allies to strike fear into their foes with vicious attacks.

4.name: Inspiring Marshal Stance
4.description: You become a brilliant example of dedication and poise in battle, encouraging your allies to follow suit.

4.name: Snap Out of It!
4.description: You give a quick shout, hoping to shake the fog clouding your ally's thoughts.

4.name: Steel Yourself!
4.description: You encourage an ally to toughen up, giving them a fighting chance.

4.name: Snap Out of It! (Marshal)
4.description: You give a quick shout, hoping to shake the fog clouding your ally's thoughts.

4.name: Push Back the Dead!
4.description: You call to your ally and strengthen their resolve and abilities to defend against the horrific tricks undead bring to bear.

4.name: Devrin's Cunning Stance
4.description: You've learned Devrin Arlos's guileful ways, and his sly teachings help you remind your allies to keep their wits about them.

4.name: Strategist Stance
4.prerequisite: Marshal Dedication; Trained in Society or Trained in Warfare Lore
4.description: You find the most strategic options for you and your allies.

8.name: Back to Back
8.description: You excel at watching your allies' backs and helping them watch yours.

8.name: To Battle!
8.description: With a resounding cry, you rally your ally to take the offensive.

8.name: Know Your Enemy
8.description: You aim to turn knowledge into power against your foes.

10.name: Topple Foe
10.description: You take advantage of the opening created by your ally to tip your foe off their feet.

10.name: Form Up!
10.description: You've trained in battle formations for a plethora of situations.

12.name: Coordinated Charge
12.description: You heroically dash into the fray, inspiring your allies to follow.

12.name: General's Gambit
12.description: You move strategically forward to draw the enemy's attention away from your allies.

14.name: Tactical Cadence
14.description: Your remarkable breath control and concise instructions allow you to coordinate your allies more effectively, even in desperate situations.

14.name: Target of Opportunity
14.description: You capitalize on your ally's attack and use the opportunity to secure a blow of your own, adding to the oncoming barrage.

12.name: Unbalancing Sweep
12.description: You make a great sweep with your weapon or fists about yourself, knocking creatures off their feet and away from you.

12.name: Know thy Doom
12.description: As your legend grows, details of your demise become clearer.

6.name: Clear the Way
6.description: You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path.

6.name: Hero-God's Bond
6.description: At times, the myth of a hero-god includes a favored partner or a bonded ally, such as the hero-gods of promises and shield-bearers, Upion and Warrick.

2.name: Warrior Of Legend Dedication
2.description: You have been given a powerful blessing of battle that is also your cursed doom.

4.name: Heroic Defiance
4.description: Even as shadows of your doom haunt the corners of your vision, your implacable spirit surges and cries out that your time has not yet come.

8.name: Piercing Doom
8.description: You have grown accustomed to the curse that comes with your blessing, able to channel its effects through your attacks and forestall your own demise.

8.name: Martyr's Parry
8.description: You intercede to absorb the triggering attack.

10.name: Spear of Doom
10.description: The conditions for your doom have been met, and you brace yourself for a battle that will see you either live to fight another day or die a legend.

10.name: Grief's Fury
10.description: A lost love. A broken spear. Rage burning through a hero-god.

14.name: Only My Doom May Claim Me
14.description: The power of your legend, fueled by your legendary deeds, resists any weapon that is not tied to your curse.

18.name: Razor's Edge
18.description: Your curse and your power are one and the same, and you accept both equally.

4.name: Mercy
4.description: Your touch soothes the body or mind.

4.name: Blessed Sacrifice
4.description: You gain the protector's sacrifice domain spell

4.name: Accelerating Touch
4.description: Your healing energies are infused with bounding energy.

8.name: Greater Mercy
8.description: Your faith enhances your ability to remove conditions.

8.name: Blessed Spell
8.prerequisite: Blessed One Dedication; Mercy; ability to cast spells from spell slots
8.description: When you focus your magic on an ally, you can remove harmful conditions.

12.name: Affliction Mercy
12.description: The divine grace that flows through you grants reprieve from an affliction.

12.name: Blessed Denial
12.description: You exude peace and protection, lessening a harmful condition as it falls upon an ally.

12.name: Amplifying Touch
12.description: Your healing energies empower attacks.

18.name: Rejuvenating Touch
18.description: Your healing energies linger after you cast, providing continual benefits.

18.name: Ultimate Mercy
18.description: Your mercy transcends the bounds of life and death.

2.name: Blessed One Dedication
2.description: You are touched by a deity and gifted with the ability to alleviate the suffering of others.

6.name: Invigorating Mercy
6.description: Your divine touch rejuvenates the weak and tired.

10.name: Elucidating Mercy
10.description: Your mercy grants clarity to those around you just when they need it most.

10.name: Resilient Touch
10.description: Your healing energies create an aura of protection that defends your allies against more than just blades and arrows.

1.name: Crane Stance
1.description: Your arms flutter like a crane's wings.

1.name: Dragon Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a dragon and make powerful leg strikes like a lashing dragon's tail.

1.name: Mountain Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of an implacable mountain—a technique created by dwarven monks—allowing you to strike with the weight of an avalanche and block blows with your garments.

1.name: Stumbling Stance
1.description: You enter a seemingly unfocused stance that mimics the movements of the inebriated—bobbing, weaving, leaving false openings, and distracting your enemies from your true movements.

1.name: Tiger Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a tiger and can make tiger claw attacks.

1.name: Wolf Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of a wolf, low to the ground with your hands held like fangs.

1.name: Gorilla Stance
1.description: You lower yourself to the ground and take an imposing, knuckle-walking stance.

1.name: Rushing Goat Stance
1.description: You enter the stance of an unruly goat, lowering your body and preparing to butt heads with your foes.

1.name: Twisting Petal Stance
1.description: Your body moves like a petal twisting on the wind, confounding your opponents while using their energy against them.

6.name: Advanced Monastic Weaponry
6.description: Your rigorous training regimen allows you to wield complex weaponry with ease.

6.name: Crane Flutter
6.description: You interpose your arm between yourself and your opponent.

6.name: Dragon Roar
6.description: You bellow, instilling fear in your enemies.

6.name: Mountain Stronghold
6.description: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you.

6.name: Stumbling Feint
6.description: You lash out confusingly, with what seems to be a weak move, but instead allows you to unleash a dangerous flurry of blows upon your unsuspecting foe.

6.name: Tiger Slash
6.description: You make a fierce swipe with both hands.

6.name: Wolf Drag
6.description: You rip your enemy off their feet.

6.name: Follow-up Strike
6.description: You have trained rigorously to use all parts of your body as a weapon, and when you miss with an attack, you can usually continue the attack with a different body part and still deal damage.

6.name: Gorilla Pound
6.description: You pound your chest before slamming into your foes.

6.name: Thunder Clap
6.description: You slam your hands together to unleash a deafening blast.

6.name: Momentous Charge
6.description: You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force.

14.name: Mountain Quake
14.description: You stomp, shaking the earth beneath you.

14.name: Path of Iron
14.description: With a burst of effort and speed, you weave a nimble path through your many enemies, striking each in turn as you move past them.

2.name: Martial Artist Dedication
2.description: You have trained to use your fists as deadly weapons and can deliver devastatingly powerful blows with them.

2.name: Brawling Focus
2.description: You know how to make the most of your attacks when fighting hand-to-hand.

2.name: Powder Punch Stance
2.description: You infuse your handwraps with black powder.

8.name: Grievous Blow
8.description: You know how to deliver focused, powerful blows that bypass your enemies' resistances.

8.name: Scattering in Spring
8.description: You evade an incoming attack by twisting your enemy's tactics in your favor.

8.name: Adamantine Body
8.description: With your strong will and even stronger body, you shrug off an otherwise devastating blow.

10.name: Black Powder Flash
10.description: You ignite a pinch of black powder in a foe's face.

12.name: Five-gods Ram
12.description: You attack in an unceasing flurry of charging headbutts.

12.name: Whirling in the Summer Storm
12.description: Your hands move in a hypnotic and distracting flurry that throws your foes off-balance before you cast them away with a violent pirouette.

18.name: Echoing Violence
18.description: Your powerful attack causes damage that reverberates through your opponent's body, shaking muscle from bone.

16.name: Fuse Stance
16.description: You have combined two stances into a single stance all your own.

2.name: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
2.prerequisite: You're from Isger or a member of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys.
2.description: The fighting style of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys is rooted in their understanding of devils.

4.name: Golden Erinys Stance
4.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
4.description: Whether you're a keen student of vengeance or you picked up techniques after being a common target for the sisters' punishment, you've learned to dig painfully into your opponent's flesh.

4.name: Eye for Weakness
4.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
4.description: When you successfully Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see, you automatically learn if it has a weakness to holy or unholy in addition to any other results.

6.name: Fiendish Brand
6.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
6.description: Make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.

6.name: Vengeance Strike
6.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
6.description: You lash out at the foe who dared to attack you.

8.name: Cruel Piercing
8.description: You learn to impale your targets.

10.name: Promise of Pain
10.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
10.description: You call out to an enemy in distress, promising them a future of unending pain.

12.name: Wrathful Presence
12.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
12.description: You channel the unending wrath of the erinyes all around you.

2.name: Alchemist Dedication
2.description: You put your alchemical interest into practice.

4.name: Advanced Alchemy
4.description: You gain the advanced alchemy benefits

4.name: Basic Concoction
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level alchemist feat.

4.name: Quick Alchemy
4.description: You gain the Quick Alchemy action.

6.name: Advanced Concoction
6.description: You gain one alchemist feat.

6.name: Voluminous Vials
6.description: Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

6.name: Expert Alchemy
6.description: Your advanced alchemy level increases to 3.

12.name: Alchemical Power
12.description: You become an expert in the alchemist class DC.

12.name: Master Alchemy
12.description: Your advanced alchemy level increases to 7.

2.name: Barbarian Dedication
2.description: You become trained in Athletics; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

4.name: Barbarian Resiliency
4.prerequisite: Barbarian Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 10 + your Constitution modifier
4.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each barbarian archetype class feat you have.

4.name: Basic Fury
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level barbarian feat.

6.name: Advanced Fury
6.description: You gain one barbarian feat.

6.name: Instinct Ability
6.description: Your rage stokes the spark of your barbarian instinct into a roaring flame.

12.name: Juggernaut's Fortitude
12.prerequisite: Barbarian Dedication; expert in Fortitude saves
12.description: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

2.name: Champion Dedication
2.description: Choose a deity.

4.name: Basic Devotion
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level champion feat.

4.name: Champion Resiliency
4.prerequisite: Champion Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier
4.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each champion archetype class feat you have.

4.name: Devout Magic
4.description: You gain a devotion spell of your choice listed in the devotion spells class feature

4.name: Healing Touch
4.description: You gain the appropriate devotion spell for your cause.

6.name: Advanced Devotion
6.description: You gain one champion feat.

6.name: Champion's Reaction
6.description: You can gain and use the champion's reaction associated with your cause

6.name: Devout Blessing
6.description: You gain the blessing of the devoted class feature

6.name: Divine Ally
6.description: You gain a divine ally of your choice.

14.name: Diverse Armor Expert
14.prerequisite: Champion Dedication; expert in unarmored defense or one or more types of armor
14.description: Your proficiency ranks for armor increase to expert.

2.name: Investigator Dedication
2.description: You gain the on the case class feature, which grants you both the Pursue a Lead activity and Clue In reaction.

4.name: Basic Deduction
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level investigator feat of your choice.

4.name: Investigator's Stratagem
4.description: You play out battles in your head, allowing you to strike when the time is right.

6.name: Advanced Deduction
6.description: You gain one investigator feat.

6.name: Keen Recollection
6.description: You can recall all sorts of information.

8.name: Skill Mastery
8.prerequisite: Investigator Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill
8.description: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert.

8.name: Skill Mastery (Investigator)
8.prerequisite: Investigator Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill
8.description: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert.

12.name: Master Spotter (Investigator)
12.description: Your proficiency rank in Perception increases to master.

2.name: Monk Dedication
2.description: You become trained in unarmed attacks and gain the powerful fist class feature.

4.name: Basic Kata
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level monk feat.

4.name: Monk Resiliency
4.prerequisite: Monk Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier
4.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each monk archetype class feat you have.

6.name: Advanced Kata
6.description: You gain one monk feat.

8.name: Monk Moves
8.description: You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed when you're not wearing armor.

10.name: Monk's Flurry
10.description: You gain the Flurry of Blows action.

12.name: Perfection's Path
12.prerequisite: Monk Dedication; expert in at least one saving throw
12.description: Choose one saving throw (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will) in which you're an expert.

2.name: Oracle Dedication
2.description: Choose a mystery.

4.name: Basic Mysteries
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level oracle feat of your choice.

4.name: Basic Oracle Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: First Revelation
4.description: You gain your mystery's initial revelation spell.

6.name: Advanced Mysteries
6.description: You gain one oracle feat.

8.name: Mysterious Breadth
8.description: Increase the spell slots you gain from oracle archetype feats

12.name: Expert Oracle Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Oracle Spellcasting; Master in Religion
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Oracle Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Oracle Spellcasting; Legendary in Religion
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Sorcerer Dedication
2.description: Choose a bloodline.

4.name: Basic Sorcerer Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Basic Blood Potency
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level sorcerer feat.

4.name: Basic Bloodline Spell
4.description: You gain your bloodline's initial bloodline spell.

6.name: Advanced Blood Potency
6.description: You gain one sorcerer feat.

8.name: Bloodline Breadth
8.description: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more spells of your bloodline's tradition each day.

12.name: Expert Sorcerer Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Sorcerer Spellcasting; master in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion, depending on bloodline
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Sorcerer Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Sorcerer Spellcasting; legendary in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion, depending on bloodline
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Swashbuckler Dedication
2.description: Choose a swashbuckler's style.

4.name: Basic Flair
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level swashbuckler feat of your choice.

4.name: Finishing Precision
4.description: You've learned how to land daring blows when you have panache.

6.name: Advanced Flair
6.description: You gain one swashbuckler feat.

6.name: Swashbuckler's Riposte
6.description: You've learned to riposte against ill-conceived attacks.

8.name: Swashbuckler's Speed
8.description: You move with a swashbuckler's speed and grace.

12.name: Evasiveness
12.prerequisite: Swashbuckler Dedication; expert in Reflex Saves
12.description: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.

12.name: Evasiveness (Swashbuckler)
12.prerequisite: Swashbuckler Dedication; expert in Reflex saves
12.description: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.

2.name: Acrobat Dedication
2.description: You become an expert in Acrobatics.

4.name: Contortionist
4.description: You can squeeze out of tight situations by twisting and bending your body into unnatural positions, gaining an advantage against foes that try to pin you down.

6.name: Dodge Away
6.description: You use your acrobatic prowess to evade an attack, using momentum to keep yourself moving if you choose.

7.name: Graceful Leaper
7.description: Mass and muscle are meaningless when you propel yourself through the air; only grace and balance matter.

8.name: Tumbling Strike
8.description: You deftly dive through a gap left by a foe to deliver an advantageous blow.

8.name: Show-Off
8.description: As is the tradition with many Firebrands, you call your shot and look to impress with an extra bit of panache or a greater stunt.

10.name: Tumbling Opportunist
10.description: You use a burst of stamina to perform a breathtaking feat of Acrobatics as you speed through a foe's space, leaving your foe lying flat on their back.

10.name: Mockingbird's Disarm
10.description: The Mockingbird is a master at running into foes and coming away with their weapons.

13.name: Quick Spring
13.description: Ishii Bunji is a skilled tumbler, and learning his technique allows you to propel yourself across the battlefield faster than your enemies can react.

12.name: Operatic Adventurer
12.description: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows.

12.name: Virtuosic Dancer
12.description: You're so fond of using your Acrobatic feats on the stage that you've begun adding your own flair to these dances on the big stage.

14.name: Costume Change
14.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Celebrity Dedication; Quick Disguise; Master in Performance
14.description: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items.

14.name: Fit for the Role
14.description: Not only are you a flamboyant performer, but you've mastered an occult secret that allows you to outfit yourself and your companions with magical visages.

16.name: Tempo Shift
16.prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; Legendary in Acrobatics
16.description: You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments.

18.name: Fight Choreography
18.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; master in Theater Lore
18.description: You've spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle.

20.name: More Real than Real
20.description: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond.

2.name: Cavalier Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Nature or Trained in Society
2.description: You gain a young animal companion that serves as your mount.

4.name: Cavalier's Banner
4.description: You fly the banner of your pledge from your mount, raising your allies' spirits.

4.name: Cavalier's Charge
4.description: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride twice.

4.name: Impressive Mount
4.description: You've trained your mount to become a powerful force on the battlefield.

4.name: Quick Mount
4.description: You and your mount can spring into action at a moment's notice.

4.name: Cushion Landing
4.description: As you fall, your mount dashes to your rescue.

4.name: Mounting Leap
4.description: You jump atop your mount from afar, landing comfortably astride it.

6.name: Defend Mount
6.description: You interpose yourself between an attacker and your mount, defending your mount from harm.

6.name: Mounted Shield
6.description: You've trained with your shield to defend both yourself and your mount.

6.name: Dashing Pickup
6.prerequisite: Cavalier Dedication; expert in Acrobatics or Athletics
6.description: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has the corresponding movement type).

6.name: Vaulting Gallop
6.description: You've trained your mount to vault over obstacles at high speeds.

8.name: Incredible Mount
8.description: Under your care and training, your mount has realized its innate potential.

10.name: Trampling Charge
10.description: You urge your mount to charge into the fray, trampling all enemies who stand in your path.

10.name: Unseat
10.description: With a mighty blow from atop your companion, you attempt to knock an opponent off their mount.

10.name: Stalwart Standard
10.description: Your banner makes it harder for your foes to push your allies around and encourages your allies to protect the innocent.

14.name: Specialized Mount
14.description: You've trained your mount to perform in unusual or even extreme circumstances, granting it abilities far beyond others of its kind.

20.name: Legendary Rider
20.description: You and your mount move like one being, effortlessly reading each other's signals and synchronizing even in the thick of battle.

16.name: Wave the Flag
16.description: You wave your banner, inspiring allies to throw off the shackles of fear.

12.name: Rearing Display
12.description: You've trained your mount to make an impressive attack and can leverage its presence to terrify your enemies.

2.name: Celebrity Dedication
2.description: The more people you have looking at you, the more content you are, and you take every opportunity to show up others when their performances are less than perfect.

4.name: Never Tire
4.description: As long as you have an audience, you can continue to perform even when you are on the brink of collapse.

4.name: You're an Embarrassment!
4.description: Some Firebrands can't stand it when their allies are ruining their moment, and you're no different.

6.name: Mesmerizing Gaze
6.description: When you meet someone's gaze, they're unable to look away from you.

6.name: Feeling Your Oats
6.prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Trained in Deception
6.description: You are incredible, impeccable, an icon of style and grace—and everyone knows it.

10.name: Command Attention
10.description: You command the attention of all around you with style, ensuring their gaze falls only upon you until the end of your next turn.

10.name: Big Debut
10.description: Now's your chance! You're a Firebrand, and the world must know it.

7.name: Grudging Compliment
7.description: Every Firebrand can recognize the skill of others, but you've turned it into an art you can wield in combat.

8.name: Statement Strut
8.description: You have an eye for fashion and know how to sell attitude and confidence with your walk.

12.name: Acknowledge Fan
12.description: Your reputation as a Firebrand precedes you, and you need only make a simple gesture or give a look of recognition to amaze those around you.

12.name: Operatic Adventurer
12.description: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows.

12.name: Perfect Pitch
12.description: Your ear for harmony has enhanced your ability with musical magic.

12.name: Primadonna
12.description: The spotlight should always be on you and you alone.

14.name: Costume Change
14.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Celebrity Dedication; Quick Disguise; Master in Performance
14.description: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items.

14.name: It's Not Over
14.description: In the world of drama, the finale of any performance doesn't have to be the end, and for you, this now extends to life itself.

18.name: Tragic Lament
18.prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Legendary in Performance
18.description: You dramatically cry out in poetic verse about the tragedies that led to your doom at this very moment, instilling guilt in your attacker.

20.name: More Real than Real
20.description: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond.

2.name: Dandy Dedication
2.description: You are a consummate student of dignity, etiquette, and fashion.

4.name: Distracting Flattery
4.description: You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company.

4.name: Gossip Lore
4.description: Your time gossiping in fashionable salons keeps you informed on every topic.

4.name: Ivy Playhouse Strike
4.description: You've spent so many hours at the Ivy Playhouse or sparring with the Street Performers and Actors' Guild that you've picked up some stage combat techniques.

4.name: Such a Disgrace!
4.description: You expect the same level of urbane sophistication from your allies as you possess, so whenever one of them succumbs to egregious behavior from a mental effect, you're immediately mortified.

4.name: Tut-Tut
4.description: The Sapphire Butterfly is not one for violence when simply intimidating a foe will do.

7.name: Fabricated Connections
7.description: You can lie about having taken an action so convincingly that you acquire all the tangible benefits of having successfully completed it.

7.name: Party Crasher
7.description: You attend all the fashionable society parties, no matter how exclusive they might be.

7.name: Petal District Socialite
7.description: Through your experience with the many parties held nightly in clubs and estates within the Petal District, you understand the way rumors and gossip circulate during social events.

3.name: Ivy District Influencer
3.description: After mingling alongside the tastemakers of the Ivy District, you understand how rumors spread through larger settlements.

6.name: Sundown Street Posturing
6.description: Whether in the salon or on the street, you've captured the attention of everyone around you.

6.name: Feeling Your Oats
6.prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Trained in Deception
6.description: You are incredible, impeccable, an icon of style and grace—and everyone knows it.

8.name: Magpie Manor Recovery
8.description: Though you're hardly ready to retire from the social life, you appreciate the luxury the older wealthy elite enjoy within the private social club of Magpie Manor in Absalom's Petal District.

8.name: Statement Strut
8.description: You have an eye for fashion and know how to sell attitude and confidence with your walk.

10.name: Bloom Cabaret Entrance
10.description: In socially exclusive venues like the Ivy District's Bloom Cabaret, you've learned how to make an entrance.

11.name: Flower Street Infamy
11.description: Your history of coquetries, flirtations, dalliances, and liaisons is so lengthy that, even in a city as large as Absalom, you're bound to run into your past at inopportune moments.

12.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
12.description: Your reputation casts a long shadow, allowing you to throw your cultural weight around, especially in larger settlements.

12.name: Operatic Adventurer
12.description: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows.

12.name: Perfect Pitch
12.description: Your ear for harmony has enhanced your ability with musical magic.

5.name: Cutting Flattery
5.prerequisite: Dandy Dedication or Pirate Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
5.description: Repeated entries in Firebrand bragging and flyting contests have taught you how to twist pretty words into concealed insults.

14.name: Costume Change
14.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Celebrity Dedication; Quick Disguise; Master in Performance
14.description: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items.

14.name: Fit for the Role
14.description: Not only are you a flamboyant performer, but you've mastered an occult secret that allows you to outfit yourself and your companions with magical visages.

18.name: Tragic Lament
18.prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Legendary in Performance
18.description: You dramatically cry out in poetic verse about the tragedies that led to your doom at this very moment, instilling guilt in your attacker.

20.name: More Real than Real
20.description: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond.

4.name: Distracting Flattery
4.description: You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company.

4.name: Gossip Lore
4.description: Your time gossiping in fashionable salons keeps you informed on every topic.

4.name: Venture-Gossip Dedication
4.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; member of the Pathfinder Society
4.description: Look, the motto of the Pathfinder Society is "explore, report, cooperate" and you're just reporting what you hear!

7.name: Fabricated Connections
7.description: You can lie about having taken an action so convincingly that you acquire all the tangible benefits of having successfully completed it.

7.name: Party Crasher
7.description: You attend all the fashionable society parties, no matter how exclusive they might be.

7.name: Read Shibboleths
7.description: All communication is filled with slight tells and signals.

7.name: Quick Change
7.description: You can shift between your identities with ease.

7.name: Subjective Truth
7.description: Your disparate identities allow you to defeat magic that detects lies.

8.name: Crude Communication
8.description: Even if you don't speak a creature's language, you can rely on inflection, root words, and body language to infer rudimentary meaning.

8.name: A Little Bird Told Me...
8.description: You transform into a small bird, such as a finch or a sparrow, allowing you to eavesdrop on others and gain information you wouldn't otherwise be able to acquire.

6.name: Verbose Distraction
6.description: You talk so much it can be distracting to your enemies and you're often quick to remind your enemies that you're just a little guy!

6.name: Hey! Over Here!
6.description: Hey! Don't listen to that! That's bad sounds! Listen to me!

10.name: Define "Report"
10.description: Look, getting caught in a lie is a normal part of venture-gossip life.

12.name: Catch and Kill
12.description: When you've decided to quash a story, no one can escape from you with any incriminating information.

16.name: Muckraking
16.description: It seems like your knowledge has come in handy after all and you have your enemy at your feet.

4.name: Gossip Lore
4.description: Your time gossiping in fashionable salons keeps you informed on every topic.

4.name: Basic Prophet Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Smile at Failure
4.description: You know staying cool is key to prevailing in social situations, as anger leads to mistakes.

2.name: Prophet of Kalistrade Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in Mercantile Lore; Trained in Society; Charisma +2
2.description: After induction into the ranks of the Kalistocrats, you learned the skills necessary to succeed in business and rise above others by following a set of detailed strictures.

6.name: Fortune's Favor
6.description: You understand when an investment in you has the chance to pay off.

8.name: Prolific Prophet Spellcasting
8.description: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and the number of spell slots you gain from prophet of Kalistrade archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest prophet of Kalistrade spell slots.

10.name: Prophet's Lockbox
10.description: You've learned secret methods that allow you to store your valuables where no one else can reach them.

12.name: Expert Prophet Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Prophet Spellcasting; Master in Society
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

14.name: Master Merchant
14.description: Kalistrade teaches that setbacks are only temporary and that perseverance is a treasured virtue.

18.name: Master Prophet Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Prophet Spellcasting; Legendary in Society
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Gladiator Dedication
2.description: You know how to turn combat into a form of entertainment.

4.name: Fancy Moves
4.description: You show off your fighting style to discourage your foes.

4.name: Play to the Crowd
4.description: You show off for the crowd.

4.name: Stage Fighting
4.description: You pull punches to give a better show.

6.name: Performative Weapons Training
6.description: You're skilled with flashy weapons and can use them to great effect.

8.name: Call Your Shot
8.description: When you successfully Play to the Crowd, add the following to the list of benefits you can choose from: A creature you can see within 30 feet becomes frightened 2.

8.name: Living for the Applause
8.description: Nothing can stop you as long as you have an audience cheering you on.

10.name: Big Debut
10.description: Now's your chance! You're a Firebrand, and the world must know it.

12.name: Gladiator's Roar
12.description: You can project your voice into a high-pitched screech that damages your foes.

12.name: Operatic Adventurer
12.description: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows.

14.name: Costume Change
14.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Celebrity Dedication; Quick Disguise; Master in Performance
14.description: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you've mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items.

14.name: It's Not Over
14.description: In the world of drama, the finale of any performance doesn't have to be the end, and for you, this now extends to life itself.

16.name: Tempo Shift
16.prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; Legendary in Acrobatics
16.description: You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments.

18.name: Fight Choreography
18.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; master in Theater Lore
18.description: You've spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle.

20.name: More Real than Real
20.description: Your performances aren't just well-known, they're famous across the land and beyond.

2.name: Herbalist Dedication
2.description: You can create natural remedies.

2.name: Fresh Ingredients
2.description: It is amazing the difference fresh herbs can make.

4.name: Poultice Preparation
4.description: When you create an elixir as an herbal item, you can prepare it as a poultice instead.

4.name: Gravelands Herbalist
4.description: Your time with the Knights of Lastwall has taught you the secrets of creating and improving upon Lastwall soup.

6.name: Advanced Herbalism
6.description: Your herbalist talents continue to grow with use and you have become potent at making even more remedies from less.

6.name: Endemic Herbs
6.description: The herbal items you create use medicinal plants endemic to your location.

6.name: Expert Herbalism
6.description: Your advanced alchemy level for herbalism increases to your level – 3.

2.name: Linguist Dedication
2.description: You have studied languages and their development.

4.name: Multilingual Cipher
4.description: You use multiple languages to create and break codes.

4.name: Phonetic Training
4.description: You can pronounce and repeat words with near-perfect accuracy even if you don't understand their meaning, and you can write them down in a phonetic script that allows you or another creature with Phonetic Training to read it later.

4.name: Spot Translate
4.description: You bridge a language gap, repeating the message in a different language that you know.

6.name: Analyze Idiolect
6.prerequisite: Linguist Dedication; Expert in Deception; Expert in Society
6.description: You break down a specific individual's idiolect, memorizing their speech mannerisms and habits.

7.name: Read Shibboleths
7.description: All communication is filled with slight tells and signals.

8.name: Crude Communication
8.description: Even if you don't speak a creature's language, you can rely on inflection, root words, and body language to infer rudimentary meaning.

2.name: Medic Dedication
2.description: You become an expert in Medicine.

4.name: Doctor's Visitation
4.description: You move to provide immediate care to those who need it.

4.name: Treat Condition
4.description: You treat an adjacent creature in an attempt to reduce the clumsy, enfeebled, or sickened condition.

6.name: Holistic Care
6.description: You provide emotional and spiritual care.

16.name: Resuscitate
16.description: You resuscitate the dead.

8.name: Preventative Treatment
8.description: You provide preventative remedies and care to help your patient fight off future maladies.

4.name: Ritualist Dedication
4.prerequisite: Expert in Occultism, Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, or Expert in Religion
4.description: You have begun to master the difficult art of casting rituals.

6.name: Flexible Ritualist
6.description: You can perform two aspects of a ritual yourself.

6.name: Resourceful Ritualist
6.description: You can cast difficult rituals that might otherwise be just beyond your skill.

8.name: Efficient Rituals
8.description: You can perform particularly extensive rituals in less time.

10.name: Assured Ritualist
10.description: You can cover for a secondary caster's error.

14.name: Enterprising Ritualist
14.description: Elegant and expensive components are no replacement for your skill and practice atritual casting.

14.name: Speedy Rituals
14.description: You can perform rituals in only a fraction of the usual time.

2.name: Scroll Trickster Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Nature, Trained in Arcana, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
2.description: You've studied scrolls in depth.

6.name: Basic Scroll Cache
6.description: You have a vast and overflowing collection of scroll scraps, riddled with errors and misspellings and leaking energy like a sieve.

8.name: Skim Scroll
8.description: You can activate the magic of a scroll with a cursory read as you draw it from your belt.

12.name: Expert Scroll Cache
12.description: Your scroll collection has vastly grown, both in size and potency.

18.name: Master Scroll Cache
18.description: Your scroll collection is incredible, brimming with eldritch power, and you can prepare far more of them than an ordinary scroll trickster.

2.name: Scrounger Dedication
2.description: While others need specialized tools and a dedicated space, you have found a way to build just about anything, anywhere.

4.name: Reverse Engineering
4.description: Your nigh-constant tinkering and fiddling with objects means you are able to reverse engineer items into formulas more effectively than most.

6.name: Magical Scrounger
6.description: You can craft a temporary wondrous item using the magic scrounged from all around.

6.name: High-Quality Scrounger
6.description: When you Craft a temporary item using Scrounger Dedication, it can be an item of up to 3rd level.

7.name: Expert Disassembly
7.description: You can apply the same techniques you use to reverse engineer objects to disable dangerous traps and break apart locks.

7.name: Expert Disassembler
7.description: You can apply the same techniques you use to reverse engineer objects to disable them.

2.name: Sentinel Dedication
2.description: You have trained carefully to maximize the protective qualities of your armor.

4.name: Steel Skin
4.description: You wear your armor like a second skin, taking comfort in the protection it offers.

6.name: Armor Specialist
6.description: You have trained hard to optimize your armor's unique protective qualities to maximize the materials used in its creation.

8.name: Armored Rebuff
8.description: You rebuff puny attacks with your armor, knocking back your foe.

8.name: Sacrifice Armor
8.description: With divine awareness, you twist your body to lessen the impact of an attack.

14.name: Greater Interpose
14.description: Your divine grace empowers you to avoid hits when you otherwise could not.

10.name: Mighty Bulwark
10.description: Thanks to your incredible connection to your armor, you can use it to shrug off an incredible array of dangers.

4.name: Steel Skin
4.description: You wear your armor like a second skin, taking comfort in the protection it offers.

4.name: Mountain Skin
4.description: You become trained in medium and heavy armor.

4.name: Tunnel Wall
4.description: Using your shield, you guard against the movement of foes as surely as if you were a wall of stone.

4.name: Stalwart Song
4.description: As a stalwart defender, you rely on your martial training and your tried-and-true armor to face any danger without flinching.

8.name: Armored Rebuff
8.description: You rebuff puny attacks with your armor, knocking back your foe.

8.name: Rupture Stomp
8.description: Every dwarf knows that the rock they walk upon can be either a best friend or a treacherous path.

8.name: Unshaken in Iron
8.description: You know the precise limits of your armor, and trust it to save you from harm.

8.name: Stalwart Chant
8.description: You know story after story of unyielding, valiant dwarven heroes whose minds were bulwarks against fear and confusion.

10.name: Mighty Bulwark
10.description: Thanks to your incredible connection to your armor, you can use it to shrug off an incredible array of dangers.

10.name: Gathering Moss
10.description: By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster.

2.name: Stalwart Defender Dedication
2.description: You have completed your initial training in the ways of a stalwart defender.

6.name: Crushing Step
6.description: The weight of your armored feet casts aside natural impediments.

6.name: Gravel Guts
6.description: Stone never becomes queasy, so why should you? You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the sickened condition.

6.name: Upset Balance
6.prerequisite: Stalwart Defender Dedication; Expert in Athletics
6.description: You lean into your foe's attack, using the weight of your body and armor to send them reeling.

12.name: Cracked Mountain
12.description: You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe.

16.name: Stone Body
16.description: Emulating the great defenders throughout dwarven history, you close your mind to the sensation of pain, becoming as resolute as stone itself.

2.name: Snarecrafter Dedication
2.description: You have studied the art of crafting snares and laying traps, and few have shown more talent in these arts than you.

4.name: Surprise Snare
4.description: You install one prepared snare for deployment in a space that's occupied by an enemy.

4.name: Brastlewark Snare Engineering
4.description: You've trained with the Brastlewark gnomes or studied their teachings, and learned the art of crafting their more magical snares.

6.name: Remote Trigger
6.description: You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly.

6.name: Barricade Snare
6.description: Using clever gnomish engineering, you can quickly erect small barriers in which your snares are hidden.

6.name: Quick Snares
6.description: You can rig a snare in only moments.

10.name: Giant Snare
10.description: You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.

10.name: Broad Snare
10.description: You can create longer snares for quick deployment, creating lines on the battlefield.

12.name: Lightning Snares
12.description: You can rig a trap with incredible speed.

12.name: Plentiful Snares
12.description: You can prepare incredible numbers of snares each day out of simple ingredients.

8.name: Remote Detonation
8.description: Brastlewark snarecrafters know that sometimes it's more advantageous to magically destroy a snare before it's triggered.

8.name: Powerful Snares
8.description: Your snares are particularly dif cult for enemies to avoid.

14.name: Domino Effect
14.description: You've learned to pull the invisible strings of magic to affect targets that wouldn't normally be.

2.name: Talisman Dabbler Dedication
2.description: You are trained in the use of talismans and similar magical paraphernalia.

4.name: Quick Fix
4.description: You can attach a talisman using only a bit of glue and some string.

8.name: Deeper Dabbler
8.description: With some streamlining to your process and a deeper collection of talisman materials, you make a greater number of talismans every day.

14.name: Talismanic Sage
14.description: Normally, affixing more than one talisman to an item causes the talismans to be suppressed, but when you Affix a Talisman, you can specially treat one item you're working on, allowing it to have two active talismans at once.

2.name: Vigilante Dedication
2.description: You have two identities, each with its own name and abilities.

4.name: Executioner Weapon Training
4.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
4.description: Your Gray Gardener training has made you deeply skilled with the weapons that execute with a swift chop to the neck.

4.name: Harsh Judgment
4.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
4.description: You loudly declare the creature's life forfeit by your judgment

4.name: Voice of Authority
4.prerequisite: Expert in Intimidation; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
4.description: You easily command the attention of others, and when the time comes to turn threats into action, your authoritative voice causes foes to falter.

6.name: Discerning Gaze
6.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
6.description: You have a sense for when people are lying.

6.name: Frightful Condemnation
6.prerequisite: Harsh Judgment; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
6.description: Your willingness to follow through on your pitiless judgment is frightful to the person you have condemned.

8.name: Accurate Swing
8.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Harsh Judgment; member of the Gray Gardeners
8.description: You strike cleanly with wide, sweeping attacks to inflict maximum damage

8.name: Gardener's Resolve
8.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
8.description: The Gray Gardeners are known for having nerves of steel and an unbreakable resolve.

10.name: Strident Command
10.prerequisite: Master in Intimidation; Vigilante Dedication; Voice of Authority; member of the Gray Gardeners
10.description: The common folk heed your demands, and though your true foes rarely bend to your commands, when they do the hesitation can cost them the battle.

14.name: Execution
14.prerequisite: Harsh Judgment; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
14.description: You swing wide, attempting to behead your condemned foe.

18.name: Terrifying Countenance
18.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
18.description: You can erect a magical cowl that terrorizes your enemies.

2.name: Weapon Improviser Dedication
2.description: You don't take the normal –2 penalty to attack rolls with improvised weapons.

4.name: Improvised Pummel
4.description: When you make a Strike with an improvised weapon you're wielding, you gain a +1 item bonus to the attack roll, and you can have the Strike deal two weapon damage dice instead of the improvised weapon's normal number.

6.name: Surprise Strike
6.description: Whenever you make a Strike with an improvised weapon against a creature that hasn't observed you making a Strike using an improvised weapon or that is otherwise ignorant of your skill with improvised weapons, the creature is off-guard against you for that Strike.

8.name: Improvised Critical
8.description: You can apply critical specialization effects to improvised weapons you wield.

8.name: Makeshift Strike
8.description: You quickly snatch up whatever is nearby and then attack with it as an improvised weapon.

10.name: Shattering Strike (Weapon Improviser)
10.description: The improvised weapon shatters, destroying it completely but dealing an additional 3d6 piercing damage to the creature you hit with the Improvised Pummel.

4.name: Thaumaturgic Ritualist
4.description: Your studies into the supernatural have resulted in an especially strong knowledge of rituals

4.name: Esoteric Spellcasting
4.description: Your study of a variety of esoteric texts and supernatural matters has broadened your mind and improved your spellcasting.

4.name: Text Decoder
4.description: Thanks to your constant involvement with cryptic texts, you have attained an almost-supernatural ability to decipher complex codes and understand ancient writings.

6.name: Cast Out
6.description: You attempt to cast a malevolent entity out of the creature or object it's possessing.

6.name: Palatine Enchantment
6.description: You have found yourself facing supernatural beings often and have learned how to combat them.

2.name: Palatine Detective Dedication
2.description: You have delved into the study of the occult and divine, becoming exceptionally skilled at identifying when such forces are at work.

8.name: Palatine Strike
8.description: Your strikes are particularly deadly against supernatural creatures.

8.name: Challenge Insight
