8.description: Your deep grasp of the mystical lets you know exactly what to say to make others doubt how well they understand the source of their own power.

10.name: Cursebreaker
10.description: Using various implements and esoteric methods, you can attempt to remove a curse from an unfortunate victim.

10.name: Open the Blazing Eye
10.description: Thanks to your diligence in the study of divine and occult mysteries, you can focus to temporarily attain a perception beyond the ordinary.

12.name: Greater Esoteric Spellcasting
12.description: Your understanding of magic has evolved, and so has your spellcasting.

2.name: Psychic Dedication
2.description: You feel something awaken within your mind

4.name: Basic Thoughtform
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level psychic feat.

4.name: Basic Psychic Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

6.name: Advanced Thoughtform
6.description: You gain one psychic feat.

6.name: Psi Development
6.description: You've found a new mental form

12.name: Expert Psychic Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Psychic Spellcasting; Master in Occultism
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Psychic Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Psychic Spellcasting; Legendary in Occultism
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Thaumaturge Dedication
2.description: You've uncovered basic thaumaturgy.

4.name: Basic Thaumaturgy
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level thaumaturge feat of your choice.

6.name: Advanced Thaumaturgy
6.description: You gain one thaumaturge feat.

6.name: Implement Initiate
6.description: Mastery of an implement is the sign of a studied thaumaturge.

8.name: Magical Knowledge
8.prerequisite: Thaumaturge Dedication; trained in at least one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion and expert in at least one other
8.description: Increase your proficiency rank in one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion.

12.name: Resolute
12.description: You've tempered your mind and become resolute against effects that strain your willpower.

2.name: Alter Ego Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Deception; Trained in Stealth
2.description: You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility.

4.name: Change of Face
4.description: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look—luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques.

4.name: Fake It Till You Make it
4.description: When you take on a role, you become more capable with all sorts of tasks involving that role.

4.name: In Plain Sight
4.description: People often only see what they want to see, a weakness you know how to take full advantage of.

6.name: Sound Mirror
6.description: You twist not just the visual, but the auditory as well, allowing you to pass without a sound and create minor noises as distractions—perfect for misdirection and infiltration.

7.name: Muscle Mimicry
7.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication; Trained in Athletics; Master in Deception
7.description: Your study of another allows you to mirror their movements subtly, even in the heat of combat.

8.name: Swap Reflections
8.description: You've learned how to use even your reflection to your advantage.

14.name: Borrow Memories
14.description: Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they'll be, or even replace them altogether.

14.name: It Was Me All Along!
14.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication or Vigilante Dedication
14.description: You discard a disguise and dramatically reveal your true identity, catching your foes off guard.

3.name: We're on the List
3.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication or Archaeologist Dedication; Trained in Society
3.description: Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same.

12.name: Illusory Identity
12.description: There are times when skills or looks are not enough to convince someone of your identity, and you instead require adequate documentation.

2.name: Living Vessel Dedication
2.description: Whether willingly or not, you've become a vessel for a being of unimaginable power.

4.name: Entity's Strike
4.description: The more you try to force your body to stay yours, the more it warps to channel the energy flowing through you.

6.name: Tap Vitality
6.description: You tap into the entity's life force to heal your wounds, though at the cost of the entity's personality bleeding into your own.

8.name: Exude Demonic Corruption
8.prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a demon
8.description: Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others.

8.name: Fey's Trickery
8.prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a fey
8.description: You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to momentarily vanish from sight.

8.name: Warped Constriction
8.prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is an aberration or outer entity
8.description: The entity inhabiting your body is an aberrant being with unfathomable motivations, and when you hold a foe close, tendrils and tentacles unfurl from your body to crush your foe and pollute it with alien wrongness.

8.name: Exude Abyssal Corruption
8.prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a demon
8.description: Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others.

16.name: Vessel's Form
16.description: You symbiotically combine your form with that of the entity within you, taking a powerful hybrid form to temporarily boost your abilities in combat while maintaining control.

2.name: Pactbinder Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
2.description: The first step toward forming a successful pact is an understanding of the magic behind it, along with skill at negotiation.

4.name: Sociable Vow
4.description: You can leverage your vow in more social interactions.

4.name: Pact of Fey Glamour
4.description: You've sworn a pact with fey powers, granting you the otherworldly appearance of your dreams in exchange for oaths of hospitality.

4.name: Pact of Huldra's Renewal
4.description: You've sworn a pact with Zemnaïdé, a huldra professor at Cobyslarni, to help renew his former homeland of the Sarkoris Scar.

6.name: Pact of Draconic Fury
6.description: You've sworn a pact with a dragon, giving you the ability to tap into the dragon's immeasurable power in exchange for adding to their hoard.

8.name: Pact of Infernal Prowess
8.description: You've sworn a pact with devils, granting you success in life in exchange for your soul in the afterlife.

8.name: Ouroboric Pact
8.description: You've studied pacts at Cobyslarni, or learned under someone who has, and understand them to not only create a bargain between individuals, but a separate entity altogether: the pact itself.

12.name: Pact of the Final Breath
12.description: You've sworn a pact with a powerful psychopomp—typically an olethros advocate or yamaraj judge—granting you a reprieve before your soul will be collected in exchange for respect for the dead and assistance against the undead.

12.name: Pact of the Crossroads
12.description: You've sworn a pact with Ng the Hooded, the Eldest known as the Lord of the Crossroads, though your only sign of Ng's acknowledgment is the benefits you receive.

14.name: Pact of Eldritch Eyes
14.description: You've sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions.

14.name: Pact of the Death Hunter
14.description: You've sworn a pact with a psychopomp bent on the destruction of all undeath.

14.name: Pact of the Fey Paths
14.description: You've sworn a pact with a powerful fey creature that longs to see the wonders of the Universe.

10.name: Pact of the Nightblossom
10.description: You've sworn a pact with Jenway Nightblossom of the Synod of Truth in Dreams, a talented oneiromancer and pactbinder.

16.name: Pact of the Rune Dragon
16.description: While the students of Cobyslarni are taught to make pacts with many kinds of dragons, a pact with a rune dragon is somewhat more frequent due to their interest in the accomplishments of various academies.

18.name: Pact of the Living Pact
18.description: You've sworn a pact with a pact that has somehow survived long after the death of the original pactbinder.

2.name: Curse Maelstrom Dedication
2.prerequisite: You are cursed or have previously been cursed.
2.description: A horrible curse has left a lingering stain on your soul, and its effects continue to plague you even if the curse's other effects have ended.

2.name: Familiar Oddities
2.prerequisite: Curse Maelstrom Dedication; Trained in Occultism or Trained in Curse Lore
2.description: Perhaps due to the curse within you, curses occasionally perceive you as an extension of themselves and readily reveal themselves to you

4.name: Unnerving Expansion
4.description: You gather your curse around you and impel it to pour outward, expanding your maelstrom.

6.name: Share Burden
6.description: You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state.

8.name: Accursed Magic
8.description: When the curse within you spills out, you can lay curses on others and claim them for yourself with ease.

8.name: Counter Curse
8.description: You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it.

10.name: Torrential Backlash
10.description: Calling upon forbidden practices, you release the curse from within yourself, allowing it free rein to destroy everything around you.

12.name: Reverse Curse
12.description: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator.

2.name: Chronoskimmer Dedication
2.description: You became partially unstuck from time and have learned how to manipulate your place in the flow of time.

4.name: Turn Back the Clock
4.description: After failing a test of skill, you hop back in your personal timeline so you can try again.

6.name: Guide the Timeline
6.description: You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination.

8.name: Reversing Charge
8.description: You dive into the fray before rewinding yourself to safety. Stride up to your Speed.

8.name: Superimpose Time Duplicates
8.description: You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat.

10.name: Borrow Time
10.description: You reach ahead and make use of time that's yet to be.

10.name: Steal Time
10.description: You reach into another creature's timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time.

12.name: Combat Premonition
12.description: By narrowing your sense of the future, you can improve that of your allies.

12.name: Escape Timeline
12.description: You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers.

12.name: Space-Time Shift
12.description: You travel just a few moments into the future to immediately arrive at your destination.

14.name: Reset the Past
14.description: You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place.

4.name: Psychic Duelist Dedication
4.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; you have been in a psychic duel
4.description: Through experience and in-depth visualizations of mental battles, you've grown adept at psychic duels.

6.name: Duel Spell Advantage
6.description: When you start a psychic duel, you gain a third natural psychic spell.

8.name: Supreme Psychic Center
8.description: With the merest thought, you realign your mental defenses to your duel's circumstances.

12.name: Instigate Psychic Duel
12.description: You attempt to enter a psychic duel with a creature.

2.name: Mind Smith Dedication
2.description: You've learned to imagine a shape in your mind, to envision it so strongly it takes form in the material world.

2.name: Malleable Movement
2.prerequisite: Mind Smith Dedication; Expert in Athletics
2.description: You shift the shape of your weapon to help you Leap farther and faster.

4.name: Ghost Blade
4.description: You alter your weapon's phase so it can more easily strike incorporeal creatures.

4.name: Just the Tool
4.description: You temporarily change your weapon's shape to assist you in the field.

4.name: Mental Forge
4.description: Your experiences in combat shape your mind's capability to strengthen and shape your weapon to match the way you move in combat.

6.name: Mind Shards
6.description: With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind.

8.name: Malleable Mental Forge
8.description: You open your mind to further weapon customization.

8.name: Mind Projectiles
8.description: You've learned to stretch your mind's influence further, releasing projectiles with a swing of your mind weapon.

10.name: Runic Mind Smithing
10.description: You focus your mind on thoughtforms of fundamental magical forces, shaping them into a property rune that you mentally etch onto your mind weapon.

12.name: Metallic Envisionment
12.description: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents.

16.name: Advanced Runic Mind-Smithing
16.description: Your mind can hold onto more complicated patterns than ever before.

4.name: Sleepwalker Dedication
4.description: You've learned to manipulate states of consciousness, beginning with your own.

6.name: Infiltrate Dream
6.description: Entering a dream is as natural to you as stepping through a doorway.

6.name: Vision of Foresight
6.description: You use your daydreams to predict the success of actions, rapidly envisioning the possibilities.

8.name: Dream Magic
8.description: You learn dream-related magic to aid your studies.

8.name: Waking Dream
8.description: While in your trance, you can blur the line between dreams and reality for others.

12.name: Oneiric Influence
12.description: While Infiltrating a Dream, you can also implant a suggestion in the target's mind.

12.name: Ward Slumber
12.description: Just before going to sleep, you can perform a 10-minute ward to protect the slumber of up to eight creatures within 30 feet of you.

14.name: Dream Logic
14.description: You can transmit a sense of dreamy nonchalance.

16.name: Shared Dream
16.description: You've learned to create a shared dreamscape to communicate with others.

18.name: Ever Dreaming
18.description: You draw no distinction between the sleeping and waking worlds.

2.name: Starstone Aspirant Dedication
2.description: Divine glory awaits! You embrace your longing to make a true and lasting difference in the Universe by embarking on the path to apotheosis.

4.name: For the Fallen!
4.description: So many other hopefuls have attempted the Test of the Starstone before you and failed.

4.name: Minor Deific Power
4.description: Your mental, physical, and spiritual training have granted you access to divine magic that doesn't rely on any other deity or patron.

4.name: Norgorber's Secret
4.description: Being the god of secrets, Norgorber has erased all traces of his life before his ascension so that his every mortal act and even his identity remain unknown and unknowable.

6.name: Cayden's Freedom
6.description: Even if you've never downed a tankard of ale nor indulged in a night of rowdy revelry, you appreciate the dedication to freedom from Cayden Cailean and his worshippers.

6.name: Iomedae's Valor
6.description: Though you might not be walking the virtuous path of honor and justice most often associated with Iomedae, you have studied her mortal bravery and can emulate it when you're on the brink of defeat.

8.name: Advanced Deific Power
8.description: Like a muscle, the more you flex your divine power, the stronger it gets.

8.name: Aroden's Innovation
8.description: As befits the god of humanity and innovation, Aroden left teachings that continue to inspire.

10.name: Gather Disciples
10.prerequisite: Starstone Aspirant Dedication; Master in Religion
10.description: Gods need followers, and you know that its best to gather a flock in the present to support you in your endeavor.

12.name: Greater Deific Power
12.description: Divine power continues to fill you.

18.name: Major Deific Power
18.description: As your apotheosis into living godhood approaches, you accrue the strongest of divine power.

2.name: Godless Healing
2.prerequisite: Battle Medicine; can't have a patron deity
2.description: You recover an additional 5 Hit Points from a successful attempt to Treat your Wounds or use Battle Medicine on you.

2.name: Mortal Healing
2.prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; you follow the Laws of Mortality
2.description: You grant greater healing when the gods don't interfere.

7.name: Paragon Battle Medicine
7.description: You've learned the modern uses of Battle Medicine originated by Kassi Aziril.

6.name: Pure Legion Enforcer Dedication
6.description: You are sworn to uphold the Laws of Mortality within the borders of Rahadoum.

8.name: Edict of Mortality
8.description: You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: "Let no mortal be beholden to a god." Attempt an Intimidation check against all enemies within 60 feet that worship a deity, comparing your result against each target's Will DC.

8.name: Unassailable Enforcer
8.description: Your faith in the Pure Legion protects you from spiritual harm.

10.name: No Gods, Only Mortals!
10.description: You order the caster to stop their spellcasting.

10.name: Traces of the Divine
10.description: You can detect those who use divine magic like an additional sense.

12.name: Shake Off the Gods
12.description: Your trust in the Pure Legion rushes forth as you fight off the influence of a god.

14.name: Throttle the Divine
14.description: You grasp the godly by their throats and damage their connection to their deities.

16.name: Wrath Against the Divine
16.description: You channel your commitment to removing the divine from the world as you recite the Laws of Mortality.

18.name: Repelling Enforcer
18.description: Your conviction reflects damage from the divine.

20.name: Mortal Possibility
20.description: You made yourself into a paragon of mortality and prove that deities aren't needed to achieve greatness.

2.name: Undersea Privateer Dedication
2.description: Your training has taught you the basics of underwater combat.

4.name: Anchor Stance
4.description: You tense your muscles to make yourself neutrally buoyant and more difficult to move.

4.name: Fast Swimmer
4.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; you have a Swim speed
4.description: You move more quickly underwater.

4.name: Trained Swimmer
4.description: Thanks to tireless practice, water has become a natural environment for you.

6.name: Float Free
6.description: You move 5 feet or up to half your swim Speed vertically through the water.

6.name: Slippery as an Eel
6.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics
6.description: You mimic the serpentine movements of an eel.

6.name: Stealthy as an Octopus
6.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; Expert in Stealth
6.description: You're an expert at using the dark of the ocean to conceal yourself.

8.name: Boarding Party
8.description: You're practiced at scaling ships, and even a wet and slippery exterior won't stand in your way.

8.name: Riptide
8.description: You swirl water around you to make a current that pulls creatures closer.

10.name: Ship's Shadow
10.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; Expert in Stealth
10.description: After extensive training around and on board ships, you've learned how to use their size and contours to conceal yourself.

12.name: Propelled Leap
12.description: Like a flying fish, you can build up momentum and launch yourself into the air.

12.name: Shroud of the Seas
12.description: You've learned to camouflage yourself among the shadows and currents of the ocean so you're hard to see from above.

14.name: Sailfish Strike
14.description: You've learned how to convert your upward momentum into a powerful attack.

16.name: Tidal Wave
16.description: Like the ocean in a storm, you overwhelm your opponents with speed and force.

2.name: Chelaxian Scion Dedication
2.description: A noble house has invested in your training, imparting special techniques the family has honed over generations.

4.name: Aristocratic Arms
4.description: Through consistent (and often punishing) practice, you've learned how to use your house's preferred weapons.

4.name: Patronize the Arts
4.description: A true aristocrat knows how to encourage their best hirelings, ensuring loyalty and future excellence.

6.name: Stoic as Hell
6.prerequisite: Chelaxian Scion Dedication; Trained in Intimidation; expert in Will
6.description: Like the archdevil Dispater, you maintain an unshakable poise even under impossible stress.

2.name: Marine Marauder Dedication
2.description: You're as skilled in combat underwater as on land.

4.name: Aquatic Pirouette
4.description: You spin in the water to avoid the attack.

4.name: Like a Fish in Water
4.description: Water feels like a second skin to you, and you glide through it as quickly as a fish.

4.name: Marine Combat Training
4.description: You're skilled with weapons that can be easily handled underwater.

4.name: Reactive Tangle
4.description: You wrap the net around the creature's feet to prevent it from escaping.

4.name: Surface Rush
4.description: You make a dedicated dash to enter the water or emerge onto land.

6.name: Aquatic Passage
6.description: You can move through water as easily as you walk on land.

6.name: Concealing Currents
6.description: You use currents of water to conceal a projectile, preventing your enemy from predicting its trajectory.

6.name: Shark Attack
6.description: Your swimming skills enable you to lunge through the water in a sudden attack.

8.name: Pressure Change
8.description: You sink or rise rapidly alongside your target, altering their internal pressure.

8.name: Stay Here!
8.description: You topple your foes with your legs and attack them while they're down.

10.name: Marine Jet
10.prerequisite: Marine Marauder Dedication; you have a swim Speed
10.description: You shoot through the water at a great speed.

10.name: Reel 'Em In
10.description: You've developed combat techniques inspired by the methods fishermen use to catch large fish.

12.name: Take in the Catch
12.description: Your skills in marine fishing can also be applied to combat.

2.name: Magus Dedication
2.description: You cast spells like a magus, gaining a spellbook with four common arcane cantrips of your choice.

4.name: Basic Magus Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Basic Martial Magic
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level magus feat of your choice.

4.name: Hybrid Study Spell
4.description: You gain the conflux spell from a hybrid study of your choice.

4.name: Spellstriker
4.description: You gain the magus's Spellstrike activity.

6.name: Advanced Martial Magic
6.description: You gain one magus feat.

12.name: Expert Magus Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Magus Spellcasting; Master in Arcana
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Magus Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Magus Spellcasting; Legendary in Arcana
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Necromancer Dedication
2.description: You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice.

4.name: Basic Death Dealing
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level necromancer feat of your choice.

4.name: Basic Necromancer Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Necrotic Bomber
4.description: You gain the necrotic bomb grave spell.

4.name: Thrall Charger
4.description: You gain the thrall charge grave cantrip, allowing you to more aggressively use your undead servants.

6.name: Inevitable Thralls
6.description: You gain the necromancer's Inevitable Return reaction, allowing you to create thralls from the corpses of your enemies.

6.name: Advanced Death Dealing
6.description: You gain one necromancer feat.

12.name: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Necromancer Spellcasting; Master in Occultism
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Necromancer Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Necromancer Spellcasting; Legendary in Occultism
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Runesmith Dedication
2.description: You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting.

4.name: Basic Rune Magic
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level runesmith feat.

6.name: Advanced Rune Magic
6.description: You gain a runesmith feat.

6.name: Tracing Studies
6.description: You can now create runes in the midst of combat.

10.name: Expanded Repertoire
10.description: Your knowledge of runes grows.

18.name: Greater Expanded Repertoire
18.description: You have gained extensive knowledge in the art of creating runes.

12.name: Runic Expertise
12.description: You become an expert in runesmith class DC.

2.name: Summoner Dedication
2.description: You've formed a bond with an eidolon, an entity that manifests in a physical body only through their link to your life force.

4.name: Basic Summoner Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Basic Synergy
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level summoner feat of your choice.

4.name: Initial Eidolon Ability
4.description: Your link to your eidolon strengthens, granting them a new ability.

6.name: Advanced Synergy
6.description: You gain one summoner feat.

12.name: Expert Combat Eidolon
12.description: Your eidolon advances their capabilities in combat.

12.name: Expert Summoner Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Summoner Spellcasting; master in the skill associated with your eidolon's tradition
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

18.name: Master Summoner Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Summoner Spellcasting; legendary in the skill associated with your eidolon's tradition
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

14.name: Signature Synergy
14.description: Your eidolon gains an evolution integral to its form, and it comes more easily than your other synergies.

2.name: Captivator Dedication
2.prerequisite: Charisma +2; Trained in Deception or Trained in Diplomacy
2.description: Your ability to captivate others borders on the preternatural.

4.name: Basic Captivator Spellcasting
4.description: Your innate ability to fascinate others develops into full‑fledged spellcasting.

6.name: Heightened Captivation
6.description: You can infuse your charms and illusions with more power.

8.name: Captivating Intensity
8.description: Your ability to captivate others has grown, and you can use your captivator abilities more often.

8.name: Countercharm
8.description: Your charms and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others.

10.name: Expert Captivator Spellcasting
10.description: You learn more powerful spells to enchant and deceive.

10.name: Reactive Charm
10.description: You're so charming and distracting that when pressed, you can cast a simple charm in time to foil an attacker.

12.name: Beguiling Aura
12.description: You channel your manipulative magic to subtly give off mental signals that either drive enemies away or draw them closer.

14.name: Effortless Captivation
14.description: You maintain your innate charms and illusions with hardly a thought.

16.name: Master Captivator Spellcasting
16.description: You master the most powerful spells that enchant and deceive.

18.name: Look Again
18.description: If your charms or illusions fail to ensnare the minds of others, you can cast them again.

2.name: Hedge Mage Dedication
2.description: The Universe is your laboratory and altar, and the world your workshop and study.

4.name: Basic Hedge Mage Spellcasting
4.description: Your independent introspections grant you rudiments of magical power.

4.name: Peer Past the Hedge
4.description: You can pick up on subtle magic with ease.

4.name: Tender Ministrations
4.description: Your gentle magic eases even the most skittish of souls, a gift that almost guarantees you popularity among parents and farmers alike.

6.name: Humble Spell
6.description: For basic spells, basic movements; you can do without flamboyant gestures or showy signs of power.

6.name: Practical Magic
6.description: Want not, waste not; through a mix of frugality, inspiration, and sheer resourcefulness, you maintain a catalog of materials with ambient, lingering magic, which you can transform into temporary spell catalysts.

8.name: Cantrip Supremacy
8.description: You know more than most how useful even the simplest of spells can be during the course of a day.

8.name: Simple Mastery
8.description: Other casters' never-ending hunger for new magic prevents them from truly understanding just how far simple magic can be pushed when truly mastered.

10.name: Keepsake of Power
10.prerequisite: Hedge Mage Dedication; Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion
10.description: Your keepsake might be disdained by your more orthodox peers as a crutch to your studies, but you know it grants you an understated, yet undeniable, power.

12.name: Expert Hedge Mage Spellcasting
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

14.name: Community Needs
14.description: You have learned to take the time needed to be flexible and to contemplate the best use of your magic for those around you.

18.name: Master Hedge Mage Spellcasting
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Living Nexus Dedication
2.prerequisite: trained in martial weapons; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
2.description: Whether through happenstance or hours of rigorous training, you have discovered within yourself the ability to breathe in the magic around you.

3.name: Inspired Memory
3.description: A memory of each spell you have absorbed remains within your soul.

4.name: Aether Blast
4.description: You channel some of the raw magical energy in your internal nexus into a devastating blast.

4.name: The Taste of Magic
4.description: Each working of magic has a unique scent and frequency of vibration.

6.name: Flexible Nexus
6.description: In bending the basic essences of magic around yourself, you have seen the ways they connect and flow into each other, changing from one to the next.

6.name: Harness Natural Magic
6.description: Although it's often faint, you can sense the presence of magic all around you.

6.name: Surging Smash
6.description: Lashing forward, your weapon becomes an extension of your nexus, washing your enemies in a torrent of magical fury.

8.name: Aether Beam
8.description: You can open your internal nexus, unleashing a destructive beam of magical energy that emanates from your hand, eyes, or chest.

8.name: Healing Nexus
8.description: You metabolize some of the magic you absorb into your internal nexus to stitch together any wounds on the rest of your body.

10.name: Null Field
10.description: You understand the frequency of energies that have damaged you and can extend the magical network of power in your internal nexus to diffuse incoming attacks.

12.name: Steal Magic's Breath
12.description: Your internal nexus has grown to an immense size and can absorb workings of magic even as they form, sometimes even swallowing them entirely.

14.name: Quick Absorption
14.description: After so much exposure to the myriad forms of magical energy, you absorb magic almost instinctively.

2.name: Soulforger Dedication
2.prerequisite: or ability to cast divine spells
2.description: You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations.

4.name: Soul Flare
4.description: You strive to change the outcome with sheer zeal.

6.name: Rapid Manifestation
6.description: Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you're in danger.

6.name: Soul Arsenal
6.description: Choose an additional soulforged armament of a different type than you already chose, and choose one essence power for it.

14.name: Devastating Manifestation
14.description: Your armaments are especially powerful the moment after you manifest them.

2.name: Spellshifter Dedication
2.description: You can exert your will over magical spells cast in your vicinity, potentially altering or controlling their effects.

4.name: Analyze Magic
4.description: Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air.

4.name: Elemental Subsitution
4.description: You can tamper with the elemental energy of a spell.

4.name: Subtle Shift
4.description: You've learned how to hide your meddling from the casters of spells you're shifting.

6.name: Dismantle Spell
6.description: Your innate power can shut down other magic.

6.name: Reactive Spellshift
6.description: You can reflexively shift a spell even as it's being cast.

8.name: Enhance Spell
8.description: You attune your senses to the magical frequencies generated by an allied spellcaster, allowing you to amplify or modify their spells to suit the needs of the moment.

12.name: Redirect Spell
12.description: You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another.

2.name: World Rouser Dedication
2.description: You know how to wake the world around you from its slumber, whether through your natural affinity for nature or hard-earned knowledge.

4.name: Nature's Embrace
4.description: You call on the world to hamper your foes.

4.name: The World Whispers
4.description: Your waking world tells you about the unseen creatures it holds.

6.name: All Returns to Slumber
6.description: Your waking world returns to slumber, and lays the peace of deep sleep on all within it.

6.name: Sheltering Hand
6.description: Animals, plants, and the earth itself rush to protect you from harm, interposing themselves between you and danger.

8.name: Dust Cloud
8.description: Dust and pollen fill your waking world, obscuring creatures from sight.

8.name: Wake and Tremble
8.description: You have the world wake with a great convulsion.

10.name: A Hush Falls Over the World
10.description: Sound is absorbed in your waking world, covering everything in a shroud of quiet until the start of your next turn.

10.name: Come in From the Wilderness
10.description: A willing ally on the ground in your waking world is swaddled in earth.

12.name: The World Devours
12.description: The ground in your waking world opens to consume a creature standing on it, which must attempt a Reflex save against your world rouser DC.

14.name: Awake With a Roar
14.description: When you Rouse the World, it awakens with a mighty yawp that stuns the unsuspecting.

2.name: Pathfinder Agent Dedication
2.description: You're a field agent of the globe-trotting Pathfinder Society.

4.name: Careful Explorer
4.description: You gain a sixth sense for traps, noticing them even when you're not trying to.

4.name: Deft Cooperation
4.description: You gain a bonus to your own checks when Aiding an ally.

4.name: Thorough Reports
4.description: Recalling Knowledge adds creatures to your list, granting you bonuses to Recall in future encounters.

4.name: Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer
4.description: Access a new cantrip by using your Wayfinder.

4.name: Dead Reckoning
4.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Trained in Survival
4.description: You've trained yourself to maintain a strong sense of direction at all times, even when you can't use a compass or see the sky above.

4.name: Environmental Explorer
4.description: You've traversed enough untamed wilderness to gain an intuitive understanding of the dangers that exist in such places.

4.name: Observant Explorer
4.description: You've gained an intuitive sense about creatures.

4.name: Remember Your Training
4.description: You were schooled on a wide variety of creatures you might encounter.

4.name: Spiritual Explorer
4.description: You're familiar with the danger that lingering spirits can pose to an unwary adventurer.

4.name: Watch and Learn
4.description: Pathfinder agents serve as members of diverse teams with complementary skill sets.

6.name: Forced Entry
6.prerequisite: Expert in Athletics; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
6.description: You are trained to preserve the archaeological value of your location when entering.

6.name: Archaeologist's Warning
6.description: You visually or audibly warn your companions of danger, granting them a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

6.name: Craft Facsimile
6.prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
6.description: You're renowned for your ability to recover important items and sometimes that requires creating a stand-in.

6.name: Westyr's Wayfinder Repository
6.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer
6.description: You can use your wayfinder to store a little extra magic for when you need it most.

6.name: Discerning Strike
6.description: Identifying a creature is the first step in finding its weaknesses.

8.name: Recognize Threat
8.prerequisite: master in a Recall Knowledge skill; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
8.description: You quickly assess the threat so you can relay the information to your team.

8.name: Diverse Recognition
8.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; master in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
8.description: Your Pathfinder training allows you to quickly size up numerous threats.

8.name: Snap Out of It! (Pathfinder Agent)
8.prerequisite: Master in Medicine; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
8.description: Pathfinders are trained to help each other be safe and successful, and you know how to jolt your allies back to their senses.

8.name: Wayfinder Resonance Infiltrator
8.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer
8.description: You are adept at using the unusual resonance of your wayfinder to aid in any deceptions you might employ.

10.name: Everyone Duck!
10.description: You intentionally set off the trap, but you take special precautions to protect yourself and your allies from the trap's effects.

10.name: Eidetic Memorization
10.description: Pathfinders are often asked to study the intricacies of ancient history under less than ideal conditions, and you've trained your brain to make the most of your limited time.

12.name: Educated Assessment
12.description: You attempt to Recall Knowledge about a creature, and the GM uses the same secret roll result against the creature's Deception or Stealth DC, giving you the information from a Battle Assessment.

12.name: Swap Investment
12.description: Your time as a Pathfinder has taught you how to improvise, and you've learned to make use of the resources you find in the field.

2.name: Aldori Duelist Dedication
2.description: Increase your dedication and training to the Aldori dueling sword.

2.name: Dueling Acumen
2.description: You're always ready for a new duel, and you've been trained to start and end fights quickly.

4.name: Aldori Parry
4.description: Increase your AC while wielding an Aldori dueling sword.

4.name: Duelist's Edge
4.description: Increase your initiative with the dueling sword.

6.name: Aldori Riposte
6.description: Learn to strike back at your opponent when they fail to attack you.

6.name: Unnerving Prowess
6.description: Make a free Demoralize check when you critically succeed with your dueling sword.

10.name: Saving Slash
10.description: Make a check to reduce a critical hit against you to a normal hit.

12.name: One-on-One
12.prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; Trained in Deception
12.description: Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent.

14.name: Aldori's Retort
14.description: You can flow through combat reactions with graceful ease.

16.name: Duelist's Form
16.description: Many assume that a duelist's habit of fighting with one hand behind their back or on their hip is an insult or self-restriction.

16.name: Tempo Duelist
16.description: You move with an unpredictable tempo, shifting between unnervingly slow and rapid movements.

18.name: Devastating Duelist
18.description: You pointedly note your enemy's deficiencies, filling them with fear and dismay.

20.name: Aldori Swordlord
20.prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; you have taken the last name of Aldori, sworn to the Aldori swordpact, and demonstrated skill at swordplay by winning a duel using only a sword in the presence of an Aldori swordlord.
20.description: You are an Aldori swordlord.

20.name: Swordlord Exile
20.prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; you have broken or forsaken the Aldori swordpact.
20.description: You are a swordlord exile.

2.name: Lastwall Sentry Dedication
2.prerequisite: member of the Knights of Lastwall; Shield Block
2.description: Swear yourself as a sentry for the Knights of Lastwall.

4.name: Eye of Ozem
4.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; expert in Perception
4.description: Learn how to better spot danger at a distance.

4.name: Necromantic Resistance
4.description: Gain resistance to necromancy effects and damage.

4.name: Rescuer's Press
4.description: Any shield you wield gains the shove trait.

4.name: Always Ready
4.description: Extensive training against undead has taught you to cover your weak points, even when you think that you're alone.

4.name: Bless Shield
4.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; you worship a good-aligned deity
4.description: Your uttered prayers become an aegis, drawing the blessing of your deity across the surface of your shield.

4.name: Familiar Foe
4.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; Expert in Religion or Expert in Undead Lore
4.description: You regularly face off against undead and can identify many with a glance.

4.name: Final Rest
4.description: As stubborn in death as you are in life, you vow you'll never aid your hated enemies.

4.name: Nonlethal Takedown
4.description: You prefer to use nonlethal means against living opponents, but the weapons you carry are lethal enough to destroy undead.

6.name: Grave Sense
6.description: Learn how to sense undead in the area.

6.name: Practiced Opposition
6.description: You've battled more undead than you care to remember, often with little time to prepare between foes, forcing you to rely on experience and muscle memory to guide your blade.

6.name: Repulse the Wicken
6.description: You use your foe's failure as an opening to push them away.

6.name: Sacred Armaments
6.description: Through the power of your faith or the blessing of a priest, your weapons are fully effective against incorporeal creatures.

8.name: Necromantic Tenacity
8.description: Reduce the power that necromantic effects hold over you.

8.name: Flashing Shield
8.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; you worship a good-aligned deity
8.description: Your shield flares with holy light as you block the attack, searing the undead with the power of your faith.

8.name: Necromantic Bulwark
8.description: Regular exposure to necromantic effects left you better able to defend against them.

10.name: Lastwall Warden
10.description: Use your shield to protect your allies.

10.name: Grave Sight
10.description: Your ability to sense undead has improved.

12.name: No Stranger to Death
12.description: Your regular exposure to the insidious putrescence of undeath inured you to its effects.

14.name: Resolute Defender
14.description: You hold your shield together with the power of your faith and conviction, refusing to let wood splinter and steel shatter until the day's battles are won.

14.name: Thwart Evil
14.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; Expert in Religion
14.description: You react instinctively when you sense evil forming, thrusting your spiritual energy toward the source to snuff out evil before it fully manifests.

16.name: Withstand Death
16.description: Through repeated exposure, you've trained to resist the damage wrought by undead.

18.name: Spirit of Vigil
18.description: Though the city of Vigil itself has been destroyed, you will carry on its warrior spirit to the end of your days.

18.name: Uncanny Vitae
18.description: Your warrior spirit is infused with a potent vital essence that imbues your gear.

20.name: Cenotaph Stance
20.description: You take on a stance that marks your location as a place where none will fall.

2.name: Living Monolith Dedication
2.prerequisite: Ancient Osiriani and Sphinx languages; Trained in Crafting
2.description: Begin to process to become a living monolith.

4.name: Ka Stone Ritual
4.prerequisite: Living Monolith Dedication; a sphinx or living monolith with this feat performs a ritual with you
4.description: You enchant your ka stone and can use it to wield magic.

6.name: Stone Blood
6.description: Your blood clots quickly.

8.name: Fortified Flesh
8.description: Your flesh is resistent to physical damage.

10.name: Attunement to Stone
10.description: You can feel vibrations through the ground.

12.name: Judgment of the Monolith
12.description: You can use your ka stone to compel the truth.

14.name: Stone Communion
14.description: You can speak Terran and speak with stones.

2.name: Student of Perfection Dedication
2.prerequisite: powerful fist or expert in unarmed attacks; member of a House of Perfection
2.description: You have joined one of the Houses of Perfection.

4.name: Perfect Strike
4.description: You call upon insight from your training to recover accuracy.

4.name: Perfect Weaponry
4.description: You gain the Monastic Weaponry monk class feat.

6.name: Perfect Ki Adept
6.description: You gain the appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection.

8.name: Perfect Resistance
8.description: You gain resistance equal to half your level to all damage from effects with the appropriate trait for your School of Perfection: fire for Unblinking Flame, water for Unbreaking Waves, air for Unfolding Wind, and earth for Untwisting Iron.

10.name: Perfect Ki Expert
10.description: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: unblinking flame aura for Unblinking Flame, unbreaking wave vapor for Unbreaking Waves, unfolding wind buffet for Unfolding Wind, or untwisting iron roots for Untwisting Iron.

14.name: Perfect Ki Exemplar
14.description: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: unblinking flame emblem for Unblinking Flame, unbreaking wave barrier for Unbreaking Waves, unfolding wind blitz for Unfolding Wind, or untwisting iron augmentation for Untwisting Iron.

18.name: Perfect Ki Grandmaster
18.prerequisite: Perfect Ki Expert or Perfect Ki Exemplar
18.description: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: unblinking flame ignition for Unblinking Flame, unbreaking wave containment for Unbreaking Waves, unfolding wind crash for Unfolding Wind, or untwisting iron pillar for Untwisting Iron.

2.name: Magic Warrior Dedication
2.description: You have taken up a nameless mask and sworn the oath of the magic warriors.

4.name: Magic Warrior Aspect
4.description: You can alter your form to gain an aspect of the animal your mask represents.

4.name: Magic Warrior Transformation
4.description: You can transform fully into the animal your mask represents.

6.name: Nameless Anonymity
6.description: Your mask protects you further from divination.

2.name: Hellknight Armiger Dedication
2.prerequisite: member of a Hellknight Order; trained in heavy armor as well as your order's favored weapon
2.description: You have taken the first step to being a full Hellknight.

4.name: Ardent Armiger
4.description: You have been trained to resist the manipulations of fiends.

4.name: Diabolic Certitude
4.description: Your Hellknight training drilled details of Hell's denizens deep into your mind.

4.name: Mortification
4.description: Your reckonings have prepared your body for physical punishment.

8.name: Armiger's Mobility
8.prerequisite: expert in heavy armor; Hellknight Armiger Dedication
8.description: You've learned how best to move in heavy armor.

8.name: Order Training
8.description: You gain the lesser order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

12.name: Advanced Order Training
12.prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; Hellknight Dedication or Hellknight Signifer Dedication
12.description: You gain the greater order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

12.name: Hellknight Order Cross-Training
12.prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; Hellknight Dedication or Hellknight Signifer Dedication
12.description: You gain the lesser order benefit of a Hellknight order other than the one to which you belong.

2.name: Runescarred Dedication
2.description: Overwhelming magic has branded your body with powerful runes.

4.name: Spell Runes
4.description: The magical runes on your body grant you several magical abilities.

6.name: Living Rune
6.description: You've bridged a connection between the runes on your body and the magic of runestones, allowing you to place an armor rune on your living flesh.

6.name: Warding Rune
6.description: Your runes provide a warding effect that protects you against a specific school of magic.

10.name: Greater Spell Runes
10.description: You gain more powerful spell runes.

6.name: Bellflower Dedication
6.prerequisite: Charisma 14; Expert in Stealth; Expert in Survival; member of the Bellflower Network
6.description: You dedicate yourself to freeing slaves and escorting them to freedom.

8.name: Scarecrow
8.description: You fight fiercely to protect your crop.

8.name: Garden Path
8.description: You can guide your crop to move without notice.

8.name: Practiced Guidance
8.description: You can better Aid your crop.

10.name: Tiller's Drive
10.description: Increase your Speed and that of your crop.

10.name: Tiller's Aid
10.description: You can quickly Aid your crop.

12.name: Cut the Bonds
12.prerequisite: Bellflower Dedication; expert in a melee weapon
12.description: You can counteract a magical effect that impedes movement.

4.name: Firebrand Braggart Dedication
4.prerequisite: Charisma 14; second mark member of the Firebrands
4.description: Your Firebrand training has taught you that achieving something is more satisfying if you boast about it first.

6.name: Boaster's Challenge
6.prerequisite: Expert in Deception, Expert in Diplomacy, or Expert in Intimidation; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
6.description: You call out a foe, causing them to become flustered and easier to defeat.

6.name: Daring Act
6.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
6.description: You attempt a death-defying maneuver to distract your enemies.

8.name: Bravo's Determination
8.prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
8.description: Your confidence borders on self-delusion, but it keeps you going against overwhelming odds.

8.name: Great Boaster
8.description: Your bragging is particularly effective.

10.name: Daring Flourish
10.description: You make quick use of an opening from your daring stunts.

10.name: Demanding Challenge
10.description: If your skill check to challenge a foe is a success, the target of your challenge takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls (or –2 if you critically succeed) until the end of your next turn.

12.name: Daredevil's Gambit
12.description: If you critically succeed at your Daring Act, you can enter the target's space and remain there until the beginning of your next turn or until the target moves, whichever comes first.

6.name: Hellknight Signifer Dedication
6.prerequisite: spellcasting class feature; Hellknight Armiger Dedication; lawful alignment; member of a Hellknight Order; passed the Hellknight Test
6.description: You have bolstered your force of will with the power of the Measure and the Chain.

8.name: Masked Casting
8.description: You harness the magical energy flowing through your eyeless mask to effortlessly protect you from visual effects.

10.name: Gaze of Veracity
10.prerequisite: Hellknight Signifer Dedication; ability to cast focus spells
10.description: You can channel your mask's power to pierce through lies and see the truth in any situation.

10.name: Signifer's Sight
10.description: The magic flowing through your signifer's mask allows you to see in the dark, and the mask dampens the distraction caused by sudden flashes of bright light.

12.name: Signifer Armor Expertise
12.description: You've spent enough time helping your comrades equip medium and heavy armor that you spread your own expertise to those armors as well.

2.name: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana or Trained in Nature; member of the Magaambya of attendant rank
2.description: You devote much of your study to halcyon magic.

4.name: Mask Familiar
4.description: Your mask takes on a personality of its own, allowing it to serve as your familiar.

6.name: Adaptive Mask Familiar
6.description: Your mask familiar adapts quickly to material form, allowing it to gain more familiar and master abilities.

6.name: Cascade Bearer's Flexibility
6.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation
6.description: You call upon your Cascade Bearer training to help you adjust a spell for the current situation.

6.name: Emerald Boughs Accustomation
6.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Expert in Society; Emerald Boughs affiliation
6.description: You are comfortable and socially capable in almost any cultural context.

6.name: Rain-Scribe Sustenance
6.description: You use the power of your Rain-Scribe magic to draw on a stream of primal power for sustenance.

6.name: Tempest-Sun Redirection
6.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Tempest-Sun Mages affiliation
6.description: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots that damages other creatures, you can bend some of that spell's offensive energy, protecting allies in the area and boosting your own defenses against certain foes.

6.name: Uzunjati Storytelling
6.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Uzunjati affiliation; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
6.description: You tell a quick story or begin telling a longer tale.

10.name: Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting
10.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation
10.description: Your Cascade Bearer training allows you to broaden the horizons of your halcyon spells further than most Magaambyans, weaving in spiritual magic.

10.name: Emerald Boughs Hideaway
10.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Emerald Boughs affiliation
10.description: You use Emerald Bough techniques to create a small extradimensional space called a hideaway that lasts as long as you are conscious.

10.name: Rain-Scribe Mobility
10.description: You surround yourself in a mantle of Rain-Scribe magic and Stride twice; difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed, even if the difficult terrain has been manipulated by magic.

10.name: Tempest-Sun Shielding
10.description: You transform unrealized spell energy into a protective shield.

10.name: Uzunjati Recollection
10.prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
10.description: You tell a story spontaneously from nearly forgotten facts, delving into your memory and entertaining your audience in the process.

12.name: Janatimo's Lessons
12.description: Thanks to Janatimo's secret techniques, you can weave your knowledge and words into powerful tools to assist your allies in life-threatening situations.

12.name: Adept Storyteller
12.prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
12.description: Your ability to tell stories rivals those of the finest bards.

12.name: Cautious Word
12.description: You let your words defend you, just as your allies in the Vellumis Scholars defend through knowledge.

14.name: Crusader's Masquerade
14.description: Your mask can hide you from the undead.

16.name: Faith in the Fallen
16.description: The Gravelands are full of fallen spirits seeking to move on, and you consider it your obligation to assist in that regard.

18.name: I Knew the Heroes
18.prerequisite: Uzunjati Recollection; legendary in a Recall Knowledge Skill
18.description: Your stories aren't mere tales passed down from elder to youth or teacher to student.

6.name: Halcyon Speaker Dedication
6.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; member of the Magaambya of conversant rank
6.description: You devote much of your study to halcyon magic.

8.name: Dualistic Synergy
8.description: If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you gain a benefit.

8.name: Persistent Creation
8.description: You can cast creation as an innate spell at will, choosing whether it is arcane or primal each time.

10.name: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate
10.description: Your knowledge of halcyon magic increases.

10.name: Shared Synergy
10.description: You can grant the benefit from Dualistic Synergy to an ally within 30 feet instead of yourself, either allowing that ally to Recall Knowledge, granting that ally temporary Hit Points, or both, depending on the spell's tradition.

12.name: Charged Creation
12.description: Your magic is drawn to your persistent creations.

12.name: Flexible Halcyon Spellcasting
12.description: You broaden your ability to channel your power into halcyon magic.

14.name: Halcyon Spellcasting Adept
14.prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate; master in either Arcana or Nature, expert in the other
14.description: You refine your halcyon magic.

14.name: Shattered Sacrament
14.prerequisite: Halcyon Speaker Dedication; Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting
14.description: When Vigil fell to Tar-Baphon's Radiant Fire, that lost innocence brought you a deeper understanding of what faith means in the context of your own magic.

14.name: Speak for the Gravelands
14.prerequisite: Halcyon Speaker Dedication; Trained in Nature; can cast at least one spell with the vitality trait
14.description: You have learned much of what the Gravelands need and are confident in your ability to speak for them.

16.name: Fulminating Synergy
16.description: When you draw upon your spells' synergy, you create a physical manifestation of their magical resonance and invoke it to harm a foe.

16.name: Vellumis Excision
16.description: You seek to excise the rot from the Gravelands and have made progress to do so.

18.name: Halcyon Spellcasting Sage
18.prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Adept; legendary in either Arcana or Nature, master in the other
18.description: Your command over halcyon magic is nearly unmatched.

18.name: Tripartite Omen
18.prerequisite: Dualistic Synergy; Shattered Sacrament; Master in Religion
18.description: You invoke religious portents to ward yourself against danger without losing sight of the history that led to this point.

20.name: Synergistic Spell
20.prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate; Fulminating Synergy; Legendary in Arcana; Legendary in Nature
20.description: You combine your synergy and spells into a fantastic web of magic, allowing you to cast two spells at once.

20.name: Vigil's Palisades
20.description: When you use Persistent Creation, you can create up to three special wooden shields that provide a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and have Hardness 15, 120 HP, and BT 60.

6.name: Scrollmaster Dedication
6.prerequisite: expert in any Lore skill; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Scrolls
6.description: Your experience chronicling adventures and discoveries grants you heightened discernment and memory.

8.name: Lore Seeker
8.description: You see what others don't, and you've developed magical tricks to find hidden truth.

8.name: Unravel Mysteries
8.prerequisite: master in a Decipher Writing skill; Scrollmaster Dedication
8.description: You can understand the true meaning of texts quickly, and even when you get lost or hit a dead end, you aren't discouraged from making further attempts to get to the bottom of things.

8.name: Foolproof Instructions
8.description: You feel confident that you can explain your scrolls so well that even your allies can use them.

8.name: Innate Magic Intuition
8.description: You've spent countless hours learning to recognize and predict a creature's innate magical abilities.

8.name: Magic Finder
8.description: You've learned a few tricks to ensure you find every last magic item and interesting magical effect during your missions.

8.name: Transcribe Moment
8.description: You gain the transcribe moment focus spell.

10.name: Font of Knowledge
10.description: Experience or focused study have granted you mastery of a number of topics.

10.name: Bestiary Scholar
10.prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Crafting, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion; Scrollmaster Dedication
10.description: You learn how to apply your extensive knowledge of certain creatures using the lore you know.

10.name: Cautious Delver
10.description: You've studied the many ways that ancient architects and spellcasters protected their possessions, such as by implementing deadly traps and curses, and learned some magic to counteract them.

10.name: Masterful Obfuscation
10.prerequisite: master in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action; Scrollmaster Dedication
10.description: You've mastered the art of deceiving others about your area of study.

12.name: Determined Lore Seeker
12.description: You've mastered useful spells that let you find hidden truths others might miss.

16.name: Ward Mind
16.description: To protect the knowledge within your mind from intrusion or erasure, you ward yourself against a mental attack.

6.name: Spellmaster Dedication
6.prerequisite: Intelligence 14, Wisdom 14, or Charisma 14; ability to cast focus spells; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Spells
6.description: As a Spellmaster, you are adept at identifying magic.

8.name: Surreptitious Spellcaster
8.description: You've learned that it pays for a Pathfinder to be able to cast spells without being noticed.

8.name: Familiar Form
8.description: You can use your magic to transform into a small creature of a type that commonly serves as a spellcaster's familiar, potentially allowing you to safely scout for your party while retaining a degree of spellcasting ability.

8.name: Glyph Expert
8.description: You've learned to recognize the telltale writings and other signs that indicate the presence of magical traps.

10.name: Ward Casting
10.description: You carefully ward your spell by drawing from a mantle of magical energy you prepared to protect your casting, increasing your chance of retaining the spell.

10.name: Recover Spell
10.description: You recover the energy of a recently disrupted spell, allowing you to cast it again as long as you do so immediately before the energy dissipates.

10.name: Spellmaster's Ward
10.description: You can create a number of powerful shielding runes that bolster your defenses against damaging spells by absorbing the worst of the energy to keep you safe.

12.name: Spellmaster's Resilience
12.description: Your experience with a specific type of harmful magic makes you more resistant to it.

12.name: Communal Sustain
12.description: Choose one spell with a sustained duration that one of your allies has in effect.

14.name: Absorb Spell
14.prerequisite: Spellmaster Dedication; spell repertoire or ability to prepare spells
14.description: You absorb a spell and store it in your body.

14.name: Spellmaster's Tenacity
14.description: You call upon the power of your spells to protect you from the worst of the magic headed your way.

16.name: Master's Counterspell
16.prerequisite: Spellmaster Dedication; master in spell attack rolls and spell DCs
16.description: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it.

16.name: Mobile Magical Combat
16.description: You dart around the battlefield, casting spells while you carefully make melee attacks with your weapon.

18.name: Retain Absorbed Spell
18.description: When you absorb a spell using the Absorb Spell reaction, you utilize secret, techniques that allow you to retain the power and knowledge necessary to cast the spell repeatedly—potentially for a greater period of time.

6.name: Swordmaster Dedication
6.prerequisite: Strength 14, Dexterity 14, or Constitution 14; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Swords
6.description: Your Swords training taught you to never lose hold of your weapon.

10.name: Harrying Strike
10.description: Your attack prevents a foe from pursuing your allies.

10.name: Armored Rest
10.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; trained in light, medium, or heavy armor
10.description: You've slept many nights in your armor and gotten used to it.

10.name: Martial Exercise
10.description: You've become comfortable in using weapons that you might not have picked up before training with the Swords.

10.name: Practiced Defender
10.description: After extensive practice with the Swords, you're comfortable enough with your shield to move at a normal pace with it raised.

12.name: Shoulder Catastrophe
12.description: You've trained to protect your allies by diverting the worst attacks to yourself.

12.name: Emergency Medical Assistance
12.description: You've learned a variety of methods for helping allies who are bleeding, burning, or otherwise suffering persistent damage, from brushing off acid to patting down fires.

12.name: Recollect Studies
12.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; expert in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
12.description: You paid attention during your studies and remember the right way to attack various creatures.

12.name: Rugged Survivalist
12.description: You've studied survival skills with the School of Swords experts and are comfortable spending long periods of time in the wilderness.

12.name: Tense Negotiator
12.description: You often find that the best way to win a conflict means avoiding a fight in the first place.

14.name: Death's Door
14.description: You continue to fight when others would fall.

14.name: Armored Exercise
14.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; trained in light, medium, or heavy armor
14.description: You've spent time training in your armor alongside other agents from the Swords.

14.name: Forceful Shot
14.description: Your ranged attacks push your foes away from your allies.

8.name: Improvised Crafting
8.description: You've learned to repair your equipment even in challenging circumstances, making use of what you have available.

8.name: Physical Training
8.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Athletics
8.description: You spend a lot of time focusing on your physical fitness.

8.name: Protect Ally
8.description: You place your body between your friends and your enemies, protecting your allies against oncoming attacks.

8.name: Quick Stow (Swordmaster)
8.description: You know that situations can change rapidly and might leave you needing to change equipment in the middle of combat.

8.name: Reflexive Grip
8.description: You keep hold of your weapons even when knocked out.

16.name: Focus Ally
16.description: You're so focused on your allies that you can help them to recenter when something would take them out of the fight.

18.name: Stave Off Catastrophe
18.description: You fully protect your allies from the worst blows.

4.name: Crystal Keeper Dedication
4.prerequisite: Trained in Elven Lore or Trained in Society
4.description: You can use Arcana, Occultism, Religion, or Society to Decipher Writing by meditating before a crystal, regardless of the type of writing.

4.name: Crystal Ward Spells
4.description: Your study of crystals and the energies held within a gem's facets grants you special arcane crystal ward spells.

6.name: Simple Crystal Magic
6.description: You are capable of seeing magic as flowing runes and can scribe a personal rune that represents you.

10.name: Armor Rune Shifter
10.description: You learn the secrets of armor runes by viewing them through gems and can alter them at your discretion.

10.name: Weapon-Rune Shifter
10.description: You learn how to alter the magic of weapon runes by using a crystal as a focusing component.

2.name: Zephyr Guard Dedication
2.description: As a Zephyr Guard, you're always vigilant against crime and threats to the city's safety.

4.name: Decry Thief
4.prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
4.description: When you attempt to Demoralize, you can make it harder for the target to flee, in place of the action's normal effects.

3.name: Know the Beat
3.description: You have been trained to investigate crimes.

6.name: Relentless Disarm
6.prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; Trained in Athletics
6.description: You have been trained to disarm foes.

8.name: Unfazed Assessment
8.prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; expert in Perception
8.description: You have witnessed hundreds of fighting styles and quickly adapt to defend against complicated maneuvers.

2.name: Juggler Dedication
2.description: You become trained in Performance and gain the Juggle skill feat

4.name: Focused Juggler
4.description: You continue Juggling until the end of your next turn.

4.name: Quick Juggler
4.description: When you start to Juggle or add another item to those you are Juggling, you add two items instead of one.

4.name: Reflexive Catch
4.description: Grab an item thrown at you.

8.name: Lobbed Attack
8.description: Make an unexpected ranged attack with a Juggled item.

16.name: Opportune Throw
16.description: Make a ranged attack with a Juggled item against a vulnerable creature.

2.name: Staff Acrobat Dedication
2.prerequisite: Dexterity 16; Trained in Acrobatics; Trained in Athletics; trained with at least one of the following weapons: staff, bo staff, halfling sling staff, or any weapon in the spear or polearm group (referred to in this archetype as "your staff")
2.description: Gain bonuses when using your staff as an implement to aid Acrobatics and Athletics actions.

4.name: Bullying Staff
4.description: You can Shove and Trip larger creatures.

6.name: Staff Sweep
6.description: You sweep your foes away with your staff.

8.name: Levering Strike
8.description: Strike your foe and make them unbalanced

10.name: Whirlwind Stance
10.prerequisite: Staff Acrobat Dedication; expert proficiency in your staff
10.description: You use your staff as a defensive implement as well as an offensive one.

14.name: Pivot Strike
14.description: You Leap and then Strike using your staff.

2.name: Animal Trainer Dedication
2.description: You gain a young animal companion.

4.name: Beast Speaker
4.description: You can speak with animals.

6.name: Mature Trained Companion
6.description: Your animal companion grows up, becoming a mature animal companion.

8.name: Insistent Command
8.prerequisite: Master in Nature; Animal Trainer Dedication
8.description: When you roll a success to Command an Animal, you get a critical success.

12.name: Splendid Companion
12.description: Your animal companion continues to develop.

18.name: Specialized Companion
18.description: Your animal companion gains a specialization.

8.name: Golem Grafter Dedication
8.prerequisite: expert in Arcana and Crafting, or an ally with expert proficiency in those skills willing to augment you
8.description: Your flesh has been specially treated with the same arcane and alchemical processes used to toughen the skin of flesh golems.

10.name: Accursed Clay Fist
10.prerequisite: Golem Grafter Dedication; expert in unarmed attacks
10.description: You have replaced one of your forearms with one made of clay and infused with cursed arcane magic.

10.name: Quicken Heartbeat
10.description: You've replaced your heart with one made of animated quicksilver and living adamantine.

12.name: Legs of Stone
12.description: You gain a +2 status bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to Shove or Trip you.

14.name: Iron Lung
14.description: Your lungs are infused with the resilience of iron.

2.name: Turpin Rowe Lumberjack Dedication
2.description: Your logging training has made you intimately familiar with all aspects of forestry.

4.name: Axe Climber
4.description: You can climb wooden surfaces using axes.

4.name: Log Roll
4.description: You shuffle your feet to dislodge the surface beneath you or otherwise cause your opponent to become unsteady.

6.name: Axe Thrower
6.description: You have mastered the weight and balance of a variety of axes and can lob them with ease.

10.name: Widen the Gap
10.description: Once you have penetrated a foe's defenses, you can home in on the same spot to exploit your opponent's wound and deal some serious damage.

2.name: Dragon Disciple Dedication
2.description: You choose to study or worship one type of dragon, and your focus grants you a measure of its power.

4.name: Claws of the Dragon
4.description: Your fingernails grow into razor-sharp claws, and scales speckle your fingers, hands, and wrists.

4.name: Dragon Arcana
4.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots; Dragon Disciple Dedication
4.description: You've discovered how to add the magic of dragons to your tradition.

4.name: Scales of the Dragon
4.description: Scales grow across your body, protecting you against physical and magical threats.

12.name: Wings of the Dragon
12.description: You can manifest draconic wings to soar through the air at great speed.

14.name: Shape of the Dragon
14.description: You've discovered how to transform yourself into a dragon.

14.name: Shape of the Cloud Dragon
14.description: You've discovered how to transform yourself into a cloud dragon.

16.name: Disciple's Breath
16.prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon breath_ sorcerer bloodline spell
16.description: You unleash your breath weapon without spending focus.

16.name: Deflecting Cloud
16.prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon wings_ sorcerer bloodline spell
16.description: You've mastered a defensive technique unique to the ancient dragons of Bloodsalt: beating your wings to create a billowing cloud of mist.

18.name: Mighty Dragon Shape
18.description: You've practiced and increased your draconic might, allowing you to take your draconic form more often.

18.name: Mighty Wings
18.prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon wings_ sorcerer bloodline spell
18.description: Your dragon wings are now a permanent part of your body, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

10.name: Cloud Walk
10.description: Your growing link to cloud dragons has granted you the ability to walk on clouds.

2.name: Bright Lion Dedication
2.prerequisite: member of the Bright Lions; not a worshipper of Walkena; Trained in Stealth
2.description: You are one of the Bright Lions, part revolutionary warrior, part undercover spy.

4.name: Warding Light
4.description: You gain a tattoo that serves as a special ward to defend you against Walkena's forces.

4.name: Blessing of the Sun Gods
4.description: The Old Sun Gods share their power with you.

4.name: Lion's Might
4.description: You've trained with the weapons of the Bright Lions.

6.name: Sun's Fury
6.description: The Old Sun Gods have granted you a gift in your fight against Walkena.

8.name: Elude the Divine
8.description: You are able to escape inquisitions involving divine magic, allowing you to blend in well in Mzali but also to avoid unwanted attention in other oppressive theocracies.

8.name: Lion's Fury
8.description: You gain access to the lion scythe's and sun sling's critical specialization effects.

12.name: Greater Sun Blessing
12.description: Your connection to the Old Sun Gods grows stronger.

2.name: Oozemorph Dedication
2.description: You are plagued by sporadic anatomical rearrangements, which grant you insights into other creatures with unusual anatomies.

4.name: Disturbing Defense
4.description: Your internal organs and blood vessels have shifted and changed, and even you don't know precisely where in your body they are.

4.name: Hideous Ululation
4.description: Your throat has multiple separate chambers that can give your voice an eerie echo.

6.name: Vacate Vision
6.description: You cause your eyes to liquefy and run out of your eye sockets, leaving them empty.

8.name: Ooze Empathy
8.prerequisite: Oozemorph Dedication; at least two other class feats from the oozemorph archetype
8.description: You can connect with oozes (and other amorphous aberrations, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level.

10.name: Rubbery Skin
10.description: Your skin develops a malleable, rubbery quality.

12.name: Uncanny Suction
12.description: Your limbs produce strange, sucker-like growths that allow you to adhere to walls, objects, and most other surfaces.

14.name: Peculiar Anatomy
14.description: Your circulatory system contains viscous protoplasmic fluid instead of ordinary blood.

2.name: Edgewatch Detective Dedication
2.description: You're a specially trained detective for the Edgewatch guard precinct in Absalom.

4.name: Sense Alignment
4.description: You read the body language of an intelligent creature within 30 feet and pick up on subtle cues to detect its general propensity for good or evil and law or chaos.

6.name: Arcane Sensitivity
6.description: You can sense the presence of the supernatural, even if you don't have any magical ability yourself.

6.name: Bolera's Interrogation
6.description: You can force a creature to tell the truth

4.name: Jalmeri Heavenseeker Dedication
4.prerequisite: Student of Perfection Dedication, or you've trained with a champion of the Challenge of Sky and Heaven
4.description: Your skill and dedication have set you on a path to master the techniques of Jalmeray's greatest martial artists.

6.name: Heaven's Thunder
6.description: With a loud shout, you unleash your ki in a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs your body.

6.name: Sky and Heaven Stance
6.description: You enter a stance allowing you to make jagged strikes like flashes of lightning through the sky.

8.name: Skyseeker
8.description: You Leap toward an opponent.

10.name: Steal the Sky
10.description: You can take away the air that keeps a flying foe aloft.

12.name: Speaking Sky
12.description: You can hear air movement like soft whispers.

20.name: Cross the Final Horizon
20.description: You Stride up to your Speed and your ki enshrouds your limbs in a terrifying stormy energy.

10.name: Provocator Dedication
10.description: For you, fighting is as much about style as skill.

12.name: Flourishing Finish
12.description: Your martial prowess demoralizes all who can see you.

12.name: Cartwheel Dodge
12.description: You can dodge away from damaging effects.

14.name: Murderer's Circle
14.description: Circle your foe while you beat on them.

14.name: Pin to the Spot
14.description: Strike a foe and restrain them.

16.name: Performance Weapon Expert
16.prerequisite: Provocator Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
