16.description: Your experience has made you better with a wide variety of weapons.

2.name: Ghost Hunter Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
2.description: You have focused your training on hunting and defeating ghosts, spirits, and all manner of haunts.

4.name: Grave's Voice
4.description: You can influence spirits and haunts

4.name: Investigate Haunting
4.description: You are skilled at noticing the telltale signs of ghosts and hauntings.

4.name: Spirit Spells
4.description: Your ability to confront incorporeal menaces develops into full-fledged spellcasting.

6.name: Ghost Strike
6.description: You can infuse a weapon you are carrying with magical energies that allow it to strike true against incorporeal undead.

8.name: Peer Beyond
8.description: You have uncanny insight into the way ghosts and haunts manifest, manipulate the mind, and rejuvenate.

2.name: Eldritch Researcher Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana; Trained in Occultism
2.description: An eager student of occult lore, you enjoy reading rare or forgotten tomes with ancient rituals and hidden secrets.

4.name: Seeker of Truths
4.description: Your devotion to discovering and hoarding abstruse truths borders on the fanatical, and you can bring this devotion to bear.

4.name: Strange Script
4.description: You have such familiarity with obscure texts that you can compel them to reveal their secrets.

6.name: Scholarly Defense
6.description: Your knowledge of strange creatures and their bizarre anatomy allows you to anticipate their physical attacks and reduce the damage you take from them.

8.name: Able Ritualist
8.description: Your readings on rituals make you a skilled participant.

8.name: Lorefinder
8.description: You know that fate sometimes conspires to keep dangerous knowledge or items from the eyes of those most able to understand them.

10.name: Know it All
10.description: Your knowledge of abstruse topics is unparalleled.

12.name: Advanced Seeker of Truths
12.prerequisite: Eldritch Researcher Dedication; Seeker of Truths
12.description: You have unlocked deeper secrets to uncovering and hoarding lore.

12.name: Words of Unraveling
12.description: You have unlocked abstruse methods to tangle with reality itself, altering the fate of a single individual.

14.name: Entities from Afar
14.description: You can call in aberrations to fight for you or to answer questions.

14.name: Incredible Recollection
14.description: You can sift through knowledge locked within your mind at an incredible pace.

2.name: Ghost Eater Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
2.description: You have trained as a ghost eater, a hunter specialized in the destruction of spirits.

4.name: Reach Beyond
4.description: You've learned to move your spiritual energy past yourself to attack spirits where others can't.

6.name: Disrupting Strikes
6.description: You call forth positive energy from within to help you destroy undead.

16.name: Cross the Threshold
16.description: You can cast ethereal jaunt as an occult innate spell once per day.

8.name: Golden League Xun Dedication
8.description: You are a xun for the Golden League, aiding the organization.

10.name: Beneath Notice
10.prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Deception
10.description: You are skilled at hiding from your foes and targets among the common populace.

10.name: Menacing Prowess
10.prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Intimidation
10.description: Scaring off multiple people at once is your specialty.

10.name: Rope Mastery
10.prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Athletics
10.description: Ropes are your tool of choice, and you deploy them in versatile ways.

10.name: Silent Sting
10.prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Stealth
10.description: You quickly hide your weapon to make it difficult to pin the attack on you.

10.name: Sixth Pillar Dedication
10.prerequisite: Dexterity 14; Expert in Acrobatics; ability to cast spells
10.description: You use your physical discipline to channel your magic.

12.name: Six Pillars Stance
12.description: You stand firm, steeling your mind and body, allowing you to use your magic unperturbed.

12.name: Maneuvering Spell
12.description: You instantly tap into the magical power of a spell you're casting to quickly pounce around the battlefield.

16.name: Sixth Pillar Mastery
16.description: Your greater discipline aligns your magical and physical potential.

14.name: Touch Focus
14.description: You can redirect a spell's power through you to deliver it within striking distance.

2.name: Cathartic Mage Dedication
2.prerequisite: Charisma 14 or ability to cast spells from spell slots
2.description: You've learned to harness a particular emotion and mix it into your magic.

4.name: Basic Cathartic Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

4.name: Cathartic Focus Spell
4.description: You learn the focus spell listed under your emotion's entry.

8.name: Work Yourself Up
8.description: You concentrate on your mental state, tapping into that raw emotional energy.

12.name: Expert Cathartic Spellcasting
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

12.name: Infectious Emotions
12.description: When you use Catharsis, one ally within 30 feet gains the catharsis activation benefits in addition to you.

18.name: Master Cathartic Spellcasting
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

2.name: Flexible Spellcaster Dedication
2.description: You now have four cantrips per day instead of three.

2.name: Geomancer Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; ability to cast spells from spell slots; at least one spell with the air, cold, earth, fire, plant, or water trait
2.description: You feel a deep connection to the world no matter where you are, a phenomenon known as "terrain attunement." When you expend a spell slot to cast a spell with a trait that corresponds to the type of terrain you are currently in (as listed below), you gain the terrain attunement e

4.name: Attunement Shift
4.description: The magic of your spell floods into you, overriding your connection to the land around you.

4.name: Shared Attunement
4.description: When you would gain a benefit from your terrain attunement, you can grant it to one ally within 30 feet instead of yourself.

6.name: Rough Terrain Stance
6.description: You enter a stance that makes it difficult to move around you.

8.name: Attuned Stride
8.description: You can move freely through terrain you're attuned to.

10.name: Draw from the Land
10.description: You pull strength from the surrounding terrain.

12.name: Read the Land
12.description: You've learned how to commune with the land to learn information.

14.name: Terrain Shield
14.description: You're so attuned to the land that it rises up to protect you from a potentially fatal blow in a seeming coincidence.

14.name: Shifting Terrain
14.prerequisite: Rough Terrain Stance; Master in Nature
14.description: You slam your fist into the ground or twirl your arms about to cause the terrain around you to shift and ripple, potentially throwing others off balance.

16.name: Quickened Attunement
16.description: If your next action is to cast a spell that would grant your terrain attunement bonus, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (to a minimum of 1 action).

2.name: Folklorist Dedication
2.description: You are a master archivist and entertainer, capable of pulling wisdom from the tales you tell and weaving your allies and enemies into a powerful narrative.

4.name: Folktales Lore
4.description: You can pull bits of wisdom from any tale.

6.name: Narrative Conduit
6.description: You act as a conduit for your companions just as your stories are a conduit between teller and listener.

8.name: Rule of Three
8.description: Heroes learn from their previous failures, often succeeding on the third attempt.

10.name: Communal Tale
10.description: Stories are an experience meant to be shared as a group.

2.name: Nantambu Chime-Ringer Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Performance; Trained in Society
2.description: You've studied the basics of harmony and resonance in magic, exemplified by the ringing of chimes.

4.name: Fleet Tempo
4.description: To rush after a criminal or reach someone in need, you ring a sprightly tone.

10.name: Deny the Songs of War
10.description: To keep the peace, you disrupt those who seek to break it.

12.name: Sing to the Steel
12.description: You strike magical tones that can turn the tide of combat.

16.name: Song of Grace and Speed
16.description: You instill great swiftness into your allies.

2.name: Spell Trickster Dedication
2.prerequisite: Able to cast spells; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
2.description: Your experience with magic and its traditions lets you specialize in the casting of certain spells, customizing familiar spells to create novel effects.

4.name: Agile Hand
4.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mage hand_
4.description: When you cast mage hand , you can modify it to control a set of thieves' tools.

4.name: Barrier Shield
4.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _shield_
4.description: When you cast shield , you can modify the spell to create a solid barrier you can use for cover, but not for blocking.

4.name: Forceful Push
4.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mage hand_
4.description: When you cast mage hand , you can modify it to shove a creature.

4.name: Shining Arms
4.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _light_
4.description: When you cast light , you can modify its target to be 1 melee weapon.

4.name: Summon Ensemble
4.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _summon instrument_
4.description: When you cast summon instrument , you can modify it to summon multiple instruments.

4.name: Tracing Sigil
4.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _sigil_
4.description: When you cast sigil , you can modify the spell to allow you to track the target.

4.name: Wild Lights
4.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _dancing lights_
4.description: When you cast dancing lights , you can modify it to create a single floating light in the shape of a Tiny creature.

6.name: Animate Net
6.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _animate rope_
6.description: When you cast animate rope , you can modify it to animate a net.

6.name: Confounding Image
6.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mirror image_
6.description: When you cast mirror image , you can modify it to create a duplicate of yourself.

6.name: Disk Rider
6.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _floating disk_
6.description: When you cast floating disk , you can modify it to ride atop.

6.name: Drenching Mist
6.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_
6.description: When you cast obscuring mist , you can modify it to extinguish flames.

6.name: Obscured Terrain
6.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_
6.description: When you cast obscuring mist , you can modify the spell to blanket the area, making it difficult to see the ground.

6.name: Uneasy Rest
6.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _sleep_
6.description: When you cast sleep , you can modify the spell to make subjects of your spell experience troubled dreams.

6.name: Volatile Grease
6.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _grease_
6.description: When you cast grease , you can modify it to cover a creature in flammable grease.

8.name: Beacon Mark
8.description: When you cast sigil , you can modify the spell to allow you to determine the target's location.

8.name: Larcenous Hand
8.description: When you cast mage hand , you can modify it to steal an object from the target.

8.name: Lingering Flames
8.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
8.description: When you cast fireball , you can modify its effects to set creatures in its area aflame.

8.name: Scattered Fire
8.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
8.description: When you cast fireball , you can modify its area to be two non-overlapping 10-foot bursts.

8.name: Siphoning Touch
8.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _vampiric touch_
8.description: When you cast vampiric touch , you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining the temporary Hit Points yourself, you can grant the temporary Hit Points to an ally within 30 feet.

8.name: Smoldering Explosion
8.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
8.description: When you cast fireball , you can modify the spell to leave behind a brief cloud of smoke in its area.

8.name: Steal Vitality
8.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _vampiric touch_
8.description: When you cast vampiric touch , you can modify it to remove your enfeebled or clumsy condition.

10.name: Surrounding Flames
10.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _wall of fire_
10.description: When you cast wall of fire , you can modify it to create a 10-foot-radius hemisphere of fire.

10.name: Toppling Tentacles
10.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _black tentacles_
10.description: When you cast black tentacles , you can modify it to trip the targets.

12.name: Choking Smoke
12.description: When you cast fireball , you can modify it to create a cloud of smoking smoke.

12.name: Directed Poison
12.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _cloudkill_
12.description: When you cast cloudkill , you can modify it to be under your control.

2.name: Pactbound Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; Erutaki or Giant language, must have earned the trust of a saumen kar who initiates you into the archetype
2.description: You befriended one of the last saumen kar and were infused with a fraction of their power, granting you the potential to become a guardian of their ancient pact.

4.name: Ice Crafter
4.description: The ancient ice-crafting techniques of the saumen kar awaken within you.

6.name: Crown of the Saumen Kar
6.description: Your body begins to evolve and adapt, taking the first steps towards blending your very self with the ancient curse of the saumen kar.

12.name: Frostbite Runes
12.description: Thick tattoos, each one a rune fragment from the saumen kar's long-lost language spelling out their pact with their equally lost deity, cover your body and stretch across your limbs, torso, and face.

14.name: Curse of the Saumen Kar
14.description: You activate the runes on your body to create an icy prison around a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet.

16.name: Bound in Ice
16.description: You become a hybrid of your ancestry and a saumen kar.

2.name: Hallowed Necromancer Dedication
2.prerequisite: Expert in Religion; good alignment, able to cast spells using spell slots, able to cast at least one necromancy spell
2.description: You've studied techniques allowing you to blend so-called hallowed necromancy into your own spellcasting to bolster the living and destroy the undead.

4.name: Hallowed Initiate
4.description: You've expanded your focus spellcasting to techniques used by clerics and wizards.

4.name: Sacred Spells
4.description: Add chill touch , death ward , disrupt undead , disrupting weapons , holy cascade , magic stone , and sunburst to your spell list.

6.name: Death Warden
6.description: With your intimate familiarity with the duality of positive and negative energy, you're able to stand as a bulwark against death and undeath alike.

8.name: Advanced Hallowed Spell
8.prerequisite: Hallowed Necromancer Dedication; necromancer initial school spell or death initial domain spell
8.description: You dig deeper into the magical tools found in wizard schools and divine domains.

8.name: Positive Luminance
8.description: You learn how to create a luminous reservoir of positive energy that you can use to punish undead who dare attack you.

14.name: Consecrated Aura
14.description: Your body radiates positive energy, making your very presence disorienting to undead and encouraging them to move away from you.

2.name: Undead Slayer Dedication
2.description: Your training has prepared you to recognize most undead on sight.

4.name: Blessed Medicine
4.description: Your experience battling undead has uniquely prepared you to fight the diseases they inflict on the survivors, and you know that leaving these maladies untreated for long will eventually lead to more undead.

4.name: Hunter's Sanctum
4.description: You establish a safe house where you can prepare for your hunt.

4.name: Slayer's Strike
4.description: You've dedicated yourself to studying ancient techniques and memorized minor prayers against undead to swiftly dispatch them.

6.name: Frighten Undead
6.prerequisite: Undead Slayer Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
6.description: Your very presence chills creatures of the night down to their core and you can use the spiritual power and faithful life force of religious verses to frighten even mindless undead.

6.name: Gear Up
6.description: Whether it's wooden stakes, holy water, or more unusual tools, you always have just the right thing to handle an undead's unusual weaknesses and vulnerabilities.

8.name: Slayer's Blessing
8.description: You carry scraps of materials dangerous to undead and can apply them to your weapon.

10.name: Slayer's Presence
10.description: Your very presence strikes fear into the undead.

4.name: Undying Conviction
4.prerequisite: able to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
4.description: Your presence has a bolstering effect on your undead minions.

12.name: Necromancer's Visage
12.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
12.description: Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect.

12.name: Master of the Dead
12.description: You have reached the pinnacle of the reanimator's craft: the ability to raise nearly any corpse or skeleton as a gruesome mockery of the creature it once was.

14.name: Sepulchral Sublimation
14.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
14.description: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice.

2.name: Reanimator Dedication
2.prerequisite: able to cast _animate dead_ with a spell slot
2.description: You have dedicated your studies to the art of raising and commanding undead.

6.name: Deathly Secrets
6.description: No means of creating or ruling the undead is beyond your grasp, even those of magical traditions not your own.

6.name: Macabre Virtuoso
6.prerequisite: Reanimator Dedication; Expert in Arcana, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
6.description: Any necromancer can create zombie and skeleton, but you know the secrets behind the creation of far more advanced undead monstrosities.

8.name: Bonds of Death
8.description: You sway with the motions of your spells that animate the dead, channeling your power to sustain two at the same time.

10.name: Greater Deathly Secrets
10.description: Your undead secrets grow stronger still.

2.name: Ghost Dedication
2.prerequisite: You died and returned as a ghost.
2.description: You have risen as a shell of your former self, a spirit of mist and anguish.

4.name: Frightful Moan
4.description: You lament your fate, realeasing a ghastly moan that frightens the living.

4.name: Ghostly Resistance
4.description: Your ghostly form becomes innately weaker but also gains resistance to many forms of damage.

4.name: Headless Haunt
4.description: You were condemned to death and executed with one of Galt's infamous final blades , where your soul was trapped for years or even decades.

6.name: Ghostly Grasp (Ghost)
6.description: Your control over your ghostly form grows.

6.name: Fling Head
6.description: You Interact to remove your head, if it isn't already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body.

8.name: Ghost Flight
8.description: You can suppress your tether to the ground, overcoming your resistance to fly free.

8.name: Haunting Memories
8.description: Your soul bears metaphysical impressions of the innumerable other spirits imprisoned with you in the final blade from which you escaped, allowing you to draw upon their memories.

10.name: Pass Through
10.description: Filtering your form through the substance of an object, you can pass through walls, doors, and more.

10.name: Klingegeist
10.description: Your imprisonment inside a final blade used to perform countless executions has instilled in you an aptitude for entering and possessing similar sharp implements of murder.

12.name: Rejuvenation
12.description: The call of your unfinished business recreates you after destruction.

12.name: Ghostly Condemnation
12.description: You shriek a death sentence upon a single target within 120 feet, forcing it to experience the final moments of your mortal life as you were dragged through a howling mob and forced to kneel before the final blade that took your life and head.

14.name: Unlimited Ghost Flight
14.description: You put your connection to the material world farther behind you.

2.name: Mummy Dedication
2.prerequisite: you are dead and were mummified (by natural or ritualistic means)
2.description: Whether through natural processes or foul rituals, your body was mummified, and you've risen as an undead mummy.

4.name: One with the Land
4.description: Your connection to your bound terrain strengthens, making you unhindered by local weather.

4.name: Semblance of Life
4.description: You draw the moisture you've drained from others into your own flesh, temporarily taking on the appearance of life.

6.name: Grave Mummification
6.description: Exposure to the elements, magic, alchemy, and other phenomena intensified the changes from your mummification.

6.name: Mummy's Despair
6.description: You force your mental anguish outward, projecting it upon those around you.

8.name: Accursed Touch
8.description: You've learned to harness the supernatural curse that animates you, imbuing your most powerful attacks with a terrible curse.

8.name: Storm Shroud
8.description: You become surrounded by a swirling storm of rain, sand, snow, or clouds, whichever of those suits your bound terrain.

10.name: Channel Rot
10.description: You've learned to channel your curse through weapons you wield instead of solely through your flesh.

10.name: Ensnaring Wrappings
10.description: Some of your wrappings come loose to ensnare a creature you recently damaged.

10.name: Terrain Form
10.description: You crumble to pieces, becoming composed of the very terrain to which you're bound, with the effects of the gaseous form spell, or you reconstitute into your normal form.

12.name: Desiccating Inhalation
12.description: You draw in the moisture from nearby creatures, draining them dry to heal your wounds.

12.name: Greater Despair
12.description: You increase the frequency of Mummy's Despair to once per 10 minutes instead of once per hour.

2.name: Vampire Dedication
2.prerequisite: You were a killed by a vampire drinking your blood.
2.description: You're a newly risen vampire.

4.name: Clinging Climber
4.description: You climb like a spider.

4.name: Manipulative Charm
4.prerequisite: Vampire Dedication; Trained in Deception or Trained in Diplomacy
4.description: Against humanoids, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie, and to Diplomacy checks to Gather Information and Make an Impression. Once per day, you can cast charm as a divine innate spell using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

4.name: Nocturnal Kindred
4.description: You have an innate connection with other creatures of the night and understand some of them.

6.name: Predatory Claws
6.description: Your nails grow into sharp claws, perfect for seizing and tearing your prey.

8.name: Vicious Fangs
8.description: You aim for your victim's prominent arteries.

10.name: Bat Form
10.description: You can transform into a bat.

10.name: Turn to Mist
10.description: You turn into vapor, gaining the effects of gaseous form .

12.name: Coffin Bound
12.description: You bind your spirit to a coffin filled with soil of your homeland, making it a place of recovery.

14.name: Mist Escape
14.description: As you fall, your body reacts to defend itself.

16.name: Dominating Gaze
16.description: You stare into your target's eyes and enthrall them, shattering their free will.

2.name: Clockwork Reanimator Dedication
2.description: You can animate corpses through cunning engineering.

4.name: Advanced Reanimated Companion
4.description: Your corpselike construct companion becomes much more powerful and can act with limited autonomy to follow your greater directives.

4.name: Hijack Undead
4.description: Your clockwork devices can commandeer the bodies of undead, bending them to your will.

6.name: It's Alive!
6.description: You've mastered the use of electrical energy to power your clockwork creations.

8.name: Incredible Reanimated Companion
8.description: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its capabilities.

12.name: Self-Destruct
12.description: You've installed a self-destruct device within your construct companion, which you can trigger with a special device from up to 60 feet away.

14.name: Improved Hijack Undead
14.description: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands.

14.name: Paragon Reanimated Companion
14.description: You have reached the pinnacle of necromantic science, creating a mechanical zombie unlike any the world has seen before.

16.name: Unwind Death
16.description: Combining necromancy with the mysterious temporal powers of clockwork, you wind a creature backward from the moment of its death.

2.name: Corpse Tender Dedication
2.description: You have a connection to mindless undead that allows you to communicate your intentions to them on a rudimentary level.

4.name: Command Corpse
4.prerequisite: Corpse Tender Dedication; ability to cast _harm_
4.description: You gain the Command Undead feat, but you can use it only to transform the effects of harm spells you cast on mindless undead.

4.name: Corpse Tender's Font
4.description: You easily tend to the wounds of the dead.

8.name: Improved Command Corpse
8.description: When you use Command Undead on a mindless undead, if the undead succeeds at its save but doesn't critically succeed, it becomes your minion for 1 round.

12.name: Imbue Mindlessness
12.description: You grasp the mind of an undead creature and temporarily wipe it as empty as a zombie's brain.

2.name: Shieldmarshal Dedication
2.description: Your elite shieldmarshal training makes you equally at home in the squalor of Smokeside and the splendor of Skyside.

4.name: Consolidated Overlay Panopticon
4.description: You volunteered for a controversial experimental procedure to install clockwork prosthetic eyes.

8.name: Equitable Defense
8.description: Gritting your teeth through the pain, you position yourself to counterattack.

10.name: Counterclockwork Focus
10.description: You understand the need for law enforcement doctrine to adapt to the ever-changing innovations in technology and arcana.

4.name: Scion of Domora Dedication
4.prerequisite: Familiar Master Dedication; you have befriended a spirit guide and it bonded with you using its Bond with Mortal ability.
4.description: You gain a spirit guide ally.

6.name: Spiritual Strike
6.description: Your spirit guide enhances your attacks with occult power.

6.name: Guided Skill
6.description: You ask your spirit guide for aid.

8.name: Guardian's Embrace
8.description: Your spirit guide discorporates to surround you in an invisible protective shroud.

10.name: Invigorating Breath
10.description: Your spirit guide exhales its sweet-smelling breath on you, granting you the strength to push through your pain.

10.name: Spiritual Flurry
10.prerequisite: Scion of Domora Dedication; Spiritual Strike
10.description: When you use Spiritual Strike, hit targets become flat-footed until the end of your current turn.

12.name: Spiritual Aid
12.description: When you call your spirit guide for aid, its presence bolsters your will and agility.

14.name: Spirit Guide Form
14.description: You fuse with your spirit guide, becoming a hybrid being with enhanced physical and spiritual power.

2.name: Twilight Speaker Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Society; you are an Ilverani elf
2.description: You have carefully studied the histories, customs, and etiquette of many of the younger peoples of Golarion.

4.name: Empathetic Envoy
4.description: You believe that treating others with respect is the fastest way into their hearts, and in turn others are more likely to believe in your good intentions and write off bad first impressions as flukes.

6.name: Disarming Smile
6.description: With a wide, sincere smile, you give your attacker pause.

6.name: Betraying Shank
6.description: While your usual diplomacy is well intentioned, you know that sometimes those same skills will need to be turned to deception.

8.name: Ilverani Purist
8.description: All twilight speakers are trained to resist the alluring customs of younger peoples, but you have made it your mandate to keep the Ilverani way unchanged.

8.name: World-Wise Vigilance
8.description: Your keen study of other cultures gives you insights into the ways those cultures fight.

10.name: Emphatic Emissary
10.description: You can tell when diplomacy has failed and a meeting is close to unraveling or falling to blows.

2.name: Harrower Dedication
2.description: You become trained in Occultism; if you are already trained in this skill, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead.

4.name: Experienced Harrower
4.description: When you perform the harrowing ritual, the DC for the Primary Check is never more than the standard DC by level, and the cost for the ritual is halved.

4.name: Harrow Casting
4.description: You draw a card from your harrow deck just before you cast a spell to infuse your magic with its destined potential.

4.name: Restore Omen
4.description: You spend 10 minutes meditating with your harrow deck, then draw a card.

6.name: Benevolent Spirit Deck
6.description: You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards that seek to protect you or an ally.

6.name: Harrow Ritualist
6.description: You immediately learn two of the following rituals: astral projection , call spirit , commune , commune with nature , legend lore , or planar binding .

6.name: Vengeful Spirit Deck
6.description: You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards.

8.name: Reading the Signs
8.description: You have a knack for drawing the right card, be it from a harrow deck, in a game of cards, or even when drawing from a Deck of Many Things .

2.name: Kineticist Dedication
2.description: You become trained in kineticist class DC and impulse attack rolls.

4.name: Base Kinesis
4.description: You gain the Base Kinesis impulse.

4.name: Through the Gate
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level kineticist feat of your choice.

6.name: Advanced Element Control
6.description: You gain one kineticist feat.

8.name: Improved Elemental Blast
8.description: The power of your elemental blast improves.

10.name: Add Element
10.description: Choose a second kinetic element to add to the one you already have.

12.name: Expert Kinetic Control
12.description: You become an expert in kineticist class DC and impulse attack rolls.

2.name: Worm Caller Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Nature or Trained in Cave Worm Lore
2.description: You pledge yourself to understanding and emulating one of the most powerful creatures of the Darklands: the mighty cave worm.

4.name: Worm Sense
4.description: You emulate the senses of the cave worm.

4.name: Wormskin
4.description: Your flesh grows thick and bloated, protecting you against harm.

6.name: Inexorable
6.description: You imbue yourself with the resilience of the cave worm.

6.name: Worm's Feast
6.description: You call forth a brood of infantile cave worms to feast on your enemy's flesh.

8.name: Worm Empathy
8.description: You can connect with cave worms (and other worm-related creatures, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level.

10.name: Azure Fins
10.description: When submerged in water or another liquid, you form small fin-like arms along your body, granting you far greater maneuverability while swimming.

10.name: Call Worm Spirit
10.description: You call forth a ghostly manifestation of the worm spirit.

10.name: Tunnel
10.description: You gain a burrow speed of 10 feet.

12.name: Crimson Breath
12.description: You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm.

12.name: Venomous Touch
12.description: You've learned to channel the sting of the worm.

14.name: Worm Form
14.description: You take on the form of a purple worm or transform into a humanoid-worm hybrid, retaining your own head but with a worm's body, transforming into a Huge battle form.

18.name: Call the Worm
18.description: You gain summon animal , heightened to 9th level, as an innate primal spell that you can cast once per day, but can only summon a purple worm.

2.name: Stone Brawler Dedication
2.description: You've learned to call the primal power of elemental stone to your aid.

4.name: Stoney Skin
4.description: Your skin takes on the hardness of stone.

6.name: Stoney Deflection
6.description: You gather the resiliency of stone to block attacks against you.

8.name: Ore Fists
8.description: When you enter the Stonestrike Stance, your fists appear to be covered with veins of unrefined ore.

10.name: Stonebane
10.description: Your stonestrike attacks deal 1d6 additional damage against constructs, creatures with the earth trait, and earthen objects, such as a stone door.

16.name: Adamantine Fists
16.description: You imbue your unarmed strikes with one of the strongest metals.

2.name: Stonebound Dedication
2.description: You bind yourself to the very essence of stone.

4.name: Elemental Existence
4.description: Your body becomes infused with elemental earth.

4.name: Stone Guardian
4.description: You learn to call a powerful guardian of earth and stone to your side.

6.name: Stonebound Magic
6.description: You've learned to manifest your connection to stone by conjuring it to your side.

8.name: Statue
8.description: Your body and equipment appear to be made of stone as you hold perfectly still.

10.name: Rocky Flesh
10.description: Your flesh takes on the hardness of stone.

12.name: Living Stone
12.description: Your body becomes living stone.

2.name: Clawdancer Dedication
2.prerequisite: permanent unarmed claw or talon attack (such as one granted by your ancestry or a graft)
2.description: You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you.

4.name: Claw Snag
4.description: You hook into the target, pulling yourself forward and rending flesh.

4.name: Dashing Pounce
4.description: With a burst of speed, you leap into the air, slashing with your hands.

4.name: Talon Sweep
4.description: Your long clawed legs let you catch enemies to either side.

6.name: Abscission Shards
6.description: You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target.

6.name: Wheeling Grab
6.description: You cartwheel on your claws, dancing over your foes.

6.name: Hindquarter Kick
6.description: You hold your prey's defensive limbs in place with your claws while delivering a swift kick to their unprotected sides.

6.name: Spinning Stand
6.description: You flare your legs around, using the momentum to both lash out and return to a standing position.

8.name: Tear Tendons
8.description: You rake into your opponent with two claws, cutting into their muscle and depriving them of needed strength.

8.name: Feline Dance
8.description: You fluidly move between stances in the process of dodging.

10.name: Hunting Snag
10.description: Learning from nature's predators has taught you how to keep your prey close.

10.name: Springboard
10.description: You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent.

12.name: Claw and Talon Flow
12.description: You fluidly shift between your two stances.

14.name: Precise Hooks
14.description: Your body is a varied and deadly weapon.

16.name: Storm of Claws
16.description: You lash out with your clawed limbs like a beast that has fallen upon its first meal in days, then back off to see your handiwork.

2.name: Ostilli Host Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana or Trained in Nature
2.description: You've bonded with an attached symbiote known as an ostilli.

4.name: Soothing Pulse
4.description: Your ostilli can use its stored magic to help staunch your wounds, granting you the Administer Ambient Magic action. Administer Ambient Magic (healing) Frequency once per hour; Effect Your ostilli pulses a calm lavender color as it converts stored magic into a curative balm.

4.name: Tactile Magic Feedback
4.description: Your ostilli can sense nearby spellcasters.

4.name: Versatile Mutation
4.description: Your ostilli's darts can deal different types of damage.

6.name: Cloaking Pulse
6.description: Your ostilli can emit illusion magic to mask your position, granting you the Drape Ambient Magic action. Drape Ambient Magic (illusion) Frequency once per round; Effect Your ostilli turns clear as it converts its stored magic into a bubble of refracting light around you.

6.name: Deflecting Pulse
6.description: Your ostilli can use its stored magic to protect you from other magic, granting you the Turn Aside Ambient Magic action. Turn Aside Ambient Magic (concentrate) Your ostilli glows a faint yellow as it establishes a barrier.

6.name: Propulsive Mutation
6.description: Your ostilli can fire its dart farther.

8.name: Chaining Mutation
8.description: The dart fired by your ostilli can ricochet to strike another creature.

8.name: Deadly Mutation
8.description: The dart fired by your ostilli is more dangerous.

10.name: Spell Swallow
10.description: Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the Devour Ambient Magic action. Devour Ambient Magic (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Trigger A creature Casts a Spell with you as the only target; Effect Your ostilli radiates cyan

10.name: Spraying Mutation
10.description: Your ostilli can launch a multitude of darts at once over a short distance.

12.name: Cellular Reconstruction
12.description: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die.

2.name: Swarmkeeper Dedication
2.description: Your body has become a symbiotic hive for a swarm of crawling insects.

4.name: Aphet Flash
4.description: Your swarm can emit a bright flash, much like aphet beetles, a genus of flash beetles once used by Osirian miners as sources of light.

4.name: Pyre Ant Sting
4.description: Your swarm's stings burn with agonizing pain, much like that caused by the bright red pyre ants that make their tunnels within the parched sands of deserts like Qadira.

4.name: Weaver's Web
4.description: Your swarm can spin dense webs much like those left by stone-gray weaver spiders under eaves and in derelict city buildings, especially along the coasts of Varisia.

6.name: Distracting Bites
6.description: You know how to take advantage of those your swarm has attacked.

6.name: Mobile Swarm
6.description: The clicking of fast-moving legs accompanies your swarm in all kinds of environments.

8.name: Carried with the Swarm
8.description: When your swarm is sharing your space and Strides, you can choose to have your swarm carry you with it.

8.name: Sportlebore Choke
8.description: Like nefarious sportlebores, a species of insect that plague adventurers by hiding in their rations as counterfeit food, your swarm can crawl down throats.

10.name: Veil of Bugs
10.description: Your swarm is dense, blotting out vision.

12.name: Buzzing Death Cicadas
12.description: Your swarm takes on characteristics of the death cicadas of the Mana Wastes, whose distinctive buzz is said to be a herald of imminent demise.

14.name: Expanded Swarm
14.description: Your hive has grown to the point where it is difficult to keep your swarm contained within your body.

2.name: Werecreature Dedication
2.description: You're a werecreature, able to shift between your humanoid shape, an animal shape, and a monstrous hybrid of the two.

4.name: Animal Fleetness
4.description: You're adept at using your animal shape's natural means of locomotion.

4.name: Beastkin Resilience
4.description: You've regained beastkin protections after becoming a full werecreature.

4.name: Feral Senses
4.description: The eyes and noses of animals are naturally sharper than most humanoids.

6.name: Antler Rush
6.description: Stride twice.

6.name: Bear Hug (Werecreature)
6.description: You hug your opponent.

6.name: Death Roll
6.description: You corkscrew your body, twisting your victim.

6.name: Echolocation
6.description: When you take the Seek action, you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet until the start of your next turn.

6.name: Fearful Symmetry
6.description: You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly.

6.name: Feeding Frenzy
6.description: Your serrated teeth rip and tear at your prey.

6.name: Pack Attack
6.description: You have mastered techniques for hunting alongside your pack.

6.name: Plague Rat
6.description: Your bites carry a cursed infection.

6.name: Rushing Boar
6.description: You embrace the pain of the triggering attack, allowing it to drive you into a violent rush.

8.name: Cornered Animal
8.description: You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies.

8.name: Feral Mending
8.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were not afflicted with the curse of the werecreature
8.description: You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh.

8.name: Terrifying Transformation
8.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were afflicted with the curse of the werecreature
8.description: Your flesh tears and warps as you transform.

8.name: You Don't Smell Right
8.description: You can sniff out fellow werecreatures and master impersonators alike.

10.name: Dire Growth
10.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape is not Small
10.description: You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape.

10.name: Feral Lunge
10.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a fangs or jaws unarmed attack
10.description: You spring on an unsuspecting opponent, tearing at them with your teeth.

10.name: Feral Scramble
10.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a claw unarmed attack
10.description: Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed.

10.name: Feral Toss
10.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants an antler, horn, or tusk unarmed attack
10.description: You hurl foes away with a shake of your head.

10.name: Touch of Lunacy
10.description: In moments of viciousness, your curse can partially infect your prey.

12.name: Pouncing Transformation
12.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a land Speed only
12.description: By transforming as you move, you attack from odd angles.

12.name: Shared Tide
12.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a swim Speed
12.description: You Swim up to twice the normal distance.

12.name: Undying Beast
12.description: You can be injured by non-silver sources but recover with staggering speed.

12.name: Wings of the Moon
12.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a fly Speed
12.description: You can fly long distances without breaks.

14.name: Scarred Hide
14.description: Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts.

14.name: Rapid Hybridization
14.description: When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice.

16.name: Force of Nature
16.description: You're a nigh-unstoppable killing machine, with only silver able to quell your rampage.

2.name: Winged Warrior Dedication
2.prerequisite: you have permanent wings (such as from an ancestry or graft)
2.description: Through rigorous training, you have strengthened your wings, granting you enough thrust to gain additional altitude.

4.name: Battering Wings
4.description: Though not powerful enough for flight, your wings can deliver a thrashing to anyone who gets close.

4.name: Gusting Spell
4.description: You manipulate the currents of your spell's energy, allowing you to gracefully glide with your wings.

4.name: Wing Bounce
4.description: You rush forward, flapping your wings for a bit of lift, and can use that momentum to knock down a foe.

6.name: Sunbird Glare
6.description: By keeping your feathers clean and sleek, you can catch the light across your wings to create a startling glare in the eyes of a creature within 20 feet.

8.name: Feathered Flechettes
8.description: Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions.

8.name: Pluck From the Sky
8.description: The skies are your rightful place, and you will not suffer another to occupy them.

8.name: Wing Shove
8.description: You spread your wings wide, pushing foes away from you.

10.name: Falcon Swoop
10.description: Like the fastest of predatory birds, you soar toward your prey at great speeds.

10.name: Redirecting Draft
10.description: You flap your wings to blow arrows off course.

12.name: Smooth Hover
12.description: You remain airborne through sheer effort.

12.name: Thunderous Landing
12.description: You hurl away enemies with the force of your landing.

14.name: Bombing Run
14.description: Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force.

14.name: Cratering Drop
14.description: You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent.

16.name: Sonic Strafe
16.description: You can now achieve such flight speeds that your passage splits the very air.

8.name: Majestic Proclamation
8.description: You announce your name to your enemies, bringing your constellation to bear in a blinding display.

2.name: Starlit Sentinel Dedication
2.description: You've been chosen by one of the constellations of the Tian Xia zodiac.

4.name: Special Sentinel Technique
4.description: You can channel the power of your constellation into a unique technique.

10.name: Blade of the Heart
10.description: The bonds of the heart are stronger than any steel, more powerful than any magic.

12.name: Desperate Wish
12.description: You call out a desperate wish to the stars to save a friend.

14.name: Sentinel's Orbit
14.description: Just as your constellation traverses the sky, so too can you.

6.name: Five-breath Vanguard Dedication
6.prerequisite: Two of the five elemental stances (Ironblood Stance, Mountain Stance, Reflective Ripple Stance, Stoked Flame Stance, and Tangled Forest Stance)
6.description: You flow like the elemental cycle, adapting your stance and techniques constantly in response to whatever circumstances you face.

10.name: Renewing Cycle
10.description: The first time each round that you Cycle Elemental Stance, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last until the start of your next turn.

14.name: Induce Imbalance
14.description: Your blows can disrupt the delicate balance of elemental energies that keep a body in good health.

16.name: Protective Cycle
16.description: You react to harm by flowing into an elemental stance with new advantages.

18.name: Five Breaths, One Death
18.description: You cycle through the elements in a devastating combination attack.

2.name: Spirit Warrior Dedication
2.description: You're a warrior who trains your spirit and body to work in perfect harmony, enhancing your attacks with your spiritual energy while fighting with a ferocious martial technique that combines blade and fist.

4.name: Kaiju Defense Oath
4.description: You've sworn an oath to defend the helpless from dangerous titanic beasts, including kaiju that roam the surface of Golarion.

4.name: Sacred Wilds Oath
4.description: You've sworn an oath to protect the holy places within nature and the spirits that dwell within, from ancient trees to primordial wild guardians.

4.name: Tricksterbane Oath
4.description: You've sworn an oath to ferret out and destroy malevolent shapechangers who pose as mortals with evil intent.

6.name: Cutting Heaven, Crushing Earth
6.description: Your skill in combining fist and blade has grown into a seamless art where each attack makes an opponent more vulnerable to the next.

6.name: Flowing Palm Deflection
6.description: The simple and precise movements of your hands allow you to deflect blows with the same efficacy as a raised shield.

6.name: Spirit of the Blade
6.description: You charge your blade with spiritual energy, allowing it to cut through spirits and fiends with fearsome efficiency.

6.name: Sword-light Wave
6.description: You channel spiritual energy through your weapon, unleashing it as a torrent of devastating power.

8.name: Gods' Palm
8.description: You control your spirit energy when you attack, using it to reinforce yourself or to thrust past your enemy's physical defenses.

8.name: Sheltering Pulse
8.description: You thrust your hand or weapon into the ground and release a pulse that creates a sheltering nexus of energy for you and your allies.

10.name: Transcendent Deflection
10.description: You charge your weapon with spiritual energy and intercept the attack.

12.name: Intercepting Hand
12.description: Your particular martial art includes various defensive actions designed to remove your opponent's ability to cause harm.

12.name: Sword of Sealing
12.description: Your spiritual power pierces both body and soul, pinning your foe in place.

2.name: Fan Dancer Dedication
2.description: You sweep across the battlefield, manifesting both the gentle spring breeze and the crisp autumn gusts.

4.name: Petal Step
4.description: You have a mastery over your own movement and can distribute your weight to dance lightly over the ground like petals drifting on the water.

4.name: Solo Dancer
4.prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Expert in Performance
4.description: You often dance alone with a grace exceeding that of most other performers, carrying yourself with a poise and confidence that draws the attention of those around you.

4.name: Twirl Through
4.description: You sweep across the battlefield in a fluttering of movement honed from years of coordinating perfectly spaced movements alongside fellow dancers.

6.name: Fluttering Misdirection
6.description: You've trained in drawing the eyes of your audience to specific aspects of your performance through the careful manipulation of your fans and body.

6.name: Sweeping Fan Block
6.description: You leap up on one leg, snapping your fans open alongside your head before sweeping them across your body.

8.name: Pushing Wind
8.description: As you spin and glide your fans alongside your allies, you kick up a mild wind that gently carries you all forward.

8.name: Twirling Strike
8.description: Your fans, one raised up alongside your head and the other alongside your hip, become a blur as you twirl across the battlefield.

10.name: Close Formation
10.prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Master in Performance
10.description: You practiced fan dance as a member of a large group, coordinating your moves together to create living art and heightening your sense of spatial awareness.

10.name: Dizzying Spin Dance
10.description: You're practiced in using your fans to spin with dizzying speed.

10.name: Fluttering Distraction
10.description: You're trained in snapping and fluttering your fans to draw the eyes of observers around you.

10.name: Sweeping Fan Redirection
10.prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Sweeping Fan Block
10.description: You can redirect ammunition back at the creature that fired it with sweeping gusts of wind.

14.name: Peony's Flourish
14.description: As you spin around and create wide arching circles with your fans, you manifest a mosaic of peonies that confuses your enemies.

14.name: Dragon's Journey
14.description: Your movements are like that of a dragon weaving a serpentine path between your enemies and allies.

2.name: Wandering Chef Dedication
2.description: Whether trained in a noble kitchen or a humble home, you know how to cook delicious dishes and source ingredients from the wilderness or urban settings.

4.name: Morning Side Dishes
4.description: You know a proper breakfast should have a variety of sides.

6.name: Additional Servings
6.prerequisite: Wandering Chef Dedication; Expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore
6.description: Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

6.name: Food Preservation
6.description: Your techniques extend the storage life for certain ingredients and food through pickling, alcohol, or fermentation.

10.name: Feast Planner
10.description: You learn the fortifying brew ritual, but you instead prepare dishes for a lavish meal that have the same effect as the drinks from the normal version of the ritual.

12.name: Packed with Flavor
12.prerequisite: Wandering Chef Dedication; Expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore
12.description: Edible morsels you create are particularly potent and bursting with flavor.

14.name: Cosmic Cocktail
14.description: Using the liquors, vinegars, and fruits or herbs at your disposal, you spend 1 minute to create a cocktail with colors reminiscent of space and its stars.

14.name: Regional Specialty
14.description: You can create dishes that reflect the food sources endemic to your environment and medicinal food techniques utilizing the cycle of the five elements.

2.name: Cultivator Dedication
2.description: Through an esoteric, often exacting, regimen of meditation, diet, and exercise, you've learned to transform your body's inner workings into a crucible of planar and spiritual energies.

4.name: Immortal Lightness
4.description: You breathe, allowing your golden core to release qi into the meridians governing your lower body, and break into a burst of speed that could shame arrows in flight.

6.name: Lotus Above the Mud
6.description: Your qi, dancing ever diligently toward cultivation, eludes the grasp of the world's muck and mire.

6.name: Three Clear Breaths
6.description: Through your disciplined condensations and circulations of qi, you've caught a fleeting glimpse of cultivation's promise, and your health has handsomely profited along the way.

6.name: Wisteria-and-Peony Reunion
6.description: Your roots of qi stand firm, shaking off pains and aches like the returning flowers and leaves shed during winter's snow.

8.name: Cultivator's Keen Eye
8.description: Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

10.name: Ghost-path Epiphany
10.description: Deviating from the orthodox path, you tread an inauspicious descent littered with flowers of death; this heretical choice will, in time, earn you the enmity and fear of more traditional cultivators.

10.name: Three Pecks of Dew
10.description: At this stage of cultivation, your body is as much spirit as flesh.

16.name: The Bitter Scholar's Promotion
16.description: Tian Xia's shining cities belie its empires' long shadow of death, darkened by thousands of years of suffering and injustice.

16.name: The Immortal Attains the Summit
16.description: Your cultivation bearing glorious fruit, you behold Heaven's will.

4.name: Familiar Sage Dedication
4.prerequisite: You have a familiar, and you're able to cast spells.
4.description: You've forged an empowered mystical bond with your familiar.

6.name: Familiar's Resolve
6.description: When you weave magic, your familiar traces symbols that throw off fear and doubt.

6.name: Fulu Familiar
6.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Expert in Occultism or Expert in Religion
6.description: You can imprint your familiar's spiritual essence into a fulu, a small paper charm that can be affixed to objects, creatures, or structures.

6.name: Tempest Cloud's Speed
6.description: You and your familiar coordinate to channel elemental air.

8.name: Familiar Ritualist
8.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; ability to cast a ritual
8.description: Your familiar's magical presence can serve as an aspect of a ritual.

8.name: Golden Dragon's Bounty
8.description: Your familiar alters the material of a spell into that of a precious metal.

8.name: Lightning Rings' Intervention
8.description: Your familiar learns to empower spells with an electrical discharge.

10.name: Seal of the Golden Dragon
10.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Golden Dragon's Bounty
10.description: Your familiar coils around you, protecting you with its magical resistance.

12.name: Lightning Rings' Overcharge
12.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Lightning Rings' Intervention
12.description: Your familiar can adopt an electrical form to empower weapon strikes.

12.name: Vexing Tempest
12.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Tempest Cloud's Speed
12.description: Your familiar channels elemental air around it to unleash a disruptive gust that sends creatures flying.

16.name: Phoenix's Flight
16.description: You and your familiar learn the secrets of elemental fire, allowing you to merge together to become a legendary creature—a phoenix.

2.name: Animist Dedication
2.description: You have formed a bond with an apparition and can cast divine spells.

4.name: Basic Animist Spellcasting
4.description: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.

4.name: Spiritual Awakening
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level animist feat.

6.name: Animist's Power
6.description: You gain one animist feat.

8.name: Apparition Magic
8.description: You can cast more divine spells each day.

12.name: Expert Animist Spellcasting
12.prerequisite: Basic Animist Spellcasting; Master in Religion
12.description: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.

18.name: Master Animist Spellcasting
18.prerequisite: Expert Animist Spellcasting; Legendary in Religion
18.description: You gain the master spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.

2.name: Exemplar Dedication
2.description: A spark of inherent divine power has lit itself within you.

4.name: Basic Glory
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level exemplar feat.

4.name: Exemplar Resilency
4.prerequisite: Exemplar Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier
4.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each exemplar archetype class feat you have.

6.name: Advanced Glory
6.description: You gain an exemplar feat.

10.name: Exemplar Expertise
10.description: Your soul has been further tempered in divine power.

12.name: Second Ikon
12.description: You gain an additional ikon, selected from those listed here.

12.name: Apocalypse Rider Dedication
12.description: In the darkest hour of the night, a fearsome and terrible steed arrives as a gift from a powerful daemonic patron.

14.name: Behold, A Pale Horse
14.description: Your apocalypse mount becomes worthier of an eventual Rider of the Apocalypse.

14.name: History of Violence
14.description: Your attacks bring with them echoes of previous battles, calling the unquiet victims of your most brutal acts to savage your opponents.

14.name: Jousting Mount
14.description: While riding your apocalypse mount, any two-handed weapon you wield gains the jousting trait with a die size equal to one die size lower than the weapon's normal damage die.

14.name: One Among The Masses
14.description: It will take more than a gathered mass of foes to take you down.

14.name: Putrefaction
14.description: You spoil the food and water nearby, even within your foes' bodies.

16.name: Night Terror
16.description: Buoyed by your fearsome reputation, your steed can take flight.

16.name: Steal Death
16.description: As a harbinger of daemonkind, you gain authority to delay the death of others if it serves your purposes, and in doing so, you bolster the well-being of both you and your mount to allow you sow further havoc.

16.name: To War!
16.description: You inspire your allies to greater battle prowess while trampling enemies in your way.

16.name: Virulent Strike
16.description: Those afflicted by certain maladies are closer to death in your presence.

16.name: Wither Away
16.prerequisite: Apocalypse Rider Dedication; Battle Harbinger Dedication
16.description: You hasten the passage of time for a living creature, prematurely aging them into decrepitude.

18.name: Contagious Spell
18.description: Your magic can bring devastation to more individuals.

18.name: Deathless Servant
18.description: The servants of apocalypse know that it is impossible to cheat death, but your will is sufficient to help you outlive even your strongest enemies.

18.name: Memory of Nothing
18.description: With a look and a gesture, you turn a thinking creature's mind against itself, causing the creature to struggle to remember how to perform more complex actions.

18.name: Soul Vessel Mount
18.description: Your mount has a supernatural hunger for mortal souls that you can feed.

20.name: Immortal Ruin
20.description: Your commitment to ending all life earns you a measure of immortality, setting the stage for you to become a true Rider of the Apocalypse, possibly supplanting one of the Four.

12.name: Archfiend Dedication
12.description: Driven by your Calling, you've begun to make plans for your own personal realm from whence you're destined to rule over an army of fiends.

14.name: Don thy Fervor
14.description: With a thought, the passion of your fiendish desires becomes evident in your eyes and posture.

14.name: Lord of the Fiends
14.description: You consider every fiend a future subject and can assess them at a glance.

14.name: Manipulate Realm
14.description: Thanks to your continued belief in your ultimate transformation, you have learned greater control over your manifested realm.

16.name: Marshall Fiendish Forces
16.description: You have been in contact with a retinue of fiends, brokering all manner of deals so that they may eventually serve you.

16.name: Realm Strider
16.description: You can teleport across the battlefield, disappearing and appearing in a burst of hellfire and brimstone, a flash of lightning, a cloud of caustic gas, or other environmental hazard common within your planned realm.

16.name: Seat of Power
16.description: Your sheer determination has created a demiplane that houses a grand residence which will serve as the heart of your planned realm.

18.name: Brandish Authority
18.description: With a terrifying pronouncement, you manifest a visible sign of your authority and fiendish power, such as a crown of flame upon your brow, a scepter forged of solidified souls, or a throne comprised of a dozen dragon skulls.

18.name: Imprison Foe
18.description: Rather than grant your foes the mercy of a swift death, you can consign them to suffer in an extradimensional prison with an appearance of your choosing.

18.name: Profane Bargain
18.description: You can strike a profane bargain with a willing, sapient creature.

20.name: Fiend Eternal
20.description: Through all your machinations and accumulation of power, you have completed your apotheosis and become a true archfiend.

12.name: Ascended Celestial Dedication
12.description: Your Calling has driven you to perform mortal deeds that will result in your ascension to the ranks of celestials.

14.name: Aegis for the Innocent
14.description: You transfer a portion of your divine spark to an ally, temporarily dimming your nimbus to encase an ally in a barrier of light that repels attackers.

14.name: Ascend
14.description: As you strive to ascend to the ranks of celestials, the pull of gravity loosens on your body.

14.name: Consult Celestial Advisor
14.description: For many, the Calling of an ascended celestial is a wondrous but challenging path, which they must walk alone.

14.name: Channel Divine Spark
14.description: You embrace your divine spark, unleashing your full potential.

16.name: Abjure Harm
16.description: You're nigh invincible, and it's clear that your foe is so far beneath you that they have no hope of winning.

16.name: A Thousand Cries For Help
16.description: You've learned to communicate with creatures from all over the world, overcoming language barriers to lend a hand and help where you're needed.

16.name: Celestial Armaments
16.description: You imbue a fragment of your divine spark into a weapon, blessing your blade and transforming it into a weapon worthy of the celestial realms.

16.name: Cleansing Spell
16.description: Infused with celestial light, your magic can more effectively heal wounds and purge afflictions.

18.name: Army of One
18.description: Even alone, you're a force to be reckoned with— an army of one, so long as you have your celestial armaments.

18.name: Eyes Unclouded
18.description: Your senses are enhanced by your divine spark, enabling you see things as they truly are, piercing through illusions, transformations, and lies.

18.name: Shining Glory
18.description: With a righteous word, your divine aura inspires your allies to great heroics and causes foes to tremble.

18.name: Scouring Spark
18.description: When you unleash your divine spark, you become a being of living light that scours away the darkness.

20.name: Celestial Rebirth
20.description: Through your diligence and commitment to heroics, you finally complete your apotheosis into a true celestial.

12.name: Beast Lord Dedication
12.prerequisite: a mature animal companion or an advanced construct companion
12.description: Your Calling has united your destiny with a companion, harnessing a connection between you that links your minds, hearts, and souls.

14.name: Chosen Ward
14.description: You have designated an ally to be you and your companion's ward, making it your primary directive to shield them from harm.

14.name: Guarded Domain
14.description: You and your united companion have elected to become guardians of a particular location or domain.

14.name: We are One
14.description: You and your companion move as one, never tripping each other up.

14.name: You Can't Hide From Us
14.description: When you and your companion attack together, you can ensure that escape is but a whispered dream.

16.name: Bat Around
16.description: Your attack moves a foe into a position that your united companion can take full advantage of.

16.name: Defend Our Union
16.description: You can protect your companion from danger with a welltimed attack.

16.name: Telepathic Union
16.description: Your union is so strong, you can communicate with each other without uttering a word, even across vast distances.

16.name: Unified Stance
16.description: You and your companion enter a unified fighting style that allows you to fight in tandem more succinctly.

18.name: Creature of Myth
18.prerequisite: Beast Lord Dedication; you have a united companion with a specialization.
18.description: Your specialized united companion grows with unparalleled power and strength, becoming a creature of myth.

18.name: Pack Of The Beast Lord
18.description: You and your united companion call upon the service of others of its kind, creating figment duplicates of your companion to form a massive swarm of formidable power.

20.name: One Life, Two Vessels
20.description: The minds of you and your companion are so intertwined that, so long as one of you lives, the other continues to exist in the living one's mind.

12.name: Broken Chain Dedication
12.description: Your Calling was sparked by your outrage at tyrants, after having witnessed a brutal act of oppression that you could no longer abide.

14.name: Bloc Tactics
14.description: You have experience in undertaking direct action and know how to protect the identity and health of you and your allies when doing so.

14.name: Break the Cycle
14.description: Sometimes people with no underlying quarrel have been fighting each other simply out of spite.

14.name: Release Me!
14.description: Your retribution against one who would detain you is swift and dangerous.

14.name: Rites of Liberation
14.description: You learn the freedom ritual.

14.name: United Front
14.description: Thanks to your powerful speeches, your movement finds allies in all sectors of society and even across enemy lines, all eager to help you accomplish your goals.

14.name: You Can't Keep Us Down
14.description: Seeing your allies falter, you fill their hearts with your unbreakable hope, rousing them to stay in the fight.

16.name: Bring into the Fold
16.description: Not all who oppress are irredeemable, and given encouragement and some time, they will abandon their cause and join your fight against the very system they used to uphold.

16.name: Cry of Rebellion
16.description: You let loose a yell of unbridled passion, which fuels your allies, and pounds against your foes.

16.name: Lose Your Chains
16.description: You rouse rebellion in the hearts of your allies, inspiring them to break free of their bonds.

16.name: Remember thy Names
16.description: You peer into the eyes of a target of your Ultimatum of Liberation, as you say aloud the names of their victims, searing them into the oppressor's mind, cursing them to feel their victims' pain.

16.name: Stand Firm
16.description: Your words help your ally shake off unease and terror.

18.name: Liberty or Death
18.description: You have given a despot enough time to think, and now is the time for them to forfeit their control or die.

18.name: Rebellious Existence
18.description: You have tied yourself so absolutely to the cause of liberty that your very existence is an act of rebellion.

18.name: Reprisal of the Fallen
18.description: You can feel the sorrow, pain, and rage of those fallen to oppression, peering from just behind the veil of death, and you can bring them forth to exact their revenge.

20.name: Break the Causal Chain
20.description: Something terrible has happened.

20.name: You Can't Kill an Idea
20.description: Those who would destroy you instead transform you into a powerful yet formless entity.

12.name: Eternal Legend Dedication
12.description: As your renown as a fighter grows, your Calling comes to fruition.

14.name: Demolishing Knockback
14.description: You make a forceful attack that has the power to push your foe through walls.

14.name: Earth to Heavens Strike
14.description: Your blows hamper both a foe's mobility and cognitive functions by focusing first on their lower extremities and then their head.

14.name: Fautless Defense
14.description: As you are struck, your steely determination reminds those who fight you that they are destined to be no more than footnotes in your tale.

14.name: Immovable Object
14.prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; master in Fortitude or Reflex Saves
14.description: You plant your feet in a wide stance, resisting all movement not of your own volition.

14.name: Scattering Shout
14.description: With a flex of your mighty thews and a guttural bellow that can make ears bleed, you drive back any enemies surrounding you.

16.name: Death from Above
16.description: Seemingly to defy gravity, you use a nearby vertical surface to propel yourself upward and then strike downward like the driving rain.

16.name: Leaping Hedgehog Strike
16.description: You pounce toward an enemy and then barrel them over with one fluid movement, ending this maneuver with an attack that may catch them off-balance.

16.name: Pierce The Eye
16.description: You aim a shot from your weapon directly at a foe's eye, blinding them in the process.

16.name: Terrifying Mien
16.prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; Master in Intimidation
16.description: Whether they have heard of your legend or seen your prowess on the field of battle, those already quaking in their boots grow weak when forced to stand against you.

16.name: Weft and Warp
16.description: With graceful poise, you perform a dance of dangerous attacks.

18.name: Exaltation Overwhelming
18.description: Raising your weapon or fist aloft, you begin to gleam with dazzling radiance.

18.name: Legend of Combat
18.description: You can deliver a lightning-fast series of blows and strikes, bringing all the strength of your legend to bear against those who have yet to experience your prowess.

18.name: Mythic Weapon Specialization
18.prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; greater weapon specialization
18.description: When you fully embrace your Calling, your blows hit with incredible force that can fell even the mightiest of creatures.

18.name: Unstoppable Force
18.description: While you are in the stance provided by Immovable Object, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

20.name: Fight Through Oblivion
20.description: Mortal wounds that would kill other warriors are no more than the flutter of butterfly wings to you.

20.name: Finish Their Story!
20.description: Though your tale is immortal, your foes aren't afforded such an advantage and mainly serve only to further your legend.

20.name: Living Epic
20.description: You are a living legend, a being who cannot be claimed by death, as death has already passed you.

12.name: Godling Dedication
12.description: Your Calling allows you to begin walking the path to true deific ascension, inspiring followers as your divine seed grows.

14.name: Claim Cardinal Domains
14.description: Your dominion over the divine truths of the world increases.

14.name: Divine Invulnerability
14.description: Though you are not yet a god, you can invoke a measure of omnipotence that makes you high invulnerable.

14.name: Receive Prayers
14.description: You open your senses so the prayers of mortals can better reach your ears.

14.name: Heroic Weakness
14.description: As word of your faith spreads, so too does word of your foibles and weaknesses.

14.name: Myth of Quick-Thinking
14.description: Your myth includes amusing parables of clever plans and sly maneuvers, often applied to small things in life such as disguising yourself as a sheep to ambush a wolf or tricking a snake into shedding its skin.

14.name: Myth of Realm-Walking
14.description: Your myth speaks of distant travel to countless countries, planes, or dimensions.

16.name: Absolve Sins
16.description: Your forgiveness is without limit, though the path to penitence can be painful, especially against those who have trespassed against your current mortal form.

16.name: Font of Life or Death
16.description: As you reach ever higher in your quest to achieve true divinity, the powers of life and death flow evermore easily from you.

16.name: Gird Champion
16.description: Your will manifests into divine weapons to protect and arm your followers.

18.name: Pass Vengeful Judgement
18.description: To prevent yourself from frivolously calling down the terrible power of divine wrath, you have vowed to do so only with the assent of your mortal hierophant.

18.name: Sanctified Relic
18.description: You fill an item with your divine power, granting the wearer your blessings.

18.name: Stymie the Gods
18.description: By exerting your will as a nascent god present in the mortal realms, you can hold off the influences of most distant entities, even ones much older and more powerful than yourself.

20.name: Assume Godhood
20.description: You complete your apotheosis into living godhood, allowing you to empower more followers.

12.name: Prophesied Monarch Dedication
12.description: Your Calling has culminated in a destiny of rulership, and you're able to forge a mythic bond with noble knights whose destinies become intertwined with your own.

14.name: Bloom of Health
14.description: You shout a rallying cry that inspires the well-being of your kingdom's protectors.

14.name: Decree of Banisment
14.description: You assume a demeanor of authority and decree banishment upon a foe who has defied your authority.

14.name: Decree of Prosperity
14.description: You speak with a gentle encouragement that inspires confidence and competence in your followers.

14.name: Might of the Realm
14.description: Bolstered by the presence of your knights, you strike a mighty blow in the name of your rule.

16.name: Kneel Before the Rightful Heir
16.description: You command that your foes bow down before you or face your wrath.

16.name: My Kingdom, My Blood
16.description: The health of the ruler is the health of the kingdom, and the health of the kingdom is that of its ruler, each bound to the other inextricably.

16.name: Noble Sacrifice
16.description: As your knights devote their lives and swords to you, so too do you return their devotion with your own fierce protection.

16.name: Protect the Royal Line
16.description: You must keep your royal person safe from harm, especially when surrounded by those who would dare approach you.

18.name: Decree of Execution
18.description: You proclaim that a foe has violated the sanctity of your realm and must die.

18.name: Decree of War
18.description: You declare your current foes as irredeemable enemies, calling your allies down upon them.

18.name: Fated Duel
18.description: You and your knights are an unbeatable force together, but sometimes it's a monarch's duty to resolve the fate of their kingdom with nothing more than their own trusted weapon.

18.name: Sovereign's Blade
18.description: As you raise your weapon into the air, it begins to shed a bright light that pierces darkness and calls your knights to your side.

20.name: Legacy of Monarchs
20.description: No matter what might happen to you, your legacy shall never die.

20.name: Once and Future
20.description: Though foul treachery might lay you low or dark magic still your heart, when the people cry out for you in desperate need, you shall rise to protect them.

12.name: Wildspell Dedication
12.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots
12.description: You gain the ability to tap into a powerful well of magic.

14.name: Extend Surge
14.description: You tap deeper into the vortex of magical energy within you.

14.name: Invigorating Surge
14.description: You alter the aura of magic surrounding you to protect a nearby ally.

14.name: Mythic Heightening
14.description: You overload your minor spells to give them greater effect.

14.name: Spell Network
14.description: Your aura links your friends together with mystic strands.

14.name: Burning Surge
14.description: You cause a surge of magical energy to flare up, harming that creature and those near it.

16.name: Imbue Spell
16.description: You pass the energy of your magic onto an ally, allowing another to release the spell.

16.name: Mystical Flare
16.description: You release a torrent of magic to fill the air with tiny, distracting explosions of light.

16.name: Rapid Switch
16.description: You've honed your control over your spellsurge aura and can rapidly alter its effects.

16.name: Recharging Transference
