16.description: You can break your spells down into raw magical potential and transfer it to an ally.

16.name: Thundering Surge
16.description: Your magic explodes in bursts of excess energy, creating thunderous waves.

18.name: Galvanize Spell
18.description: You reabsorb the magic of your spellsurge aura to power a piece of powerful magic.

18.name: Mana Detonation
18.description: You can violently discorporate your form.

18.name: Mythic Counter
18.description: You can overwhelm the magical designs of others with sheer magic power.

20.name: Mystic Life Force
20.description: Magic energy sustains you, supporting your form far beyond the capabilities of mere flesh.

20.name: Surging Interference
20.description: You absorb the scattered energy of others' failed spells, using it to recharge your own magic.

2.name: Kitharodian Actor Dedication
2.description: You've studied classic Taldan theater and learned to embody various roles to a sublime degree.

4.name: Animal Actor
4.description: You participated in a performance of The Leaping Lion , a play focusing on Cyricas, the animal-loving adventurer who traveled with his ape friend Mardu and remains a favorite hero among Taldan youth.

4.name: Heaven's Step Offense
4.description: Your lessons from the stage find life in the storied mercy and fearlessness of Grand Prince Gennaris III.

6.name: Clean Take
6.description: Thanks to many long hours of rehearsals, your acting skill is infinitely adaptable.

8.name: Monumental Maestro
8.description: You've studied the moving compositions of Andreas Romung, a legendary maestro whose Shining Crusade anthems live on in the music for the play Echoes of Glory .

10.name: Stunt Performer Stance
10.description: You clear your mind, regulate your breathing, and prepare your muscles in a stance inspired by Kemen Kayton, a graduate of Zimar's Monastery of the Seven Forms.

12.name: Sympathetic Portrayal
12.description: You portrayed Grand Prince Stavian III in Fall of the Troubled King , a production dedicated to the life and times of the paranoid Taldan ruler whose violent resistance to new policies on succession kicked off the War for the Crown.

12.name: Bleak Humorist
12.description: You've watched dozens of morbid comedies depicting Beldam I, Taldor's prankster emperor whose wife accidentally killed him when she struck him with a marble bust after he jumped out from behind curtains to frighten her.

14.name: Of Lions and Wyrms
14.description: You starred in a war drama depicting First Emperor Taldaris's battles against the Grogrisant, a massive six- eyed lion, and Verksaris the Kingeater, a mighty dragon.

16.name: Ruthless Orator
16.description: You were once cast in the role of Daronlyr XII, one of Taldor's most ambitious rulers who slew his cousin to seize the crown, yet somehow still managed to convince the entire Ulfen Guard to swear loyalty to him simply through his powers of oration.

2.name: Razmiran Priest Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Crafting; Trained in Deception
2.description: You have earned entry to the priesthood of Razmir, either at the Exalted Lodge or another temple where Razmir's holy masks are forged.

6.name: Perfect Truths
6.description: Your knowledge of Razmir's faith and doctrines has grown.

10.name: Mask of The 12th Step
10.prerequisite: Razmiran Priest Dedication; Expert in Crafting
10.description: You have reached the 12th Step and been instructed in greater secrets of Razmir's doctrine.

14.name: Mask of The 15th Step
14.prerequisite: Razmiran Priest Dedication; Master in Crafting
14.description: You have ascended to the 15th Step and stand among the greatest of Razmir's priests.

20.name: Living God
20.prerequisite: Razmiran Priest Dedication; Legendary in Crafting
20.description: You have reached heights of power equaling Razmir's himself.

2.name: Tattooed Historian Dedication
2.prerequisite: Constitution +1; Trained in Belkzen Lore, Trained in Orc Lore, Trained in Orc Pantheon Lore, or (at the GM's discretion) a related Lore skill
2.description: You become trained in Diplomacy or Performance; if you are already trained in both skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

2.name: Agent of All Holds
2.description: Orcs across Belkzen recognize you as an honored lorekeeper.

4.name: Inked Panoply
4.description: Your tattoos can briefly animate and extend from your skin, granting you a spectral shieldbearer who protects you from harm.

6.name: Infused with Belkzen's Might
6.description: Your tattoos immortalize the conquests of orc war leaders, such as Belkzen besieging the dwarven Sky Citadel of Koldukar.

6.name: Inscribed with Elders' Deeds
6.description: Your tattoos commemorate unique exploits that (according to legends) only an orc could accomplish.

8.name: Wrath of the Hold
8.description: Your tattoos carry the strength of an innumerable horde, and you can expend one use of your storied skin's Living History ability to animate your tattoos as ghostly assailants that swarm your foes.

2.name: Spectral Dagger
2.description: By touching the splinter of finality in your neck, you conjure a spectral dagger into your hand that resembles the splinter wrapped in a crude hilt.

4.name: Dread Blade
4.description: Your strikes with your conjured dagger impart the chill of the grave.

6.name: Soul Bleed
6.description: Your blade can rupture an enemy's very soul, draining away its essence to empower you.

8.name: Soul Well
8.description: Your brush your fingers across your splinter of finality , momentarily creating a metaphysical vortex from which mortal spirits struggle to escape.

10.name: Lethal Edge
10.description: When the terrified are struck by your spectral weapon, they feel the anguish of every life taken by Silent Lenore .

12.name: Hungry Blade
12.description: Once your spectral dagger has tasted an enemy's soul, your splinter of finality becomes increasingly relentless in its attempts to claim the soul.

14.name: Vengful Remnant
14.description: You wreathe yourself in the tatters of all the souls claimed by your blade.

16.name: Instrument of Death
16.description: Your splinter of finality has reached the apex of its death-dealing potential.

18.name: Guillotine Blade
18.description: The echoes of the splinter of finality's original purpose resonate through the artifact.

20.name: Soul Oubliette
20.description: Your mortal strike wrenches the soul from your victim's body and imprisons it in your splinter of finality , with the effects of seize soul .

2.name: Sanguimancer Dedication
2.description: You can draw and manipulate energy from blood. You store life energy in the form of special temporary Hit Points and spend it to manifest powerful effects.

4.name: Blood Shield
4.description: You raise a barrier of your own blood to protect you.

6.name: Exsanguinate
6.description: After one of your attacks, you direct your foe's blood to spray upon you, infusing you with life energy.

8.name: Transfusion
8.description: You bring forth the regenerative properties of blood on behalf of an ally or yourself.

10.name: Venipuncture
10.description: A shell made up of hundreds of razor-thin needles of blood forms around you before exploding outward.

2.name: Commander Dedication
2.description: You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing.

4.name: Basic Field Training
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.

4.name: Tactical Excellence
4.description: You add two new tactics to your folio and increase your maximum number of tactics prepared by 1.

6.name: Advanced Field Training
6.description: You gain a commander feat.

12.name: Officer's Expertise
12.description: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to expert, and you become an expert in Warfare Lore.

18.name: Officer's Mastery
18.description: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to master, and you become a master in Warfare Lore.

2.name: Guardian Dedication
2.description: You become trained in Athletics; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

4.name: Basic Defender
4.description: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level guardian feat.

4.name: Guardian Resiliency
4.prerequisite: Guardian Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points than 10 + your Constitution modifier
4.description: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each guardian archetype class feat you have.

6.name: Advanced Defender
6.description: You gain one guardian feat.

6.name: Guardian's Intercept
6.description: You can use the Intercept Attack reaction once per 10 minutes.

8.name: Armored Resistance
8.description: While you are wearing medium or heavy armor, you gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your character level when you use the Intercept Attack reaction to take damage instead of your ally.

12.name: Ironclad Fortitude
12.prerequisite: Guardian Dedication; expert in Fortitude saves
12.description: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

2.name: Field Propagandist Dedication
2.prerequisite: Charisma +2; Trained in Deception; Trained in Diplomacy
2.description: Having devoted your life to crafting propaganda, you know that winning the hearts and minds of soldiers can be a deciding factor in securing the successful outcome of a war.

4.name: Fabricate Truth
4.description: You invent a false truth by fast talking, switching arguments, shifting the standard of evidence, and generally confounding others.

4.name: Predispose Settlement
4.prerequisite: Field Propagandist Dedication; Expert in Deception
4.description: You spend 7 days of downtime seeding propaganda through a settlement with a population of 2,500 or fewer.

6.name: Invented Vulnerability
6.description: You list off the potential fears and weaknesses of an enemy you can see or hear, speaking with such certainty that they become real.

6.name: Invincible Army
6.description: You enumerate the many virtues and victories of your chosen allies, creating a story of their invincibility so convincing that it is as good as the truth.

8.name: Orator's Fillibuster
8.description: When you seek to convince others of the worth of your cause, you are capable of unleashing such an entrancing torrent of rhetoric and metaphor that it is all but impossible to look away from you.

8.name: A Tale to Believe In
8.description: You recite a tale of prowess that rewrites the combat unfolding around you.

10.name: The Truth as I See it
10.description: Your knack for spinning a believable reality from threads of story is so practiced that sometimes even you begin to believe what you're saying.

12.name: Mass Delusion
12.description: You wave around fabricated evidence that contradicts what your enemies know to be true.

2.name: Iridian Choirmaster Dedication
2.description: When you take this dedication, choose one willing, non-minion ally to be your student in the ways of the Iridian Choir.

4.name: Lesson of the Broken Wing
4.description: You make yourself appear to be a tempting target to draw an enemy in, distracting them from your student's attacks.

4.name: Lesson of the Circling Gale
4.description: You and your student have trained with footwork drills to mirror each other's movements.

6.name: Ensnaring Disarm
6.description: You smack your foe's item out of their hand so that your student can grab it.

6.name: Lesson of Bonded Eyes
6.description: You and your student share an understanding of your surroundings.

6.name: Repeat Lesson
6.description: Upon seeing your student falter, you demonstrate the proper technique.

8.name: Lesson of Mutual Gambits
8.description: You create an opening for your student, setting them up for their own attack.

8.name: Lesson of Sympathetic Vulnerability
8.description: You temporarily borrow the essence of your student's attack to infuse yourself.

10.name: Lesson of the Splintered Aegis
10.description: With your attack, you demonstrate to your student a hole in your enemy's defenses.

10.name: Seize Advantage
10.description: You take the openings granted by your student's success to reposition yourself.

12.name: Lesson of Unified Elusion
12.description: You and your student react as one to common threats.

12.name: Pupil's Guard
12.description: You're intimately familiar with your student's motions and are ready to step in at a moment's notice should anything threaten to disrupt them.

14.name: Lesson of the Hurricane's Might
14.description: You and your student enact a graceful dance of battle.

14.name: Simultaneous Strike
14.description: Moving in unison, you and your student unleash an attack against a foe.

16.name: Shared Mind, Shared Heart
16.description: Your thoughts and dreams are your student's thoughts and dreams, and vice versa.

6.name: Necrologist Dedication
6.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots, ability to cast _summon undead_
6.description: Your studies of the lists of the dead allow you to call forth a horde of undead with a brief incantation.

8.name: Dismal Harvest
8.description: The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power.

8.name: Grasping Corpses
8.description: Your foes are left reeling from the attacks made by the zombies or skeletons of your horde.

8.name: Shambling March
8.description: Your horde is swifter, marching in time to your command.

10.name: Deathguard
10.description: The twisting rotted limbs, clattering bones, or swirling ectoplasm of your horde can hide you from others' vision.

10.name: Ghostsong
10.description: You have come to understand the pain and fury of spirits and can raise them to do your ghastly work.

10.name: Preserve the Horde
10.description: The act of summoning additional undead minions doesn't make you lose the focus required to maintain the animation of your horde.

12.name: Danse Macabre
12.description: Your horde can drag unwilling victims along with it as it shambles forward.

12.name: Shift Horde
12.description: With a wave of your hand, your risen undead horde collapses and another one rises to take its place.

12.name: Wailing Dead
12.description: The voices of the spirits you command spark fear in the hearts of your enemies.

14.name: Death Rattle
14.description: When the time comes for your horde to be returned to its temporary rest, its departure carries those nearby closer to death.

14.name: In the Horde's Grip
14.description: When your skeletons and zombies attack, their skeletal claws and rotting hands clutch and tear flesh.

2.name: War Mage Dedication
2.prerequisite: You have a spellcasting class feature.
2.description: Your studies into the battlefield applications of magic have made your spells particularly effective at disrupting enemy formations or manipulating enemy troops into positions where they are more vulnerable to wide-scale magical attacks.

4.name: Mage's Field Dressing
4.description: As your spell takes hold on your ally, you use some of its magic to quickly dress their wounds.

4.name: Shield Spell Reinforcement
4.prerequisite: War Mage Dedication; you can cast the _shield_ cantrip
4.description: You can empower your defensive magic by channeling it through a physical shield.

4.name: Siege Ritualist
4.description: Sometimes, magical warfare requires the application of more complex arcana.

6.name: Arcana of Iron
6.description: You eschew wands and staves for more advanced weaponry.

6.name: Intimidating Spell
6.description: The devastation wrought by your large-scale spells is particularly terrifying.

8.name: Shielding Formation
8.description: You have mastered unique magical techniques designed to protect your allies from harm.

8.name: Spellshield
8.description: Your shield becomes a bonded item capable of storing your spells.

10.name: Secrets of Steel
10.description: As your prowess with weapons increases, so does the ferocity of magic you channel through those weapons.

12.name: Battlefield Arcana
12.description: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle.

2.name: Captain Dedication
2.prerequisite: Charisma +2; you don't have an animal companion, construct companion, or other companion that functions similarly
2.description: You become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Intimidation; if you are already trained in both of these skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice.

4.name: Additional Follower
4.description: Another follower joins you in your travels.

4.name: Experienced Follower
4.description: Your followers' skills have developed over the course of your adventures.

4.name: Leader of All
4.description: You accept anyone who would follow you on your adventures.

6.name: Cadre
6.prerequisite: Captain Dedication; expert in Diplomacy or Intimidation
6.description: Between your daring adventures, people seek you out.

6.name: Tactical Guidance
6.description: You can provide tactical guidance to help your follower act more efficiently.

8.name: Veteran Follower
8.description: Your followers' training has made them veterans of battle.

12.name: Coordinated Tactics
12.description: You and your follower fight in tandem.

14.name: Exceptional Follower
14.description: Your followers' abilities have soared to new heights.

15.name: Legendary Leader
15.prerequisite: Captain Dedication; legendary in Diplomacy or Intimidation
15.description: Your fame has spread throughout the lands.

20.name: Peerless Captain
20.description: When you have an active follower in an encounter, you are quickened.

2.name: Draconic Acolyte Dedication
2.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
2.description: As an acolyte of dragonkind, you have an item known as a draconic gift that you can use to summon a portion of the magical essence of the dragon you received it from.

4.name: Draconic Fury
4.description: You briefly summon spectral claws that lash out in a flurry.

4.name: Draconic Resilience
4.description: Energy reminiscent of dragon scales shimmers over you, making it more difficult for attacks to penetrate your defenses.

6.name: Draconic Familiar
6.description: Your devotion to dragons has attracted a loyal servant.

6.name: Essence Overflow
6.description: Your Channel Draconic Essence ends, and all creatures (except you) in a 10-foot emanation from your spectral dragon take 6d6 damage with a

8.name: Benefactor's Wings
8.description: Calling on your draconic gift, spectral wings carry you to your destination.

8.name: Reactive Resilience
8.description: Your power blunts blades and weakens spells like the hardiest of dragon scales.

10.name: Deepening Devotion
10.description: Your investment in your draconic gift has unlocked greater power.

10.name: Reflexive Devotion
10.description: The power of dragons flows through you at the merest thought.

12.name: Frightening Power
12.description: Draconic essence coruscates around you, sapping the resilience of your foes.

14.name: Call Draconic Ally
14.description: Either by beseeching a dragon or bending it to your will, you conjure a mighty creature to assist you.

16.name: Hidden Hoard
16.description: Your draconic gift is the key to a repository of treasure that only you can access.

2.name: Drake Rider Dedication
2.description: You gain the service of a young riding drake, riding dragonet, or another animal companion with the dragon trait you have access to.

4.name: Mature Dragon Companion
4.description: Your dragon companion matures and the bond you share is strengthened.

4.name: Winged Leap
4.prerequisite: dragon companion with the mount special ability; Drake Rider Dedication
4.description: While drakes and dragons are able flyers, they're uncomfortable carrying a rider in the air without special training.

6.name: Flair Rider Stance
6.prerequisite: Drake Rider Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics
6.description: You spend little time in your saddle as you flip unpredictably around your dragon mount, dodging attacks.

6.name: War Rider Stance
6.prerequisite: Drake Rider Dedication; expert in martial weapons; dragon companion with a support benefit that includes damage
6.description: Your dragon's constant breath threatens your foes.

8.name: Incredible Dragon Companion
8.description: Your mature dragon companion develops further, becoming more robust and formidable.

10.name: Wing Rider
10.description: Your bond with your dragon has been honed so fine that it can carry you aloft with its full capability.

12.name: Death Dive
12.description: You guide your mount into a plummet, diving headlong at a single foe.

12.name: Strafing Breath
12.description: You urge your dragon mount forward, wreathed in magical power.

14.name: Guided Hover
14.description: You guide your draconic companion, whose outstretched wings fill with unseen thermals.

12.name: Avenging Runelord Dedication
12.description: The call of a long dead runelord has infected your soul and transformed your fate.

14.name: Expanded Runelord Magic
14.description: Your ability to use magic associated with your chosen sin grows.

14.name: Reliable Magic
14.description: Magic stored in written form or within wands is more reliable in your capable hands.

14.name: Shining Runes
14.description: Whenever you Cast a Spell that requires more than one action to cast, the signature Thassilonian runes you trace in the air flicker with light and command attention.

14.name: Willing Runes
14.description: Magical markings of every kind seem eager to aid your endeavors.

14.name: Writhing Runelord Weapon
14.description: Your prowess with long-hafted weapons catches your opponents by surprise, as it bends or elongates in an obviously supernatural manner.

16.name: Autonomous Arms
16.prerequisite: Avenging Runelord Dedication; expert proficiency in a spear or polearm
16.description: A portion of the ancient grasping spirit that infuses your being spills over into a spear or polearm you carry.

16.name: Subjugation
16.description: You have managed to gain a degree of control over the runelord's ancient soul within your mind, enough that you can project this invasive influence into the minds of others.

16.name: Vindictive Thoughts
16.description: Those who seek to do you personal harm with magic must suffer the same misfortune.

18.name: Advanced Runelord Magic
18.description: Your ability to use magic associated with your chosen sin grows.

18.name: Apocalyptic Visions
18.description: Your runelord may not have lived long enough to need to retreat into hiding in the face of Earthfall, but the apocalyptic echoes of this event nevertheless reached their soul all the way in the Boneyard.

20.name: Craft Runewell
20.description: Even if the runelord whose soul influences you never did so themselves, you know how to create your own runewell—an artifact that grants you a measure of immortality.

12.name: Heroic Scion Dedication
12.description: Destiny calls, and the soul of a dead hero reincarnates to take up the fight! Either an old enemy resumes their efforts to affect chaos and violence, or a new threat arises and you feel compelled to stand against it.

14.name: Avoid Fate's Gaze
14.description: Your past and current enemies may know you by reputation, but spying on you with magic is much more difficult.

14.name: I've Been Here Before
14.description: You adapt quickly to new settings and terrains.

14.name: Internal Dialogue
14.description: Past experiences or even past selves whisper words of advice and encouragement when you need them.

14.name: My Reputation Precedes Me
14.description: Long years of brave exploits haven't gone unnoticed.

14.name: Reincarnated Companion
14.prerequisite: Heroic Scion Dedication; familiar or nimble or savage animal companion
14.description: You're not alone in having a legendary past life—so too does your companion.

14.name: To Thine Own Self
14.description: Awareness of your past perils protects you from those who would manipulate your thoughts.

16.name: Daunting Spell
16.description: Your enemies feel the inevitability of defeat once they feel the potency of your magic.

16.name: Let Death Be My Weapon
16.description: You recall your death in vivid detail, and the fear, pain, and uncertainty you suffered are blunted by the truth of your reincarnation.

16.name: Momentary Respite
16.description: Your sense of destiny manifests as rapid physical healing.

16.name: Vigorous Victor
16.description: Long years of success have not only shown you where your limits lie, they've expanded them.

18.name: On My Best Day
18.description: Be they in your current life or your previous one, you've had many heroic moments that continue to inspire you.

18.name: Telling Blow
18.description: Your determination empowers a telling blow to defeat your most powerful enemies.

18.name: To Me!
18.description: Two lives spent in adventuring groups has given you a special gift for bolstering party morale and pushing your allies to achieve greater ends when they work as a team.

20.name: Eternal Hero
20.description: Whatever the explanation, you're almost impossible to kill.

12.name: Timewracked Dedication
12.description: The current of time shifts subtly in your field of view. You have learned to tread these temporal eddies, moving forward and pushing backward in small strokes.

14.name: Be Right Back
14.description: You can manipulate time to produce an item in a seemingly impossible fashion.

14.name: Live Off Borrowed Time
14.description: You tap into the future to steal a bit of time from yourself a few seconds from now that you can use immediately.

14.name: Now You See Me
14.description: You flash through several possible timelines as you move.

14.name: Second Sight
14.description: You peer into the next several seconds to watch the potential timelines around a nearby creature unfold.

14.name: Temporal Fury
14.description: You shift and skip through time, vanishing during your movement to appear in unexpected and advantageous locations for combat.

16.name: Bolstered Recovery
16.description: Whenever you rest, you recover with remarkable speed.

16.name: Echoing Fury
16.description: You cheat the rules of time to co-locate during your attack.

16.name: Preserve the Moment
16.description: Sometimes, your actions are so successful and impressive that it's worth going back to them.

18.name: Fracture Time Flow
18.description: Your ability to interact with and even observe the flow of time allows you to fracture it slightly in a localized place whenever you land a particularly solid blow on a foe.

18.name: Not This Time
18.description: You reflexively attempt to cycle a creature's timeline briefly to a reality where it's less able to succeed.

20.name: Timelessness
20.description: Time travelers are rare, but even among them your isolation from time is unique.

12.name: Warshard Warrior Dedication
12.description: When you became infused with a shard of the god of war, you knew in your gut that your destiny would be one for the ages—yet you may not, at first, know the exact way such a destiny would play out.

14.name: Athlete's Ally
14.description: You channel the power of your warshard through your weapon to better perform athletic maneuvers.

14.name: Lightless Sight
14.description: You gain darkvision as long as you wield your warshard weapon.

14.name: Steadfast Grip
14.description: The connection you have with your warshard weapon strengthens it and assists you in maintaining your grip on it in battle.

14.name: Transmute Weapon
14.description: When you choose a warshard weapon during daily preparations, you can transform the material it's composed of so that the weapon is made of a precious material.

14.name: Warshard Rune
14.description: When you choose a warshard weapon during your daily preparations, you can empower it with an additional magical effect.

16.name: Divide and Conquer
16.description: When you face multiple foes, you wield your warshard weapon with vigor.

16.name: Indomitable Shot
16.description: You can fire a single shot that penetrates multiple foes.

16.name: Prescient Parry
16.description: Your warshard weapon intervenes at the last second, rising to deflect the incoming blow.

18.name: Final Shot Knows the Way
18.description: You judge a foe's defenses after attacking them and channel that knowledge into your warshard weapon and its ammunition.

18.name: Throw and Catch
18.description: You hurl your warshard weapon at an opponent, even though the weapon isn't designed to be thrown.

20.name: I Am the Weapon
20.description: Your supernatural bond with your weapon infuses it with a powerful echo of your sentience, your memory, and even fragments of your very soul.

spells.name: Abyssal Plague
spells.description: Inflict a draining curse.

spells.name: Acid Arrow
spells.description: Magical arrow deals acid damage persistently.

spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: You splash a glob of acid that splatters your target and nearby creatures.

spells.name: Aerial Form
spells.description: Turn into a flying combatant.

spells.name: Air Bubble
spells.description: React to create air for a creature to breathe.

spells.name: Air Walk
spells.description: Walk on air as though it were solid ground.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.description: Be alerted if a creature enters a warded area.

spells.name: Alter Reality
spells.description: Warp reality to duplicate occult spells.

spells.name: Anathematic Reprisal
spells.description: Cause mental pain to one who commits anathema against your deity.

spells.name: Animal Form
spells.description: Turn into a dangerous animal.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.description: Send a Tiny animal to deliver a message.

spells.name: Animal Vision
spells.description: Project your senses through an animal.

spells.name: Ant Haul
spells.description: Target can carry more.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.description: Magic doesn't function in an area around you.

spells.name: Augury
spells.description: Predict whether a course of action brings good fortune.

spells.name: Avatar
spells.description: Transform into a battle form determined by your deity.

spells.name: Baleful Polymorph
spells.description: Transform a creature into a harmless animal.

spells.name: Bane
spells.description: Weaken enemies' attacks in an aura around you.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: Send a creature back to its home plane.

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.description: Target's skin is covered in protective bark.

spells.name: Bind Soul
spells.description: Imprison a dead creature's soul.

spells.name: Bind Undead
spells.description: Take control of a mindless undead.

spells.name: Black Tentacles
spells.description: Tentacles in an area grab creatures.

spells.name: Blade Barrier
spells.description: Form a wall of swords made of force.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Strengthen allies' attacks in an aura around you.

spells.name: Blindness
spells.description: Strike a target blind.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Flit between the planes, vanishing and reappearing.

spells.name: Blur
spells.description: Cause a target's form to become blurry and hard to hit.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.description: React to revive a creature at the moment of its death.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: A small cone of flame rushes from your hands.

spells.name: Calm Emotions
spells.description: Suppress strong emotions and hostility.

spells.name: Cataclysm
spells.description: Call an instant, damaging cataclysm.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Lightning jumps from creature to creature.

spells.name: Charm
spells.description: A creature becomes more friendly to you.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: Your touch hurts the living or disorients undead.

spells.name: Chilling Darkness

spells.name: Telekinetic Projectile

spells.name: Touch of Idiocy

spells.name: Tree Shape

spells.name: Tree Stride

spells.name: True Seeing

spells.name: True Strike

spells.name: True Target

spells.name: Uncontrollable Dance

spells.name: Undetectable Alignment

spells.name: Unfettered Pack

spells.name: Unseen Servant

spells.name: Vampiric Touch

spells.name: Ventriloquism

spells.name: Vibrant Pattern

spells.name: Visions of Danger

spells.name: Vital Beacon
spells.description: Radiate vitality that heals creatures that touch you.

spells.name: Volcanic Eruption

spells.name: Wail of the Banshee
spells.description: Scream, dealing damage and draining creatures.

spells.name: Wall of Fire

spells.name: Wall of Force

spells.name: Wall of Ice

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.description: Shape a wall of stone.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.description: Grow a wall of brambles.

spells.name: Wall of Wind

spells.name: Wanderer's Guide
spells.description: Find an ideal route to a location.

spells.name: Warp Mind

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.description: Allow creatures to breathe underwater.

spells.name: Water Walk

spells.name: Weapon of Judgment

spells.name: Weapon Storm
spells.description: Multiply a weapon you hold and attack many creatures with it.

spells.name: Web

spells.name: Weird

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.description: Turn creatures into swift-moving clouds.

spells.name: Zealous Conviction
spells.description: Instill unshakable conviction and zeal in willing creatures.

spells.name: Zone of Truth

spells.name: Allegro

spells.name: Counter Performance

spells.name: Dirge of Doom

spells.name: Fatal Aria

spells.name: House of Imaginary Walls

spells.name: Inspire Competence

spells.name: Inspire Courage

spells.description: You inspire your allies to protect themselves more effectively.

spells.name: Inspire Heroics

spells.name: Lingering Composition

spells.name: Loremaster's Etude

spells.name: Soothing Ballad
spells.description: You draw upon your muse to soothe your allies.

spells.name: Triple Time
spells.description: You dance at a lively tempo, speeding your allies' movement.

spells.name: Hero's Defiance

spells.name: Lay on Hands

spells.name: Litany Against Wrath

spells.name: Litany of Righteousness

spells.name: Agile Feet

spells.name: Bit of Luck

spells.name: Fire Ray

spells.name: Flame Barrier

spells.name: Glimpse the Truth

spells.name: Hurtling Stone

spells.name: Read Fate

spells.name: Unity

spells.name: Dragon Wings

spells.name: Undeath's Blessing

spells.name: Unusual Anatomy

spells.name: Augment Summoning

spells.name: Call of the Grave
spells.description: You fire a ray of sickening energy.

spells.name: Charming Words
spells.description: You whisper enchanting words to deflect your foe's ire.

spells.name: Dimensional Steps
spells.description: You teleport a short distance.

spells.name: Diviner's Sight
spells.description: You glimpse into the target's future.

spells.name: Dread Aura
spells.description: You emit an aura of terror.

spells.name: Elemental Tempest

spells.name: Energy Absorption

spells.name: Force Bolt
spells.description: You fire an unerring dart of force from your fingertips.

spells.name: Hand of the Apprentice

spells.name: Invisibility Cloak
spells.description: You become invisible.

spells.name: Life Siphon

spells.name: Physical Boost
spells.description: You temporarily improve the target's physique.

spells.name: Protective Ward
spells.description: You emanate a shimmering aura of protective magic.

spells.name: Shifting Form
spells.description: You morph to gain an ability of your choice.

spells.name: Vigilant Eye

spells.name: Warped Terrain

spells.name: Perfect Strike

spells.name: Unblinking Flame Revelation

spells.name: Unbreaking Wave Advance
spells.description: Unleash a blast of water to push back foes.

spells.name: Unfolding Wind Rush

spells.name: Untwisting Iron Buffer

spells.name: Magic Warrior Transformation
spells.description: transform into your totem animal.

spells.name: Exchange Image
spells.description: Trade appearances with the target.

spells.name: Forgotten Lines

spells.name: Imprint Message

spells.name: Join Pasts
spells.description: Share thoughts and experiences with allies.

spells.name: Object Reading

spells.name: Spiritual Anamnesis

spells.name: Silver's Refrain

spells.name: Invoke the Crimson Oath

spells.name: Light of Revelation

spells.name: Sun Blade
spells.description: Launch a bolt of divine sunfire.

spells.name: Apex Companion

spells.name: Song of the Fallen

spells.name: Feast of Ashes

spells.name: Fungal Hyphae

spells.name: Share Lore

spells.name: Shifting Sand

spells.description: You create a beacon in time, intending to return to it if things go wrong.

spells.name: Whirling Scarves
spells.description: You surround yourself in a vortex of whirling colorful scarves of force that obfuscate you and disorient your foes.

spells.name: Adapt Self
spells.description: You make subtle changes to yourself to adapt to the situation.

spells.name: Adaptive Ablation
spells.description: You shift yourself to adapt to the mystical wavelengths of the energy damage, protecting yourself from further harm.

spells.name: Winter Bolt
spells.description: You fling a hollow icicle filled with winter's wrath.

spells.name: Diamond Dust
spells.description: You supercool the nearby air, forming a cloud of dancing ice crystals in an emanation around you.

spells.name: Withering Grasp
spells.description: Your touch rots organic material and decays objects.

spells.name: Fallow Field
spells.description: A sickly yellow light fills the area as entropic forces prevent healing.

spells.name: Hyperfocus
spells.description: You sharpen a creature's senses, though more distant objects become hazy, indistinct, or muted to it.

spells.name: Ephemeral Hazards
spells.description: You create illusory hazards, such as spinning blades or a puddle of acid.

spells.name: Parch
spells.description: Dry winds dehydrate a creature.

spells.name: Dust Storm
spells.description: You call forth a swirling storm of dust.

spells.name: Oathkeeper's Insignia
spells.description: A magical indicator assures a creature that you've upheld your end of a bargain.

spells.name: Dutiful Challenge
spells.description: As you challenge an enemy, you take some of its attention away from your allies.

spells.name: Redact
spells.description: You strike mention of a specific name from one or more documents.

spells.name: Ghostly Transcription
spells.description: Glowing letters assemble in the air, providing a transcription of the target's speech in all languages you speak.

spells.name: Charged Javelin
spells.description: You fire a javelin of electricity that leaves a charged field around its target.

spells.name: Bottle the Storm
spells.description: When lightning is turned at you, you store the charge safely within yourself, unleashing it when the time is right.

spells.name: Divine Plagues
spells.description: Your deity sends wracking plagues.

spells.name: Foul Miasma
spells.description: You multiply the disease within a creature, drawing it into an infectious mist outside their body where it can spread to other creatures.

spells.name: Share Burden
spells.description: You shoulder some of your ally's pain.

spells.name: Font of Serenity
spells.description: A divine beacon radiates serenity, soothing nearby allies.

spells.name: Lament
spells.description: You let out your negative emotions in a guttural wail that shakes your enemies' hearts.

spells.name: Overflowing Sorrow
spells.description: Sadness flows out of you into nearby creatures, blotting out any other thoughts they had.

spells.name: Eject Soul
spells.description: Your touch disrupts the connection between body and soul, possibly forcing the soul out of the body altogether.

spells.name: Ectoplasmic Interstice
spells.description: You force the Material and Ethereal Planes to partially overlap, creating a zone that causes incorporeal and spiritual entities to take on many of the aspects of corporeal creatures.

spells.name: Zenith Star
spells.description: You call a tiny star to orbit a creature in a sparkling halo before shooting up into the heavens, where it marks the creature's rough location.

spells.name: Asterism
spells.description: Lines of burning starlight form a constellation around you.

spells.name: Swarmsense
spells.description: You extend your senses through a multitude of crawling and flying creatures.

spells.name: Swarm Form
spells.description: You discorporate into a swarm of Tiny creatures.

spells.name: Delay Consequence
spells.description: You transpose the moment that the target would be injured to later in its timestream.

spells.name: Stasis
spells.description: The flow of time congeals around an object or creature, holding it in place.

spells.name: Object Memory
spells.description: By touching an object, you draw forth the experience of those who created and used it.

spells.name: Remember the Lost
spells.description: You call upon the lost and forgotten, assailing your foes' minds with the memories of those who died with a grievance toward them.

spells.name: Empty Inside
spells.description: You inject a sliver of the void into your mind, momentarily remaking it into a bleak and empty place.

spells.name: Door to Beyond
spells.description: Striking at thin air, you create hairline cracks in an unoccupied adjacent space that lead somewhere outside reality.

spells.name: Draconic Barrage
spells.description: You shape energy into one incorporeal tiny dragon that flits around you.

spells.name: Roar of the Wyrm
spells.description: You channel the might of dragons into your voice, letting out a roar that engenders respect in dragonkind but that instills fear in most other creatures.

spells.name: Breath of Drought
spells.description: You fill the area with an oppressive, arid swelter that overwhelms creatures with heat exhaustion.

spells.name: Personal Rain Cloud
spells.description: You conjure a 5-foot-wide rain cloud that follows the target wherever it goes.

spells.name: Rime Slick
spells.description: You call down a chill wind.

spells.name: Scouring Sand
spells.description: You blast the area with grit that scours away soil and gets into creatures' eyes.

spells.name: Sea Surge
spells.description: You slap or stomp on a nearby solid or liquid surface, sending a surge of water rushing away from you.

spells.name: Sudden Bolt
spells.description: You call down a small bolt of lightning on the target

spells.name: Unseasonable Squall
spells.description: You issue a blast of sudden wind that ripples outward from the center of the burst.

spells.name: Verdant Sprout
spells.description: You imbue a single ordinary, inexpensive plant seed with primal energy and throw it onto a surface, where it gradually sprouts into a Medium plant.

spells.name: Clownish Curse
spells.description: You afflict the target with a curse that causes it to emit ridiculous noises as it moves.

spells.name: Favorable Review
spells.description: You enchant a creature to ensure they have only good things to say about your show.

spells.name: Pyrotechnics
spells.description: You turn a fire into either a burst of blinding fireworks or a thick cloud of choking smoke

spells.name: Pillar of Water
spells.description: You create a large, self-contained cylinder of still fresh water

spells.name: Ravening Maw
spells.description: You evoke Zevgavizeb's unceasing hunger and inflict it upon your target.

spells.name: Blood Feast
spells.description: Your head splits vertically into an enormous maw, which feasts upon the target's blood.

spells.name: Entrancing Eyes
spells.description: Your eyes glow with an entrancing radiance that captivates those who meet your gaze.

spells.name: Necrotic Radiation
spells.description: You imbue the touched object or space with slow-acting necrotic radiation.

spells.name: Blightburn Blast
spells.description: Inflict a creature with blightburn sickness.

spells.name: Control Sand
spells.description: Manipulate sand around you.

spells.name: Pillars of Sand
spells.description: Create pillars of sand.

spells.name: Touch of Corruption
spells.description: The antipaladin infuses the target with negative energy.

spells.name: Astral Labyrinth
spells.description: You connect the entire area with an invisible maze of astral energy that interferes with dimensional and mental magic.

spells.name: Deluge
spells.description: You unleash a catastrophic downpour in the area that vanishes an instant later.

spells.name: Devour Life
spells.description: You attempt to utterly consume the target's life force.

spells.name: Prying Survey
spells.description: You create eight invisible, floating eyes, each about 3 inches in diameter, that scan the area around you, transmitting rough impressions of the environment.

spells.name: Undermine Reality
spells.description: You lash a target with tendrils of shadow that steal some of its substance, making it quasi-real.

spells.name: Upheaval
spells.description: The ground in the area shudders and crumbles as huge pillars of stone erupt into the air, rending the terrain around them.

spells.name: Beastmaster Trance
spells.description: You enter a magical trance that allows you to perceive through the senses of the target companion.

spells.name: Dance of Darkness
spells.description: You dance, Striding up to half your Speed.

spells.name: Shadow Illusion
spells.description: You create a shadowy illusion of a creature or a stationary object, but the illusion can exist only in an area of dim light or darkness.

spells.name: Shadow Jump
spells.description: You instantly transport yourself from one shadow to another.

spells.name: Agonizing Despair
spells.description: Mentally damage and frighten a creature.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.description: Animate an undead creature to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Animate Rope
spells.description: Command a rope to move and tie as you wish.

spells.name: Animated Assault
spells.description: Temporarily animate small objects to attack creatures in an area.

spells.name: Aqueous Orb
spells.description: Roll a ball of water to put out fires and engulf creatures.

spells.name: Bestial Curse
spells.description: Make a humanoid take on features of a beast.

spells.name: Blanket of Stars
spells.description: A cloak of darkness hides you in the dark and dazzles those who get too close.

spells.name: Blinding Fury
spells.description: Curse a creature that attacks you, making its victims become invisible to it.

spells.name: Blister
spells.description: Grow large blisters on a creature and pop them to spray acid.

spells.name: Blistering Invective
spells.description: Light a creature on fire with the sheer viciousness of your words.

spells.name: Blood Vendetta
spells.description: Cause a creature that attacks you to start bleeding.

spells.name: Chameleon Coat
spells.description: Camouflage creatures to match their environment.

spells.name: Charitable Urge
spells.description: Make a creature give away an object in its possession.

spells.name: Chroma Leach
spells.description: Sap the color and vitality from a living creature.

spells.name: Countless Eyes
spells.description: Cause magical eyes to appear all over a creature's body.

spells.name: Cozy Cabin
spells.description: Conjure a temporary cabin sheltered from the elements.

spells.name: Crashing Wave
spells.description: Smash a cone of water against foes.

spells.name: Curse of Lost Time
spells.description: Artificially erode or age a target.

spells.name: Déjà Vu
spells.description: Make a creature do the same thing again.

spells.name: Dismantle
spells.description: Temporarily disassemble an object into its components.

spells.name: Dull Ambition
spells.description: Curse a creature with an unfortunate lack of ambition.

spells.name: Enervation
spells.description: Drain a creature's vigor.

spells.name: Familiar's Face
spells.description: Implant your senses in your animal companion or familiar.

spells.name: Final Sacrifice
spells.description: Channel energy to blow up your minion.

spells.name: Force Cage
spells.description: Form a prison of pure magical force.

spells.name: Fungal Infestation
spells.description: Plant poisonous fungal growths in a creature.

spells.name: Ghostly Tragedy
spells.description: Have spirits reenact a violent event.

spells.name: Grisly Growths
spells.description: A creature grows excess limbs and organs, sickening those who witness the transformation.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.description: Make metal red hot.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.description: Call a storm cloud that pelts creatures with hail.

spells.name: Impaling Spike
spells.description: Skewer a creature with a cold iron spike.

spells.name: Indestructibility
spells.description: Become briefly immune to everything.

spells.name: Invisible Item
spells.description: Make an item disappear from view.

spells.name: Lightning Storm
spells.description: Create clouds and repeatedly call down lightning bolts.

spells.name: Mad Monkeys
spells.description: Monkey spirits make mischief.

spells.name: Magic Stone
spells.description: Make ordinary stones into magical sling bullets that are especially dangerous to undead.

spells.name: Noxious Vapors
spells.description: Form a toxic cloud that poisons and sickens.

spells.name: Pet Cache
spells.description: Hide a familiar or animal companion in a pocket dimension.

spells.name: Phantasmal Treasure
spells.description: Tempt a creature with an illusory reward.

spells.name: Pummeling Rubble
spells.description: Hurl a cone of rocks to batter creatures.

spells.name: Quench
spells.description: Put out fires and hurt fire creatures.

spells.name: Reaper's Lantern
spells.description: A ghostly lantern diminishes healing for the living and weakens undead.

spells.name: Rusting Grasp
spells.description: Rapidly rust metal.

spells.name: Safe Passage
spells.description: Make an area safe to move through.

spells.name: Scintillating Safeguard
spells.description: Reactively protect multiple creatures from harm with a magic barrier.

spells.name: Sculpt Sound
spells.description: Quiet or alter the sound from a creature or object.

spells.name: Seal Fate
spells.description: Curse a creature to be harmed by a certain type of damage.

spells.name: Secret Chest
spells.description: Hide a container on the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Spike Stones
spells.description: Grow sharp spikes out of the ground.

spells.name: Spirit Sense
spells.description: Find spirits and haunts.

spells.name: Strange Geometry
spells.description: Confoundingly warp spatial geometry, making passage difficult and destinations unpredictable.

spells.name: Sudden Blight
spells.description: Decay living creatures and plants.

spells.name: Summon Instrument
spells.description: Conjure a musical instrument.

spells.name: Thoughtful Gift
spells.description: Teleport an item to an ally's grasp.

spells.name: Threefold Aspect
spells.description: Switch between versions of yourself at different ages.

spells.name: Transmute Rock and Mud
spells.description: Turn an area of rock into mud or vice versa.

spells.name: Vampiric Maiden
spells.description: A ghostly iron maiden harms a creature and transfers its vitality to you.

spells.name: Vomit Swarm
spells.description: Vermin erupt in a cone from your mouth, biting and stinging creatures.

spells.name: Wall of Flesh
spells.description: Spawn a wall of living flesh.

spells.name: Hymn of Healing
spells.description: Your divine singing mends wounds and provides a temporary respite from harm.

spells.name: Ode to Ouroboros
spells.description: Your ode temporarily staves off death.

spells.name: Pied Piping
spells.description: Your performance enraptures those who hear it, compelling them to follow you about in admiration.

spells.name: Song of Marching
spells.description: You maintain a brisk performance that keeps allies on the move.

spells.name: Song of Strength
spells.description: You bolster your allies' physical strength with a hearty exhortation.

spells.name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart
spells.description: Your symphony lifts listeners from their worldly concerns.

spells.name: Litany of Depravity
spells.description: Your litany calls into question the morals your foe claims to hold dear.

spells.name: Litany of Self-Interest
spells.description: You give a speech that fills your target with a drive to improve themself to the exclusion of assisting others.

spells.name: Clinging Shadows Stance
spells.description: You adopt the stance of clinging shadows.

spells.name: Ki Form
spells.description: Drawing from deep wells of spiritual power, you take on a special ki form.

spells.name: Medusa's Wrath
spells.description: You make an attack filled with a medusa's petrifying power.

spells.name: Shadow's Web
spells.description: Grasping darkness surges from you, dealing 14d4 negative damage.

spells.name: Access Lore
spells.description: You sift through the multiverse's divine knowledge, seeking out tidbits related to a particular subject.

spells.name: Ancestral Defense
spells.description: Your ancestor protects you against those who would bend your will.

spells.name: Ancestral Form
spells.description: You take the form of your ancestral spirits, becoming invisible and quasi-corporeal.

spells.name: Ancestral Touch
spells.description: You touch a creature and force them to see and feel the ancestors surrounding you.

spells.name: Armor of Bones
spells.description: You ossify your physical form, mimicking the durability of bone.

spells.name: Battlefield Persistence
spells.description: You're difficult to remove from battle.

spells.name: Brain Drain
spells.description: You probe the target's mind to glean knowledge.

spells.name: Call to Arms
spells.description: You cry out a call to arms, inspiring your allies to enter the fray.

spells.name: Claim Undead
spells.description: You attempt to wrest control of a target undead or force it to recognize you as its master.

spells.name: Debilitating Dichotomy
spells.description: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well.

spells.name: Delay Affliction
spells.description: With a surge of healing energy, you push back against an affliction threatening the target and grant a small amount of healing.

spells.name: Dread Secret
spells.description: You utter a powerful secret at odds with the fundamental nature of the target creatures.

spells.name: Flaming Fusillade
spells.description: You call upon an endless barrage of flames, producing miniature fireballs in your hands to hurl at foes.

spells.name: Heroic Feat
spells.description: You gain the ability to perform a specialized combat technique from the vast wealth of martial knowledge your mystery provides.

spells.name: Incendiary Aura
spells.description: You surround yourself with a combustible aura.

spells.name: Interstellar Void
spells.description: You call upon the frigid depths of outer space to bring a terrible chill to your enemy.

spells.name: Life-Giving Form
spells.description: You transcend your physical form, becoming a beacon of healing energy.

spells.name: Life Link
spells.description: You forge a connection of life energy between you and your target, distributing harm between both of you.

spells.name: Moonlight Bridge
spells.description: You summon a bridge of radiant, shimmering moonlight.

spells.name: Soul Siphon
spells.description: You siphon off a portion of the target's soul to bolster your own vitality.

spells.name: Spray of Stars
spells.description: You fling a spray of tiny shooting stars, dealing 1d4 fire damage.

spells.name: Tempest Form
spells.description: Your body becomes fluid to better suit your surroundings.

spells.name: Tempest Touch
spells.description: Your touch calls forth a churning mass of icy water that clings to your target, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage and 1d4 cold damage.

spells.name: Thunderburst
spells.description: You create a powerful blast of air and a loud peal of thunder, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage and 2d6 sonic damage.

spells.name: Vision of Weakness
spells.description: You focus your gaze on a creature and gain a flash of divine insight into its nature.

spells.name: Whirling Flames
spells.description: You call forth a storm of whirling flames, engulfing all creatures in that area and dealing 5d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.

spells.name: Animal Feature
spells.description: Without fully transforming your body, you gain one animalistic feature, which you select from the list below each time you Cast the Spell.

spells.name: Enlarge Companion
spells.description: Your animal companion grows much larger, towering over its foes in battle.

spells.name: Ephemeral Tracking
spells.description: You can look at currents in the air and water and see tracks that you can follow just as you would on land.

spells.name: Gravity Weapon
spells.description: You build up gravitational force and funnel it into your blows, leading to more powerful attacks with blade and bow alike.

spells.name: Heal Companion
spells.description: You harness positive energy to heal your animal companion's wounds.

spells.name: Hunter's Luck
spells.description: You have a preternatural ability to remember details about your foes.

spells.name: Hunter's Vision
spells.description: Your target glows with a magical aura visible only to you and those who follow your lead.

spells.name: Magic Hide
spells.description: Your animal companion grows a thicker hide, matted fur, or a harder shell, granting it a +1 status bonus to AC.

spells.name: Ranger's Bramble
spells.description: You cause plants in the area to entangle your foes, with the effects of entangle .

spells.name: Snare Hopping
spells.description: You may not have placed your snare in the right place, but you can magically move it there.

spells.name: Soothing Mist
spells.description: You call forth a magical mist of positive energy that envelops a creature.

spells.name: Terrain Transposition
spells.description: You mystically transpose your current location with another.

spells.name: Blinding Beauty
spells.description: You channel the allure of your nymph bloodline into a terribly beautiful glance.

spells.name: Consuming Darkness
spells.description: Your shadow wriggles before spreading out from you, forming a gateway of clinging, consuming shadow through which the horrors of another plane can barely be seen.

spells.name: Dim the Light
spells.description: You magnify the darkness from the triggering effect, causing the ambient light level to flicker briefly so you can slip from sight.

spells.name: Establish Ward
spells.description: You bind a part of your essence to your surroundings, creating a warded area that grants you power within it, but drains you outside of it.

spells.name: Genie's Veil
spells.description: With a flourish, you fulfill a creature's wish for protection, bending reality to keep them from harm.

spells.name: Heart's Desire
spells.description: You surround your target with wondrous illusions of their greatest desires, which distract them from reality.

spells.name: Nymph's Token
spells.description: You grant an ally a token of favor.

spells.name: Sepulchral Mask
spells.description: You manifest a supernatural funerary mask, granting you a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws against emotion effects for 1 minute.

spells.name: Shepherd of Souls
spells.description: You stay the hand of fate for one not yet destined to die, sacrificing some of your own vitality to heal them.

spells.name: Spirit Veil
spells.description: You draw an occluding veil of spirits around yourself, blocking yourself especially well from undead eyes.

spells.name: Steal Shadow
spells.description: You steal a creature's shadow, leaving it weakened and vulnerable.

spells.name: Wish-Twisted Form
spells.description: You focus your magic upon an enemy, wishing for their defenses to fail and turning their strengths into weaknesses.

spells.name: Blood Ward
spells.description: You consolidate warding energies with a gesture, guarding a creature against attacks from a certain type of foe.

spells.name: Cackle
spells.description: With a quick burst of laughter, you prolong a magical effect you created.

spells.name: Clinging Ice
spells.description: Freezing sleet and heavy snowfall collect on the target's feet and legs, dealing 1d4 cold damage and other effects depending on its Reflex save.

spells.name: Curse of Death
spells.description: You focus your malevolent gaze on a target, causing their heart to seize in dread.

spells.name: Deceiver's Cloak
spells.description: You wrap yourself in a cloak of illusion, appearing as another creature of the same body shape with roughly similar height and weight as yourself.

spells.name: Discern Secrets
spells.description: You call upon your patron's power to better uncover secrets.

spells.name: Elemental Betrayal
spells.description: You call upon the elements to undermine your foe.

spells.name: Evil Eye
spells.description: Your fix your eye on the target, imposing a malevolent hex.

spells.name: Life Boost
spells.description: You temporarily bolster the target's vitality.

spells.name: Malicious Shadow
spells.description: You reshape the target's shadow into a deadly form, such as strangling hands, a dangerous weapon, harrying runes, or the like, and command it to attack the target.

spells.name: Needle of Vengeance
spells.description: A long, jagged needle jabs into the target foe's psyche whenever it tries to attack a specifically forbidden creature.

spells.name: Nudge Fate
spells.description: You read slightly into the future and give fate a tiny push to achieve the result you desire.

spells.name: Personal Blizzard
spells.description: You summon an isolated blizzard of obscuring, scouring ice to follow your target.

spells.name: Phase Familiar
spells.description: You draw upon your patron's power to momentarily shift your familiar from its solid, physical form into an ephemeral version of itself shaped of mist.

spells.name: Restorative Moment
spells.description: You manipulate the threads of time around the target, giving them some of the benefits of a day's passage.

spells.name: Shroud of Night
spells.description: Drawing your hand in a sweeping gesture, you shroud the target in a veil of night.

spells.name: Stoke the Heart
spells.description: Intense fervor fills the target creature, empowering their blows.

spells.name: Veil of Dreams
spells.description: You draw the target into a drowsy state, causing daydreams and sluggishness.

spells.name: Wilding Word
spells.description: With a few words, you convince a wild creature you are a kindred spirit, making it reluctant to harm you.

spells.name: Spirit Object
spells.description: Using a sliver of Baba Yaga's power, you briefly bring an object to life.

spells.name: Glacial Heart
spells.description: Ice and bone-deep cold assail the target, freezing it from the inside out.

spells.name: Aromatic Lure
spells.description: You override a target's olfactory senses, luring them to a specific location through tantalizing false scents.

spells.name: Rebounding Barrier
spells.description: You swiftly raise a reflective barrier, reducing physical damage and rebounding it onto your attacker.

spells.name: Achaekek's Clutch
spells.description: You mark the holy symbol of Achaekek in a visible location on the target's body.

spells.name: All is One, One is All
spells.description: You meld the targets' matter and life force into one and then, in an instant, sift them back out into their component selves.

spells.name: Halcyon Infusion
spells.description: You infuse magical energy into your target, opening up their mind to the pathways of magic and granting them the ability to use magic to affect the world around them.

spells.name: Shall Not Falter, Shall Not Rout
spells.description: Calling out the fifth line of the Crimson Oath, you seal your most grievous injuries with a stroke of your blade.

spells.name: Sun's Fury
spells.description: The target weapon becomes wreathed in a glowing flame.

spells.name: Admonishing Ray
spells.description: A ray of energy bludgeons your target into submission without causing lasting harm.

spells.name: Magical Fetters
spells.description: Ghostly manacles launch from your outstretched hand and clasp around the target's limbs, impeding its movements.

spells.name: Maze of Locked Doors
spells.description: The target of your spell is drawn into a long, twisting, extradimensional hallway.

spells.name: Putrefy Food and Drink
spells.description: You cause otherwise edible food to rot and spoil instantly, and water and other liquids to become brackish and undrinkable.

spells.name: Speaking Sky
spells.description: The air speaks to you.

spells.name: Steal the Sky
spells.description: You deny a flying creature the support of the air.

spells.name: Imp Sting
spells.description: You reproduce an imp's evil, poisonous sting, stabbing at an enemy and possibly affecting them with the devil's benumbing venom.

spells.name: Leng Sting
spells.description: You use the power of nightmares to magically replicate the venomous attack of the aberrant and cunning Leng spiders.

spells.name: Linnorm Sting
spells.description: You replicate the fiery venom of the tor linnorm and inflict an enemy with the dread dragon's debilitating bite.

spells.name: Swarming Wasp Stings
spells.description: You manifest a swarm of disembodied wasp stingers that stab creatures in the area, possibly poisoning them.

spells.name: Wyvern Sting
spells.description: You duplicate the venomous sting of a wyvern.

spells.name: Transcribe Moment
spells.description: You instantly create a small, permanent scroll that contains a magically precise written description of your current surroundings in every direction.

spells.name: Familiar Form
spells.description: You transform into a Tiny animal that commonly serves as a spellcaster's familiar.

spells.name: Spellmaster's Ward
spells.description: You create one or more glowing protective runes that revolve around you.

spells.name: Perseis's Precautions
spells.description: Leaving nothing to chance, you weave divinatory precautions against an ambush, alerting the target to danger.

spells.name: Split the Tongue
spells.description: The deceiving creature's tongue splits like a serpent's tongue.

spells.name: Ordained Purpose
spells.description: You call upon the authority of cosmic forces of order, overwhelming creatures with remorse and agony for acting outside of their station and purpose.

spells.name: Divinity Leech
spells.description: You disrupt the connection between a divine caster or deific servitor and their deity, blocking their use of divine power.

spells.name: Prismatic Shield
spells.description: Shield-sized shards of multicolored light manifest in the air around you, each rotating quickly to intercept attacks.

spells.name: Worm's Repast
spells.description: Gnawing worms materialize within the flesh of the target creature.

spells.name: Daydreamer's Curse
spells.description: You impose a curse upon the target that renders it easily distracted and unable to focus its thoughts on tasks that demand insight or discernment.

spells.name: Sage's Curse
spells.description: You afflict the target with a curse that fills its mind with distracting and hyperspecialized minutiae, causing it to second-guess even simple facts.

spells.name: Lift Nature's Caul
spells.description: With a wave of the hand, you cause the targets to see the world around them as if a gauzy fi lm had been lifted away to expose the truth that lies below their perceived reality.

spells.name: Fearful Feast
spells.description: You open your mouth wide and inhale sharply; you draw in the bravery, self-confidence, and hope to which the frightened target clings and then strip away the target's false assumption that these fragile emotions can save them from the oblivion of terror.

spells.name: Call the Blood
spells.description: With a word and gesture, you cause streams of blood to erupt from the target's mouth, nostrils, ears, or other facial openings and come rushing into your mouth.

spells.name: Ectoplasmic Expulsion
spells.description: You call upon tendrils of ephemeral ectoplasm to pass through the target and carry away a harmful psychic affliction.

spells.name: Aura of the Unremarkable
spells.description: You and allies in the area appear to be completely innocuous to other creatures within the spell's area, regardless of the actions you're committing.

spells.name: Return Beacon
spells.description: You create a unique planar beacon somewhere within the spell's range that remains in place.

spells.name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
spells.description: You unleash your ki as a powerful storm of force and lightning.

spells.name: Rejuvenating Flames
spells.description: You create a gout of flame that both heals and burns.

spells.name: Shroud of Flame
spells.description: You encircle yourself in an aura of protective flames.

spells.name: Cleansing Flames
spells.description: You wrap the target in purifying flames.

spells.name: Internal Insurrection
spells.description: You afflict the target with the supernatural disease known as internal insurrection, causing portions of their body to rebel against the whole, leading to painful agonies and, in time, death.

spells.name: Stumbling Curse
spells.description: With a twist of a finger, you send a creature careening on a haphazard trajectory.

spells.name: Verminous Lure
spells.description: Upon casting, the target emits a musk that's captivating to certain animals.

spells.name: Impeccable Flow
spells.description: You attune yourself to an underlying cosmic order to the world.

spells.name: Airburst
spells.description: A blast of wind wildly pushes everything nearby.

spells.name: Grave Impressions
spells.description: You project a fragment of your senses into the corpse.

spells.name: Mind Games
spells.description: You lock minds with the target, trying to mentally subdue them.

spells.name: Friendfetch
spells.description: You shoot out ephemeral, telekinetic strands that drag each target directly toward you, stopping in the closest unoccupied space to you in this path.

spells.name: Aberrant Form
spells.description: Transform into an aberration battle form.

spells.name: Angel Form
spells.description: Transform into an angel battle form.

spells.name: Animal Allies
spells.description: Summon animals to briefly attack adjacent foes.

spells.name: Approximate
spells.description: Magically estimate the number of nearby objects.

spells.name: Ash Cloud
spells.description: Summon a cloud of hot ash and smoke.

spells.name: Bandit's Doom
spells.description: Set up a ward to protect an item.

spells.name: Befitting Attire
spells.description: Make clothes fit the occasion.

spells.name: Biting Words
spells.description: Hurl sonic taunts to hurt creatures.

spells.name: Blazing Dive
spells.description: Fly up, then dive in an explosion of superheated air.

spells.name: Blazing Fissure
spells.description: Rip a crack of magma in the earth.

spells.name: Blessing of Defiance
spells.description: Boost one of an ally's defenses.

spells.name: Blink Charge
spells.description: Teleport and attack with magical force.

spells.name: Bloodspray Curse
spells.description: Curse a foe with deeper wounds and bleeding.

spells.name: Boil Blood
spells.description: Boil a foe's blood.

spells.name: Bottomless Stomach
spells.description: Store things in a creature's stomach.

spells.name: Breadcrumbs
spells.description: Make a trail behind a creature.

spells.name: Bullhorn
spells.description: Magnify your voice to be heard at a distance.

spells.name: Burning Blossoms
spells.description: A tree fascinates enemies and burns creatures that stay beneath it.

spells.name: Canticle of Everlasting Grief
spells.description: Mournful dirge frightens and mentally damages a foe, preventing its bonuses.

spells.name: Cast into Time
spells.description: Make a creature fall through time, damaging and sickening it.

spells.name: Chromatic Armor
spells.description: Glowing armor sheds light, dazzling foes and granting random resistances.

spells.name: Chromatic Image
spells.description: Colorful mirror images damage foes who destroy them.

spells.name: Chromatic Ray
spells.description: Ray of light causes effects based on its color.

spells.name: Claim Curse
spells.description: Draw a creature's curse into you temporarily.

spells.name: Clone Companion
spells.description: Create a duplicate animal companion that mirrors your companion's actions.

spells.name: Concordant Choir
spells.description: Damage foes with music.

spells.name: Coral Eruption
spells.description: Create damaging areas of razor-sharp coral.

spells.name: Corrosive Body
spells.description: Turn your body into living acid.

spells.name: Cosmic Form
spells.description: Turn into a battle form based on the sun or moon.

spells.name: Daemon Form
spells.description: Turn into a daemon battle form.

spells.name: Day's Weight
spells.description: Use time magic to fatigue a creature.

spells.name: Deity's Strike
spells.description: Enormous deific weapon falls onto a foe from the sky.

spells.name: Demon Form
spells.description: Turn into a demon battle form.

spells.name: Devil Form
spells.description: Turn into a devil battle form.

spells.name: Distracting Chatter
spells.description: Distract a creature with auditory illusions.

spells.name: Divine Armageddon
spells.description: Call on your deity to bring about a cataclysm.

spells.name: Draw Ire
spells.description: Mentally sting a creature's mind to make it less capable of attacking creatures other than you.

spells.name: Draw the Lightning
spells.description: Call down lightning into you or a weapon.

spells.name: Echoing Weapon
spells.description: Your attacks build up to release a sonic pulse.

spells.name: Element Embodied
spells.description: Turn into a massive elemental.

spells.name: Elemental Absorption
spells.description: Resist elemental effects and then release the energy against a foe.

spells.name: Elemental Annihilation Wave
spells.description: Draw in elemental energy to unleash a cone of burning destruction.

spells.name: Elemental Confluence
spells.description: Summon a confluence of elementals of all four elements.

spells.name: Elemental Gift
spells.description: Infuse an ally with one of the four elements.

spells.name: Elemental Zone
spells.description: Make one element more damaging within a zone.

spells.name: Envenom Companion
spells.description: Make your companion's attacks toxic.

spells.name: Extract Poison
spells.description: Draw out poison from an object and make your next attack poisonous.

spells.name: Fated Confrontation
spells.description: Isolate two fated opponents and let them twist each other's fate.

spells.name: Feral Shades
spells.description: A cone of hound-shaped shades tear creatures apart.

spells.name: Fey Form
spells.description: Turn into a fey battle form.

spells.name: Flame Vortex
spells.description: Invoke a moving tornado of fire and wind.

spells.name: Flame Wisp
spells.description: Fire wisps damage those you strike, and more grow if you cast fire spells.

spells.name: Flammable Fumes
spells.description: Conjure poisonous fumes that can explode in flame.

spells.name: Flowing Strike
spells.description: Flow on a wave and attack on the way.

spells.name: Forceful Hand
spells.description: Create a hand of force that can interpose to defend you or attack if heightened.

spells.name: Frigid Flurry
spells.description: Turn into slashing snowflakes and fly in a straight line.

spells.name: Gale Blast
spells.description: Damage and push adjacent creatures with air.

spells.name: Geyser
spells.description: Blast foes upward with superheated water, causing them to fall and leaving concealing fog.

spells.name: Glimmer of Charm
spells.description: Briefly improve the attitude of nearby creatures with a charming aura.

spells.name: Gouging Claw
spells.description: Morph your limb into a claw and attack with it.

spells.name: Gravitational Pull
spells.description: Pull one or more creatures towards you using gravity.

spells.name: Guiding Star
spells.description: Constellations nudge the target to travel to a location you choose.

spells.name: Haunting Hymn
spells.description: A powerful hymn harms and deafens.

spells.name: Healing Plaster
spells.description: Transform mud into a healing plaster to treat wounds without healer's tools.

spells.name: Healing Well
spells.description: Create a well that you and your allies can use to heal.

spells.name: Horizon Thunder Sphere
spells.description: Gather energy and throw a ball of lightning.

spells.name: Ignite Fireworks
spells.description: Throw exploding fireworks.

spells.name: Impending Doom
spells.description: Make a foe witness its potential death and become distressed.

spells.name: Inevitable Disaster
spells.description: Twist fate to damage a foe in the near future.

spells.name: Inexhaustible Cynicism
spells.description: Make creatures paranoid and cynical.

spells.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
spells.description: Encourage yourself and an ally to improve one roll apiece.

spells.name: Infectious Melody
spells.description: An infectious tune makes creatures sing along.

spells.name: Inner Radiance Torrent
spells.description: Gather spiritual energy to fire a storm of force bolts and beams.

spells.name: Instant Armor
spells.description: Set a contingency to return your armor to you.

spells.name: Invisibility Curtain
spells.description: Wall makes creatures on one side invisible to the other side.

spells.name: Invoke Spirits
spells.description: Call a group of ghostly apparitions to attack your foes.

spells.name: Juvenile Companion
spells.description: Turn your companion into its juvenile form.

spells.name: Life Connection
spells.description: Set a contingency to take damage for an ally.

spells.name: Lose the Path
spells.description: React to impede and possibly divert a Stride.

spells.name: Lucky Number
spells.description: Set a contingency to reroll a specific, randomly chosen d20 result.

spells.name: Magic Mailbox
spells.description: Interdimensionally link two containers.

spells.name: Magnetic Acceleration
spells.description: Magnetically launch an item to attack a foe.

spells.name: Magnetic Attraction
spells.description: Pull items with magnetism, even disarming metal weapons.

spells.name: Magnetic Repulsion
spells.description: Push metal away, defending against metal weapons and armored foes.

spells.name: Mantle of the Frozen Heart
spells.description: Morph your body with ice, which you can change during the spell.

spells.name: Mantle of the Magma Heart
spells.description: Morph yourself with fire, which you can change during the spell.

spells.name: Mimic Undead
spells.description: Pretend to be undead.

spells.name: Mind of Menace
spells.description: Set a contingency to punish a foe's mental effect and protect yourself from it.

spells.name: Mirror Malefactors
spells.description: Mirrors surround a target, and the reflections attack them repeatedly.

spells.name: Mirror's Misfortune
spells.description: Split into two copies. Destroying the fake curses the attacker.

spells.name: Mud Pit
spells.description: Conjure mud to slow movement.

spells.name: Murderous Vine
spells.description: Grab a creature with a vine.

spells.name: Nature's Reprisal
spells.description: Anger plant life to slow and damage creatures.

spells.name: Necromancer's Generosity
spells.description: Heal your undead minion and protect it from positive energy.

spells.name: Necrotize
spells.description: Necrotize a foe's body, harming and randomly debilitating them.

spells.name: Nudge the Odds
spells.description: Cheat at gambling.

spells.name: Nullify
spells.description: React to automatically counteract a spell and take backlash damage.
