spells.description: You emit a plaintive cry to lure your enemies closer.

spells.name: Primal Chorus
spells.description: You let loose a primal howl that incites animals and beasts to join in the chorus.

spells.name: Sacred Beasts
spells.description: You call out to the creatures of the wild favored by your deity.

spells.name: Snake Fangs
spells.description: Your jaw unhinges as your teeth extend into wicked fangs.

spells.name: Summon Stampede
spells.description: You summon an unstoppable stampede of panicking beasts.

spells.name: Summon Warden of the Wild
spells.description: You briefly call forth the spirit of one of the Wardens of the Wild, the legendary guardians of nature.

spells.name: Anointed Ground
spells.description: Create a 24-hour area of protection against aberrations, celestials, dragons, fiends, monitors, or undead.

spells.name: Carryall
spells.description: A floating platform follows you, carrying objects.

spells.name: Confusing Colors
spells.description: Dazzle, confuse, or stun creatures in a cloud.

spells.name: Containment
spells.description: Seal a creature in a sphere to contain or protect it.

spells.name: Corrosive Muck
spells.description: Create two puddles of acidic slime.

spells.name: Familiar’s Face
spells.description: Implant your senses and voice in your companion.

spells.name: Imaginary Lockbox
spells.description: Hide items in a mental compartment.

spells.name: Leaden Steps
spells.description: Make creatures heavy and weak to electricity.

spells.name: Lifewood Cage
spells.description: Trap a creature in a wooden cage.

spells.name: Live Wire
spells.description: Slash and shock a creature with an electrified filament.

spells.name: Nature’s Enmity
spells.description: Turn animals, plants, and weather against foes.

spells.name: Reaper’s Lantern
spells.description: A ghostly lantern diminishes healing for the living and weakens the undead.

spells.name: Sacred Form
spells.description: Transform into a battle form with sacred armaments.

spells.name: Shared Invisibility
spells.description: You and nearby creatures become invisible.

spells.name: Spell Riposte
spells.description: Reflect a spell targeted at you.

spells.name: Wanderer’s Guide
spells.description: Find an ideal route to a location.

spells.name: Whispers of the Void
spells.description: Drain creatures' vigor with void energy.

spells.name: Touch of the Void
spells.description: You infuse the target with void energy, healing undead or damaging a living creature.

spells.name: Shields of the Spirit
spells.description: You Raise your Shield, causing ephemeral spirit shields to float within your champion's aura.

spells.name: Spectral Advance
spells.description: Taking on a spiritual form, you flash across the battlefield to engage an enemy.

spells.name: Inner Upheaval
spells.description: You focus your qi into devastating magical attacks.

spells.name: Qi Rush
spells.description: Accelerated by your qi, you move with such speed you become a blur.

spells.name: Qi Blast
spells.description: You unleash your qi as a powerful blast that deals 2d6 force damage.

spells.name: Shrink the Span
spells.description: The world seems to shrink before your footfalls.

spells.name: Touch of Death
spells.description: Make a melee unarmed Strike.

spells.name: Embrace Nothingness
spells.description: You empty your body of substance, becoming one with nothingness.

spells.name: Qi Form
spells.description: Drawing from deep wells of spiritual power, you take on a special qi form.

spells.name: Harmonize Self
spells.description: You heal yourself in one of the following ways, chosen by you when you cast the spell.

spells.name: Weapon Trance
spells.description: The serenity of violence fills your mind, giving you a heightened sense of knowing exactly where your weapons need to be.

spells.name: Revel in Retribution
spells.description: Time seems to slow for you, allowing you to strike your opponents mid-move.

spells.name: Glutton's Jaws
spells.description: A slavering maw opens beneath a target and tries to take a bite out of them.

spells.name: Chthonian Wrath
spells.description: You evoke the energy of a part of the Outer Rifts.

spells.name: Flurry of Claws
spells.description: Vicious dragon claws appear and slash at two nearby foes.

spells.name: Extend Blood Magic
spells.description: You call upon the arcane energy coursing through your blood to extend the magic it grants.

spells.name: Life's Flowing River
spells.description: You create a volume of faint shimmering light that resembles a flowing river.

spells.name: Bone Flense
spells.description: The target weapon becomes imbued with Achaekek's power

spells.name: Crimson Breath
spells.description: You turn a creature toward you and exhale a blast of crimson mist from your mouth

spells.name: Mantis's Grasp
spells.description: You cause red, ghostly mantis arms to sprout from a nearby surface.

spells.name: Mark of Blood
spells.description: You place a drop of your blood on a weapon and charge it with magic

spells.name: Sawtooth Terrain
spells.description: You cause long, serrated mantis limbs to appear.

spells.name: Debilitating Terror
spells.description: You fill the target's mind with terrifying images to disrupt their combat focus.

spells.name: Shroud of the Mantis
spells.description: You wrap yourself in a crimson cloak that renders you invisible.

spells.name: Luminous Stardust Healing
spells.description: You scatter twinkling sparks from your sentinel weapon, replenishing your allies' fighting spirit and driving out evil.

spells.name: Shining Starlight Attack
spells.description: You brandish your sentinel weapon, summoning the image of your constellation above your head.

spells.name: Home Among Mulberry Leaves
spells.description: Qi-formed threads unravel from your fabric on conjured needles as your attack makes contact with an enemy and wraps it in place like an insect in its cocoon.

spells.name: Sky Laughs at Waves
spells.description: You soar and leave the world's squabbles behind before your violent intentions ground you once more.

spells.name: Traveling Workshop
spells.description: Your apparition guides you through complex procedures while using your magic to provide you with whatever tools you need.

spells.name: Store Time
spells.description: You store time for later use.

spells.name: Discomfiting Whisper
spells.description: You are surrounded by an aura of spiteful murmurings that incite bad luck and punish failure.

spells.name: Devouring Dark Form
spells.description: Your apparition's dark power blends with your physical body, allowing you to take on terrifying characteristics of creatures that lurk in dark places.

spells.name: Nymph's Grace
spells.description: Your apparition manifests as a mask of unearthly beauty that bewilders your enemies.

spells.name: Trickster's Mirrors
spells.description: You are surrounded by up to 3 mirrors that reflect twisted and distorted images of you, making it hard to tell where you actually are within your space and potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the mirrors instead.

spells.name: Darkened Forest Form
spells.description: Your apparition casts a feral shadow over your form.

spells.name: Earth's Bile
spells.description: Your apparition is the will of lava and magma made manifest, the earth's molten blood unleashing devastating bursts of liquid stone and unquenchable fire at your command.

spells.name: River Carving Mountains
spells.description: Your apparition solidifies around you into roaring water and spraying mist.

spells.name: Embodiment of Battle
spells.description: Your apparition guides your attacks and imparts its skill to your movements.

spells.name: Manifest Will
spells.description: You unleash energy from the broken connection to your patron.

spells.name: Vindicator's Mark
spells.description: You launch a magical dart at your hunted prey, which marks them with a nimbus only you can detect.

spells.name: Vindicator's Judgement
spells.description: You pronounce a terrible judgment upon your quarry that causes all of your attacks and divine spells to strike with deadly efficacy.

spells.name: Spellsurge
spells.description: Magic surges to life around you, feeding on the raw power you radiate.

spells.name: Arcane Explosion
spells.description: Your body is temporarily converted into a ball of pure magic, rapidly exploding outward and reforming as a glowing sphere, after which you eventually regain your normal form.

spells.name: Banishing Touch
spells.description: Your touch projects a surge of magic that launches your target safely away.

spells.name: Beseech Arcanotheign
spells.description: With a whispered prayer or arcane sending, you conjure Arcanotheign, herald of Nethys.

spells.name: Bounty of The Sky
spells.description: You call forth a flock of geese that drop restorative fruits and breads from the sky as they fly overhead.

spells.name: Final Fate of The Locust Host
spells.description: You conjure the rotting corpse of Deskari, previously Lord of the Locust Hosts, to the battlefield.

spells.name: Garden Of The Green Man's Growth
spells.description: You cast your magic into the earth, calling out to a powerful green man, a verdant lesser deity of nature, to come to your aid.

spells.name: It Is Written
spells.description: You envision a future for yourself, confident in the certainty that this vision is your destiny.

spells.name: Part the Mists To Paradise
spells.description: You conjure a pathway to paradise, visible only to you and your allies through a dense cloud of magical mist.

spells.name: Perceive the Threads of Fate
spells.description: You open your mind to the grand design of existence, enabling you to view the threads of fate in all their complex, tangled glory.

spells.name: Rainbow's End
spells.description: You reach upward to wrest down a rainbow and harness its power to connect this world to the heavens.

spells.name: Seize Identity
spells.description: With a gleeful cackle, you seize an individual's voice and swallow it.

spells.name: Summon Oliphaunt Of Jandelay
spells.description: You briefly summon the mythical Oliphaunt of Jandelay, unleashing a manifestation of pure destruction that obliterates everything unfortunate enough to stand in its path.

spells.name: Diadem of Divine Radiance
spells.description: You don a diadem of radiant light, which sheds bright light to a range of 60 feet and dim light to a further 60 feet.

spells.name: Travel by Turtle
spells.description: You conjure an intelligent sea turtle, who agrees to carry you upon its shell on a water journey.

spells.name: Trickster's Feathers
spells.description: You conjure four magic feathers, each with the potential to hold a single illusory guise.

spells.name: Garden of Healing
spells.description: Spirits of comfort and respite swirl around you, trailing visions of growing grass and blooming blossoms.

spells.name: Grasping Vine
spells.description: A thick, curling vine erupts from the ground beneath you and stretches to the target, allowing you to move it around.

spells.name: Unsettling Knowledge
spells.description: You share a piece of hidden knowledge with a creature that is both upsetting and intriguing.

spells.name: Bridge of Vines
spells.description: Vines sprout beneath your feet and extend away from you in a straight line.

spells.name: Mental Map
spells.description: You glean detailed information about a specific place visited by a creature directly from its mind.

spells.name: Overwhelming Memory
spells.description: You cause the target to recall a specific type of memory.

spells.name: Restore Ground
spells.description: You sense that this place yearns to throw off the shackles of civilization.

spells.name: Mimic Spell
spells.description: You learn the secrets of a spell just by watching someone else cast it.

spells.name: Recall Legacy
spells.description: You establish a mental link with the target, focusing on a piece of knowledge important to their culture, family (by birth or choice), or home settlement.

spells.name: Information Overload
spells.description: You call on Cobyslarni to open the target's mind to knowledge—too much knowledge

spells.name: Unravel Knowledge
spells.description: Your patron reaches into the target's mind, plucking out their past training like pulling a thread from a cloth.

spells.name: Censure Falsehoods
spells.description: You call on your patron to reprimand a creature that has attempted a Deception or Stealth check against you.

spells.name: Halcyon Mists
spells.description: In a moment of dire need, you call upon ancestral power to strengthen and sustain.

spells.name: Call the Ten
spells.description: The Ten Magic Warriors were the first of the Magaambya's students, and they come to your aid even now.

spells.name: Domora's Defense
spells.description: When you Cast this Spell, a watery replica of the eidolon Dyzad appears in front of each of the targets.

spells.name: The Four Hunters
spells.description: This is a story of four evenly matched hunters who sought to capture a falling star.

spells.name: Ibex's Harvest
spells.description: In the tale "Ibex's Harvest," Ibex turns from the path of a warrior to the path of a farmer, building up their community by working hard and sharing a bountiful harvest not just with their humanoid neighbors but also with their animal neighbors.

spells.name: Kgalaserke's Axes
spells.description: The folklore and tales surrounding the legendary hero Kgalaserke are so widespread and well known that a hundred lifetimes would not be enough to have accomplished everything she is reputed to have done.

spells.name: The Parrot's Whisper
spells.description: You call forth an echo of the gossiping parrot from the tale of the Witch and the Weave.

spells.name: Ranage's Circle
spells.description: Many stories tell of a clearing deep in the Mwangi jungle, surrounded by ancient cypress trees

spells.name: Turbulent Tide
spells.description: You cause the sheath of water and the improvised weapon it surrounds to surge outward with stupendous force as you attack.

spells.name: Threefold Limb
spells.description: You temporarily transform one of your limbs into water, taking the form of ice, liquid water, or steam as you desire.

spells.name: Unbroken Panoply
spells.description: As tools of violence undone by violence, broken weapons contain potent symbolic magic that faydhaans often call upon when forming alliances.

spells.name: Beseech the Sphinx
spells.description: You look to the great Sphinx constellation, wisest of all cosmic guides and favored of Phimater, asking them to lend their insight to the target.

spells.name: Buzzing Servants
spells.description: You summon a swarm of bees from the city of Axis that rapidly constructs geometric shapes from wax.

spells.name: Coiling Dance
spells.description: You perform a dance that seeks to pass on the knowledge and wisdom of a naga.

spells.name: Disruptive Transfer
spells.description: Using Venorium Blorm's formulas, you calculate a path through space.

spells.name: All-Encompassing Hunger
spells.description: You reach out to devour a life, regardless of whether you need it for sustenance.

spells.name: Crescent Scepter
spells.description: You hold up any object, which takes on the appearance of glowing regalia in the eyes of those who look on you.

spells.name: Cutting Eye
spells.description: Your eyes open enviously, stealing the power of an opponent for yourself.

spells.name: Heart's Hook
spells.description: You drive two creatures toward a fated meeting

spells.name: Precious Gleam
spells.description: You temporarily enhance a weapon, replacing it with finer materials.

spells.name: Reclined Apport
spells.description: Walking over to an item to pick it up is so much effort.

spells.name: Vengeful Glare
spells.description: Your gaze falls on a creature, filled with icy vengeance or fiery wrath

spells.name: Personal Runewell
spells.description: The runelords of Thassilon pioneered the creation of runewells, magical artifacts that could extract and store the power of sin magic from mortal souls.

spells.name: Chrysopoetic Curse
spells.description: You grant the target the gift of riches, giving them the power to turn anything they touch to gold

spells.name: Devouring Void
spells.description: Countless tears in space appear in the area, like hungry mouths.

spells.name: Indolent Haze
spells.description: The faint scent of poppies and a soothing calm fill the area, urging creatures to lay down and take a rest.

spells.name: Love's Sacrifice
spells.description: You cry out for aid, and a creature near you feels compelled to throw itself in front of the threat as the ultimate expression of their love.

spells.name: Thief of Fortune
spells.description: Seeing another creature improve themself with magic, you reach out and seize its benefits for yourself.

spells.name: The Queen's Rainbow
spells.description: You tell the story of the Queen of Bees and her retinue trying to pass through a rainbow on their way to visit the King of Spiders.

spells.name: Annunciation of the Outer Gate
spells.description: You announce yourself in the name of certain grim pacts that predate mortal life.

spells.name: 500 Toads
spells.description: You conjure hundreds of magical toads to fill the area and hop around.

spells.name: Burglar's Blind
spells.description: The only thing thieves love more than being silent and stealthy is the piles of gold they win with that silence and stealth.

spells.name: Far-Flung Fetch
spells.description: You can pilfer an object even if it's outside the reach of your fingers.

spells.name: Infiltrator's Tunnel
spells.description: It's best to know the ingress and egress points for any location you plan to rob.

spells.name: Benediction
spells.description: Divine protection helps protect your companions.

spells.name: Glamorize
spells.description: Using simple magical gestures, you alter a minor detail of your appearance.

spells.name: Malediction
spells.description: You incite distress in the minds of your enemies, making it more difficult for them to defend themselves.

spells.name: Clouded Focus
spells.description: You sharpen a creature's senses, though more distant objects become hazy, indistinct, or muted to it.

spells.name: Roar of the Dragon
spells.description: You channel the might of dragons into your voice, letting out a roar that engenders respect in dragonkind but that instills fear in most other creatures.

spells.name: Swear Oath
spells.description: You loudly and firmly state a course of action that you swear to fulfill.

spells.name: Chastising Retort
spells.description: You unleash some choice words empowered with divine might.

spells.name: Show the Path
spells.description: You grant the target insight on things to come, guiding them toward a fate they find most fitting and encouraging them to continue this journey.

spells.name: Ulcerous Canker
spells.description: Weeping sores open on the target as you expose it to decay, dealing 1d4 void damage and 1d4 poison damage plus 1 persistent bleed damage.

spells.name: Purging Toxins
spells.description: In the right dose, a scourge can become a cure.

spells.name: Accelerated Decomposition
spells.description: You speed the natural process of a creature's decline and debilitation.

spells.name: Entreat Spirit
spells.description: You invite a spirit you've bonded with to bolster your mind.

spells.name: Entreat the Many
spells.description: You manifest echoes of all the spirits you've ever bonded with at once, in a spiraling cyclone of colorful forms.

spells.name: Share Vision
spells.description: Your patron temporarily links your vision with that of another, causing both of you to be able to see through each other's eyes.

spells.name: Trade Death for Life
spells.description: Your patron steals life from one of your enemies to grant it to another.

spells.name: Bee-Man's Summons
spells.description: You recreate the Bee-Man's infamous ability to sense when someone utters their name.

spells.name: Fungal Exhalation
spells.description: You exhale toxic mold spores that fill the area.

spells.name: Hedge Prison
spells.description: You conjure an intricate hedge prison to trap a creature, encasing them completely in a hollow cube of dense bushes.

spells.name: Mushroom Patch
spells.description: You cause mushrooms to sprout in the area.

spells.name: Boomerang Shot
spells.description: You launch a curved length of wood at a foe that arcs around objects and obstacles to strike from an unexpected direction.

spells.name: Bramble Bush
spells.description: In a sudden burst of growth, you cause a thorned bush to sprout from the ground, lash around, and wither.

spells.name: Conjured Conveyance
spells.description: You conjure an intricate vehicle, carved entirely from wood, to serve as a method of conveyance.

spells.name: Cordyceps Command
spells.description: You conjure a mote of cordyceps spores uniquely tailored to the target before whisking it at them.

spells.name: Reed Whistle
spells.description: You enchant a blade of grass that you can easily hold in your mouth without inhibiting your speech or other actions.

spells.name: Reflected Beauty
spells.description: When you cast reflected beauty , choose a willing creature that's the same size as you and that you can see within 30 feet.

spells.name: Missed Cue
spells.description: You make the spell's target believe they had something incredibly important to say but forgot to say it, and now they've missed their opportunity.

spells.name: Musical Shift
spells.description: With a quick series of wrist flicks, music fills the air.

spells.name: Take Your Places
spells.description: The scene would play out exactly as you envisioned it, if only the actors would respect their blocking.

spells.name: Vibrant Vibrato
spells.description: Your voice trills in perfect vibrato.

spells.name: Ancestral Winds
spells.description: You call on the same energies that manifest ancestor storms, summoning wailing spirits to terrorize your foes.

spells.name: Mutilate
spells.description: You cut your own body in a ritualistic manner, causing similar damage to a creature in your line of sight.

spells.name: Strength of Mind
spells.description: You bolster your ally with reminders of their physical prowess, granting them additional defenses against harmful mental effects.

spells.name: Utter Destruction
spells.description: You screech with an unearthly voice made of destructive energy, smashing everything that lies before you.

spells.name: Tanglecurse
spells.description: Tanglebriar has been called a "curse on the land," which has inspired Treerazer's cult to develop this notorious spell.

spells.name: Ray of Corruption
spells.description: You unleash a sickly gray beam of toxic spores at your target.

spells.name: Dimensional Excision
spells.description: You manipulate the boundaries between planes like a scalpel, using it to cut away portions of a creature's essence and banishing those portions to other realities and dimensions, afflicting the target deep lacerations or even severed appendages.

spells.name: Trim the Blight
spells.description: You create a cone of shimmering energy that attempts to banish the influence of invasive, supernatural blight, such as that found in Tanglebriar.

spells.name: Avenging Wildwood
spells.description: Medium tree sprouts in an unoccupied square within range, its branches capable of striking out at your foes.

spells.name: Eagle's Cry
spells.description: You let out the mighty cry of a majestic eagle that pierces eardrums.

spells.name: Equal Footing
spells.description: You level the field between yourself and another creature, hampering its movements if it's quicker than you.

spells.name: Radiant Globe
spells.description: You create a dome of brilliant light that destroys projectiles attempting to pass through it.

spells.name: Unexpected Windfall
spells.description: Coins, trinkets carved from heavy stone, and other cumbersome treasures rain down upon a foe.

spells.name: Capital Dividend
spells.description: Through diet and other strict regimens, you've fortified your body as Kalistrade's teachings have fortified your mind.

spells.name: Attacked From Within
spells.description: You assert your power over the target's own spirit as you reach deep into its soul in order to discover a moment of excruciating anguish, debilitating humiliation, or abject despair.

spells.name: Defended By Spirits
spells.description: You entreat a spirit or the spiritual energies in your location to surround and protect an ally from an certain foe.

spells.name: Manifestation Of Spirits
spells.description: You open the target's eyes to the plethora of spirits surrounding it—and it sees all these spirits as menacing and powerful.

spells.name: Pain Of Ages
spells.description: You sense a spiritual resonance of deep anguish in the earth beneath your feet, the walls surrounding you, or the fragments of souls left behind in a place of calamity.

spells.name: Spirit Ward
spells.description: You draw on nearby spiritual energy or on echoes of the spirits you've invoked throughout your life to temporarily ward living flesh against dangerous spirits.

spells.name: Spiritual Renewal
spells.description: You draw upon the restorative power of the spirits around you.

spells.name: Spiritual Transport
spells.description: You call upon the spiritual energies surrounding you to teleport you to an unoccupied space within range that you can see.

spells.name: Veil Of Spirits
spells.description: You draw on the essence of spiritual energy surrounding you to manifest a misty veil.

spells.name: Menacing Lament
spells.description: You wail a dirge for your enemies.

spells.name: Valiant Anthem
spells.description: You chant a rallying cry to bolster your allies.

spells.name: Elemental Sheath
spells.description: You coat yourself in nature's power.

spells.name: Vicious Howl
spells.description: You howl with passion for your cause, empowering yourself to push beyond your limits.

spells.name: Friendly Push
spells.description: You exert magical force to propel a willing creature up to 10 feet in a straight line, including upward, though if they aren't on solid ground or have another way to maintain their height (such as a fly Speed) when the movement ends, they fall.

spells.name: Rapid Retreat
spells.description: You know how to swiftly escape from harm.

spells.name: Echo Jump
spells.description: You teleport to an unoccupied space within range, leaving behind a faint echo of your form that explodes with magical force.

spells.name: Forest of Gates
spells.description: You transport yourself and your allies to a peaceful extraplanar realm of towering trees, each of which holds a misty gateway to another location.

spells.name: King's Castle
spells.description: You and a willing creature swap places.

spells.name: Sudden Transposition
spells.description: You wrench the targets off their feet, forcefully teleporting them within the area.

spells.name: Trade Items
spells.description: You magically swap an item you're holding for another that someone else has.

spells.name: Warping Pull
spells.description: You get an ally out of danger with a teleporting pull.

spells.name: Conjured Clockwork
spells.description: You conjure a complex clockwork device on the ground and cause it to slowly spread across the battlefield.

spells.name: Augmented Body
spells.description: You magically augment your body with clockwork parts and magitech innovations.

spells.name: Shielding Formation
spells.description: You conjure magical shields of force to protect your allies around you.

spells.name: Barbed Spear
spells.description: You conjure a vicious barbed spear and hurl it at a foe.

spells.name: Wings of the Valkyrie
spells.description: Powerful feathered wings—usually vibrant white or jet black— emerge from your back, granting you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

spells.name: Let not the Fallen Rest
spells.description: You exhort your fallen comrades to return to the battle.

spells.name: Blinding Bottle
spells.description: You conjure an exploding glass container filled with a sightstealing poison and hurl it across enemy lines.

spells.name: Blister Bomb
spells.description: You launch a small bomb enchanted with a fast-acting skin disease at your foes, causing their skin to break out in horrible bleeding sores.

spells.name: Boots on the Ground
spells.description: You craft the illusion of your army being much bigger than it actually is, hoping to overwhelm the opposing forces and shatter their hopes.

spells.name: Clockwork Devotion
spells.description: You toss a handful of magical cogs before you, summoning a battalion of clockwork soldiers to fight your enemies.

spells.name: Conquering Soldiers
spells.description: You tap into the glories of the armies of old, bringing forth their might to your battlefield and making their strength and power your own.

spells.name: Curse of Recoil
spells.description: You curse an enemy to suffer a kickback as they make a ranged attack, potentially causing them to miss.

spells.name: Explosive Barrage
spells.description: You fire a booming, fiery explosion followed by a salvo of smaller blasts, each cracking the air with the sound of thunder.

spells.name: Fallen Soldier's Lament
spells.description: You raise an illusion in the space of a fallen foe, crafting it to resemble a ghost of your target before parading it across the battlefield.

spells.name: Filter Air
spells.description: You suck in a rough breath of air, and your body automatically filters out the harmful molecules that would infest your lungs.

spells.name: Frozen Fog
spells.description: You conjure a chilling mist that settles into the bones and makes it difficult to move.

spells.name: Helpful Reload
spells.description: With a quick gesture, you reload your ally's weapon, allowing them to focus on fighting the enemy.

spells.name: Holy Host
spells.description: In stories, armies with just and righteous causes win with little difficulty, conquering unholy legions.

spells.name: Instant Minefield
spells.description: You create several hidden mines throughout the area that explode when stepped on.

spells.name: Jassim's Allegiance
spells.description: You bartered for this spell in some strange market or perhaps gained it while wandering the desert, hopelessly lost and surrounded by nothing but the remnants of time and fallen empires.

spells.name: Pest Swarm
spells.description: Sometimes the most common irritations can band together and become threats to your enemies.

spells.name: Shock and Awe
spells.description: You create the illusion of cannons exploding, bullets and arrows flying, and magical ballistics firing, as an overwhelming torrent of information, both visual and auditory.

spells.name: Siege Weapon's Blessing
spells.description: You trace a magic rune onto the body of a siege weapon, calling upon fate or your faith to guide the attacks your allies make with this machine.

spells.name: Skeleton Army
spells.description: With a fistful of compressed bones, you summon a legion of skeletal hulks to fight in your war, refusing to let them rest until they've given up their last inches of usefulness to your cause.

spells.name: Steel Fortifications
spells.description: You conjure several metal structures that consist of angled beams attached to one another at a central point, which can help block attacks.

spells.name: Sticky Fire
spells.description: You send a bubble of viscous liquid that sparks into flame.

spells.name: Unholy Army
spells.description: Reaching out to the legions of the wicked, you call upon them for assistance.

spells.name: Funeral Flames
spells.description: You transform a bludgeon into a fearsome torch suited to casting undead into the afterlife.

spells.name: Pyrefowl Rebuke
spells.description: Fiery wings briefly envelop your arms, and with a swift wingbeat, you flutter away from your attacker in a shower of searing sparks.

spells.name: Crown of Prophets
spells.description: Serpents sprout from your head, equally ready to bite your foes or offer you counsel.

spells.name: Gift of the Anemos
spells.description: Your apparition envelops you in gusting winds that can speed your steps or buffet your foes.

spells.name: Armor of Thorn and Claw
spells.description: Razor-sharp thorns and claws erupt from your skin or scales.

spells.name: Blood-Feasting Breath
spells.description: Like a vorpal dragon, you absorb life with an inhale and release it with an exhale.

spells.name: Channel Arrogance
spells.description: You channel your heightened sense of self-worth into a creature, forcing them to acknowledge your true worth.

spells.name: Cloud Current
spells.description: Air and water vapor combine into a great cloud that funnels a powerful current within it.

spells.name: Divine Dragon's Watch
spells.description: You summon an invisible divine draconic spirit to watch over your target.

spells.name: Dragon Turret
spells.description: You conjure forth a massive tower with a large dragon that's bound to crawl its length.

spells.name: Earth and Sky
spells.description: You erupt into the air with the force of a dragon taking flight, launching nearby creatures into the sky with you.

spells.name: Horde of Underlings
spells.description: You summon six underlings, such as skeletons or kobolds.

spells.name: Orb of Twisting Fate
spells.description: The glass orb of an omen dragon erupts from your target's forehead, overwhelming their mind with alternative options.

spells.name: Wish Market
spells.description: You signal your willingness to make a deal, attracting ghostly merchants that eagerly and silently wave contracts for your consideration while demanding an esoteric price.

spells.name: Anchoring Air
spells.description: You solidify the air around an incoming attack, catching it in a vise-like grip

spells.name: Connective Current
spells.description: You create a magical connection between you and an enemy, as if you were both caught in the same current.

spells.name: Shipwreck
spells.description: You gesture toward a vehicle and the vessel wrenches itself apart.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.description: You create an area of water 20 feet deep.

spells.name: Whispers of a Dead Goddess
spells.description: The mysterious whispers that fill the Mordant Spire, which some believe to be the voice of the dead goddess Acavna, become audible.

spells.name: With Friends Like These
spells.description: You create a subtle dissonance between creatures, driving them apart. Each target must attempt a Will save.

spells.name: Amalgamizing Leap
spells.description: Teleport yourself and a foe into the same space, potentially fusing.

spells.name: Artistic Recollection
spells.description: You create a temporary oil painting.

spells.name: Begone
spells.description: Launch an adjacent foe away.

spells.name: Blessing of Vigor
spells.description: Grant an ally the gift of rapid healing.

spells.name: Blood Chestnuts
spells.description: You plant a draining seed inside of an opponent.

spells.name: Blood Runs Cold
spells.description: Slowly begin to freeze an opponent's blood.

spells.name: Bone Moth's Kiss
spells.description: You send a disease-ridden moth to infect an opponent.

spells.name: Bone Shield
spells.description: Create a bony shield.

spells.name: Burning Trail
spells.description: Your companion or eidolon leaves a fiery trail as they move.

spells.name: Calcium Rain
spells.description: Sharpened bones rain down from the sky.

spells.name: Chosen Gravity
spells.description: Alter gravity to allow the target to walk on walls and ceilings.

spells.name: Cinder Scribe
spells.description: Scribe a note that is only revealed with heat.

spells.name: Comet Charge
spells.description: Launch yourself before delivering a massive blow.

spells.name: Companion's Shadow
spells.description: Your companion's shadow helps them fight.

spells.name: Corpse Bloom
spells.description: Conjure clusters of poisonous fungi.

spells.name: Cradle Aloft
spells.description: Cause an item to float by your side.

spells.name: Create Earthen Facsimile
spells.description: Facsimile Mold earth into a simple form.

spells.name: Crucible of Iron
spells.description: Encase a creature in molten iron.

spells.name: Cryostasis
spells.description: Protect a dying creature by encasing them in ice.

spells.name: Crystallized Vapors
spells.description: Turn water vapor into many frozen attacks.

spells.name: Decompose
spells.description: Speed up the decaying process of a corpse.

spells.name: Defensive Prescience
spells.description: Twist fate to protect your familiar.

spells.name: Defy the Gods
spells.description: Drain away a creature's divine spark.

spells.name: Dimensional Drop
spells.description: Force an enemy to fall through a portal.

spells.name: Disintegrating Puddle
spells.description: Spit an acid puddle at a creature.

spells.name: Disorienting Flash
spells.description: With a flash and a bang, disorient your foes.

spells.name: Dome of Tranquility
spells.description: Create a safe area for secrets.

spells.name: Doom Mark
spells.description: Mark your foes, connecting their fates.

spells.name: Draw Blood
spells.description: Grow a mouth on your hand that can feed off your opponent's life energy.

spells.name: Earthbreaker Stride
spells.description: Create a tunnel as you walk.

spells.name: Electrostatic Glider
spells.description: Use static electricity to glide.

spells.name: Ember Doppelgänger
spells.description: A fiery duplicate joins the battle.

spells.name: Explosive Dust
spells.description: Scatter explosive dust in the air.

spells.name: Expunge Blood
spells.description: Remove the blood from an enemy.

spells.name: Familiar's Call
spells.description: Teleport your familiar back to your side.

spells.name: Familiar's Resurrection
spells.description: Return a familiar back to life.

spells.name: Far Reach
spells.description: Use portals to extend your reach.

spells.name: Fetch
spells.description: Teleport your familiar away to do a task before returning.

spells.name: Fiendish Rift
spells.description: Open a rift to an unholy realm.

spells.name: Fishing Spot
spells.description: Catch a fish that can bolster whoever eats it.

spells.name: Floating Harness
spells.description: Connect a harness to your companion, eidolon, or familiar.

spells.name: Force Rain
spells.description: Rain down shards of solid magic.

spells.name: Fractious Echo
spells.description: Make a Strike that separates the target's spirit from their body.

spells.name: Freezing Touch
spells.description: Freeze a creature with a single touch.

spells.name: Friends to Foes
spells.description: Sow distrust into the mind of an enemy.

spells.name: Frozen Lungs
spells.description: Freeze a creature's lungs.

spells.name: Fulminating Impact
spells.description: Charge your attacks with electric energy.

spells.name: Garden of Stone
spells.description: Raise a stalagmite surrounded by spiky stones.

spells.name: Ghost Rush
spells.description: Quickly move, ignoring obstacles in your path.

spells.name: Glacial Causeway
spells.description: Create a line of ice that you can glide upon.

spells.name: Glacial Skewer
spells.description: Launch an impaling ice spike at an enemy.

spells.name: Gleaming Pet
spells.description: Cause your companion or eidolon to glow with a blinding light.

spells.name: Glossolalia
spells.description: Scramble a creature's ability to speak.

spells.name: Gravity Wave
spells.description: Knock down foes with a wave of rippling gravity.

spells.name: Groom Companion
spells.description: Clean your companion or eidolon.

spells.name: Haunting Spirit
spells.description: Haunt an foe with a spirit only they can see.

spells.name: Heartbolt
spells.description: Launch an exploding bolt of vital energy.

spells.name: Helpful Scribe
spells.description: Conjure a quill that can copy written language.

spells.name: Hop, Skip, Jump
spells.description: Teleport to 3 spaces over the course of 3 rounds.

spells.name: Horizon's Veil
spells.description: Create an area of warped perception.

spells.name: Imprinting Hand
spells.description: Imprint your hand into a creature to thwart future healing.

spells.name: Incarnate Ancient Specter
spells.description: Summon an incarnate wraith that causes enemies to bow down and weep bloody tears.

spells.name: Incarnate Archmage
spells.description: Summon an incarnate archmage to fire magic missiles, stupefy foes, and tear away their spells.

spells.name: Incarnate Deific Herald
spells.description: Summon an incarnate representative of your deity, with effects depending on sanctification.

spells.name: Incarnate Draconic Legion
spells.description: Summon an incarnate legion of dragons to destroy your foes.

spells.name: Incarnate Faerie Revelers
spells.description: Summon an incarnate faerie revel that creates mischief and mischance.

spells.name: Incarnate Kaiju
spells.description: Summon an incarnate kaiju with effects depending on the specific kaiju.

spells.name: Incarnate Shadow Minuet
spells.description: Summon an incarnate of your own shadow that steals shadows and creates darkness.

spells.name: Incarnate Skeletal Giant
spells.description: Summon an incarnate giant skeleton that shakes the earth and attacks your foes.

spells.name: Incarnate Tempest of Shades
spells.description: Summon an incarnate storm of spirits that drains and frightens your foes.

spells.name: Incarnate Wild Rose
spells.description: Summon an incarnate giant rose that entangles foes and poisons the air.

spells.name: Inertia Lock
spells.description: Lock an object in its space with gravity.

spells.name: Infinitesimal Collapse Field
spells.description: Field Warp space and time around yourself to slow down enemies.

spells.name: Invent Code
spells.description: Invent a new language for you and the targets.

spells.name: Iron Rain
spells.description: Rain down iron blades upon your enemies.

spells.name: Lightning Lasso
spells.description: Bind a creature in an electric lasso.

spells.name: Lively Flight
spells.description: Create wings made of healing vital energy.

spells.name: Living Terrain
spells.description: Give life to the earth to destabilize your foes.

spells.name: Living Thunderbolt
spells.description: Transform yourself into a lightning bolt.

spells.name: Magnetize
spells.description: metal weapons and projectiles to your target.

spells.name: Metal Merged
spells.description: You weld your weapon to your hand.

spells.name: Metal Reverberation
spells.description: vibrate metal to make a painful sound.

spells.name: Metallic Meteorite Glyph
spells.description: Leave a mark on a creature that attracts one or more meteorites.

spells.name: Mist Sight
spells.description: Grant your target the ability to see through mist and fog.

spells.name: Murder of Crows
spells.description: Attack an enemy with a murder of crows.

spells.name: Overload Connection
spells.description: Send a flare of mental, damaging creatures between you and your familiar.

spells.name: Palm-Held Sun
spells.description: Create a tiny star in your space that imbues fire and light with life energy.

spells.name: Patron's Protector
spells.description: Transform your familiar into a fighting ally.

spells.name: Pierce the Sky
spells.description: Shoot three arrow-shaped thunderbolts that leave trails of electricity.

spells.name: Planar Collision
spells.description: Smash part of an elemental plane onto your foes.

spells.name: Plasma Whirl
spells.description: Teleport a blast of plasma onto the battlefield.

spells.name: Propelling Air Stream
spells.description: Fire a blast of air that lifts you off the ground.

spells.name: Proximal Shift
spells.description: Teleport yourself and part of your surroundings around you somewhere else.

spells.name: Psychic Outburst
spells.description: Psychic energy explodes around you.

spells.name: Puppet Strings
spells.description: Manipulate your target with ethereal strings.

spells.name: Reblooded
spells.description: Fill an undead creature with toxic blood.

spells.name: Remake Physiology
spells.description: Transform a creature's body into an amalgam of mismatched animal parts.

spells.name: Rend Magic
spells.description: Rend a creature's connection to magic.

spells.name: Restraining Chains
spells.description: Tie down a creature with a magical chain.

spells.name: Retrieving Hook
spells.description: Pull a creature toward you.

spells.name: Sacred Covenant
spells.description: Create a sacred pact with your allies that could save their lives.

spells.name: Shadow Strike
spells.description: Attack with a tendril of darkness.

spells.name: Shift Perspective
spells.description: See through a small object you throw.

spells.name: Sky Sight
spells.description: See the sky, wherever you might be.

spells.name: Skyglass Prison
spells.description: Solidify air into a glassy prison.

spells.name: Soul Cutter
spells.description: Cut the very soul of your enemy.

spells.name: Space Fold Gate
spells.description: Gate Fold space to connect two distant spaces.

spells.name: Speak with Magic
spells.description: Ask questions of a spell or magic item.

spells.name: Speak with Water
spells.description: Ask questions of a body of water or the rain.

spells.name: Spectral Blade
spells.description: Throw spectral blades that always return to your hands.

spells.name: Spiked Carapace
spells.description: Your arm becomes a bony weapon.

spells.name: Spontaneous Cartography
spells.description: Create a simple map of the area.

spells.name: Stars of Another Sky
spells.description: Sky Drag your enemies into the River of Souls.

spells.name: Stick On
spells.description: Stick yourself to a creature or object.

spells.name: Stop Heart
spells.description: Squeeze the heart of an adjacent enemy.

spells.name: Sudden Swarm
spells.description: Turn your familiar into a biting swarm.

spells.name: Tacky Pine Sap
spells.description: Throw flammable sap onto the ground.

spells.name: Tear the Veil
spells.description: Create a rift to the Void that sucks in living creatures.

spells.name: Tentacular Innervation
spells.description: Grab an enemy with sickening tentacles.

spells.name: Theogeny
spells.description: Create your own personal divine realm.

spells.name: Thunder Echo
spells.description: Discharge a loud burst of electrostatic that helps reveal secrets.

spells.name: Timely Reminder
spells.description: Send a message to your future self.

spells.name: Tiny Wings
spells.description: Grow a small pair of wings on your familiar.

spells.name: Tornadic Gale
spells.description: Pull creatures into a small tornado.

spells.name: Tracing Bond
spells.description: Keep tabs on an ally and signal if needed.

spells.name: Tracking Mayflies
spells.description: Send magic-eating mayflies with a ranged Strike.

spells.name: Tree of Life and Death
spells.description: Conjure a tree that heals and a tree that harms onto the battlefield.

spells.name: Uncover Device
spells.description: Use electricity to reveal the intricacies of a device.

spells.name: Unravel Existence
spells.description: Use reality to tear a creature apart.

spells.name: Unrelenting Gravity
spells.description: Increase the gravity a creature feels.

spells.name: Vampiric Revelry
spells.description: Steal the life of your enemies and perhaps share some with your allies.

spells.name: Vanish Weapon
spells.description: Disarm with an extradimensional hole.

spells.name: Vital Seed
spells.description: Plant a seed in a creature that drains the life of those nearby to heal the target.

spells.name: Warshard Shot
spells.description: Launch a piece of metal imbued with the spirit of the dead war god.

spells.name: Watchdog
spells.description: Have your companion guard a location.

spells.name: Weapon Tide
spells.description: Conjure a wave of dangerous weapons.

spells.name: Weight of the World
spells.description: Crush a creature with intense force.

spells.name: Widow's Bite
spells.description: Inject a creature with a dangerous poison.

spells.name: Call of the Quenching
spells.description: Legends say Aroden and Arazni called upon the Boundless Sea itself to defeat the fiery lizard Cuetzmonquali and the Army of Fire.

spells.name: The Everfull Moon
spells.description: You call upon the secret moon, who's always whole, to shine upon yourself, granting you the form of a mighty werewolf without letting the curse touch you.

spells.name: Pyroclastic Truth
spells.description: The blast of liquid fire created by this spell brands the soul of those who are touched by its flames.

spells.name: Under Sunless Skies
spells.description: The sun goes dark across the entire area of the spell, manipulating your enemies and giving your allies great resilience.

spells.name: Veil of Broken Reality
spells.description: All events that took place within the area are wiped from the memories of all creatures everywhere (including yourself and other excluded creatures), all records of the events are erased, and all attempts to receive any information about the events are automatically negated.

spells.name: Booming Blast
spells.description: Frighten your opponents with a terrifying gunshot.

spells.name: Conjurer's Countermeasure
spells.description: You quickly create a barrier that protects you against the magic of spellcraft.

spells.name: Force Fling
spells.description: A magical force echo of your weapon flies out to attack a foe.

spells.name: Bind Heroic Spirit
spells.description: You turn one of your thralls into a conduit to bind the spirit of a hero into your body.

spells.name: Blood Infusion
spells.description: You pull blood and other fluid from a thrall before embedding it into another creature.

spells.name: Bloody Tendrils
spells.description: You conjure forth stationary tentacles formed from pure, partially hardened blood.

spells.name: Blossoming Gore
spells.description: By spilling the blood of a thrall, you grow a large field of bloody roses that feeds on the life force of those around it and uses it to create thralls that do your bidding.

spells.name: Bone Spear
spells.description: You shape a thrall into a spear of jagged bone.

spells.name: Bony Barrage
spells.description: You shatter the skeleton of a thrall, creating a volley of teeth, vertebrae, and phalanges.

spells.name: Bridge of Graves
spells.description: You summon a bridge formed from grave dirt and tombstones that allow thralls to move with great speed.

spells.name: Calcification
spells.description: You transform a thrall into fine dust particles that invade a creature's body and begin transforming their body into a statue made of pure enhanced bone.

spells.name: Conglomerate of Limbs
spells.description: You conjure forth a humongous thrall consisting solely of undead severed limbs.

spells.name: Create Thrall
spells.description: You conjure forth the undead.

spells.name: Dead Weight
spells.description: You command a thrall to hurl itself on another creature, fusing their flesh together.

spells.name: Deathly Scream
spells.description: Your thrall lets forth a spectral scream that pierces the mind.

spells.name: Dread Mosquito Storm
spells.description: You release a plague of terrible undead mosquitoes over a massive area that exposes creatures to their necrotic blood disease.

spells.name: Flesh Tsunami
spells.description: You melt one of your thralls into a massive wave of sticky flesh.

spells.name: Life Tap
spells.description: Using a thrall as a siphon, you attempt to drain the life essence of a creature and use it to restore the life of yourself or an ally.

spells.name: Living Graveyard
spells.description: You conjure forth a walking bulk of graves and tombstones held together by the buried dead.

spells.name: Muscle Barrier
spells.description: You transform a thrall into layers of thick muscle that wrap around you or an ally, providing both protection and a boost to strength.

spells.name: Necrotic Bomb
spells.description: You overload one of your thralls with void energy, causing it to explode.

spells.name: Perfected Thrall
spells.description: You create a perfect thrall that's the conglomeration of all aspects of necromancy.

spells.name: Reanimate Foe
spells.description: You launch a thrall up to 30 feet into the corpse of an enemy that has been dead for no more than 1 minute, destroying the thrall in an effort to call the corpse to fight.

spells.name: Recurring Nightmare
spells.description: You conjure forth a ghostly thrall that isn't easily slain. You create a thrall within range, and you can create it in a space occupied by a creature.

spells.name: Sanguine Transference
spells.description: You diffuse your spirit into your blood before escaping your body and transferring your blood and soul into a thrall. You use the target thrall to reform your body in its space, and you leave a thrall where your body once was.

spells.name: Skeletal Lancers
spells.description: You conjure a force of skeletons wielding bony spears.

spells.name: Song of the Soul
spells.description: You shape a thrall into an instrument that plays a silent song that can be heard by only one soul.

spells.name: Temporary Possession
spells.description: You destroy the target thrall, using its destruction as a catalyst to temporarily possess an enemy.

spells.name: Thrall Charge
spells.description: You urge a thrall to move and attack.

spells.name: Zombie Horde
spells.description: You create a horde of nearly endless, but temporary, zombies.

spells.name: Appeal to Authority
spells.description: You implant a thought in your target's mind that resembles an authority figure in their life, influencing how they feel about you.

spells.name: Hot Air
spells.description: Your enemies are full of hot air, so you make their lungs burn when they try to talk.

spells.name: Fact Check
spells.description: You use your arcane knowledge to double-check the information learned.

spells.name: Unsettling Perspective
spells.description: You reach into a creature's mind and give them a glimpse of their place in the universe, learning how they perceive their position within society while damaging their mind with the truth of their insignificance relative to all of existence.

spells.name: Extradimensional Cover
spells.description: You've learned how to bring extradimensional spaces filled with debris into your current reality.

spells.name: Unbounded Sphere
spells.description: You magically desynchronize the current plane of existence, trapping creatures in an area that loops back on itself in the manner of an unbounded plane.

spells.name: Circle of Weakness
spells.description: You evoke a circle of floating inscriptions that creates and amplifies energy-based weaknesses on creatures inside the circle.

spells.name: Quantic Dampening
spells.description: You demonstrate exceptional control over elemental forces, allowing you to mitigate the effects of energy damage.
